Gulu lotchedwa Human Rights Defenders Coalition linati izi zinali zolakwika. Anati kusunga Namiwa m'ndende pomwe Boma silinatsutse belo kunali kosayenera. Anati linaswa malamulo okhudza milandu yolungama komanso yachangu.

Kwa banja la Namiwa ndi omutsatira ake, chigamulo cha Lachisanu n'chofunika kwambiri. Zingatanthauze kuti atuluka m'ndende kapena akukhalabe m'ndende. Mlandu wake wakopa chidwi chifukwa cha thanzi lake komanso nthawi yomwe wakhala akuyembekezera chigamulo cha khothi.

en.title: Maize price rises sharply in July across Malawi
en.body: The price of maize rose fast in July. It cost K791 per kilogramme, up from K731 in June. This is an eight percent rise. The Southern Region had the highest price at K866 per kg. The Central Region was K773 per kg. The Northern Region was K618 per kg. Imports helped stop prices from rising more.
en.body_more:
The International Food Policy Research Institute, called Ifpri, gave these numbers in their July report. A 50kg bag of maize cost K39,550 in July. In the same month last year, maize cost K1,169 per kg, much higher than now. Even so, experts say prices will keep rising soon.

Agnes Nyirongo works for the Centre for Social Concern. She said on Sunday that the price drop was not permanent. She said the government must fix farm problems. Irrigation is important. Climate-resistant crops help. Storage buildings and modern silos reduce waste. Warehouse receipt systems help farmers. "Without these things, poor families will suffer most," she said.

The Alliance for a Green Revolution, called Agra, gave a warning last week. They said maize will cost about K1,270 per kg from October 2026 to March 2027. Many things cause high prices: fertiliser costs more, seeds cost more, fuel is expensive, the kwacha is weak, and global markets push prices up. El Niño weather is also coming. When families run out of their own food, they must buy maize. High prices hurt them badly.

The government is helping. The 2026/27 budget gives K100 billion to the National Food Reserve Agency to buy maize. The Agriculture Development and Marketing Corporation Limited gets K60 billion to buy maize and fill markets. This helps keep prices down. Tobacco farmers earn less money now, and this hurts the whole economy.

ny.title: Mtengo wa chimanga wakwera kwambiri mu Julayi ku Malawi konse
ny.body: Mtengo wa chimanga unakwera mofulumira mu Julayi. Unakwera mtengo wa K791 pa kilogalamu, kuchokera pa K731 mu Juni. Uku ndi kukwera kwa magawo asanu ndi atatu. Chigawo cha Kumwera chinali ndi mtengo wapamwamba kwambiri wa K866 pa kg. Chigawo cha Pakati chinali K773 pa kg. Chigawo cha Kumpoto chinali K618 pa kg. Kutumiza kunja kunathandiza kuti mitengo isakwere kwambiri.
ny.body_more:
Bungwe la International Food Policy Research Institute, lotchedwa Ifpri, linapereka manambalawa mu lipoti lawo la Julayi. Thumba la chimanga la 50kg linagula K39,550 mu Julayi. Mwezi womwewo chaka chatha, chimanga chinagula K1,169 pa kg, zomwe ndi zokwera kwambiri kuposa pano. Ngakhale zili choncho, akatswiri amati mitengo ipitilira kukwera posachedwa.

Agnes Nyirongo amagwira ntchito ku Centre for Social Concern. Iye anati Lamlungu kuti kutsika kwa mitengo sikunali kosatha. Iye anati boma liyenera kukonza mavuto a ulimi. Kuthirira ndikofunikira. Mbewu zopirira nyengo zimathandiza. Nyumba zosungiramo zinthu ndi malo amakono osungiramo zinthu zimachepetsa zinyalala. Makina olandirira zinthu m'nyumba zosungiramo zinthu amathandiza alimi. "Popanda zinthuzi, mabanja osauka adzavutika kwambiri," adatero.

Alliance for a Green Revolution, yotchedwa Agra, inapereka chenjezo sabata yatha. Iwo anati chimanga chidzagula pafupifupi K1,270 pa kg kuyambira Okutobala 2026 mpaka Marichi 2027. Zinthu zambiri zimayambitsa mitengo yokwera: feteleza amawononga ndalama zambiri, mbewu zimawononga ndalama zambiri, mafuta ndi okwera mtengo, kwacha ndi yofooka, ndipo misika yapadziko lonse ikukweza mitengo. Nyengo ya El Niño ikubweranso. Mabanja akatha chakudya chawo, ayenera kugula chimanga. Mitengo yokwera imawapweteka kwambiri.

Boma likuthandiza. Bajeti ya 2026/27 imapereka K100 biliyoni ku National Food Reserve Agency kuti igule chimanga. Agriculture Development and Marketing Corporation Limited yapeza K60 biliyoni yogulira chimanga ndikudzaza misika. Izi zimathandiza kuti mitengo ichepetse. Alimi a fodya amapeza ndalama zochepa tsopano, ndipo izi zikuwononga chuma chonse.

en.title: Malawi power project misses third deadline
en.body: Malawi's plan to get power from Mozambique has failed again. The Mozambique-Malawi Interconnection Project was set to start by the end of July. It did not start. The country needs more power. Demand is over 700MW but only 551MW is available.
en.body_more:
The project was supposed to help Malawi get electricity from a neighboring country. It was first meant to start in October 2025. When that date passed, Energy Minister Jean Mathanga said it would start by February 2026. February came and went. During the recent parliamentary sitting, Mathanga set a new date: the end of July 2026. That date has now also passed. The government has not said when it will start.

Malawi is facing a big power shortage. Homes, hospitals, shops, farms and factories all face blackouts. The blackouts are becoming longer, more frequent and more disruptive. The country needs 150MW more power than it can make right now. People lose food when power cuts happen. Children cannot study. Businesses lose money. Manufacturers cannot make goods.

When asked about the delay, Mathanga did not give a clear answer. She said she would respond later. In the past, she said talks with Mozambique over price were the reason for delays. Malawi wanted lower prices so people would not pay more for electricity. But this raises a question: how long can Malawi wait for a fix while people suffer?

Energy expert Grain Malunga said the interconnection could help Malawi grow its factories and manufacturing. Business leaders have called unreliable power a major problem for doing business. The government knows the country needs more power. It has a project to fix this. But it has now missed three deadlines. Malawians are still waiting for answers.

ny.title: Ntchito yamagetsi ku Malawi yalephera kufika pa tsiku lomaliza lachitatu
ny.body: Dongosolo la Malawi lopeza magetsi kuchokera ku Mozambique lalephera kachiwiri. Ntchito yolumikizirana pakati pa Mozambique ndi Malawi idayenera kuyamba kumapeto kwa Julayi. Siinayambe. Dzikoli likufunika magetsi ochulukirapo. Kufunika kwa magetsi opitilira 700MW koma 551MW yokha ndi yomwe ilipo.
ny.body_more:
Ntchitoyi inkayenera kuthandiza Malawi kupeza magetsi kuchokera kudziko loyandikana nalo. Poyamba inkayenera kuyamba mu Okutobala 2025. Tsiku limenelo litadutsa, Nduna ya Zamagetsi Jean Mathanga inati iyamba pofika February 2026. February inafika ndipo inatha. Pa msonkhano waposachedwa wa nyumba yamalamulo, Mathanga anakhazikitsa tsiku latsopano: kumapeto kwa July 2026. Tsiku limenelo ladutsanso. Boma silinanene kuti liyamba liti.

Malawi akukumana ndi kusowa kwakukulu kwa magetsi. Nyumba, zipatala, masitolo, mafamu ndi mafakitale onse akukumana ndi kutsekedwa kwa magetsi. Kutsekedwa kwa magetsi kukukulirakulira, kumachitika kawirikawiri komanso kusokoneza kwambiri. Dzikoli likufunika mphamvu zambiri za 150MW kuposa momwe lingapangire pakali pano. Anthu amataya chakudya magetsi akatsekedwa. Ana sangaphunzire. Mabizinesi amataya ndalama. Opanga sangathe kupanga katundu.

Atafunsidwa za kuchedwa kumeneku, Mathanga sanapereke yankho lomveka bwino. Anati adzayankha pambuyo pake. M'mbuyomu, adati zokambirana ndi Mozambique pamitengo ndizo zomwe zinachititsa kuchedwa. Malawi imafuna mitengo yotsika kuti anthu asalipire ndalama zambiri zamagetsi. Koma izi zikubweretsa funso: kodi Malawi ingadikire nthawi yayitali bwanji kuti ikonzedwe pamene anthu akuvutika?

Katswiri wa zamagetsi Grain Malunga adati kulumikizanaku kungathandize Malawi kukulitsa mafakitale ake ndi zopangira. Atsogoleri amalonda ati magetsi osadalirika ndi vuto lalikulu pochita bizinesi. Boma likudziwa kuti dzikolo likufunika magetsi ambiri. Lili ndi pulojekiti yokonza izi. Koma tsopano lalephera masiku atatu omalizira. Anthu aku Malawi akuyembekezerabe mayankho.

en.title: Silver Strikers Ladies fly to Botswana for Champions League fight
en.body: Silver Strikers Ladies left Malawi on Wednesday for Gaborone, Botswana. They play in the CAF Women's Champions League Cosafa Qualifiers. This is their first time in this big competition. The team plays Costa do Sol of Mozambique on Friday.
en.body_more:
Silver Strikers are the new champions of the National Bank of Malawi Women's Premiership. They landed at Sir Seretse Khama International Airport in Gaborone. The team is in Group B with three other teams. The other teams are Mamelodi Sundowns of South Africa, Costa do Sol of Mozambique, and Nsingizini Hotspurs of Eswatini.

Silver Strikers' first game is against Costa do Sol on Friday. The top two teams in the group move on to the semi-finals. The whole competition ends on 30 August. The winner gets a place in the continental league.

Coach Andrew Chikhosi said the team is ready. "All the teams are champions of their own countries. But we have a good team that can compete," he said. The chief executive officer Patrick Chimimba said the team got what they needed. "We expect the best," he said. Cosafa also gave the team praise, calling them "debutants who arrive with a growing reputation."

Five players on the team played in the Women's Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco. The Malawi women's team was runners-up at that tournament. The five players are Ireen Khumalo, Tionge Phiri, Madyina Nguluwe, Chikondi Gondwe and Deborah Henry. One player, Deborah Henry, came straight from Morocco to join the team in Botswana.

ny.title: Silver Strikers Ladies yapita ku Botswana kukamenyana ndi Champions League
ny.body: Timu ya Silver Strikers Ladies idachoka ku Malawi Lachitatu kupita ku Gaborone, Botswana. Ikusewera mu mpikisano wa CAF Women's Champions League Cosafa Qualifiers. Iyi ndi nthawi yawo yoyamba mu mpikisano waukuluwu. Timuyi isewera ndi Costa do Sol ya ku Mozambique Lachisanu.
ny.body_more:
Silver Strikers ndi akatswiri atsopano a National Bank of Malawi Women's Premiership. Adafika pa Sir Seretse Khama International Airport ku Gaborone. Gululi lili mu Gulu B ndi magulu ena atatu. Magulu ena ndi Mamelodi Sundowns ya ku South Africa, Costa do Sol ya ku Mozambique, ndi Nsingizini Hotspurs ya ku Eswatini.

Masewera oyamba a Silver Strikers ndi motsutsana ndi Costa do Sol Lachisanu. Magulu awiri apamwamba m'gululi akupita ku semi-finals. Mpikisano wonse udzatha pa 30 Ogasiti. Wopambana amapeza malo mu continental ligi.

Mphunzitsi Andrew Chikhosi adati gululi lakonzeka. "Magulu onse ndi akatswiri a mayiko awo. Koma tili ndi gulu labwino lomwe lingapikisane," adatero. Mkulu wa bungweli Patrick Chimimba adati gululi lapeza zomwe likufuna. "Tikuyembekezera zabwino kwambiri," adatero. Cosafa idayamikanso gululo, ikuwatcha "oyamba omwe afika ndi mbiri yowonjezereka."

Osewera asanu m'gululi adasewera mu Women's Africa Cup of Nations ku Morocco. Gulu la azimayi la Malawi linali lachiwiri pa mpikisanowu. Osewera asanu ndi Ireen Khumalo, Tionge Phiri, Madyina Nguluwe, Chikondi Gondwe ndi Deborah Henry. Wosewera m'modzi, Deborah Henry, adachokera ku Morocco kudzalowa nawo timuyi ku Botswana.

en.title: Malawi needs more money from taxes at home
en.body: Minister of Finance Joseph Mwanamvekha visited the Malawi Revenue Authority in Lilongwe. He told tax workers to collect more money from people and businesses. He said Malawi must use domestic taxes more because donors give less money now.
en.body_more:
Mwanamvekha said free trade deals with other African countries will reduce customs taxes. Customs taxes are money the government gets from goods brought into the country. So Malawi must collect more from domestic taxes instead. Domestic taxes are taxes paid by people and businesses inside Malawi.

The minister said the Lilongwe tax station can collect more money. Many businesses and rental homes are in Lilongwe. "This station has more potential to make more revenue," Mwanamvekha said. He compared Lilongwe with the Southern Region. The Southern Region collects more, he noted.

MRA Commissioner General Felix Tambulasi said his workers are doing well. MRA is already over K20 billion ahead of its target. Tambulasi said MRA will finish the year above its K6.07 trillion target. "We are on the right path," he said. MRA must collect K6.2 trillion for the 2026/27 financial year. A financial year is a 12-month period used for money counting.

In June 2026, the government had a K349.9 billion surplus. A surplus is when money left over is more than money spent. This was the first surplus in more than one year. The 2026/27 National Budget is K11 trillion. Both leaders said digital tools will help collect more taxes and stop tax cheating. Mwanamvekha said tax increases should not hurt people already paying taxes.

ny.title: Malawi ikufunika ndalama zambiri kuchokera ku misonkho m'dziko muno
ny.body: Nduna ya Zachuma Joseph Mwanamvekha adapita ku Malawi Revenue Authority ku Lilongwe. Adauza ogwira ntchito zamisonkho kuti azisonkhanitsa ndalama zambiri kuchokera kwa anthu ndi mabizinesi. Adati Malawi iyenera kugwiritsa ntchito misonkho yapakhomo kwambiri chifukwa opereka ndalama amapereka ndalama zochepa tsopano.
ny.body_more:
Mwanamvekha anati mapangano amalonda aulere ndi mayiko ena aku Africa achepetsa misonkho ya misonkho. Misonkho ya misonkho ndi ndalama zomwe boma limapeza kuchokera ku katundu wobweretsedwa mdziko muno. Chifukwa chake Malawi iyenera kusonkhanitsa zambiri kuchokera ku misonkho yamkati m'malo mwake. Misonkho yamkati ndi misonkho yoperekedwa ndi anthu ndi mabizinesi mkati mwa Malawi.

Ndunayo inati siteshoni yamisonkho ya Lilongwe ikhoza kusonkhanitsa ndalama zambiri. Mabizinesi ambiri ndi nyumba zobwereka zili ku Lilongwe. "Siteshoni iyi ili ndi kuthekera kopeza ndalama zambiri," adatero Mwanamvekha. Anayerekeza Lilongwe ndi Chigawo cha Kumwera. Chigawo cha Kumwera chimasonkhanitsa zambiri, adatero.

Commissioner General wa MRA Felix Tambulasi anati antchito ake akuchita bwino. MRA ili kale ndi K20 biliyoni patsogolo pa cholinga chake. Tambulasi adati MRA idzamaliza chakachi pamwamba pa cholinga chake cha K6.07 trillion. "Tili panjira yoyenera," adatero. MRA iyenera kusonkhanitsa K6.2 trillion pachaka chachuma cha 2026/27. Chaka chachuma ndi nthawi ya miyezi 12 yomwe imagwiritsidwa ntchito powerengera ndalama.

Mu June 2026, boma linali ndi K349.9 biliyoni yowonjezera. Ndalama zotsala ndi pamene ndalama zotsala zimakhala zambiri kuposa ndalama zomwe zinagwiritsidwa ntchito. Iyi inali ndalama zotsala koyamba m'zaka zoposa chimodzi. Bajeti ya Dziko ya 2026/27 ndi K11 trilioni. Atsogoleri onse awiri adati zida za digito zithandiza kusonkhanitsa misonkho yambiri ndikuletsa chinyengo cha misonkho. Mwanamvekakha adati kukweza misonkho sikuyenera kuvulaza anthu omwe alipira kale misonkho.

en.title: Court stops group from removing MCP secretary general
en.body: Malawi's High Court has blocked a group from suspending the Malawi Congress Party secretary general. Justice William Yakuwawa Msiska made the order on Wednesday. The group called itself the MCP Veteran Management Committee. It tried to remove Richard Chimwendo Banda from his job.
en.body_more:
The group stormed MCP headquarters last Tuesday. They said Chimwendo Banda was to blame for the party's loss in the 2025 general election. Party leader Lazarus Chakwera lost power to Peter Mutharika of the Democratic Progressive Party. The court said the group had no right to suspend Chimwendo Banda. An injunction is a court order that stops someone from doing something. The MCP's legal director, George Kadzipatike, asked the court for help. He said the group had no power under the party's rules.

The court named ten people as defendants. Their names are William Phakamisa, Frank Chatanga, Dyson Simsamala, Jaji Banda, Mizeck Masula, Eliya Kadula, Ernest Soko, Chaponda Chizwa, Mai Kanyemba and Dzeke Dzeke. The judge told them to stop all work at MCP headquarters at once. The court also said they could not lock the party building or take control of it.

The order keeps the ten people from using any power to fire, suspend or remove members of the party's National Executive Committee. This is a group that runs the MCP between big meetings. The court said they must not stop the secretary general from doing his job. The order also stops them from closing, locking or blocking the MCP office and from taking powers that belong only to the National Executive Committee or to the party's national convention. This crisis shows how much trouble the MCP faces after its election defeat.

ny.title: Khoti laletsa gululo kuchotsa mlembi wamkulu wa chipani cha MCP
ny.body: Khothi Lalikulu ku Malawi laletsa gulu lina kuti lisayimitse mlembi wamkulu wa chipani cha Malawi Congress. Woweruza William Yakuwawa Msiska adapereka lamuloli Lachitatu. Gululo lidadzitcha kuti ndi Komiti Yoyang'anira Akale a MCP. Lidayesa kuchotsa Richard Chimwendo Banda pa ntchito yake.
ny.body_more:
Gululo linalowa m'malo oikulu a MCP Lachiwiri lapitali. Anati Chimwendo Banda ndiye amene anachititsa kuti chipanichi chitayike pa chisankho chachikulu cha 2025. Mtsogoleri wa chipanichi Lazarus Chakwera anataya mphamvu kwa Peter Mutharika wa chipani cha Democratic Progressive Party. Khotilo linati gululo lilibe ufulu woimitsa Chimwendo Banda. Lamulo la khoti ndi lamulo loletsa munthu kuchita zinazake. Woyang'anira zamalamulo wa MCP, George Kadzipatike, anapempha khotilo kuti limuthandize. Anati gululo lilibe mphamvu motsatira malamulo a chipanicho.

Khotilo linatchula anthu khumi ngati otsutsa. Mayina awo ndi William Phakamisa, Frank Chatanga, Dyson Simsamala, Jaji Banda, Mizeck Masula, Eliya Kadula, Ernest Soko, Chaponda Chizwa, Mai Kanyemba ndi Dzeke Dzeke. Woweruzayo anawauza kuti asiye ntchito yonse ku likulu la MCP nthawi imodzi. Khotilo linanenanso kuti sangatseke nyumba ya chipanicho kapena kuilamulira.

Lamuloli limaletsa anthu khumiwo kugwiritsa ntchito mphamvu iliyonse kuchotsa, kuyimitsa kapena kuchotsa mamembala a Komiti Yaikulu Yapadziko Lonse ya chipanicho. Ili ndi gulu lomwe limayendetsa MCP pakati pa misonkhano ikuluikulu. Khotilo linati sayenera kuletsa mlembi wamkulu kugwira ntchito yake. Lamuloli limawaletsanso kutseka, kutseka kapena kuletsa ofesi ya MCP komanso kutenga mphamvu zomwe zili za Komiti Yoyang'anira Yadziko Lonse kapena za msonkhano wadziko lonse wa chipanicho. Vutoli likuwonetsa mavuto omwe MCP ikukumana nawo pambuyo poti yagonjetsedwa pa chisankho.

en.title: Judge tells male police officers to speak about mental health
en.body: A High Court judge told male police officers to stop hiding their feelings and ask for help. Justice Chifundo Kachale spoke on Monday at Area 3 police offices in Lilongwe. He said police work and money problems cause stress. But officers do not talk about it because of police culture.
en.body_more:
Kachale told the men it is OK to cry. He said even Jesus wept. Officers should talk to their wives and trusted friends about their problems. He also told married officers to tell their wives how much money they earn. He said wives should start small businesses to help the family.

The judge spoke at the first men's conference organised by Central West Region Police. Many male officers from Lilongwe came to listen. Mental health expert Mark Chalamanda also spoke. He told officers not to think about past mistakes. He said they should focus on the present and on their good qualities. This helps them cope with stress and sadness.

Pastor Reuben Chilera warned officers against affairs outside marriage. He said affairs add more stress and problems. Central West Region Police operations officer Hanleck Chingolo said the talk was needed. Police officers face many hard things at work. These problems hurt their lives at home and their jobs. Many officers do not speak about their struggles because of shame. This conference helps officers see it is good to speak openly about feelings and mental health. Police work is hard and can cause trauma. Officers need support.

ny.title: Woweruza akuuza apolisi achimuna kuti alankhule za thanzi la maganizo
ny.body: Woweruza milandu wa Khoti Lalikulu adauza apolisi achimuna kuti asiye kubisa malingaliro awo ndikupempha thandizo. Woweruza milandu Chifundo Kachale adalankhula Lolemba ku maofesi apolisi a Area 3 ku Lilongwe. Iye adati ntchito ya apolisi ndi mavuto azachuma zimayambitsa nkhawa. Koma apolisi salankhula za izi chifukwa cha chikhalidwe cha apolisi.
ny.body_more:
Kachale anauza amunawo kuti palibe vuto kulira. Anati ngakhale Yesu analira. Apolisi ayenera kulankhula ndi akazi awo ndi anzawo odalirika za mavuto awo. Anauzanso apolisi okwatira kuti auze akazi awo ndalama zomwe amapeza. Anati akazi ayenera kuyambitsa mabizinesi ang'onoang'ono kuti athandize banja.

Woweruzayo analankhula pamsonkhano woyamba wa amuna womwe unakonzedwa ndi Apolisi a Central West Region. Apolisi ambiri aamuna ochokera ku Lilongwe anabwera kudzamvetsera. Katswiri wa zaumoyo wamaganizo Mark Chalamanda nayenso analankhula. Anauza apolisi kuti asaganizire za zolakwa zakale. Anati ayenera kuyang'ana kwambiri pa zomwe zikuchitika panopa komanso makhalidwe awo abwino. Izi zimawathandiza kuthana ndi nkhawa ndi chisoni.

M'busa Reuben Chilera anachenjeza apolisi kuti asachite zinthu zomwe sizili m'banja. Anati nkhani zimawonjezera nkhawa ndi mavuto. Mkulu wa apolisi a Central West Region, Hanleck Chingolo, anati nkhaniyo ikufunika. Apolisi amakumana ndi zinthu zambiri zovuta kuntchito. Mavutowa amavulaza miyoyo yawo kunyumba ndi ntchito zawo. Apolisi ambiri salankhula za mavuto awo chifukwa cha manyazi. Msonkhanowu umathandiza apolisi kuona kuti ndi bwino kulankhula momasuka za malingaliro ndi thanzi la maganizo. Ntchito ya apolisi ndi yovuta ndipo ingayambitse kuvulala. Apolisi amafunika thandizo.

en.title: MACRA warns against sharing intimate videos without consent
en.body: Malawi's communications watchdog has warned against sharing intimate videos without permission. The Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority (MACRA) says this breaks the Data Protection Act, 2024. People who share such videos risk fines and prison time. MACRA acts as the country's Data Protection Authority.
en.body_more:
MACRA says recording, publishing or sharing intimate videos without consent is illegal. The videos have been spread on social media and online platforms. The people in the videos did not agree to this sharing. MACRA warned that breaking the Data Protection Act can lead to big penalties.

Under the law, a person who records or shares intimate content without permission may face a fine of up to K20 million. This is an administrative penalty. Penalty means a punishment for breaking a rule. If a person has information they know was obtained illegally and then shares it, they commit a crime. Crime is an action that breaks the law. A person found guilty of this crime may face a fine of up to K20 million and prison time of up to five years.

MACRA also reminded people about another law. Sharing pornographic material through online systems is illegal under the Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act, 2016. Pornographic means showing sexual acts. A person convicted under this law faces a fine of K10 million and up to fifteen years in prison.

MACRA has asked anyone who shared these videos to remove them from all platforms immediately. The authority also called on all people to respect the privacy and dignity of others. Privacy means keeping personal information secret. MACRA said people must stop sharing personal information without permission. The warning was issued on 18 August 2026 by MACRA Director General Dr Mayamiko Nkoloma.

ny.title: MACRA yachenjeza kuti isawonetse mavidiyo achinsinsi popanda chilolezo
ny.body: Bungwe loona za mauthenga ku Malawi lachenjeza kuti lisawonetse mavidiyo achinsinsi popanda chilolezo. Bungwe loona za mauthenga ku Malawi (MACRA) lati izi zikuphwanya lamulo la Data Protection Act, 2024. Anthu omwe amawonetsa mavidiyo oterewa ali pachiwopsezo cha chindapusa komanso kutsekeredwa m'ndende. MACRA imagwira ntchito ngati bungwe loona za chitetezo cha deta mdzikolo.
ny.body_more:
MACRA ikunena kuti kujambula, kufalitsa kapena kugawana makanema apachibwenzi popanda chilolezo n'koletsedwa. Makanemawa afalikira pa malo ochezera a pa Intaneti komanso pa intaneti. Anthu omwe ali m'mavidiyowa sanavomereze kugawana kumeneku. MACRA yachenjeza kuti kuswa lamulo la Data Protection Act kungayambitse zilango zazikulu.

Motsatira lamuloli, munthu amene amalemba kapena kugawana zinthu zapachibwenzi popanda chilolezo akhoza kulipidwa chindapusa cha K20 miliyoni. Ichi ndi chilango cha oyang'anira. Chilango chimatanthauza chilango chophwanya lamulo. Ngati munthu ali ndi chidziwitso chomwe akudziwa kuti chinapezeka mosaloledwa kenako n’kugawana, amachita upandu. Upandu ndi mlandu womwe umaphwanya lamulo. Munthu amene wapezeka ndi mlanduwu akhoza kulipidwa chindapusa cha K20 miliyoni ndi kundende kwa zaka zisanu.

MACRA yakumbutsanso anthu za lamulo lina. Kugawana zinthu zolaula kudzera pa intaneti n'koletsedwa motsatira Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act, 2016. Zolaula zimatanthauza kuwonetsa zachiwerewere. Munthu amene wapezeka ndi mlandu motsatira lamuloli akuyenera kulipidwa chindapusa cha K10 miliyoni ndi kundende kwa zaka khumi ndi zisanu.

MACRA yapempha aliyense amene wagawana makanemawa kuti awachotse pamapulatifomu onse nthawi yomweyo. Akuluakuluwo adapemphanso anthu onse kuti azilemekeza zachinsinsi ndi ulemu wa ena. Zachinsinsi zikutanthauza kusunga chinsinsi cha chidziwitso chaumwini. MACRA idati anthu ayenera kusiya kugawana zambiri zawo popanda chilolezo. Chenjezoli lidaperekedwa pa 18 Ogasiti 2026 ndi Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa MACRA Dr Mayamiko Nkoloma.

en.title: Malawi Scorchers get heroes' welcome home from WAFCON
en.body: Malawi's women's football team, the Scorchers, came home on Wednesday, 19 August 2026. They played in the Women's Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco. The team finished second. First Lady Gertrude Mutharika led a big welcome at Kamuzu International Airport. A military parade and brass band greeted the players.
en.body_more:
The Scorchers reached the WAFCON final for the first time ever. They lost 3-0 to Cameroon in the final in Rabat, Morocco, on Sunday. But the team also did something very important: they qualified for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil. This is Malawi's first time ever at a World Cup.

The Ministry of Youth, Sports and Culture said the team earned a big welcome home. Macmillan Mwale, a spokesman, told the press: "The Scorchers deserve to be appreciated by the country. We want to give them the best reception." The parade went from the airport through Kanengo to Area 18. The Malawi Defence Force Band played music. Many groups joined the welcome: Lilongwe City Council, the Football Association of Malawi, the Malawi National Council of Sports, the Malawi Police Service, and National Bank of Malawi, the team's sponsor.

The Scorchers played very well at WAFCON. They beat Nigeria 3-2, Egypt 3-1, and Algeria 3-1 in the semi-final. They lost only to Zambia 1-2 but still moved forward in the tournament. Fleetwood Haiya, the Football Association chief, said the team's success came from a plan made on May 18, 2025. The Football Association has a 10-year plan from 2024 to 2034. Haiya said: "We want to conquer Africa and compete on the world stage." The team will use the Olympic Games qualifiers in October to get ready for the World Cup.

Sports analyst Enock Banda said the government was right to celebrate the team. He said the Scorchers made Malawi famous in Africa and the world.

ny.title: Malawi Scorchers yalandiridwa ndi ngwazi kunyumba kuchokera ku WAFCON
ny.body: Gulu la mpira wa azimayi la Malawi, a Scorchers, linabwera kunyumba Lachitatu, pa 19 Ogasiti 2026. Linasewera mu mpikisano wa Women's Africa Cup of Nations ku Morocco. Gululi linamaliza lachiwiri. Mkazi woyamba Gertrude Mutharika anatsogolera kulandira bwino osewera ku Kamuzu International Airport. Gulu lankhondo ndi gulu la oimba nyimbo za brass linalandira osewerawo.
ny.body_more:
A Scorchers adafika pa mpikisano wa WAFCON koyamba. Adagonja 3-0 ndi Cameroon pa mpikisano womaliza ku Rabat, Morocco, Lamlungu. Koma gululi lidachitanso chinthu chofunikira kwambiri: adayenerera mpikisano wa FIFA Women's World Cup wa 2027 ku Brazil. Iyi ndi nthawi yoyamba ku Malawi ku World Cup.

Unduna wa Achinyamata, Masewera ndi Chikhalidwe unati gululi lalandiridwa bwino kwambiri kunyumba. Macmillan Mwale, wolankhulira, adauza atolankhani kuti: "A Scorchers ayenera kuyamikiridwa ndi dzikolo. Tikufuna kuwalandira bwino kwambiri." Ulendowu udachitika kuchokera ku eyapoti kudzera ku Kanengo kupita ku Area 18. Gulu la Malawi Defence Force Band lidasewera nyimbo. Magulu ambiri adalowa nawo mpikisano wolandila: Lilongwe City Council, Football Association of Malawi, Malawi National Council of Sports, Malawi Police Service, ndi National Bank of Malawi, omwe ndi othandizira gululi.

A Scorchers adasewera bwino kwambiri ku WAFCON. Adagonjetsa Nigeria 3-2, Egypt 3-1, ndi Algeria 3-1 pa semi-final. Iwo adagonja ndi Zambia 1-2 koma adapitilizabe patsogolo mu mpikisano. Fleetwood Haiya, mkulu wa Football Association, adati kupambana kwa timuyi kudachokera ku dongosolo lomwe lidapangidwa pa Meyi 18, 2025. Football Association ili ndi dongosolo la zaka 10 kuyambira 2024 mpaka 2034. Haiya adati: "Tikufuna kugonjetsa Africa ndikupikisana padziko lonse lapansi." Gululi lidzagwiritsa ntchito masewera oyeserera Masewera a Olimpiki mu Okutobala kuti likonzekere World Cup.

Katswiri wa zamasewera Enock Banda adati boma linali lolondola kukondwerera timuyi. Iye adati Scorchers adapangitsa Malawi kutchuka ku Africa ndi padziko lonse lapansi.

en.title: Real Estate Council Still Not Working in Malawi
en.body: A council to manage the real estate market in Malawi is not yet working. The Real Estate Management Council was created by law in January 2025. It should check agents and protect buyers. But many months later, it is still not running. Minister Chimwemwe Chipungu said the government is still sorting out problems.
en.body_more:
The Real Estate Management Act of 2024 made the council. It was supposed to start in January 2025. The council will give licenses to agents. It will set rules for how agents must work. It will help buyers and renters stay safe from fraud. But the council has not started yet.

The ministry said it would be ready by July or mid-August. Now it says it must wait for more steps. First, the council must be gazetted. This means it must be printed in the official government news. Second, it must be opened formally. Only then can it do its work. The ministry says it is still doing these steps.

Real estate consultant Prince Machika says this is a big problem. He cannot get a license to work because the council is not open. Bad agents are taking money from people who want to buy or rent homes. Malawi does not have enough cheap houses. This makes the problem worse. Machika says the answer is to build more cheap homes. He also says all agents must follow the same rules.

Many people in cities like Lilongwe and Blantyre need homes. They pay high rents. Some homes are not safe. Without a council to check agents, bad people can cheat buyers and renters. The ministry says it will move fast to finish the work. But people are waiting and hope it will start before the year ends.

ny.title: Bungwe la Malo Ogulitsa Nyumba Silikugwirabe Ntchito ku Malawi
ny.body: Bungwe loyang'anira msika wa malo ku Malawi silikugwira ntchito. Bungwe Loyang'anira Malo linakhazikitsidwa ndi lamulo mu Januwale 2025. Liyenera kuyang'anira othandizira ndikuteteza ogula. Koma patatha miyezi yambiri, silikugwirabe ntchito. Nduna Chimwemwe Chipungu adati boma likukonzabe mavuto.
ny.body_more:
Lamulo la Kusamalira Nyumba la 2024 ndi lomwe linapanga bungweli. Linayenera kuyamba mu Januwale 2025. Bungweli lipereka zilolezo kwa othandizira. Lidzakhazikitsa malamulo a momwe othandizira ayenera kugwirira ntchito. Lidzathandiza ogula ndi obwereka kuti asachite zachinyengo. Koma bungweli silinayambebe.

Unduna unati udzakhala wokonzeka pofika mu Julayi kapena pakati pa Ogasiti. Tsopano ukunena kuti uyenera kudikira masitepe ena. Choyamba, bungweli liyenera kulembedwa mu gazette. Izi zikutanthauza kuti liyenera kusindikizidwa m'nkhani zaboma. Chachiwiri, liyenera kutsegulidwa mwalamulo. Pokhapokha lingathe kugwira ntchito yake. Undunawu ukunena kuti ukuchitabe masitepe awa.

Katswiri wa zamalonda Prince Machika akuti ili ndi vuto lalikulu. Sangapeze chilolezo chogwira ntchito chifukwa bungweli silinatsegulidwe. Othandizira oipa akutenga ndalama kwa anthu omwe akufuna kugula kapena kubwereka nyumba. Malawi ilibe nyumba zokwanira zotsika mtengo. Izi zikuwonjezera vutoli. Machika akuti yankho lake ndikumanga nyumba zotsika mtengo. Amanenanso kuti othandizira onse ayenera kutsatira malamulo omwewo.

Anthu ambiri m'mizinda ngati Lilongwe ndi Blantyre amafunikira nyumba. Amalipira lendi yokwera. Nyumba zina sizili zotetezeka. Popanda bungwe loyang'anira othandizira, anthu oipa amatha kubera ogula ndi obwereketsa. Undunawu umati uchitapo kanthu mwachangu kuti umalize ntchitoyi. Koma anthu akudikira ndipo akuyembekeza kuti iyamba chaka chisanathe.

en.title: Malawi's Insurance Sector Misses Farmers as El Niño Looms
en.body: Malawi's insurance sector is not helping farmers. Agricultural insurance covers less than one tenth of the insurance market. Motor insurance is much bigger. Wales Meja, head of the Insurance Association of Malawi, said this is a problem. El Niño weather is coming. It could hurt farms and the economy.
en.body_more:
Most Malawi farmers are small farmers. They grow food for their families, not for sale. These farmers cannot pay for insurance without help. Meja said the government and other helpers must pay part of the cost. This is called a subsidy. A subsidy is money that makes something cheaper.

El Niño is a weather change. The African Development Bank says El Niño could destroy up to 20 billion dollars of crops worldwide. Malawi's farms depend on rain. Rain that does not come will hurt many people. Marvin Banda is an economist. An economist is a person who studies money and business. Banda said that agriculture employs more than eighty out of every one hundred Malawians. If only less than one tenth of farmers have insurance, what happens to the rest when rain does not come? Banda asked.

However, Tamani Nkhono Mvula, an agriculture policy analyst, said insurance works best for big farms that sell crops for money. Small farms are harder to insure. Many farmers do not know what insurance is or what it can do. They need more education.

In August 2024, Malawi got good news. The African Risk Capacity and the African Development Bank paid the government 11.2 million dollars. This money came from insurance. It helped more than 350,000 families with food and cash. Now the Ministry of Agriculture will start a new project. It is called Index-Based Crop Insurance. The African Development Bank will pay for it. This project will help farmers get insurance and grow back.

ny.title: Makampani a Inshuwalansi ku Malawi Akusowa Alimi Chifukwa cha El Niño
ny.body: Gawo la inshuwaransi ku Malawi silikuthandiza alimi. Inshuwaransi yaulimi imaphimba ndalama zosakwana gawo limodzi mwa magawo khumi a msika wa inshuwaransi. Inshuwaransi yamagalimoto ndi yayikulu kwambiri. Wales Meja, mtsogoleri wa bungwe la Inshuwaransi la Malawi, anati ili ndi vuto. Nyengo ya El Niño ikubwera. Ikhoza kuwononga minda ndi chuma.
ny.body_more:
Alimi ambiri aku Malawi ndi alimi ang'onoang'ono. Amalima chakudya cha mabanja awo, osati chogulitsa. Alimi awa sangalipire inshuwalansi popanda thandizo. Meja anati boma ndi othandizira ena ayenera kulipira gawo la ndalamazo. Izi zimatchedwa subsidy. Subsidy ndi ndalama zomwe zimapangitsa chinthu kukhala chotsika mtengo.

El Niño ndi kusintha kwa nyengo. African Development Bank ikunena kuti El Niño ikhoza kuwononga mbewu zokwana madola mabiliyoni 20 padziko lonse lapansi. Minda ya ku Malawi imadalira mvula. Mvula yomwe sibwera idzavulaza anthu ambiri. Marvin Banda ndi katswiri wazachuma. Katswiri wazachuma ndi munthu amene amaphunzira ndalama ndi bizinesi. Banda adati ulimi umagwiritsa ntchito anthu oposa makumi asanu ndi atatu mwa alimi zana aliwonse aku Malawi. Ngati alimi ochepera gawo limodzi mwa khumi ali ndi inshuwalansi, chimachitika ndi chiyani kwa ena onse mvula ikapanda kubwera? Banda anafunsa.

Komabe, Tamani Nkhono Mvula, katswiri wa mfundo zaulimi, anati inshuwalansi imagwira ntchito bwino kwambiri m'mafamu akuluakulu omwe amagulitsa mbewu ndi ndalama. Minda yaying'ono ndi yovuta kuipereka inshuwalansi. Alimi ambiri sadziwa kuti inshuwalansi ndi chiyani kapena ingachite chiyani. Amafunika maphunziro ambiri.

Mu Ogasiti 2024, Malawi idalandira nkhani yabwino. Bungwe la African Risk Capacity ndi African Development Bank adalipira boma ndalama zokwana madola 11.2 miliyoni. Ndalamazi zidachokera ku inshuwaransi. Zathandiza mabanja opitilira 350,000 ndi chakudya ndi ndalama. Tsopano Unduna wa Zaulimi uyambitsa pulojekiti yatsopano. Imatchedwa Index-Based Crop Insurance. African Development Bank idzalipira. Pulojekitiyi ithandiza alimi kupeza inshuwaransi ndikuyambiranso kukula.

en.title: Activist Namiwa's charity risks being shut down
en.body: The Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives (CDEDI) faces deregistration. The organisation has not filed reports to the NGO Regulatory Authority (NGORA) for two years. CDEDI's boss is Sylvester Namiwa, an activist currently in jail. He was arrested on 30 July 2026 on treason charges.
en.body_more:
Under Section 22 of the NGO Act, all registered NGOs must submit three documents each year: an Annual Activity Report, Audited Financial Statements, and an Annual Return Report. Organisations that do not submit these documents face a fine of K1 million and may be deregistered. NGORA gave CDEDI extra time. The original deadline was 30 June 2026, but this was extended to 31 July 2026. CDEDI did not submit the papers by either date.

Namiwa has been locked up for three weeks as he waits for the High Court to make a decision on his bail. He was arrested on 30 July 2026 and charged with treason and publishing false news. A judge heard his bail application on 13 August. The government asked the court to set bail at K2 million. Namiwa's lawyer, Gift Mwenye, said this amount is too high. The defence suggested K500,000 instead, saying Namiwa cannot pay K2 million.

While in custody, Namiwa became ill and was taken to ABC Hospital in Lilongwe. He was discharged on Sunday and returned to Maula Prison. The charges come from statements Namiwa made in a television interview with Luntha Television. He claimed that First Vice-President Jane Ansah would become President within two months. He also said certain members of the ruling DPP had hired people from Dzaleka to attack others.

Namiwa now faces two serious problems at the same time. His freedom depends on the bail decision from the High Court. His organisation, CDEDI, may be shut down because of the missing reports. This adds more pressure to the activist as he waits for the court to rule.

ny.title: Bungwe lothandiza anthu lotchedwa Namiwa likhoza kutsekedwa
ny.body: Bungwe la Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives (CDEDI) likuyenera kuchotsedwa m'kaundula. Bungweli silinapereke malipoti ku bungwe la NGO Regulatory Authority (NGORA) kwa zaka ziwiri. Bwana wa CDEDI ndi Sylvester Namiwa, womenyera ufulu wa anthu amene ali m'ndende pakali pano. Anamangidwa pa 30 Julayi 2026 chifukwa cha milandu yokhudza kuukira boma.
ny.body_more:
Malinga ndi Gawo 22 la NGO Act, ma NGO onse olembetsedwa ayenera kupereka zikalata zitatu chaka chilichonse: Lipoti la Ntchito Yapachaka, Malipoti a Zachuma Owunikidwa, ndi Lipoti la Kubweza Pachaka. Mabungwe omwe sapereka zikalatazi amakumana ndi chindapusa cha K1 miliyoni ndipo akhoza kuchotsedwa m'kaundula. NGORA inapatsa CDEDI nthawi yowonjezera. Tsiku lomaliza lomaliza linali 30 June 2026, koma izi zinawonjezeredwa mpaka 31 July 2026. CDEDI sinapereke mapepalawo pa tsiku lililonse.

Namiwa wakhala m'ndende kwa milungu itatu pamene akuyembekezera Khoti Lalikulu kuti lipange chisankho pa belo yake. Anamangidwa pa 30 July 2026 ndipo anaimbidwa mlandu woukira boma komanso kufalitsa nkhani zabodza. Woweruza milandu anamva pempho lake la belo pa 13 August. Boma linapempha khoti kuti lipereke belo pa K2 miliyoni. Loya wa Namiwa, Gift Mwenye, anati ndalamazi ndi zambiri kwambiri. Oteteza mlanduwo adapereka K500,000 m'malo mwake, ponena kuti Namiwa sangalipire K2 miliyoni.

Ali m'ndende, Namiwa anadwala ndipo anatengedwa kupita ku Chipatala cha ABC ku Lilongwe. Anatulutsidwa Lamlungu ndipo anabwerera kundende ya Maula. Milanduyi ikuchokera ku zomwe Namiwa adanena poyankhulana pa wailesi yakanema ndi Luntha Television. Anati Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah adzakhala Purezidenti mkati mwa miyezi iwiri. Anatinso mamembala ena a DPP olamulira adalemba anthu ntchito ochokera ku Dzaleka kuti akaukire ena.

Namiwa tsopano akukumana ndi mavuto awiri akuluakulu nthawi imodzi. Ufulu wake umadalira chigamulo cha Khothi Lalikulu. Bungwe lake, CDEDI, likhoza kutsekedwa chifukwa cha malipoti omwe akusowa. Izi zikuwonjezera kukakamizidwa kwa womenyera ufulu pamene akuyembekezera kuti khothi lipereke chigamulo.

en.title: Miss Malawi says Ireen Navicha's race is not over
en.body: The Miss Malawi Organisation said a report ranking Ireen Navicha 64th at Miss World 2026 is not real. The group's spokesman Stephen Mdala said bloggers and websites made up this ranking. Miss World has not given official rankings yet, he told people. Navicha is Miss Malawi First Princess and competes in Vietnam now.
en.body_more:
Mdala said the 64th ranking does not show how Miss World actually works. Different bloggers give their own opinions. These opinions are not official. Miss World has a set way to choose winners. Contestants do many challenges and activities first. These activities give points. The points matter when judges make their choices.

Miss World will cut the field step by step. First, the group will pick a Top 40. This means 10 women from each big area: Africa, the Americas and Caribbean, Asia and Oceania, and Europe. Some women can jump to the Top 40 by winning fast races. These fast races are Beauty With a Purpose, Multimedia, Head-to-Head and Top Model. Judges pick the rest. From the Top 40, the group cuts to 20 women. Then judges and voters choose a Top 12. The Top 12 becomes 6 women. These 6 are the Beauty With a Purpose winner, one woman from each area, and the People's Choice winner. These 6 women then fight for the crown.

Navicha must do well in Top Model next. In this challenge, judges watch and score women in new clothes. The Top Model first round was at Dragon Beach in Hải Phòng, Vietnam. All 111 women there wore clothes made by Vietnamese designers. Navicha is one of the 111 women at the 75th Anniversary Miss World competition.

ny.title: Abiti Malawi ati mpikisano wa Ireen Navicha sunathe
ny.body: Bungwe la Miss Malawi Organization linati lipoti loti Ireen Navicha ali pa nambala 64 pa Miss World 2026 si lachitsimikizo chenicheni. Mneneri wa gululo, Stephen Mdala, anati olemba mabulogu ndi mawebusayiti ndi omwe adapanga izi. Miss World sanaperekebe maudindo ovomerezeka, adatero kwa anthu. Navicha ndiye Miss Malawi First Princess ndipo akupikisana ku Vietnam tsopano.
ny.body_more:
Mdala adati kusankhidwa kwa 64 sikuwonetsa momwe Miss World imagwirira ntchito. Olemba mabulogu osiyanasiyana amapereka malingaliro awoawo. Malingaliro awa si ovomerezeka. Miss World ali ndi njira yokhazikika yosankhira opambana. Opikisana amachita zovuta zambiri ndi zochitika kaye. Zochita izi zimapereka mfundo. Mfundo ndizofunikira pamene oweruza asankha.

Miss World adzadula munda pang'onopang'ono. Choyamba, gululo lidzasankha Top 40. Izi zikutanthauza akazi 10 ochokera m'dera lililonse lalikulu: Africa, Americas ndi Caribbean, Asia ndi Oceania, ndi Europe. Akazi ena amatha kupita ku Top 40 popambana mipikisano yachangu. Mipikisano yachangu iyi ndi Beauty With a Purpose, Multimedia, Head-to-Head ndi Top Model. Oweruza amasankha ena onse. Kuchokera pa Top 40, gululo limadula akazi 20. Kenako oweruza ndi ovota amasankha Top 12. Top 12 imakhala akazi 6. 6 awa ndi Beauty With a Purpose wopambana, mkazi m'modzi kuchokera m'dera lililonse, ndi People's Choice wopambana. Akazi 6 awa amamenyera korona.

Navicha ayenera kuchita bwino mu Top Model kenako. Mu mpikisano uwu, oweruza amaonera ndi kugoletsa akazi atavala zovala zatsopano. Gawo loyamba la Top Model linali ku Dragon Beach ku Hải Phòng, Vietnam. Azimayi onse 111 omwe analipo anavala zovala zopangidwa ndi opanga mapulani aku Vietnam. Navicha ndi m'modzi mwa akazi 111 omwe ali pa mpikisano wa Miss World wa 75th Anniversary.

en.title: Activist Namiwa leaves hospital, returns to prison
en.body: Sylvester Namiwa, leader of the Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives (CDEDI), was discharged from hospital on Tuesday. He had been treated for a tonsil problem. After leaving the hospital in Lilongwe, he was taken back to Maula Prison, where he stays on remand.
en.body_more:
Namiwa was admitted to African Bible College clinic over the weekend while in police custody. A tonsil is a part of the body in the throat. He received treatment and was cleared to leave. CDEDI spokesman Promise Thomu said Namiwa was discharged and then taken straight back to Maula Prison.

Namiwa faces charges of treason. Treason means working against the country. Last Thursday, a High Court judge named Kondi Mvula said he would decide later about Namiwa's bail application. A bail application is a request to leave prison while waiting for trial. Namiwa must stay in police custody for three weeks after his arrest.

The hospital stay gave Namiwa a break from prison life, but it did not change his legal status. His health problem was treated, but his case remains unresolved. He returned to the same prison walls after his medical care ended. The hospital chapter has closed, but uncertainty about his detention continues.

ny.title: Namiwa, womenyera ufulu wa anthu, wachoka kuchipatala, wabwerera kundende
ny.body: Sylvester Namiwa, mtsogoleri wa Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives (CDEDI), adatulutsidwa m'chipatala Lachiwiri. Anali atalandira chithandizo cha vuto la tonsil. Atatuluka m'chipatala ku Lilongwe, adabwereranso ku ndende ya Maula, komwe amakhalabe m'ndende.
ny.body_more:
Namiwa adalowetsedwa ku chipatala cha African Bible College kumapeto kwa sabata ali m'manja mwa apolisi. Chilonda cha tonsil ndi gawo la thupi pakhosi. Adalandira chithandizo ndipo adaloledwa kutuluka. Wolankhulira CDEDI Promise Thomu adati Namiwa adatulutsidwa kenako adabwezedwa kundende ya Maula.

Namiwa akukumana ndi milandu yokhudza kuukira boma. Kuukira boma kumatanthauza kugwira ntchito motsutsana ndi dzikolo. Lachinayi lapitali, woweruza wa Khothi Lalikulu dzina lake Kondi Mvula adati adzasankha pambuyo pake za pempho la Namiwa la belo. Pempho la belo ndi pempho loti achoke m'ndende akuyembekezera kuzengedwa mlandu. Namiwa ayenera kukhala m'manja mwa apolisi kwa milungu itatu atamangidwa.

Kukhala m'chipatala kunapatsa Namiwa mpumulo ku moyo wake wandende, koma sizinasinthe momwe alili mwalamulo. Vuto lake la thanzi linachiritsidwa, koma mlandu wake sunathetsedwebe. Anabwerera ku makoma omwewo a ndende atamaliza chithandizo chake chamankhwala. Gawo la chipatala latsekedwa, koma kusatsimikizika za kumangidwa kwake kukupitirirabe.

en.title: Malawi holds youth summit to boost jobs and skills
en.body: More than 1,200 young people met in Lilongwe this week for the 2026 National Youth Summit. The three-day event focused on job creation, business skills, and education. Government leaders and business chiefs told youth they must create their own opportunities and learn practical skills.
en.body_more:
Minister of Local Government Dr Ben Malunga Phiri spoke at the summit on Tuesday. He said Malawi cannot allow half of all young people to stay home without work. Phiri told youth to knock on doors and take action themselves. He also said the government alone cannot fix the problem. Schools must teach practical skills that match what businesses need.

Deputy Minister of Natural Resources Chipiliro Mpinganjira urged youth to start businesses rather than wait for jobs. Standard Bank Malawi chief executive Phillip Madinga challenged young people to build companies that solve problems in their communities. He said many new technologies and businesses that could change Malawi do not yet exist. Government has given K22.9 billion to the Youth and Women Empowerment Fund to help startups.

United Nations Resident Coordinator Rebecca Adda-Dontoh called for better support for young people. She said they need money, teachers, access to markets, and good policies all working together. The UN Youth Innovation Fund 2026 helps young people create solutions in farming, tourism, mining, and digital work. Adda-Dontoh urged leaders to let young people help make important decisions, not just ask them questions.

Dr Phiri also spoke about the Constituency Development Fund (CDF). Each of Malawi's 229 constituencies now gets K5 billion. More than 2,000 building projects have been advertised for youth to bid on. Construction materials like cement blocks and metal doors are needed. Dr Phiri said youth must form groups, register companies, and ask banks for loans to work on these projects.

ny.title: Malawi yachita msonkhano wa achinyamata kuti alimbikitse ntchito ndi luso
ny.body: Achinyamata oposa 1,200 adakumana ku Lilongwe sabata ino pa Msonkhano Wadziko Lonse wa Achinyamata wa 2026. Chochitika cha masiku atatuchi chidayang'ana kwambiri pakupanga ntchito, luso la bizinesi, ndi maphunziro. Atsogoleri aboma ndi akuluakulu a mabizinesi adauza achinyamata kuti ayenera kupanga mwayi wawo ndikuphunzira maluso othandiza.
ny.body_more:
Nduna ya Maboma Apafupi, Dr Ben Malunga Phiri, adalankhula pamsonkhanowu Lachiwiri. Iye adati Malawi silingalole theka la achinyamata onse kukhala panyumba osagwira ntchito. Phiri adauza achinyamata kuti agogode pakhomo ndikuchitapo kanthu okha. Anatinso boma lokha silingathe kukonza vutoli. Masukulu ayenera kuphunzitsa maluso othandiza omwe akugwirizana ndi zomwe mabizinesi amafunikira.

Wachiwiri kwa Nduna ya Zachilengedwe, Chipiliro Mpinganjira, adalimbikitsa achinyamata kuti ayambe mabizinesi m'malo moyembekezera ntchito. Mkulu wa Standard Bank Malawi, Phillip Madinga, adalimbikitsa achinyamata kuti amange makampani omwe amathetsa mavuto m'madera awo. Iye adati matekinoloje ambiri atsopano ndi mabizinesi omwe angasinthe Malawi salipo. Boma lapereka K22.9 biliyoni ku Youth and Women Empowerment Fund kuti ithandize makampani atsopano.

Wogwirizanitsa Bungwe la United Nations, Rebecca Adda-Dontoh, adapempha kuti achinyamata athandizidwe bwino. Iye adati akufunika ndalama, aphunzitsi, mwayi wopeza misika, ndi mfundo zabwino zonse zikugwira ntchito limodzi. UN Youth Innovation Fund 2026 imathandiza achinyamata kupanga mayankho mu ulimi, zokopa alendo, migodi, ndi ntchito zama digito. Adda-Dontoh adalimbikitsa atsogoleri kuti alole achinyamata kuti athandize kupanga zisankho zofunika, osati kungowafunsa mafunso.

Dr Phiri adalankhulanso za Constituency Development Fund (CDF). Chigawo chilichonse mwa zigawo 229 za Malawi tsopano chalandira K5 biliyoni. Mapulojekiti omanga oposa 2,000 alengezedwa kuti achinyamata apereke ndalama. Zipangizo zomangira monga simenti ndi zitseko zachitsulo zikufunika. Dr Phiri adati achinyamata ayenera kupanga magulu, kulembetsa makampani, ndikupempha mabanki kuti apereke ngongole kuti agwire ntchitozi.

en.title: Goalkeeper Sikelo says she did not quit Scorchers team
en.body: Malawi's goalkeeper Mercy Sikelo says a letter about her leaving the national women's football team is fake. The letter looked like it came from the Football Association of Malawi. But Sikelo wrote on Facebook that this was not true. She said she did not quit the Scorchers.
en.body_more:
The fake letter said Sikelo quit after people said mean things about her on the internet. This happened after Malawi lost the WAFCON final to Cameroon. WAFCON is the Women's Africa Cup of Nations. But Sikelo told people the letter was not real.

Many fans were sad when they read about Sikelo leaving. They thought the Scorchers would lose a good player. Sikelo helped the team do something big. Malawi reached the final of WAFCON. This is the first time Malawi did this. The team spent 34 days in Morocco for the tournament. Malawi beat Algeria 3-1 in the semi-final.

Jomo Osman said people should not say bad things about Sikelo. He said Malawians should say thank you to the team. He said women's football does not get enough help in Malawi. He said the Scorchers did well and people should be proud. The team will now go home. Malawi will play in the FIFA Women's World Cup next time. This will be the first time Malawi goes to this big tournament.

ny.title: Woyang'anira zigoli Sikelo akuti sanasiye timu ya Scorchers
ny.body: Wosewera wapagolo wa Malawi, Mercy Sikelo, akuti kalata yokhudza kuchoka kwake mu timu ya mpira wa azimayi ndi yabodza. Kalatayo inkaoneka ngati yachokera ku Football Association of Malawi. Koma Sikelo analemba pa Facebook kuti izi sizinali zoona. Anati sanasiye timu ya Scorchers.
ny.body_more:
Kalata yabodzayo inati Sikelo wasiya ntchito anthu atamunena zinthu zoipa pa intaneti. Izi zinachitika Malawi itataya mpikisano wa WAFCON ku Cameroon. WAFCON ndi mpikisano wa Women's Africa Cup of Nations. Koma Sikelo anauza anthu kuti kalatayo si yeniyeni.

Mafani ambiri anakhumudwa atawerenga za kuchoka kwa Sikelo. Anaganiza kuti Scorchers itaya wosewera wabwino. Sikelo anathandiza timuyi kuchita chinthu chachikulu. Malawi inafika pa mpikisano wa WAFCON. Iyi ndi nthawi yoyamba Malawi kuchita izi. Timuyi inakhala masiku 34 ku Morocco pa mpikisanowu. Malawi inagonjetsa Algeria 3-1 mu semi-final.

Jomo Osman anati anthu sayenera kunena zoipa za Sikelo. Anati anthu aku Malawi ayenera kuyamikira timuyi. Anati mpira wa azimayi sulandira thandizo lokwanira ku Malawi. Anati Scorchers adachita bwino ndipo anthu ayenera kunyada. Timuyi tsopano ipita kwawo. Malawi idzasewera mu FIFA Women's World Cup nthawi ina. Iyi idzakhala nthawi yoyamba Malawi kupita ku mpikisano waukuluwu.

en.title: Malawi and Zimbabwe want stronger trade ties
en.body: Malawi and Zimbabwe agreed to work closer together. Second Vice-President Enock Chihana met Zimbabwean President Emmerson Mnangagwa in South Africa. They talked at a big regional meeting in Durban. Both countries want more trade, investment, and business work together.
en.body_more:
The two leaders met on the side of the 46th Southern African Development Community (Sadc) Summit. Sadc is a group of southern African countries that work together. Chihana led Malawi's group to the summit because President Peter Mutharika could not go. Minister of Foreign Affairs George Chaponda and other government people came with Chihana.

During the meeting, Chihana told Mnangagwa that President Mutharika thanks Zimbabwe. Mutharika says Zimbabwe is an important partner for Malawi's money and growth. The two leaders talked about many things. The most important talks were about how countries in the region can help each other, how to fix money problems in Sadc, how to make trade easier, how to work together on safety, and how to bring money into their countries.

Chihana said the talks show why countries that live near each other must work as partners. Mnangagwa said Malawi and Zimbabwe have a special bond. At the same summit, Mnangagwa gave his job as Sadc leader to South African President Cyril Ramaphosa. The summit brought together leaders from the whole region. They talked about how to grow their countries in a way that is strong, lasting, and helps all people. They also talked about using factories, roads and farms to make the region better.

ny.title: Malawi ndi Zimbabwe akufuna mgwirizano wolimba wamalonda
ny.body: Malawi ndi Zimbabwe agwirizana kuti agwire ntchito limodzi. Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Enock Chihana anakumana ndi Purezidenti wa Zimbabwe Emmerson Mnangagwa ku South Africa. Anakambirana pamsonkhano waukulu wachigawo ku Durban. Mayiko onsewa akufuna kuti malonda, ndalama, ndi bizinesi zigwirizane.
ny.body_more:
Atsogoleri awiriwa adakumana kumbali ya Msonkhano wa 46 wa Southern African Development Community (Sadc). Sadc ndi gulu la mayiko akumwera kwa Africa omwe amagwira ntchito limodzi. Chihana adatsogolera gulu la Malawi pamsonkhanowu chifukwa Purezidenti Peter Mutharika sakanatha kupita. Nduna ya Zachilendo George Chaponda ndi anthu ena aboma adabwera ndi Chihana.

Pamsonkhanowu, Chihana adauza Mnangagwa kuti Purezidenti Mutharika akuthokoza Zimbabwe. Mutharika akuti Zimbabwe ndi bwenzi lofunika kwambiri pa ndalama ndi kukula kwa Malawi. Atsogoleri awiriwa adakambirana zinthu zambiri. Zokambirana zofunika kwambiri zinali zokhudza momwe mayiko m'chigawochi angathandizirena, momwe angakonzere mavuto azachuma ku Sadc, momwe angapangire malonda kukhala osavuta, momwe angagwirire ntchito limodzi pachitetezo, komanso momwe angabweretsere ndalama m'maiko awo.

Chihana adati zokambiranazo zikusonyeza chifukwa chake mayiko omwe amakhala pafupi ayenera kugwira ntchito limodzi ngati ogwirizana. Mnangagwa adati Malawi ndi Zimbabwe ali ndi mgwirizano wapadera. Pamsonkhano womwewo, Mnangagwa adapereka ntchito yake monga mtsogoleri wa Sadc kwa Purezidenti wa South Africa Cyril Ramaphosa. Msonkhanowu udasonkhanitsa atsogoleri ochokera m'chigawo chonse. Anakambirana za momwe angakulitsire mayiko awo m'njira yolimba, yokhalitsa, komanso yothandiza anthu onse. Analankhulanso za kugwiritsa ntchito mafakitale, misewu ndi minda kuti chigawochi chikhale chabwino.

en.title: Court visits murdered banker's home as trial continues
en.body: A High Court in Lilongwe visited the home of Agnes Katengeza on Tuesday. Agnes worked for the Reserve Bank of Malawi. She was killed on September 23, 2023. The court went to her house in Area 49, Baghdad, to see where she lived. A housemaid told the court what she saw that day.
en.body_more:
Judge Bruno Kalemba allowed the court visit after both the State and the defence asked for it. This helps the court understand what happened on Agnes's last morning. Rabecca Batison, Agnes's old housemaid, gave evidence at the house. She is the sixth witness for the State.

Batison told the court that on the morning Agnes died, she was doing her normal work at home. Amos Katengeza was outside washing Agnes's car to get it ready. Agnes was planning to leave that day. Everything seemed normal then. But the next day, everything changed. People came to the house after they saw news on social media. They had learned that Agnes was dead. Her body was found in the boot of her own car. The car was behind Lilongwe Gateway Mall.

Dzikondianthu Malunda leads the case for the State. He works for the Directorate of Public Prosecutions. Two men are accused of the murder: Amos Katengeza and Egnat Katengeza. Amos Katengeza has a lawyer named Kavu Kaphwiti Banda. Egnat Katengeza has a lawyer named Khumbo Soko. The trial is still going on. Tuesday's visit to the house helped the court see the real place where Agnes spent her final hours.

ny.title: Khoti lapita kunyumba kwa wa banki yemwe anaphedwa pamene mlandu ukupitirira
ny.body: Khoti Lalikulu ku Lilongwe linapita kunyumba kwa Agnes Katengeza Lachiwiri. Agnes ankagwira ntchito ku Reserve Bank of Malawi. Anaphedwa pa September 23, 2023. Khotilo linapita kunyumba kwake ku Area 49, Baghdad, kuti akaone komwe ankakhala. Mtsikana wantchito anauza khotilo zomwe adawona tsiku limenelo.
ny.body_more:
Woweruza Bruno Kalemba analola kuti khoti lipite kukaonana ndi khoti pambuyo poti Boma ndi oteteza onse apempha. Izi zimathandiza khoti kumvetsetsa zomwe zinachitika m'mawa wa Agnes. Rabecca Batison, wantchito wakale wa Agnes, anapereka umboni kunyumbako. Iye ndi mboni yachisanu ndi chimodzi ya Boma.

Batison anauza khotilo kuti m'mawa Agnes atamwalira, ankagwira ntchito yake yanthawi zonse kunyumba. Amos Katengeza anali panja akutsuka galimoto ya Agnes kuti akaikonze. Agnes anali kukonzekera kuchoka tsiku limenelo. Zonse zinkaoneka ngati zili bwino nthawi imeneyo. Koma tsiku lotsatira, chilichonse chinasintha. Anthu anabwera kunyumbako atawona nkhani pa malo ochezera a pa Intaneti. Anamva kuti Agnes wamwalira. Mtembo wake unapezeka mu buti la galimoto yake. Galimotoyo inali kumbuyo kwa Lilongwe Gateway Mall.

Dzikondianthu Malunda akutsogolera mlandu wa Boma. Amagwira ntchito ku Directorate of Public Prosecutions. Amuna awiri akuimbidwa mlandu wakupha: Amos Katengeza ndi Egnat Katengeza. Amos Katengeza ali ndi loya dzina lake Kavu Kaphwiti Banda. Egnat Katengeza ali ndi loya dzina lake Khumbo Soko. Mlanduwu ukupitirirabe. Ulendo wa Lachiwiri kunyumbako unathandiza khoti kuona malo enieni omwe Agnes anakhala maola ake omaliza.

en.title: Malawi Women Football Team to Play More Games Before 2027 World Cup
en.body: The Football Association of Malawi said the Malawi Women's National Football Team will play more games. The team just finished at the Women's Africa Cup of Nations. The team will play in 2028 Olympic Games qualifiers in October. These games help prepare for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil.
en.body_more:
Fleetwood Haiya is the Football Association of Malawi President. He said this on Monday. The team, called the Scorchers, did very well at the Women's Africa Cup of Nations. They reached the semi-finals. This means they qualified for the 2027 World Cup.

The Scorchers have made big progress in recent years. In 2023, they won the COSAFA title. COSAFA is a regional football competition. They also played in their first Women's Africa Cup of Nations in 2026. The team finished second at this tournament and won a silver medal.

The October qualifiers for the 2028 Olympic Games are part of the team's plan. The team will use these games to get ready for the World Cup. Haiya said the team will stay active and play more matches. This is important because the players need to play against other countries. Playing more games helps them get better and stronger as a team.

The Scorchers have shown great skill and hard work. Many people say the women's team works harder than the men's football team, called the Flames. The women play with strong discipline and never give up. The team has come a long way from having little money and poor support. Now they are ready to play on the world stage in Brazil in 2027.

ny.title: Gulu la Mpira wa Azimayi ku Malawi Lidzasewera Masewera Ambiri Asanafike World Cup ya 2027
ny.body: Bungwe la Mpira wa Manja la Malawi lati timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi idzasewera masewera ambiri. Timuyi yangomaliza kumene ku Women's Africa Cup of Nations. Timuyi idzasewera masewera oyenerera a Olimpiki a 2028 mu Okutobala. Masewerawa akuthandizira kukonzekera 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup ku Brazil.
ny.body_more:
Fleetwood Haiya ndi Purezidenti wa Bungwe la Mpira wa Mipira ku Malawi. Iye wanena izi Lolemba. Gululi, lotchedwa Scorchers, linachita bwino kwambiri pa Women's Africa Cup of Nations. Linafika mu semi-finals. Izi zikutanthauza kuti linayenerera World Cup ya 2027.

Scorchers apita patsogolo kwambiri m'zaka zaposachedwa. Mu 2023, adapambana chikho cha COSAFA. COSAFA ndi mpikisano wa mpira wa m'chigawo. Adaseweranso mu Women's Africa Cup of Nations yawo yoyamba mu 2026. Gululi linamaliza lachiwiri pa mpikisanowu ndipo linapambana mendulo yasiliva.

Mipikisano yoyenerera ya Okutobala ya Masewera a Olimpiki a 2028 ndi gawo la dongosolo la gululo. Gululi lidzagwiritsa ntchito masewerawa kukonzekera World Cup. Haiya adati gululi lidzakhalabe lochita masewera olimbitsa thupi ndikusewera masewera ambiri. Izi ndizofunikira chifukwa osewera ayenera kusewera motsutsana ndi mayiko ena. Kusewera masewera ambiri kumawathandiza kukhala olimba komanso abwino ngati gulu.

Scorchers awonetsa luso lalikulu komanso khama. Anthu ambiri amanena kuti timu ya akazi imagwira ntchito molimbika kuposa timu ya mpira wa amuna, yotchedwa Flames. Akazi amasewera ndi kudziletsa kwambiri ndipo sasiya. Timuyi yapita patsogolo kwambiri chifukwa chokhala ndi ndalama zochepa komanso thandizo lochepa. Tsopano ali okonzeka kusewera pa siteji yapadziko lonse ku Brazil mu 2027.

en.title: Zambia president Hichilema wins second term in office
en.body: Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema has won a second term. The Electoral Commission of Zambia said final results on Monday showed Hichilema won 2,965,326 votes. His closest rival Brian Mundubile got 1,856,217 votes. The election was on 13 August 2026. Hichilema leads the United Party for National Development (UPND).
en.body_more:
The Electoral Commission counted votes from all 226 constituencies. Hichilema beat Mundubile by more than 1.1 million votes. The election had some problems. There was violence against people who worked at voting stations. Some ballot papers were stolen. The counting stopped for a short time. Counting started again after security was better.

Hichilema thanked all Zambians in a message. He said he was pleased they trusted him. He said the vote showed Zambia is a peaceful nation. He said Zambians settle fights using votes, not violence. He travelled to all 116 districts during his campaign. He visited cities, villages and farms. He said he saw the problems people face. He promised to work with all Zambians, even those who voted for other people.

Hichilema spoke about young people. He said his time meeting children during the campaign made him want to help the next generation. He called for the nation to work as one. He said his government will give development work to every part of Zambia. Hichilema first became president in 2021. His new term comes as many Zambians worry about the cost of living and development work that is not finished. His government must now focus on these problems.

ny.title: Purezidenti wa Zambia Hichilema apambana nthawi yachiwiri paudindo wake
ny.body: Purezidenti wa Zambia Hakainde Hichilema wapambana nthawi yachiwiri. Bungwe Loona za Chisankho ku Zambia lati zotsatira zomaliza Lolemba zikusonyeza kuti Hichilema wapambana mavoti 2,965,326. Mdani wake wapamtima Brian Mundubile adapeza mavoti 1,856,217. Chisankhocho chinali pa 13 Ogasiti 2026. Hichilema akutsogolera United Party for National Development (UPND).
ny.body_more:
Komiti Yoona za Chisankho inawerenga mavoti ochokera m'madera onse 226. Hichilema anapambana Mundubile ndi mavoti opitilira 1.1 miliyoni. Chisankhocho chinali ndi mavuto ena. Panali chiwawa kwa anthu omwe ankagwira ntchito m'malo ovotera. Mapepala ena ovotera anabedwa. Kuwerenga kunayima kwakanthawi kochepa. Kuwerenga kunayambanso chitetezo chitakwera.

Hichilema anathokoza anthu onse aku Zambia mu uthenga. Anati akusangalala kuti amamukhulupirira. Anati votiyo inasonyeza kuti Zambia ndi dziko lamtendere. Anati anthu aku Zambia amathetsa mikangano pogwiritsa ntchito mavoti, osati chiwawa. Anapita m'madera onse 116 panthawi ya kampeni yake. Anapita kumizinda, midzi ndi minda. Anati anaona mavuto omwe anthu amakumana nawo. Analonjeza kugwira ntchito ndi anthu onse aku Zambia, ngakhale omwe anavotera anthu ena.

Hichilema analankhula za achinyamata. Anati nthawi yomwe anakumana ndi ana panthawi ya kampeniyo inamupangitsa kufuna kuthandiza mbadwo wotsatira. Anapempha kuti dzikolo ligwire ntchito limodzi. Anati boma lake lipereka ntchito yopititsa patsogolo chitukuko kumadera onse a Zambia. Hichilema adakhala purezidenti koyamba mu 2021. Ulamuliro wake watsopano wabwera pamene anthu ambiri aku Zambia akuda nkhawa ndi mtengo wa moyo ndi ntchito zachitukuko zomwe sizinathe. Boma lake tsopano liyenera kuyang'ana kwambiri pa mavutowa.

en.title: All candidates fail test for top anti-corruption job
en.body: Malawi's search for a new leader of the Anti-Corruption Bureau has hit a problem. All the candidates who were interviewed failed the test. The government says it will try again. The job has been empty for nearly two years.
en.body_more:
The last real leader, Martha Chizuma, left when her time ended in 2024. Since then, someone has been working as acting leader. Attorney General Frank Mbeta said the job will be readvertised next week. New interviews will happen after that.

Mbeta said people should not worry about the delay. He also said it is lawful for someone to run the bureau without being properly appointed. But experts disagree with this idea. Benedicto Kondowe, a law expert, said acting leaders should only hold a job for a short time. They should not stay in place for years and years.

Willy Kambwandira from the Centre for Social Accountability and Transparency said the bureau cannot do good work if its own leader is not real. He said it looks bad. The Anti-Corruption Bureau must investigate graft, which is stealing by leaders. But how can it do this work well if nobody knows who runs it?

The problem shows a larger issue in government. Sometimes temporary leaders stay in place too long. Nobody acts to fix it. Two years is a very long time for this to happen. The search for a new leader must start again from the start.

ny.title: Anthu onse omwe akufuna ntchito yolimbana ndi ziphuphu alephera mayeso awo
ny.body: Kufunafuna mtsogoleri watsopano wa bungwe lolimbana ndi ziphuphu ku Malawi kwabweretsa vuto lalikulu. Anthu onse omwe adafunsidwa mafunso adalephera mayesowo. Boma lati liyesanso. Ntchitoyi yakhala yopanda anthu kwa zaka pafupifupi ziwiri.
ny.body_more:
Mtsogoleri weniweni womaliza, Martha Chizuma, adachoka pamene nthawi yake inatha mu 2024. Kuyambira pamenepo, wina wakhala akugwira ntchito ngati mtsogoleri wochita zinthu motsatira malamulo. Loya Wamkulu Frank Mbeta adati ntchitoyi idzasinthidwa sabata yamawa. Mafunso atsopano adzachitika pambuyo pake.

Mbeta adati anthu sayenera kuda nkhawa ndi kuchedwa. Anatinso ndikololedwa kuti munthu aziyendetsa bungweli popanda kusankhidwa moyenera. Koma akatswiri sagwirizana ndi lingaliro ili. Benedicto Kondowe, katswiri wa zamalamulo, adati atsogoleri ochita zinthu motsatira malamulo ayenera kugwira ntchito kwa kanthawi kochepa. Sayenera kukhala pamalopo kwa zaka zambiri.

Willy Kambwandira wochokera ku Centre for Social Accountability and Transparency adati bungweli silingagwire ntchito yabwino ngati mtsogoleri wake si weniweni. Anati likuwoneka loipa. Bungwe Lolimbana ndi Ziphuphu liyenera kufufuza zachinyengo, zomwe zikubera atsogoleri. Koma lingachite bwanji izi bwino ngati palibe amene akudziwa amene akuliyendetsa?

Vutoli likuwonetsa vuto lalikulu m'boma. Nthawi zina atsogoleri osakhalitsa amakhala pamalopo kwa nthawi yayitali. Palibe amene amachitapo kanthu kuti akonze. Zaka ziwiri ndi nthawi yayitali kwambiri kuti izi zichitike. Kufunafuna mtsogoleri watsopano kuyenera kuyambanso kuyambira pachiyambi.

en.title: Malawi loses chance to sell more to China
en.body: Malawi can sell goods to China with no tax. China said this in 2024 for 33 African poor countries. But Malawi may not use this chance well. The Centre for Agricultural Research and Development said the problem is low productivity. Certification takes too long. Processing is weak. Shipping costs too much.
en.body_more:
China now allows zero tax on almost all goods from 33 African least developed countries. This is a big chance for Malawi. Malawian businesses can send goods to one of the world's biggest markets. They do not pay heavy import tax. But many problems stop them.

Low productivity is the first problem. Farmers and makers do not produce enough goods. The goods are not always the same quality. Without steady supply, Malawi cannot make long-term deals with China buyers. Businesses need more training and better seeds and tools to grow more.

Certification is the second problem. Certification means checking that goods meet China's rules. This takes a very long time. Papers move slowly. Quality checks take weeks or months. Small businesses lose money when goods sit and wait. Old goods can go bad. The government must make these checks faster.

Processing is the third problem. Most Malawi exports are raw goods. Raw means not finished. Malawi ships raw crops, not finished food or goods. If Malawi processes goods here first, the goods are worth more money. Processing creates jobs for young people. More money stays in Malawi. But the country does not have enough factories or machines.

Shipping costs are the fourth problem. Moving goods from farms to ports costs a lot of money. High costs make Malawi goods too expensive. Buyers choose cheaper goods from other countries. Better roads and better ports would help. Faster, cheaper shipping would help too. The business community must improve quality, make more goods, and lower costs to win the China market.

ny.title: Malawi yataya mwayi wogulitsa zambiri ku China
ny.body: Malawi ikhoza kugulitsa katundu ku China popanda msonkho. China inanena izi mu 2024 kwa mayiko 33 osauka aku Africa. Koma Malawi mwina sangagwiritse ntchito mwayiwu bwino. Bungwe la Centre for Agricultural Research and Development linati vuto ndi kuchepa kwa ntchito. Chitsimikizo chimatenga nthawi yayitali. Kukonza zinthu n'kofooka. Kutumiza katundu kumawononga ndalama zambiri.
ny.body_more:
China tsopano imalola msonkho pa katundu pafupifupi aliyense wochokera kumayiko 33 aku Africa omwe akutukuka kumene. Uwu ndi mwayi waukulu kwa Malawi. Mabizinesi aku Malawi amatha kutumiza katundu ku msika waukulu kwambiri padziko lonse lapansi. Salipira msonkho waukulu wochokera kunja. Koma mavuto ambiri amawaletsa.

Vuto loyamba ndi lochepa. Alimi ndi opanga sapanga katundu wokwanira. Katunduyo nthawi zonse siwofanana. Popanda kupezeka nthawi zonse, Malawi singathe kupanga mapangano a nthawi yayitali ndi ogula aku China. Mabizinesi amafunika maphunziro ambiri ndi mbewu zabwino komanso zida zokulira zambiri.

Vuto lachiwiri ndi chitsimikizo. Chitsimikizo chimatanthauza kuwona ngati katunduyo akutsatira malamulo a China. Izi zimatenga nthawi yayitali kwambiri. Mapepala amayenda pang'onopang'ono. Kuwunika khalidwe kumatenga milungu kapena miyezi. Mabizinesi ang'onoang'ono amataya ndalama katundu akangokhala pansi ndikudikirira. Katundu wakale akhoza kuwonongeka. Boma liyenera kupanga macheke awa mwachangu.

Kuwunika ndi vuto lachitatu. Kutumiza katundu wambiri ku Malawi ndi katundu wosaphika. Wamba amatanthauza kuti sunamalizidwe. Malawi imatumiza mbewu zosaphika, osati chakudya chomalizidwa kapena katundu. Ngati Malawi ikukonza katundu kuno poyamba, katunduyo ndi wofunika ndalama zambiri. Kuwunika kumapanga ntchito kwa achinyamata. Ndalama zambiri zimakhalabe ku Malawi. Koma dzikolo lilibe mafakitale kapena makina okwanira.

Ndalama zotumizira ndi vuto lachinayi. Kusamutsa katundu kuchokera ku mafamu kupita ku madoko kumawononga ndalama zambiri. Mitengo yokwera imapangitsa katundu waku Malawi kukhala wokwera mtengo kwambiri. Ogula amasankha katundu wotsika mtengo kuchokera kumayiko ena. Misewu yabwino ndi madoko abwino zingathandize. Kutumiza mwachangu komanso kotsika mtengo kungathandizenso. Amalonda ayenera kukonza khalidwe, kupanga katundu wambiri, ndikuchepetsa ndalama kuti apeze msika waku China.

en.title: Temwa wins golden boot at Wafcon. Team came second.
en.body: Temwa Chawinga won the golden boot award at the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations. She scored five goals and made two assists. Malawi's women's team came second. Cameroon beat them 3-0 in the final. Temwa plays for Kansas City Current in the United States.
en.body_more:
Temwa shared the award with two other players. Zambian Barbara Banda and Cameroonian Marrie Ngah both scored five goals. But Temwa won because she made more assists. The Confederation of African Football uses assists to decide ties.

Temwa thanked her teammates for helping her win. She said Cameroon is a big team with much experience at Wafcon. She felt proud that Malawi came to the final for the first time. Temwa's sister Tabitha is the team captain and plays in France. Tabitha scored four goals at the tournament. She said she was very proud of Temwa's win.

Malawi's team scored twelve goals in total at Wafcon. Rose Kabzere scored two goals. Faith Chimzimu scored one goal. No player has scored more than five goals at Wafcon since 2010. Temwa has won golden boot awards for two years in a row. She won back-to-back awards in the National Women's Soccer League. She also won the 2023 Cosafa Women's Championship golden boot with nine goals in South Africa.

Temwa plays for the Scorchers. The team will now prepare for the 2027 Fifa Women's World Cup.

ny.title: Temwa wapambana nsapato yagolide ku Wafcon. Gululo lakhala lachiwiri.
ny.body: Temwa Chawinga adapambana mphoto ya nsapato zagolide pa mpikisano wa Women's Africa Cup of Nations wa 2026. Adagoletsa zigoli zisanu ndikupereka zigoli ziwiri. Gulu la azimayi la Malawi lidakhala lachiwiri. Cameroon idawagonjetsa 3-0 pamasewera omaliza. Temwa amasewera mu timu ya Kansas City Current ku United States.
ny.body_more:
Temwa adagawana mphotoyi ndi osewera ena awiri. Mzambia Barbara Banda ndi Cameroon Marrie Ngah onse adagoletsa zigoli zisanu. Koma Temwa adapambana chifukwa adagoletsa zigoli zambiri. Bungwe la Confederation of African Football limagwiritsa ntchito zigoli zothandizira kuti asankhe machesi.

Temwa adathokoza osewera anzake chifukwa chomuthandiza kupambana. Anati Cameroon ndi timu yayikulu yokhala ndi luso lalikulu ku Wafcon. Anadzimva wonyada kuti Malawi idafika pa fainali koyamba. Mlongo wake wa Temwa, Tabitha, ndiye kapitawo wa timuyi ndipo amasewera ku France. Tabitha adagoletsa zigoli zinayi pa mpikisanowu. Anati anali wonyada kwambiri ndi kupambana kwa Temwa.

Timu ya Malawi idagoletsa zigoli khumi ndi ziwiri ku Wafcon. Rose Kabzere adagoletsa zigoli ziwiri. Faith Chimzimu adagoletsa chigoli chimodzi. Palibe wosewera yemwe wagoletsa zigoli zoposa zisanu ku Wafcon kuyambira 2010. Temwa wapambana mphoto za golide kwa zaka ziwiri motsatizana. Adapambana mphoto zingapo mu National Women's Soccer League. Adapambananso golide wa 2023 Cosafa Women's Championship ndi zigoli zisanu ndi zinayi ku South Africa.

Temwa amasewera mu timu ya Scorchers. Gululi tsopano likonzekera mpikisano wa 2027 Fifa Women's World Cup.

en.title: Malawi Scorchers to get military parade homecoming
en.body: Malawi will welcome home its women's football team, the Scorchers, with a military parade on Wednesday. The team qualified for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil and came second at the Women's Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON). The Ministry of Sports, Youth and Culture and Lilongwe City Council are planning the celebration.
en.body_more:
Macmillan Mwale, the ministry's public relations officer, said the team deserves a big welcome. "They have managed to qualify for the Women's World Cup set to take place in Brazil next year and managed to come second in the WAFCON, so they deserve to be welcomed properly," Mwale said. The event will take place in Lilongwe with help from NBM, the team's main sponsor, the Malawi Police Service, and the Malawi Defence Force.

The Scorchers played six matches at WAFCON. They won four matches and lost two. The team beat Nigeria 3-2 in their first game. They then beat Egypt 3-1. Zambia beat them 2-1 in the group stage.
