Kadzere wazaka 20 adaponya chigoli cha mlonda wa Ghana kuti zigolizo zifike 2-1. Ghana idayesanso kugoletsa koma chitetezo cha Malawi chidalimba mpaka kumapeto.

Malawi idafika pampikisano ngati gulu lotsika kwambiri mwa magulu 16. Palibe amene ankaganiza kuti angachite bwino. Koma adadabwitsa aliyense. Adagonjetsa Nigeria, omwe adateteza, 3-2 pamasewera awo oyamba ndi Egypt 3-1 pamasewera awo achiwiri. Tsopano apita mpaka kumapeto. Adzakumana ndi Algeria Lachitatu ku Stade Olympique de Rabat nthawi ya 7 koloko masana.

Pambuyo pa masewerawa, pulezidenti wa bungwe la mpira wa miyendo la Malawi, Fleetwood Haiya, adati kupambana kwa timuyi kukuwonetsa kuti mpira wa Malawi ukusintha kukhala wabwino. Adelladie Migogo, purezidenti wa Komiti ya Mpira wa Akazi ya Dziko Lonse, adati wakhudzidwa mtima kwambiri ndi misozi. Iye adati timuyi yapangitsa anthu onse 20 miliyoni aku Malawi kunyada. Ananenanso kuti chaka chino timuyi idapambana COSAFA Cup koyambirira kwa nyengo ino. Kupambana kwa Scorchers kumatanthauza kuti Malawi idzapikisana ndi mayiko ena 31 pa World Cup ku Brazil.

en.title: Brian Banda, MBC Director General, laid to rest
en.body: Brian Banda, the Director General of the Malawi Broadcasting Corporation (MBC), has been buried. He died on 8 August at Mwaiwathu Hospital in Blantyre after a short illness. He was laid to rest at his home village in Chileka, Blantyre. Many people came to pay respect, including political leaders and journalists.
en.body_more:
Banda was a well-known broadcaster in Malawi. He worked in journalism and media for many years. He became MBC director general in March this year. People said he was skilled, fearless and committed to his work. He was known for his calm and fair style of leadership.

Peter Mukhito, secretary general of the Democratic Progressive Party, said Banda's death deeply hurt the party. He said journalists are very important to a democratic society. Finance Minister Joseph Mwanamvekha described Banda as hard-working and dedicated to Malawi's progress. Colleagues Wonder Msiska and Cathy Maulidi said Banda's legacy would live on because of his commitment to accuracy and fairness. They said he helped people reconcile differences and encouraged dialogue.

Banda's six children gave tribute at his funeral. They said their father always showed up for them, even though his job was very demanding. They said he taught them hard work, integrity, honesty and faith in God. His sister, Gladys Banda, said the family was devastated by his loss. She said he was a central figure at home.

President Peter Mutharika, First Vice President Jane Ansah, Speaker of Parliament Sameer Suleman and opposition leader Atupele Muluzi all sent tributes. Banda is remembered as a broadcaster who believed journalism is a public service. His work helped guide national conversations during periods of change. Many in Malawi's media said his death left a significant void.

ny.title: Brian Banda, Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa MBC, waikidwa m'manda
ny.body: Brian Banda, Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa Malawi Broadcasting Corporation (MBC), waikidwa m'manda. Iye anamwalira pa 8 Ogasiti ku Chipatala cha Mwaiwathu ku Blantyre atadwala kwa kanthawi kochepa. Anaikidwa m'manda kumudzi kwawo ku Chileka, Blantyre. Anthu ambiri anabwera kudzalemekeza, kuphatikizapo atsogoleri andale ndi atolankhani.
ny.body_more:
Banda anali wofalitsa nkhani wodziwika bwino ku Malawi. Anagwira ntchito mu utolankhani ndi atolankhani kwa zaka zambiri. Anakhala director wamkulu wa MBC mu Marichi chaka chino. Anthu ankati anali waluso, wopanda mantha komanso wodzipereka pantchito yake. Amadziwika ndi utsogoleri wake wodekha komanso wolungama.

Peter Mukhito, mlembi wamkulu wa chipani cha Democratic Progressive Party, anati imfa ya Banda inapweteka kwambiri chipanicho. Anati atolankhani ndi ofunika kwambiri pagulu la demokalase. Nduna ya zachuma Joseph Mwanamvekha anafotokoza kuti Banda anali wolimbikira ntchito komanso wodzipereka kuti Malawi ipite patsogolo. Anzake a Wonder Msiska ndi Cathy Maulidi anati cholowa cha Banda chidzakhalapobe chifukwa chodzipereka kwake pakuchita zinthu molondola komanso mwachilungamo. Anati anathandiza anthu kuyanjanitsa kusiyana kwawo ndipo analimbikitsa kukambirana.

Ana asanu ndi mmodzi a Banda anapereka ulemu pa maliro ake. Anati abambo awo nthawi zonse ankabwera kwa iwo, ngakhale kuti ntchito yake inali yovuta kwambiri. Anati anawaphunzitsa kugwira ntchito mwakhama, umphumphu, kuona mtima komanso kukhulupirira Mulungu. Mlongo wake, Gladys Banda, anati banjali linasokonezeka kwambiri ndi imfa yake. Anati anali munthu wofunika kwambiri panyumba.

Purezidenti Peter Mutharika, Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah, Sipika wa Nyumba Yamalamulo Sameer Suleman ndi mtsogoleri wotsutsa Atupele Muluzi onse adapereka ulemu. Banda amakumbukiridwa ngati mlengezi yemwe ankakhulupirira kuti utolankhani ndi ntchito yothandiza anthu. Ntchito yake idathandiza kutsogolera zokambirana za dziko panthawi ya kusintha. Ambiri m'manyuzipepala aku Malawi adati imfa yake idasiya malo obisika.

en.title: Land audit finds illegal plot deals in Lilongwe
en.body: A land audit in Lilongwe found problems with how plots were given out. Officials checked Areas 3 and 10. They found double allocations and plots given without proper approval. The risk to government money is more than K800 million. Many senior officials are named in the report.
en.body_more:
The Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development started the land audit in February. The audit checked 1,029 hectares of public land. Area 3 had 625 hectares and Area 10 had 404 hectares. The ministry said it wants to fix past problems and stop bad practices in the future.

The audit found 15 cases where one plot was given to two people. One case was in Area 3 and 14 were in Area 10. It also found 323 plots given without the required approval from the minister. This is against the law. Area 3 had 791 plots allocated but only 511 were properly marked and measured. Area 10 had 604 plots allocated but only 548 were properly marked. The report says the government must investigate and punish those who broke the rules.

The audit also found plots in areas that should be protected. Some plots were in flood-prone land near the Lilongwe River in Area 3. Others were near the Area 10 dam. The report says buildings on these plots must be knocked down. The government must also fix the environment where damage was done. The audit found K190.8 million in ground rent that was not paid. Another K399.2 million in payments have no official receipts. K213.8 million in records could not be found in official books. Minister Chimwemwe Chipungu said the government is fixing the records and managing the future well. He said they are not protecting powerful people.

ny.title: Kafukufuku wa malo wapeza kuti pali mgwirizano wosaloledwa wa malo ku Lilongwe
ny.body: Kafukufuku wa malo ku Lilongwe adapeza mavuto ndi momwe malo amaperekedwera. Akuluakulu adayang'ana Madera 3 ndi 10. Adapeza magawo awiri ndipo malo adaperekedwa popanda chilolezo choyenera. Chiwopsezo cha ndalama za boma ndi choposa K800 miliyoni. Akuluakulu ambiri atchulidwa mu lipotilo.
ny.body_more:
Unduna wa Malo, Nyumba ndi Chitukuko cha Mizinda unayamba kuunika malo mu February. Undunawu unafufuzanso malo okwana mahekitala 1,029 a anthu onse. Malo achitatu anali ndi mahekitala 625 ndipo Malo a 10 anali ndi mahekitala 404. Undunawu unati ukufuna kukonza mavuto akale ndikuletsa machitidwe oipa mtsogolo.

Undunawu unapeza milandu 15 pomwe malo amodzi adaperekedwa kwa anthu awiri. Mlanduwu umodzi unali ku Area 3 ndipo 14 unali ku Area 10. Unapezanso malo 323 omwe adaperekedwa popanda chilolezo chochokera kwa nduna. Izi ndi zosemphana ndi lamulo. Malo achitatu anali ndi malo 791 omwe adaperekedwa koma 511 okha ndi omwe adalembedwa bwino ndipo adayesedwa bwino. Malo a 10 anali ndi malo 604 omwe adaperekedwa koma 548 okha ndi omwe adalembedwa bwino. Lipotilo likuti boma liyenera kufufuza ndi kulanga omwe adaswa malamulo.

Undunawu unapezanso malo m'malo omwe ayenera kutetezedwa. Malo ena anali m'malo omwe madzi amasefukira pafupi ndi Mtsinje wa Lilongwe ku Area 3. Ena anali pafupi ndi damu la Area 10. Lipotilo likuti nyumba zomwe zili pa malo awa ziyenera kugwetsedwa. Boma liyeneranso kukonza malo omwe kuwonongeka kudachitika. Kafukufukuyu adapeza kuti ndalama zokwana K190.8 miliyoni za lendi yapansi sizinalipidwe. Ndalama zina zokwana K399.2 miliyoni zomwe zalipidwa zilibe ma risiti ovomerezeka. Ndalama zokwana K213.8 miliyoni zomwe zalembedwa sizinapezeke m'mabuku ovomerezeka. Nduna Chimwemwe Chipungu adati boma likukonza zolembazo ndikusamalira bwino tsogolo. Anati sakuteteza anthu amphamvu.

en.title: Reserve Bank keeps loan rates the same
en.body: The Reserve Bank of Malawi kept its policy rate at 24 percent on Thursday. The policy rate is the price banks charge when they lend money. It also affects what commercial banks charge for loans to people. The bank made this choice at its third Monetary Policy Committee meeting in 2026.
en.body_more:
The Reserve Bank also kept the Liquidity Reserve Requirement ratio the same. This ratio tells banks how much money they must keep in the bank vault. Local currency deposits must stay at 12 percent. Foreign currency deposits must stay at 3.75 percent. These numbers have not changed.

The policy rate is important for business owners. A policy rate is the cost the central bank charges banks to borrow money. When this rate stays high at 24 percent, it costs more money for people to borrow from banks. Business owners who want loans for new shops or tools must pay more interest. Interest is the extra money you pay when you borrow. High interest rates make it hard for small businesses to grow. Business owners must think carefully before taking new loans when rates are this high.

The Reserve Bank chose to keep rates steady. This means the bank wants to stop prices from going up too fast. When prices go up too fast, people's money buys less food and goods. By keeping rates high, the bank tries to protect the value of the Kwacha. The Kwacha is Malawi's money. This is a hard choice because it makes borrowing more expensive. But the bank believes this helps Malawi's economy in the long run. Business leaders should focus on saving money and growing slowly during this time.

ny.title: Banki Yaikulu imasunga mitengo ya ngongole mofanana
ny.body: Banki Yaikulu ya Malawi idasunga chiwongola dzanja chake cha ndondomeko pa 24 peresenti Lachinayi. Chiwongola dzanja cha ndondomeko ndi mtengo womwe mabanki amalipiritsa akamabwereketsa ndalama. Zimakhudzanso zomwe mabanki amalonda amalipiritsa ngongole kwa anthu. Bankiyo idasankha izi pamsonkhano wake wachitatu wa Komiti Yoona za Ndalama mu 2026.
ny.body_more:
Banki Yaikulu inasunganso chiŵerengero cha Liquidity Reserve Requirement chomwechi. Chiŵerengerochi chimauza mabanki kuchuluka kwa ndalama zomwe ayenera kusunga m'malo osungira ndalama. Ndalama zosungiramo ndalama za m'deralo ziyenera kukhala pa 12 peresenti. Ndalama zosungiramo ndalama zakunja ziyenera kukhala pa 3.75 peresenti. Manambalawa sanasinthe.

Chiŵerengero cha ndondomeko n'chofunika kwa eni mabizinesi. Chiŵerengero cha ndondomeko ndi mtengo womwe banki yayikulu imalipiritsa mabanki kuti abwereke ndalama. Chiŵerengerochi chikakhala chokwera pa 24 peresenti, zimawononga ndalama zambiri kuti anthu abwereke ku mabanki. Eni mabizinesi omwe akufuna ngongole zamashopu atsopano kapena zida ayenera kulipira chiwongola dzanja chochulukirapo. Chiwongola dzanja ndi ndalama zowonjezera zomwe mumalipira mukabwereka. Chiwongola dzanja chokwera chimapangitsa kuti mabizinesi ang'onoang'ono akule. Eni mabizinesi ayenera kuganizira mosamala asanatenge ngongole zatsopano pamene mitengo ili yokwera chonchi.

Banki Yaikulu inasankha kusunga mitengo yokhazikika. Izi zikutanthauza kuti banki ikufuna kuletsa mitengo kuti isakwere mofulumira kwambiri. Mitengo ikakwera mofulumira kwambiri, ndalama za anthu zimagula chakudya ndi katundu wochepa. Posunga mitengo yokwera, banki imayesetsa kuteteza mtengo wa Kwacha. Kwacha ndi ndalama za Malawi. Ichi ndi chisankho chovuta chifukwa chimapangitsa kubwereka kukhala kokwera mtengo kwambiri. Koma bankiyi ikukhulupirira kuti izi zithandiza chuma cha Malawi kwa nthawi yayitali. Atsogoleri a mabizinesi ayenera kuyang'ana kwambiri pakusunga ndalama ndikukula pang'onopang'ono panthawiyi.

en.title: Malawi turns on new solar power plant in Salima
en.body: Malawi has started a new solar power plant in Salima. The plant cost US$12 million and makes 10 megawatts of power. Energy Minister Jean Mathanga turned it on on Monday. Power is now flowing into the national grid. The plant will help Malawi make more electricity.
en.body_more:
The Salima Nanjoka Solar Power Plant is the first part of a bigger plan. The full project will make 50 megawatts when it is done. A second phase will add 40 more megawatts. Officials are now planning how to build this second part. They are looking for an engineer to check if the plan will work.

Minister Mathanga said the plant is part of Malawi's plan to use more types of power. The country wants to use less hydropower, which comes from rivers. She said the government wants more companies to build solar plants. She also talked about other power projects. Malawi will build the Mpatamanga Hydropower Project, which will make at least 358 megawatts. This project will start full building work in 2027. Malawi will also buy 50 megawatts of power from Mozambique through the Southern African Power Pool.

William Liabunya is the chief of EGENCO, the company that made the plant. He said a battery system will help the solar plant work better. The battery is 3.5 megawatts big. It will store power when the sun shines strong and release it when needed. This helps keep power steady for people. The battery is being made now and will arrive soon. Liabunya said payment problems made the battery late, but now it is coming. He thanked the Ministry of Finance, the banks, and the Reserve Bank of Malawi for helping EGENCO pay for everything.

ny.title: Malawi yatsegula malo atsopano opangira magetsi a dzuwa ku Salima
ny.body: Malawi yayambitsa fakitale yatsopano yamagetsi ya dzuwa ku Salima. Fakitaleyi yawononga ndalama zokwana US$12 miliyoni ndipo imapanga ma megawatts 10 amagetsi. Nduna ya Mphamvu Jean Mathanga yayatsa Lolemba. Mphamvu yamagetsi tsopano ikulowa mu gridi ya dziko lonse. Fakitaleyi ithandiza Malawi kupanga magetsi ambiri.
ny.body_more:
Chipinda chamagetsi cha Salima Nanjoka ndi gawo loyamba la pulani yayikulu. Pulojekiti yonseyi ipanga ma megawatts 50 ikatha. Gawo lachiwiri lidzawonjezera ma megawatts ena 40. Akuluakulu a boma tsopano akukonzekera momwe angamangire gawo lachiwirili. Akufuna injiniya kuti aone ngati pulaniyi igwira ntchito.

Nduna Mathanga adati fakitaleyi ndi gawo la pulani ya Malawi yogwiritsa ntchito mitundu yambiri yamagetsi. Dzikoli likufuna kugwiritsa ntchito mphamvu zochepa zamadzi, zomwe zimachokera ku mitsinje. Anati boma likufuna makampani ambiri kuti amange mafakitale amagetsi a dzuwa. Ananenanso za mapulojekiti ena amagetsi. Malawi idzamanga Pulojekiti yamagetsi ya Mpatamanga, yomwe ipanga ma megawatts osachepera 358. Pulojekitiyi iyamba ntchito yonse yomanga mu 2027. Malawi idzagulanso ma megawatts 50 amagetsi kuchokera ku Mozambique kudzera mu Southern African Power Pool.

William Liabunya ndiye mkulu wa EGENCO, kampani yomwe idapanga fakitaleyi. Anati dongosolo la batri lithandiza fakitale yamagetsi ya dzuwa kugwira ntchito bwino. Batri yake ndi yayikulu ma megawatts 3.5. Idzasunga magetsi dzuwa likawala kwambiri ndipo idzatulutsa magetsi akafunika kutero. Izi zimathandiza kuti magetsi azikhala olimba kwa anthu. Batire ikupangidwa tsopano ndipo idzafika posachedwa. Liabunya adati mavuto olipira adapangitsa kuti batire ichedwe, koma tsopano ikubwera. Anayamikira Unduna wa Zachuma, mabanki, ndi Reserve Bank of Malawi chifukwa chothandiza EGENCO kulipira chilichonse.

en.title: Malawi Broadcasting Corporation Director General Brian Banda Dies
en.body: Brian Banda, Director General of Malawi Broadcasting Corporation (MBC), died on Saturday, August 8, 2026 at Mwaiwathu Private Hospital in Blantyre after a short illness. Banda was a well-known journalist and broadcaster who shaped national conversation through his work on radio and television for many years.
en.body_more:
Banda started his career at MBC as a young reporter. A former MBC Director General who worked with him in 2007 said Banda was eager and fearless with a microphone. He created and hosted talk shows, including The Gurus, a programme on Radio 1. His first big show discussed the state of security and included senior government figures and politicians. Banda became known across Malawi for his journalism work and later became the first Malawian to work in the press offices of two presidents.

Banda returned to MBC as Director General. Last month, he met with a former leader of the station to discuss how to improve the broadcast house. He asked serious questions about content, programming and business. He wanted MBC to grow and improve its service to the nation.

Dr Dalitso Kabambe, leader of UTM party, said Banda's death is a great loss. In a message, Dr Kabambe said Banda was not only a journalist but a communicator with rare skill. He said Banda was a man of warmth and humility who could connect with people from all walks of life. Dr Kabambe also said Banda was a Christian who shared his faith with others and preached at church. He said Banda understood that having a platform was a responsibility to inform, question and challenge the nation.

Dr Kabambe said Banda's voice will be difficult to replace. He said although Banda is gone, his work and the conversations he started will remain with the people of Malawi. The media, the church and the nation will miss his presence and his voice.

ny.title: Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa Malawi Broadcasting Corporation Brian Banda Amwalira
ny.body: Brian Banda, Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa Malawi Broadcasting Corporation (MBC), anamwalira Loweruka, Ogasiti 8, 2026 ku Chipatala cha Mwaiwathu Private ku Blantyre atadwala kwakanthawi. Banda anali mtolankhani wodziwika bwino komanso woulutsa nkhani yemwe adasintha nkhani za dziko lonse kudzera mu ntchito yake pa wailesi ndi wailesi yakanema kwa zaka zambiri.
ny.body_more:
Banda anayamba ntchito yake ku MBC ali mtolankhani wachinyamata. Mtsogoleri wakale wa MBC yemwe adagwira naye ntchito mu 2007 adati Banda anali wofunitsitsa komanso wopanda mantha ndi maikolofoni. Adapanga ndikuchititsa mapulogalamu okambirana, kuphatikizapo The Gurus, pulogalamu ya pa Radio 1. Pulogalamu yake yoyamba yayikulu idakambirana za chitetezo ndipo idaphatikizapo akuluakulu aboma ndi andale. Banda adadziwika ku Malawi konse chifukwa cha ntchito yake yolemba nkhani ndipo pambuyo pake adakhala Mmalawi woyamba kugwira ntchito m'maofesi a atolankhani a apulezidenti awiri.

Banda adabwerera ku MBC ngati Mtsogoleri Wamkulu. Mwezi watha, adakumana ndi mtsogoleri wakale wa wailesiyi kuti akambirane momwe angakonzere nyumba yowulutsira nkhani. Adafunsa mafunso ofunikira okhudza zomwe zili mkati, mapulogalamu ndi bizinesi. Amafuna kuti MBC ikule ndikupititsa patsogolo ntchito yake kudziko.

Dr Dalitso Kabambe, mtsogoleri wa chipani cha UTM, adati imfa ya Banda ndi imfa yayikulu. Mu uthenga, Dr Kabambe adati Banda sanali mtolankhani wokha komanso wolankhulana ndi luso losowa. Adati Banda anali munthu wachikondi komanso wodzichepetsa yemwe amatha kulumikizana ndi anthu ochokera m'mitundu yonse. Dr. Kabambe adatinso Banda anali Mkhristu amene ankagawana chikhulupiriro chake ndi ena komanso ankalalikira kutchalitchi. Anati Banda akumvetsa kuti kukhala ndi nsanja ndi udindo wodziwitsa, kufunsa mafunso ndi kutsutsa dziko.

Dr. Kabambe adati mawu a Banda adzakhala ovuta kuwasintha. Anati ngakhale Banda wapita, ntchito yake ndi zokambirana zomwe adayambitsa zidzakhalabe ndi anthu aku Malawi. Atolankhani, mpingo ndi dziko lonse adzasowa kukhalapo kwake komanso mawu ake.

en.title: Bullets beat Chitipa United to stay fourth
en.body: FCB Nyasa Big Bullets won 2-0 against Chitipa United at Mpira Stadium in Blantyre on Sunday. Blessings Mpokera scored from a penalty. Clever Kalambo added a second goal. The win gives Bullets 23 points from 12 matches. They stay in fourth place in the FDH Bank Premiership.
en.body_more:
Coach Wedson Nyirenda said his team played better than in recent games. He wanted them to score even more goals. Nyirenda said: "Today we were a better team. The only thing we did not do is use our chances. We will work on that." He said Chitipa United defended very well and made it hard for his players to score.

The loss to Goshen City Dedza Dynamos the week before was Bullets' first defeat of the season. Nyirenda had missed that match because he was in Zambia at his mother's funeral. His assistant Heston Munthali looked after the team while he was away. Nyirenda said the coaches found where they went wrong and made changes.

Bullets are now separated from defending champions Mighty Wanderers only by goal difference. The win helps Bullets rebuild after a difficult run of games where they drew many matches. Nyirenda said his team looked sharp in training before the match against Chitipa. He was happy with what he saw from his players.

The coach told his players they must get better at finishing chances. Chitipa United made the game hard by defending tightly as a team. Bullets will want to keep this good form and score more goals in future matches.

ny.title: Bullets yagonjetsa Chitipa United ndipo yakhalabe pa nambala 4
ny.body: FCB Nyasa Big Bullets idapambana 2-0 motsutsana ndi Chitipa United pa Mpira Stadium ku Blantyre Lamlungu. Blessings Mpokera adagoletsa chigoli kuchokera ku penalty. Clever Kalambo adawonjezera chigoli chachiwiri. Kupambana kumeneku kwapatsa Bullets mapointi 23 kuchokera pamasewera 12. Akukhalabe pa nambala 4 mu FDH Bank Premiership.
ny.body_more:
Mphunzitsi Wedson Nyirenda anati timu yake idasewera bwino kuposa masewera aposachedwa. Amafuna kuti iwo apeze zigoli zambiri. Nyirenda anati: "Lero tinali timu yabwino. Chinthu chokha chomwe sitinachite ndikugwiritsa ntchito mwayi wathu. Tidzagwira ntchito pa zimenezo." Anati Chitipa United idateteza bwino kwambiri ndipo zidapangitsa kuti osewera ake azivutika kupeza zigoli.

Kugonjetsedwa ndi Goshen City Dedza Dynamos sabata yatha kunali kugonjetsedwa koyamba kwa Bullets nyengo ino. Nyirenda adaphonya masewerawa chifukwa anali ku Zambia pamaliro a amayi ake. Wothandizira wake Heston Munthali adasamalira timuyi pamene iye anali kutali. Nyirenda anati aphunzitsi adapeza komwe adalakwitsa ndipo adasintha.

Bullets tsopano yalekanitsidwa ndi Mighty Wanderers, omwe adateteza, chifukwa cha kusiyana kwa zigoli. Kupambana kumeneku kumathandiza Bullets kumanganso pambuyo pa masewera ovuta omwe adasewera masewera ambiri. Nyirenda adati timu yake imawoneka yanzeru pochita masewera olimbitsa thupi asanayambe masewera motsutsana ndi Chitipa. Anali wokondwa ndi zomwe adawona kuchokera kwa osewera ake.

Mphunzitsiyo adauza osewera ake kuti ayenera kukhala ndi luso pomaliza mwayi. Chitipa United yapangitsa masewerawa kukhala ovuta poteteza bwino ngati timu. Bullets ikufuna kupitiriza kuchita bwino komanso kupeza zigoli zambiri m'masewera amtsogolo.

en.title: Government to build Mombera University in Mzimba
en.body: The government will give K14 billion to start building Mombera University in Mzimba district. Second Vice President Enock Chihana said this on Saturday at Hora Mountain. He said all work to prepare the land is done. The government wants K300 billion more from private companies to finish the university.
en.body_more:
Chihana said construction will begin after the Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets Authority (PPDA) approves the project. PPDA is the government body that checks contracts. He told the crowd: "The dream to have Mombera University will come true."

The university will teach veterinary medicine, animal husbandry, and mining. A college for mining will also be built. The government plans to make the area around the university into a university town. This town will have shops, houses, schools, roads, and other things people need. The government and private companies will work together to build all of this.

Chihana also promised to finish the Eswazini-Mzalangwe-Kafukule Road. Work on this road stopped because the government did not pay the builders. He said the government will pay the money owed so the road can be finished. Chihana said these projects will bring jobs, schools, shops, and hotels to Mzimba. More people will come to live and work there.

Paramount Chief M'mbelwa V asked investors to help build Hora Mountain into a big tourist place. Hora Mountain is now a World Heritage Site. This means UNESCO, a big world group, said Hora Mountain is very important. The chief wants to make Hora Mountain famous so many visitors come. He said this will help the whole of Malawi, not just Mzimba.

ny.title: Boma likufuna kumanga yunivesite ya Mombera ku Mzimba
ny.body: Boma lipereka K14 biliyoni kuti liyambe kumanga Yunivesite ya Mombera m'boma la Mzimba. Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Enock Chihana adanena izi Loweruka ku Hora Mountain. Iye anati ntchito yonse yokonzekera malo yatha. Boma likufuna K300 biliyoni yowonjezera kuchokera ku makampani achinsinsi kuti amalize yunivesite.
ny.body_more:
Chihana anati ntchito yomanga idzayamba bungwe la Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets Authority (PPDA) litavomereza ntchitoyi. PPDA ndi bungwe la boma lomwe limafufuza mapangano. Iye anauza khamu la anthu kuti: "Maloto okhala ndi Mombera University adzakwaniritsidwa."

Yunivesiteyi idzaphunzitsa zamankhwala a ziweto, ulimi wa ziweto, ndi migodi. Koleji ya migodi idzamangidwanso. Boma likukonzekera kupanga dera lozungulira yunivesite kukhala tawuni ya yunivesite. Tawuniyi idzakhala ndi masitolo, nyumba, masukulu, misewu, ndi zinthu zina zomwe anthu amafunikira. Boma ndi makampani achinsinsi adzagwira ntchito limodzi kuti amange zonsezi.

Chihana adalonjezanso kuti adzamaliza msewu wa Eswazini-Mzalangwe-Kafukule. Ntchito yomanga msewuwu inayima chifukwa boma silinalipire omanga. Anati boma lidzalipira ndalama zomwe adalipira kuti msewuwu uthe. Chihana adati mapulojekitiwa abweretsa ntchito, masukulu, masitolo, ndi mahotela ku Mzimba. Anthu ambiri adzabwera kudzakhala ndikugwira ntchito kumeneko.

Mkulu wa Paramount M'mbelwa V adapempha osunga ndalama kuti athandize kumanga Phiri la Hora kukhala malo akuluakulu oyendera alendo. Phiri la Hora tsopano ndi malo odziwika padziko lonse lapansi. Izi zikutanthauza kuti UNESCO, gulu lalikulu la padziko lonse lapansi, inati Phiri la Hora ndi lofunika kwambiri. Mfumu ikufuna kupangitsa Phiri la Hora kutchuka kuti alendo ambiri abwere. Inati izi zithandiza dziko lonse la Malawi, osati Mzimba yokha.

en.title: Malawi Mourns Broadcaster Brian Banda
en.body: Brian Banda, the Director General of Malawi Broadcasting Corporation, has died. A church service was held for him at Word of Faith Temple International in Chilobwe, Blantyre. Apostle Timothy Khoviwa said Banda's death is a deeply painful loss. Many people gathered to honour his life and work.
en.body_more:
Banda had a long career in radio and media. He worked at Capital FM Radio as a host and producer of main shows. He also worked as a news reporter at the Malawi Broadcasting Corporation. Later, he moved to Times Group, where he was a senior manager, host and producer. After that, he returned to MBC as Director General.

At MBC, Banda started many changes to make the station better. He was known for his work to inform, educate and entertain the people of Malawi. His voice and presence touched many lives through his work in broadcasting.

Apostle Timothy Khoviwa, who is also an adviser to the President on religious affairs, led the church service. He said he regarded Banda as his own son. Khoviwa urged people to honour Banda's legacy of compassion, service and love for Malawi. Mourners gathered at Mthuzi Funeral Parlour to pay their respects. Word of Faith Temple International was the church where Banda worshipped and preached.

ny.title: Woulutsa nkhani ku Malawi Brian Banda akulira
ny.body: Brian Banda, Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa Malawi Broadcasting Corporation, wamwalira. Mwambo wa tchalitchi unachitikira ku Word of Faith Temple International ku Chilobwe, Blantyre. Mtumwi Timothy Khoviwa anati imfa ya Banda ndi imfa yopweteka kwambiri. Anthu ambiri anasonkhana kuti alemekeze moyo wake ndi ntchito yake.
ny.body_more:
Banda wakhala akugwira ntchito yayitali pa wailesi ndi atolankhani. Anagwira ntchito ku Capital FM Radio monga wotsogolera komanso wopanga mapulogalamu akuluakulu. Anagwiranso ntchito ngati mtolankhani wa nkhani ku Malawi Broadcasting Corporation. Pambuyo pake, anasamukira ku Times Group, komwe anali manejala wamkulu, wotsogolera komanso wopanga. Pambuyo pake, anabwerera ku MBC monga Mtsogoleri Wamkulu.

Ku MBC, Banda anayamba kusintha zambiri kuti akonze siteshoniyo. Ankadziwika ndi ntchito yake yodziwitsa, kuphunzitsa ndi kusangalatsa anthu aku Malawi. Mawu ake ndi kupezeka kwake zinakhudza miyoyo yambiri kudzera mu ntchito yake yofalitsa nkhani.

Mtumwi Timothy Khoviwa, yemwenso ndi mlangizi wa Purezidenti pankhani zachipembedzo, anatsogolera utumiki wa tchalitchi. Anati amaona Banda ngati mwana wake. Khoviwa analimbikitsa anthu kuti alemekeze cholowa cha Banda cha chifundo, kutumikira ndi chikondi kwa Malawi. Olira anasonkhana ku Mthuzi Funeral Parlour kuti apereke ulemu wawo. Word of Faith Temple International inali tchalitchi komwe Banda ankalambira ndi kulalikira.

en.title: Police and tax officers raid lawyer Kadzipatike's offices
en.body: More than 20 police and tax officers raided lawyer George Kadzipatike's offices in Lilongwe and Mzuzu on Friday. Kadzipatike works for the opposition MCP party. Officers took computers and files. Kadzipatike says the raid was about taxes, but he thinks it is punishment for his work.
en.body_more:
Kadzipatike is the director of legal affairs for the MCP, the main opposition party. He also works as a private lawyer. He says tax officers should talk to him first if they have questions about taxes. Instead, they came with many police. "The first option for a taxman should be to collect tax and not to have taxpayers imprisoned and their businesses disrupted," he said.

Kadzipatike claims the raid is punishment. He represents opposition people in court. He also sits on a parliament group that looks at the Chikangawa plane crash. "This action by MRA confirms my fears that I am being victimized for representing MCP and opposition figures in their cases in the Courts and for being among the legislators standing up for justice in the ad-hoc parliamentary committee on the Chikangawa plane crash inquiry," he said. The raid happened just days after Parliament stopped meeting, when lawmakers lose their protection from arrest.

Officers took many files from both offices. They also took computers that belong to five lawyers at the firm Jivason and Company. Kadzipatike says clients are worried about their legal papers. But he told them the firm will still work. "We have electronic backup for all the files and where need be, we are going to be photocopying their files from the Courts," he said.

The police and the tax office, called MRA, have not yet explained the raid in public. They have not said what tax problems they are looking into. Kadzipatike says he and his colleagues are now talking to both groups about what happened.

ny.title: Apolisi ndi akuluakulu amisonkho alowa m'maofesi a loya Kadzipatike
ny.body: Apolisi ndi apolisi opitilira 20 a msonkho adalowa m'maofesi a loya George Kadzipatike ku Lilongwe ndi Mzuzu Lachisanu. Kadzipatike amagwira ntchito ku chipani chotsutsa cha MCP. Apolisi adatenga makompyuta ndi mafayilo. Kadzipatike akunena kuti kuwukiraku kunali kokhudza misonkho, koma akuganiza kuti ndi chilango cha ntchito yake.
ny.body_more:
Kadzipatike ndi mkulu wa nkhani zamalamulo ku MCP, chipani chachikulu chotsutsa. Amagwiranso ntchito ngati loya wachinsinsi. Akuti akuluakulu amisonkho ayenera kulankhula naye kaye ngati ali ndi mafunso okhudza misonkho. M'malo mwake, anabwera ndi apolisi ambiri. "Njira yoyamba ya wokhometsa msonkho iyenera kukhala kusonkhanitsa misonkho osati kutsekera okhometsa msonkho m'ndende ndi kusokoneza mabizinesi awo," adatero.

Kadzipatike akunena kuti kuukira kumeneku ndi chilango. Amayimira anthu otsutsa kukhothi. Amakhalanso m'gulu la nyumba yamalamulo lomwe limayang'ana ngozi ya ndege ya Chikangawa. "Zomwe MRA yachitazi zikutsimikizira mantha anga kuti ndikuzunzidwa chifukwa choyimira MCP ndi akuluakulu otsutsa milandu yawo m'makhothi komanso chifukwa chokhala m'gulu la opanga malamulo omwe akuyimira chilungamo mu komiti yanyumba yamalamulo yanthawi yochepa yofufuza za ngozi ya ndege ya Chikangawa," adatero. Kuukiraku kunachitika patangopita masiku ochepa Nyumba yamalamulo itasiya kukumana, pomwe opanga malamulo ataya chitetezo chawo kuti asamangidwe.

Apolisi adatenga mafayilo ambiri kuchokera ku maofesi onse awiri. Adatenganso makompyuta omwe ndi a maloya asanu ku kampani ya Jivason and Company. Kadzipatike akuti makasitomala akuda nkhawa ndi mapepala awo azamalamulo. Koma adawauza kuti kampaniyo ipitiliza kugwira ntchito. "Tili ndi zosungiramo mafayilo onse pakompyuta ndipo ngati pakufunika kutero, tidzakopera mafayilo awo kuchokera ku Makhothi," adatero.

Apolisi ndi ofesi yamisonkho, yotchedwa MRA, sanafotokozebe za kuukira kumeneku pagulu. Sananene mavuto amisonkho omwe akuyang'ana. Kadzipatike akuti iye ndi anzake tsopano akulankhula ndi magulu onse awiri za zomwe zinachitika.

en.title: Politicians remember Brian Banda, fearless broadcaster
en.body: Brian Banda died on 8 August 2026 at Mwaiwathu Hospital in Blantyre after a short illness. He was 45 years old. On Sunday, his body was taken to Chilobwe for a church service. Many politicians came to remember him. They said he was a brave journalist who asked hard questions.
en.body_more:
A church service at Word of Faith Temple was led by presidential aide Apostle Timothy Khoviwa. He told the mourners that Banda was a God-fearing man who had earned his place in paradise. Politicians and colleagues met separately at Times Group to remember Banda's life and his work as a broadcaster.

Former President Joyce Banda said Banda was a rare and very skilled journalist. She first knew him when he worked at Capital Radio. He ran a popular radio show called Straight Talk from around 2009 to 2012. Joyce Banda said she was his first guest on that show. She described him as flamboyant, full of life, fearless, and very expressive. After she became president, she gave him work in her office. Later, every other president also employed him, she said. This showed how special and valued he was.

Former Cabinet minister Nicholas Dausi said the loss was very hard. He simply said, "The world is so cruel." Dausi recalled a time when Banda came to his office for an interview while he was Minister of Security. Banda asked very tough questions. Dausi said some of Banda's questions could have made him lose his job. When Dausi tried to warn Banda away, the journalist said, "Malawians want to know." But Banda asked his questions with humour, Dausi added.

MCP deputy publicity secretary Ken Msonda remembered Banda for his sharp questioning style. In 2016, Msonda did an interview with Banda after his scheduled guest did not come. Msonda said Banda could catch guests off guard. "If you are not clever enough, he could finish you," Msonda said. Banda was born in 1981 and worked as Director General of the Malawi Broadcasting Corporation from March 2026. He will be laid to rest on Monday, 10 August 2026, at his home village in Chileka, Blantyre.

ny.title: Andale akukumbukira Brian Banda, wofalitsa nkhani wopanda mantha
ny.body: Brian Banda anamwalira pa 8 Ogasiti 2026 ku Chipatala cha Mwaiwathu ku Blantyre atadwala kwakanthawi. Anali ndi zaka 45. Lamlungu, thupi lake linatengedwa kupita ku Chilobwe kukachita mapemphero a tchalitchi. Andale ambiri anabwera kudzamukumbukira. Anati anali mtolankhani wolimba mtima amene ankafunsa mafunso ovuta.
ny.body_more:
Utumiki wa tchalitchi ku Word of Faith Temple unatsogozedwa ndi wothandiza pulezidenti, Apostle Timothy Khoviwa. Iye anauza olira kuti Banda anali munthu woopa Mulungu amene adapeza malo ake m'paradaiso. Andale ndi anzake anakumana padera ku Times Group kukumbukira moyo wa Banda ndi ntchito yake monga woulutsa nkhani.

Purezidenti wakale Joyce Banda anati Banda anali mtolankhani wosowa komanso waluso kwambiri. Anamudziwa koyamba pamene ankagwira ntchito ku Capital Radio. Anayendetsa pulogalamu yotchuka ya pa wailesi yotchedwa Straight Talk kuyambira cha m'ma 2009 mpaka 2012. Joyce Banda anati anali mlendo wake woyamba pa pulogalamuyo. Anamufotokoza kuti anali wodzikuza, wodzaza ndi moyo, wopanda mantha, komanso wolankhula momveka bwino. Atakhala purezidenti, anamupatsa ntchito mu ofesi yake. Pambuyo pake, purezidenti wina aliyense anamugwiritsanso ntchito, iye anatero. Izi zinasonyeza momwe anali wapadera komanso wofunika kwambiri.

Nduna yakale ya Cabinet Nicholas Dausi anati kutayikako kunali kovuta kwambiri. Anangonena kuti, "Dziko lapansi ndi lankhanza kwambiri." Dausi anakumbukira nthawi imene Banda anabwera ku ofesi yake kudzafunsidwa mafunso pamene anali Nduna ya Chitetezo. Banda anafunsa mafunso ovuta kwambiri. Dausi anati mafunso ena a Banda akanatha kumuchotsa ntchito. Pamene Dausi anayesa kuchenjeza Banda, mtolankhaniyo anati, "Anthu aku Malawi akufuna kudziwa." Koma Banda anafunsa mafunso ake moseka, Dausi anawonjezera.

Wachiwiri kwa mlembi wofalitsa nkhani wa MCP, Ken Msonda, anakumbukira Banda chifukwa cha kalembedwe kake kofunsa mafunso mwachangu. Mu 2016, Msonda adachita kuyankhulana ndi Banda pambuyo poti mlendo wake sanabwere. Msonda anati Banda akhoza kudabwitsa alendo. "Ngati simuli anzeru mokwanira, akhoza kukumalizani," anatero Msonda. Banda anabadwa mu 1981 ndipo adagwira ntchito ngati Director General wa Malawi Broadcasting Corporation kuyambira mu Marichi 2026. Adzaikidwa m'manda Lolemba, 10 Ogasiti 2026, kumudzi kwawo ku Chileka, Blantyre.

en.title: Brian Banda, MBC chief, dies at age 45
en.body: Brian Banda, director general of the Malawi Broadcasting Corporation (MBC), died on Saturday after a short illness. He was 45 years old. Banda died at Mwaiwathu Private Hospital in Blantyre. His family, colleagues and community members gathered in Chileka, Blantyre, his home village, to mourn.
en.body_more:
Banda's sister Naomi said he became ill at the start of the week. He complained of vomiting and was taken to hospital, where doctors said he had malaria. His condition became worse on Friday evening after dinner. The family rushed him back to hospital, where he died the next morning.

Banda was born in 1981 and was the eldest of eight children. Before becoming MBC director general in March this year, he worked as a broadcaster for many years. He hosted talk shows for Times Group and Capital Radio. His shows had names like Hot Current, Times Exclusive, Times Talk, Straight Talk and NewsTalk. He also worked twice in government, as State House Press Officer from 2012 to 2014, and as Presidential Press Secretary from 2020 to 2022. He won awards for his work, including Talk Show Host of the Year and Television Personality of the Year.

Many people sent tributes after his death. President Peter Mutharika called Banda a patriot and a distinguished media icon whose voice and vision reached homes across Malawi for decades. First Vice-President Jane Ansah said his work to broadcasting would be remembered. Speaker of Parliament Sameer Suleman praised his dedication and professionalism. Opposition leader Atupele Muluzi said it was a deeply painful loss.

Banda will be buried on Monday, 10 August 2026 at M'banda Village in Chileka, Blantyre. A church service will be held on Sunday, 9 August 2026 at Word of Faith Church in Chilobwe, Blantyre.

ny.title: Brian Banda, mkulu wa MBC, wamwalira ali ndi zaka 45
ny.body: Brian Banda, mkulu wa bungwe la Malawi Broadcasting Corporation (MBC), anamwalira Loweruka atadwala kwakanthawi. Anali ndi zaka 45. Banda anamwalira ku Chipatala cha Mwaiwathu Private ku Blantyre. Banja lake, anzake ogwira nawo ntchito komanso anthu ammudzi adasonkhana ku Chileka, Blantyre, mudzi wakwawo, kuti amve chisoni.
ny.body_more:
Mlongo wake wa Banda, Naomi, anati anayamba kudwala kumayambiriro kwa sabata. Anadandaula kuti akusanza ndipo anatengedwera kuchipatala, komwe madokotala anati anali ndi malungo. Matenda ake anakula kwambiri Lachisanu madzulo atatha kudya chakudya chamadzulo. Banja linamuthamangitsanso kuchipatala, komwe anamwalira m'mawa wotsatira.

Banda anabadwa mu 1981 ndipo anali wamkulu pa ana asanu ndi atatu. Asanakhale director wamkulu wa MBC mu Marichi chaka chino, adagwira ntchito youlutsa nkhani kwa zaka zambiri. Anachititsa mapulogalamu olankhula ku Times Group ndi Capital Radio. Ma pulogalamu ake anali ndi mayina monga Hot Current, Times Exclusive, Times Talk, Straight Talk ndi NewsTalk. Anagwiranso ntchito kawiri m'boma, monga State House Press Officer kuyambira 2012 mpaka 2014, komanso monga Presidential Press Secretary kuyambira 2020 mpaka 2022. Anapambana mphoto chifukwa cha ntchito yake, kuphatikizapo Talk Show Host of the Year ndi Television Personality of the Year.

Anthu ambiri adatumiza ulemu atamwalira. Purezidenti Peter Mutharika adatcha Banda kuti ndi munthu wokonda dziko lake komanso munthu wodziwika bwino pa nkhani za atolankhani yemwe mawu ake ndi masomphenya ake adafika m'nyumba zambiri ku Malawi kwa zaka zambiri. Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah adati ntchito yake yofalitsa nkhani idzakumbukiridwa. Sipikala wa Nyumba Yamalamulo Sameer Suleman adayamika kudzipereka kwake komanso ukatswiri wake. Mtsogoleri wa chipani chotsutsa Atupele Muluzi adati ndi imfa yopweteka kwambiri.

Banda adzaikidwa m'manda Lolemba, 10 Ogasiti 2026 ku M'banda Village ku Chileka, Blantyre. Mwambo wa tchalitchi udzachitika Lamlungu, 9 Ogasiti 2026 ku Word of Faith Church ku Chilobwe, Blantyre.

en.title: Brian Banda, MBC Director General, dies after short illness
en.body: Brian Banda, the director general of the Malawi Broadcasting Corporation (MBC), has died at Mwaiwathu Private Hospital in Blantyre after a short illness. MBC spokesperson Chisomo Mwamadi confirmed the death. Banda had led the state broadcaster for less than five months.
en.body_more:
Banda was appointed by the MBC Board on 12 March 2026 and started work on 16 March. He replaced George Kasakula. Before his role at MBC, Banda was a well-known broadcaster across Malawi.

Early in his career, Banda hosted a programme called Straight Talk on Capital Radio. This programme made him famous across the country. The programme was about current affairs and phone calls from listeners. Later, he moved to Times Group, where he worked as a journalist and television presenter. He co-hosted a show called Hot Current with George Kasakula. In 2015, the Media Institute of Southern Africa (MISA) Malawi named him the country's Best Talk Show Host. Banda also worked in government. He served as press officer to President Joyce Banda and later to President Lazarus Chakwera at the State House.

When Banda was appointed to MBC, journalist Davie Mchinga asked the Office of the Ombudsman to look at the appointment. Mchinga said the job had not been advertised publicly. However, Parliament's Public Appointments Committee later approved the appointment. The committee said the Communications Act gives the MBC Board the power to appoint a Director General without needing a public advertisement.

MBC has not yet announced who will lead the organisation next. The family and MBC are expected to share more details about funeral plans soon.

ny.title: Brian Banda, Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa MBC, wamwalira atadwala kwakanthawi
ny.body: Brian Banda, mkulu wa bungwe la Malawi Broadcasting Corporation (MBC), wamwalira ku chipatala cha Mwaiwathu Private Hospital ku Blantyre atadwala kwa kanthawi kochepa. Mneneri wa MBC Chisomo Mwamadi watsimikiza za imfayo. Banda anali atatsogolera bungwe la boma la Broadcasting Corporation kwa miyezi yosakwana isanu.
ny.body_more:
Banda adasankhidwa ndi Bungwe la MBC pa 12 Marichi 2026 ndipo adayamba kugwira ntchito pa 16 Marichi. Adalowa m'malo mwa George Kasakula. Asanagwire ntchito ku MBC, Banda anali wowulutsa nkhani wodziwika bwino ku Malawi konse.

Kumayambiriro kwa ntchito yake, Banda adachititsa pulogalamu yotchedwa Straight Talk pa Capital Radio. Pulogalamuyi idamupangitsa kutchuka mdziko lonselo. Pulogalamuyi inali yokhudza nkhani zaposachedwa komanso mafoni ochokera kwa omvera. Pambuyo pake, adasamukira ku Times Group, komwe adagwira ntchito ngati mtolankhani komanso wowonetsa pa TV. Adachititsa pulogalamu yotchedwa Hot Current ndi George Kasakula. Mu 2015, Media Institute of Southern Africa (MISA) Malawi adamutcha kuti ndiye Woyang'anira Pulogalamu Yabwino Kwambiri ya Talk Show mdzikolo. Banda adagwiranso ntchito m'boma. Adagwiranso ntchito ngati mtolankhani kwa Purezidenti Joyce Banda ndipo pambuyo pake kwa Purezidenti Lazarus Chakwera ku State House.

Banda atasankhidwa ku MBC, mtolankhani Davie Mchinga adapempha Ofesi ya Ombudsman kuti iyang'ane kusankhidwako. Mchinga adati ntchitoyi sinalengezedwe poyera. Komabe, Komiti Yoyang'anira Kusankhidwa kwa Anthu ku Nyumba Yamalamulo pambuyo pake idavomereza kusankhidwako. Komitiyi inati lamulo la Communications Act limapatsa MBC Board mphamvu yosankha Director General popanda kufunikira kulengeza pagulu.

MBC sinalengezebe yemwe adzatsogolere bungwe lotsatira. Banja ndi MBC akuyembekezeka kugawana zambiri zokhudza mapulani a maliro posachedwa.

en.title: Standard Bank gives K50 million to university fund
en.body: Standard Bank has given K50 million to the Malawi University of Science and Technology (Must) Endowment Fund. The bank's Chief Executive Phillip Madinga gave the money to Minister of Education Bright Msaka on Thursday. The gift will help students and research at the university.
en.body_more:
The Must Endowment Fund was made to give money for scholarships, research and new buildings at the university. The fund helps students who do not have much money. Madinga said the bank wants to help the next leaders, scientists and new thinkers in Malawi. He said the gift shows the bank wants to build skills and help research. He also said no good student should lose a chance to study because they have no money.

Professor Address Malata was the Must Vice Chancellor who is now leaving the job. She said the K50 million comes at a good time. She said the Endowment Fund will help Must have money for the future. She said the fund will help make new leaders who can fix Malawi's problems.

The K50 million will pay for three things. First, it will give scholarships to students. Second, it will give money for research. Third, it will pay for new ideas and projects. These projects will help Malawi grow and move forward. The money shows that big banks in Malawi want to help schools and universities make strong workers for the country.

ny.title: Banki ya Standard yapereka K50 miliyoni ku thumba la mayunivesite
ny.body: Banki ya Standard yapereka ndalama zokwana K50 miliyoni ku Malawi University of Science and Technology (Must) Endowment Fund. Mkulu wa bankiyi Phillip Madinga anapereka ndalamazo kwa Nduna ya Maphunziro Bright Msaka Lachinayi. Mphatsoyi ithandiza ophunzira ndi kufufuza ku yunivesiteyi.
ny.body_more:
Ndalama ya Must Endowment Fund idapangidwa kuti ipereke ndalama zothandizira maphunziro, kafukufuku ndi nyumba zatsopano ku yunivesite. Ndalamayi imathandiza ophunzira omwe alibe ndalama zambiri. Madinga adati bankiyi ikufuna kuthandiza atsogoleri otsatira, asayansi ndi akatswiri atsopano ku Malawi. Anati mphatsoyi ikuwonetsa kuti bankiyi ikufuna kumanga luso ndikuthandizira kafukufuku. Anatinso palibe wophunzira wabwino amene ayenera kutaya mwayi wophunzira chifukwa alibe ndalama.

Pulofesa Address Malata anali Must Vice Chancellor yemwe tsopano akusiya ntchito. Anati K50 miliyoni ikubwera panthawi yabwino. Anati Ndalama ya Endowment Fund ithandiza Must kukhala ndi ndalama zamtsogolo. Anati ndalamayi ithandiza kupanga atsogoleri atsopano omwe angathe kukonza mavuto a Malawi.

K50 miliyoni idzalipira zinthu zitatu. Choyamba, ipereka maphunziro kwa ophunzira. Chachiwiri, ipereka ndalama zofufuzira. Chachitatu, idzalipira malingaliro ndi mapulojekiti atsopano. Mapulojekiti awa athandiza Malawi kukula ndikupita patsogolo. Ndalamazi zikusonyeza kuti mabanki akuluakulu ku Malawi akufuna kuthandiza masukulu ndi mayunivesite kupanga antchito olimba mdzikolo.

en.title: Parliament orders new check on Kangankunde mine in Balaka
en.body: Parliament has ordered a fresh investigation into the Kangankunde Rare Earths Project in Balaka. Speaker Sameer Suleman directed committees to look into the mine's licence, rules, and export of mineral samples. Lilongwe Nyanja MP Steve Baba Malondera called for the mine to stop work. He said the Australian-owned company was mining without a valid licence.
en.body_more:
Minister of Mining Thoko Tembo told Parliament that government checks found no illegal mining. He said mineral samples that were exported had been approved by the right government offices for testing. Tembo said the work was part of the normal technical work needed to develop the rare earths project.

Tembo said the government keeps watch on the mine through inspections. The Ministry of Mining, the Malawi Mining Regulatory Authority, and other government offices do these checks. They make sure the company follows Malawi's mining laws and rules. Tembo welcomed the Speaker's order for Parliament to do its own investigation. He said the government had nothing to hide and would help the lawmakers.

The Natural Resources Committee of Parliament had raised concerns about environmental care, the licence type, and the export of samples for testing. Tembo said the government will keep working with the Malawi Environmental Protection Authority. He said all environmental approvals must be obtained before any new activities start. Tembo also said the government agrees that Malawi needs a better geological lab. He said the government will find money to build lab facilities for rare earth minerals and other minerals. This will reduce the need to send samples to foreign labs.

The Kangankunde Rare Earths Project is owned by Australian company Lindian Resources. The rare earth minerals found there include dysprosium and terbium. These minerals are used in electric vehicles, renewable energy systems, and military equipment. The project is seen as important for Malawi's economic growth.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo yalamula kuti mgodi wa Kangankunde ufufuzidwenso ku Balaka
ny.body: Nyumba Yamalamulo yalamula kuti pakhale kafukufuku watsopano pa Kangankunde Rare Earths Project ku Balaka. Sipikala Sameer Suleman walamula makomiti kuti ayang'ane za chilolezo cha mgodi, malamulo, ndi kutumiza zitsanzo za mchere kunja. MP wa ku Lilongwe Nyanja Steve Baba Malondera wapempha kuti mgodiwo usiye kugwira ntchito. Iye anati kampani ya ku Australia ikukumba migodi popanda chilolezo chovomerezeka.
ny.body_more:
Nduna ya Zamigodi Thoko Tembo adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti macheke a boma sanapeze migodi yosaloledwa. Iye adati zitsanzo za mchere zomwe zidatumizidwa kunja zavomerezedwa ndi maofesi aboma oyenera kuti ziyesedwe. Tembo adati ntchitoyi ndi gawo la ntchito yaukadaulo yofunikira popanga pulojekiti ya rare earth.

Tembo adati boma limayang'anira mgodi kudzera mukuwunika. Unduna wa Zamigodi, Malawi Mining Regulatory Authority, ndi maofesi ena aboma amachita macheke awa. Amaonetsetsa kuti kampaniyo ikutsatira malamulo ndi malamulo a migodi ku Malawi. Tembo adalandila lamulo la Sipikala kuti Nyumba Yamalamulo ichite kafukufuku wake. Anati boma lilibe chobisa ndipo lithandiza opanga malamulo.

Komiti ya Zachilengedwe ya Nyumba Yamalamulo yapereka nkhawa zokhudzana ndi chisamaliro cha chilengedwe, mtundu wa layisensi, ndi kutumiza zitsanzo kunja kuti ziyesedwe. Tembo adati boma lipitiliza kugwira ntchito ndi Malawi Environmental Protection Authority. Anati zilolezo zonse zachilengedwe ziyenera kupezeka ntchito zatsopano zisanayambe. Tembo adatinso boma likuvomereza kuti Malawi ikufunika labu yabwino kwambiri ya geology. Anati boma lipeza ndalama zomangira malo ochitira labu a miyala ya rare earth ndi miyala ina. Izi zichepetsa kufunikira kotumiza zitsanzo ku labu zakunja.

Kangankunde Rare Earths Project ndi ya kampani ya ku Australia ya Lindian Resources. Miyala ya nthaka yosowa yomwe imapezeka kumeneko ndi monga dysprosium ndi terbium. Miyala iyi imagwiritsidwa ntchito m'magalimoto amagetsi, makina obwezeretsanso mphamvu, komanso zida zankhondo. Ntchitoyi ikuwoneka kuti ndi yofunika kwambiri pakukula kwachuma cha Malawi.

en.title: MRA says tax stamp system helps more tax money
en.body: The Malawi Revenue Authority says the Kalondola Tax Stamps system has helped the government collect more tax money. The system started two years ago. MRA Head of Corporate Affairs Wilma Chalulu said makers of goods now pay more excise tax. Excise tax is money the government takes when goods are made. Some makers pay much more tax than before.
en.body_more:
Wilma Chalulu told people that some makers have seen their tax bills grow very much. The new system tracks goods better and stops gaps in the supply chain. A supply chain is the path goods take from maker to buyer.

When makers register for the stamp, they get a clearance certificate. This paper is a proof that the goods are legal. Customs officers and buyers know the goods are good. This certificate helps goods move faster at the border. It also costs less to ship goods.

Small and medium makers say the stamp helps them work in the open. When they register, they can sell more easily and do business in other countries. Traders in Zambia and Tanzania now buy from Malawi makers because the goods have the stamp. The stamp shows that the goods are real and safe.

Local business groups want to teach owners how to use the stamp system. They hold workshops with help from the Chambers of Commerce. Owners learn how to mark goods, store them right, and send in their records on time. The government also gives tax breaks to makers who make more goods and keep records on computers.

Government leaders say this system helps the country grow. More tax money comes in. This money can build better roads and power lines. Better roads help makers send goods to other countries and sell more. Foreign investors see that Malawi is stable and want to put money here in bottling, beer making, and sweet making.

ny.title: MRA yati njira yosungiramo masitampu a msonkho imathandiza ndalama zambiri za msonkho
ny.body: Bungwe la Malawi Revenue Authority likunena kuti njira ya Kalondola Tax Stamps yathandiza boma kusonkhanitsa ndalama zambiri zamisonkho. Njirayi idayamba zaka ziwiri zapitazo. Mtsogoleri wa MRA wa Corporate Affairs Wilma Chalulu adati opanga katundu tsopano amalipira msonkho wochulukirapo wa excise. Misonkho ya excise ndi ndalama zomwe boma limatenga katundu akapangidwa. Opanga ena amalipira msonkho wochuluka kwambiri kuposa kale.
ny.body_more:
Wilma Chalulu anauza anthu kuti opanga ena awona mabilu awo amisonkho akukula kwambiri. Dongosolo latsopanoli limatsata bwino katundu ndikuletsa mipata mu unyolo wopereka. Unyolo wopereka ndi njira yomwe katundu amatenga kuchokera kwa wopanga kupita kwa wogula.

Opanga akalembetsa sitampu, amalandira satifiketi yovomerezeka. Pepala ili ndi umboni wakuti katunduyo ndi wovomerezeka. Akuluakulu a misonkho ndi ogula amadziwa kuti katunduyo ndi wabwino. Satifiketi iyi imathandiza katundu kuyenda mwachangu pamalire. Zimawononganso ndalama zochepa kutumiza katundu.

Opanga ang'onoang'ono ndi apakatikati akuti sitampuyo imawathandiza kugwira ntchito poyera. Akalembetsa, amatha kugulitsa mosavuta ndikuchita bizinesi m'maiko ena. Amalonda ku Zambia ndi Tanzania tsopano amagula kuchokera kwa opanga aku Malawi chifukwa katunduyo ali ndi sitampuyo. Sitampuyo ikuwonetsa kuti katunduyo ndi weniweni komanso wotetezeka.

Magulu amalonda am'deralo akufuna kuphunzitsa eni ake momwe angagwiritsire ntchito njira yotsatsira sitampu. Amachita misonkhano mothandizidwa ndi Chambers of Commerce. Eni ake amaphunzira momwe angalembe katundu, kuwasunga bwino, ndikutumiza zolemba zawo panthawi yake. Boma limaperekanso mpumulo wamisonkho kwa opanga omwe amapanga katundu wambiri ndikusunga zolemba pamakompyuta.

Atsogoleri aboma amati njira iyi imathandiza dzikolo kukula. Ndalama zambiri zamisonkho zimabwera. Ndalamazi zimatha kumanga misewu yabwino komanso mawaya amagetsi abwino. Misewu yabwino imathandiza opanga kutumiza katundu kumayiko ena ndikugulitsa zambiri. Ogulitsa akunja akuwona kuti Malawi ndi yokhazikika ndipo akufuna kuyika ndalama pano mu mabotolo, kupanga mowa, ndi kupanga maswiti.

en.title: Malawi Parliament passes 12 bills and adjourns
en.body: Malawi's parliament closed its meeting on Friday, August 7, 2026. Speaker Sameer Suleman ended the session sine die – which means without a fixed date to return. Parliament passed 12 new bills during the five-week meeting in Lilongwe. The bills change rules for banks, money, and the economy.
en.body_more:
The parliament worked very hard. MPs answered more than 400 questions from each other. The government extended the meeting by one week to finish all the work. President Arthur Peter Mutharika helped by approving the extra time.

The new bills are very important. One bill is the Economics Society of Malawi Bill. This bill will control who can work as an economist. Before, anyone could say they were an economist. Six bills change rules for banks and money services. One bill stops the use of paper cheques. Another bill protects people's money in banks. Two more bills help catch crimes with money and make the payment system better.

Speaker Suleman asked parliament committees to do better work. He said oversight is very important. This means parliament must watch what the government does. He told MPs to visit their people and listen to them. He also said MPs must come to meetings. Not coming hurts trust in parliament.

But one big problem remains unsolved. The Public Accounts Committee did not finish its report. The report is about K128 billion. This money was used to buy Amaryllis Hotel in Blantyre. The Public Service Pension Trust Fund bought it. Many people want answers. Michael Kaiyatsa said Malawians waited too long. He warned that trust in parliament is falling. The committee was supposed to hear from Colleen Zamba, who was Secretary to the President and Cabinet. But she did not come many times. The report did not finish before parliament closed.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo ku Malawi yavomereza malamulo 12 ndikuyimitsa ntchito
ny.body: Nyumba yamalamulo ya ku Malawi inatseka msonkhano wake Lachisanu, pa 7 Ogasiti, 2026. Sipikala Sameer Suleman anamaliza msonkhanowo ndi kulira - zomwe zikutanthauza kuti palibe tsiku lokhazikika loti abwerere. Nyumba yamalamulo inavomereza malamulo atsopano 12 pamsonkhano wa milungu isanu ku Lilongwe. Malamulowa amasintha malamulo a mabanki, ndalama, ndi chuma.
ny.body_more:
Nyumba yamalamulo inagwira ntchito molimbika kwambiri. Aphungu a Nyumba yamalamulo anayankha mafunso oposa 400 kuchokera kwa wina ndi mnzake. Boma linawonjezera msonkhanowo ndi sabata imodzi kuti amalize ntchito yonse. Purezidenti Arthur Peter Mutharika anathandiza povomereza nthawi yowonjezera.

Malamulo atsopanowa ndi ofunikira kwambiri. Lamulo limodzi ndi la Economics Society of Malawi Bill. Lamuloli lidzalamulira omwe angagwire ntchito ngati katswiri wa zachuma. Kale, aliyense anganene kuti anali katswiri wa zachuma. Malamulo asanu ndi limodzi amasintha malamulo a mabanki ndi ntchito zandalama. Lamulo limodzi limaletsa kugwiritsa ntchito macheke apepala. Lamulo lina limateteza ndalama za anthu m'mabanki. Malamulo ena awiri amathandiza kuthana ndi milandu ndi ndalama ndikupanga njira yolipira kukhala yabwino.

Spika Suleman adapempha makomiti a nyumba yamalamulo kuti agwire ntchito yabwino. Anati kuyang'anira ndikofunikira kwambiri. Izi zikutanthauza kuti nyumba yamalamulo iyenera kuyang'anira zomwe boma limachita. Adauza aphungu a Nyumba yamalamulo kuti akachezere anthu awo ndikuwamvetsera. Anatinso aphungu a Nyumba yamalamulo ayenera kubwera kumisonkhano. Kusabwera kumavulaza chidaliro mu nyumba yamalamulo.

Koma vuto limodzi lalikulu silinathetsedwe. Komiti ya Public Accounts sinamalize lipoti lake. Lipotilo ndi pafupifupi K128 biliyoni. Ndalamazi zinagwiritsidwa ntchito kugula Amaryllis Hotel ku Blantyre. Bungwe la Public Service Pension Trust Fund linagula nkhaniyi. Anthu ambiri akufuna mayankho. Michael Kaiyatsa anati anthu aku Malawi anadikira nthawi yayitali. Anachenjeza kuti chidaliro mu nyumba yamalamulo chikuchepa. Komitiyo inkayenera kumva kuchokera kwa Colleen Zamba, yemwe anali Mlembi wa Purezidenti ndi Kabineti. Koma sanabwere kangapo. Lipotilo silinathe nyumba yamalamulo isanatseke.

en.title: Cannabis regulator arrested with 19kg of chamba
en.body: Police arrested two men at Jenda in Mzimba on August 6. David Chikomeni Chirwa, 49, is a board member of the Cannabis Regulatory Authority. He was caught with 19.2 kilograms of cannabis in a car. Police say he had no permit for the drug.
en.body_more:
Officers at a roadblock stopped the Toyota Sienta as it travelled from Lilongwe to Mzuzu. Inside the vehicle, police found the large amount of cannabis hidden away. A second man, Storm Kandodo, 45, from Mpulula Village in Balaka District, was also arrested with Chikomeni. Kandodo is from Traditional Authority Nsamala.

Gladwell Simwaka, the police spokesperson at Jenda Police Station, said the men had no documents to show they could carry the drug. Cannabis Sativa is the full name of the plant. Locally, people call it chamba. Police seized the drug and kept both men in custody.

Chikomeni's arrest is unusual and embarrassing. He sits on the board of the Cannabis Regulatory Authority. This is the government body that decides who can grow, own, and sell cannabis in Malawi. The CRA gives permits to people who want to work with cannabis legally. Chikomeni is meant to help regulate the drug, not break the law about it.

Chikomeni stood as an independent candidate in the 2019 presidential election. He is a Rastafarian, a religious group whose followers often use cannabis. The two men will appear in court soon. They face charges of possessing Cannabis Sativa without a permit. The case will be decided by a judge.

ny.title: Woyang'anira za chamba wagwidwa ndi 19kg ya chamba
ny.body: Apolisi adagwira amuna awiri ku Jenda ku Mzimba pa Ogasiti 6. David Chikomeni Chirwa, wazaka 49, ndi membala wa bungwe la Cannabis Regulatory Authority. Adagwidwa ndi makilogalamu 19.2 a chamba mgalimoto. Apolisi akuti analibe chilolezo chogula chambacho.
ny.body_more:
Apolisi omwe anali pa msewu wotsekeredwa anaimitsa galimoto ya Toyota Sienta pamene inkayenda kuchokera ku Lilongwe kupita ku Mzuzu. Mkati mwa galimotoyo, apolisi anapeza chamba chochuluka chomwe chinali chobisika. Mwamuna wina, Storm Kandodo, wazaka 45, wochokera ku Mpulula Village ku Balaka District, nayenso anamangidwa ndi Chikomeni. Kandodo ndi wochokera ku Traditional Authority Nsamala.

Gladwell Simwaka, wolankhulira apolisi ku Jenda Police Station, anati amunawa analibe zikalata zosonyeza kuti akhoza kunyamula mankhwalawo. Cannabis Sativa ndi dzina lonse la chomeracho. Kumaloko, anthu amachitcha chamba. Apolisi anagwira mankhwalawo ndipo anasunga amuna onse awiri m'ndende.

Kumangidwa kwa Chikomeni n'kwachilendo komanso kochititsa manyazi. Ali m'bungwe la Cannabis Regulatory Authority. Ili ndi bungwe la boma lomwe limasankha omwe angalime, kukhala ndi, ndikugulitsa chamba ku Malawi. CRA imapereka zilolezo kwa anthu omwe akufuna kugwira ntchito ndi chamba mwalamulo. Chikomeni cholinga chake ndi kuthandiza kuwongolera mankhwalawo, osati kuswa lamulo lokhudza chambacho.

Chikomeni adayima ngati woyimira payokha pa chisankho cha purezidenti cha 2019. Iye ndi Rastafari, gulu lachipembedzo lomwe otsatira ake nthawi zambiri amagwiritsa ntchito chamba. Amuna awiriwa adzawonekera kukhothi posachedwa. Akukumana ndi milandu yokhala ndi Cannabis Sativa popanda chilolezo. Mlanduwu udzagamulidwa ndi woweruza milandu.

en.title: Mining Minister Says Kangankunde Project Has No Illegal Activity
en.body: Malawi's Mining Minister Thoko Tembo told parliament on Friday that government checks found no illegal mining at the Kangankunde Rare Earth project in Balaka. The minister said all materials leaving the site were approved for testing. Parliament's Natural Resources Committee had raised concerns about blasting, ore stockpiles, and mineral exports.
en.body_more:
Minister Tembo explained that rare earth exploration is a technical process. Valuable minerals are found in very small amounts inside large rocks. One truckload of mined material may have only a small amount of actual rare earth elements. This is why companies need large samples for laboratory testing and analysis.

Tembo said the size of samples should not be seen as proof of wrongdoing. He said all exported materials had regulatory approval for laboratory work and technical purposes. The minister told MPs that some people do not understand mining processes, and this causes unnecessary fear. He asked Malawians to seek proper information before forming opinions about the project.

Government will continue to check the Kangankunde project through regular inspections. The Ministry of Mining, the Mining and Minerals Regulatory Authority, and other agencies will do this work. The goal is to ensure the project follows Malawi's mining laws. Tembo said government is also working with Rift Valley Resources Developments Limited on remaining compliance issues. Companies that break the law may face enforcement action under the Mines and Minerals Act 2023. Tembo said government's priority is to protect Malawi's interests, encourage responsible investment, and bring economic benefits to citizens.

ny.title: Nduna ya Zamigodi Yati Pulojekiti ya Kangankunde Ilibe Zochita Zosaloledwa
ny.body: Nduna ya Zamigodi ku Malawi, Thoko Tembo, idauza nyumba yamalamulo Lachisanu kuti macheke a boma sanapeze kuti pali migodi yosaloledwa pa projekiti ya Kangankunde Rare Earth ku Balaka. Ndunayo idati zinthu zonse zomwe zidachoka pamalopo zavomerezedwa kuti ziyesedwe. Komiti ya Zachilengedwe ya Nyumba Yamalamulo yapereka nkhawa zokhudzana ndi kuphulika kwa zinthu, kusungidwa kwa miyala, ndi kutumiza miyala kunja.
ny.body_more:
Nduna Tembo anafotokoza kuti kufufuza nthaka yosowa ndi njira yaukadaulo. Miyala yamtengo wapatali imapezeka pang'ono kwambiri mkati mwa miyala ikuluikulu. Galimoto imodzi yodzaza ndi zinthu zofufuzidwa ikhoza kukhala ndi zinthu zochepa chabe za nthaka yosowa. Ichi ndichifukwa chake makampani amafunika zitsanzo zazikulu kuti ayesedwe ndi kusanthula labotale.

Tembo adati kukula kwa zitsanzo sikuyenera kuonedwa ngati umboni wa cholakwika. Iye adati zinthu zonse zotumizidwa kunja zili ndi chilolezo chovomerezeka cha ntchito za labotale ndi zaukadaulo. Ndunayo idauza aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo kuti anthu ena samvetsa njira zofufuzira migodi, ndipo izi zimayambitsa mantha osafunikira. Adapempha anthu aku Malawi kuti afufuze bwino asanapange malingaliro okhudza polojekitiyi.

Boma lipitiliza kuyang'ana pulojekiti ya Kangankunde kudzera mukuwunika nthawi zonse. Unduna wa Migodi, Boma Loyang'anira Migodi ndi Migodi, ndi mabungwe ena achita ntchitoyi. Cholinga chake ndikuwonetsetsa kuti pulojekitiyi ikutsatira malamulo a migodi ku Malawi. Tembo adati boma likugwiranso ntchito ndi Rift Valley Resources Developments Limited pankhani zotsala zotsata malamulo. Makampani omwe amaswa lamulo angakumane ndi milandu yokhudza kukakamiza malamulo motsatira lamulo la Mines and Minerals Act 2023. Tembo adati cholinga chachikulu cha boma ndikuteteza zofuna za Malawi, kulimbikitsa ndalama zodalirika, ndikubweretsa phindu pazachuma kwa nzika.

en.title: Reserve Bank keeps borrowing costs the same
en.body: The Reserve Bank of Malawi has kept the policy rate at 24 percent. The policy rate is the cost of borrowing money. The Monetary Policy Committee made this choice on August 5 and 6, 2026. Prices are going down slowly. The bank wants the earlier changes to keep working.
en.body_more:
Prices fell to almost 23 percent in the second quarter from over 24 percent in the first quarter. The bank believes prices will drop to 22 percent by the end of 2026. George Partridge is the chairperson of the committee and governor of the Reserve Bank. He said keeping the rate the same will help prices fall more and keep money stable.

The committee also kept two other rates the same. The Liquidity Reserve Requirement stays at 12 percent for local money and 3.75 percent for foreign money. The Lombard Rate stays at 0.2 percent higher than the policy rate. But prices are still much higher than the bank's target of 5 percent.

Food prices fell because more food was available. But prices for other things stayed high because of electricity costs and expensive imported goods. The bank now says the economy will grow 2.8 percent in 2026. This is lower than the earlier guess of 3.8 percent. Growth was 2.5 percent in 2025. Money growth slowed greatly in the second quarter. This shows the earlier changes are working. Banks remain strong and have enough money. The next committee meeting will be on October 28 and 29, 2026.

The committee warned of risks ahead. Tensions between countries could affect global trade. El Niño weather could harm crops in the 2026 to 2027 growing season. These things could push prices up again.

ny.title: Banki Yaikulu ikupitirizabe kubweza ndalama zomwezo
ny.body: Banki Yaikulu ya Malawi yasunga chiwongola dzanja cha ndondomeko pa 24 peresenti. Chiwongola dzanja cha ndondomeko ndi mtengo wobwereka ndalama. Komiti ya Ndondomeko ya Ndalama idasankha izi pa Ogasiti 5 ndi 6, 2026. Mitengo ikutsika pang'onopang'ono. Bankiyo ikufuna kuti kusintha koyambirira kupitirize kugwira ntchito.
ny.body_more:
Mitengo inatsika kufika pafupifupi 23 peresenti mu kotala yachiwiri kuchokera pa oposa 24 peresenti mu kotala yoyamba. Banki ikukhulupirira kuti mitengo idzatsika kufika pa 22 peresenti pofika kumapeto kwa chaka cha 2026. George Partridge ndiye wapampando wa komiti komanso bwanamkubwa wa Reserve Bank. Iye anati kusunga mitengo mofanana kudzathandiza mitengo kutsika kwambiri ndikusunga ndalama zokhazikika.

Komitiyi idasunganso mitengo ina iwiri yofanana. Chifuniro cha Liquidity Reserve chikukhala pa 12 peresenti ya ndalama zakomweko ndi 3.75 peresenti ya ndalama zakunja. Chiwongola dzanja cha Lombard chikukhala pa 0.2 peresenti yokwera kuposa chiwongola dzanja cha ndondomeko. Koma mitengo ikadali yokwera kwambiri kuposa cholinga cha banki cha 5 peresenti.

Mitengo ya chakudya inatsika chifukwa chakudya chochuluka chinalipo. Koma mitengo ya zinthu zina inakhala yokwera chifukwa cha mtengo wamagetsi ndi katundu wokwera mtengo wochokera kunja. Banki tsopano ikunena kuti chuma chidzakula ndi 2.8 peresenti mu 2026. Izi ndi zotsika kuposa zomwe zinali kuganiziridwa kale za 3.8 peresenti. Kukula kunali 2.5 peresenti mu 2025. Kukula kwa ndalama kunachepa kwambiri mu kotala yachiwiri. Izi zikusonyeza kuti kusintha koyambirira kukugwira ntchito. Mabanki akadali olimba ndipo ali ndi ndalama zokwanira. Msonkhano wotsatira wa komiti udzakhala pa 28 ndi 29 Okutobala, 2026.

Komitiyo inachenjeza za zoopsa zomwe zikubwera. Kusamvana pakati pa mayiko kungakhudze malonda apadziko lonse. Nyengo ya El Niño ikhoza kuwononga mbewu mu nyengo yolima ya 2026 mpaka 2027. Zinthuzi zitha kukweza mitengo kachiwiri.

en.title: Parliament ends sitting without Amaryllis Hotel report
en.body: Parliament rose on Friday without receiving a report from the Public Accounts Committee about the K128 billion purchase of Amaryllis Hotel in Blantyre. The hotel was bought by the Public Service Pension Trust Fund. The committee was told to finish its work, but the report was not given to Parliament.
en.body_more:
The Public Accounts Committee started its investigation earlier this year. The probe looked at how K128 billion was spent to buy the hotel. About K90 billion was already given to the old owners. Many questions remained unanswered about the price, the way the deal was done, and how it was paid for.

The committee's work was stopped when former Secretary to the President and Cabinet Colleen Zamba did not come to give evidence many times. The committee wanted to finish without her testimony. But the Leader of the House Jappie Mhango said she must speak to the committee. The committee held more meetings for her, but she did not come. The chairperson Steven Malondera said the State must stop a court case against Zamba before she could speak to the committee. This delayed the work more. The Speaker of Parliament Sameer Suleman then said the committee could finish and give the report without Zamba's evidence. But this did not happen.

When asked on Thursday, Malondera did not say why the report was not finished. He said the committee would soon meet to approve the report. But he said Parliament must agree to receive it. This decision rests with Parliament, he added.

Civil society groups are worried. Michael Kaiyatsa from the National Anti-Corruption Alliance said Malawians have waited too long for answers. Benedict Kondowe from the National Advocacy Platform said the delay is bad for fighting corruption. He said the report must come out to show the facts about the hotel deal. Without it, people may lose trust in Parliament to check how government uses money.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo yatha popanda lipoti la Amaryllis Hotel
ny.body: Nyumba yamalamulo idadzuka Lachisanu popanda kulandira lipoti kuchokera ku Komiti Yoona za Maakaunti a Anthu Lonse lokhudza kugula hotelo ya Amaryllis ku Blantyre ya K128 biliyoni. Hoteloyi idagulidwa ndi Public Service Pension Trust Fund. Komitiyo idauzidwa kuti imalize ntchito yake, koma lipotilo silinaperekedwe ku Nyumba yamalamulo.
ny.body_more:
Komiti Yoona za Maakaunti a Anthu inayamba kufufuza koyambirira kwa chaka chino. Kafukufukuyu adayang'ana momwe K128 biliyoni idagwiritsidwira ntchito kugula hoteloyi. Pafupifupi K90 biliyoni idaperekedwa kale kwa eni ake akale. Mafunso ambiri sanayankhidwe okhudza mtengo, momwe mgwirizanowu udachitikira, komanso momwe udalipidwira.

Ntchito ya komitiyi idayimitsidwa pamene wakale Mlembi wa Purezidenti ndi Cabinet Colleen Zamba sanabwere kudzapereka umboni kangapo. Komitiyi inkafuna kumaliza popanda umboni wake. Koma Mtsogoleri wa Nyumba Yamalamulo Jappie Mhango adati ayenera kulankhula ndi komitiyi. Komitiyi idachita misonkhano yambiri kwa iye, koma sanabwere. Wapampando Steven Malondera adati Boma liyenera kuyimitsa mlandu kukhothi motsutsana ndi Zamba asanalankhule ndi komitiyi. Izi zidachedwetsa ntchitoyo kwambiri. Kenako Sipikala wa Nyumba Yamalamulo Sameer Suleman adati komitiyi ikhoza kumaliza ndikupereka lipotilo popanda umboni wa Zamba. Koma izi sizinachitike.

Atafunsidwa Lachinayi, Malondera sananene chifukwa chake lipotilo silinamalizidwe. Anati komitiyi ikumana posachedwa kuti ivomereze lipotilo. Koma adati Nyumba Yamalamulo iyenera kuvomereza kulilandira. Chigamulochi chili m'manja mwa Nyumba Yamalamulo, anawonjezera.

Mabungwe a anthu wamba akuda nkhawa. Michael Kaiyatsa wa National Anti-Corruption Alliance anati anthu aku Malawi adikira nthawi yayitali kuti apeze mayankho. Benedict Kondowe wa National Advocacy Platform anati kuchedwako n'koipa polimbana ndi ziphuphu. Anati lipotilo liyenera kutulutsidwa kuti liwonetse zoona za mgwirizano wa hotelo. Popanda izi, anthu angataye chidaliro mu Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti ione momwe boma limagwiritsira ntchito ndalama.

en.title: Parliament passes law to regulate economists
en.body: Parliament passed a new law on Thursday, August 6. The law creates the Economics Society of Malawi (ESOMA). This body will register, regulate and discipline economists. Finance Minister Joseph Mwanamvekha said the law will strengthen the profession. Before this, the old Economics Association of Malawi (ECAMA) could not discipline economists.
en.body_more:
Minister Mwanamvekha explained why the law was needed. He said economists give advice on money and policy to the government and businesses. But they had no official body to check if they were qualified. "We hear people on social media talk as economists when they do not know economics," he said. "This law will give recognition to qualified economists only."

ECAMA was just a group of professionals. It had no power to register or discipline economists. The new ESOMA body will have this power. All economists and companies that give economic advice must register with ESOMA. They must get a licence. This will show they meet the required standards.

MP Arthur Sungitsa from Dowa district said the new body should work with data and facts, not politics. He said ECAMA did good work and should get recognition. He also asked ESOMA to work with the University of Malawi to train new economists. Sungitsa said ESOMA must be affordable so all economists can join. Budget and Finance Committee chairperson Sosten Gwengwe said the law was made after talking with ECAMA. He said it is wide enough to include students and economists in far places. Opposition UTM spokesperson Felix Njawala said strong rules are needed for economists, just like other professions have rules.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo yapereka lamulo lowongolera akatswiri azachuma
ny.body: Nyumba Yamalamulo idapereka lamulo latsopano Lachinayi, pa 6 Ogasiti. Lamuloli lipanga bungwe la Economics Society of Malawi (ESOMA). Bungweli lidzalembetsa, kuwongolera ndi kulanga akatswiri azachuma. Nduna ya zachuma Joseph Mwanamvekha adati lamuloli lidzalimbitsa ntchitoyi. Izi zisanachitike, bungwe lakale la Economics Association of Malawi (ECAMA) silinkatha kulanga akatswiri azachuma.
ny.body_more:
Nduna Mwanamvekha anafotokoza chifukwa chake lamuloli linkafunika. Anati akatswiri azachuma amapereka upangiri pa ndalama ndi mfundo kwa boma ndi mabizinesi. Koma analibe bungwe lovomerezeka loti liwone ngati ali oyenerera. "Timamva anthu pa malo ochezera a pa Intaneti akulankhula ngati akatswiri azachuma pomwe sadziwa zachuma," adatero. "Lamuloli lidzapereka ulemu kwa akatswiri azachuma oyenerera okha."

ECAMA inali gulu la akatswiri chabe. Lilibe mphamvu zolembetsa kapena kulanga akatswiri azachuma. Bungwe latsopano la ESOMA lidzakhala ndi mphamvu imeneyi. Akatswiri azachuma onse ndi makampani omwe amapereka upangiri wazachuma ayenera kulembetsa ndi ESOMA. Ayenera kupeza chilolezo. Izi ziwonetsa kuti akukwaniritsa miyezo yofunikira.

MP Arthur Sungitsa wochokera ku chigawo cha Dowa adati bungwe latsopanoli liyenera kugwira ntchito ndi deta ndi mfundo, osati ndale. Anati ECAMA yachita bwino ndipo iyenera kuvomerezedwa. Anapemphanso ESOMA kuti igwire ntchito ndi University of Malawi kuphunzitsa akatswiri azachuma atsopano. Sungitsa adati ESOMA iyenera kukhala yotsika mtengo kuti akatswiri azachuma onse athe kulowa nawo. Wapampando wa Komiti ya Bajeti ndi Zachuma Sosten Gwengwe adati lamuloli lidapangidwa atakambirana ndi ECAMA. Iye anati ndi lalikulu mokwanira kuti ophunzira ndi akatswiri azachuma azitha kuyikapo mbali zina. Mneneri wa chipani chotsutsa cha UTM, Felix Njawala, adati malamulo olimba amafunika kwa akatswiri azachuma, monga momwe akatswiri ena alili ndi malamulo.

en.title: Malawi Women's Team Reaches Cup Quarterfinals
