en.body: Malawi's national women's football team, the Scorchers, moved to the quarterfinals of the Women's Africa Cup of Nations. They lost 1-2 to Zambia on Wednesday in Morocco. The team still went forward because of goal difference. Football Association of Malawi president Fleetwood Haiya said he will increase player bonuses.
en.body_more:
The Scorchers played Zambia at Al Madina Stadium in Rabat in their final group match. Zambia scored first through Barbra Banda in the opening minute. Margaret Belemu made a second goal for Zambia eight minutes before half-time. Prisca Chilufya scored that goal. Zambia led 2-0 at the break.

Malawi fought back after half-time. Tabitha Chawinga scored in the 72nd minute. She moved past two Zambia players and shot low past the goalkeeper. The final score was 1-2 to Zambia. But Malawi still went through to the quarterfinals.

The Scorchers finished top of Group C. Nigeria, the defending champions, finished second after beating Egypt 4-2. Zambia's campaign ended after the loss to Malawi. The cup is called the TotalEnergies CAF Women's Africa Cup of Nations Morocco 2026.

Fleetwood Haiya, the Football Association of Malawi president, said he will revise the bonuses for the Scorchers. The team's success at the cup was historic for Malawi women's football.

ny.title: Timu ya Azimayi ya Malawi Yafika mu Quarterfinals ya Cup
ny.body: Timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya dziko la Malawi, Scorchers, yafika mu quarterfinals ya Women's Africa Cup of Nations. Yagonja 1-2 ndi Zambia Lachitatu ku Morocco. Timuyi idapitilizabe kupita patsogolo chifukwa cha kusiyana kwa zigoli. Purezidenti wa Football Association of Malawi, Fleetwood Haiya, adati awonjezera mabhonasi a osewera.
ny.body_more:
A Scorchers adasewera ndi Zambia pa Al Madina Stadium ku Rabat pamasewera awo omaliza a gulu. Zambia idapeza chigoli choyamba kudzera mwa Barbra Banda mu mphindi yoyamba. Margaret Belemu adapanga chigoli chachiwiri kwa Zambia mphindi zisanu ndi zitatu nthawi yopuma isanafike. Prisca Chilufya adapanga chigoli chimenecho. Zambia idatsogolera 2-0 nthawi yopuma.

Malawi adalimbana pambuyo pa nthawi yopuma. Tabitha Chawinga adapanga chigoli mu mphindi ya 72. Adadutsa osewera awiri a Zambia ndikuponya chigoli chapansi kudutsa wolondera. Chigoli chomaliza chinali 1-2 kwa Zambia. Koma Malawi idapitilirabe mpaka kotala fainali.

A Scorchers adamaliza pamwamba pa Gulu C. Nigeria, omwe adateteza ngwazi, adamaliza pachiwiri atagonjetsa Egypt 4-2. Kampeni ya Zambia idatha pambuyo pa kugonjetsedwa ndi Malawi. Chikhochi chimatchedwa TotalEnergies CAF Women's Africa Cup of Nations Morocco 2026.

Fleetwood Haiya, purezidenti wa Football Association of Malawi, adati asintha mabhonasi a Scorchers. Kupambana kwa timuyi pa chikhochi kunali mbiri yakale kwa mpira wa azimayi aku Malawi.

en.title: American pilot fined for landing plane without permission
en.body: An American pilot named Terry Lee Jennings landed his plane at Bakili Muluzi International Airport without permission. The Blantyre Magistrate's Court fined him K3 million (money he must pay as punishment). This is a fine: a sum of money paid as punishment for breaking a rule. He could have gone to prison for one year instead. Jennings paid the money and left.
en.body_more:
Jennings was arrested on Wednesday after flying from South Africa into Malawi. He did not follow the rules for landing planes. Southern Region police spokesperson Beatrice Mikuwa said Jennings broke aviation regulations. Aviation regulations are the rules that planes and pilots must follow when they fly.

The case went to the Blantyre Magistrate's Court. Magistrate Paul Chiotcha heard the case and found Jennings guilty. Guilty means he broke the law. The magistrate ordered him to pay K3 million or spend one year in prison. Jennings chose to pay the fine.

The plane had come to Malawi to collect people. These people had been on holiday in the country. One source said they were a foreign couple. Another source said they were a family. The plane was then going to take them to Portugal to leave Malawi. After Jennings paid the fine, the aircraft left the airport and went away.

ny.title: Woyendetsa ndege waku America apatsidwa chindapusa chifukwa chotsika ndege popanda chilolezo
ny.body: Woyendetsa ndege waku America dzina lake Terry Lee Jennings anafika pa bwalo la ndege la Bakili Muluzi International Airport popanda chilolezo. Khoti la Blantyre Magistrate linamulipiritsa chindapusa cha K3 miliyoni (ndalama zomwe ayenera kulipira ngati chilango). Ichi ndi chindapusa: ndalama zomwe analipira ngati chilango chifukwa choswa lamulo. Akanatha kupita kundende chaka chimodzi m'malo mwake. Jennings analipira ndalamazo ndipo anachoka.
ny.body_more:
Jennings adamangidwa Lachitatu atakwera ndege kuchokera ku South Africa kupita ku Malawi. Sanatsatire malamulo a ndege zotera. Mneneri wa apolisi ku Southern Region Beatrice Mikuwa adati Jennings adaswa malamulo a ndege. Malamulo a ndege ndi malamulo omwe ndege ndi oyendetsa ndege ayenera kutsatira akamauluka.

Mlanduwu udapita ku Khothi la Milandu ku Blantyre. Woweruza milandu Paul Chiotcha adamva mlanduwu ndipo adapeza Jennings wolakwa. Kulakwa kumatanthauza kuti waswa lamulo. Woweruza milandu adamulamula kuti alipire K3 miliyoni kapena akhale m'ndende chaka chimodzi. Jennings adasankha kulipira chindapusa.

Ndege idabwera ku Malawi kudzatenga anthu. Anthuwa anali patchuthi mdzikolo. Munthu wina adati anali banja lachilendo. Munthu wina adati anali banja. Kenako ndegeyo inkapita nawo ku Portugal kuti achoke ku Malawi. Jennings atalipira chindapusacho, ndegeyo idachoka pabwalo la ndege ndikupita.

en.title: Banks raise borrowing cost to 20.80 percent
en.body: Banks in Malawi raised their lending reference rate for August. The rate went up to 20.80 percent from 20.50 percent in July. A reference rate is the cost of money banks charge when they give loans. This is the second month the rate went up.
en.body_more:
The higher rate means loans now cost more money. Businesses that borrow from banks will pay more interest. Interest is extra money you pay when you borrow. Small and medium businesses feel this most. These companies often have small profits. Extra costs make it hard to grow.

Farming and food businesses are hit hard. They borrow money to buy seeds and tools each season. If borrowing costs more, farms may not plant enough crops. This can lower the food and goods Malawi sells to other countries. Dr. Mubadwa, an economist at the Malawi Bank of Commerce, said farms already face stress. He said higher costs make farmers less willing to grow more.

Banks say they must do this to keep profits safe. Ms. Ngowi, a portfolio manager, said banks need higher rates because they give fewer loans now. Fewer loans plus higher costs help banks stay strong. But this slows down business growth.

Businesses can try other ways to get money. They can use development banks or micro-credit groups. Joint business partnerships can help lower costs too. Some companies can apply for government help with renewable energy or export deals. Dr. Phiri said special finance for these projects can cut the impact of higher rates. As costs rise, smart planning helps businesses survive and grow.

ny.title: Mabanki akweza ndalama zobwereka kufika pa 20.80 peresenti
ny.body: Mabanki ku Malawi adakweza chiwongola dzanja chawo cha ngongole mu Ogasiti. Chiwongola dzanjacho chinakwera kufika pa 20.80 peresenti kuchokera pa 20.50 peresenti mu Julayi. Chiwongola dzanja cha ngongole ndi mtengo wa ndalama zomwe mabanki amalipiritsa akamapereka ngongole. Uno ndi mwezi wachiwiri chiwongola dzanjacho chinakwera.
ny.body_more:
Kukwera kwa chiwongola dzanja kumatanthauza kuti ngongole tsopano zimadula ndalama zambiri. Mabizinesi omwe amabwereka ku mabanki amalipira chiwongola dzanja chochulukirapo. Chiwongola dzanja ndi ndalama zowonjezera zomwe mumalipira mukabwereka. Mabizinesi ang'onoang'ono ndi apakatikati amamva izi kwambiri. Makampaniwa nthawi zambiri amakhala ndi phindu laling'ono. Ndalama zowonjezera zimapangitsa kuti zikhale zovuta kulima.

Mabizinesi a ulimi ndi chakudya amakhudzidwa kwambiri. Amabwereka ndalama kuti agule mbewu ndi zida nyengo iliyonse. Ngati kubwereka kumadula kwambiri, minda singabzale mbewu zokwanira. Izi zitha kuchepetsa chakudya ndi katundu womwe Malawi imagulitsa kumayiko ena. Dr. Mubadwa, katswiri wazachuma ku Malawi Bank of Commerce, adati minda ikukumana kale ndi mavuto. Anati ndalama zambiri zimapangitsa alimi kukhala osafuna kulima kwambiri.

Mabanki akuti ayenera kuchita izi kuti asunge phindu. Mayi Ngowi, manejala wa portfolio, adati mabanki amafunika mitengo yokwera chifukwa amapereka ngongole zochepa tsopano. Ngongole zochepa komanso ndalama zokwera zimathandiza mabanki kukhala olimba. Koma izi zimachedwetsa kukula kwa bizinesi.

Mabizinesi angayesere njira zina zopezera ndalama. Angagwiritse ntchito mabanki otukuka kapena magulu ang'onoang'ono a ngongole. Mgwirizano wamalonda wogwirizana ungathandizenso kuchepetsa ndalama. Makampani ena amatha kupempha thandizo la boma ndi mgwirizano wamagetsi obwezerezedwanso kapena kutumiza kunja. Dr. Phiri anati ndalama zapadera za mapulojekitiwa zitha kuchepetsa zotsatira za mitengo yokwera. Pamene mitengo ikukwera, kukonzekera mwanzeru kumathandiza mabizinesi kukhalabe ndikukula.

en.title: President Mutharika leaves for South Africa on private visit
en.body: President Peter Mutharika left Malawi on Wednesday for South Africa. The Office of the President and Cabinet said it is a private visit. This is his fourth private trip away in 11 months. Chief Secretary Justin Saidi said the President left through Kamuzu International Airport.
en.body_more:
Before he left, President Mutharika spoke to people in Lilongwe. He said he has already done 50% of his work since he took power in 2025.

The President said he had two main goals. The first goal was to stop Malawi from becoming a one-party state again. A one-party state means only one group can rule the country. He said he has done this goal. His second goal is to make the country's money stronger. He said the country is doing well with money now and is almost there.

President Mutharika said that making the economy strong takes time. He said in 2014 it took almost one and a half years to fix the money problems. He told people to wait. He said he will work for five years. In 2030 there will be a new choice for a leader. He said he will give power to another member of the Democratic Progressive Party at that time.

The President told all Malawians to stay united. He said working together will help build the country strong. He also said that the numbers about money show the country is going in the right way.

ny.title: Purezidenti Mutharika apita ku South Africa paulendo wake wachinsinsi
ny.body: Purezidenti Peter Mutharika adachoka ku Malawi Lachitatu kupita ku South Africa. Ofesi ya Purezidenti ndi Nduna ya Zamalamulo idati ndi ulendo wake wachinsinsi. Uwu ndi ulendo wake wachinayi wachinsinsi m'miyezi 11. Mlembi Wamkulu Justin Saidi adati Purezidenti adachoka kudzera pa eyapoti ya Kamuzu International Airport.
ny.body_more:
Asananyamuke, Purezidenti Mutharika adalankhula ndi anthu ku Lilongwe. Adati wachita kale 50% ya ntchito yake kuyambira pomwe adatenga ulamuliro mu 2025.

Purezidenti adati ali ndi zolinga ziwiri zazikulu. Cholinga choyamba chinali kuletsa Malawi kuti isabwererenso kukhala boma la chipani chimodzi. Dziko la chipani chimodzi limatanthauza kuti gulu limodzi lokha ndi lomwe lingalamulire dzikolo. Adati wachita cholinga ichi. Cholinga chake chachiwiri ndikulimbitsa ndalama za dzikolo. Adati dzikolo likuchita bwino ndi ndalama tsopano ndipo latsala pang'ono kufika.

Purezidenti Mutharika adati kulimbitsa chuma kumatenga nthawi. Adati mu 2014 zidatenga pafupifupi chaka chimodzi ndi theka kuti akonze mavuto azachuma. Adauza anthu kuti adikire. Adati adzagwira ntchito kwa zaka zisanu. Mu 2030 padzakhala chisankho chatsopano cha mtsogoleri. Adati adzapereka mphamvu kwa membala wina wa Democratic Progressive Party panthawiyo.

Purezidenti adauza anthu onse aku Malawi kuti akhale ogwirizana. Adati kugwira ntchito limodzi kudzathandiza kumanga dzikolo kukhala lolimba. Adatinso kuti ziwerengero za ndalama zikuwonetsa kuti dzikolo likuyenda bwino.

en.title: Malawi Women Play Zambia in Cup Match Tonight
en.body: The Malawi Women's National Football Team play Zambia tonight. The match is at Al Madina Stadium in Rabat, Morocco. Malawi can reach the quarter-finals even if they lose. Malawi leads their group with six points. Zambia must win to move forward.
en.body_more:
Malawi's coach Lovemore Fazili wants his team to win and not give away any goals. He said: "We are focused on winning the game." A draw would help Malawi qualify for the next round. But Fazili said winning is better. "A draw will be fine if things do not go as expected, but our aim is to win the game," he said.

Malawi beat Nigeria 3-2 and Egypt 3-1 in earlier games. One player, Rose Alufandika, cannot play tonight because she got a red card against Egypt. But winger Asimenye Simwaka is back after playing in the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland. Fazili said Simwaka being here helps the team.

Zambia's coach Nora Häuptle said both teams are equal and know each other well. She said: "We know about their strength." Zambia must win to reach the quarter-finals. Striker Racheal Kundananji may not play because of injury. Zambia will likely use striker Barbra Banda instead. The two teams last played in February 2025. Zambia won 2-0, then Malawi won 3-2.

Five teams already qualified for the next round: Ivory Coast, Algeria, Morocco, South Africa, and Cameroon. Three more spots are left for teams from Malawi and Zambia's groups.

ny.title: Malawi Women isewera ndi Zambia mu Cup mawa lino
ny.body: Timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi isewera ndi Zambia usikuuno. Masewerowa ali ku Al Madina Stadium ku Rabat, Morocco. Malawi ikhoza kufika mu quarter-finals ngakhale italephera. Malawi ikutsogolera gulu lawo ndi mapointi asanu ndi limodzi. Zambia iyenera kupambana kuti ipite patsogolo.
ny.body_more:
Mphunzitsi wa Malawi, Lovemore Fazili, akufuna kuti timu yake ipambane osati kupereka zigoli zilizonse. Iye anati: "Tikuyang'ana kwambiri pakupambana masewerawa." Kuyerekeza kungathandize Malawi kuti ifike pa mpikisano wotsatira. Koma Fazili anati kupambana ndikwabwino. "Kuyerekeza kudzakhala bwino ngati zinthu sizikuyenda monga momwe timayembekezera, koma cholinga chathu ndikupambana masewerawa," adatero.

Malawi idagonjetsa Nigeria 3-2 ndi Egypt 3-1 m'masewera oyambirira. Wosewera m'modzi, Rose Alufandika, sangasewere usikuuno chifukwa adalandira khadi lofiira motsutsana ndi Egypt. Koma winger Asimenye Simwaka wabwerera atasewera Masewera a Commonwealth ku Glasgow, Scotland. Fazili adati kukhala pano kwa Simwaka kumathandiza timuyi.

Mphunzitsi wa Zambia, Nora Häuptle, adati magulu onse awiri ndi ofanana ndipo amadziwana bwino. Iye anati: "Tikudziwa za mphamvu zawo." Zambia iyenera kupambana kuti ifike mu kotala fainali. Wosewera Racheal Kundananji sangasewere chifukwa cha kuvulala. Zambia mwina idzagwiritsa ntchito womenya Barbra Banda m'malo mwake. Magulu awiriwa adasewera komaliza mu February 2025. Zambia idapambana 2-0, kenako Malawi idapambana 3-2.

Magulu asanu adayenerera kale gawo lotsatira: Ivory Coast, Algeria, Morocco, South Africa, ndi Cameroon. Malo ena atatu atsala kuti magulu ochokera m'magulu a Malawi ndi Zambia alowe nawo.

en.title: Government asks MACRA to act against two TV stations
en.body: Malawi's government asked the media regulator MACRA to take action against two TV stations. Zodiak Broadcasting Station (ZBS) and Luntha TV broke broadcasting rules, the government said. ZBS aired a false report that President Arthur Peter Mutharika had left the country. Luntha TV broadcast an interview that also made false claims.
en.body_more:
Minister of Information and Communications Technology Shadric Namalomba made the statement on 5 August 2026. He said ZBS reported falsely that the President had travelled outside Malawi. The government said this report was wrong and broke the rules of responsible broadcasting.

Namalomba said this was the second time ZBS broke the rules in under one year. Earlier, ZBS aired reports about missing manhood cases in the Shire Valley. These reports were not checked before broadcast and caused public alarm, the government said. Luntha TV also broke the rules. It broadcast an interview with Silvester Namiwa of the Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives (CDEDI). In the interview, Namiwa said Vice-President Jane Ansah would become President within two months. The government said this broadcast did not meet the standards of responsible media work.

The government said it asked MACRA to start disciplinary action against both stations. Namalomba said the government protects freedom of speech. But he said freedom of speech does not allow spreading false information. Media workers must check facts before they broadcast, he added. The government said it will address platforms that spread lies and damage public trust.

The statement came after confusion about the President's travel. MBC Digital, the state broadcaster, posted on Facebook that Mutharika would travel to South Africa. The post was deleted soon after. ZBS then reported that Mutharika had already left the country. ZBS later said sorry and retracted the report. It said it had relied on sources at Kamuzu International Airport. The President eventually left for South Africa on Wednesday for a private visit. This was his fourth private trip to South Africa in recent months.

ny.title: Boma lapempha MACRA kuti ichitepo kanthu motsutsana ndi ma TV awiri
ny.body: Boma la Malawi lapempha bungwe loyang'anira nkhani la MACRA kuti lichitepo kanthu pa ma TV awiri. Zodiak Broadcasting Station (ZBS) ndi Luntha TV zaswa malamulo ofalitsa nkhani, boma latero. ZBS idawulutsa lipoti labodza loti Purezidenti Arthur Peter Mutharika wachoka mdzikolo. Luntha TV idawulutsa kuyankhulana komwe kudanenanso zabodza.
ny.body_more:
Nduna ya Zaukadaulo ndi Kulankhulana Shadric Namalomba adapereka mawuwa pa 5 Ogasiti 2026. Adati ZBS idanena zabodza kuti Purezidenti adapita kunja kwa Malawi. Boma lidati lipotili ndi lolakwika ndipo lidaswa malamulo oyendetsera ntchito yofalitsa nkhani mwanzeru.

Namalomba adati iyi ndi nthawi yachiwiri ZBS idaswa malamulowo pasanathe chaka chimodzi. M'mbuyomu, ZBS idawulutsa malipoti okhudza milandu ya amuna omwe akusowa ku Shire Valley. Malipotiwa sanayang'aniridwe asanaulutsidwe ndipo adayambitsa mantha kwa anthu, boma lidatero. Luntha TV idaswanso malamulowo. Idawulutsa kuyankhulana ndi Silvester Namiwa wa Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives (CDEDI). Mu kuyankhulana, Namiwa adati Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah adzakhala Purezidenti mkati mwa miyezi iwiri. Boma lidati kuwulutsa kumeneku sikukwaniritsa miyezo ya ntchito yoyendetsera ntchito yofalitsa nkhani mwanzeru.

Boma lidati lapempha MACRA kuti iyambe kulanga mawayilesi onse awiri. Namalomba adati boma limateteza ufulu wolankhula. Koma adati ufulu wolankhula sulola kufalitsa uthenga wabodza. Ogwira ntchito zofalitsa nkhani ayenera kufufuza zoona asanaulutse, adawonjezera. Boma lati lidzathetsa nkhani zokhudza mawebusayiti omwe amafalitsa mabodza komanso kuwononga chidaliro cha anthu.

Mawuwa adabwera pambuyo pa chisokonezo chokhudza ulendo wa Purezidenti. MBC Digital, wailesi ya boma, idalemba pa Facebook kuti Mutharika apita ku South Africa. Uthengawu udachotsedwa posakhalitsa. Kenako ZBS idanena kuti Mutharika wachoka kale mdzikolo. Pambuyo pake ZBS idati pepani ndipo idachotsa lipotilo. Idati idadalira magwero a ku Kamuzu International Airport. Purezidenti pamapeto pake adapita ku South Africa Lachitatu kukacheza payekha. Uwu unali ulendo wake wachinayi payekha ku South Africa m'miyezi yaposachedwa.

en.title: Malawi's Government Spending Falls, Cuts Money Debt
en.body: The government spent less money in May 2026. This helped cut the fiscal deficit by more than half. The fiscal deficit is the money gap when a country spends more than it earns. The Reserve Bank of Malawi said lower spending caused this change.
en.body_more:
The Reserve Bank of Malawi shared this news in its Monthly Economic Review. Officials said the fall in government spending was the main reason for the smaller deficit. When the government spends less, it does not need to borrow as much money. This takes pressure off the national budget.

When the government borrows less, it does not need to print new money. This helps stop prices from going up too fast. Slower price growth means families can buy more food and goods. Small business owners can plan their costs better when prices stay stable. Farmers can plan what seeds and tools to buy without big price shocks.

A smaller deficit also helps the Malawi kwacha stay strong. This is the Malawi money. When the government borrows less, foreign money stays more stable in the country. Business owners who buy goods from other countries can get foreign money at fair prices. Traders who work across borders can buy and sell more easily.

The Reserve Bank said the change came from lower spending, not from more tax money coming in. This shows the government is trying to control how much it spends. When a government controls spending, people who want to put money into the country feel more sure. Local business owners can feel confident to grow their own work. Lower prices and a steady money value give businesses a good time to plan and invest for the future.

ny.title: Ndalama za Boma la Malawi Zatsika, Zachepetsa Ngongole
ny.body: Boma linagwiritsa ntchito ndalama zochepa mu Meyi 2026. Izi zinathandiza kuchepetsa ndalama zotsala ndi theka. Ndalama zotsala ndi kusiyana kwa ndalama pamene dziko limagwiritsa ntchito ndalama zambiri kuposa zomwe limapeza. Banki Yaikulu ya Malawi inati ndalama zochepa zomwe linagwiritsa ntchito zinayambitsa kusinthaku.
ny.body_more:
Banki Yaikulu ya Malawi inanena izi mu Monthly Economic Review. Akuluakulu aboma anati kutsika kwa ndalama zomwe boma limagwiritsa ntchito ndi chifukwa chachikulu chomwe chimapangitsa kuti ndalamazo zichepe. Boma likamagwiritsa ntchito ndalama zochepa, siliyenera kubwereka ndalama zambiri. Izi zimachepetsa kukakamizidwa kwa bajeti ya dziko.

Boma likabwereka ndalama zochepa, siliyenera kusindikiza ndalama zatsopano. Izi zimathandiza kuti mitengo isakwere mofulumira kwambiri. Kukula pang'onopang'ono kwa mitengo kumatanthauza kuti mabanja amatha kugula chakudya ndi katundu wambiri. Eni mabizinesi ang'onoang'ono amatha kukonzekera bwino ndalama zawo mitengo ikakhazikika. Alimi amatha kukonzekera mbewu ndi zida zogulira popanda kugwedezeka kwa mitengo yayikulu.

Kuchepa kwa ndalama kumathandizanso kuti Malawi kwacha ikhale yolimba. Iyi ndi ndalama ya Malawi. Boma likabwereka ndalama zochepa, ndalama zakunja zimakhala zokhazikika mdziko muno. Eni mabizinesi omwe amagula zinthu kuchokera kumayiko ena amatha kupeza ndalama zakunja pamitengo yoyenera. Amalonda omwe amagwira ntchito m'malire amatha kugula ndikugulitsa mosavuta.

Banki Yaikulu inati kusinthaku kudabwera chifukwa cha ndalama zochepa, osati chifukwa cha ndalama zambiri zamisonkho zomwe zikubwera. Izi zikusonyeza kuti boma likuyesera kulamulira kuchuluka kwa ndalama zomwe limagwiritsa ntchito. Boma likalamulira ndalama, anthu omwe akufuna kuyika ndalama mdziko muno amakhala otsimikiza kwambiri. Eni mabizinesi am'deralo akhoza kukhala otsimikiza mtima kuti akulitsa ntchito zawo. Mitengo yotsika komanso ndalama zokhazikika zimapatsa mabizinesi nthawi yabwino yokonzekera ndikuyika ndalama zamtsogolo.

en.title: Music Industry Leaders Say Royalty System Is Out of Date
en.body: Leaders in Malawi's music business say the system for sharing money from blank media is not fair. On Monday, they met with the Copyright Society of Malawi (Cosoma). They said the system is old. It does not match how people listen to music today.
en.body_more:
Kelvin Sulugwe, who runs Akometsi Limited, led the meeting. He was joined by Kelvin Ngumuya from Madness Entertainment and George Nyale from the film industry. Their lawyers Henry Mvula and Ntchindi Chiyamwaka also came. The meeting was nearly four hours long.

Sulugwe said the Blank Media Levy is still based on old data from burning centres. This means places that burn CDs and DVDs. But people now listen to music on streaming services and YouTube. So the money does not go to the right artists. This year, Cosoma collected about K3 billion. Rights holders only got about K1.44 billion. That is less than half. Sulugwe said they need to check if this is fair and will last.

At the meeting, Cosoma found a mistake. Royalty statements showed a 20 percent deduction as an administration fee. But it was actually a withholding tax. Cosoma said it would fix this error. Dora Makwinja is the head of Cosoma. She said the Malawi Revenue Authority helps collect the Blank Media Levy and gets a share. The government also gets a share. Cosoma keeps 20 percent for managing the money. The rest, 60 percent, goes to rights holders.

Makwinja said Cosoma tried to move to digital data before. But members voted against it at a yearly meeting. They wanted to keep the old system. Sulugwe said Malawi cannot build a modern music business using old information. The two companies said they will meet again to plan what to do next. The Blank Media Levy started in 2011 to help artists who lose money to piracy. Piracy means illegal copying of music.

ny.title: Atsogoleri a Makampani a Nyimbo Akuti Dongosolo la Royalty ndi Lakale
ny.body: Atsogoleri a bizinesi ya nyimbo ku Malawi akuti njira yogawana ndalama kuchokera ku ma TV opanda kanthu si yolungama. Lolemba, adakumana ndi Copyright Society of Malawi (Cosoma). Adati njira imeneyi ndi yakale. Siikugwirizana ndi momwe anthu amamvera nyimbo masiku ano.
ny.body_more:
Kelvin Sulugwe, yemwe amayendetsa Akometsi Limited, ndiye anatsogolera msonkhanowo. Anagwirizana ndi Kelvin Ngumuya wochokera ku Madness Entertainment ndi George Nyale wochokera ku makampani opanga mafilimu. Maloya awo Henry Mvula ndi Ntchindi Chiyamwaka nawonso anabwera. Msonkhanowo unatenga pafupifupi maola anayi.

Sulugwe anati Blank Media Levy ikadali yochokera ku deta yakale yochokera ku malo oyaka moto. Izi zikutanthauza malo omwe amayaka ma CD ndi ma DVD. Koma anthu tsopano amamvetsera nyimbo pa ntchito zowonera ndi YouTube. Chifukwa chake ndalamazo sizipita kwa ojambula oyenera. Chaka chino, Cosoma inasonkhanitsa pafupifupi K3 biliyoni. Eni ufulu adapeza pafupifupi K1.44 biliyoni yokha. Izi ndi zosakwana theka. Sulugwe anati ayenera kuwona ngati izi ndi zolungama ndipo zidzapitirira.

Pamsonkhanowo, Cosoma adapeza cholakwika. Mauthenga achifumu adawonetsa kuchotsera kwa 20 peresenti ngati ndalama zoyendetsera. Koma kwenikweni inali msonkho woletsa. Cosoma adati idzakonza cholakwikachi. Dora Makwinja ndiye mtsogoleri wa Cosoma. Adati Malawi Revenue Authority imathandizira kusonkhanitsa Blank Media Levy ndipo imapeza gawo. Boma limapezanso gawo. Cosoma imasunga 20 peresenti yoyendetsera ndalamazo. Zotsalazo, 60 peresenti, zimapita kwa eni ufulu.

Makwinja adati Cosoma idayesapo kugwiritsa ntchito deta ya digito kale. Koma mamembala adavota motsutsana nazo pamsonkhano wapachaka. Amafuna kusunga dongosolo lakale. Sulugwe adati Malawi singamange bizinesi yamakono ya nyimbo pogwiritsa ntchito chidziwitso chakale. Makampani awiriwa adati adzakumananso kuti akonze zomwe achite. Blank Media Levy idayamba mu 2011 kuthandiza ojambula omwe amataya ndalama chifukwa cha chinyengo. chinyengo chimatanthauza kukopera nyimbo mosaloledwa.

en.title: South African experts join Chikangawa crash inquiry
en.body: A group investigating the Chikangawa plane crash has called in two South African experts. The plane crashed in June 2024 and killed former Vice President Saulos Chilima and eight other people. The Parliamentary Ad-Hoc Committee wants the experts to help find out what happened.
en.body_more:
The Committee's chairperson Walter Nyamilandu said the experts are Dr Robert Gabriel Ngude and Dr Wilson Sibusiso Ntsele. They are forensic pathologists. This means they study bodies to find out how people died. The two men will work with the Malawi team to investigate the crash.

The experts will first look at post-mortem reports. Post-mortem reports describe what doctors found when they checked the bodies after death. The experts will also look for gaps in evidence and documents. They will talk to the families of the people who died. The experts will check if Malawi can do DNA testing, toxicology testing, and mortuary work to a high standard. Toxicology testing checks if poisons or drugs were in a person's body. The Committee admits that Malawi may not have all the skills or tools needed to do this work alone.

The Committee said it will do the forensic work in phases. The work may include taking bodies out of the ground again, but only if the law allows it and families agree. Walter Nyamilandu said the process will respect the families' beliefs and culture. He said the work will keep the dignity of the families safe. The Committee will give updates through press statements when important steps are done.

The Committee said the process aims to produce a clear record of facts about the crash. The record will help the Committee find out what happened. Officials said the work will not go against tradition or faith. They promise to keep evidence safe and in the right order.

ny.title: Akatswiri aku South Africa alowa nawo kafukufuku wokhudza ngozi za Chikangawa
ny.body: Gulu lofufuza za ngozi ya ndege ya Chikangawa layitanitsa akatswiri awiri aku South Africa. Ndegeyo inagwa mu June 2024 ndipo inapha Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Saulos Chilima ndi anthu ena asanu ndi atatu. Komiti Yoyang'anira Nyumba Yamalamulo ikufuna kuti akatswiriwa athandize kupeza zomwe zinachitika.
ny.body_more:
Wapampando wa Komitiyi, Walter Nyamilandu, anati akatswiriwa ndi Dr Robert Gabriel Ngude ndi Dr Wilson Sibusiso Ntsele. Ndi akatswiri a zaukhondo. Izi zikutanthauza kuti amafufuza matupi kuti adziwe momwe anthu anafera. Amuna awiriwa adzagwira ntchito ndi gulu la Malawi kuti afufuze ngoziyi.

Akatswiriwa adzayang'ana kaye malipoti a zaukhondo. Malipoti a zaukhondo akufotokoza zomwe madokotala adapeza pamene adayang'ana matupi atamwalira. Akatswiriwa adzafufuzanso mipata mu umboni ndi zikalata. Adzalankhula ndi mabanja a anthu omwe anamwalira. Akatswiriwa adzafufuza ngati Malawi ingathe kuchita mayeso a DNA, mayeso a poizoni, ndi ntchito yosungiramo mitembo pamlingo wapamwamba. Kuyesa za poizoni kumafufuza ngati poizoni kapena mankhwala anali m'thupi la munthu. Komitiyi ikuvomereza kuti Malawi singakhale ndi luso kapena zida zonse zofunika kuti ichite ntchitoyi yokha.

Komitiyi idati ichita ntchito ya zaukhondo m'magawo. Ntchitoyi ingaphatikizepo kuchotsanso matupi pansi, koma pokhapokha ngati lamulo likulola ndipo mabanja avomereza. Walter Nyamilandu adati njira iyi idzalemekeza zikhulupiriro ndi chikhalidwe cha mabanja. Iye anati ntchitoyi idzateteza ulemu wa mabanja. Komitiyi idzapereka zosintha kudzera m'manyuzipepala zinthu zofunika zikachitika.

Komitiyi inati ndondomekoyi ikufuna kupanga mbiri yomveka bwino ya mfundo zokhudza ngoziyi. Nkhaniyi ithandiza Komiti kudziwa zomwe zinachitika. Akuluakulu a boma anati ntchitoyi sidzasemphana ndi miyambo kapena chikhulupiriro. Akulonjeza kusunga umboni motetezeka komanso motsatira dongosolo loyenera.

en.title: President Mutharika leaves Malawi for South Africa trip
en.body: President Arthur Peter Mutharika left Malawi for South Africa on Wednesday for a private visit. The State House said he departed from Kamuzu International Airport in the afternoon. The government did not say why he is going or when he will come back. This is his fourth private trip to South Africa since he returned to office in October 2025.
en.body_more:
The departure caused confusion because reports on Tuesday said Mutharika would leave, but the journey did not happen. The Malawi Broadcasting Corporation posted news about the trip but then removed the story. Zodiak Broadcasting Station said the president had left but later apologised and took back the report. The State House did not explain why the first reports were wrong.

Mutharika has now spent at least 42 days in South Africa on private visits since returning to office. In December 2025, he spent 14 days there. In March 2026, he spent 11 days there. In June 2026, he spent 17 days there. On all these trips, the State House said little about what he was doing. When he came back from the June trip, he said he had met with South African President Ramaphosa, but the State House had not told people about these meetings before.

Many people are asking questions because the president keeps going away without explaining why. Malawi is facing high prices for goods and problems with foreign money. The president told other government workers to travel less to save money. But he has taken these private trips. People want to know more about what the government is spending on these journeys.

Meanwhile, civil society groups are calling on the Director of Public Prosecutions to stop the trial of human rights defender Sylvester Namiwa. Namiwa was arrested and charged with treason. The groups said the case raises big questions about justice and the right to free speech in Malawi.

ny.title: Pulezidenti Mutharika wachoka ku Malawi kupita ku South Africa
ny.body: Purezidenti Arthur Peter Mutharika adachoka ku Malawi kupita ku South Africa Lachitatu paulendo wake wachinsinsi. Nyumba Yamalamulo idati adachoka pa eyapoti ya Kamuzu International Airport masana. Boma silinanene chifukwa chake akupita kapena nthawi yomwe adzabwerere. Uwu ndi ulendo wake wachinayi wachinsinsi ku South Africa kuyambira pomwe adabwerera ku ofesi mu Okutobala 2025.
ny.body_more:
Kuchoka kumeneku kunabweretsa chisokonezo chifukwa malipoti Lachiwiri anati Mutharika achoka, koma ulendowo sunachitike. Bungwe la Malawi Broadcasting Corporation linalemba nkhani zokhudza ulendowo koma kenako linachotsa nkhaniyi. Zodiak Broadcasting Station inati purezidenti wachoka koma pambuyo pake anapepesa ndipo anabweza lipotilo. Nyumba Yamalamulo sinafotokoze chifukwa chake malipoti oyamba anali olakwika.

Tsopano Mutharika wakhala masiku osachepera 42 ku South Africa paulendo wake wachinsinsi kuyambira pomwe adabwerera ku ofesi. Mu Disembala 2025, adakhala masiku 14 kumeneko. Mu Marichi 2026, adakhala masiku 11 kumeneko. Mu Juni 2026, adakhala masiku 17 kumeneko. Pa maulendo onsewa, Nyumba Yamalamulo sinanene zambiri za zomwe akuchita. Atabwerera kuchokera paulendo wake wa mu Juni, anati adakumana ndi Purezidenti waku South Africa Ramaphosa, koma Nyumba Yamalamulo sinauze anthu za misonkhanoyi kale.

Anthu ambiri akufunsa mafunso chifukwa purezidenti amapitilizabe kupita osafotokoza chifukwa chake. Malawi ikukumana ndi mitengo yokwera ya katundu komanso mavuto ndi ndalama zakunja. Purezidenti adauza antchito ena aboma kuti ayende pang'ono kuti asunge ndalama. Koma wapita maulendo ake achinsinsi. Anthu akufuna kudziwa zambiri za ndalama zomwe boma likugwiritsa ntchito paulendowu.

Pakadali pano, magulu a anthu wamba akupempha Director of Public Prosecutions kuti ayimitse mlandu wa woteteza ufulu wa anthu Sylvester Namiwa. Namiwa adamangidwa ndipo adaimbidwa mlandu woukira boma. Maguluwa adati nkhaniyi ikubweretsa mafunso akuluakulu okhudza chilungamo ndi ufulu wolankhula ku Malawi.

en.title: Mutharika says he will lead until 2030
en.body: President Peter Mutharika left Malawi for South Africa on Wednesday. This is his fourth private trip in seven months. Before he left, Mutharika told people he will stay as president until 2030. He said rivals must wait for that year.
en.body_more:
Mutharika spoke at Kamuzu Palace in Lilongwe before he left the country. He told citizens that he keeps his promises. He said he agreed to serve for five years as president. Those five years will end in 2030.

The president said he had two goals when he took power. The first goal was to stop a one-party state. A one-party state means only one group rules the country. Mutharika said he achieved this goal. The second goal was to build the economy. Economy means how the country makes money and grows. He said the country is doing this now.

Mutharika called for unity among Malawians. He said people must work together to build the nation. He also said he achieved half of his key promises. He told people that economic indicators show the country is turning the corner. This means money and jobs are getting better.

Mutharika's words seem to be a message to other party members who want his job. He leads the Democratic Progressive Party, the ruling party. At the end of 2030, he said there will be a competition. Mutharika hopes to hand over the government to another member of his party. The president is 85 or 86 years old. State House did not say why he goes to South Africa or how long he stays. This has caused confusion and questions among Malawians about where their leader is and what he does.

ny.title: Mutharika akuti adzatsogolera mpaka 2030
ny.body: Purezidenti Peter Mutharika adachoka ku Malawi kupita ku South Africa Lachitatu. Uwu ndi ulendo wake wachinayi wachinsinsi m'miyezi isanu ndi iwiri. Asananyamuke, Mutharika adauza anthu kuti adzakhalabe pulezidenti mpaka 2030. Anati otsutsana nawo ayenera kudikira chaka chimenecho.
ny.body_more:
Mutharika adalankhula ku Nyumba yachifumu ya Kamuzu ku Lilongwe asanachoke mdzikolo. Adauza nzika kuti amasunga malonjezo ake. Adati adavomereza kutumikira zaka zisanu monga purezidenti. Zaka zisanu zimenezo zidzatha mu 2030.

Purezidenti adati anali ndi zolinga ziwiri pamene adatenga mphamvu. Cholinga choyamba chinali kuletsa boma la chipani chimodzi. Dziko la chipani chimodzi limatanthauza gulu limodzi lokha lomwe likulamulira dzikolo. Mutharika adati adakwaniritsa cholinga ichi. Cholinga chachiwiri chinali kumanga chuma. Chuma chimatanthauza momwe dzikolo limapangira ndalama ndikukula. Adati dzikolo likuchita izi tsopano.

Mutharika adapempha mgwirizano pakati pa anthu aku Malawi. Adati anthu ayenera kugwira ntchito limodzi kuti amange dzikolo. Adatinso adakwaniritsa theka la malonjezo ake ofunikira. Adauza anthu kuti zizindikiro zachuma zikuwonetsa kuti dzikolo likusintha. Izi zikutanthauza kuti ndalama ndi ntchito zikuyenda bwino.

Mawu a Mutharika akuoneka ngati uthenga kwa mamembala ena a chipani omwe akufuna ntchito yake. Amatsogolera chipani cha Democratic Progressive Party, chomwe ndi chipani cholamulira. Kumapeto kwa chaka cha 2030, adati padzakhala mpikisano. Mutharika akuyembekeza kupereka boma kwa membala wina wa chipani chake. Purezidenti ali ndi zaka 85 kapena 86. Nyumba ya Malamulo sinanene chifukwa chake amapita ku South Africa kapena nthawi yomwe amakhala. Izi zabweretsa chisokonezo ndi mafunso pakati pa anthu aku Malawi okhudza komwe mtsogoleri wawo ali komanso zomwe amachita.

en.title: Malawi Queens return home from Commonwealth Games
en.body: The Malawi Queens netball team came home on Tuesday after the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland. The team finished seventh in the tournament. NICO Group and the Netball Association of Malawi said the Queens played very well and showed the team is growing strong.
en.body_more:
Netball Association of Malawi President Vitumbiko Gubuduza said the seventh-place finish was a big win for the team. He said the players worked hard and stayed focused during the games. Gubuduza thanked NICO Group for paying for the team's training camp in Malawi, the players' money for food and travel, and the training camp in Manchester, England. This help meant the Queens could play practice games before going to Glasgow.

NICO Group Head of Corporate Affairs Mbumba Mlia Ndasauka said the team showed the group's plan to build up Malawi netball is working. She said the Queens played with pride and hard work in every game. Ndasauka said Malawi has good players who can play with the best teams in the world. NICO Group wants to find new players from villages and towns across Malawi and make the sport stronger.

Head Coach Deborah Fuller said the games showed real progress. She said the team beat two better teams in warm-up games before the games started. Fuller praised two players: Mwai Kumwenda for shooting goals well, and Takondwa Lwazi for helping other players score. Nine new players played in the Commonwealth Games for the first time. Eight of these new players were 23 years old or younger. Fuller said the next big goal is to get into the top six teams in the world.

Gubuduza said the team will rest for two weeks. After that, they will get ready for the Africa Cup in September. The team will also work to prepare for the World Cup games in Kenya next month. The One NICO Top 12 League in 2026 will help find and grow the best young players.

ny.title: Malawi Queens yabwerera kwawo kuchokera ku Masewera a Commonwealth
ny.body: Timu ya netiboli ya Malawi Queens idabwera kunyumba Lachiwiri pambuyo pa Masewera a Commonwealth ku Glasgow, Scotland. Timuyi idamaliza pa nambala 7 pa mpikisanowu. NICO Group ndi Netball Association of Malawi adati Queens idasewera bwino kwambiri ndipo yawonetsa kuti timuyi ikukula bwino.
ny.body_more:
Purezidenti wa bungwe la Netball Association of Malawi Vitumbiko Gubuduza adati kumaliza pa nambala 7 kunali kupambana kwakukulu kwa timuyi. Anati osewerawo adagwira ntchito molimbika ndipo adakhalabe osamala pamasewerawa. Gubuduza adayamikira NICO Group chifukwa cholipira malo ophunzitsira a timuyi ku Malawi, ndalama za osewera kuti adye ndi kuyenda, komanso malo ophunzitsira ku Manchester, England. Thandizoli likutanthauza kuti a Queens amatha kusewera masewera oyeserera asanapite ku Glasgow.

Mtsogoleri wa NICO Group wa Corporate Affairs Mbumba Mlia Ndasauka adati timuyi yawonetsa kuti dongosolo la gululo lomanga netiball ku Malawi likugwira ntchito. Anati a Queens adasewera monyadira komanso molimbika pamasewera aliwonse. Ndasauka adati Malawi ili ndi osewera abwino omwe amatha kusewera ndi magulu abwino kwambiri padziko lonse lapansi. NICO Group ikufuna kupeza osewera atsopano ochokera m'midzi ndi matauni ku Malawi ndikupangitsa masewerawa kukhala olimba.

Mphunzitsi Wamkulu Deborah Fuller adati masewerawa akuwonetsa kupita patsogolo kwenikweni. Anati timuyi idagonjetsa magulu awiri abwino kwambiri pamasewera okonzekera masewerawa asanayambe. Fuller adayamika osewera awiri: Mwai Kumwenda chifukwa chowombera bwino zigoli, ndi Takondwa Lwazi chifukwa chothandiza osewera ena kugoletsa. Osewera atsopano asanu ndi anayi adasewera mu Masewera a Commonwealth koyamba. Osewera atsopano asanu ndi atatu awa anali ndi zaka 23 kapena kuchepera. Fuller adati cholinga chachikulu chotsatira ndikulowa m'magulu asanu ndi limodzi apamwamba padziko lonse lapansi.

Gubuduza adati gululo lidzapuma kwa milungu iwiri. Pambuyo pake, adzakonzekera Africa Cup mu Seputembala. Gululo lidzagwiranso ntchito yokonzekera masewera a World Cup ku Kenya mwezi wamawa. One NICO Top 12 League mu 2026 ithandiza kupeza ndikukulitsa osewera achinyamata abwino kwambiri.

en.title: Malawi: Healthy food now costs too much for most people
en.body: The Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) says the cost of eating well has doubled in Malawi between 2017 and 2025. A healthy diet now costs $5.01 per person per day. This is K8,772.51 per day, or about K263,175 per month. Most Malawians cannot pay this much. About 75 percent of people earn less than $3 per day.
en.body_more:
In 2017, a healthy diet cost $2.38 per day in Malawi. Now it costs $5.01. A healthy diet means food that is balanced and has different types. It includes fruits, vegetables, meat, fish, milk, eggs and beans. The FAO report says that costs have risen across the world, but different countries pay very different prices.

Malawi focuses too much on maize, say farm leaders. Maness Nkhata is the president of the Farmers Union of Malawi. She said the country grows mainly maize. Other foods like fruits, vegetables, beans, meat, fish and milk do not get enough help or money. Because these foods are rare, they are expensive. Climate shocks, inflation and weak money also make prices high. Transport costs and farm inputs are also costly. All this means families cannot buy healthy food.

Experts say Malawi must change its food system. Innocent Pangapanga-Phiri works at the Centre for Agricultural Research and Development. He said Malawians think food means maize only. But other crops can give carbohydrates too. The country needs more livestock, fish and dairy farms. If supply grows, prices will fall. John Kapito is at the Consumers Association of Malawi. He said the government must teach people about good food and help them eat different types. The FAO report was made by five groups: FAO, IFAD, UNICEF, WFP and WHO.

ny.title: Malawi: Chakudya chopatsa thanzi tsopano chikukwera mtengo kwambiri kwa anthu ambiri
ny.body: Bungwe la Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) lati mtengo wodya bwino wawirikiza kawiri ku Malawi pakati pa 2017 ndi 2025. Zakudya zopatsa thanzi tsopano zimadula $5.01 pa munthu aliyense patsiku. Izi ndi K8,772.51 patsiku, kapena pafupifupi K263,175 pamwezi. Anthu ambiri aku Malawi sangakwanitse kulipira ndalama zambiri chonchi. Pafupifupi 75 peresenti ya anthu amapeza ndalama zosakwana $3 patsiku.
ny.body_more:
Mu 2017, chakudya chopatsa thanzi chimadula $2.38 patsiku ku Malawi. Tsopano chimadula $5.01. Chakudya chopatsa thanzi chimatanthauza chakudya chopatsa thanzi komanso chokhala ndi mitundu yosiyanasiyana. Chimaphatikizapo zipatso, ndiwo zamasamba, nyama, nsomba, mkaka, mazira ndi nyemba. Lipoti la FAO likuti mitengo yakwera padziko lonse lapansi, koma mayiko osiyanasiyana amalipira mitengo yosiyana kwambiri.

Malawi akuyang'ana kwambiri chimanga, akutero atsogoleri a minda. Maness Nkhata ndi purezidenti wa Farmers Union of Malawi. Iye anati dzikolo limalima chimanga kwambiri. Zakudya zina monga zipatso, ndiwo zamasamba, nyemba, nyama, nsomba ndi mkaka sizilandira thandizo lokwanira kapena ndalama. Chifukwa zakudya izi ndizosowa, zimakhala zodula. Mavuto a nyengo, kukwera mtengo kwa zinthu komanso ndalama zochepa zimapangitsanso mitengo kukhala yokwera. Ndalama zoyendera ndi zinthu zogwiritsidwa ntchito pa minda nazonso zimakhala zodula. Zonsezi zikutanthauza kuti mabanja sangagule chakudya chopatsa thanzi.

Akatswiri akuti Malawi iyenera kusintha njira yake ya chakudya. Innocent Pangapanga-Phiri amagwira ntchito ku Center for Agricultural Research and Development. Iye anati anthu aku Malawi amaganiza kuti chakudya chimatanthauza chimanga chokha. Koma mbewu zina zimatha kupereka chakudya cham'mimba. Dzikolo likufunika ziweto zambiri, nsomba ndi minda ya mkaka. Ngati chakudya chikukula, mitengo idzatsika. John Kapito ali ku Consumers Association of Malawi. Iye anati boma liyenera kuphunzitsa anthu za chakudya chabwino ndikuwathandiza kudya mitundu yosiyanasiyana. Lipoti la FAO linapangidwa ndi magulu asanu: FAO, IFAD, UNICEF, WFP ndi WHO.

en.title: Wanderers learn Champions League opponents Thursday
en.body: Mighty Wanderers will know their opponents for the 2026 CAF Champions League first preliminary round on Thursday. The draw will take place in Cairo, Egypt at the CAF headquarters. It will start at 2pm. The continental football body says it will broadcast the draw live. Wanderers director David Kanyenda said they are eager for the draw.
en.body_more:
Kanyenda told reporters: "There are no easy games at this level. With thorough preparation and commitment, we can spring a few surprises." He added that the club already strengthened the squad at the start of the season. Five new players joined: Alex Kambilinya, Peter Ng'ambi, Dalitso Nahipa, Lameck Mithi and Jacob Anyandwile. "We believe we have enough depth to compete in Africa," Kanyenda said.

Wanderers will play their first leg match between 4 and 6 September. The return leg will be between 11 and 13 September. Last year, Wanderers played in the CAF Confederation Cup. They went out in the first round after losing to Botswana's Jwaneng Galaxy. The two teams drew 1-1 over two legs, then Wanderers lost 4-3 on penalties. It was Wanderers' first time in the Champions League since 2017.

The winners of the Champions League will get US$6 million (about K1.05 billion) in prize money. Teams that go out in the preliminary rounds will each get US$100,000 (about K175 million) as a payment for taking part. Mamelodi Sundowns of South Africa won last year's Champions League. USM Alger of Algeria won the Confederation Cup.

ny.title: Wanderers aphunzira za otsutsa a Champions League Lachinayi
ny.body: Mighty Wanderers idzadziwa omwe adzamenyane nawo mu gawo loyamba la CAF Champions League la 2026 Lachinayi. Kujambula kudzachitika ku Cairo, Egypt ku likulu la CAF. Kuyamba nthawi ya 2 koloko masana. Bungwe la mpira wamiyendo lati lidzawonetsa chiwonetserochi pompopompo. Mtsogoleri wa Wanderers David Kanyenda adati akufunitsitsa kujambula.
ny.body_more:
Kanyenda anauza atolankhani kuti: "Palibe masewera osavuta pamlingo uwu. Ndi kukonzekera bwino komanso kudzipereka, titha kuchita zodabwitsa." Anawonjezera kuti kalabuyo yalimbitsa kale gululo kumayambiriro kwa nyengo. Osewera atsopano asanu adalowa nawo: Alex Kambilinya, Peter Ng'ambi, Dalitso Nahipa, Lameck Mithi ndi Jacob Anyandwile. "Tikukhulupirira kuti tili ndi mphamvu zokwanira zopikisana ku Africa," adatero Kanyenda.

Wanderers idzasewera masewera awo oyamba pakati pa 4 ndi 6 Seputembala. Masewera obwereza adzakhala pakati pa 11 ndi 13 Seputembala. Chaka chatha, Wanderers idasewera mu CAF Confederation Cup. Adatuluka mu gawo loyamba atagonjetsedwa ndi Jwaneng Galaxy ya ku Botswana. Magulu awiriwa adagwirizana 1-1 pamasewera awiri, kenako Wanderers idataya 4-3 pa ma penalty. Unali nthawi yoyamba ya Wanderers mu Champions League kuyambira 2017.

Opambana mu Champions League adzalandira ndalama zokwana US$6 miliyoni (pafupifupi K1.05 biliyoni) mu ndalama za mphotho. Magulu omwe adzatuluke mu magawo oyambirira adzalandira US$100,000 (pafupifupi K175 miliyoni) ngati malipiro otenga nawo mbali. Mamelodi Sundowns ya ku South Africa idapambana Champions League chaka chatha. USM Alger ya ku Algeria idapambana Confederation Cup.

en.title: Malawi Scorchers win both games at Women's Africa Cup
en.body: Malawi's women's football team, the Scorchers, has won both their first matches at the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco. They beat Nigeria 3-2 and Egypt 3-1. Only two other teams have won both games. Malawi tops their group with six points.
en.body_more:
The Scorchers will play their final group match tomorrow against Zambia at Al Madina Stadium in Rabat, Morocco. A win or a draw will help them reach the quarter-finals. Zambia needs to win by two or more goals to move ahead.

Malawi's captain Tabitha Chawinga plays in France. She said the two wins give the team confidence. "It is not easy to have such a record at this stage of a big tournament," she said. "We have to remain focused and stay hungry for success." She asked all Malawians to pray for the team.

Coach Lovemore Fazili is looking at new defensive choices before the match against Zambia. He said his players have shown strong character. "They are determined to get to the quarter-finals," he said. Forward Temwa Chawinga, who plays in the United States, is one of the top scorers with three goals. She shares this with Marie Ngah of Cameroon. Barbara Banda of Zambia has scored four goals.

Morocco and Cameroon are also teams with two wins. Morocco beat Kenya 4-0 and Algeria 1-0. Cameroon beat Mali 2-1 and Ghana 1-0. These three teams are the only ones with a perfect record so far.

ny.title: Malawi Scorchers yapambana masewera onse awiri pa Women's Africa Cup
ny.body: Gulu la mpira wa azimayi la Malawi, Scorchers, lapambana masewera onse awiri oyamba pa mpikisano wa Women's Africa Cup of Nations wa 2026 ku Morocco. Adagonjetsa Nigeria 3-2 ndipo Egypt 3-1. Magulu ena awiri okha ndi omwe apambana masewera onse awiri. Malawi ndi yomwe yapambana gulu lawo ndi mapointi asanu ndi limodzi.
ny.body_more:
A Scorchers adzasewera masewera awo omaliza a gulu mawa motsutsana ndi Zambia ku Al Madina Stadium ku Rabat, Morocco. Kupambana kapena draw kudzawathandiza kufika mu kotala-fainali. Zambia iyenera kupambana ndi zigoli ziwiri kapena zingapo kuti ipite patsogolo.

Kaputeni wa Malawi Tabitha Chawinga amasewera ku France. Iye anati kupambana kawiri konseku kumapatsa timu chidaliro. "Sikophweka kukhala ndi mbiri yotereyi pagawo lino la mpikisano waukulu," adatero. "Tiyenera kukhalabe olunjika ndikukhala ndi njala yopambana." Iye anapempha a Malawi onse kuti apempherere timuyi.

Mphunzitsi Lovemore Fazili akuyang'ana njira zatsopano zodzitetezera masewerawa asanakumane ndi Zambia. Iye anati osewera ake awonetsa khalidwe labwino. "Atsimikiza mtima kufika mu kotala-fainali," adatero. Wosewera kutsogolo Temwa Chawinga, yemwe amasewera ku United States, ndi m'modzi mwa omwe apambana zigoli zambiri ndi zigoli zitatu. Amagawana izi ndi Marie Ngah wa ku Cameroon. Barbara Banda wa ku Zambia wagoletsa zigoli zinayi.

Morocco ndi Cameroon nawonso ndi magulu omwe apambana kawiri. Morocco idagonjetsa Kenya 4-0 ndi Algeria 1-0. Cameroon idagonjetsa Mali 2-1 ndipo Ghana 1-0. Magulu atatuwa ndi okhawo omwe ali ndi mbiri yabwino kwambiri mpaka pano.

en.title: Malawi Signs New China Deal To Build Judicial Complex
en.body: Malawi's government signed a new agreement with China last Friday. The deal will give almost 290 million Chinese Yuan for the judicial complex in Lilongwe. Minister of Justice Charles Mhango told Parliament on Monday the money will help finish the project. The complex sits opposite Parliament. It has had delays and cost increases for many years.
en.body_more:
The judicial complex will have three main parts. First is the main court building opposite the National Assembly. Second is a new home for the Chief Justice. This home will move from Blantyre to Lilongwe. Third is a judicial training institute. This will teach judges, magistrates and other court workers.

Before Chinese builders can start work, Malawi must finish securing the site. The government must complete the fence around the project. A local company called Terra Stone built part of this fence. But Terra Stone has not finished because the government still owes them money. Mhango said he is working with the Minister of Finance to pay Terra Stone. Once the site is secure, Chinese builders will come and start construction.

The project area has looked bad for years. Trees grow wild there. The fence is not complete. Mhango called it an eyesore in the heart of the capital city. The new Chinese money and agreement give hope the project will finally be finished.

During his speech to Parliament, Mhango also talked about a different problem. People are stealing metal from public roads and railways to sell it. They break down fences and culverts. This damage hurts the country's development. Mhango said the Ministry of Justice is working with other ministries to write a new law. This law will punish people who damage public things much harder. The government will bring this new law to Parliament soon.

ny.title: Malawi Yasaina Mgwirizano Watsopano ndi China Womanga Nyumba ya Malamulo
ny.body: Boma la Malawi lasayina pangano latsopano ndi China Lachisanu lapitali. Mgwirizanowu upereka pafupifupi 290 miliyoni ya Chinese Yuan ku khonsolo ya milandu ku Lilongwe. Nduna ya Zachilungamo Charles Mhango adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo Lolemba kuti ndalamazo zithandiza kumaliza ntchitoyi. Khonsoloyi ili moyang'anizana ndi Nyumba Yamalamulo. Yakhala ikuchedwa komanso ikukwera mtengo kwa zaka zambiri.
ny.body_more:
Malo oweruza milandu adzakhala ndi magawo atatu akuluakulu. Choyamba ndi nyumba yayikulu ya khothi moyang'anizana ndi Nyumba Yamalamulo. Chachiwiri ndi nyumba yatsopano ya Woweruza Wamkulu. Nyumbayi idzasamutsidwa kuchokera ku Blantyre kupita ku Lilongwe. Chachitatu ndi bungwe lophunzitsira milandu. Izi zidzaphunzitsa oweruza, oweruza milandu ndi ogwira ntchito ena a khothi.

Omanga nyumba aku China asanayambe ntchito, Malawi iyenera kumaliza kuteteza malowo. Boma liyenera kumaliza mpanda wozungulira ntchitoyi. Kampani yakomweko yotchedwa Terra Stone idamanga gawo la mpanda uwu. Koma Terra Stone sinamalize chifukwa boma lidakali ndi ngongole kwa iwo. Mhango adati akugwira ntchito ndi Nduna ya Zachuma kuti alipire Terra Stone. Malowa akakhazikika, omanga nyumba aku China adzabwera ndikuyamba kumanga.

Malo a polojekitiyi akhala akuoneka oipa kwa zaka zambiri. Mitengo imamera m'nkhalango kumeneko. Mpandawo sunamalizidwe. Mhango adati ndi malo owoneka bwino pakati pa likulu la mzinda. Ndalama zatsopano zaku China ndi mgwirizano zimapatsa chiyembekezo kuti ntchitoyi idzatha.

Panthawi yolankhula ku Nyumba Yamalamulo, Mhango adalankhulanso za vuto lina. Anthu akuba zitsulo m'misewu ya anthu onse ndi njanji kuti azigulitse. Amaphwanya mipanda ndi makoma a miyala. Kuwonongeka kumeneku kukuwononga chitukuko cha dziko. Mhango adati Unduna wa Zachilungamo ukugwira ntchito ndi maunduna ena kuti alembe lamulo latsopano. Lamuloli lidzalanga anthu omwe amawononga zinthu za anthu ambiri. Boma lidzabweretsa lamulo latsopanoli ku Nyumba Yamalamulo posachedwa.

en.title: Activist Namiwa charged with treason over TV interview
en.body: Sylvester Namiwa, leader of the Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives (CDEDI), was charged with treason on Monday. Chief Resident Magistrate Austin Banda read the charges in Lilongwe. Namiwa also faces a charge of publishing false news likely to cause fear and alarm. The court sent him to the High Court for trial.
en.body_more:
Namiwa was arrested last Thursday. The charges come from statements he made during an interview with Luntha Television in July. In that interview, Namiwa allegedly said there would be a change of presidential power in two months.

Commentator Idriss Ali Nasser has criticised how the government handled Namiwa's arrest. Nasser said in a social media post that the arrest was a mistake. He argued that Namiwa's comments were not important and would have been forgotten quickly if the government had simply ignored them. Nasser said that without the arrest, people would have forgotten what Namiwa said within hours.

Nasser was critical of the government's response. He said that the officials who advised the government did not show political maturity. He argued that the arrest has made Namiwa more popular, not less. Nasser said Namiwa, who is an experienced and sometimes provocative public commentator, will use the arrest to increase his public profile. Nasser compared Namiwa's case to the arrest of former Anti-Corruption Bureau Director Martha Chizuma, whose early-morning arrest also drew public criticism.

Nasser's main point was about restraint. He said that when government officials respond to controversial comments with harsh punishment instead of ignoring them, they damage their own credibility. He said they create political heroes instead of silencing critics. His comments are part of a wider debate about how Malawi's authorities respond to political criticism and dissent.

ny.title: Womenyera ufulu wa anthu Namiwa akuimbidwa mlandu woukira boma chifukwa cha kuyankhulana pa TV
ny.body: Sylvester Namiwa, mtsogoleri wa Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives (CDEDI), adaimbidwa mlandu woukira boma Lolemba. Woweruza Wamkulu Austin Banda adawerenga milanduyi ku Lilongwe. Namiwa akukumananso ndi mlandu wofalitsa nkhani zabodza zomwe zingachititse mantha komanso mantha. Khotilo linamutumiza ku Khoti Lalikulu kuti akaweruzidwe.
ny.body_more:
Namiwa adamangidwa Lachinayi lapitali. Milanduyi ikuchokera ku zomwe adanena panthawi yoyankhulana ndi Luntha Television mu Julayi. Mu kuyankhulana kumeneko, Namiwa akuti adati padzakhala kusintha kwa mphamvu za purezidenti m'miyezi iwiri.

Wolemba ndemanga Idriss Ali Nasser watsutsa momwe boma linachitira ndi kumangidwa kwa Namiwa. Nasser adati mu positi ya pa intaneti kuti kumangidwako kunali kulakwitsa. Anati ndemanga za Namiwa sizinali zofunika ndipo zikanaiwalika mwachangu ngati boma likanangonyalanyaza. Nasser adati popanda kumangidwako, anthu akanaiwala zomwe Namiwa adanena mkati mwa maola ochepa.

Nasser adatsutsa zomwe boma lachita. Anati akuluakulu omwe adalangiza boma sanawonetse kukula kwa ndale. Anati kumangidwako kwapangitsa Namiwa kutchuka kwambiri, osati kuchepa. Nasser adati Namiwa, yemwe ndi wodziwa bwino ntchito komanso nthawi zina wotsutsa anthu, adzagwiritsa ntchito kumangidwako kuti awonjezere mbiri yake pagulu. Nasser adayerekeza nkhani ya Namiwa ndi kumangidwa kwa wakale Director wa Anti-Corruption Bureau Martha Chizuma, yemwe kumangidwa kwake m'mawa kwambiri kudakopanso anthu ambiri.

Mfundo yaikulu ya Nasser inali yokhudza kudziletsa. Iye anati akuluakulu aboma akayankha ndemanga zotsutsana ndi chilango chokhwima m'malo mozinyalanyaza, amawononga mbiri yawo. Iye anati zimapangitsa ngwazi zandale m'malo moletsa otsutsa. Ndemanga zake ndi gawo la mkangano waukulu wokhudza momwe akuluakulu aboma aku Malawi amachitira akatsutsidwa ndi otsutsa andale.

en.title: Michael Usi: Why was he not called to Chilima inquiry?
en.body: Parliament is asking questions about the plane crash that killed former Vice-President Saulos Chilima. But one person has not been called to give answers: Michael Usi. Usi was Chilima's deputy in the political party. He was very close to Chilima. Now people ask: why is he not a witness?
en.body_more:
Usi was not just any party member. Chilima chose him as vice-president of the UTM party when other experienced leaders were also available. This shows the two men had strong trust. They worked closely together and spoke often. Usi was also unique because he could talk to both Chilima and President Lazarus Chakwera. He worked as a bridge between the two leaders.

Relations between Chakwera and Chilima had become tense. Chilima was preparing to run against Chakwera in the 2025 election. In this situation, Usi knew things happening on both sides. He could have known about Chilima's plans, his movements, and his communications. After Chilima died, Chakwera made Usi the new Vice-President within days. This made Usi's knowledge of Chilima even more important.

The inquiry has said it will call more than 150 witnesses. These people work in aviation, government, and other places connected to the aircraft and flight. The committee wants to understand Chilima's decisions and his movements before the crash. Former government secretary Colleen Zamba told the committee that Chilima planned to go to a funeral. He had not told Chakwera about this journey first. If the inquiry is asking about these details, why has it not asked Usi? He could have explained Chilima's plans, his schedule changes, and who knew about the trip.

Usi himself said in October 2024 that an inquiry was needed. He said it was necessary to find answers. Now Parliament is doing this inquiry, but Usi has not appeared as a key witness. This is strange. The person closest to Chilima wanted answers, but the people seeking those answers have not made his testimony central to the public inquiry.

ny.title: Michael Usi: N’chifukwa chiyani sanaitanidwe kukafufuza za Chilima?
ny.body: Nyumba Yamalamulo ikufunsa mafunso okhudza ngozi ya ndege yomwe inapha Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Saulos Chilima. Koma munthu m'modzi sanayitanidwe kuti ayankhe: Michael Usi. Usi anali wachiwiri kwa Chilima mu chipani cha ndale. Anali pafupi kwambiri ndi Chilima. Tsopano anthu akufunsa kuti: bwanji iye si mboni?
ny.body_more:
Usi sanali membala wa chipani chilichonse. Chilima anamusankha kukhala wachiwiri kwa purezidenti wa chipani cha UTM pamene atsogoleri ena odziwa zambiri analipo. Izi zikusonyeza kuti amuna awiriwa anali ndi chikhulupiriro champhamvu. Ankagwira ntchito limodzi kwambiri ndipo ankalankhula nthawi zambiri. Usi analinso wapadera chifukwa ankatha kulankhula ndi Chilima ndi Purezidenti Lazarus Chakwera. Anagwira ntchito ngati mlatho pakati pa atsogoleri awiriwa.

Ubale pakati pa Chakwera ndi Chilima unali utasokonekera. Chilima anali kukonzekera kupikisana ndi Chakwera pa chisankho cha 2025. Pamkhalidwewu, Usi ankadziwa zinthu zomwe zikuchitika mbali zonse ziwiri. Akanatha kudziwa za mapulani a Chilima, mayendedwe ake, ndi mauthenga ake. Chilima atamwalira, Chakwera adapanga Usi kukhala Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti watsopano mkati mwa masiku angapo. Izi zinapangitsa kuti chidziwitso cha Usi cha Chilima chikhale chofunikira kwambiri.

Kafukufukuyo wanena kuti aitana mboni zoposa 150. Anthuwa amagwira ntchito zoyendetsa ndege, boma, ndi malo ena okhudzana ndi ndege ndi ndege. Komitiyi ikufuna kumvetsetsa zisankho za Chilima ndi mayendedwe ake asanagwe. Mlembi wakale wa boma, Colleen Zamba, adauza komitiyi kuti Chilima adakonza zopita ku maliro. Sanauze Chakwera za ulendowu kaye. Ngati kafukufukuyu akufunsa za izi, bwanji sanafunse Usi? Akanatha kufotokoza mapulani a Chilima, kusintha kwa nthawi yake, komanso amene amadziwa za ulendowu.

Usi mwiniwake adati mu Okutobala 2024 kuti kafukufukuyu akufunika. Anati ndikofunikira kupeza mayankho. Tsopano Nyumba Yamalamulo ikuchita kafukufukuyu, koma Usi sanawonekere ngati mboni yofunika. Izi n'zachilendo. Munthu wapafupi ndi Chilima amafuna mayankho, koma anthu omwe akufuna mayankhowo sanapange umboni wake kukhala wofunikira pa kafukufuku wa anthu onse.

en.title: High Court to hear contempt case August 17
en.body: The High Court of Malawi will hear a case on August 17 2026 in Lilongwe. Chief Secretary Justin Saidi and Minister Chimwemwe Chipungu face contempt of court charges. They are accused of failing to pay rent for a warehouse used by the Malawi Electoral Commission.
en.body_more:
The case comes from a dispute over the Electoral Commission's office location. In June 2026, the Malawi Congress Party and three lawmakers won a court order stopping the office move from Lilongwe to Blantyre. The court told the government to keep paying rent for the warehouse at Njewa in Lilongwe.

However, the warehouse owner sealed the building because rent was not paid. Reports say the unpaid rent was about K885 million. The Malawi Congress Party says Saidi and Chipungu deliberately refused to pay the rent. This breaks the court order, the party claims. Party lawyer George Kadzipatike filed the contempt case. In his sworn statement, he said the officials showed open defiance to the court.

The court order came after President Peter Mutharika gave an executive order to move the Electoral Commission to Blantyre. The Malawi Congress Party opposed this move. The party's three MPs are Emmanuel Chambulanyina Jere of Mzimba South, Abraham Mwakhwawa of Karonga Lufilya, and Daniel Mwanyongo Chitonya of Karonga Town. They are listed as applicants in the case.

Attorney General Frank Mbeta is representing Saidi and Chipungu. Mbeta also filed an application to cancel the court order that stopped the relocation. High Court Judge Kenyatta Nyirenda gave the original order in June 2026.

ny.title: Khoti Lalikulu lidzamva mlandu wonyoza pa 17 Ogasiti
ny.body: Khothi Lalikulu la Malawi lidzamvetsera mlandu pa Ogasiti 17, 2026 ku Lilongwe. Mlembi Wamkulu Justin Saidi ndi Nduna Chimwemwe Chipungu akukumana ndi milandu yonyoza khothi. Akuimbidwa mlandu wolephera kulipira lendi ya nyumba yosungiramo zinthu yomwe imagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi bungwe la Malawi Electoral Commission.
ny.body_more:
Mlanduwu ukuchokera pa mkangano wokhudza malo a ofesi ya Electoral Commission. Mu June 2026, chipani cha Malawi Congress ndi opanga malamulo atatu adapambana chigamulo cha khothi choletsa kusamutsa ofesi kuchokera ku Lilongwe kupita ku Blantyre. Khothi linauza boma kuti lipitirize kulipira lendi ya nyumba yosungiramo katundu ku Njewa ku Lilongwe.

Komabe, mwini nyumba yosungiramo katundu adatseka nyumbayo chifukwa lendi sinalipidwe. Malipoti akuti lendi yosalipidwa inali pafupifupi K885 miliyoni. Chipani cha Malawi Congress chikuti Saidi ndi Chipungu adakana mwadala kulipira lendi. Izi zikuphwanya lamulo la khothi, chipanicho chikutero. Loya wa chipani George Kadzipatike adapereka mlandu wonyoza. M'mawu ake olumbira, adati akuluakulu a khothi adawonetsa kusamvera poyera kwa khothi.

Lamulo la khothi lidabwera Purezidenti Peter Mutharika atapereka lamulo loti bungwe la Electoral Commission lisamutsire ku Blantyre. Chipani cha Malawi Congress chidatsutsa izi. Aphungu atatu a chipanichi ndi Emmanuel Chambulanyina Jere wa ku Mzimba South, Abraham Mwakhwawa wa ku Karonga Lufilya, ndi Daniel Mwanyongo Chitonya wa ku Karonga Town. Alembedwa ngati ofunsira mlanduwu.

Loya Wamkulu Frank Mbeta akuyimira Saidi ndi Chipungu. Mbeta adaperekanso pempho loletsa lamulo la khothi lomwe lidaletsa kusamutsidwa kwa anthu. Woweruza wa Khothi Lalikulu Kenyatta Nyirenda adapereka lamulo loyambirira mu June 2026.

en.title: Three opposition parties demand Namiwa's release
en.body: Three opposition parties have joined together to call for the release of activist Sylvester Namiwa. The People's Development Party, United Transformation Movement, and United Democratic Front say Namiwa must be freed or given bail. They say his arrest and treason charge threaten democracy and freedom of speech in Malawi.
en.body_more:
The three party leaders are Kondwani Nankhumwa, Dalitso Kabambe, and Atupele Muluzi. They say they have read the charges against Namiwa. They are worried that the treason case rests mainly on things Namiwa said in one television interview. Treason is one of the most serious crimes under Malawi law. Treason means trying to overthrow the government.

The parties say the charges do not show any proof of real violence, armed uprising, or a plan to overthrow the government. They say political opinions and controversial speech should not become treason. The Constitution protects freedom of opinion and expression for all Malawians, they say. Namiwa also faces a separate charge about false news. The parties say he must be treated as innocent until a court finds him guilty. They say he should not stay in prison before his trial unless the court agrees it is needed.

The three parties also warn that Malawi could become a police state. A police state is a country where the government punishes people for criticism. They say if nothing changes, journalists, human rights workers, activists, and ordinary people could face arrest for speaking out. Today it is Namiwa, they say, but tomorrow it could be anyone who asks difficult questions.

The parties also clarified that Vice President Jane Ansah has nothing to do with Namiwa's case and should not be pulled into the dispute. The opposition leaders have asked the United Nations, African Union, SADC, the Commonwealth, and the Malawi Human Rights Commission to watch the case closely. They ask these groups to push authorities to follow the Constitution and respect human rights laws.

ny.title: Zipani zitatu zotsutsa zikufuna kuti Namiwa amasulidwe
ny.body: Zipani zitatu zotsutsa zagwirizana kuti zipemphe kuti Sylvester Namiwa, yemwe ndi wolimbikitsa ufulu wa anthu, amasulidwe. Zipani za People's Development Party, United Transformation Movement, ndi United Democratic Front zikuti Namiwa ayenera kumasulidwa kapena kupatsidwa belo. Akuti mlandu wake womangidwa ndi woukira boma ukuopseza demokalase ndi ufulu wolankhula ku Malawi.
ny.body_more:
Atsogoleri atatu a chipanichi ndi Kondwani Nankhumwa, Dalitso Kabambe, ndi Atupele Muluzi. Akuti awerenga milandu yokhudza Namiwa. Akuda nkhawa kuti mlandu wokhudza chiwembu umadalira kwambiri zomwe Namiwa adanena mu kuyankhulana kwa pa TV. Chiwembu ndi chimodzi mwa milandu yayikulu kwambiri pansi pa malamulo a Malawi. Chiwembu chimatanthauza kuyesa kugwetsa boma.

Maguluwa akuti milanduyi sikuwonetsa umboni uliwonse wa chiwawa chenicheni, kuukira kwa zida, kapena dongosolo logwetsa boma. Akuti malingaliro andale ndi mawu otsutsana sayenera kukhala chiwembu. Malamulo a dziko amateteza ufulu woganiza ndi kufotokoza maganizo kwa anthu onse aku Malawi, akutero. Namiwa akukumananso ndi mlandu wosiyana wokhudza nkhani zabodza. Maguluwa akuti ayenera kuonedwa ngati wosalakwa mpaka khothi litapeza kuti ndi wolakwa. Akuti sayenera kukhala m'ndende mlandu wake usanazengedwe pokhapokha khothi litavomereza kuti ndikofunikira.

Magulu atatuwa akuchenjezanso kuti Malawi ikhoza kukhala boma la apolisi. Dziko la apolisi ndi dziko lomwe boma limalanga anthu chifukwa chodzudzula. Akuti ngati palibe chomwe chikusintha, atolankhani, ogwira ntchito za ufulu wa anthu, omenyera ufulu wa anthu, ndi anthu wamba akhoza kumangidwa chifukwa cholankhula. Lero ndi Namiwa, akutero, koma mawa akhoza kukhala aliyense amene akufunsa mafunso ovuta.

Maguluwa adafotokozanso kuti Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah alibe chochita ndi nkhani ya Namiwa ndipo sayenera kulowetsedwa mu mkanganowu. Atsogoleri otsutsa apempha United Nations, African Union, SADC, Commonwealth, ndi Malawi Human Rights Commission kuti ayang'anire nkhaniyi mosamala. Akupempha maguluwa kuti akakamize akuluakulu kuti atsatire Malamulo Oyendetsera Dziko ndikulemekeza malamulo a ufulu wa anthu.

en.title: TNM Makes Big Profit. Gives Money Back to Owners.
en.body: TNM plc made much more money in 2025. The company earned K222.9 billion. Its profit grew very fast. TNM held a big meeting in Lilongwe on Friday. Leaders told owners the company did well. TNM will give owners K7.96 billion.
en.body_more:
Board chair Ted Sauti-Phiri said 2025 was a very good year. "We built strong things," he said. "Last year we gave no money to owners. This year we give them K7.96 billion." This makes owners happy.

Chief Officer Michel Hebert said the company added many new users. More than one million new people joined TNM. More than one million people started using TNM Mpamba. Mpamba is a way to send money by phone. The company now has seven million users in total. "We got back much of the market," Hebert said.

TNM bought new things to make services better. The company paid K11.5 billion to buy fibre from Open Connect Limited. Fibre is thick cables that carry fast internet. This will help TNM serve more people and add new services. A leader named Frank Harawa said this buy is good. "It will cost less to run," he said. "It will bring new ways to make money."

The numbers show TNM is strong. Money came in 41 more than before. Profit grew much more than that. The company can now pay owners money and still grow. This helps Malawi's phone business move forward.

ny.title: TNM Imapanga Phindu Lalikulu. Imabwezera Ndalama kwa Eni ake.
ny.body: TNM plc inapeza ndalama zambiri mu 2025. Kampaniyo inapeza K222.9 biliyoni. Phindu lake linakula mofulumira kwambiri. TNM inachita msonkhano waukulu ku Lilongwe Lachisanu. Atsogoleri anauza eni ake kuti kampaniyo yachita bwino. TNM ipereka eni ake K7.96 biliyoni.
ny.body_more:
Wapampando wa bungwe la Ted Sauti-Phiri anati chaka cha 2025 chinali chabwino kwambiri. "Tinamanga zinthu zolimba," adatero. "Chaka chatha sitinapatse eni ake ndalama. Chaka chino tawapatsa K7.96 biliyoni." Izi zikusangalatsa eni ake.

Mkulu wa bungweli Michel Hebert adati kampaniyo yawonjezera ogwiritsa ntchito atsopano ambiri. Anthu atsopano opitilira miliyoni imodzi adalowa nawo TNM. Anthu opitilira miliyoni imodzi adayamba kugwiritsa ntchito TNM Mpamba. Mpamba ndi njira yotumizira ndalama pafoni. Kampaniyo tsopano ili ndi ogwiritsa ntchito mamiliyoni asanu ndi awiri. "Tabweza msika wambiri," adatero Hebert.

TNM idagula zinthu zatsopano kuti ntchito zikhale bwino. Kampaniyo idalipira K11.5 biliyoni kuti igule ulusi kuchokera ku Open Connect Limited. Ulusi ndi zingwe zokhuthala zomwe zimanyamula intaneti mwachangu. Izi zithandiza TNM kutumikira anthu ambiri ndikuwonjezera ntchito zatsopano. Mtsogoleri wotchedwa Frank Harawa adati kugula kumeneku ndi kwabwino. "Kudzawononga ndalama zochepa kuyendetsa," adatero. "Kudzabweretsa njira zatsopano zopangira ndalama."

Ziwerengero zikuwonetsa kuti TNM ndi yolimba. Ndalama zidabwera ndi 41 kuposa kale. Phindu linakula kwambiri kuposa pamenepo. Kampaniyo tsopano ikhoza kulipira eni ake ndalama ndikupitiriza kukula. Izi zimathandiza bizinesi ya mafoni ku Malawi kupita patsogolo.

en.title: Parliament celebrates Malawi women's football team at WAFCON
en.body: Parliament stopped work on Monday to celebrate the Malawi Women's Football Team, the Scorchers, at the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco. Speaker Sameer Suleman said the team's play had lifted the nation's spirit. He called for all MPs to meet the team at the airport when they come home.
en.body_more:
Suleman told Parliament the Scorchers had done more than people hoped. He said they rewrote Malawi's football story. He asked for more money for women's football so the team can stay strong. "These young women have carried the flag with honour," he said. "They deserve to be celebrated by the entire country."

The Scorchers won two big games in Morocco. They beat Nigeria 3-2 in their first game. Then they beat Egypt 3-1 in their second game. The wins put Malawi at the top of their group. Faith Chimzimu, Rose Kabzere and Temwa Chawinga scored against Egypt. Fans back home watched and cheered at watch parties. One fan, Lucy Francis, said "I am very happy to have witnessed the Scorchers win this game against Egypt."

National Bank of Malawi (NBM) plc held watch parties in Blantyre and Lilongwe so fans could watch the games together. Bernard Masi from NBM plc said the bank sponsors the Scorchers long-term, not just for this tournament. "We are the proud sponsors of the Scorchers," he said. "We will continue supporting the team."

On Monday, Minister of Gender Mary Navicha asked Speaker Suleman to let some women MPs travel to Morocco to cheer the team. Suleman said he would think about this. He also said he believed the Scorchers could win the whole tournament. Malawi's next game is against Zambia in their final group match.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo Yakondwerera Timu Ya Mpira Ya Azimayi Ya Malawi ku WAFCON
ny.body: Nyumba Yamalamulo inayimitsa ntchito Lolemba kuti ikondwerere timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi, Scorchers, pa mpikisano wa Women's Africa Cup of Nations wa 2026 ku Morocco. Wokamba nkhani Sameer Suleman anati masewero a timuyi akweza mzimu wa dziko. Iye anapempha aphungu onse a nyumba yamalamulo kuti akakumane ndi timuyi pa eyapoti akabwerera kwawo.
ny.body_more:
Suleman adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti a Scorchers adachita zambiri kuposa momwe anthu ankayembekezera. Anati adalembanso nkhani ya mpira wa ku Malawi. Anapempha ndalama zambiri za mpira wa azimayi kuti timuyi ikhale yolimba. "Atsikana awa anyamula mbendera mwaulemu," adatero. "Ayenera kukondweretsedwa ndi dziko lonse."

A Scorchers adapambana masewera awiri akuluakulu ku Morocco. Adagonjetsa Nigeria 3-2 pamasewera awo oyamba. Kenako adagonjetsa Egypt 3-1 pamasewera awo achiwiri. Kupambana kumeneku kunapangitsa Malawi kukhala pamwamba pa gulu lawo. Faith Chimzimu, Rose Kabzere ndi Temwa Chawinga adagoletsa motsutsana ndi Egypt. Mafani akunyumba adawonera ndikusangalala ndi maphwando owonera. Wokonda m'modzi, Lucy Francis, adati "Ndili wokondwa kwambiri kuwona Scorchers ikupambana masewerawa motsutsana ndi Egypt."

National Bank of Malawi (NBM) plc idachita maphwando owonera ku Blantyre ndi Lilongwe kuti mafani athe kuwonera masewerawa pamodzi. Bernard Masi wa NBM plc adati bankiyo imathandizira a Scorchers kwa nthawi yayitali, osati mpikisano uno wokha. "Ndife othandizira onyada a Scorchers," adatero. "Tipitiliza kuthandizira gululo."
