Lolemba, Nduna ya za Gender Mary Navicha adapempha Sipikala Suleman kuti alole azimayi ena a Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti apite ku Morocco kukalimbikitsa gululo. Suleman adati angaganizire izi. Anatinso akukhulupirira kuti Scorchers akhoza kupambana mpikisano wonse. Masewera otsatira a Malawi ndi motsutsana ndi Zambia pamasewera awo omaliza a gulu.

en.title: IMF plans new money deal with Malawi for reforms
en.body: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) says a new money deal for Malawi will focus on reforms. The IMF wants to restore the economy and help poor families. The old deal ended in 2025 after the government failed to meet review dates. The IMF resident representative Nelnan Koumtingue said talks are happening now.
en.body_more:
The IMF wants any new deal to follow Malawi's National Economic Recovery Plan (Nerp). Nerp is a five-year plan. It aims to stop inflation (when prices go up fast) and grow the economy by 6.5 percent by 2030. Koumtingue said the IMF will help restore economic stability. He said reforms must include help for poor families. Exchange rate reforms are changes to how Malawi's money relates to other country money. These changes can hurt poor families quickly, so protection is needed.

Malawi's old deal was worth 175 million dollars (about K306 billion). It ended in May 2025 after the government did not finish the first review. Minister of Finance Joseph Mwanamvekha said the plan needs to fix deep problems. These problems include lack of foreign money, poor spending control, and need for new investment from outside. Bertha Bangara-Chikadza is president of the Economics Association of Malawi. She said the plan finds the right problems but does not show how to fix them.

Nerp wants to change farming methods. It plans solar-powered water systems for crops. It wants large farms through contract farming. Crops include maize, soya, rice and cashew. The plan aims to help exports and give farmers guaranteed sales. Malawi 2063 is the country's long-term plan. It wants Malawi to be wealthy, self-reliant and industrial by 2063. The IMF believes reforms with strong safety nets can help growth and better living for all Malawians.

ny.title: IMF yakonza mgwirizano watsopano wa ndalama ndi Malawi kuti asinthe zinthu
ny.body: Bungwe la International Monetary Fund (IMF) lati mgwirizano watsopano wa ndalama ku Malawi udzayang'ana kwambiri pa kusintha kwa chuma. IMF ikufuna kubwezeretsa chuma ndi kuthandiza mabanja osauka. Mgwirizano wakalewu unatha mu 2025 boma litalephera kukwaniritsa masiku owunikiranso. Woyimira wa IMF, Nelnan Koumtinggue, adati zokambirana zikuchitika tsopano.
ny.body_more:
IMF ikufuna kuti mgwirizano uliwonse watsopano utsatire Ndondomeko ya Kubwezeretsa Chuma cha Dziko la Malawi (Nerp). Nerp ndi dongosolo la zaka zisanu. Cholinga chake ndi kuletsa kukwera kwa mitengo (mitengo ikakwera mofulumira) ndikukulitsa chuma ndi 6.5 peresenti pofika chaka cha 2030. Koumtingue adati IMF ithandiza kubwezeretsa bata lachuma. Iye anati kusintha kuyenera kuphatikizapo kuthandiza mabanja osauka. Kusintha kwa ndalama zosinthira ndalama ndi kusintha kwa momwe ndalama za Malawi zimagwirizanirana ndi ndalama za mayiko ena. Kusintha kumeneku kungavulaze mabanja osauka mwachangu, kotero chitetezo chikufunika.

Mgwirizano wakale wa Malawi unali wamtengo wapatali wa madola 175 miliyoni (pafupifupi K306 biliyoni). Unatha mu Meyi 2025 boma litalephera kumaliza kuwunika koyamba. Nduna ya Zachuma Joseph Mwanamvekha adati dongosololi liyenera kukonza mavuto akulu. Mavutowa akuphatikizapo kusowa kwa ndalama zakunja, kuwongolera ndalama molakwika, komanso kufunikira kwa ndalama zatsopano kuchokera kunja. Bertha Bangara-Chikadza ndi purezidenti wa Economics Association of Malawi. Iye adati dongosololi likupeza mavuto oyenera koma silikuwonetsa momwe angawakonzere.

Nerp ikufuna kusintha njira zaulimi. Ikukonzekera njira zoyendetsera madzi pogwiritsa ntchito mphamvu ya dzuwa kuti mbewu zigwiritsidwe ntchito. Ikufuna minda ikuluikulu kudzera mu ulimi wa mgwirizano. Mbewu zikuphatikizapo chimanga, soya, mpunga ndi nthangala. Cholinga cha ndondomekoyi ndi kuthandiza kutumiza kunja ndikupatsa alimi chitsimikizo cha malonda. Malawi 2063 ndi dongosolo la nthawi yayitali la dzikolo. Ikufuna kuti Malawi ikhale yolemera, yodzidalira komanso yamakampani pofika chaka cha 2063. IMF ikukhulupirira kuti kusintha ndi njira zodzitetezera kungathandize kukula ndi moyo wabwino kwa anthu onse aku Malawi.

en.title: Power cuts off across Malawi. Escom finds and fixes problem.
en.body: Malawi lost all electricity on Sunday at 7.11am. The Electricity Supply Corporation of Malawi, called Escom, said a system shutdown caused the blackout. A system shutdown is when the power network stops working. Power came back to the Southern Region at 8.44am, the Central Region at 9.50am, and the Northern Region at 10.34am. Escom said its team was still finding out what went wrong.
en.body_more:
Escom told the public it would share more news once the team found all the facts. Pilirani Phiri, who speaks for Escom, said the public will be told what happened. The blackout cut power to homes, shops, hospitals and schools across the country. Many people got angry and asked Escom to tell them more quickly about power cuts.

This blackout happened more than one year after another big power cut in April 2025. That cut left Malawi with no power for about two hours. After those past cuts, Escom said it was looking into what went wrong but never told the public what it found. John Kapito, the head of the Consumers Association of Malawi, said the repeated blackouts without answers make people lose trust in Escom.

Days before this blackout, Escom said it had just turned on a new Battery Energy Storage System. This system was giving an extra 10 to 12 megawatts of power during peak hours. A megawatt is a measure of electricity. Malawi can make 554.24 megawatts of power. This comes from hydropower (401.8 megawatts), diesel power (51.4 megawatts), and solar power (101 megawatts). Escom still had not told the public what caused the Sunday blackout.

ny.title: Magetsi azima ku Malawi konse. Escom yapeza ndikukonza vuto.
ny.body: Malawi yataya magetsi onse Lamlungu nthawi ya 7:11am. Kampani Yogulitsa Magetsi ku Malawi, yotchedwa Escom, yati kutseka kwa makina kunayambitsa kuzimitsidwa kwa magetsi. Kuzimitsidwa kwa makina kumachitika pamene netiweki yamagetsi yasiya kugwira ntchito. Magetsi adabwerera ku Southern Region nthawi ya 8:44am, Central Region nthawi ya 9:50am, ndi Northern Region nthawi ya 10:34am. Escom yati gulu lake likupitilizabe kufufuza chomwe chalakwika.
ny.body_more:
Escom yauza anthu kuti idzagawana nkhani zambiri gululo likapeza mfundo zonse. Pilirani Phiri, yemwe amalankhula m'malo mwa Escom, anati anthu adzauzidwa zomwe zinachitika. Kuzimitsidwa kwa magetsi kunachepetsa magetsi m'nyumba, m'masitolo, m'zipatala ndi m'masukulu mdziko lonselo. Anthu ambiri anakwiya ndipo anapempha Escom kuti iwauze mwachangu za kuzimitsidwa kwa magetsi.

Kuzimitsidwa kumeneku kunachitika patatha chaka chimodzi kuchokera pamene kuzimitsidwa kwa magetsi kwakukulu kunachitika mu Epulo 2025. Kuzimitsidwa kumeneko kunasiya Malawi ilibe magetsi kwa maola pafupifupi awiri. Pambuyo pa kuzimitsidwa kumeneku, Escom inati ikuyang'ana zomwe zinalakwika koma sinauze anthu zomwe yapeza. John Kapito, mtsogoleri wa Consumers Association of Malawi, anati kuzimitsidwa mobwerezabwereza popanda mayankho kumapangitsa anthu kutaya chidaliro mu Escom.

Masiku angapo izi zisanachitike, Escom inati yangoyatsa kumene Battery Energy Storage System yatsopano. Dongosololi limapereka ma megawatts 10 mpaka 12 owonjezera nthawi yomwe anthu ambiri amagwira ntchito. Megawatt ndi muyeso wa magetsi. Malawi ikhoza kupanga ma megawatts 554.24 amagetsi. Izi zimachokera ku mphamvu yamagetsi yamadzi (401.8 megawatts), mphamvu ya dizilo (51.4 megawatts), ndi mphamvu ya dzuwa (101 megawatts). Escom sinauze anthu zomwe zinayambitsa kuzima kwa magetsi Lamlungu.

en.title: Wanderers beat Blue Eagles in penalty game to reach final
en.body: Mighty Wanderers Football Club won a cup semi-final match on Sunday. They beat Blue Eagles on penalties after the game ended 1-1. The match was at Silver Stadium. Wanderers won the penalty shootout 5-4. Now Wanderers will play Ekhaya FC in the Airtel Top 8 final.
en.body_more:
The match was very tight. Wanderers scored first. After four minutes, Lameck Mithi put the ball in the goal from a penalty kick. This gave Wanderers an early lead. But Blue Eagles did not give up. In the 27th minute, Blue Eagles also scored from a penalty. Christian Maluwa took the penalty kick. The score became 1-1. Both teams played hard in the second half but could not score again. The game ended 1-1 after 90 minutes of play.

Because the score was equal, the teams had to take penalty kicks. This is when each team takes five shots from the penalty spot. In the shootout, Wanderers scored five goals. Isaac Kaliati, Muhammad Sulumba, Emmanuel Nyirenda, Promise Kamwendo and Alex Kambilinya all scored. Sama Thierry missed one penalty but Wanderers still won. Blue Eagles scored four goals. Lanken Mwale, Matthias Nyirenda, Webster Nzunda and Christian Maluwa all scored. But Fahad Mtcheka and Davie Phiri missed their penalties. This cost Blue Eagles the match.

Wanderers will now face Ekhaya FC in the final. Ekhaya beat Karonga United 2-1 in their semi-final match to reach the final. This will be Ekhaya's first time in an Airtel Top 8 final. Ekhaya is from Blantyre. The final match will be an important game. Wanderers won the cup in 2022. Ekhaya is a new team in the final. The winner will get K40 million in prize money. This is more than last year when the prize was K35 million.

ny.title: Wanderers yagonjetsa Blue Eagles pamasewera a penalty kuti ifike kumapeto
ny.body: Mighty Wanderers Football Club idapambana masewera a semi-final a chikho Lamlungu. Adagonjetsa Blue Eagles ndi ma penalty masewerawa atatha 1-1. Masewerawa anali ku Silver Stadium. Wanderers idapambana ma penalty 5-4. Tsopano Wanderers idzasewera ndi Ekhaya FC mu mpikisano wa Airtel Top 8.
ny.body_more:
Masewerowa anali ovuta kwambiri. Wanderers anagoletsa chigoli choyamba. Patatha mphindi zinayi, Lameck Mithi anaika mpirawo m'goli atalandira penalty kick. Izi zinapatsa Wanderers chigoli choyamba. Koma Blue Eagles sanagonje. Pa mphindi 27, Blue Eagles nayonso inagoletsa chigoli kuchokera ku penalty. Christian Maluwa anagoletsa chigoli cha penalty. Chigolicho chinakhala 1-1. Magulu onse awiri adasewera molimbika mu theka lachiwiri koma sanathenso kugoletsa. Masewerowa anatha 1-1 patatha mphindi 90.

Popeza chigolicho chinali chofanana, maguluwo adayenera kutenga penalty kick. Apa ndi pamene gulu lililonse linatenga zigoli zisanu kuchokera pa penalty. Pa penalty, Wanderers inagoletsa zigoli zisanu. Isaac Kaliati, Muhammad Sulumba, Emmanuel Nyirenda, Promise Kamwendo ndi Alex Kambilinya onse anagoletsa. Sama Thierry anaphonya penalty imodzi koma Wanderers anapambanabe. Blue Eagles inagoletsa zigoli zinayi. Lanken Mwale, Matthias Nyirenda, Webster Nzunda ndi Christian Maluwa onse anagoletsa zigoli. Koma Fahad Mtcheka ndi Davie Phiri anaphonya zigoli zawo. Izi zidapangitsa kuti Blue Eagles iwononge ndalama zambiri pamasewerawa.

Wanderers tsopano ikumana ndi Ekhaya FC pamasewera omaliza. Ekhaya idagonjetsa Karonga United 2-1 pamasewera awo a semi-final kuti ifike pamasewera omaliza. Iyi ikhala nthawi yoyamba kwa Ekhaya pamasewera omaliza a Airtel Top 8. Ekhaya ndi wochokera ku Blantyre. Masewera omaliza adzakhala ofunikira kwambiri. Wanderers idapambana chikho mu 2022. Ekhaya ndi timu yatsopano pamasewera omaliza. Wopambana adzalandira ndalama zokwana K40 miliyoni. Izi ndi zoposa chaka chatha pomwe mphotoyo inali K35 miliyoni.

en.title: Malawi Women Football Team Faces Egypt Today
en.body: The Malawi Women's National Football Team, called the Scorchers, play Egypt today. The match is at Moulay Hassan Stadium in Rabat, Morocco. It is their second game in the Women's Africa Cup of Nations. Four days ago, Malawi beat Nigeria 3-2 in their first game. Nigeria were the holders and champions ten times before.
en.body_more:
Coach Lovemore Fazili said the team must focus now. "We need to build on that win," Fazili said. "That historic win will count for nothing if we do not do well against Egypt." He said Egypt is a good side and the team must be careful. "A win could boost our chances of making it to the knockout stages," Fazili added.

Captain Tabitha Chawinga said the team is ready. She plays in France. Her sister Temwa plays in the United States. Temwa scored two goals against Nigeria. Tabitha scored one goal. "We will fight hard," Tabitha said. "We are living everything in the hands of God Almighty."

Egypt lost their first game to Zambia 6-0. But Egypt is still a strong team. They have won five of their last seven matches. Sarah Eddam is Egypt's main player. She played before in England for Stoke City. Nadine Ghazi is another key player for Egypt.

This is the first time Malawi and Egypt play each other. Malawi is ranked 153rd in the world. Egypt is ranked 99th. Malawi is making their first appearance at this tournament. Egypt is making their third appearance. Zambia is top of the group with three points. Malawi has three points too, but a worse goal difference. Goal difference means the number of goals you score minus the goals against you.

ny.title: Timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi ikukumana ndi Egypt lero
ny.body: Timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi, yotchedwa Scorchers, isewera ndi Egypt lero. Masewerawa ali pa bwalo la Moulay Hassan Stadium ku Rabat, Morocco. Ndi masewera awo achiwiri mu mpikisano wa Women's Africa Cup of Nations. Masiku anayi apitawo, Malawi idagonjetsa Nigeria 3-2 pamasewera awo oyamba. Nigeria inali yopambana mpikisanowu kakhumi m'mbuyomu.
ny.body_more:
Mphunzitsi Lovemore Fazili anati timuyi iyenera kuyang'ana kwambiri tsopano. "Tiyenera kumanga pa chigonjetso chimenecho," adatero Fazili. "Kupambana kwa mbiri yakale kumeneko sikudzakhala kopanda phindu ngati sitichita bwino motsutsana ndi Egypt." Anati Egypt ndi timu yabwino ndipo timuyi iyenera kusamala. "Kupambana kungapangitse mwayi wathu wofika pagawo lomaliza," adatero Fazili.

Captain Tabitha Chawinga anati timuyi yakonzeka. Amasewera ku France. Mlongo wake Temwa amasewera ku United States. Temwa adagoletsa zigoli ziwiri motsutsana ndi Nigeria. Tabitha adagoletsa chigoli chimodzi. "Tidzamenyana mwamphamvu," adatero Tabitha. "Tikukhala ndi chilichonse m'manja mwa Mulungu Wamphamvuyonse."

Egypt idataya masewera awo oyamba ndi Zambia 6-0. Koma Egypt ikadali timu yolimba. Yapambana masewera asanu mwa asanu ndi awiri apitawa. Sarah Eddam ndiye wosewera wamkulu wa Egypt. Adasewera kale ku England ku Stoke City. Nadine Ghazi ndi wosewera wina wofunikira ku Egypt.

Iyi ndi nthawi yoyamba Malawi ndi Egypt kusewera wina ndi mnzake. Malawi ili pa nambala 153 padziko lonse lapansi. Egypt ili pa nambala 99. Malawi ikupezeka koyamba pa mpikisanowu. Egypt ikupezekanso pa nambala 3. Zambia ili pamwamba pa gululi ndi mapointi atatu. Malawi ilinso ndi mapointi atatu, koma kusiyana kwakukulu kwa zigoli. Kusiyana kwa zigoli kumatanthauza kuchuluka kwa zigoli zomwe mumapeza kupatula zigoli zomwe mukulimbana nazo.

en.title: Government builds new markets in Thyolo and Blantyre
en.body: Minister of Local Government and Rural Development Ben Phiri opened two new market projects on Saturday. He started the day in Blantyre at Limbe Produce Main Market. Then he went to Thyolo District for another groundbreaking. Both projects are part of the TRADE Programme. The new markets will help local traders and boost the economy.
en.body_more:
The TRADE Programme is a government plan to build better markets and increase business across Malawi. The plan helps farmers and traders sell more goods. It also helps the country make more of its own products instead of buying from other countries.

At Limbe Produce Main Market in Blantyre, Minister Phiri told the builder Blithe Construction Limited to do good work. He asked the company to hire local people for jobs. The new market in Limbe will be tall building with many floors. This saves space because many people move to cities. The market will have cold storage rooms for milk and other fresh goods. Noel Fanisako is the chairperson of Limbe market. He said traders need loans to buy things to sell. He also asked the government to fix the old market building.

Blantyre City Council Chief Executive Officer Costly Chanza said Limbe is very busy. Traders bring farm goods from many districts, even from Nkhata Bay. The new market will help all these traders sell better. Seven new markets will be built in eleven districts. Each market will take two years to build. The work helps the Trade Programme plan for 2026 and 2027. That plan wants more dairy farms in the South.

In Thyolo, Minister Phiri also had a royal ceremony. He made Traditional Authority Ngolongoliwa into a Senior Chief. He also made Group Village Head Samu into a Sub Traditional Authority. President Arthur Peter Mutharika chose both men for these jobs. The government says building markets and honoring chiefs helps both trade and local rule.

ny.title: Boma lamanga misika yatsopano ku Thyolo ndi Blantyre
ny.body: Nduna ya Maboma Apafupi ndi Chitukuko cha Kumidzi Ben Phiri adatsegula mapulojekiti awiri atsopano a msika Loweruka. Adayamba tsikulo ku Blantyre ku Limbe Produce Main Market. Kenako adapita ku Thyolo District kukachitanso chinthu china chatsopano. Mapulojekiti onsewa ndi gawo la Pulogalamu ya TRADE. Misika yatsopanoyi ithandiza amalonda am'deralo ndikukweza chuma.
ny.body_more:
Pulogalamu ya TRADE ndi dongosolo la boma lomanga misika yabwino ndikuwonjezera mabizinesi ku Malawi konse. Dongosololi limathandiza alimi ndi amalonda kugulitsa katundu wambiri. Limathandizanso dzikolo kupanga zinthu zake zambiri m'malo mogula kuchokera kumayiko ena.

Ku Limbe Produce Main Market ku Blantyre, Nduna Phiri adauza womanga Blithe Construction Limited kuti agwire ntchito yabwino. Adapempha kampaniyo kuti ilembe anthu am'deralo ntchito. Msika watsopano ku Limbe udzakhala nyumba zazitali zokhala ndi zipinda zambiri. Izi zimasunga malo chifukwa anthu ambiri amasamukira kumizinda. Msikawu udzakhala ndi zipinda zosungiramo mkaka ndi zinthu zina zatsopano. Noel Fanisako ndiye wapampando wa msika wa Limbe. Adati amalonda amafunika ngongole kuti agule zinthu zogulitsa. Adapemphanso boma kuti likonze nyumba yakale ya msika.

Mkulu wa bungwe la mzinda wa Blantyre, Costly Chanza, adati Limbe ndi yotanganidwa kwambiri. Amalonda amabweretsa katundu wa pafamu kuchokera m'maboma ambiri, ngakhale ochokera ku Nkhata Bay. Msika watsopanowu udzathandiza amalonda onsewa kugulitsa bwino. Misika isanu ndi iwiri yatsopano idzamangidwa m'maboma khumi ndi limodzi. Msika uliwonse udzatenga zaka ziwiri kuti umangidwe. Ntchitoyi ikuthandiza kukonzekera Pulogalamu ya Zamalonda ya 2026 ndi 2027. Ndondomekoyi ikufuna minda yambiri ya mkaka ku South.

Ku Thyolo, Nduna Phiri nayenso adachita mwambo wachifumu. Anapanga Ulamuliro Wachikhalidwe Ngolongoliwa kukhala Mfumu Yaikulu. Anapanganso Mtsogoleri wa Mudzi wa Gulu Samu kukhala Ulamuliro Waching'ono Wachikhalidwe. Purezidenti Arthur Peter Mutharika anasankha amuna onse awiri pantchitozi. Boma limati kumanga misika ndi kulemekeza mafumu kumathandiza malonda ndi ulamuliro wa m'deralo.

en.title: Ekhaya reach Airtel Top 8 final in first tournament
en.body: Ekhaya Football Club won 2-1 against Karonga United on Saturday. The match was a semi-final at Silver Stadium in Lilongwe. Allen Chihana scored first for Ekhaya in the 44th minute. Karonga came back with a penalty goal. Chimwemwe Chunga scored the winning goal in the 73rd minute.
en.body_more:
Ekhaya is a new team in this tournament. This is their first time playing in the Airtel Top 8. Their victory on Saturday marks a big moment for the club. The match was tight and both teams played well.

Ekhaya played with good control of the ball. They used the right side of the field well. Right-back Hermas Masinja made good runs forward. Right winger Chimwemwe Chunga worked well with him. Left winger James Lumbe also helped attack. The team moved the ball through midfield with Allen Chihana helping. This helped them find spaces in Karonga's defence.

Karonga United played a different way. They used direct play and set pieces to attack. Kennedy Mwakabaghe was key for Karonga in midfield. After Ekhaya scored, Karonga came back strong. In the 49th minute, they won a penalty. Lennox Kiwambe scored from the penalty to make it 1-1. But Ekhaya kept pushing. A quick move gave them a chance. Chimwemwe Chunga finished well to score the second goal.

In the last part of the game, Ekhaya played tight defence. Clever Mkungula and defenders Andrew Lameck, Happy Mphepo and Samuel Khedira Rukura kept Karonga's attack stopped. Ekhaya will now wait to see their final opponent. Mighty Wanderers will face Blue Eagles in the second semi-final on Sunday. The final winner will lift the Airtel Top 8 trophy.

ny.title: Ekhaya yafika pa mpikisano wa Airtel Top 8 mu mpikisano woyamba
ny.body: Ekhaya Football Club idapambana 2-1 motsutsana ndi Karonga United Loweruka. Masewerawa anali semi-final ku Silver Stadium ku Lilongwe. Allen Chihana ndiye adagoletsa chigoli choyamba cha Ekhaya mu mphindi ya 44. Karonga adabweranso ndi chigoli cha penalty. Chimwemwe Chunga ndiye adagoletsa chigoli chopambana mu mphindi ya 73.
ny.body_more:
Ekhaya ndi timu yatsopano mu mpikisanowu. Iyi ndi nthawi yawo yoyamba kusewera mu Airtel Top 8. Kupambana kwawo Loweruka ndi nthawi yofunika kwambiri kwa kilabu. Masewerawa anali olimba ndipo magulu onse awiri adasewera bwino.

Ekhaya adasewera ndi ulamuliro wabwino pa mpira. Adagwiritsa ntchito bwino mbali yakumanja ya bwalo. Hermas Masinja, yemwe anali kumbuyo kwa dzanja lamanja, adathamanga bwino kutsogolo. Chimwemwe Chunga, yemwe anali kumbuyo kwa dzanja lamanja, adagwira ntchito bwino naye. James Lumbe, yemwe anali kumbuyo kwa dzanja lamanzere, adathandiziranso kuukira. Gululo lidasuntha mpirawo pakati pa bwalo ndipo Allen Chihana adathandiza. Izi zidawathandiza kupeza malo pakati pa chitetezo cha Karonga.

Karonga United idasewera mosiyana. Adagwiritsa ntchito masewero olunjika komanso zida zoyesera kuti aukirane. Kennedy Mwakabaghe anali wofunikira kwambiri kwa Karonga pakati pa bwalo. Ekhaya atangogoletsa, Karonga adabweranso mwamphamvu. Mphindi 49, adapeza penalty. Lennox Kiwambe adagoletsa kuchokera pa penalty kuti zitheke 1-1. Koma Ekhaya adapitiliza kukankha. Kusuntha mwachangu kunawapatsa mwayi. Chimwemwe Chunga adamaliza bwino kuti apeze chigoli chachiwiri.

Mu gawo lomaliza la masewerawa, Ekhaya adasewera bwino kwambiri. Clever Mkungula ndi oteteza Andrew Lameck, Happy Mphepo ndi Samuel Khedira Rukura adaletsa kuukira kwa Karonga. Ekhaya tsopano akuyembekezera kuwona mdani wawo womaliza. Mighty Wanderers idzakumana ndi Blue Eagles mu semi-final yachiwiri Lamlungu. Wopambana womaliza adzapambana chikho cha Airtel Top 8.

en.title: Malawi Business Leader Bokosi Weds US Financial Advisor
en.body: Jacqueline Bokosi, chief of CTS Courier and CTS Funeral Services, has married Ken Kilmer. Kilmer is a United States citizen. The wedding was a civil ceremony at Bothell Courthouse in Bothell, Washington. The company's public relations officer Mike Kalumbi said the ceremony took place as planned.
en.body_more:
Kalumbi spoke with Bokosi after the ceremony. He said she was very happy. She thanked both families and friends for their support. She also thanked her new husband, Ken Kilmer, for his love. She said he kept the promises he made to her.

Bokosi is a well-known business leader in Malawi. She runs CTS Courier and CTS Funeral Services. Kilmer works in the United States. He is a financial adviser. He holds the position of First Vice President in the Wealth Management division at the Royal Bank of Canada. This is a senior job working with money and investments for rich people.

The wedding ceremony was conducted by Judge Langbehn at the courthouse. Both families gave their blessing to the marriage. The Msiska family and the Bokosi family both supported the couple. They said the marriage joins two families from different countries. One family is from Malawi. The other family is from the United States. Kalumbi described the day as joyful for both families as they started this new chapter together.

ny.title: Mtsogoleri wa Malawi Business Bokosi Weds US Financial Advisor
ny.body: Jacqueline Bokosi, mkulu wa CTS Courier ndi CTS Funeral Services, wakwatira Ken Kilmer. Kilmer ndi nzika ya ku United States. Ukwatiwo unali mwambo wa boma ku Bothell Courthouse ku Bothell, Washington. Mkulu wa ubale wa anthu ku kampaniyo, Mike Kalumbi, anati mwambowo unachitika monga momwe anakonzera.
ny.body_more:
Kalumbi adalankhula ndi Bokosi pambuyo pa mwambowo. Iye adati anali wokondwa kwambiri. Anathokoza mabanja ndi abwenzi chifukwa cha thandizo lawo. Anathokozanso mwamuna wake watsopano, Ken Kilmer, chifukwa cha chikondi chake. Anati adasunga malonjezo omwe adamulonjeza.

Bokosi ndi mtsogoleri wodziwika bwino wa bizinesi ku Malawi. Amayendetsa CTS Courier ndi CTS Funeral Services. Kilmer amagwira ntchito ku United States. Ndi mlangizi wazachuma. Ali ndi udindo wa Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Woyamba mu gawo la Wealth Management ku Royal Bank of Canada. Uwu ndi ntchito yayikulu yogwira ntchito ndi ndalama ndi ndalama zogulira anthu olemera.

Mwambo waukwati unachitidwa ndi Woweruza Langbehn kukhothi. Mabanja onse awiri adadalitsa ukwatiwo. Banja la Msiska ndi banja la Bokosi onse adathandizira awiriwa. Anati ukwatiwo umaphatikiza mabanja awiri ochokera kumayiko osiyanasiyana. Banja limodzi ndi la ku Malawi. Banja lina ndi la ku United States. Kalumbi adafotokoza tsikuli ngati losangalatsa kwa mabanja onse awiri pamene adayamba mutu watsopanowu pamodzi.

en.title: Malawi cuts diesel and kerosene prices from 1 August
en.body: Malawi has cut the price of diesel and kerosene. The Malawi Energy Regulatory Authority (MERA) made the change on 1 August 2026. Diesel now costs K5,863 per litre, down from K6,306. Kerosene now costs K4,389 per litre, down from K4,771. Petrol prices stay the same.
en.body_more:
MERA Chief Executive Officer Lucas Kondowe signed the statement. Diesel prices fell because global fuel costs fell. The price drop is almost one-seventh for diesel and one-twelfth for kerosene. The Automatic Pricing Mechanism ties domestic fuel prices to world market prices. This system means Malawi prices move when international prices move.

The cuts also apply to jet fuel at airports. At Kamuzu International Airport in Lilongwe, Jet A-1 fuel costs K4,577 per litre, down from K4,870 per litre. At Bakili Muluzi International Airport in Blantyre, Jet A-1 fuel costs K4,496 per litre, down from K4,733 per litre. These are the maximum prices airlines can charge.

MERA said it reviewed all costs before setting new prices. The review looked at fuel import costs, insurance, taxes and other pricing parts for July 2026. Global fuel markets remain unstable because of conflict in Iran. Despite this, prices fell enough to bring costs down for Malawi. People and companies with diesel machines and vehicles saw immediate savings from Saturday onwards.

ny.title: Malawi yachepetsa mitengo ya dizilo ndi mafuta a palafini kuyambira pa 1 Ogasiti
ny.body: Malawi yachepetsa mtengo wa dizilo ndi mafuta a palafini. Bungwe loona za mphamvu la Malawi Energy Regulatory Authority (MERA) linasintha izi pa 1 Ogasiti 2026. Dizilo tsopano imadula K5,863 pa lita, kuchoka pa K6,306. Kerosene tsopano imadula K4,389 pa lita, kuchoka pa K4,771. Mitengo ya mafuta ikadali yomweyo.
ny.body_more:
Mkulu wa bungwe la MERA, Lucas Kondowe, adasaina chikalatacho. Mitengo ya dizilo idatsika chifukwa mitengo ya mafuta padziko lonse idatsika. Kutsika kwa mitengo ndi pafupifupi gawo limodzi mwa magawo asanu ndi awiri a dizilo ndi gawo limodzi mwa magawo khumi ndi awiri a palafini. Njira Yodzipangira Mitengo Yokha imagwirizanitsa mitengo yamafuta am'dziko ndi mitengo yamsika wapadziko lonse. Dongosololi likutanthauza kuti mitengo ya mafuta aku Malawi imasintha mitengo ikasintha.

Kuchepetsa kumeneku kumagwiranso ntchito pa mafuta a ndege m'mabwalo a ndege. Pa bwalo la ndege la Kamuzu International ku Lilongwe, mafuta a Jet A-1 amawononga K4,577 pa lita, kuchokera pa K4,870 pa lita. Pa bwalo la ndege la Bakili Muluzi International ku Blantyre, mafuta a Jet A-1 amawononga K4,496 pa lita, kuchokera pa K4,733 pa lita. Izi ndi mitengo yayikulu kwambiri yomwe makampani opanga ndege angayilipire.

MERA idati idawunikiranso ndalama zonse asanakhazikitse mitengo yatsopano. Ndemangayi idayang'ana ndalama zogulira mafuta, inshuwaransi, misonkho ndi zina zogulira mafuta za Julayi 2026. Misika yamafuta padziko lonse lapansi ikadali yosakhazikika chifukwa cha mikangano ku Iran. Ngakhale izi, mitengo idatsika mokwanira kuti ichepetse ndalama ku Malawi. Anthu ndi makampani omwe ali ndi makina ndi magalimoto a dizilo adawona ndalama zosungidwa nthawi yomweyo kuyambira Loweruka kupita mtsogolo.

en.title: Police arrest civil rights activist Sylvester Namiwa
en.body: Police arrested Sylvester Namiwa on Thursday. He is the Executive Director of Cdedi. Cdedi is the Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives. Police held him at Lingadzi Police Station in Lilongwe. Police said he broke laws about peace and false news.
en.body_more:
Police Deputy Spokesperson Alfred Chimthere said Namiwa was arrested for conduct likely to cause a breach of peace and publication of false news. He was expected to appear in court after his arrest.

Namiwa's arrest came after he refused to say sorry to Lands Minister Chimwemwe Chipungu. On July 27, 2026, Cdedi held a press meeting. At this meeting, Cdedi said Chipungu bought seven vehicles worth K2.8 billion after he became a minister. Cdedi also said Chipungu started building a hotel and was involved in land deals with Airport Development Limited. Chipungu's lawyer Khwima Mchizi asked Cdedi to take back these words and say sorry within 48 hours. Namiwa refused. He said Cdedi was ready to go to court. He asked Chipungu to show documents to prove his money and his things were real.

Before his arrest, Namiwa was called to National Police Headquarters in Area 30, Lilongwe on Thursday afternoon. He met with Criminal Investigations Department Director Gerland Chiwanda and Inspector General Richard Luhanga. After this meeting, police took him to Lingadzi Police Station.

Cdedi demanded that Namiwa be set free. The group said police did not tell them why they held him. Cdedi also said police did not give Namiwa warm clothes or food. Police stopped people from visiting him, including his family and other activists. UTM leader Dalitso Kabambe and civil rights leader Benedicto Kondowe were not allowed to see him.

ny.title: Apolisi agwira Sylvester Namiwa, womenyera ufulu wa anthu
ny.body: Apolisi adagwira Sylvester Namiwa Lachinayi. Iye ndi Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa Cdedi. Cdedi ndi Center for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives. Apolisi adamugwira ku Lingadzi Police Station ku Lilongwe. Apolisi adati adaswa malamulo okhudza mtendere ndi nkhani zabodza.
ny.body_more:
Wachiwiri kwa Mneneri wa Apolisi, Alfred Chimthere, anati Namiwa anamangidwa chifukwa cha khalidwe lomwe lingasokoneze mtendere komanso kufalitsa nkhani zabodza. Akuyembekezeka kuonekera kukhothi atamangidwa.

Kumangidwa kwa Namiwa kunabwera atakana kupepesa kwa Nduna ya Malo Chimwemwe Chipungu. Pa Julayi 27, 2026, Cdedi adachita msonkhano ndi atolankhani. Pamsonkhanowu, Cdedi adati Chipungu adagula magalimoto asanu ndi awiri amtengo wa K2.8 biliyoni atakhala nduna. Cdedi adatinso Chipungu adayamba kumanga hotelo ndipo anali ndi mgwirizano wa malo ndi Airport Development Limited. Loya wa Chipungu, Khwima Mchizi, adapempha Cdedi kuti abweze mawu awa ndikupepesa mkati mwa maola 48. Namiwa anakana. Anati Cdedi anali wokonzeka kupita kukhothi. Anapempha Chipungu kuti awonetse zikalata zotsimikizira ndalama zake ndi zinthu zake zinali zenizeni.

Asanamangidwe, Namiwa adaitanidwa ku National Police Headquarters ku Area 30, Lilongwe Lachinayi masana. Adakumana ndi Director wa Criminal Investigations Department Gerland Chiwanda ndi Inspector General Richard Luhanga. Pambuyo pa msonkhanowu, apolisi adamutengera ku siteshoni ya apolisi ya Lingadzi.

Cdedi adapempha kuti Namiwa amasulidwe. Gululo linati apolisi sanawauze chifukwa chomwe adamugwirira. Cdedi adatinso apolisi sanapatse Namiwa zovala zofunda kapena chakudya. Apolisi adaletsa anthu kuti asamuyendere, kuphatikizapo banja lake ndi anthu ena omenyera ufulu wa anthu. Mtsogoleri wa UTM Dalitso Kabambe ndi mtsogoleri wa ufulu wa anthu Benedicto Kondowe sanaloledwe kumuona.

en.title: Military officer denies knowing plane crash details
en.body: A retired military officer told parliament he learned about a missing plane through social media. Lieutenant General John Msonthi Jr said on June 10, 2024, he heard Vice-President Saulos Klaus Chilima's aircraft had gone missing. He called a friend to say sorry. But he said he did not know the plane had crashed.
en.body_more:
Msonthi told the parliamentary committee investigating the Chikangawa plane crash that his belief the aircraft had gone down was only his own guess. He said poor weather, the crew's silence, and the plane not reaching its destination made him think it had crashed. But he had no proof. He stressed he received no official message telling him the plane had crashed or where the wreckage was.

His testimony seemed to conflict with earlier evidence from Moses Nthakomwa, a close friend of Chilima. Nthakomwa told the committee that Msonthi called him at about 8:19pm on June 10 and described crash details. Msonthi denied this. He said he knew nothing certain about what happened to the aircraft. Committee chairperson Walter Nyamilandu-Manda said Msonthi was called to help clear up the conflicting stories. Earlier testimony suggested Msonthi knew the plane had been found on June 10, but the public was only told on June 11.

Former National Intelligence Service director Dokani Ngwira also gave testimony. Ngwira said the NIS did not plan Chilima's trip to Nkhata Bay but knew he was going to a funeral. Around 11am on June 10, Ngwira received a report that the aircraft carrying Chilima and eight others was missing. He told the Secretary to the President and Cabinet, who told President Lazarus Chakwera. Search and rescue began immediately. Ngwira contacted intelligence agencies in the United States, France and Israel for help, but none could find the aircraft. Nyamilandu-Manda praised Ngwira for his openness and said his evidence was important to the inquiry.

ny.title: Msilikali wakana kuti akudziwa zambiri za ngozi ya ndege
ny.body: Msilikali wopuma pantchito adauza nyumba yamalamulo kuti adamva za ndege yomwe yasowa kudzera pa malo ochezera a pa Intaneti. Lieutenant General John Msonthi Jr adati pa June 10, 2024, adamva kuti ndege ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Saulos Klaus Chilima yasowa. Anayimbira mnzake kuti amupepese. Koma adati sakudziwa kuti ndegeyo yagwa.
ny.body_more:
Msonthi anauza komiti ya nyumba yamalamulo yomwe inkafufuza za ngozi ya ndege ya Chikangawa kuti chikhulupiriro chake chakuti ndegeyo yagwa chinali kungoganiza kwake. Anati nyengo yoipa, chete cha ogwira ntchito, komanso kusafika komwe ndegeyo ikupita kunamupangitsa kuganiza kuti yagwa. Koma analibe umboni. Ananenetsa kuti sanalandire uthenga wovomerezeka womuuza kuti ndegeyo yagwa kapena komwe kunali zinyalala.

Umboni wake ukuwoneka kuti ukusemphana ndi umboni wakale wochokera kwa Moses Nthakomwa, bwenzi lapamtima la Chilima. Nthakomwa anauza komitiyo kuti Msonthi adamuyimbira foni pafupifupi 8:19pm pa June 10 ndipo anafotokoza zambiri za ngoziyo. Msonthi anakana izi. Anati sakudziwa chilichonse chotsimikizika za zomwe zinachitika ku ndegeyo. Wapampando wa komiti Walter Nyamilandu-Manda anati Msonthi adaitanidwa kuti athandize kumveketsa nkhani zotsutsanazo. Umboni wakale umasonyeza kuti Msonthi ankadziwa kuti ndegeyo idapezeka pa June 10, koma anthu adangouzidwa pa June 11.

Dokani Ngwira, yemwe kale anali mkulu wa National Intelligence Service, nayenso anapereka umboni. Ngwira anati bungwe la NIS silinakonzekere ulendo wa Chilima wopita ku Nkhata Bay koma linkadziwa kuti akupita ku maliro. Pafupifupi 11 koloko m'mawa pa 10 June, Ngwira adalandira lipoti lakuti ndege yomwe inali ndi Chilima ndi ena asanu ndi atatu yasowa. Anauza Mlembi wa Purezidenti ndi Kabungwe ka Boma, yemwe anauza Purezidenti Lazarus Chakwera. Kusaka ndi kupulumutsa anthu kunayamba nthawi yomweyo. Ngwira adalumikizana ndi mabungwe anzeru ku United States, France ndi Israel kuti amuthandize, koma palibe amene adapeza ndegeyo. Nyamilandu-Manda adayamika Ngwira chifukwa cha kutseguka kwake ndipo adati umboni wake ndi wofunikira pakufufuza.

en.title: Malawi launches new dashboard to track development money
en.body: Malawi's government launched a new digital dashboard on Friday to track development projects across the country. The dashboard lets the President, Finance Minister, and other top officials see project progress right now. More than 2,000 projects are happening in 36 local areas. Minister of Local Government Ben Phiri said the system will stop officials hiding behind slow paper reports.
en.body_more:
The dashboard was launched on Friday, July 31, 2026, at the Bingu International Convention Centre in Lilongwe. It tracks Constituency Development Fund (CDF) projects. The CDF is money the government gives directly to communities for local development. Each constituency gets MK5 billion.

The dashboard shows project plans, money spent, photos, and when work finishes. It uses GPS and artificial intelligence to check project locations and progress. President Peter Mutharika, the Finance Minister, the Office of the President and Cabinet, and other senior officials can view project performance from their offices. The general public can also access the dashboard to check projects in their own areas.

Minister Phiri said tracking 2,000 projects by hand was not possible. Paper reports arrived late at offices. Decisions got delayed. Problems stayed unsolved. The new system stops this. "Every kwacha of public money must produce visible development," Phiri said. He warned district commissioners and chief executive officers that they will be personally accountable for keeping their data up to date. "The era of hiding behind delayed reports is over," he declared. Council leaders must update the dashboard every day.

Phiri said the government has given councils the staff they need. Directors of public works, directors of planning, chief procurement officers, and CDF officers are now in place at constituency level. "The capacity is there. The systems are in place. The resources have been provided. Therefore, there is no excuse for failure," Phiri warned. Those councils performing well will be recognized. Those falling behind will be visible to the government and the public.

ny.title: Malawi yakhazikitsa dashboard yatsopano yowunikira ndalama zoyendetsera chitukuko
ny.body: Boma la Malawi lakhazikitsa dashboard yatsopano ya digito Lachisanu kuti litsatire mapulojekiti a chitukuko m'dziko lonselo. Dashboard iyi imalola Purezidenti, Nduna ya Zachuma, ndi akuluakulu ena apamwamba kuwona momwe mapulojekiti akuyendera pakadali pano. Mapulojekiti opitilira 2,000 akuchitika m'madera 36 am'deralo. Nduna ya Boma la M'deralo Ben Phiri adati dongosololi liletsa akuluakulu kubisala kumbuyo kwa malipoti ochedwa a mapepala.
ny.body_more:
Dashboard idakhazikitsidwa Lachisanu, pa Julayi 31, 2026, ku Bingu International Convention Centre ku Lilongwe. Imatsata mapulojekiti a Constituency Development Fund (CDF). CDF ndi ndalama zomwe boma limapereka mwachindunji kumadera kuti zitukule m'deralo. Chigawo chilichonse chimapeza MK5 biliyoni.

Dashboard ikuwonetsa mapulani a mapulojekiti, ndalama zomwe zagwiritsidwa ntchito, zithunzi, ndi nthawi yomwe ntchito yatha. Imagwiritsa ntchito GPS ndi luntha lochita kupanga kuti ione malo a mapulojekiti ndi momwe zinthu zikuyendera. Purezidenti Peter Mutharika, Nduna ya Zachuma, Ofesi ya Purezidenti ndi Kabungwe, ndi akuluakulu ena akuluakulu amatha kuwona momwe mapulojekiti amagwirira ntchito kuchokera m'maofesi awo. Anthu onse amathanso kupeza dashboard kuti ayang'ane mapulojekiti m'madera awo.

Nduna Phiri adati kutsatira mapulojekiti 2,000 ndi manja sikungatheke. Malipoti a mapepala adafika mochedwa m'maofesi. Zisankho zidachedwa. Mavuto sanathetsedwe. Dongosolo latsopanoli limaletsa izi. "Kwacha iliyonse ya ndalama za boma iyenera kupanga chitukuko chowoneka," adatero Phiri. Anachenjeza akuluakulu a zigawo ndi akuluakulu akuluakulu kuti adzakhala ndi udindo pawokha pakusunga deta yawo kukhala yatsopano. "Nthawi yobisala kumbuyo kwa malipoti ochedwa yatha," adatero. Atsogoleri a makhansala ayenera kusintha dashboard tsiku lililonse.

Phiri adati boma lapatsa makhansala antchito omwe amafunikira. Oyang'anira ntchito za anthu onse, owongolera mapulani, akuluakulu ogula zinthu, ndi akuluakulu a CDF tsopano ali pamalo awo pamlingo wa chigawo. "Kutha kwa ntchito kulipo. Machitidwe alipo. Zida zaperekedwa. Chifukwa chake, palibe chifukwa cholephera," Phiri adachenjeza. Makhansala omwe akuchita bwino adzazindikirika. Omwe akutsalira adzawonekera kwa boma komanso anthu onse.

en.title: Nico Holdings pays K41.8 billion dividend to shareholders
en.body: Nico Holdings approved a dividend payout of K41.8 billion. Shareholders will receive this money for the year ending December 31, 2025. The final dividend is K8.4 billion. A dividend is money a company pays to its owners from profits. The payout shows the company is doing well.
en.body_more:
The dividend decision is a sign of strength. It shows Nico Holdings is making good profits and can pay money back to shareholders. The company is stable. This helps investors trust Nico Holdings more.

When big companies like Nico pay dividends, other Malawi businesses watch. Smaller companies may try to do the same thing. They want to show they also make good profits. This helps them get money from investors. Investors look for companies that share profits with owners.

The timing of this payout matters too. Nico decided to pay the dividend late in the year. This shows the company is sure it can keep working well next year. Some Malawi companies delayed dividends in the past because money was hard to find. Nico did not wait. This tells investors the company is honest and strong.

Nico Holdings works in many business areas. Consumer goods and other sectors help the company earn money. When one area does poorly, other areas may do well. This mix helps Nico stay stable. The K41.8 billion payout shows this works. Investors in Malawi and other countries may now want to put money into Nico and similar companies. The payout may help bring more foreign money into Malawi. It shows Malawi is a good place to do business.

ny.title: Nico Holdings yapereka gawo la K41.8 biliyoni kwa eni masheya
ny.body: Kampani ya Nico Holdings yavomereza kuti pakhale ndalama zokwana K41.8 biliyoni zolipirira magawo a kampani. Ogawana nawo adzalandira ndalamazi chaka chomwe chidzatha pa Disembala 31, 2025. Gawo lomaliza la magawo a kampani ndi K8.4 biliyoni. Gawo la magawo a kampani ndi ndalama zomwe kampani imapereka kwa eni ake kuchokera ku phindu. Malipirowo akusonyeza kuti kampaniyo ikuyenda bwino.
ny.body_more:
Chisankho cha magawo ndi chizindikiro cha mphamvu. Zimasonyeza kuti Nico Holdings ikupanga phindu labwino ndipo ikhoza kubwezera ndalama kwa eni masheya. Kampaniyo ndi yokhazikika. Izi zimathandiza amalonda kudalira Nico Holdings kwambiri.

Makampani akuluakulu ngati Nico akapereka magawo, mabizinesi ena aku Malawi amawaona. Makampani ang'onoang'ono angayese kuchita zomwezo. Amafuna kusonyeza kuti nawonso amapeza phindu labwino. Izi zimawathandiza kupeza ndalama kuchokera kwa amalonda. Amalonda amafunafuna makampani omwe amagawana phindu ndi eni ake.

Nthawi yolipira iyi ndiyofunikanso. Nico adaganiza zolipira magawo kumapeto kwa chaka. Izi zikusonyeza kuti kampaniyo ikutsimikiza kuti ingapitirize kugwira ntchito bwino chaka chamawa. Makampani ena aku Malawi adachedwetsa magawo kale chifukwa ndalama zinali zovuta kupeza. Nico sanadikire. Izi zimauza amalonda kuti kampaniyo ndi yoona mtima komanso yamphamvu.

Nico Holdings imagwira ntchito m'mabizinesi ambiri. Katundu wogula ndi magawo ena amathandiza kampaniyo kupeza ndalama. Pamene dera lina silichita bwino, madera ena angachite bwino. Kuphatikiza kumeneku kumathandiza Nico kukhala yokhazikika. Malipiro a K41.8 biliyoni akuwonetsa kuti izi zikugwira ntchito. Amalonda ku Malawi ndi mayiko ena tsopano angafune kuyika ndalama ku Nico ndi makampani ena ofanana. Malipirowo angathandize kubweretsa ndalama zambiri zakunja ku Malawi. Zikusonyeza kuti Malawi ndi malo abwino ochitira bizinesi.

en.title: Vice President's Office denies claims about presidency.
en.body: The Office of the Vice President has denied claims that Vice President Jane Ansah wants to become President. The office said on Friday it does not support any statements that seek to weaken the Presidency. The denial comes after activist Sylvester Namiwa said Vice President Ansah could become President within two months.
en.body_more:
Namiwa made his remarks on Luntha TV. He suggested that Vice President Ansah is being left out of cabinet meetings and other official work. He said if this continues, Dr Jane Ansah will be the next president within two months.

The Vice President's Office said it does not associate itself with any statements or actions that seek to undermine the Presidency or its unity. The office said Vice President Ansah remains committed to the Constitution. She rejects any position that goes against the country's constitutional rules. The office said Ansah believes in unity and respect for the Presidency. She remains dedicated to supporting the President while doing her constitutional responsibilities.

Bishop Gilford Matonga of the religious group Public Affairs Committee (PAC) demanded that the Vice President's Office publicly deny Namiwa's claims. Matonga questioned how someone could rise to the presidency when a lawfully elected president is still in office. He said this sentiment is criminal in nature. He asked the Vice President's Office to issue a public statement dissociating itself from Namiwa's remarks.

Namiwa is now in custody at Lingadzi Police Station. He faces charges of false news publication. The Vice President's Office urged the public to disregard the claims and focus on serving Malawi in line with the Constitution.

ny.title: Ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti yakana zomwe akunena zokhudza utsogoleri.
ny.body: Ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti yakana zomwe akunena kuti Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah akufuna kukhala Purezidenti. Ofesiyi yati Lachisanu silikugwirizana ndi mawu aliwonse omwe akufuna kufooketsa Utsogoleri. Kukana kumeneku kwachitika pambuyo poti Sylvester Namiwa, wolimbikitsa ufulu wa anthu, wanena kuti Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Ansah akhoza kukhala Purezidenti mkati mwa miyezi iwiri.
ny.body_more:
Namiwa adalankhula pa Luntha TV. Adanenanso kuti Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Ansah akusiyidwa pamisonkhano ya nduna ndi ntchito zina zovomerezeka. Adati ngati izi zipitirira, Dr Jane Ansah adzakhala purezidenti wotsatira mkati mwa miyezi iwiri.

Ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti idati sigwirizana ndi mawu kapena zochita zilizonse zomwe zikufuna kuwononga Utsogoleri kapena mgwirizano wake. Ofesiyo idati Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Ansah akupitilizabe kudzipereka ku Constitution. Akukana udindo uliwonse womwe umatsutsana ndi malamulo a dzikolo. Ofesiyo idati Ansah amakhulupirira umodzi ndi ulemu kwa Utsogoleri. Akupitirizabe kudzipereka kuthandiza Purezidenti pamene akuchita maudindo ake oyendetsera malamulo.

Bishopu Gilford Matonga wa gulu lachipembedzo la Public Affairs Committee (PAC) adapempha kuti Ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti ikane poyera zomwe Namiwa adanena. Matonga adafunsa momwe munthu angakwerere kukhala purezidenti pamene purezidenti wosankhidwa mwalamulo akadali paudindo. Adati malingaliro awa ndi achifwamba. Adapempha Ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti kuti ipereke chikalata cha anthu onse chodzipatula ku zomwe Namiwa adanena.

Namiwa tsopano ali m'ndende ku Lingadzi Police Station. Akukumana ndi mlandu wofalitsa nkhani zabodza. Ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti idapempha anthu kuti asamamvere zomwe akunenazo ndikuyang'ana kwambiri kutumikira Malawi motsatira Malamulo Oyendetsera Dziko.

en.title: Parliament rejects call to stop work over activist arrest
en.body: Leader of the House Jappie Mhango rejected a request to stop Parliament work on Friday. Leader of Opposition Simplex Chithyola asked to stop the work over the arrest of human rights activist Sylvester Namiwa. Mhango said Parliament must continue. He said police must handle the arrest case.
en.body_more:
Chithyola told Parliament he visited Namiwa at Lingadzi Police Station. He said Namiwa was denied food, a lawyer, and visits from family. Chithyola said this was not fair. He asked if Malawi was becoming a "police state". He called for Namiwa to be released or taken to court quickly.

Mhango told Parliament to let police do their work. He said no one is above the law. He said if Namiwa broke a law, he must go through the legal process. Mhango also said the Opposition did not help Namiwa before. "They almost killed the young man," Mhango said. "Today they are becoming holier."

Member of Parliament Felix Njawala from Mwanza Central agreed with Mhango. Njawala said the Opposition's words about law and fairness were not real because they did not help Namiwa months ago. "The words are right, but they come from the wrong person," Njawala said. Minister of Homeland Security Peter Mukhito said Namiwa was not denied bail. Mukhito said Namiwa is being handled by the law. He said Namiwa had similar problems during the past MCP government.

Namiwa was arrested on Thursday. Police said he made false news and acted in ways that could cause trouble. Police said they are still checking the case. Opposition groups and human rights workers asked the government to follow the law and protect Namiwa's rights.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo Yakana Kuyimitsa Ntchito Chifukwa Chomangidwa Kwa Anthu Otsatira Chiwawa
ny.body: Mtsogoleri wa Nyumba Yamalamulo Jappie Mhango wakana pempho loti Nyumba Yamalamulo iyimitse ntchito zake Lachisanu. Mtsogoleri wa Otsutsa Simplex Chithyola wapempha kuti ntchitoyi iyimitse chifukwa cha kumangidwa kwa Sylvester Namiwa womenyera ufulu wa anthu. Mhango adati Nyumba Yamalamulo iyenera kupitiliza. Iye anati apolisi ayenera kusamalira mlandu womangidwa kwa munthuyo.
ny.body_more:
Chithyola adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti adapita ku Namiwa ku Lingadzi Police Station. Adati Namiwa adakanidwa chakudya, loya, komanso kuchezeredwa ndi achibale. Chithyola adati izi sizinali chilungamo. Adafunsa ngati Malawi ikukhala "boma la apolisi". Adapempha kuti Namiwa amasulidwe kapena atengedwe kukhothi mwachangu.

Mhango adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti ilole apolisi kuchita ntchito yawo. Adati palibe amene ali pamwamba pa lamulo. Adati ngati Namiwa aswa lamulo, ayenera kudutsa njira zamalamulo. Mhango adatinso Otsutsa sanamuthandize Namiwa kale. "Anatsala pang'ono kupha mnyamatayo," adatero Mhango. "Lero akukhala oyera kwambiri."

Membala wa Nyumba Yamalamulo Felix Njawala wochokera ku Mwanza Central adagwirizana ndi Mhango. Njawala adati mawu a Otsutsa okhudza lamulo ndi chilungamo sanali enieni chifukwa sanamuthandize Namiwa miyezi yapitayo. "Mawuwo ndi olondola, koma amachokera kwa munthu wolakwika," adatero Njawala. Nduna ya Zachitetezo cha Dziko Peter Mukhito adati Namiwa sanakanidwe belo. Mukhito adati Namiwa akusamalidwa ndi lamulo. Iye anati Namiwa anali ndi mavuto ofanana ndi amenewa m'boma lakale la MCP.

Namiwa anamangidwa Lachinayi. Apolisi anati adapanga nkhani zabodza ndipo adachita zinthu m'njira zomwe zingayambitse mavuto. Apolisi adati akuyang'anirabe nkhaniyi. Magulu otsutsa ndi ogwira ntchito za ufulu wa anthu apempha boma kuti litsatire malamulo ndikuteteza ufulu wa Namiwa.

en.title: Malawi Queens beat Tonga, play Scotland next
en.body: Malawi's netball team beat Tonga 55-49 in Glasgow yesterday. The win helps the Queens try to finish in the top seven. They now play Scotland today in the seventh-place match. Coach Debbie Fuller said the team played well.
en.body_more:
The match was the last Group A game at the 2026 Commonwealth Games. Tonga scored first and led 15-14 in the first quarter. But Malawi came back strong. Shooter Mwawi Kumwenda and goal-attacker Ethel Ng'ambi shot better as the game went on. Malawi led 29-26 at half-time. The team played even better in the third quarter and led 43-39. In the last quarter, Tonga fought hard to get back. But Malawi's defence was too strong. Wing defender Martha Dambo, goal defender Sophie Banda and goalkeeper Shabel Bengo stopped Tonga from scoring more.

Fuller changed one player before this match. Centre Mphatso Banda played instead of Melia Soko. Fuller has been the coach for five months. After the match, wing-attacker Takondwa Lwazi said the team was proud. She said losing would have meant playing for ninth place. "We did our best to avoid that," she said.

The Queens have now won two of five group matches. Scotland lost to Uganda yesterday, so they also play in the seventh-place match. Fuller said Scotland will be hard to beat because they have tall players and will have fans to help them. But Fuller said she believes her team can win. The Queens lost to South Africa, Australia and England earlier in the games. They beat Northern Ireland before beating Tonga. Fuller said the team must improve their defence and keep the ball better in today's match. She said finishing seventh is better than eighth.

ny.title: Malawi Queens yagonjetsa Tonga, kenako yasewera ndi Scotland.
ny.body: Timu ya netiboli ya Malawi yagonjetsa Tonga 55-49 ku Glasgow dzulo. Kupambana kumeneku kwathandiza timu ya Queens kuyesa kumaliza m'magulu asanu ndi awiri apamwamba. Tsopano asewera ndi Scotland lero pamasewera a nambala 7. Mphunzitsi Debbie Fuller adati timuyi yasewera bwino.
ny.body_more:
Masewerowa anali masewera omaliza a Gulu A pa Masewera a Commonwealth a 2026. Tonga idayamba ndi chigoli ndipo idatsogolera 15-14 mu kotala yoyamba. Koma Malawi idabweranso mwamphamvu. Woponya chigoli Mwawi Kumwenda ndi woponya chigoli Ethel Ng'ambi adawombera bwino pamene masewerawa akupitiliza. Malawi idatsogolera 29-26 nthawi yopuma. Gululo lidasewera bwino kwambiri mu kotala yachitatu ndipo lidatsogolera 43-39. Mu kotala yomaliza, Tonga idalimbana kwambiri kuti ibwerere. Koma chitetezo cha Malawi chinali champhamvu kwambiri. Woteteza wing Martha Dambo, woteteza zigoli Sophie Banda ndi golikipa Shabel Bengo adaletsa Tonga kuti isagole zambiri.

Fuller adasintha wosewera m'modzi masewerawa asanachitike. Centre Mphatso Banda adasewera m'malo mwa Melia Soko. Fuller wakhala mphunzitsi kwa miyezi isanu. Pambuyo pa masewerawa, woponya wing Takondwa Lwazi adati gululo lidanyadira. Iye adati kutayika kukanatanthauza kusewera malo achisanu ndi chinayi. "Tidachita zonse zomwe tingathe kuti tipewe zimenezo," adatero.

The Queens tsopano yapambana masewera awiri mwa asanu a gulu. Scotland idagonja ndi Uganda dzulo, kotero imaseweranso pamasewera omwe ali pa nambala 7. Fuller adati Scotland idzakhala yovuta kugonja chifukwa ili ndi osewera ataliatali ndipo idzakhala ndi mafani oti awathandize. Koma Fuller adati akukhulupirira kuti timu yake ikhoza kupambana. A Queens adagonja ndi South Africa, Australia ndi England koyambirira kwa masewerawa. Adagonja Northern Ireland asanagonjetse Tonga. Fuller adati timuyi iyenera kukonza chitetezo chawo ndikusunga mpira bwino pamasewera a lero. Iye adati kumaliza pa nambala 7 ndikwabwino kuposa pa nambala 8.

en.title: Chief Malemia jailed 21 years for sex with child
en.body: Senior Chief Malemia has been sent to prison for 21 years. A court found him guilty of having sex with a young girl and helping to arrange an abortion for her. The Senior Resident Magistrate's Court in Zomba gave this sentence on Friday. The chief's real name is Clement Lloyd. He is 33 years old. He was arrested earlier this month.
en.body_more:
Magistrate Elijah Daniels gave the chief 21 years for the first crime of having sex with a child. He gave him nine more years for helping with the abortion. But both sentences run together, so the chief will serve 21 years in total. This is the longest prison time the law allows.

Magistrate Daniels said the chief did wrong because of his position. "You were a chief," Daniels told the court. "You were supposed to use your position well. But you did not. That is why your crime is very serious." The magistrate also said the chief had sex with the child many times. The girl herself told the court this was true.

State prosecutor Naarai Longwe said the government was happy with the sentence. But the case will now go to the High Court. Judges there can choose to make the prison time longer or shorter. The chief's lawyer, Patrick Debwe, said he would talk to his client first. Then he will decide if they will ask the court to change the sentence. This case has shocked many people in Zomba and across Malawi.

ny.title: Chief Malemia Wagamulidwa ku Chigamulo cha Zaka 21 chifukwa chogonana ndi mwana
ny.body: Mkulu wa a Senior Chief Malemia watumizidwa kundende kwa zaka 21. Khothi linamupeza wolakwa chifukwa chogonana ndi mtsikana wamng'ono komanso kuthandiza kukonza mimba yake. Khothi la Senior Resident Magistrate ku Zomba linapereka chigamulochi Lachisanu. Dzina lenileni la mkuluyo ndi Clement Lloyd. Ali ndi zaka 33. Anamangidwa koyambirira kwa mwezi uno.
ny.body_more:
Woweruza milandu Elijah Daniels adapatsa mkulu wa milandu zaka 21 chifukwa cha mlandu woyamba wogonana ndi mwana. Adamupatsa zaka zina zisanu ndi zinayi chifukwa chothandiza kuchotsa mimba. Koma zilango zonse ziwiri zimagwirizana, kotero mkuluyo adzakhala m'ndende zaka 21 zonse. Iyi ndi nthawi yayitali kwambiri yomwe lamulo limalola.

Woweruza milandu Daniels adati mkuluyo adachita zolakwika chifukwa cha udindo wake. "Unali mfumu," Daniels adauza khothi. "Umayenera kugwiritsa ntchito udindo wako bwino. Koma sunachite. Ndicho chifukwa chake mlandu wako ndi waukulu kwambiri." Woweruza milandu adatinso mkuluyo adagonana ndi mwanayo kangapo. Mtsikanayo mwiniwake adauza khothi kuti izi ndi zoona.

Woyimira milandu wa boma Naarai Longwe adati boma lasangalala ndi chigamulocho. Koma mlanduwu tsopano upita ku Khothi Lalikulu. Oweruza milandu kumeneko angasankhe kukulitsa nthawi ya ndende kapena kufupikitsa. Loya wa mkuluyo, Patrick Debwe, adati alankhula ndi kasitomala wake kaye. Kenako adzasankha ngati apempha khothi kuti lisinthe chigamulocho. Mlanduwu wadabwitsa anthu ambiri ku Zomba ndi ku Malawi konse.

en.title: Church leader says VP power claim is criminal talk
en.body: A church leader has hit back at an activist who said the First Vice President could become president in two months. Bishop Gilford Matonga said this talk is wrong and dangerous. He asked how anyone can take power when the president is still in office.
en.body_more:
Activist Sylvester Namiwa made the claim on TV. He said First Vice President Jane Ansah is being kept away from cabinet meetings and government work. Namiwa said if this does not stop, Ansah will become president within two months. "If these actions do not change, Jane Ansah will be the next President of this country within the next two months," he told the TV station.

Bishop Matonga spoke for the Public Affairs Committee. He said Namiwa's words are dangerous and break the country's rules. Malawi's Constitution is the book of country rules. Constitution means the rules that say how the country must work. "How does one ascend to the presidency when a lawfully elected incumbent is still in office? Such sentiments are criminal in nature," Matonga said. He said such talk can scare people and hurt the country's government.

Matonga asked the Office of the Vice President to speak out. He said Ansah's office must tell the public that Namiwa's words do not show what the Vice President thinks. A clear message from the Vice President's office would help calm people, Matonga said. He said it would show the country's leaders still care about the Constitution and keeping the country safe and stable.

The government has not said any change will happen to the country's leadership. Under Malawi's Constitution, the president stays in charge until his time in office ends.

ny.title: Mtsogoleri wa tchalitchi akuti kunena kuti ndi wachiwiri kwa purezidenti ndi nkhani yaupandu
ny.body: Mtsogoleri wa tchalitchi wabwezera munthu womenyera ufulu wa anthu amene anati Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti woyamba akhoza kukhala purezidenti pakatha miyezi iwiri. Bishop Gilford Matonga anati nkhaniyi ndi yolakwika komanso yoopsa. Anafunsa kuti munthu angalande bwanji mphamvu pamene purezidenti akadali paudindo.
ny.body_more:
Womenyera ufulu wachibadwidwe Sylvester Namiwa adanena izi pa TV. Iye anati Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti woyamba Jane Ansah akuletsedwa kusonkhana ndi akuluakulu a boma komanso ntchito za boma. Namiwa adati ngati izi sizisiya, Ansah adzakhala purezidenti mkati mwa miyezi iwiri. "Ngati izi sizisintha, Jane Ansah adzakhala Purezidenti wotsatira wa dziko lino mkati mwa miyezi iwiri ikubwerayi," adatero kwa wailesi yakanema.

Bishopu Matonga adalankhula m'malo mwa Komiti Yoona za Anthu. Iye adati mawu a Namiwa ndi owopsa ndipo amaswa malamulo a dzikolo. Malamulo a dziko la Malawi ndi buku la malamulo a dzikolo. Malamulo a dzikolo amatanthauza malamulo omwe amanena momwe dzikolo liyenera kugwirira ntchito. "Kodi munthu amalowa bwanji paudindo wa purezidenti pamene munthu wosankhidwa mwalamulo akadali paudindo? Maganizo otere ndi achifwamba," adatero Matonga. Iye adati nkhani zotere zimatha kuopseza anthu ndikuvulaza boma la dzikolo.

Matonga adapempha Ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti kuti ilankhule. Iye adati ofesi ya Ansah iyenera kuuza anthu kuti mawu a Namiwa sakusonyeza zomwe Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti amaganiza. Uthenga womveka bwino wochokera ku ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti ungathandize anthu kukhala chete, anatero Matonga. Anati izi ziwonetsa kuti atsogoleri a dzikolo akusamalabe za Malamulo Oyendetsera Dziko komanso kuti dzikolo likhale lotetezeka komanso lokhazikika.

Boma silinanene kuti kusintha kulikonse kudzachitika pa utsogoleri wa dzikolo. Malinga ndi Malamulo Oyendetsera Dziko la Malawi, purezidenti amakhalabe paudindo mpaka nthawi yake yolamulira itatha.

en.title: Minister denies activist denied food in police custody
en.body: Minister of Homeland Security Peter Mukhito has denied that detained activist Sylvester Namiwa is being denied basic food and clothing in police custody. Namiwa was brought to police headquarters in Lilongwe on Thursday after police summoned him. The Opposition Leader Simplex Chithyola Banda said in parliament on Friday that Namiwa is in a bad state.
en.body_more:
Banda told parliament that Namiwa has been denied access to food and warm clothing since his arrest. He said he was the only person allowed to see Namiwa, and that he was even stopped from praying with the activist. Banda demanded that Namiwa either be freed at once or be formally charged with a crime.

Namiwa is the Executive Director for the Center for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives. Mukhito responded by saying the law will run its course without political influence. He told parliament that all legal processes are being properly followed and that Namiwa is not being denied basic necessities.

Later, opposition leaders United Democratic Front President Atupele Muluzi and United Transformation Movement President Dalitso Kabambe visited Namiwa. Muluzi said Namiwa told them he had been denied food, water, warm clothing, visits from relatives, and access to his lawyers. Muluzi called on the government to check if these claims are true and to make sure Namiwa gets fair treatment. He said respect for the rights of people in custody shows whether Malawi truly follows justice and human dignity.

ny.title: Nduna yakana kuti womenyera ufulu wa anthu adamukanidwa chakudya ali m'manja mwa apolisi
ny.body: Nduna ya Zachitetezo cha Dziko Peter Mukhito yakana kuti Sylvester Namiwa yemwe anali womenyera ufulu wa anthu akumanidwa chakudya ndi zovala zofunika ali m'manja mwa apolisi. Namiwa adabweretsedwa ku likulu la apolisi ku Lilongwe Lachinayi apolisi atamuitana. Mtsogoleri wa Otsutsa Simplex Chithyola Banda adati Lachisanu m'nyumba yamalamulo kuti Namiwa ali mu mkhalidwe woipa.
ny.body_more:
Banda adauza nyumba yamalamulo kuti Namiwa waletsedwa kupeza chakudya ndi zovala zofunda kuyambira pomwe adamangidwa. Adati ndiye yekhayo amene adaloledwa kuonana ndi Namiwa, ndipo adaletsedwa kupemphera ndi womenyera ufuluyo. Banda adapempha kuti Namiwa amasulidwe nthawi yomweyo kapena aimbidwe mlandu wolakwa.

Namiwa ndi Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa Center for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives. Mukhito adayankha ponena kuti lamuloli lidzayendetsedwa popanda chikoka cha ndale. Adauza nyumba yamalamulo kuti njira zonse zamalamulo zikutsatiridwa bwino ndipo Namiwa sakuletsedwa zinthu zofunika pa moyo.

Pambuyo pake, atsogoleri otsutsa Purezidenti wa United Democratic Front, Atupele Muluzi, ndi Purezidenti wa United Transformation Movement, Dalitso Kabambe, adapita ku Namiwa. Muluzi adati Namiwa adawauza kuti waletsedwa chakudya, madzi, zovala zofunda, kuchezeredwa ndi achibale, komanso mwayi wolankhula ndi maloya ake. Muluzi adapempha boma kuti liwone ngati zomwe akunenazi ndi zoona ndikuwonetsetsa kuti Namiwa akuchitiridwa zinthu mwachilungamo. Adati kulemekeza ufulu wa anthu omwe ali m'ndende kukuwonetsa ngati Malawi ikutsatiradi chilungamo ndi ulemu wa anthu.

en.title: UEFA says no to FIFA World Cup sale plan
en.body: UEFA and its 55 member nations said they will not play in FIFA competitions if FIFA sells parts of the World Cup to private investors. FIFA President Gianni Infantino wants to sell stakes to raise money. UEFA said on Thursday this is wrong. The World Cup is not for sale.
en.body_more:
UEFA made this decision after an emergency meeting. The group said the plan lacks honesty and consultation. A proposal of this size was made in secret and nearly approved without asking national football groups first. UEFA described this as a failure of leadership. It said FIFA is pressuring nations to accept the plan or face consequences. This is not real democracy, UEFA said.

If private investors own parts of FIFA competitions, football will change forever, UEFA warned. Money and profit will become the main goal. Decisions about the international calendar and tournament formats will be driven by investor interests, not what is good for football. UEFA said: "Football's future cannot be dictated by the expectations of those whose first duty is to maximise financial return."

Nations like Spain, Portugal, England, France, Germany, Italy and the Netherlands could refuse to play in future FIFA competitions. This would reduce the value and quality of FIFA competitions greatly. FIFA says it will give 211 member associations 53 days to decide. Nations that approve the plan will get up to US$40 million in funding. Nations that reject it will get around US$10 million. FIFA has announced it plans to create a new commercial company called FIFA Forward Enterprise to sell these stakes and raise billions of dollars for football development. However, FIFA maintains it will keep control over how competitions are run and sporting decisions made.

ny.title: UEFA yakana dongosolo logulitsa FIFA World Cup
ny.body: UEFA ndi mayiko 55 omwe ali mamembala ake adati sadzasewera m'mipikisano ya FIFA ngati FIFA igulitsa magawo a World Cup kwa amalonda achinsinsi. Purezidenti wa FIFA Gianni Infantino akufuna kugulitsa magawo kuti apeze ndalama. UEFA idati Lachinayi izi ndi zolakwika. World Cup si yogulitsa.
ny.body_more:
UEFA idapanga chisankho ichi pambuyo pa msonkhano wadzidzidzi. Gululo linati dongosololi silili ndi chilungamo komanso upangiri. Lingaliro lalikulu chonchi linapangidwa mwachinsinsi ndipo linatsala pang'ono kuvomerezedwa popanda kufunsa magulu a mpira wa dziko kaye. UEFA idafotokoza izi ngati kulephera kwa utsogoleri. Inati FIFA ikukakamiza mayiko kuti avomereze dongosololi kapena akumane ndi zotsatirapo zake. UEFA idatero.

Ngati amalonda achinsinsi ali ndi magawo a mpikisano wa FIFA, mpira udzasintha kwamuyaya, UEFA idachenjeza. Ndalama ndi phindu zidzakhala cholinga chachikulu. Zisankho zokhudzana ndi kalendala yapadziko lonse lapansi ndi mawonekedwe a mpikisano zidzayendetsedwa ndi zofuna za amalonda, osati zomwe zili zabwino pa mpira. UEFA idati: "Tsogolo la mpira silingayang'aniridwe ndi ziyembekezo za omwe ntchito yawo yoyamba ndi kukulitsa phindu lazachuma."

Mayiko monga Spain, Portugal, England, France, Germany, Italy ndi Netherlands akhoza kukana kusewera m'mipikisano yamtsogolo ya FIFA. Izi zingachepetse kwambiri mtengo ndi khalidwe la mipikisano ya FIFA. FIFA ikunena kuti ipatsa mabungwe 211 masiku 53 kuti asankhe. Mayiko omwe avomereza dongosololi adzapeza ndalama zokwana US$40 miliyoni. Mayiko omwe akukana adzalandira pafupifupi US$10 miliyoni. FIFA yalengeza kuti ikukonzekera kupanga kampani yatsopano yamalonda yotchedwa FIFA Forward Enterprise kuti igulitse magawo awa ndikusonkhanitsa mabiliyoni ambiri a madola kuti apititse patsogolo chitukuko cha mpira. Komabe, FIFA ikutsimikiza kuti ipitilizabe kuwongolera momwe mipikisano imachitikira komanso zisankho zamasewera.

en.title: Police summon CDEDI leader Namiwa to headquarters
en.body: Sylvester Namiwa, head of CDEDI, was called to the National Police Headquarters in Lilongwe on Thursday at 2:30pm. CDEDI is a group that watches the government. Namiwa was told to meet with Gerland Chiwanda, the head of police investigations, and then with Inspector General Richard Luhanga. The police sent the summons through WhatsApp.
en.body_more:
The summons came one day after Lands and Urban Development Minister Chimwemwe Chipungu told Namiwa to say sorry. Chipungu's lawyer Khwima Mchizi gave Namiwa 48 hours to take back his words. Namiwa had spoken at a press meeting on Monday. At that meeting, CDEDI asked Chipungu to let the government check how he got his money. CDEDI said it had proof of wrong things Chipungu did.

Namiwa has also been loud about other problems. He asked for a full check of First Lady Gertrude Mutharika's charity called Beautify Malawi. He said the charity may have done bad deals. The police have not yet said why they called Namiwa in. No one knows if the summons links to what Namiwa said about Chipungu or about other things.

CDEDI also said that Norman Chisale called Namiwa. Chisale is Deputy Minister of Homeland Security and the bodyguard for President Peter Mutharika. Chisale was not happy about things Namiwa said in a recent TV talk. CDEDI said Namiwa has had bad phone calls and got threats. But Namiwa will keep pushing the government to do the right thing, CDEDI said.

UDF leader Atupele Muluzi said Namiwa should be free to ask questions. He told the police to treat Namiwa well and respect his rights. Muluzi said people must be able to speak out without fear. He said this is how a real democracy works.

ny.title: Apolisi aitanitsa mtsogoleri wa CDEDI Namiwa ku likulu lawo
ny.body: Sylvester Namiwa, mtsogoleri wa CDEDI, adaitanidwa ku Likulu la Apolisi ku Lilongwe Lachinayi nthawi ya 2:30pm. CDEDI ndi gulu lomwe limayang'anira boma. Namiwa adauzidwa kuti akakumane ndi Gerland Chiwanda, mkulu wa ofufuza apolisi, kenako ndi Inspector General Richard Luhanga. Apolisi adatumiza chikalata choitanira apolisi kudzera pa WhatsApp.
ny.body_more:
Kuitanidwa kumeneku kunabwera tsiku lina Nduna ya Zamalo ndi Chitukuko cha Mizinda Chimwemwe Chipungu atauza Namiwa kuti apepese. Loya wa Chipungu, Khwima Mchizi, adapatsa Namiwa maola 48 kuti abweze mawu ake. Namiwa adalankhula pamsonkhano wa atolankhani Lolemba. Pamsonkhanowo, CDEDI idapempha Chipungu kuti alole boma kuti liwone momwe adapezera ndalama zake. CDEDI idati ili ndi umboni wa zinthu zolakwika zomwe Chipungu adachita.

Namiwa wakhala akunena mokweza za mavuto ena. Adapempha kuti afufuze zonse za bungwe lothandiza anthu la First Lady Gertrude Mutharika lotchedwa Beautify Malawi. Adati bungweli mwina lidachita zinthu zoipa. Apolisi sananenebe chifukwa chomwe adayimbira Namiwa. Palibe amene akudziwa ngati kuitanidwako kukugwirizana ndi zomwe Namiwa adanena zokhudza Chipungu kapena zinthu zina.

CDEDI idanenanso kuti Norman Chisale adayimbira Namiwa. Chisale ndi Wachiwiri kwa Nduna ya Zachitetezo cha Dziko komanso mlonda wa Purezidenti Peter Mutharika. Chisale sanasangalale ndi zomwe Namiwa adanena mu nkhani yaposachedwa ya pa TV. CDEDI idati Namiwa wakhala akuimbidwa mafoni molakwika ndipo adawopsezedwa. Koma Namiwa apitilizabe kulimbikitsa boma kuti lichite zoyenera, anatero CDEDI.

Mtsogoleri wa UDF Atupele Muluzi anati Namiwa ayenera kukhala ndi ufulu wofunsa mafunso. Anauza apolisi kuti azimuchitira zabwino Namiwa ndikulemekeza ufulu wake. Muluzi anati anthu ayenera kulankhula momasuka popanda mantha. Anati umu ndi momwe demokalase yeniyeni imagwirira ntchito.

en.title: Music industry leaders visit Cosoma over royalty concerns
en.body: Music producers and record label managers visited the Copyright Society of Malawi (Cosoma) offices in Lilongwe on Wednesday to ask questions about how royalties are shared. The group wanted to meet Cosoma's leader Dora Makwinja but she was not there. They said Cosoma is not listening to their concerns about the Blank Media Levy. Blank Media Levy is money the government collects from devices like memory sticks to pay artists.
en.body_more:
The creatives were led by Kelvin Sulugwe, who manages Akometsi Entertainment, and Kelvin Ngumuya, who leads Madness Entertainment. They brought lawyers Henry Mvula and Ntchindi Chiyamwaka with them. Sulugwe said the group simply wanted Cosoma to explain how it works. "We are not here to ask Cosoma to defend itself. We want them to help us understand the processes," he said. He told reporters that Cosoma had shared K1.8 billion in royalties, which is much more money than before. But many rights holders complained about how it was divided.

In the recent payment period from April 2025 to March 2026, musicians got over K1 billion, writers received K519 million, and filmmakers got over K259 million. Ngumuya said young artists are not happy. "Young artists should feel that if they work hard, they will earn more," he said. He said right now young artists do not gain much from their work no matter how hard they try. The group also said Cosoma's Facebook posts show the society does not take these issues seriously.

Makwinja said she was in Blantyre for other government work that day. She said the creatives did not confirm the meeting before they came. "In our previous meeting, we agreed to meet on Wednesday but I told them to confirm and they did not," she said. She added that Cosoma is open to meet with them and explain how it works, but they need better communication first.

ny.title: Atsogoleri a makampani a nyimbo apita ku Cosoma chifukwa cha nkhawa za mafumu
ny.body: Opanga nyimbo ndi oyang'anira ma studio ojambulira nyimbo adapita ku maofesi a Copyright Society of Malawi (Cosoma) ku Lilongwe Lachitatu kuti akafunse mafunso okhudza momwe ndalama zachifumu zimagawidwira. Gululo linkafuna kukumana ndi mtsogoleri wa Cosoma, Dora Makwinja, koma iye sanapezekepo. Iwo anati Cosoma sakumvetsera nkhawa zawo zokhudza Blank Media Levy. Blank Media Levy ndi ndalama zomwe boma limasonkhanitsa kuchokera ku zipangizo monga zokumbukira kuti lilipire ojambula.
ny.body_more:
Opanga zinthu anali kutsogoleredwa ndi Kelvin Sulugwe, yemwe amayang'anira Akometsi Entertainment, ndi Kelvin Ngumuya, yemwe akutsogolera Madness Entertainment. Anabweretsa maloya Henry Mvula ndi Ntchindi Chiyamwaka nawo. Sulugwe anati gululo linkangofuna kuti Cosoma afotokoze momwe limagwirira ntchito. "Sitili pano kuti tipemphe Cosoma kuti adziteteze. Tikufuna kuti atithandize kumvetsetsa njira zomwe zikuchitika," adatero. Anauza atolankhani kuti Cosoma adagawana K1.8 biliyoni mu ndalama zachifumu, zomwe ndi ndalama zambiri kuposa kale. Koma anthu ambiri omwe ali ndi ufulu adadandaula za momwe zidagawidwira.

Mu nthawi yaposachedwa yolipira kuyambira Epulo 2025 mpaka Marichi 2026, oimba adapeza ndalama zoposa K1 biliyoni, olemba adalandira K519 miliyoni, ndipo opanga mafilimu adapeza ndalama zoposa K259 miliyoni. Ngumuya adati ojambula achinyamata sakusangalala. "Ojambula achinyamata ayenera kumva kuti ngati agwira ntchito molimbika, adzalandira ndalama zambiri," adatero. Anati pakadali pano ojambula achinyamata sapindula kwambiri ndi ntchito yawo mosasamala kanthu kuti ayesetsa bwanji. Gululo linanenanso kuti zolemba za Cosoma pa Facebook zikusonyeza kuti anthu satenga nkhanizi mozama.

Makwinja anati anali ku Blantyre kukagwira ntchito zina za boma tsiku limenelo. Iye anati opanga zinthu sanatsimikizire msonkhanowo asanabwere. "M'msonkhano wathu wapitawu, tinagwirizana kuti tikumane Lachitatu koma ndinawauza kuti atsimikizire koma sanatero," iye anatero. Anawonjezera kuti Cosoma ndi wokonzeka kukumana nawo ndikuwafotokozera momwe zimagwirira ntchito, koma akufunika kulankhulana bwino kaye.

en.title: Parliament approves K229.5 billion in grants
en.body: Parliament has approved K229.5 billion in money from the World Bank to help Malawi. The money will help local councils and help businesses that export goods. The two grants are K87.5 billion for the Thrive Project and K142 billion for the Gesd 2.0 Project. Finance Minister Joseph Mwanamvekha said the money will help Malawi grow.
en.body_more:
The Thrive Project will give money to export businesses in Malawi. It will create a special fund to help banks lend money to exporters. The project will also give grants to help businesses and give advice to business owners. It will also help Malawi make export rules stronger and help farmers deal with bad weather.

Gesd 2.0 will help district and city councils use money better. It will give money to councils if they do good work. The project will teach local leaders how to plan, buy things and manage money better. It will also check if people are happy with government services in their towns and villages.

Lawmakers said the money must help people live better lives. They said councils must finish roads and water projects on time. One lawmaker said councils need more engineers, planners and money experts to do good work. MPs also said the government must watch banks that get Thrive money to make sure it goes to real businesses. A civil society leader said the first Gesd project lost about K5 billion because of bad management. He said the new project must teach people to watch councils and stop councils from wasting money. He also said politics must not get in the way of the project.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo Yavomereza Ndalama Zothandizira K229.5 Biliyoni
ny.body: Nyumba Yamalamulo yavomereza ndalama zokwana K229.5 biliyoni kuchokera ku World Bank kuti zithandize Malawi. Ndalamazi zithandiza makhonsolo am'deralo komanso mabizinesi omwe amatumiza katundu kunja. Ndalama ziwirizi ndi K87.5 biliyoni ya Thrive Project ndi K142 biliyoni ya Gesd 2.0 Project. Nduna ya zachuma Joseph Mwanamvekha adati ndalamazi zithandiza Malawi kukula.
ny.body_more:
