Thrive Project ipereka ndalama kwa mabizinesi otumiza kunja ku Malawi. Idzapanga thumba lapadera lothandizira mabanki kubwereketsa ndalama kwa ogulitsa kunja. Ntchitoyi iperekanso ndalama zothandizira mabizinesi ndikupereka upangiri kwa eni mabizinesi. Idzathandizanso Malawi kulimbitsa malamulo otumiza kunja ndikuthandizira alimi kuthana ndi nyengo yoipa.

Gesd 2.0 ithandiza makhonsolo a m'madera ndi m'mizinda kugwiritsa ntchito ndalama bwino. Idzapereka ndalama kwa makhonsolo ngati agwira ntchito yabwino. Ntchitoyi idzaphunzitsa atsogoleri am'deralo momwe angakonzekere, kugula zinthu ndi kusamalira ndalama bwino. Idzawonanso ngati anthu akusangalala ndi ntchito za boma m'matauni ndi m'midzi yawo.

Opanga malamulo adati ndalamazo ziyenera kuthandiza anthu kukhala ndi moyo wabwino. Anati makhonsolo ayenera kumaliza misewu ndi mapulojekiti amadzi panthawi yake. Wopanga malamulo wina adati makhonsolo akufunika mainjiniya ambiri, okonza mapulani ndi akatswiri azachuma kuti agwire ntchito yabwino. Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo adatinso boma liyenera kuyang'anira mabanki omwe amalandira ndalama za Thrive kuti atsimikizire kuti zikupita ku mabizinesi enieni. Mtsogoleri wa mabungwe aboma adati pulojekiti yoyamba ya Gesd idataya pafupifupi K5 biliyoni chifukwa cha kasamalidwe koyipa. Anati pulojekiti yatsopanoyi iyenera kuphunzitsa anthu kuyang'anira makhonsolo ndikuletsa makhonsolo kuti asawononge ndalama. Ananenanso kuti ndale siziyenera kusokoneza polojekitiyi.

en.title: Malawi Scorchers beat Nigeria in first Wafcon game
en.body: Malawi's women's football team beat Nigeria 3-2 on Tuesday night in Morocco. The match was at Al Madina Stadium in Rabat. Sisters Temwa and Tabitha Chawinga scored the winning goals. This was Malawi's first game at the Women's Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon). Nigeria were the defending champions.
en.body_more:
The game was very quiet for 70 minutes with no goals. Then Temwa Chawinga scored in the 73rd minute. Three minutes later, her sister Tabitha scored to make it 2-0. Nigeria came back with a goal from Rasheedat Ajibade from a penalty in the 90th minute plus 2 seconds. But Temwa scored again 3 minutes later to make it 3-1. In the last few minutes, Nigeria's Uchenna Kanu scored a second goal for them. Temwa was named Player of the Match for her two goals.

Coach Lovemore Fazili said his team won because the players believed in themselves. He said they knew they had to work hard for Malawi. Fazili told the news people that the team will not rest now. He said they want to reach the semifinal and play in the World Cup. The Football Association of Malawi President Fleetwood Haiya praised the players for their work and said they must stay focused for the next games.

Malawi is now second in their group, called Group C. Zambia is first because they beat Egypt 6-0 on the same day. Malawi will play Egypt next on Saturday, August 1, 2026, at Moulay Hassan Stadium in Rabat. After that, they will play Zambia on August 5. Coach Fazili said another win could take them to the semifinal. This would be big for Malawi women's football, as this is their first time at the Wafcon finals.

ny.title: Malawi Scorchers yagonjetsa Nigeria pamasewera awo oyamba a Wafcon
ny.body: Timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi idagonjetsa Nigeria 3-2 Lachiwiri usiku ku Morocco. Masewerowa adachitikira ku Al Madina Stadium ku Rabat. Sisters Temwa ndi Tabitha Chawinga adagoletsa zigoli zopambana. Uwu unali masewera oyamba a Malawi ku Women's Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon). Nigeria inali yoteteza ngwazi.
ny.body_more:
Masewerowa anali chete kwa mphindi 70 popanda zigoli. Kenako Temwa Chawinga anagoletsa mu mphindi ya 73. Patatha mphindi zitatu, mlongo wake Tabitha anagoletsa kuti zigoli zifike pa 2-0. Nigeria inabweranso ndi chigoli cha Rasheedat Ajibade kuchokera ku penalty mu mphindi ya 90 kuphatikiza masekondi awiri. Koma Temwa anagoletsanso mu mphindi zitatu kuti zigoli zifike pa 3-1. M'mphindi zochepa zapitazi, Uchenna Kanu wa ku Nigeria anagoletsanso chigoli chachiwiri. Temwa adasankhidwa kukhala Wosewera wa Match chifukwa cha zigoli zake ziwiri.

Mphunzitsi Lovemore Fazili adati timu yake idapambana chifukwa osewerawo adadzidalira. Anati amadziwa kuti ayenera kugwira ntchito mwakhama ku Malawi. Fazili adauza anthu atolankhani kuti timuyi sidzapuma tsopano. Anati akufuna kufika mu semifinal ndikusewera mu World Cup. Purezidenti wa Football Association of Malawi Fleetwood Haiya adayamika osewerawo chifukwa cha ntchito yawo ndipo adati ayenera kukhala osamala pamasewera otsatira.


Malawi tsopano ili pa nambala yachiwiri m'gulu lawo, lotchedwa Gulu C. Zambia ili pa nambala yoyamba chifukwa idagonjetsa Egypt 6-0 tsiku lomwelo. Malawi idzasewera ndi Egypt Loweruka, Ogasiti 1, 2026, pa Moulay Hassan Stadium ku Rabat. Pambuyo pake, idzasewera ndi Zambia pa Ogasiti 5. Mphunzitsi Fazili adati kupambana kwina kungawatengere ku semifinal. Izi zikhala zazikulu pa mpira wa azimayi aku Malawi, chifukwa iyi ndi nthawi yawo yoyamba ku Wafcon finals.

en.title: Government tells bosses: invest in your workers now
en.body: A top government official has told employers across Malawi to invest in their workers. Deputy Chief Secretary Stewart Ligomeka spoke at the Institute of People Management Malawi annual dinner and dance in Blantyre on Friday. He said companies that do not train their staff will fall behind. "Invest," he told business leaders. "It is that simple."
en.body_more:
Ligomeka warned that the world is changing fast. Companies must give workers ongoing training. This is true for all types of training — on-the-job, short-term, or long-term. The rise of artificial intelligence is reshaping industries. Employers who ignore this will lose ground to rivals who invest in their workers.

The government is also creating a new Human Resource Bill. This bill will set rules for how employers treat workers and how human resource workers do their jobs. The bill must go to Cabinet first, then to Parliament for a vote. Employers should get ready for this new law now. They should build better hiring processes and treat staff fairly before the law starts.

Frank Sabola is the president of the Institute of People Management Malawi. He agrees that employers must invest in their workers. But he made an important change to a common saying. "People say people are the greatest asset," he said. "But I say skilled people are the greatest asset." This matters for Malawi. Many businesses struggle to find workers with the right skills. When a company trains its workers, those workers can do bigger jobs, serve more customers, and help the business grow. Sabola said employers should see training as an investment, not a cost. Companies that build up their workers will be stronger and more able to compete in the region.

ny.title: Boma lauza abwana kuti: yika ndalama mu antchito anu tsopano
ny.body: Mkulu wina wa boma wauza olemba ntchito ku Malawi konse kuti azigwiritsa ntchito ndalama zothandizira antchito awo. Wachiwiri kwa Nduna Wamkulu Stewart Ligomeka adalankhula pa chakudya chamadzulo cha pachaka cha Institute of People Management Malawi ku Blantyre Lachisanu. Iye adati makampani omwe saphunzitsa antchito awo adzatsala m'mbuyo. "Ndalama," adatero kwa atsogoleri a mabizinesi. "Ndizosavuta."
ny.body_more:
Ligomeka adachenjeza kuti dziko likusintha mwachangu. Makampani ayenera kupatsa antchito maphunziro opitilira. Izi ndi zoona pa mitundu yonse ya maphunziro - kuntchito, kwakanthawi kochepa, kapena kwa nthawi yayitali. Kukwera kwa luntha lochita kupanga kukukonzanso mafakitale. Olemba ntchito omwe amanyalanyaza izi adzataya mwayi kwa otsutsana nawo omwe amaika ndalama mwa antchito awo.

Boma likupanganso Bili yatsopano ya Human Resource. Bili iyi ikhazikitsa malamulo a momwe olemba ntchito amachitira antchito komanso momwe ogwira ntchito za anthu amachitira ntchito zawo. Biliyi iyenera kupita ku Cabinet kaye, kenako ku Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti ivotedwe. Olemba ntchito ayenera kukonzekera lamulo latsopanoli tsopano. Ayenera kumanga njira zabwino zolembera anthu ntchito ndikuchitira antchito mwachilungamo lamulo lisanayambe.

Frank Sabola ndi purezidenti wa Institute of People Management Malawi. Akuvomereza kuti olemba ntchito ayenera kuyika ndalama mwa antchito awo. Koma adasintha kwambiri kukhala mawu wamba. "Anthu amati anthu ndi chuma chambiri," adatero. "Koma ine ndikuti anthu aluso ndi chuma chambiri." Izi ndizofunikira ku Malawi. Mabizinesi ambiri amavutika kupeza antchito omwe ali ndi luso loyenera. Kampani ikaphunzitsa antchito ake, antchito amenewo amatha kugwira ntchito zazikulu, kutumikira makasitomala ambiri, ndikuthandiza bizinesiyo kukula. Sabola anati olemba ntchito ayenera kuona maphunziro ngati ndalama, osati ndalama. Makampani omwe amalimbitsa antchito awo adzakhala olimba komanso okhoza kupikisana m'derali.

en.title: Malawi opens K35 billion battery power store
en.body: Malawi has opened a new battery energy storage system at Kanengo in Lilongwe. The system cost K35 billion (US$20 million). Minister of Energy Jean Mathanga said it will store solar power and release it when people need it most. The battery will help stop blackouts and make the grid more stable.
en.body_more:
The battery storage system is 20 megawatts in size. It was funded by the Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Geapp). Minister Mathanga said the system will catch solar energy made during the day and release it when electricity demand is highest in the evening. She called it "the shock absorber our national grid has desperately needed."

The battery helps Malawi's long-term plan called Malawi 2063. This plan aims to make Malawi a lower middle income country by 2030 and an upper middle income country by 2063. Stable and cheap power is key to this goal. The Minister asked Escom (the power company) to improve service. She said Escom must connect new customers faster, reduce power losses, and fix problems more quickly.

Escom board member Welford Sabola said the battery will help reach zero load shedding (no blackouts). The system responds in milliseconds to keep the grid stable. It also helps prevent sudden blackouts caused by quick changes in power generation or demand. The battery was damaged after Cyclone Ana hit, and diesel power had to be shut down.

Geapp vice-president Carol Koech said Malawi's project is a model for other African countries. Lessons learned from design, building, and construction will be shared at the Southern Africa Battery Energy Storage System Centre of Excellence at Mzuzu University. Geapp will continue to help Escom under the Grids of the Future programme. This will add digital tools to the grid. A digital map called a digital twin will show Escom exactly where the network is weak and where new investment is needed.

ny.title: Malawi yatsegula sitolo yogulitsira magetsi ya K35 biliyoni
ny.body: Dziko la Malawi latsegula njira yatsopano yosungira mphamvu ya mabatire ku Kanengo ku Lilongwe. Njirayi yawononga ndalama zokwana K35 biliyoni (US$20 miliyoni). Nduna ya Zamagetsi Jean Mathanga yati idzasunga mphamvu ya dzuwa ndikuyitulutsa nthawi iliyonse anthu akaifuna kwambiri. Batireyi ithandiza kuletsa kuzimitsidwa kwa magetsi ndikupangitsa kuti gridi ikhale yokhazikika.
ny.body_more:
Dongosolo losungira mabatire ndi lalikulu ma megawatts 20. Linathandizidwa ndi Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Geapp). Nduna Mathanga anati dongosololi lidzagwira mphamvu ya dzuwa yopangidwa masana ndikuyitulutsa pamene kufunikira kwa magetsi kuli kwakukulu madzulo. Iye anati "choletsa kugwedezeka kwa magetsi chomwe gridi yathu ya dziko lonse yakhala ikufunikira kwambiri."

Batireli limathandiza dongosolo la nthawi yayitali la Malawi lotchedwa Malawi 2063. Dongosololi likufuna kuti Malawi ikhale dziko lotsika la ndalama zapakati pofika chaka cha 2030 komanso dziko lokwera la ndalama zapakati pofika chaka cha 2063. Mphamvu yokhazikika komanso yotsika mtengo ndiyofunika kwambiri pa cholinga ichi. Nduna inapempha Escom (kampani yamagetsi) kuti ikonze ntchito. Inati Escom iyenera kulumikiza makasitomala atsopano mwachangu, kuchepetsa kutayika kwa magetsi, ndikukonza mavuto mwachangu.

Membala wa bungwe la Escom, Welford Sabola, anati batireli lithandiza kufika pa zero load shed (palibe damage). Dongosololi limayankha mu milliseconds kuti gridi ikhale yokhazikika. Limathandizanso kupewa kuzima mwadzidzidzi komwe kumachitika chifukwa cha kusintha kwachangu kwa kupanga magetsi kapena kufunikira. Batireli linawonongeka pambuyo pa kugunda kwa mphepo yamkuntho ya Ana, ndipo mphamvu ya dizilo inayenera kuzimitsidwa.

Wachiwiri kwa purezidenti wa Geapp, Carol Koech, anati pulojekiti ya Malawi ndi chitsanzo cha mayiko ena aku Africa. Maphunziro omwe aphunziridwa kuchokera ku kapangidwe, nyumba, ndi zomangamanga adzagawidwa ku Southern Africa Battery Energy Storage System Centre of Excellence ku Mzuzu University. Geapp ipitiliza kuthandiza Escom pansi pa pulogalamu ya Grids of the Future. Izi ziwonjezera zida za digito ku grid. Mapu a digito otchedwa digital twin adzawonetsa Escom komwe netiweki ili yofooka komanso komwe ndalama zatsopano zimafunikira.

en.title: Rights group warns police and prison staff about detainee abuse
en.body: The Malawi Human Rights Commission (MHRC) says torture still happens in police cells and prisons. MHRC Commissioner Theresa Ndanga spoke in Blantyre on Tuesday. She told police and prison officers that detainees' rights are not being protected. The commission has found many cases of abuse by some officers against people in custody.
en.body_more:
Ndanga said the commission's checks across the country over many years have found torture in prisons. She said this breaks national and international human rights laws. Every person in custody must get humane treatment, she said. Nobody should face torture, no matter what crime they are accused of.

The MHRC held a training workshop on Tuesday to teach police and prison officers about human rights. Irish Rule of Law International helped support the training. The workshop brought together officers from the Malawi Police Service and the Malawi Prison Service from the South and Northern Regions. The training aimed to help officers respect the rights of all people deprived of their liberty.

Vincent Silungwe, a Legal Officer for the Malawi Prison Service, said the training will give officers better knowledge in how to handle detainee issues. He said poor interviewing skills can stop a person from getting a fair trial. Prescort Zuze Mwayiulipo, the Head of Prosecutions in the Malawi Police Service, said the training is important. He said police must stop using torture to investigate crimes.

Ndanga said the MHRC will continue to push for accountability and strict respect for human rights standards in all government institutions. She said this is especially true for places where people are held and detained.

ny.title: Gulu la ufulu wa anthu likuchenjeza apolisi ndi ogwira ntchito kundende za nkhanza zomwe anthu akuchitira akaidi.
ny.body: Bungwe la Malawi Human Rights Commission (MHRC) lati kuzunzidwa kukuchitikabe m'maselo a apolisi ndi m'ndende. Commissioner wa MHRC Theresa Ndanga adalankhula ku Blantyre Lachiwiri. Adauza apolisi ndi akuluakulu a ndende kuti ufulu wa akaidi sukutetezedwa. Bungweli lapeza milandu yambiri yochitira nkhanza anthu omwe ali m'ndende ndi apolisi ena.
ny.body_more:
Ndanga adati macheke a komishoni mdziko lonselo kwa zaka zambiri apeza kuzunzidwa m'ndende. Iye anati izi zikuphwanya malamulo adziko lonse ndi apadziko lonse a ufulu wachibadwidwe. Munthu aliyense amene ali m'ndende ayenera kulandira chithandizo chachifundo, adatero. Palibe amene ayenera kuzunzidwa, mosasamala kanthu za mlandu womwe akuimbidwa.

MHRC idachita msonkhano wophunzitsa Lachiwiri kuti iphunzitse apolisi ndi apolisi a ndende za ufulu wachibadwidwe. Irish Rule of Law International yathandiza kuthandizira maphunzirowa. Msonkhanowu unasonkhanitsa apolisi ochokera ku Malawi Police Service ndi Malawi Prison Service ochokera ku South ndi Northern Regions. Cholinga cha maphunzirowa chinali kuthandiza apolisi kulemekeza ufulu wa anthu onse omwe alibe ufulu wawo.

Vincent Silungwe, Woyang'anira Zamalamulo ku Malawi Prison Service, adati maphunzirowa apatsa apolisi chidziwitso chabwino cha momwe angathanirane ndi nkhani za akaidi. Iye anati luso losakwanira loyankhulana lingathe kuletsa munthu kuti apeze mlandu wolungama. Prescort Zuze Mwayiulipo, Mtsogoleri wa Otsutsa mu Malawi Police Service, adati maphunzirowa ndi ofunikira. Iye adati apolisi ayenera kusiya kugwiritsa ntchito kuzunza pofufuza milandu.

Ndanga adati MHRC ipitiliza kulimbikitsa kuti anthu azitsatira malamulo komanso kulemekeza kwambiri miyezo ya ufulu wa anthu m'mabungwe onse aboma. Iye adati izi ndi zoona makamaka m'malo omwe anthu amamangidwa ndi kumangidwa.

en.title: Malawi Queens lose to Australia at Commonwealth Games
en.body: Malawi Queens lost 68-32 to Australia on Tuesday at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland. This is Malawi's third loss in four games. The Queens must now play Tonga to finish their group matches. They cannot go to the semi-finals. They will play for fifth or sixth place instead.
en.body_more:
Australia is the top-ranked netball team in the world. The defending champions proved too strong for Malawi. By half-time, Australia led 38-13. Malawi could not keep up in the first two quarters. Head Coach Deborah Fuller made one change to the team, bringing in Melia Soko for Mphatso Banda. But this change did not help Malawi.

Malawi played better in the second half. The team scored 10 goals in the third quarter while Australia scored 17. Malawi also lost the final quarter 13-9. Players like shooter Mwawi Kumwenda-M'bwana, goal-attacker Ethel Ng'ambi, and wing-attacker Takondwa Lwazi showed good skill. Lwazi said after the game: "It was a very tough game playing against the number one team. But I am happy we made the gap smaller after trailing by many goals at the start." Malawi scored 32 goals from 38 attempts. This was a good shooting rate against a strong Australian defence.

Malawi is now fourth in their six-team group with two points. They have the same points as Tonga, who is fifth. South Africa leads the group with six points from three wins. Australia has six points too. England has four points. Northern Ireland has zero points after four losses. The match against Tonga will be important for Malawi. A win could help them build momentum in the games. The Queens have never beaten Australia before. Their heaviest loss to Australia was 49 baskets, when they lost 74-25 at the 2019 World Cup.

ny.title: Malawi Queens yagonja ndi Australia pa Masewera a Commonwealth
ny.body: Malawi Queens idagonjetsedwa ndi Australia ndi 68-32 Lachiwiri pa Masewera a Commonwealth ku Glasgow, Scotland. Uku ndi kutayika kwachitatu kwa Malawi m'masewera anayi. Tsopano a Queens ayenera kusewera ndi Tonga kuti amalize masewera awo amagulu. Sangapite ku semi-finals. M'malo mwake adzasewera malo achisanu kapena achisanu ndi chimodzi.
ny.body_more:
Australia ndi timu ya netiboli yapamwamba kwambiri padziko lonse lapansi. Akatswiri oteteza adawonetsa mphamvu kwambiri kuposa Malawi. Pofika nthawi yopuma, Australia idatsogolera 38-13. Malawi sinathe kupitilizabe mu magawo awiri oyamba. Mphunzitsi wamkulu Deborah Fuller adasintha timuyi kamodzi, ndikubweretsa Melia Soko m'malo mwa Mphatso Banda. Koma kusinthaku sikunathandize Malawi.

Malawi idasewera bwino mu theka lachiwiri. Timuyi idagoletsa zigoli 10 mu gawo lachitatu pomwe Australia idagoletsa 17. Malawi idagoletsanso gawo lomaliza 13-9. Osewera monga woponya Mwawi Kumwenda-M'bwana, woponya zigoli Ethel Ng'ambi, ndi woponya zigoli Takondwa Lwazi adawonetsa luso labwino. Lwazi adati pambuyo pa masewerawa: "Unali masewera ovuta kwambiri kusewera ndi timu nambala wani. Koma ndikusangalala kuti tachepetsa kusiyana pambuyo potsatira zigoli zambiri poyamba." Malawi idagoletsa zigoli 32 kuchokera pakuyesera 38. Uwu unali mulingo wabwino woponya zigoli motsutsana ndi chitetezo champhamvu cha Australia.

Malawi tsopano ili pachinayi m'gulu lawo la magulu asanu ndi limodzi ndi mapointi awiri. Ali ndi mapointi ofanana ndi Tonga, yomwe ili pa nambala 5. South Africa ikutsogolera gululi ndi mapointi asanu ndi limodzi kuchokera pa mapointi atatu omwe adapambana. Australia ilinso ndi mapointi asanu ndi limodzi. England ilinso ndi mapointi anayi. Northern Ireland ilibe mapointi anayi pambuyo pa mapointi anayi omwe adataya. Masewerawa ndi Tonga adzakhala ofunikira kwa Malawi. Kupambana kungathandize kulimbitsa mphamvu zawo pamasewerawa. A Queens sanagonjetsepo Australia kale. Kutayika kwawo kwakukulu kwa Australia kunali madengu 49, pomwe adataya 74-25 pa World Cup ya 2019.

en.title: Minister Chipungu tells CDEDI: Retract claims or face court
en.body: The Minister of Lands Chimwemwe Chipungu has given CDEDI 48 hours to take back statements made on 27 July. CDEDI accused the minister of buying seven vehicles worth K2.8 billion and building a hotel. Chipungu's lawyer Khwima Mchizi demanded an apology. CDEDI head Sylvester Namiwa said he will not retract anything.
en.body_more:
CDEDI also claimed the minister was involved in land sales linked to ADL. Chipungu denies all the charges. Through his lawyer, he says he bought only two vehicles since becoming an MP. Both were paid for with bank loans from NBS Bank and FDH Bank. The loans are available to all MPs.

About the hotel, Chipungu says he has run a hospitality business since 2016. This was before he became minister. The hotel work is also financed through a loan from FDH Bank. On the land issue, the minister's lawyers say Chipungu is not involved in selling or giving ADL plots to anyone. His job as minister does not include this work.

Namiwa was asked if he had proof for his claims. He said he had no evidence now. He said he would try to find proof if the minister takes him to court. The lawyer's letter gives CDEDI 48 hours to apologise and publish a retraction. If CDEDI does not obey, Chipungu will begin legal action. Namiwa has not yet answered the demand letter. Legal experts say this case may become a big court fight about defamation law and the right to question how much money public workers have.

ny.title: Nduna Chipungu akuuza CDEDI kuti: Tulutsani madandaulo kapena apite kukhoti
ny.body: Nduna ya Zamalo Chimwemwe Chipungu yapatsa CDEDI maola 48 kuti ibweze zomwe inanena pa 27 Julayi. CDEDI yadzudzula ndunayo chifukwa chogula magalimoto asanu ndi awiri amtengo wa K2.8 biliyoni ndikumanga hotelo. Loya wa Chipungu Khwima Mchizi adapempha kuti apepese. Mtsogoleri wa CDEDI Sylvester Namiwa adati sadzabweza chilichonse.
ny.body_more:
CDEDI inanenanso kuti ndunayo inali ndi gawo pa malonda a malo okhudzana ndi ADL. Chipungu akukana milandu yonse. Kudzera mwa loya wake, akuti adagula magalimoto awiri okha kuyambira pomwe adakhala MP. Onse awiri adalipira ndi ngongole za banki kuchokera ku NBS Bank ndi FDH Bank. Ngongolezo zilipo kwa aphungu onse.

Ponena za hoteloyi, Chipungu akuti wakhala akuchita bizinesi yochereza alendo kuyambira 2016. Izi zinali asanakhale nduna. Ntchito ya hoteloyi imathandizidwanso kudzera mu ngongole kuchokera ku FDH Bank. Pankhani ya malo, maloya a ndunayo akuti Chipungu sakuchita nawo kugulitsa kapena kupereka malo a ADL kwa aliyense. Ntchito yake monga nduna sikuphatikiza ntchito imeneyi.

Namiwa adafunsidwa ngati ali ndi umboni wa zomwe akunena. Anati alibe umboni tsopano. Anati ayesa kupeza umboni ngati ndunayo ikamutengera kukhothi. Kalata ya loyayo imapatsa CDEDI maola 48 kuti apepese ndikufalitsa chikalata chokana. Ngati CDEDI samvera, Chipungu ayamba kuchitapo kanthu kukhothi. Namiwa sanayankhebe kalata yopempha. Akatswiri azamalamulo akuti nkhaniyi ikhoza kukhala mkangano waukulu kukhothi wokhudza lamulo lonyoza anthu komanso ufulu wofunsa kuti antchito aboma ali ndi ndalama zingati.

en.title: Malawi women's football team starts WAFCON tournament
en.body: Two winners of an NBM bank promotion, Charles Msatiyenda and Halima Mangani, flew to Morocco on Sunday to watch Malawi's women's football team play Nigeria. The team, called the Scorchers, will play their first match on Tuesday at Al Madina Stadium in Rabat. This is Malawi's first time in the Women's Africa Cup of Nations tournament.
en.body_more:
Mangani was happy to travel to Morocco. She said NBM bank kept its promise to give the winners this prize. "When the Scorchers see us with our flag, it will help them want to win," she said. She asked all people in Malawi to keep helping the team.

NBM bank said it is glad to help women's football in Malawi. The bank's manager Akossa Mphepo-Hiwa said the winners will give the players courage in the match against Nigeria.

The Scorchers' coach is Lovemore Fazili. He said his team did not come to lose. "We are here to fight," he said. He said small teams can sometimes beat big teams. Nigeria are the defending champions and have won WAFCON ten times. But Fazili said Malawi can surprise them. "After 90 minutes there will be something good," he said.

Scorchers captain Tabitha Chawinga said the match is equal chances for both teams. "Nigeria is good, and Malawi is good too, because we qualified," she said. The team will play with sisters Tabitha and Temwa Chawinga. Nigeria's coach Justine Madungu said he does not take Malawi lightly. "They are debutants but very good. We have respect for them," he said. Nigeria beat Senegal 2-1 and 3-0 before coming here. Malawi lost to Morocco 2-1 and Ghana 4-0. Group C also has Egypt and Zambia.

ny.title: Timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi yayamba mpikisano wa WAFCON
ny.body: Anthu awiri opambana mpikisano wa banki ya NBM, Charles Msatiyenda ndi Halima Mangani, adapita ku Morocco Lamlungu kukaonera timu ya mpira wa azimayi ku Malawi ikusewera ndi Nigeria. Timuyi, yotchedwa Scorchers, idzasewera masewera awo oyamba Lachiwiri ku Al Madina Stadium ku Rabat. Iyi ndi nthawi yoyamba ya Malawi mu mpikisano wa Women's Africa Cup of Nations.
ny.body_more:
Mangani anali wokondwa kupita ku Morocco. Iye anati banki ya NBM yasunga lonjezo lake lopatsa opambana mphoto iyi. "A Scorchers akadzationa ndi mbendera yathu, zidzawathandiza kufuna kupambana," iye anatero. Iye anapempha anthu onse ku Malawi kuti apitirize kuthandiza timuyi.

Banki ya NBM inati ikusangalala kuthandiza mpira wa azimayi ku Malawi. Woyang'anira bankiyo Akossa Mphepo-Hiwa anati opambanawo adzapatsa osewerawo kulimba mtima pamasewera olimbana ndi Nigeria.

Mphunzitsi wa Scorchers ndi Lovemore Fazili. Iye anati timu yake sinagonje. "Tili pano kuti timenye nkhondo," iye anatero. Iye anati magulu ang'onoang'ono nthawi zina amatha kupambana magulu akuluakulu. Nigeria ndi omwe akuteteza ndipo apambana WAFCON kakhumi. Koma Fazili anati Malawi ikhoza kuwadabwitsa. "Pakatha mphindi 90 padzakhala chinthu chabwino," iye anatero.

Kaputeni wa Scorchers Tabitha Chawinga anati masewerawa ndi ofanana kwa magulu onse awiri. "Nigeria ndi yabwino, ndipo Malawi nayonso ndi yabwino, chifukwa tinayenerera," iye anatero. Gululi lidzasewera ndi alongo ake aakazi Tabitha ndi Temwa Chawinga. Mphunzitsi wa Nigeria Justine Madungu anati satenga Malawi mopepuka. "Ndi osewera oyamba koma ndi abwino kwambiri. Timawalemekeza," adatero. Nigeria idagonjetsa Senegal 2-1 ndi 3-0 isanabwere kuno. Malawi idagonjetsedwa ndi Morocco 2-1 ndipo Ghana 4-0. Gulu C lilinso ndi Egypt ndi Zambia.

en.title: Chihana to represent Malawi at SADC summit
en.body: President Peter Mutharika will not go to the 46th SADC summit. Second Vice-President Enoch Chihana will go instead. The summit is in Durban, South Africa. It will happen on August 17. Minister George Chaponda told the news this yesterday.
en.body_more:
Chihana will speak for Malawi at the meeting of regional leaders. SADC is the Southern African Development Community. This is Chihana's third time to represent the President since June. On June 29, he went to an Extraordinary SADC summit. On June 22, he led a meeting in Lilongwe.

The SADC summit this year will talk about industry, building, farming, and minerals. The theme is "Resilient, sustainable and inclusive industrialisation through infrastructure development, agricultural and critical minerals transformation in pursuit of a just world." Leaders from the region will meet to discuss big plans for Southern Africa.

Some people question why Chihana represents the President so much. First Vice-President Jane Ansah has not been given these tasks. One lawyer says this may break the Constitution. The Constitution says the President can give tasks to his deputies. But people want to know why the President picks Chihana more than Ansah. Last week, Chihana led a Cabinet meeting in Lilongwe. Ansah was not asked to join. The government says the President can choose who does his work. But officials have not explained why Chihana is chosen more often.

The Pattern has made people ask questions about how the President and his two deputies work together. Opposition leaders and others want more information. The government has not made a full statement about these choices. Chihana's delegation will leave for Durban in the coming days.

ny.title: Chihana adzayimilira Malawi pa msonkhano wa SADC
ny.body: Purezidenti Peter Mutharika sadzapita ku msonkhano wa 46 wa SADC. Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Enoch Chihana adzapita m'malo mwake. Msonkhanowu udzachitikira ku Durban, South Africa. Uchitika pa 17 Ogasiti. Nduna George Chaponda idauza nkhaniyi dzulo.
ny.body_more:
Chihana adzalankhula m'malo mwa Malawi pamsonkhano wa atsogoleri a chigawo. SADC ndi bungwe la Southern African Development Community. Iyi ndi nthawi yachitatu Chihana kuyimira Purezidenti kuyambira June. Pa June 29, adapita ku msonkhano wapadera wa SADC. Pa June 22, adatsogolera msonkhano ku Lilongwe.

Msonkhano wa SADC chaka chino udzakambirana za mafakitale, zomangamanga, ulimi, ndi mchere. Mutu wake ndi "Kukhazikitsa mafakitale olimba, okhazikika komanso ophatikizana kudzera mu chitukuko cha zomangamanga, ulimi ndi kusintha kwa mchere wofunikira pofuna dziko lolungama." Atsogoleri ochokera m'chigawochi adzakumana kuti akambirane mapulani akuluakulu a Southern Africa.

Anthu ena amafunsa chifukwa chake Chihana akuyimira Purezidenti kwambiri. Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah sanapatsidwe ntchitozi. Loya wina akuti izi zitha kuswa Malamulo Oyendetsera Dziko. Malamulo Oyendetsera Dziko amati Purezidenti akhoza kupereka ntchito kwa aphungu ake. Koma anthu akufuna kudziwa chifukwa chake Purezidenti amasankha Chihana kuposa Ansah. Sabata yatha, Chihana adatsogolera msonkhano wa Cabinet ku Lilongwe. Ansah sanapemphedwe kuti alowe nawo. Boma limati Purezidenti akhoza kusankha amene amachita ntchito yake. Koma akuluakulu sanafotokoze chifukwa chake Chihana amasankhidwa nthawi zambiri.

Chitsanzochi chapangitsa anthu kufunsa mafunso okhudza momwe Purezidenti ndi aphungu ake awiri amagwirira ntchito limodzi. Atsogoleri otsutsa ndi ena akufuna kudziwa zambiri. Boma silinanene chilichonse chokhudza zisankhozi. Gulu la a Chihana lipita ku Durban masiku akubwerawa.

en.title: MCP leaders fight over who leads the party next
en.body: The Malawi Congress Party (MCP) is split. Alex Major wants an emergency meeting to choose new leaders. He says the party must not change its rules to keep President Lazarus Chakwera. Other MCP leaders say Chakwera should stay until 2029.
en.body_more:
Major leads one group in the party. He says changing the MCP constitution to help one person would damage the party. A constitution is the set of rules that govern an organisation. Major insists the next party meeting must allow all members to contest for the top job. This fight started after MCP lost the general election on 16 September 2025.

Some MCP leaders support Chakwera staying on. Lilongwe lawmaker Lawrence Chakakala Chaziya held a rally at Malembo Primary School grounds on Sunday. He said Chakwera should lead until 2029. "One president sits on the throne at once," Chaziya told the crowd. He said Secretary General Richard Chimwendo Banda, Director of Youth Steven Malondera, and National Campaign Director Moses Kunkuyu should also stay in their jobs. Malondera said Chakwera was rebuilding the party to win the 2030 election.

Political experts say the debate is about following the party's rules. Boniface Dulani, a university teacher, said term limits stop leaders from staying too long. "If Chakwera's terms have expired, the fair thing is for him to step aside," Dulani said. Dennis Nathumba, a senior MCP member from the South, recalled that John Tembo tried to get a third term in 2013 but the party rejected it. A court recently told MCP to hold elections for district and regional leaders within 12 months. This will change who votes at the next party convention.

ny.title: Atsogoleri a MCP akukangana kuti ndani atsogolere chipani chotsatira
ny.body: Chipani cha Malawi Congress Party (MCP) chagawanika. Alex Major akufuna msonkhano wadzidzidzi kuti asankhe atsogoleri atsopano. Iye akuti chipanicho sichiyenera kusintha malamulo ake kuti Purezidenti Lazarus Chakwera apitirize kukhalapo. Atsogoleri ena a MCP akuti Chakwera ayenera kukhalapo mpaka chaka cha 2029.
ny.body_more:
Major akutsogolera gulu limodzi m'chipani. Iye akuti kusintha malamulo a MCP kuti athandize munthu mmodzi kungawononge chipani. Malamulo ndi malamulo omwe amalamulira bungwe. Major akuumirira kuti msonkhano wotsatira wa chipani uyenera kulola mamembala onse kupikisana paudindo wapamwamba. Mkanganowu unayamba pambuyo poti MCP yataya chisankho chachikulu pa 16 Seputembala 2025.

Atsogoleri ena a MCP akuchirikiza Chakwera kuti apitirize. Wopanga malamulo ku Lilongwe Lawrence Chakakala Chaziya adachita msonkhano ku Malembo Primary School Lamlungu. Iye anati Chakwera ayenera kutsogolera mpaka 2029. "Purezidenti m'modzi amakhala pampando nthawi yomweyo," Chaziya adauza khamulo. Iye adati Mlembi Wamkulu Richard Chimwendo Banda, Mtsogoleri wa Achinyamata Steven Malondera, ndi Mtsogoleri wa National Campaign Moses Kunkuyu nawonso ayenera kukhala pantchito zawo. Malondera adati Chakwera akumanganso chipani kuti chipambane chisankho cha 2030.

Akatswiri andale amati mkanganowu ndi wokhudza kutsatira malamulo a chipani. Boniface Dulani, mphunzitsi wa yunivesite, adati malire a nthawi amaletsa atsogoleri kukhala nthawi yayitali. "Ngati nthawi ya Chakwera yatha, ndiye kuti akuyenera kusiya," adatero Dulani. Dennis Nathumba, membala wamkulu wa MCP wochokera Kum'mwera, adakumbukira kuti John Tembo adayesa kupeza nthawi yachitatu mu 2013 koma chipanicho chidakana. Posachedwapa khothi lidauza MCP kuti ichite zisankho za atsogoleri a zigawo ndi zigawo mkati mwa miyezi 12. Izi zisintha omwe adzavote pamsonkhano wotsatira wa chipani.

en.title: More than half of Malawi workers not fully used
en.body: The World Bank says more than half of Malawi's workers are not fully used. Nearly one in five people have no job. The bank says this slows down the country's growth. Most jobs in Malawi are informal. An informal job is work with no contract or protection.
en.body_more:
The World Bank found that 55 percent of workers are underused. Unemployment is at 19 percent. About 91 percent of all jobs are informal. The bank warns that more pressure is coming. Four in ten people in Malawi are below 14 years old. These young people will look for jobs soon.

Businesses face many hard problems. Electricity is not reliable. Foreign exchange is hard to find. Foreign exchange is money from other countries. High costs make it hard to do business. The Malawi Confederation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry asked businesses what troubles them. Almost three in four firms said foreign exchange shortages are their biggest problem. Seven in ten said inflation hurts them. More than half said rising costs of materials hurt them.

Most firms are not using their full power. More than half of all companies work at less than half their capacity. Only one in ten work at more than three quarters of their capacity. Lucky Mfungwe is the director of business environment at the Confederation. He said on Monday that these problems weaken private sector confidence. Simon Itaye is Minister of Industrialisation, Business, Trade and Tourism. He said the government will strengthen local industries and reduce dependence on imports.

World Bank data show weak investment. Over five years, total investment was only 15 percent of the country's total output. Other countries in the region invest more than 23 percent. Private investment was only 9 percent. This fall in private investment undermines job creation and economic growth.

ny.title: Ogwira ntchito oposa theka la Malawi sanagwiritsidwe ntchito mokwanira
ny.body: Banki Yapadziko Lonse ikunena kuti antchito oposa theka la Malawi sagwiritsidwa ntchito mokwanira. Pafupifupi munthu m'modzi mwa asanu aliwonse alibe ntchito. Bankiyo ikunena kuti izi zikuchedwetsa kukula kwa dzikolo. Ntchito zambiri ku Malawi sizili zovomerezeka. Ntchito yosavomerezeka ndi ntchito yopanda pangano kapena chitetezo.
ny.body_more:
Banki Yapadziko Lonse yapeza kuti 55 peresenti ya antchito sagwiritsidwa ntchito mokwanira. Ulova uli pa 19 peresenti. Pafupifupi 91 peresenti ya ntchito zonse ndi zosavomerezeka. Bankiyo ikuchenjeza kuti mavuto ambiri akubwera. Anthu anayi pa khumi ku Malawi ali ndi zaka zosakwana 14. Achinyamata awa adzafunafuna ntchito posachedwa.

Mabizinesi akukumana ndi mavuto ambiri ovuta. Magetsi si odalirika. Kusinthana kwa ndalama zakunja n'kovuta kupeza. Kusinthana kwa ndalama zakunja ndi ndalama zochokera kumayiko ena. Mitengo yokwera imapangitsa kuti zikhale zovuta kuchita bizinesi. Bungwe la Malawi Confederation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry linafunsa mabizinesi zomwe zimawavutitsa. Pafupifupi makampani atatu pa anayi anati kusowa kwa ndalama zakunja ndiye vuto lawo lalikulu. Asanu ndi awiri pa khumi anati kukwera kwa mitengo ya zinthu kumawavutitsa. Oposa theka akuti kukwera kwa mitengo ya zipangizo kumawavutitsa.

Makampani ambiri sakugwiritsa ntchito mphamvu zawo zonse. Makampani oposa theka amagwira ntchito yochepera theka la mphamvu zawo. Mmodzi yekha pa khumi amagwira ntchito yoposa magawo atatu mwa anayi a mphamvu zawo. Lucky Mfungwe ndiye director wa zachitukuko cha bizinesi ku Confederation. Iye anati Lolemba kuti mavutowa amafooketsa chidaliro cha makampani achinsinsi. Simon Itaye ndi Nduna ya Zamalonda, Bizinesi, Zamalonda ndi Zokopa alendo. Iye anati boma lidzalimbitsa mafakitale am'deralo ndikuchepetsa kudalira zinthu zochokera kunja.

Zambiri za Banki Yadziko Lonse zikuwonetsa kuti ndalama zoyambira kuyikamo ndalama sizili bwino. Kwa zaka zisanu, ndalama zonse zomwe zayikidwa zinali 15 peresenti yokha ya ndalama zonse zomwe dzikolo lapanga. Mayiko ena m'chigawochi amaikamo ndalama zoposa 23 peresenti. Ndalama zomwe zayikidwa payokha zinali 9 peresenti yokha. Kutsika kumeneku kwa ndalama zomwe zayikidwa payokha kumawononga kupanga ntchito ndi kukula kwachuma.

en.title: Minister says donors still help Malawi with money
en.body: Finance Minister Joseph Mwanamvekha said on Saturday that Malawi will keep getting money from donors. He spoke in Lilongwe at a church event. The minister said some donors are giving less money, but others are giving more. He said Malawi got $900 million from the United States and will get more from the World Bank.
en.body_more:
Mwanamvekha made his words at the launch of the Tiyende Limodzi Endowment Fund for the Catholic Archdiocese of Lilongwe. He said: "Some partners are reducing support, but others are increasing it. Donors are not withdrawing; they are reallocating their investments. Malawi will continue receiving support, and even more than before."

The minister spoke after the United Kingdom said it will cut its aid to Malawi by 60 percent in 2026/27. The cuts will grow to 90 percent by 2028/29. Aid is money a rich country gives to a poor country to help it. Mwanamvekha said Malawi has already secured more than $900 million from the United States under the America First Global Health Strategy. He said the World Bank and the African Development Bank will also give money soon.

Phillip Madinga is the chairperson of the endowment fund and chief of Standard Bank Malawi. He said Malawi must depend less on foreign aid. "Recent reductions in donor funding show it is time for Malawi to become more self-reliant and develop home-grown solutions," he said.

The endowment fund aims to raise K10 billion. Investment returns is money made from putting money in a bank or business. The fund will use investment returns to pay for education, healthcare and community work. The church event raised K118 million in cash and promises. An earlier Mass raised K43 million. President Peter Mutharika gave K25 million, and Mwanamvekha gave K15 million. The Archdiocese of Lilongwe serves about 1.7 million Catholics through 52 churches and runs more than 300 schools.

ny.title: Nduna yati opereka ndalama akuthandizabe Malawi ndi ndalama
ny.body: Nduna ya zachuma Joseph Mwanamvekha adati Loweruka kuti Malawi ipitiliza kulandira ndalama kuchokera kwa opereka ndalama. Iye adalankhula ku Lilongwe pamwambo wa tchalitchi. Ndunayo idati opereka ndalama ena akupereka ndalama zochepa, koma ena akupereka zambiri. Iye adati Malawi yalandira $900 miliyoni kuchokera ku United States ndipo ipeza zambiri kuchokera ku World Bank.
ny.body_more:
Mwanamvekha adalankhula mawu ake pa kukhazikitsidwa kwa Tiyende Limodzi Endowment Fund ya Archdiocese ya Katolika ku Lilongwe. Iye anati: "Ogwirizana ena akuchepetsa thandizo, koma ena akuliwonjezera. Opereka ndalama sakuchoka; akusamutsa ndalama zawo. Malawi ipitiliza kulandira thandizo, komanso kuposa kale."

Ndunayi idalankhula pambuyo poti United Kingdom yanena kuti ichepetsa thandizo lake ku Malawi ndi 60 peresenti mu 2026/27. Kuchepetsa kumeneku kudzakula kufika pa 90 peresenti pofika 2028/29. Thandizo ndi ndalama zomwe dziko lolemera limapereka kudziko losauka kuti lilithandize. Mwanamvekha adati Malawi yapeza kale ndalama zoposa $900 miliyoni kuchokera ku United States pansi pa America First Global Health Strategy. Iye adati World Bank ndi African Development Bank nawonso apereka ndalama posachedwa.

Phillip Madinga ndiye wapampando wa thumba la ndalama komanso mkulu wa Standard Bank Malawi. Iye adati Malawi sayenera kudalira thandizo lakunja. "Kuchepa kwa ndalama zothandizira opereka ndalama posachedwapa kukusonyeza kuti nthawi yakwana yoti Malawi ikhale yodzidalira kwambiri ndikupanga njira zothetsera mavuto m'dziko," adatero.

Cholinga cha ndalama zothandizira ndalama ndi kupeza K10 biliyoni. Ndalama zomwe zasungidwa ndi ndalama zomwe zasungidwa ndi banki kapena bizinesi. Ndalamazi zidzagwiritsa ntchito ndalama zomwe zasungidwa kuti zilipire maphunziro, chisamaliro chaumoyo komanso ntchito za anthu ammudzi. Chochitika cha tchalitchichi chinapeza K118 miliyoni monga ndalama ndi malonjezo. Misa yapitayi inapeza K43 miliyoni. Purezidenti Peter Mutharika anapereka K25 miliyoni, ndipo Mwanamvekha anapereka K15 miliyoni. Archdiocese ya Lilongwe imatumikira Akatolika pafupifupi 1.7 miliyoni kudzera m'matchalitchi 52 ndipo imayendetsa masukulu opitilira 300.

en.title: MP Questions Why First Vice President Did Not Chair Cabinet
en.body: Member of Parliament Joshua Malango asked why First Vice President Jane Ansah did not chair a Cabinet meeting in Lilongwe. President Peter Mutharika had gone to Blantyre. Second Vice President Enoch Chihana chaired the meeting instead. Malango raised the question in Parliament under Standing Order 69.
en.body_more:
Malango asked the government to explain the law that allowed this. He said Ansah was elected with the President. He wanted to know why she did not chair the meeting. The Minister of Justice has not yet answered.

Chief Secretary to Government Justin Saidi said the President can choose either vice president to chair a Cabinet meeting. He said the law allows the President to delegate the Second Vice President. He also said the law allows the President to delegate the First Vice President. When asked why Ansah was not at the meeting, Saidi said he did not know. He told people to ask Ansah's office.

The government said President Mutharika told Chihana to chair the Cabinet meeting while Mutharika did other government work in Blantyre. The government said this follows Section 92(3) of the Constitution. This section says the President chairs Cabinet meetings. It says the First Vice President chairs if the President is away for a short time. It says the Second Vice President chairs if both the President and First Vice President are away.

Speaker of Parliament Sameer Suleman said this is an internal government matter. He told Malango to follow the correct Parliament procedures. He said the government is a machine and knows what it does.

ny.title: MP Akufunsa Chifukwa Chake Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Sanakhale Mtsogoleri wa Bungwe la Nduna
ny.body: Mphungu wa Nyumba Yamalamulo Joshua Malango anafunsa chifukwa chake Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah sanatsogolere msonkhano wa nduna ku Lilongwe. Purezidenti Peter Mutharika anapita ku Blantyre. Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Enoch Chihana ndiye anatsogoza msonkhanowo. Malango anafunsa funsoli mu Nyumba Yamalamulo motsatira Standing Order 69.
ny.body_more:
Malango anafunsa boma kuti lifotokoze lamulo lomwe linalola izi. Anati Ansah anasankhidwa ndi Purezidenti. Anafuna kudziwa chifukwa chake sanatsogolere msonkhanowo. Nduna ya Zachilungamo sinayankhebe.

Mlembi Wamkulu wa Boma Justin Saidi anati Purezidenti akhoza kusankha wachiwiri kwa purezidenti kuti atsogolere msonkhano wa Kabungwe. Anati lamuloli limalola Purezidenti kupatsa Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti udindo. Anatinso lamuloli limalola Purezidenti kupatsa Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti udindo. Atafunsidwa chifukwa chake Ansah sanali pamsonkhanowo, Saidi anati sakudziwa. Anauza anthu kuti afunse ofesi ya Ansah.

Boma linati Purezidenti Mutharika anauza Chihana kuti atsogolere msonkhano wa Kabungwe pomwe Mutharika ankagwira ntchito zina za boma ku Blantyre. Boma linati izi zikutsatira Gawo 92(3) la Malamulo Oyendetsera Dziko. Gawoli limati Purezidenti ndiye amatsogolera misonkhano ya Kabungwe. Limati Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti amakhala pampando ngati Purezidenti ali kutali kwa kanthawi kochepa. Limati Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti amakhala pampando ngati Purezidenti ndi Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti ali kutali.

Sipika wa Nyumba Yamalamulo Sameer Suleman anati iyi ndi nkhani yamkati mwa boma. Iye anauza Malango kuti atsatire njira zoyenera za Nyumba Yamalamulo. Iye anati boma ndi makina ndipo likudziwa zomwe limachita.

en.title: Minister Phiri says market investments help councils earn money
en.body: Minister of Local Government Ben Phiri says Malawi is moving power and money from central government to local councils. He told Parliament that councils will now plan and run their own projects based on what their communities need. Phiri said investments in modern markets will help councils make more money to pay for local services.
en.body_more:
Speaking after a parliamentary sitting, Phiri said the government has moved resources back to councils. Central government will now give advice and set policies only. Councils will identify and prioritise development projects themselves, not wait for central government to decide.

Phiri dismissed reports that councils are slow to process Constituency Development Fund (CDF) projects and Malawi Enterprise Development Fund (MEDF) loans. CDF is money the government gives to councils for local projects. MEDF is money for young people and women to start businesses. Mchinji South MP Owen Malijani had said communities are waiting for these projects and loans while councils struggle to hire enough workers or process paperwork. But Phiri said councils have good plans and processes are moving forward smoothly.

Phiri said some councils are close to hiring contractors for CDF work. Lilongwe District Council has already opened documents showing who wants to bid for projects and is near the stage of choosing winners. He said the government has given councils 20 percent of contractor fees to start construction before all paperwork is done. On staffing, Phiri said the situation has got better over nine months. All council offices now have trained workers. The government has sent qualified engineers and chief procurement officers to all councils across the country to make CDF project work stronger. He said the government will hire more council workers and that the Ministry of Local Government is working with MEDF to help youth and women's groups get loans faster.

ny.title: Nduna Phiri yati ndalama zomwe zimayikidwa pamsika zimathandiza makhonsolo kupeza ndalama
ny.body: Nduna ya Boma la Madera Ben Phiri akuti Malawi ikusuntha mphamvu ndi ndalama kuchokera ku boma lalikulu kupita ku makhonsolo am'deralo. Iye adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti makhonsolo tsopano akukonzekera ndikuyendetsa mapulojekiti awo kutengera zomwe madera awo akufunikira. Phiri adati ndalama zomwe zimayikidwa m'misika yamakono zithandiza makhonsolo kupeza ndalama zambiri zolipirira ntchito za m'deralo.
ny.body_more:
Polankhula pambuyo pa msonkhano wa nyumba yamalamulo, Phiri anati boma lasamutsa ndalama ku makhonsolo. Boma lapakati tsopano lipereka upangiri ndikukhazikitsa mfundo zokha. Makhonsolo azizindikira ndikuyika patsogolo mapulojekiti otukuka okha, osati kudikira kuti boma lapakati lisankhe.

Phiri adakana malipoti akuti makhonsolo akuchedwa kukonza mapulojekiti a Constituency Development Fund (CDF) ndi ngongole za Malawi Enterprise Development Fund (MEDF). CDF ndi ndalama zomwe boma limapereka ku makhonsolo a mapulojekiti am'deralo. MEDF ndi ndalama za achinyamata ndi akazi kuti ayambe mabizinesi. MP wa Mchinji South, Owen Malijani, adati madera akuyembekezera mapulojekiti ndi ngongolezi pomwe makhonsolo akuvutika kulemba antchito okwanira kapena kukonza mapepala. Koma Phiri adati makhonsolo ali ndi mapulani abwino ndipo njira zikuyenda bwino.

Phiri adati makhonsolo ena ali pafupi kulemba makontrakitala ntchito za CDF. Khonsolo ya Lilongwe District yatsegula kale zikalata zosonyeza omwe akufuna kupereka mapulojekiti ndipo ali pafupi kusankha opambana. Anati boma lapatsa makhonsolo 20 peresenti ya ndalama zolipirira makontrakitala kuti ayambe kumanga mapepala onse asanamalize. Pankhani yokhudza antchito, Phiri adati zinthu zayamba bwino patatha miyezi isanu ndi inayi. Maofesi onse a khonsolo tsopano ali ndi antchito ophunzitsidwa bwino. Boma latumiza mainjiniya oyenerera ndi akuluakulu oyang'anira kugula zinthu ku makhonsolo onse mdziko lonse kuti ntchito ya CDF igwire bwino ntchito. Iye anati boma lidzalemba ntchito antchito ambiri a khonsolo ndipo Unduna wa Zaboma Zam'deralo ukugwira ntchito ndi MEDF kuti uthandize magulu a achinyamata ndi azimayi kupeza ngongole mwachangu.

en.title: Cabinet meeting: Vice-President Ansah was not invited
en.body: Second Vice-President Enoch Chihana chaired a Cabinet meeting in Lilongwe on Monday. President Peter Mutharika was in Blantyre. First Vice-President Jane Ansah was at her office but was not invited to the meeting. The Chief Secretary said the President can choose who chairs Cabinet.
en.body_more:
Jane Ansah confirmed to the Daily Times that she was not invited. While the meeting happened, she posted a video at Capitol Hill. She said: "Mondays are exciting to be in office." Chief Secretary Justin Saidi said the law allows the President to pick either Vice-President to chair Cabinet. But Saidi said he did not know why Ansah was not invited.

Lawyer Seodi White said the meeting broke the Constitution. Section 92(3) of the Constitution says the First Vice-President must chair Cabinet when the President is away. The Second Vice-President can only chair when both the President and First Vice-President are away. White said: "A Cabinet meeting chaired by someone who has no power to preside is wrong." White warned that decisions made at the meeting could be cancelled by courts.

In Parliament, Dedza Kasina MP Joshua Malango asked why Ansah was left out. He said: "Why is the Vice-President, who was elected with the President, not chairing the meeting?" Speaker Sameer Suleman said this was an internal government matter. Earlier in June, Chihana chaired two SADC meetings for the President. Some people questioned why Education Minister Bright Msaka, not a Vice-President, represented the President at the unveiling of former Vice-President Saulos Chilima's mausoleum in Nsipe, Ntcheu, even though both Ansah and Chihana were there.

ny.title: Msonkhano wa nduna: Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Ansah sanaitanidwe
ny.body: Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Enoch Chihana ndiye anatsogolera msonkhano wa nduna ku Lilongwe Lolemba. Purezidenti Peter Mutharika anali ku Blantyre. Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah anali ku ofesi yake koma sanaitanidwe ku msonkhanowo. Mlembi Wamkulu anati Purezidenti akhoza kusankha amene akutsogolera nduna.
ny.body_more:
Jane Ansah adatsimikizira ku Daily Times kuti sanaitanidwe. Pamene msonkhanowo unkachitika, adayika kanema ku Capitol Hill. Iye anati: "Lolemba ndi zosangalatsa kukhala paudindo." Mlembi Wamkulu Justin Saidi adati lamulo limalola Purezidenti kusankha Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti kuti akhale mtsogoleri wa nduna. Koma Saidi adati sakudziwa chifukwa chake Ansah sanaitanidwe.

Loya Seodi White adati msonkhanowo unaswa Malamulo Oyendetsera Dziko. Gawo 92(3) la Malamulo Oyendetsera Dziko limati Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti ayenera kukhala mtsogoleri wa nduna pamene Purezidenti ali kutali. Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti akhoza kukhala mtsogoleri pokhapokha Purezidenti ndi Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti ali kutali. White adati: "Msonkhano wa nduna womwe umatsogozedwa ndi munthu yemwe alibe mphamvu zotsogolera ndi wolakwika." White adachenjeza kuti zisankho zomwe zapangidwa pamsonkhanowu zitha kuthetsedwa ndi makhothi.

Mu Nyumba Yamalamulo, MP wa Dedza Kasina Joshua Malango adafunsa chifukwa chake Ansah sanatchulidwe. Iye adati: "N'chifukwa chiyani Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti, yemwe adasankhidwa ndi Purezidenti, sakutsogolera msonkhanowo?" Wokamba nkhani Sameer Suleman adati iyi ndi nkhani yamkati mwa boma. Kumayambiriro kwa mwezi wa June, Chihana adatsogolera misonkhano iwiri ya SADC ya Purezidenti. Anthu ena anafunsa chifukwa chake Nduna ya Maphunziro Bright Msaka, osati Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti, anayimira Purezidenti pa mwambo wovumbulutsa manda a Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Saulos Chilima ku Nsipe, Ntcheu, ngakhale kuti Ansah ndi Chihana onse analipo.

en.title: Malawi Queens lose heavily to England at Games
en.body: Malawi's netball team lost 73-38 to England on Monday at the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games in Scotland. The loss is the Queens' second defeat in three group matches. England is ranked third in the world. Malawi is ranked ninth. The score gap of 35 points is the biggest loss to England in the last ten games between the two teams.
en.body_more:
The match took place at the OVO Hydro. England led 18-9 after the first quarter. By half-time, England had stretched their lead to 37-23. England won the second quarter 19-14. In the third quarter, England took another 18-10. Malawi made only 45 goal attempts and scored 38 goals. This was their lowest score in the tournament so far.

Takondwa Lwazi is the Queens' captain. She said England played very well and found Malawi's weak points. "England came hard at us and the game did not go as we expected," Lwazi said. "They studied our style of play very well and punished us. We have to learn from our mistakes, remain united as a team and prepare well for our next match."

Coach Debbie Fuller kept the same starting seven players from Malawi's win over Northern Ireland on Sunday. But England's tall defenders were too strong. Players like Mwawi Kumwenda-M'bwana and Ethel Ng'ambi tried hard but could not score enough. Malawi has now won one match and lost two. They beat Northern Ireland 64-48. They lost to South Africa 65-44 before the England game. Malawi will face Australia today. Australia are the defending champions and are ranked first in the world.

ny.title: Malawi Queens yataya kwambiri ndi England pa Masewera
ny.body: Timu ya netiboli ya Malawi idagonjetsedwa ndi England ndi 73-38 Lolemba pa Masewera a Commonwealth ku Glasgow 2026 ku Scotland. Kutayika kumeneku ndi kugonjetsedwa kwachiwiri kwa Queens m'masewera atatu amagulu. England ili pa nambala 3 padziko lonse lapansi. Malawi ili pa nambala 9. Kusiyana kwa zigoli za mapointi 35 ndi komwe kudatayika kwambiri kwa England m'masewera khumi apitawa pakati pa magulu awiriwa.
ny.body_more:
Masewerowa adachitikira ku OVO Hydro. England idatsogolera 18-9 pambuyo pa kotala yoyamba. Pofika nthawi yopuma, England idakulitsa utsogoleri wawo kufika pa 37-23. England idapambana kotala yachiwiri ndi 19-14. Mu kotala yachitatu, England idatenganso 18-10. Malawi idayesa zigoli 45 zokha ndipo idapeza zigoli 38. Ichi chinali chigoli chawo chotsika kwambiri mu mpikisanowu mpaka pano.

Takondwa Lwazi ndiye kaputeni wa Queens. Iye adati England idasewera bwino kwambiri ndipo idapeza mfundo zofooka za Malawi. "England idatiukira mwamphamvu ndipo masewerawa sanayende momwe tinkayembekezera," adatero Lwazi. "Adaphunzira bwino momwe timasewerera ndipo adatilanga. Tiyenera kuphunzira kuchokera ku zolakwa zathu, kukhalabe ogwirizana ngati gulu ndikukonzekera bwino masewera athu otsatira."

Mphunzitsi Debbie Fuller adasunga osewera asanu ndi awiri omwe adayambitsa kuyambira pomwe Malawi idapambana Northern Ireland Lamlungu. Koma oteteza aatali a England anali amphamvu kwambiri. Osewera ngati Mwawi Kumwenda-M'bwana ndi Ethel Ng'ambi adayesetsa kwambiri koma sanathe kupeza zigoli zokwanira. Malawi tsopano yapambana masewera amodzi ndipo yataya awiri. Yagonjetsa Northern Ireland 64-48. Yataya South Africa 65-44 masewera asanayambe pakati pa England. Malawi ikumana ndi Australia lero. Australia ndiye ngwazi yoteteza ndipo ili pamalo oyamba padziko lonse lapansi.

en.title: Malawi and China sign deal for four Lake Malawi vessels
en.body: Malawi's government signed an agreement with Chinese company Xiao Xiang Investment on Monday. The deal will bring four new ships to Lake Malawi. The ships include two cargo vessels, one fuel tanker, and one passenger ship. A new port will be built at Chipoka in Salima.
en.body_more:
Bright Kumwenda, Principal Secretary for the Ministry of Transport and Public Works, signed the agreement at Capital Hill in Lilongwe. The new ships will help the old passenger ship MV Ilala. The Ilala is very old and needs major repair work. When the new ships start work, the Ilala can stop for repairs without hurting communities that use it.

Kumwenda said the new ships and port will lower the cost of moving goods. They will reduce the load on the M1 highway. They will also create cheaper trade routes in the region. Agricultural and mineral products will reach markets more easily. The ships will allow trade across borders with Tanzania and Mozambique.

Chen Cheng is the managing director of Xiao Xiang Investment. He said the new tankers will help NOCMA and PIL companies. The ships will cut costs and move more goods. Heavy trucks damage the M1 road. Ships will reduce this damage. During the rainy season, roads become difficult. Ships can work all year round. Xiao Xiang will also build storage parks and train Malawians in port and road management.

One of the four vessels is expected to start sailing within one year. Xiao Xiang will also build a separate port in the Northern Region. This port will connect Chipoka in Salima with Kaporo in the Northern Region. The wider project will move dry cargo, including coal. Industries in the Central Region use this coal. The financial details of the project have not yet been shared.

ny.title: Malawi ndi China asayina mgwirizano wogula zombo zinayi za m'nyanja ya Malawi
ny.body: Boma la Malawi lasayina pangano ndi kampani yaku China ya Xiao Xiang Investment Lolemba. Mgwirizanowu udzabweretsa zombo zinayi zatsopano ku Nyanja ya Malawi. Zombozi zikuphatikizapo zombo ziwiri zonyamula katundu, sitima imodzi yamafuta, ndi sitima imodzi yonyamula anthu. Doko latsopano lidzamangidwa ku Chipoka ku Salima.
ny.body_more:
Bright Kumwenda, Mlembi Wamkulu wa Unduna wa Mayendedwe ndi Ntchito za Anthu, adasaina panganoli ku Capital Hill ku Lilongwe. Zombo zatsopanozi zithandiza sitima yakale yonyamula anthu ya MV Ilala. Ilala ndi yakale kwambiri ndipo ikufunika ntchito yayikulu yokonzanso. Zombo zatsopano zikayamba kugwira ntchito, Ilala ikhoza kuyima kuti ikonze popanda kuvulaza anthu omwe amaigwiritsa ntchito.

Kumwenda adati zombo zatsopano ndi doko zidzachepetsa mtengo wosuntha katundu. Zidzachepetsa katundu pamsewu waukulu wa M1. Zidzapanganso njira zotsika mtengo zamalonda m'derali. Zaulimi ndi mchere zidzafika pamsika mosavuta. Zombozi zilola malonda kudutsa malire ndi Tanzania ndi Mozambique.

Chen Cheng ndi mkulu woyang'anira Xiao Xiang Investment. Anati zombo zatsopanozi zithandiza makampani a NOCMA ndi PIL. Zombozi zidzachepetsa ndalama ndikusuntha katundu wambiri. Magalimoto akuluakulu amawononga msewu wa M1. Zombozi zidzachepetsa kuwonongeka kumeneku. Nthawi yamvula, misewu imakhala yovuta. Zombozi zitha kugwira ntchito chaka chonse. Xiao Xiang adzamanganso malo osungiramo zinthu ndikuphunzitsa anthu aku Malawi za kayendetsedwe ka doko ndi misewu.

Chimodzi mwa zombo zinayi chikuyembekezeka kuyamba kuyenda mkati mwa chaka chimodzi. Xiao Xiang adzamanganso doko lina ku Northern Region. Dokoli lidzalumikiza Chipoka ku Salima ndi Kaporo ku Northern Region. Ntchito yaikulu idzasuntha katundu wouma, kuphatikizapo malasha. Makampani ku Central Region amagwiritsa ntchito malasha awa. Zambiri zachuma za polojekitiyi sizinafotokozedwebe.

en.title: Court hears appeal in sodomy case in Mangochi
en.body: The High Court in Mangochi heard an appeal on Monday. The Office of the Director of Public Prosecution asked the court to increase the sentence for Geoffrey Kamtedza. Kamtedza was sentenced to eight years in prison in April for forcing a 13-year-old boy into sexual activity. The prosecutor says the sentence is too low.
en.body_more:
Kamtedza went to the boy's school with a knife. He threatened the boy and took him to an uncompleted building. He forced the boy into sexual activity. The boy told his parents. This led to Kamtedza's arrest and trial in the Mangochi Senior Resident Magistrate Court.

Kamtedza had been released from prison in January after State President Peter Mutharika pardoned him. He had been in prison for a related crime. However, he then committed the same crime again. He was convicted of raping the same boy when the boy was nine years old in 2023. Now he has done this again with the same boy at age 13. Josephine Gwaza is the Director of Criminal Litigation in the Office of the DPP. She said the state believes eight years is too short for a repeat offender. An offender is a person who breaks the law more than once. The appeal hearing was scheduled for Monday before the High Court.

Gwaza said the court decided to sit in Mangochi so that local people could watch the proceedings. This means the trial was open to the public. She said watching the trial could teach people about the consequences of crime. The High Court now must decide if the sentence should be longer.

ny.title: Khoti lamva apilo ya mlandu wokhudza kugonana kwa amuna kapena akazi okhaokha ku Mangochi
ny.body: Khoti Lalikulu ku Mangochi linamva apilo Lolemba. Ofesi ya Director of Public Prosecution inapempha khotilo kuti liwonjezere chilango cha Geoffrey Kamtedza. Kamtedza anaweruzidwa kuti akhale m'ndende zaka zisanu ndi zitatu mu Epulo chifukwa chokakamiza mnyamata wazaka 13 kuti achite zachiwerewere. Woyimira milandu anati chilangocho ndi chochepa kwambiri.
ny.body_more:
Kamtedza anapita kusukulu ya mnyamatayo ndi mpeni. Anamuopseza mnyamatayo ndipo anamutengera ku nyumba yosamalizidwa. Anamukakamiza mnyamatayo kuchita zachiwerewere. Mnyamatayo anauza makolo ake. Izi zinapangitsa kuti Kamtedza amangidwe ndi kuzengedwa mlandu ku Khoti Lalikulu la Mangochi.

Kamtedza anatulutsidwa m'ndende mu Januwale Pulezidenti wa Boma Peter Mutharika atamukhululukira. Anali m'ndende chifukwa cha mlandu wina wofanana nawo. Komabe, kenako anachitanso mlandu womwewo. Anapezeka ndi mlandu wogwiririra mnyamatayo pamene mnyamatayo anali ndi zaka zisanu ndi zinayi mu 2023. Tsopano wachitanso izi ndi mnyamatayo ali ndi zaka 13. Josephine Gwaza ndi Mtsogoleri wa Milandu Yachifwamba mu Ofesi ya DPP. Iye anati boma likukhulupirira kuti zaka zisanu ndi zitatu ndi zochepa kwambiri kwa munthu wochita zachiwawa mobwerezabwereza. Wochita zachiwawa ndi munthu amene amaswa lamulo kangapo. Kumvetsera apilo kunakonzedwa Lolemba pamaso pa Khoti Lalikulu.

Gwaza anati khotilo linaganiza zokhala ku Mangochi kuti anthu am'deralo athe kuonera zomwe zikuchitika. Izi zikutanthauza kuti mlanduwo unali wotseguka kwa anthu onse. Iye anati kuonera mlanduwu kungaphunzitse anthu za zotsatira za upandu. Khoti Lalikulu tsopano liyenera kusankha ngati chilangocho chiyenera kukhala chotalikirapo.

en.title: Why did Second Vice-President chair Cabinet meeting?
en.body: First Vice-President Jane Ansah did not chair a Cabinet meeting in Lilongwe on Monday. President Arthur Peter Mutharika asked Second Vice-President Enoch Chihana to lead the meeting instead. Reports say both the President and Ansah were in Blantyre at the time. Many people want to know why Ansah was not asked to chair.
en.body_more:
Chief Secretary Justin Saidi said the President can choose either vice-president to lead Cabinet business. "The law allows the President to delegate the Second Vice-President. It also allows the President to delegate the First Vice-President," Saidi said. But when asked why Ansah did not attend, Saidi gave no clear answer. "I do not know anything on that. Check with her office," he said.

In Parliament, Joshua Malango, a lawmaker from Dedza Kasina, asked the government to explain. He questioned why the First Vice-President, who was elected with the President, was not asked to chair. "Why is the Vice-President, who was elected together with the President, not chairing the meeting?" he asked. Speaker Suleman stopped the question. He said the matter was an internal government issue and that Malango should use formal channels if he wanted more answers.

Human rights activist Sylvester Namiwa also raised concerns. He asked: "Which law are you following?" Namiwa pointed out that President Mutharika was in Blantyre while the Cabinet met in Lilongwe. He questioned why Ansah, who was also in Blantyre, was not invited to the meeting. Namiwa tried to contact Chief Secretary Saidi for answers but could not reach him.

Social commentator Latimu Matenje said the President's choice shows a good working relationship between the two vice-presidents. The government has not yet given a full public answer to the questions raised.

ny.title: N’chifukwa chiyani Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti anatsogolera msonkhano wa nduna?
ny.body: Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah sanatsogolere msonkhano wa nduna ku Lilongwe Lolemba. Purezidenti Arthur Peter Mutharika adapempha Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Enoch Chihana kuti atsogolere msonkhanowo m'malo mwake. Malipoti akuti Purezidenti ndi Ansah onse anali ku Blantyre panthawiyo. Anthu ambiri akufuna kudziwa chifukwa chake Ansah sanapemphedwe kukhala tcheyamani.
ny.body_more:
Mlembi Wamkulu Justin Saidi anati Purezidenti akhoza kusankha wachiwiri kwa purezidenti kuti atsogolere ntchito za Kabineti. "Lamulo limalola Purezidenti kupatsa Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti udindo. Limalolanso Purezidenti kupatsa Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti udindo," adatero Saidi. Koma atafunsidwa chifukwa chake Ansah sanapezekepo, Saidi sanayankhe momveka bwino. "Sindikudziwa chilichonse pankhaniyi. Funsani ofesi yake," adatero.

Mu Nyumba Yamalamulo, Joshua Malango, wopanga malamulo wochokera ku Dedza Kasina, adapempha boma kuti lifotokoze. Adafunsa chifukwa chake Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti, yemwe adasankhidwa ndi Purezidenti, sanapemphedwe kukhala wapampando. "N'chifukwa chiyani Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti, yemwe adasankhidwa limodzi ndi Purezidenti, sakutsogolera msonkhano?" adafunsa. Sipikala Suleman adayimitsa funsoli. Adati nkhaniyi ndi nkhani yamkati mwa boma ndipo Malango ayenera kugwiritsa ntchito njira zovomerezeka ngati akufuna mayankho ambiri.

Womenyera ufulu wa anthu Sylvester Namiwa adawonetsanso nkhawa. Adafunsa kuti: "Mukutsatira lamulo liti?" Namiwa adanenanso kuti Purezidenti Mutharika anali ku Blantyre pomwe Kabineti idakumana ku Lilongwe. Iye anafunsa chifukwa chake Ansah, yemwenso anali ku Blantyre, sanaitanidwe pamsonkhanowo. Namiwa anayesa kulankhulana ndi Mlembi Wamkulu Saidi kuti apeze mayankho koma sanathe kumupeza.

Wopereka ndemanga pa za chikhalidwe cha anthu Latimu Matenje anati chisankho cha Purezidenti chikusonyeza mgwirizano wabwino pakati pa achiwiri a purezidenti awiriwa. Boma silinapereke yankho lathunthu la mafunso omwe adafunsidwa.

en.title: Malawi mining firm files to list on US Nasdaq market
en.body: Chilwa Minerals Limited wants to list shares on Nasdaq, the US stock market. The firm explores minerals in Lake Chilwa, Machinga District. This listing will raise money to develop the mine. Chilwa Minerals also trades on Australia's stock market. The company owns the Lake Chilwa project fully.
en.body_more:
Chilwa Minerals filed papers with the US Securities and Exchange Commission. The company plans to list on Nasdaq Capital Market. Founder and Managing Director Cadell Buss said this is a big chance. The US market holds about US$70 trillion in value. Buss said the US needs rare earth minerals and critical minerals for defence, energy, and making things.

The Lake Chilwa project has heavy mineral sands, niobium, and rare earth elements. These minerals are important for electric cars, wind turbines, and green energy. The US government wants to buy these minerals. Investment analyst Bond Mtembezeka said foreign stock markets give firms hard currency. This money pays for machines and equipment. Geoscience expert Ignatius Kamwanje said Nasdaq's good name will help investors trust the mine more. He noted that Malawi's mineral deposits are rare and open to dig in Africa.

Another Malawi firm, Mkango Resources Limited, also plans to list on Nasdaq. Mkango has a rare earths project in Songwe Hill, Phalombe District. Both firms show that Malawi's mining sector is growing. But challenges remain. Mining firms need expertise, money, and clear rules from government. They must also follow environmental and social rules. Transport links and processing plants must work well. Malawi's government and firms must work together to support these projects.

ny.title: Kampani ya migodi ku Malawi yalembetsa kuti igulitsidwe pamsika wa US Nasdaq
ny.body: Kampani ya Chilwa Minerals Limited ikufuna kulemba magawo pa Nasdaq, msika wamasheya ku US. Kampaniyi imafufuza za mchere ku Lake Chilwa, Machinga District. Mndandandawu udzapeza ndalama zoti ipange mgodiwu. Chilwa Minerals imagulitsanso pamsika wamasheya ku Australia. Kampaniyo ndi mwini wa pulojekiti ya Lake Chilwa mokwanira.
ny.body_more:
Chilwa Minerals idapereka mapepala ku US Securities and Exchange Commission. Kampaniyo ikukonzekera kulembetsa pa Nasdaq Capital Market. Woyambitsa komanso Managing Director Cadell Buss adati uwu ndi mwayi waukulu. Msika wa US uli ndi mtengo wa pafupifupi US $70 trillion. Buss adati US ikufunika mchere wosowa wa nthaka ndi mchere wofunikira kuti ateteze, apereke mphamvu, komanso apange zinthu.

Pulogalamu ya Lake Chilwa ili ndi mchenga wolemera wa mchere, niobium, ndi zinthu zosowa za nthaka. Miyala iyi ndi yofunika kwambiri pamagalimoto amagetsi, ma turbine amphepo, ndi mphamvu zobiriwira. Boma la US likufuna kugula mcherewu. Katswiri wa zachuma Bond Mtembezeka adati misika yamasheya akunja imapatsa makampani ndalama zokhazikika. Ndalamazi zimalipira makina ndi zida. Katswiri wa sayansi ya nthaka Ignatius Kamwanje adati dzina labwino la Nasdaq lithandiza osunga ndalama kudalira mgodiwo kwambiri. Adanenanso kuti miyala yamchere ku Malawi ndi yosowa ndipo ndi yotseguka ku Africa.

Kampani ina yaku Malawi, Mkango Resources Limited, ikukonzekeranso kulembetsa pa Nasdaq. Mkango ali ndi pulojekiti yosowa wa nthaka ku Songwe Hill, Phalombe District. Makampani onsewa akuwonetsa kuti gawo la migodi ku Malawi likukula. Koma mavuto akadalipo. Makampani a migodi amafunika ukatswiri, ndalama, ndi malamulo omveka bwino ochokera ku boma. Ayeneranso kutsatira malamulo okhudza chilengedwe ndi chikhalidwe cha anthu. Maulalo oyendera ndi mafakitale opangira zinthu ayenera kugwira ntchito bwino. Boma la Malawi ndi makampani ayenera kugwirira ntchito limodzi kuti athandize mapulojekitiwa.

en.title: Malawi women ready to fight Nigeria at WAFCON
en.body: Malawi's women football team will play Nigeria tonight in the WAFCON tournament. The match is in Group C at Al Madina Stadium in Rabat, Morocco. Coach Lovemore Fazili says his team is ready. Nigeria are the champions. Malawi qualified after a hard campaign.
en.body_more:
Fazili spoke to reporters on Monday in Morocco. He said Malawi will fight hard in the match. "When we qualified, it was not an easy task. We fought for it, and we will do the same when we play Nigeria," he said.

Nigeria are strong. They have won many matches and have not lost in two years. But Fazili believes Malawi can win. He said his team has found Nigeria's weak points. "We have quality players who can play well," Fazili said. The Scorchers have played many friendly matches before WAFCON. This helps every player to be ready.

Malawi plays in Group C with Nigeria, Egypt and Zambia. This is Malawi's first time at WAFCON. Egypt will play Zambia in the other Group C match. The top two teams in the group will go to the next round. The match kicks off at 10pm local time.

ny.title: Azimayi aku Malawi akonzeka kumenyana ndi Nigeria ku WAFCON
ny.body: Timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi isewera ndi Nigeria usikuuno pa mpikisano wa WAFCON. Masewerawa ali mu Gulu C pa bwalo la Al Madina ku Rabat, Morocco. Mphunzitsi Lovemore Fazili akuti timu yake yakonzeka. Nigeria ndiye opambana. Malawi yapambana pambuyo pa mpikisano wovuta.
ny.body_more:
Fazili adalankhula ndi atolankhani Lolemba ku Morocco. Iye adati Malawi idzamenyana mwamphamvu pamasewerawa. "Pamene tidayenerera, sinali ntchito yophweka. Tinamenyera nkhondo, ndipo tidzachita chimodzimodzi tikasewera ndi Nigeria," adatero.

Nigeria ndi yamphamvu. Yapambana masewera ambiri ndipo sinagonjetsedwe m'zaka ziwiri. Koma Fazili akukhulupirira kuti Malawi ikhoza kupambana. Iye adati timu yake yapeza zofooka za Nigeria. "Tili ndi osewera abwino omwe amatha kusewera bwino," adatero Fazili. A Scorchers adasewera masewera ambiri aubwenzi asanafike WAFCON. Izi zimathandiza wosewera aliyense kukhala wokonzeka.

Malawi imasewera mu Gulu C ndi Nigeria, Egypt ndi Zambia. Iyi ndi nthawi yoyamba ya Malawi ku WAFCON. Egypt idzasewera ndi Zambia pamasewera ena a Gulu C. Magulu awiri apamwamba mu gululi adzapita ku gawo lotsatira. Masewerawa ayamba nthawi ya 10pm nthawi yakomweko.

en.title: Malawi girls' team wins and will play Bayern Munich
en.body: Girls from Ascent Soccer Academy won 2-0 and reached the final of an international youth tournament in Sweden. They will play Bayern Munich next. The boys' team won 5-0 in their own tournament game. NICO Group sponsors both teams.
en.body_more:
The girls' team is Under-16 and the boys' team is Under-14. Both teams played in tournaments in Sweden. The girls reached the final of the Rey Cup tournament. The boys reached the Round-of-16 stage at the Gothia Cup tournament.

Taweni Gondwe Xaba is head of marketing at NICO Group. She said the girls' win is a special moment. She said playing Bayern Munich is a big chance. Bayern Munich is one of the biggest football clubs in the world. Gondwe Xaba said the girls gave Malawi something to be happy about. She said young Malawi players can do great things when they get help and chances to play.

Thom Mkolongo is operations director at Ascent Academy. He said both teams showed great character in the tournaments. NICO Group gave Ascent Academy K900 million for three years to help them. This money came three weeks before the tournament. NICO Group said they will keep helping Ascent Academy find new young football players for Malawi.

ny.title: Timu ya atsikana ya Malawi ipambana ndipo isewera ndi Bayern Munich
ny.body: Atsikana ochokera ku Ascent Soccer Academy adapambana 2-0 ndipo adafika kumapeto kwa mpikisano wapadziko lonse wa achinyamata ku Sweden. Kenako adzasewera ndi Bayern Munich. Gulu la anyamata lidapambana 5-0 pamasewera awoawo a mpikisano. Gulu la NICO limathandizira magulu onse awiri.
ny.body_more:
Gulu la atsikana ndi la Under-16 ndipo gulu la anyamata ndi la Under-14. Magulu onse awiri adasewera m'mipikisano ku Sweden. Atsikana adafika kumapeto kwa mpikisano wa Rey Cup. Anyamatawo adafika mu gawo la Round-of-16 pa mpikisano wa Gothia Cup.

Taweni Gondwe Xaba ndi mkulu wa malonda ku NICO Group. Iye adati kupambana kwa atsikana ndi nthawi yapadera. Iye adati kusewera Bayern Munich ndi mwayi waukulu. Bayern Munich ndi imodzi mwa makalabu akuluakulu a mpira padziko lonse lapansi. Gondwe Xaba adati atsikanawo adapatsa Malawi chinthu choti chikhale chosangalatsa nacho. Iye adati osewera achinyamata aku Malawi amatha kuchita zinthu zazikulu akalandira thandizo ndi mwayi wosewera.

Thom Mkolongo ndi director wa ntchito ku Ascent Academy. Iye adati magulu onse awiri adawonetsa khalidwe labwino m'mipikisano. NICO Group idapatsa Ascent Academy K900 miliyoni kwa zaka zitatu kuti iwathandize. Ndalamazi zidabwera milungu itatu mpikisano usanachitike. NICO Group idati ipitiliza kuthandiza Ascent Academy kupeza osewera atsopano a mpira ku Malawi.

en.title: Malawi Flames start AFCON 2027 qualifiers at home.
en.body: The Malawi National Football Team, called the Flames, will play South Sudan at home in their first AFCON 2027 match. AFCON is the Africa Cup of Nations football tournament. The game will happen at Bingu National Stadium in Lilongwe between September 21 and October 6, 2026. The Confederation of African Football released the match schedule on Sunday.
en.body_more:
After playing South Sudan at home, the Flames will travel to Angola for their second match in the same time period. This early home match gives Malawi a chance to get good points and build momentum at the start of the campaign.

In November 2026, the Flames will face Egypt twice. They will play Egypt away first, then host Egypt at Bingu National Stadium in Lilongwe between November 9 and 17. Egypt has won the Africa Cup of Nations seven times and is very strong.

The Flames will play South Sudan again away in March 2027. Their last match will be at home against Angola. Group B has four teams: Malawi, Egypt, Angola, and South Sudan. Only the top two teams will go to the finals. Sports journalist Williams Chande said Egypt are the favourites because of their history. Angola reached the quarterfinals in 2023. South Sudan have become better in recent years. Chande said the Flames must win both home matches against South Sudan to stay in the fight for a place in the finals. The Flames last played in AFCON in 2021 in Cameroon and reached the Round of 16. They did not play in the last two AFCON tournaments.

ny.title: Malawi Flames ikuyamba masewera oyesera a AFCON 2027 kunyumba.
ny.body: Timu ya mpira wa dziko la Malawi, yotchedwa Flames, idzasewera ndi South Sudan kunyumba pamasewera awo oyamba a AFCON 2027. AFCON ndi mpikisano wa mpira wa Africa Cup of Nations. Masewerawa adzachitikira ku Bingu National Stadium ku Lilongwe pakati pa Seputembala 21 ndi Okutobala 6, 2026. Bungwe la Confederation of African Football latulutsa ndondomeko ya masewerawa Lamlungu.
