ny.body_more:
Pambuyo posewera ndi South Sudan kunyumba, Flames idzapita ku Angola kukasewera masewera awo achiwiri nthawi yomweyo. Masewerawa oyambirira apakhomo apatsa Malawi mwayi wopeza mapointi abwino ndikumanga mphamvu kumayambiriro kwa kampeni.

Mu Novembala 2026, Flames idzakumana ndi Egypt kawiri. Adzasewera ndi Egypt kutali koyamba, kenako adzalandira Egypt ku Bingu National Stadium ku Lilongwe pakati pa Novembala 9 ndi 17. Egypt yapambana Africa Cup of Nations kasanu ndi kawiri ndipo ndi yamphamvu kwambiri.

Flames idzaseweranso ndi South Sudan kutali mu Marichi 2027. Masewera awo omaliza adzakhala kunyumba motsutsana ndi Angola. Gulu B lili ndi magulu anayi: Malawi, Egypt, Angola, ndi South Sudan. Magulu awiri apamwamba okha ndi omwe adzapite kumapeto. Mtolankhani wa zamasewera Williams Chande adati Egypt ndiye omwe akukondedwa chifukwa cha mbiri yawo. Angola idafika mu quarterfinals mu 2023. South Sudan yakhala bwino m'zaka zaposachedwa. Chande adati Flames iyenera kupambana masewera onse awiri apakhomo motsutsana ndi South Sudan kuti ipitirizebe kumenyana kuti ipeze malo omaliza. Flames idasewera komaliza mu AFCON mu 2021 ku Cameroon ndipo idafika mu Round of 16. Sanasewere mu mipikisano iwiri yapitayi ya AFCON.

en.title: CDEDI asks Lands Minister to explain his wealth
en.body: A watchdog group asked Lands Minister Chimwemwe Chipungu to explain where his money comes from. The Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives (CDEDI) sent a letter on 27 July 2026. CDEDI says Chipungu should have a public lifestyle audit. A lifestyle audit means showing how much money you have and where it came from.
en.body_more:
CDEDI Executive Director Sylvester Namiwa said Chipungu must answer questions about his assets. The group wants to know about Backyard Park Hotel in Lilongwe. CDEDI says the hotel expansion will cost at least K1.5 billion. Namiwa asked where the money for this work came from. He also asked about luxury vehicles the minister owns, including a Nissan car with number CMC 7.

CDEDI said Chipungu bought these things while working as Defence Minister and now as Lands Minister. The group wants proof that Chipungu paid taxes on the money. CDEDI also asked about money Chipungu spent on food and sports gifts after he won the Luchenza Municipal seat. Namiwa said the gifts seemed too big for a minister's salary to pay for.

CDEDI sent the letter using the Access to Information Act. This Act lets people ask the government for information. The group wants Chipungu to appear on radio and television to answer questions. Chipungu can also send written answers with papers to show his money came from proper sources. CDEDI said if Chipungu does not answer, people will think he is not being honest about his wealth.

The letter also asks Chipungu to publish names of all people he gave land to since January. It asks if any of these people are his friends or family. CDEDI wants details about a land audit in Areas 3 and 10 in Lilongwe. The group said Chipungu ordered illegal land occupiers to leave in January, but CDEDI wants to know what happened after that.

ny.title: CDEDI yapempha Nduna ya Malo kuti ifotokoze chuma chake
ny.body: Gulu loyang'anira za malo linafunsa Nduna ya Zamalonda Chimwemwe Chipungu kuti afotokoze komwe ndalama zake zimachokera. Bungwe la Centre for Democracy and Economic Development Initiatives (CDEDI) linatumiza kalata pa 27 Julayi 2026. CDEDI ikunena kuti Chipungu ayenera kukhala ndi kafukufuku wa moyo wa anthu onse. Kafukufuku wa moyo wa anthu amatanthauza kusonyeza kuchuluka kwa ndalama zomwe muli nazo komanso komwe zachokera.
ny.body_more:
Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa CDEDI, Sylvester Namiwa, anati Chipungu ayenera kuyankha mafunso okhudza chuma chake. Gululi likufuna kudziwa za Backyard Park Hotel ku Lilongwe. CDEDI ikunena kuti kukulitsa hoteloyi kudzawononga ndalama zosachepera K1.5 biliyoni. Namiwa anafunsa komwe ndalama zogwirira ntchitoyi zinachokera. Anafunsanso za magalimoto apamwamba omwe nduna ili nawo, kuphatikizapo galimoto ya Nissan yokhala ndi nambala CMC 7.

CDEDI inati Chipungu anagula zinthuzi pamene anali kugwira ntchito ngati Nduna ya Zachitetezo komanso tsopano monga Nduna ya Malo. Gululi likufuna umboni wakuti Chipungu analipira misonkho pa ndalamazo. CDEDI inafunsanso za ndalama zomwe Chipungu anagwiritsa ntchito pa chakudya ndi mphatso zamasewera atapambana mpando wa Luchenza Municipal. Namiwa anati mphatsozo zinkaoneka ngati zazikulu kwambiri kuti malipiro a nduna azitha kulipira.

CDEDI inatumiza kalatayo pogwiritsa ntchito Access to Information Act. Lamuloli limalola anthu kufunsa boma kuti liwadziwitse zambiri. Gululi likufuna kuti Chipungu awonekere pa wailesi ndi wailesi yakanema kuti ayankhe mafunso. Chipungu akhozanso kutumiza mayankho olembedwa ndi mapepala osonyeza kuti ndalama zake zinachokera ku magwero oyenera. CDEDI inati ngati Chipungu sayankha, anthu adzaganiza kuti sakunena zoona za chuma chake.

Kalatayo ikupemphanso Chipungu kuti afalitse mayina a anthu onse omwe adawapatsa malo kuyambira Januwale. Ikufunsa ngati pali aliyense mwa anthuwa amene ndi anzake kapena abale ake. CDEDI ikufuna tsatanetsatane wokhudza kafukufuku wa malo ku Area 3 ndi 10 ku Lilongwe. Gululo linati Chipungu adalamula anthu okhala m'malo osaloledwa kuti achoke mu Januwale, koma CDEDI ikufuna kudziwa zomwe zinachitika pambuyo pake.

en.title: Apostle Kawinga Opens Farm Market in Mchinji District
en.body: Apostle Clifford Kawinga opened a new farm market in Mchinji on Sunday, July 26, 2026. He pays farmers K50,000 per 50-kilogram bag of maize. This is much more than other buyers pay. Ten Chisomo Farmers' Clubs sold 1,300 bags to him. They earned K65 million together.
en.body_more:
The new market is called the Hope Field Agricultural Produce Market. It is part of Kawinga's Hope Field Initiative (HFI). The initiative helps smallholder farmers get better prices for their crops. Before this, many farmers sold maize for only K30,000 per bag. Kawinga's price of K50,000 per bag gives farmers K20,000 more per bag.

Kawinga said the project is about more than buying maize. He wants to help farmers earn better money and give them hope for a better life. He also wants to share a message about faith. "The core objective is to ensure that love leads," Kawinga said. "We want people to know there is hope for a better life."

To help farmers grow more crops, HFI gave them a solar-powered irrigation system. This system uses the sun's power to water crops. It will help farmers grow food all year, not just when it rains. This means higher harvests and more household income. Traditional Authority Mkanda said the project is timely and will reduce hunger in the area. Agricultural Extension Development Coordinator Thandie Sathula said crop yields are already much higher than before.

Kawinga plans to reach 1.5 million farmers across six districts in the next five years. The six districts are Thyolo, Machinga, Chirazulu, Lilongwe, Ntchisi and Mchinji. He wants to spend K25 billion on this work. Nathan Dhlamini, speaking for the farmers' clubs, thanked Kawinga for helping smallholder farmers at this important time.

ny.title: Apostle Kawinga Atsegula Msika wa Famu ku Chigawo cha Mchinji
ny.body: Mtumwi Clifford Kawinga anatsegula msika watsopano wa famu ku Mchinji Lamlungu, pa Julayi 26, 2026. Amalipira alimi K50,000 pa thumba la chimanga la makilogalamu 50. Izi ndi zambiri kuposa zomwe ogula ena amalipira. Magulu khumi a alimi a Chisomo adamugulitsa matumba 1,300. Anapeza K65 miliyoni pamodzi.
ny.body_more:
Msika watsopanowu umatchedwa Msika wa Zokolola za Ulimi wa Hope Field. Ndi gawo la Kawinga's Hope Field Initiative (HFI). Pulogalamuyi imathandiza alimi ang'onoang'ono kupeza mitengo yabwino ya mbewu zawo. Izi zisanachitike, alimi ambiri ankagulitsa chimanga pa K30,000 yokha pa thumba. Mtengo wa Kawinga wa K50,000 pa thumba umapatsa alimi K20,000 yowonjezera pa thumba.

Kawinga adati pulojekitiyi ndi yoposa kungogula chimanga. Akufuna kuthandiza alimi kupeza ndalama zabwino ndikuwapatsa chiyembekezo cha moyo wabwino. Akufunanso kugawana uthenga wokhudza chikhulupiriro. "Cholinga chachikulu ndikuwonetsetsa kuti chikondi chikutsogolera," adatero Kawinga. "Tikufuna kuti anthu adziwe kuti pali chiyembekezo cha moyo wabwino."

Pofuna kuthandiza alimi kulima mbewu zambiri, HFI idawapatsa njira yothirira yogwiritsa ntchito mphamvu ya dzuwa. Njirayi imagwiritsa ntchito mphamvu ya dzuwa kuthirira mbewu. Idzathandiza alimi kulima chakudya chaka chonse, osati mvula ikagwa. Izi zikutanthauza kuti anthu ambiri adzakolola komanso ndalama zambiri zomwe amapeza pabanja. Akuluakulu a Zachikhalidwe Mkanda adati pulojekitiyi ndi yanthawi yake ndipo idzachepetsa njala m'derali. Wogwirizanitsa Ntchito Zokulitsa Ulimi Thandie Sathula anati zokolola za mbewu zakwera kale kuposa kale.

Kawinga akukonzekera kufikira alimi 1.5 miliyoni m'maboma asanu ndi limodzi m'zaka zisanu zikubwerazi. Maboma asanu ndi limodzi ndi Thyolo, Machinga, Chirazulu, Lilongwe, Ntchisi ndi Mchinji. Akufuna kugwiritsa ntchito K25 biliyoni pantchitoyi. Nathan Dhlamini, yemwe amalankhula m'malo mwa magulu a alimi, adathokoza Kawinga chifukwa chothandiza alimi ang'onoang'ono panthawi yofunikayi.

en.title: Wanderers draw with Masters in FDH Premiership match
en.body: Mighty Wanderers and Masters FC drew 1-1 on Sunday at Mpira Stadium in Blantyre. Promise Kamwendo scored for Wanderers in the eighth minute. Patrick Phiri scored for Masters in the ninth minute. The match was part of the FDH Bank Premiership.
en.body_more:
The match took place at Mpira Stadium in Chiwembe Township on Sunday. Cold weather made good conditions for football but made it hard for supporters watching the match. Wanderers started well when Kamwendo scored after Gaddie Chirwa gave him the ball from a corner kick. This goal made Wanderers supporters happy. Masters replied very fast. Patrick Phiri scored in the ninth minute to make it 1-1 and quiet the home crowd.

Wanderers had more of the ball after that. Masters stayed organized and looked for chances to score on the fast break. Both teams made chances before half time but did not score again. The score stayed 1-1 at half time. In the second half, Wanderers pushed harder to find a winning goal. Masters goalkeeper Richard Chimbamba made many good saves. He stopped Wanderers from scoring and won the award for best player in the match.

After the match, Wanderers coach Bob Mpinganjira said he was not happy about not winning but was pleased with his players' work. He said: "We wanted all three points but I am satisfied with the performance from my players." Masters coach Peter Mponda said the match was hard and that Wanderers played better for long periods. He said his players did well to stay organized and get a point.

Wanderers stay at the top of the FDH Bank Premiership table with 22 points from 11 matches. Masters FC moved to fifth place with 17 points from 11 matches. Three other teams also have 22 points but Wanderers are first because they scored more goals.

ny.title: Wanderers ikugwirizana ndi Masters pamasewera a FDH Premiership
ny.body: Mighty Wanderers ndi Masters FC adasewera 1-1 Lamlungu pa Mpira Stadium ku Blantyre. Promise Kamwendo adagoletsa chigoli cha Wanderers mu mphindi yachisanu ndi chitatu. Patrick Phiri adagoletsa chigoli cha Masters mu mphindi yachisanu ndi chinayi. Masewerowa anali gawo la FDH Bank Premiership.
ny.body_more:
Masewerowa adachitikira ku Mpira Stadium ku Chiwembe Township Lamlungu. Nyengo yozizira idapangitsa kuti zinthu zikhale bwino pa mpira koma zidapangitsa kuti zikhale zovuta kwa otsatira kuonera masewerawa. Wanderers idayamba bwino Kamwendo atagoletsa chigoli Gaddie Chirwa atamupatsa mpira kuchokera ku kona. Chigolichi chidasangalatsa otsatira a Wanderers. Masters adayankha mwachangu kwambiri. Patrick Phiri adagoletsa chigoli mu mphindi yachisanu ndi chinayi kuti zigoli zikhale 1-1 ndikutonthoza khamu la anthu.

Wanderers idagoletsa kwambiri pambuyo pake. Masters adakhalabe okonzeka ndipo adafunafuna mipata yogoletsa nthawi yopuma. Magulu onse awiri adapanga mipata nthawi yopuma isanafike koma sanagoletsenso. Zigolizo zidatsala 1-1 nthawi yopuma. Mu theka lachiwiri, Wanderers adalimbikira kwambiri kuti apeze chigoli chopambana. Golikipa wa Masters Richard Chimbamba adapulumutsa bwino kwambiri. Adaletsa Wanderers kuti isagoletse ndipo adapambana mphoto ya wosewera wabwino kwambiri pamasewerawa.

Pambuyo pa masewerawa, mphunzitsi wa Wanderers Bob Mpinganjira adati sanasangalale ndi kusapambana koma adakondwera ndi ntchito ya osewera ake. Iye adati: "Tinkafuna mfundo zonse zitatu koma ndikukhutira ndi momwe osewera anga adachitira." Mphunzitsi wa Masters Peter Mponda anati masewerawa anali ovuta ndipo Wanderers adasewera bwino kwa nthawi yayitali. Anati osewera ake adachita bwino kuti akhale okonzekera bwino ndikupeza mfundo imodzi.

Wanderers ikupitilirabe pamwamba pa tebulo la FDH Bank Premiership ndi mfundo 22 kuchokera pamasewera 11. Masters FC yasamuka kupita pa nambala 5 ndi mfundo 17 kuchokera pamasewera 11. Magulu ena atatu alinso ndi mfundo 22 koma Wanderers ndi oyamba chifukwa adagoletsa zigoli zambiri.

en.title: Malawi plane goes missing in DR Congo after engine fails
en.body: A plane from Malawi has gone missing in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The aircraft left Beni in North Kivu Province on Friday at about 12:11pm. One hour into the flight, the crew said they lost an engine and tried to fly to another airport. Contact with the plane was then lost. Search teams are looking in a remote area of eastern DR Congo.
en.body_more:
The plane is a Let L-410 turboprop with the number 7Q-GMR. It was flying from Beni to Kasongo when problems started. The crew told another aircraft they had lost one of the plane's Walter M601 engines. They said they would divert to Walikale, a different airport. This was the last time anyone heard from the plane.

A device that sends emergency signals was found near Kitshanga. This place is about 100 nautical miles south of Beni. But the plane did not reach Walikale or any other airfield. Two crew members were on the plane. By Saturday, search and rescue teams backed by aircraft were still looking. No wreckage or survivors have been found yet.

The search is very hard. The area has dense forests, mountains, and few roads. These things make it difficult to find the plane quickly. Aviation authorities are now looking at flight information and communication records. They want to know what happened after the engine problem began.

Families and the public are waiting for news. Officials said they will share more details when they know what happened. The 7Q number on the plane shows it is registered in Malawi. The plane was working in DR Congo when it disappeared.

ny.title: Ndege ya Malawi yasowa ku DR Congo injini yake italephera kugwira ntchito
ny.body: Ndege yochokera ku Malawi yasowa ku Democratic Republic of Congo. Ndegeyo inachoka ku Beni ku North Kivu Province Lachisanu pafupifupi 12:11pm. Patatha ola limodzi ndegeyo itayamba, ogwira ntchito anati injini yake yatayika ndipo anayesa kuuluka kupita ku eyapoti ina. Kenako ndegeyo inasowa. Magulu ofufuza akufufuza kudera lakutali kum'mawa kwa DR Congo.
ny.body_more:
Ndegeyo ndi ya Let L-410 turboprop yokhala ndi nambala 7Q-GMR. Inali kuuluka kuchokera ku Beni kupita ku Kasongo pamene mavuto anayamba. Ogwira ntchitoyo anauza ndege ina kuti yataya imodzi mwa injini za ndegeyo za Walter M601. Anati apita ku Walikale, eyapoti ina. Iyi inali nthawi yomaliza kumva kuchokera mu ndegeyo.

Chida chomwe chimatumiza zizindikiro zadzidzidzi chinapezeka pafupi ndi Kitshanga. Malo awa ali pamtunda wa makilomita pafupifupi 100 kum'mwera kwa Beni. Koma ndegeyo sinafike ku Walikale kapena ku bwalo lina lililonse la ndege. Ogwira ntchito awiri anali mu ndegeyo. Pofika Loweruka, magulu ofufuza ndi opulumutsa omwe akuthandizidwa ndi ndege anali akadali kufunafuna. Palibe zotsalira kapena opulumuka omwe apezekabe.

Kufufuza n'kovuta kwambiri. Derali lili ndi nkhalango zowirira, mapiri, ndi misewu yochepa. Zinthuzi zimapangitsa kuti zikhale zovuta kupeza ndegeyo mwachangu. Akuluakulu a ndege tsopano akuyang'ana zambiri za ndege ndi zolemba zolumikizirana. Akufuna kudziwa zomwe zinachitika vuto la injini litayamba.

Mabanja ndi anthu akuyembekezera nkhani. Akuluakulu adati adzagawana zambiri akadziwa zomwe zinachitika. Nambala ya 7Q yomwe inali pa ndegeyo ikusonyeza kuti yalembetsedwa ku Malawi. Ndegeyo inali kugwira ntchito ku DR Congo pamene inasowa.

en.title: Popular Creator Hannah Jabesi Shows Girlfriend on Social Media
en.body: Content creator Hannah Jabesi, known as Tamia Ja, shared videos of herself with her girlfriend on Sunday. She posted the videos on social media. In Malawi, some same sex acts are crimes under the Penal Code. No government response has come yet.
en.body_more:
Tamia Ja shared a video in a car with her girlfriend. She wrote: "I love her so much. This weekend, choose peace over pressure and joy over stress. Feel free to comment, nothing will happen. I am happy." She posted another video from R & L Farm, where she spent the weekend with her girlfriend. She wrote: "I had an amazing time with my girl at R & L Farm."

Last year, Tamia Ja spoke to another content creator named Danrrow. She said: "Whether I am a lesbian or not, it's my life. If I am a lesbian, it doesn't matter, it's my life." When asked about videos of her kissing women, she said: "What you hear is what you hear."

Malawi's Penal Code has three laws against same sex acts. Section 137A criminalizes "indecent practices between females." A crime is a break of law. The punishment is up to five years in prison. Sections 153 and 154 prohibit "carnal knowledge against the order of nature" and attempted acts like this. These crimes carry punishments of up to 14 years in prison.

Human rights groups say Malawi should change these laws. They say the laws break international human rights rules about privacy and equality. Religious groups say the laws match Malawi's moral values. Legal experts say crime under these laws needs proof of actions, not just words or identity. As of Sunday, government authorities had not made any statement about Tamia Ja's videos.

ny.title: Mlengi Wotchuka Hannah Jabesi Akuwonetsa Chibwenzi Chake Pa Malo Ochezera a Pa Intaneti
ny.body: Wopanga nkhani Hannah Jabesi, wodziwika kuti Tamia Ja, adagawana mavidiyo ake ndi chibwenzi chake Lamlungu. Adayika mavidiyowo pa malo ochezera a pa Intaneti. Ku Malawi, chiwerewere china chofanana ndi milandu yokhudza milandu yokhudza milandu. Palibe yankho la boma lomwe laperekedwa.
ny.body_more:
Tamia Ja adagawana kanema mgalimoto ndi chibwenzi chake. Adalemba kuti: "Ndimamukonda kwambiri. Kumapeto kwa sabata ino, sankhani mtendere m'malo mokakamizidwa ndi chisangalalo m'malo mopsinjika maganizo. Khalani omasuka kupereka ndemanga, palibe chomwe chidzachitike. Ndili wokondwa." Adalemba kanema wina wochokera ku R & L Farm, komwe adakhala kumapeto kwa sabata ndi chibwenzi chake. Adalemba kuti: "Ndinakhala ndi nthawi yabwino kwambiri ndi mtsikana wanga ku R & L Farm."

Chaka chatha, Tamia Ja adalankhula ndi wopanga zinthu wina dzina lake Danrrow. Adati: "Kaya ndine mkazi kapena ayi, ndi moyo wanga. Ngati ndine mkazi kapena mwamuna, sizikukhudza, ndi moyo wanga." Atafunsidwa za makanema a akazi ake akupsompsonana, adati: "Zimene mumamva ndi zomwe mumamva."

Lamulo la Milandu ku Malawi lili ndi malamulo atatu oletsa chiwerewere chofanana. Gawo 137A limaletsa "machitidwe osayenera pakati pa akazi." Upandu ndi kuswa lamulo. Chilangocho ndi mpaka zaka zisanu m'ndende. Gawo 153 ndi 154 limaletsa "kudziwana ndi thupi motsutsana ndi dongosolo la chilengedwe" ndikuyesera kuchita zinthu ngati izi. Milandu iyi ili ndi zilango za zaka 14 m'ndende.

Mabungwe omenyera ufulu wa anthu akuti Malawi iyenera kusintha malamulowa. Amati malamulowa akuswa malamulo apadziko lonse okhudza ufulu wa anthu okhudza zachinsinsi komanso kufanana. Mabungwe azipembedzo amati malamulowa akugwirizana ndi makhalidwe abwino a Malawi. Akatswiri azamalamulo amati milandu yomwe ili pansi pa malamulowa ikufunika umboni wa zochita, osati mawu okha kapena umunthu wawo. Pofika Lamlungu, akuluakulu aboma sananene chilichonse chokhudza makanema a Tamia Ja.

en.title: Malawi Queens beat Northern Ireland 64-48
en.body: Malawi Queens won their first game at the Commonwealth Games. They beat Northern Ireland 64-48 in Glasgow. The game took place after Malawi lost to South Africa in their first match. Malawi played well from start to finish.
en.body_more:
Malawi scored 19 points in the first quarter. Northern Ireland scored 9 points. By half-time, Malawi led 35-23. The third quarter ended with Malawi ahead 44-38. In the last quarter, Malawi played faster and won 64-48.

Two players shot very well for Malawi. Mwai Kumwenda and Ethel Ng'ambi both scored perfectly. Captain Takondwa Lwazi controlled the midcourt. Sophie Banda and Shabel Bengo played strong defence. The team worked together well.

Five young players played their first Commonwealth Games. They were Stella Matelezi, Ethel Ng'ambi, Mphatso Banda, Melia Soko and Sophie Banda. All of them played with confidence. The win gives Malawi hope for the next match.

Malawi will now play England. England is one of the best netball teams in the world. Malawi has beaten England twice before. In 2015, Malawi won 34-32. In 2018, Malawi won 27-26. But England has won the last four times they played. England won 62-36 in 2025, 62-39 in 2023, 62-41 in 2022, and 62-60 in 2017. The match will be hard for Malawi.

ny.title: Malawi Queens yagonjetsa Northern Ireland 64-48
ny.body: Malawi Queens idapambana masewera awo oyamba pa Masewera a Commonwealth. Adagonjetsa Northern Ireland 64-48 ku Glasgow. Masewerawa adachitika Malawi itagonja ndi South Africa pamasewera awo oyamba. Malawi idasewera bwino kuyambira pachiyambi mpaka kumapeto.
ny.body_more:
Malawi idapeza mapointi 19 mu kotala yoyamba. Northern Ireland idapeza mapointi 9. Pofika nthawi yopuma, Malawi idatsogolera ndi 35-23. Kotala yachitatu idatha ndi Malawi patsogolo ndi 44-38. Mu kotala yomaliza, Malawi idasewera mwachangu ndipo idapambana 64-48.

Osewera awiri adawombera bwino kwambiri ku Malawi. Mwai Kumwenda ndi Ethel Ng'ambi onse adagoletsa bwino. Captain Takondwa Lwazi adalamulira bwalo lapakati. Sophie Banda ndi Shabel Bengo adasewera chitetezo champhamvu. Gululi lidagwira ntchito limodzi bwino.

Osewera asanu achichepere adasewera Masewera awo oyamba a Commonwealth. Anali Stella Matelezi, Ethel Ng'ambi, Mphatso Banda, Melia Soko ndi Sophie Banda. Onse adasewera ndi chidaliro. Kupambanaku kumapatsa Malawi chiyembekezo cha masewera otsatira.

Malawi tsopano idzasewera ndi England. England ndi imodzi mwa magulu abwino kwambiri a netball padziko lonse lapansi. Malawi idagonjetsa England kawiri kale. Mu 2015, Malawi idapambana 34-32. Mu 2018, Malawi idapambana 27-26. Koma England yapambana nthawi zinayi zapitazi zomwe idasewera. England idapambana 62-36 mu 2025, 62-39 mu 2023, 62-41 mu 2022, ndi 62-60 mu 2017. Masewerawa adzakhala ovuta kwa Malawi.

en.title: Man damages hospital after wife dies in Machinga
en.body: A Burundian man damaged hospital property at Machinga District Hospital after his wife died there. He became very angry when doctors told him she had passed away. He broke equipment and smashed things in the emergency ward. The damage is still being counted.
en.body_more:
The man arrived at the hospital with his wife to get medical help. Hospital staff tried hard to save her, but she died. When he heard the news, he lost control and started to break things. Nurses ran away for safety as he moved through the wards and threw whatever he could find. The emergency ward looked like a storm had passed through it.

Hospital spokesperson Wongani Nyirenda confirmed what happened. He said the man destroyed hospital property, but the exact value is not yet known. Staff say the damage is very big and could cost many millions of kwacha. Kwacha is Malawi money.

The man's family members have promised to pay the full cost when the hospital finishes checking the damage. Police from Liwonde Police Station are now looking into what happened. The police spokesperson, Ngwashape Msume, asked the public to wait for police to finish their work before asking more questions. The hospital has also started its own check to see exactly what was broken and how much it will cost to fix.

ny.title: Mwamuna wawononga chipatala mkazi wake atamwalira ku Machinga
ny.body: Mwamuna wina waku Burundi anawononga katundu wa chipatala ku Machinga District Hospital mkazi wake atamwalira kumeneko. Anakwiya kwambiri madokotala atamuuza kuti wamwalira. Anaswa zida ndi kuswa zinthu m'chipinda chadzidzidzi. Kuwonongekaku kukuwerengedwabe.
ny.body_more:
Mwamunayo anafika kuchipatala ndi mkazi wake kuti akalandire thandizo lachipatala. Ogwira ntchito kuchipatala anayesetsa kwambiri kuti amupulumutse, koma anamwalira. Atamva nkhaniyi, analephera kudziletsa ndipo anayamba kuswa zinthu. Anamwino anathawa kuti akapulumuke pamene ankadutsa m'mawodi ndikuponya chilichonse chomwe anapeza. Wodi yadzidzidzi inkaoneka ngati mphepo yamkuntho yadutsamo.

Wolankhulira chipatala Wongani Nyirenda adatsimikiza zomwe zinachitika. Anati mwamunayo anawononga katundu wa chipatala, koma mtengo wake weniweni sunadziwikebe. Ogwira ntchito akunena kuti kuwonongekako ndi kwakukulu kwambiri ndipo kungawononge ndalama zambiri za kwacha. Kwacha ndi ndalama za ku Malawi.

Anthu a m'banja la mwamunayo alonjeza kulipira ndalama zonse chipatalacho chikamaliza kuwona kuwonongekako. Apolisi ochokera ku Liwonde Police Station tsopano akuyang'ana zomwe zinachitika. Wolankhulira apolisi, Ngwashape Msume, adapempha anthu kuti adikire apolisi kuti amalize ntchito yawo asanafunse mafunso ena. Chipatalachi chayambanso kufufuza kuti chione chomwe chasweka komanso ndalama zomwe zingagwiritsidwe ntchito kukonza.

en.title: Malawi Queens start Commonwealth Games against South Africa
en.body: The Malawi Queens netball team plays South Africa in their first game of the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland. The Queens have not beaten South Africa for eleven years. Their last win was in 2015. Coach Debbie Fuller from New Zealand leads the team. Star player Mwawi Kumwenda has returned to help.
en.body_more:
The Queens last beat South Africa in August 2015 at the Netball World Cup in Sydney, Australia. That match ended 58–51. Now the team hopes to end this long losing run.

Coach Fuller said the team is ready. She said: "The build-up has been very good. We played against Wales and Northern Ireland. These are strong teams." Fuller said the players are working very hard together. She added that the team must improve accuracy. "Netball is a precision game," she said. "We need good timing and decisions when under pressure."

Mwawi Kumwenda played as top scorer for Malawi at Commonwealth Games in 2014 and 2018. Other experienced players in the squad are captain Takondwa Lwazi and goal defender Martha Dambo. Nine players in the twelve-person squad are making their Commonwealth Games debut. Fuller said: "Six young players are half of our team. But they are very fast and athletic." The team finished three training games in Manchester, England, before the tournament started.

South Africa's coach Jenny van Dyk said her team is also ready. Key South African players include Karla Pretorius, Khanyisa Chawane and Karla Victor. Malawi's goal is to finish in the top seven at the Games. The Commonwealth Games run until 2 August in Glasgow.

ny.title: Malawi Queens yayamba masewera a Commonwealth motsutsana ndi South Africa
ny.body: Timu ya netiboli ya Malawi Queens isewera ndi South Africa pamasewera awo oyamba a Commonwealth Games a 2026 ku Glasgow, Scotland. Timu ya Queens sinagonjetse South Africa kwa zaka khumi ndi chimodzi. Kupambana kwawo komaliza kunali mu 2015. Mphunzitsi Debbie Fuller wochokera ku New Zealand ndiye akutsogolera timuyi. Wosewera nyenyezi Mwawi Kumwenda wabwerera kudzathandiza.
ny.body_more:
A Queens adagonjetsa South Africa komaliza mu Ogasiti 2015 pa Netball World Cup ku Sydney, Australia. Masewerawa adathera ndi 58-51. Tsopano timuyi ikuyembekeza kuthetsa kutayika kwa nthawi yayitali.

Mphunzitsi Fuller adati timuyi yakonzeka. Iye anati: "Kukonzekera kwakhala kwabwino kwambiri. Tinasewera motsutsana ndi Wales ndi Northern Ireland. Awa ndi magulu olimba." Fuller adati osewerawa akugwira ntchito limodzi molimbika. Anawonjezera kuti timuyi iyenera kukonza kulondola. "Netball ndi masewera olondola," adatero. "Tikufunika nthawi yabwino komanso zisankho zabwino tikamapanikizika."

Mwawi Kumwenda adasewera ngati wogoletsa wamkulu wa Malawi pa Masewera a Commonwealth mu 2014 ndi 2018. Osewera ena odziwa bwino ntchito mu timuyi ndi kaputeni Takondwa Lwazi ndi woteteza zigoli Martha Dambo. Osewera asanu ndi anayi mu timu ya anthu khumi ndi awiri akuyamba kusewera Masewera a Commonwealth. Fuller adati: "Osewera asanu ndi mmodzi achinyamata ndi theka la timu yathu. Koma ndi othamanga kwambiri komanso othamanga." Gululi lidamaliza masewera atatu ophunzitsira ku Manchester, England, mpikisano usanayambe.

Mphunzitsi wa ku South Africa, Jenny van Dyk, adati timu yake nayonso ili okonzeka. Osewera ofunikira ku South Africa ndi Karla Pretorius, Khanyisa Chawane ndi Karla Victor. Cholinga cha Malawi ndikumaliza m'magulu asanu ndi awiri apamwamba pa Masewerawa. Masewera a Commonwealth apitilira mpaka pa 2 Ogasiti ku Glasgow.

en.title: Miss Malawi bosses say sorry for age mix-up
en.body: The Miss Malawi Organisation said sorry on Friday for getting its own rules wrong. Chief executive Benedette Mweso admitted the group told the public the wrong age limit for Miss World. The true rule says contestants must be aged 26 or younger, not 27. The organisation now needs K30 million to send Irene Navicha to Vietnam for the pageant.
en.body_more:
Mweso spoke at a press meeting in Lilongwe. She said the Miss World Organisation sets the real age rules, not Miss Malawi. "We take full responsibility for causing this confusion," she told reporters. "I apologise to Malawians for this mistake."

The age error comes after the organisation chose first runner-up Navicha to go to Miss World. Many people said this choice was wrong. They said the reigning queen Thandi Chisi should go instead. The choice has caused much anger across the country. Some people ask why the group keeps changing its reasons for not sending Chisi. First the group said she was too old. Then it said she had no international pageant experience. Now it returns to the age issue.

Mweso said other countries may have sent contestants above the age limit. But she said Malawi has no special deal with Miss World to do the same thing. The organisation has now asked Miss World for clear answers about the age rules. Navicha must fly to Vietnam on 8 August. She will come back to Malawi on 7 September.

But the group has a big money problem. It needs K30 million for Navicha's trip. The group has only found K15 million so far. It still needs to find K15 million more. The bosses are asking businesses and rich people to help give money. Time is short — Navicha must leave in just a few weeks.

ny.title: Akuluakulu a Miss Malawi ati pepani chifukwa cha kusokoneza zaka
ny.body: Bungwe la Miss Malawi Organisation lati pepani Lachisanu chifukwa cholakwitsa malamulo ake. Mkulu wa bungweli Benedette Mweso adavomereza kuti gululi linauza anthu za zaka zolakwika za Miss World. Lamulo lenileni limati opikisana nawo ayenera kukhala ndi zaka 26 kapena kuchepera, osati zaka 27. Bungweli tsopano likufunika K30 miliyoni kuti litumize Irene Navicha ku Vietnam kukachita nawo mpikisano.
ny.body_more:
Mweso adalankhula pamsonkhano wa atolankhani ku Lilongwe. Iye adati bungwe la Miss World Organization limakhazikitsa malamulo enieni a zaka, osati a Miss Malawi. "Timatenga udindo wonse woyambitsa chisokonezochi," adatero kwa atolankhani. "Ndikupepesa kwa anthu aku Malawi chifukwa cha cholakwika ichi."

Cholakwika cha zaka chikubwera pambuyo poti bungweli lasankha Navicha yemwe anali wachiwiri kuti apite ku Miss World. Anthu ambiri adati chisankhochi chinali cholakwika. Anati mfumukazi yolamulira Thandi Chisi ayenera kupita m'malo mwake. Chisankhochi chakwiyitsa kwambiri dziko lonselo. Anthu ena amafunsa chifukwa chake gululi likusinthasintha zifukwa zake zosatumizira Chisi. Choyamba gululo linati anali wokalamba kwambiri. Kenako linati analibe chidziwitso chapadziko lonse lapansi pa mpikisano wa mayiko. Tsopano likubwerera ku nkhani ya zaka.

Mweso adati mayiko ena mwina adatumiza opikisana nawo oposa zaka. Koma adati Malawi ilibe mgwirizano wapadera ndi Miss World kuti achite zomwezo. Bungweli tsopano lapempha Miss World kuti ayankhe momveka bwino za malamulo a zaka. Navicha ayenera kupita ku Vietnam pa 8 Ogasiti. Adzabwerera ku Malawi pa 7 Seputembala.

Koma gululi lili ndi vuto lalikulu la ndalama. Ikufunika K30 miliyoni paulendo wa Navicha. Gululi langopeza K15 miliyoni yokha mpaka pano. Likufunabe K15 miliyoni yowonjezera. Mabwana akupempha mabizinesi ndi anthu olemera kuti athandize kupereka ndalama. Nthawi ndi yochepa — Navicha ayenera kuchoka m'masabata ochepa chabe.

en.title: Kayelekera uranium mine starts work in August
en.body: Lotus Resources Limited will restart the Kayelekera Uranium Mine in early August. The mine in Karonga District stopped work last month. The company fixed problems with the acid plant. Now acid will arrive and production will begin again.
en.body_more:
The mine stopped because acid supply did not come. Problems in the Middle East caused this. The acid plant also needed repairs. Parts inside the furnace broke and had to be fixed. Lotus Resources said repairs are now done. Acid is arriving at the mine. More acid will come by the end of July. When acid comes, the mine will restart both plants in early August.

Lotus Resources must deliver uranium this year. The company said it needs to send 1.01 million pounds of uranium in 2026. But it cannot send all of it now. So Lotus asked buyers to wait. The buyers agreed to take the uranium in 2027 instead.

Lotus got help for the mine. Mercuria Energy Group gave 30 million dollars. Mercuria will also sell three million pounds of uranium for Lotus. This money helps Lotus run the mine. The deal will be finished in two months. Lotus also has a deal with Curzon, an American company. Curzon will buy 600,000 pounds of uranium from 2026 to 2029. Four companies now buy uranium from Lotus. They will buy up to 3.8 million pounds in total.

When the mine is fully open, it will make 2.4 million pounds of uranium each year. Geologist Ignatius Kamwanje said the mine is good for Malawi. It will create jobs in Karonga. It will bring money from other countries. Mining expert Grain Malunga said the mine will help Malawi's economy grow. In July 2024, Lotus gave Malawi Government 15 percent of the mine. The mine will be fully open in the last three months of this year.

ny.title: Mgodi wa uranium wa Kayelekera wayamba kugwira ntchito mu Ogasiti
ny.body: Kampani ya Lotus Resources Limited iyambitsanso mgodi wa Kayelekera Uranium kumayambiriro kwa mwezi wa Ogasiti. Mgodi womwe uli m'boma la Karonga unayimitsa ntchito mwezi watha. Kampaniyo inakonza mavuto ndi fakitale ya asidi. Tsopano asidi afika ndipo kupanga kudzayambanso.
ny.body_more:
Mgodi unayima chifukwa chakuti asidi sanabwere. Mavuto ku Middle East adayambitsa izi. Fakitale ya asidi nayonso inkafunika kukonzedwa. Zigawo zomwe zinali mkati mwa ng'anjo zinasweka ndipo zinayenera kukonzedwa. Lotus Resources inati kukonza kwachitika tsopano. Asidi akufika ku mgodi. Asidi wochulukirapo adzabwera kumapeto kwa Julayi. Asidi akabwera, mgodiwo udzayambiranso mafakitale onse awiri kumayambiriro kwa Ogasiti.

Lotus Resources iyenera kupereka uranium chaka chino. Kampaniyo inati ikufunika kutumiza mapaundi 1.01 miliyoni a uranium mu 2026. Koma singatumize yonse tsopano. Choncho Lotus inapempha ogula kuti adikire. Ogulawo adavomereza kutenga uranium mu 2027 m'malo mwake.

Lotus idalandira thandizo la mgodiwo. Mercuria Energy Group idapereka madola 30 miliyoni. Mercuria idzagulitsanso mapaundi atatu miliyoni a uranium ku Lotus. Ndalamazi zimathandiza Lotus kuyendetsa mgodiwo. Mgwirizanowu udzatha m'miyezi iwiri. Lotus ilinso ndi mgwirizano ndi Curzon, kampani yaku America. Curzon idzagula mapaundi 600,000 a uranium kuyambira 2026 mpaka 2029. Makampani anayi tsopano agula uranium kuchokera ku Lotus. Adzagula mapaundi okwana 3.8 miliyoni.

Mgodi ukatsegulidwa kwathunthu, upanga mapaundi 2.4 miliyoni a uranium chaka chilichonse. Katswiri wa za nthaka Ignatius Kamwanje adati mgodiwu ndi wabwino kwa Malawi. Udzapanga ntchito ku Karonga. Udzabweretsa ndalama kuchokera kumayiko ena. Katswiri wa migodi Grain Malunga adati mgodiwu uthandiza chuma cha Malawi kukula. Mu Julayi 2024, Lotus idapatsa Boma la Malawi 15 peresenti ya mgodiwo. Mgodiwu udzatsegulidwa kwathunthu m'miyezi itatu yomaliza ya chaka chino.

en.title: Old Mutual tells couples to plan money together
en.body: Old Mutual Malawi Limited told couples to plan their money as partners. The company's Group Chief Executive Officer, Tavona Biza, spoke at a dinner in Lilongwe. He said couples who plan together have better money results than those who do not. He told them that Malawi's money problems also bring chances to grow.
en.body_more:
Biza said it is very important that couples agree on money plans. "Those that run together have a better chance of achieving their goals," he said. "The importance of making sure that you are aligned, you are focused and you move together is really important." He told couples to work as partners with clear plans for their future.

Biza also spoke about Malawi's money problems. He said the country faces big challenges, but these challenges also bring chances for people who want to try new things and invest money. "We are in an environment that is so challenging, but behind every challenge there is also a set of opportunities," he said. He told people that Malawians have always been strong and able to move forward. "The future is bright," he said.

Biza said Old Mutual works as a long-term investor. The company invests in many areas of the economy. Old Mutual has put money into agriculture and tourism. The company is now looking at mining and other industries to help Malawi grow. "If we just keep investing in the stock market, then we are not helping the economy as much as we should," Biza said. He added that Old Mutual makes new money plans to help Malawians, including people who get pensions and people who buy insurance.

ny.title: Old Mutual ikuuza maanja kuti azikonzekera ndalama limodzi
ny.body: Old Mutual Malawi Limited yauza maanja kuti akonze ndalama zawo ngati ogwirizana. Mkulu wa kampani ya Group, Tavona Biza, adalankhula pa chakudya chamadzulo ku Lilongwe. Iye adati maanja omwe amakonzekera limodzi amapeza ndalama zabwino kuposa omwe sakonzekera. Anawauza kuti mavuto azachuma ku Malawi amabweretsanso mwayi wokulira.
ny.body_more:
Biza anati n’kofunika kwambiri kuti maanja agwirizane pa mapulani a ndalama. "Amene amagwirizana amakhala ndi mwayi wabwino wokwaniritsa zolinga zawo," adatero. "Kufunika koonetsetsa kuti mukugwirizana, mukuyang'ana kwambiri ndipo mukuyenda limodzi n’kofunika kwambiri." Anauza maanja kuti agwire ntchito limodzi ndi mapulani omveka bwino a tsogolo lawo.

Biza analankhulanso za mavuto azachuma ku Malawi. Anati dzikolo likukumana ndi mavuto akulu, koma mavutowa amabweretsanso mwayi kwa anthu omwe akufuna kuyesa zinthu zatsopano ndikuyika ndalama. "Tili m'malo ovuta kwambiri, koma kumbuyo kwa vuto lililonse palinso mwayi," adatero. Anauza anthu kuti anthu aku Malawi nthawi zonse akhala olimba komanso okhoza kupita patsogolo. "Tsogolo ndi lowala," adatero.

Biza anati Old Mutual imagwira ntchito ngati wogulitsa ndalama kwa nthawi yayitali. Kampaniyo imayika ndalama m'magawo ambiri azachuma. Old Mutual yaika ndalama mu ulimi ndi zokopa alendo. Kampaniyo tsopano ikuyang'ana migodi ndi mafakitale ena kuti athandize Malawi kukula. "Ngati tipitiliza kuyika ndalama pamsika wamasheya, ndiye kuti sitikuthandiza chuma momwe tiyenera kukhalira," adatero Biza. Iye anawonjezera kuti Old Mutual ikupanga mapulani atsopano oti ithandize anthu aku Malawi, kuphatikizapo anthu omwe amalandira penshoni ndi anthu omwe amagula inshuwaransi.

en.title: NBM Pension has K100 billion that members have not claimed
en.body: NBM Pension Administration Limited says K100 billion in pension money is waiting for members who have not claimed it. The company told people about this at a meeting in Blantyre on Wednesday. Pension is money saved for when workers stop working. NBM Pension says members need to check if they have money waiting.
en.body_more:
William Mabulekesi is the Chief Executive Officer of NBM Pension Administration Limited. He told people at the meeting that members must understand how their pension money is growing. He said: "We want members to see that their Pension Fund is growing. When they leave work, they will have money to live on." Mabulekesi said NBM Pension manages about K700 billion in pension money for many different schemes.

Nenauthe Nkoloma works for NBM Capital Markets Limited. She said the company must make sure pension money does not lose value. She said: "We have a big pool of funds. We make sure we do not put all money into one thing." This means they spread the money across different types of investments to keep it safe.

NBM Pension told its members that the pension fund earned very high returns in 2025. Titus Mtonyo works at Chibuku Products Limited. He said he was very happy with what NBM Pension did. He said he was expecting only 30 percent return on the money, but got much more than that. He told NBM Pension: "The more we send money each month, the more the funds will grow."

NBM Pension Administration Limited and NBM Capital Markets Limited are owned by National Bank of Malawi. NBM Pension looks after pension money and talks to workers and their bosses. NBM Capital Markets puts the money into investments. The company wants workers to visit an office or use online ways to check their pension accounts.

ny.title: Pensheni ya NBM ili ndi K100 biliyoni zomwe mamembala sanazitenge
ny.body: NBM Pension Administration Limited yati ndalama za penshoni zokwana K100 biliyoni zikudikira mamembala omwe sanazitenge. Kampaniyo idauza anthu za izi pamsonkhano ku Blantyre Lachitatu. Ndalama za penshoni ndi ndalama zomwe zimasungidwa antchito akasiya kugwira ntchito. NBM Pension yati mamembala ayenera kuwona ngati ali ndi ndalama zomwe akudikira.
ny.body_more:
William Mabulekesi ndi Chief Executive Officer wa NBM Pension Administration Limited. Iye anauza anthu omwe anali pamsonkhanowo kuti mamembala ayenera kumvetsetsa momwe ndalama zawo za penshoni zikukulirakulira. Iye anati: "Tikufuna kuti mamembala awo aone kuti ndalama zawo za penshoni zikukulirakulira. Akachoka kuntchito, adzakhala ndi ndalama zoti azisamalira." Mabulekesi anati NBM Pension imasunga ndalama za penshoni zokwana K700 biliyoni pa mapulani osiyanasiyana.

Nenauthe Nkoloma amagwira ntchito ku NBM Capital Markets Limited. Iye anati kampaniyo iyenera kuonetsetsa kuti ndalama za penshoni sizitaya phindu. Iye anati: "Tili ndi ndalama zambiri. Timaonetsetsa kuti sitikuyika ndalama zonse mu chinthu chimodzi." Izi zikutanthauza kuti amagawa ndalamazo m'njira zosiyanasiyana kuti zikhale zotetezeka.

NBM Pension idauza mamembala ake kuti penshoni idapeza phindu lalikulu kwambiri mu 2025. Titus Mtonyo amagwira ntchito ku Chibuku Products Limited. Iye adati anali wokondwa kwambiri ndi zomwe NBM Pension idachita. Iye adati akuyembekezera phindu la 30 peresenti pa ndalamazo, koma adapeza zambiri kuposa pamenepo. Iye anauza NBM Pension kuti: "Tikatumiza ndalama zambiri mwezi uliwonse, ndalamazo zimakula kwambiri."

NBM Pension Administration Limited ndi NBM Capital Markets Limited ndi a National Bank of Malawi. NBM Pension imayang'anira ndalama za penshoni ndipo imalankhula ndi antchito ndi mabwana awo. NBM Capital Markets imayika ndalamazo mu ndalama zomwe zimayikidwa. Kampaniyo ikufuna kuti antchito azipita ku ofesi kapena kugwiritsa ntchito njira za pa intaneti kuti akawone maakaunti awo a penshoni.

en.title: Malawi Revenue Authority beats money targets in first quarter
en.body: The Malawi Revenue Authority (MRA) collected K1.398 trillion in the first quarter of the 2026-27 financial year. This beat the target of K1.378 trillion. Gold exports and mining royalties drove the strong performance. MRA officials told media in Lilongwe on 24 July.
en.body_more:
Mineral royalties reached K28.4 billion between April and June. This was much more than the K667 million target. Gold exports by the Reserve Bank of Malawi helped achieve this result. Other taxes did not perform as well, but the gold sales made up the difference.

Penalties from non-compliance cases also helped. These penalties reached K15.5 billion, higher than the K4.3 billion target. Non-compliance means people or businesses did not follow tax rules. MRA Head of Corporate Affairs Wilma Chalulu said the Electronic Invoicing System (EIS) is helping improve tax compliance. This is a new electronic system for recording sales and purchases. The EIS had 8,428 businesses registered, close to the target of 9,000 businesses. Chalulu encouraged all businesses with annual turnover above K50 million to register.

MRA expects to collect K603 billion this month (July 2026). The authority believes the second quarter will also beat targets. Chalulu said external donors are giving less money. This means domestic tax revenue is now more important for paying for public services and national development. She called on taxpayers to comply voluntarily with tax rules. She also asked media to help teach the public about tax reforms.

The government introduced a 40 percent excise duty on scrap metal exports. This is a tax on scrap metal sold abroad. The tax aims to stop people from stealing electricity cables, phone equipment and railway metal for scrap sales.

ny.title: Bungwe la Malawi Revenue Authority lapambana zolinga za ndalama mu kotala yoyamba
ny.body: Bungwe la Malawi Revenue Authority (MRA) linasonkhanitsa K1.398 trillion mu kotala yoyamba ya chaka cha 2026-27. Izi zinaposa cholinga cha K1.378 trillion. Kutumiza golide kunja ndi ndalama zogulira migodi zinapangitsa kuti ntchito iyende bwino. Akuluakulu a MRA adauza atolankhani ku Lilongwe pa 24 Julayi.
ny.body_more:
Ndalama zamtengo wapatali za mchere zinafika K28.4 biliyoni pakati pa Epulo ndi Juni. Izi zinali zoposa zomwe zinali kuyembekezeredwa ndi K667 miliyoni. Kutumiza golide kunja kwa Reserve Bank of Malawi kunathandiza kukwaniritsa izi. Misonkho ina sinayende bwino, koma kugulitsa golide kunapanga kusiyana.

Zilango zochokera ku milandu yosatsatira malamulo zinathandizanso. Zilango izi zinafika K15.5 biliyoni, kuposa zomwe zinali kuyembekezeredwa ndi K4.3 biliyoni. Kusatsatira malamulo kumatanthauza kuti anthu kapena mabizinesi sanatsatire malamulo amisonkho. Mtsogoleri wa MRA, Wilma Chalulu, anati Electronic Invoiceing System (EIS) ikuthandiza kukonza malamulo amisonkho. Iyi ndi njira yatsopano yamagetsi yolembera malonda ndi zogula. EIS inali ndi mabizinesi 8,428 olembetsedwa, pafupifupi cholinga cha mabizinesi 9,000. Chalulu analimbikitsa mabizinesi onse omwe ali ndi ndalama zopitilira K50 miliyoni pachaka kuti alembetse.

MRA ikuyembekeza kusonkhanitsa K603 biliyoni mwezi uno (Julayi 2026). Bungweli likukhulupirira kuti kotala lachiwiri lidzapambananso zomwe zili kuyembekezeredwa. Chalulu anati opereka ndalama akunja akupereka ndalama zochepa. Izi zikutanthauza kuti ndalama zomwe zimaperekedwa pamisonkho ya m'dziko muno tsopano ndizofunikira kwambiri polipira ntchito za boma komanso chitukuko cha dziko. Iye anapempha okhometsa msonkho kuti azitsatira malamulo amisonkho mwaufulu. Anapemphanso atolankhani kuti athandize kuphunzitsa anthu za kusintha kwa misonkho.

Boma linakhazikitsa msonkho wa 40 peresenti pa zogulitsa zitsulo zotsalira. Uwu ndi msonkho wa zitsulo zotsalira zomwe zimagulitsidwa kunja. Cholinga cha msonkhowu ndi kuletsa anthu kuba zingwe zamagetsi, zida zamafoni ndi zitsulo za sitima kuti agulitse zitsulo zotsalira.

en.title: Miss Malawi row: Chisi turned down offer, says Bushiri's office
en.body: Prophet Shepherd Bushiri's office says reigning Miss Malawi Thandi Chisi was offered a chance to go to Miss Universe on 30 June, but she said no. After that, the Miss Malawi board chose first runner-up Ireen Navicha for Miss World instead. Bushiri's spokesperson Aubrey Kusakala made this claim in a statement on Friday night.
en.body_more:
Kusakala said Chisi turned down the Miss Universe chance for personal reasons. Once she said no, the board gave the Miss World spot to Navicha. He said Miss World only takes people under age 26. Chisi is 27 years old.

The claim is very different from what the Miss Malawi Organisation said before. First, they said Chisi could not go because of her age. Then they said she did not have enough pageant experience. On Friday, they went back to the age reason. They showed a paper they said came from Miss World saying people must be 26 or younger. But Miss World's own rules say people can be 17 to 27 years old. Many other 27-year-old women are going to Miss World this year from other countries.

Kusakala also said there are money and contract problems between Chisi and the Miss Malawi Organisation. He said these problems should be fixed in private, not in public. He said Goshen City is only the main sponsor, not the boss of Miss World Malawi. The board chair is Prophetess Mary Bushiri. She said in her plan that all top three finalists should get chances to go to big pageants, not just the winner.

Chisi has not yet said anything about these new claims. The Miss Malawi Organisation asked for K30 million to pay for Navicha to go to Miss World. The Miss World final will be on 5 September this year.

ny.title: Miss Malawi row: Chisi anakana, yatero ofesi ya Bushiri
ny.body: Ofesi ya Mneneri Shepherd Bushiri ikunena kuti Miss Malawi Thandi Chisi yemwe akulamulira adapatsidwa mwayi wopita ku Miss Universe pa 30 June, koma iye adati ayi. Pambuyo pake, bungwe la Miss Malawi linasankha Ireen Navicha yemwe anali wachiwiri paudindo wa Miss World m'malo mwake. Mneneri wa Bushiri, Aubrey Kusakala, adanena izi Lachisanu usiku.
ny.body_more:
Kusakala anati Chisi anakana mwayi wa Miss Universe pazifukwa zake. Atanena kuti ayi, bungweli linapatsa Navicha malo a Miss World. Anati Miss World imatenga anthu osakwana zaka 26 okha. Chisi ali ndi zaka 27.

Nkhaniyi ndi yosiyana kwambiri ndi zomwe bungwe la Miss Malawi linanena kale. Choyamba, anati Chisi sangapite chifukwa cha msinkhu wake. Kenako anati analibe chidziwitso chokwanira pa mpikisano. Lachisanu, anabwerera ku chifukwa cha msinkhu. Anawonetsa pepala lomwe anati linachokera kwa Miss World lonena kuti anthu ayenera kukhala ndi zaka 26 kapena kuchepera. Koma malamulo a Miss World amati anthu akhoza kukhala ndi zaka 17 mpaka 27. Azimayi ena ambiri azaka 27 akupita ku Miss World chaka chino ochokera kumayiko ena.

Kusakala adatinso pali mavuto azachuma ndi mgwirizano pakati pa Chisi ndi bungwe la Miss Malawi. Anati mavutowa ayenera kuthetsedwa mwachinsinsi, osati poyera. Anati Goshen City ndiye wothandizira wamkulu, osati bwana wa Miss World Malawi. Wapampando wa bungweli ndi Prophetess Mary Bushiri. Iye anati mu dongosolo lake kuti onse atatu apamwamba ayenera kupeza mwayi wopita ku mpikisano waukulu, osati wopambana yekha.

Chisi sananene chilichonse chokhudza madandaulo atsopanowa. Bungwe la Miss Malawi linapempha K30 miliyoni kuti alipire Navicha kuti apite ku Miss World. Miss World final idzakhala pa 5 Seputembala chaka chino.

en.title: Police question MEC official over money problems
en.body: Police went to the Malawi Electoral Commission office in Lilongwe on Friday. About 11 officers came to the building during a meeting. They asked questions of Yacinto Chikapa, the Director of Administration and Human Resources. The Attorney General said this was part of a probe into money mismanagement. An audit found problems with how money was used.
en.body_more:
The police came at 8.30am on Friday. Chikapa was questioned for close to one hour. Some workers left the building because they were scared. They did not know why the police were there. The meeting continued while Chikapa was being questioned in another room.

Attorney General Frank Mbeta said the Fiscal Police are looking into financial mismanagement. Financial mismanagement means money was not used correctly. Mbeta said: "Fiscal Police are conducting investigations into the financial mismanagement and abuse revealed by the audit report. They were at MEC as part of those investigations."

The MEC is also having other money problems. A landlord sealed the warehouses because the MEC did not pay rent for a long time. The government asked the MEC to move to Blantyre, but the MEC said no. The MEC said it is independent and must stay in Lilongwe. The MEC asked the government to pay the rent money that is owed.

During the meeting, the Commissioners talked about two by-elections. These are elections for Nsanje South and Mangochi East. The elections will happen between July and September. The MEC Chief Executive Officer Andrew Mpesi has left his job. Some people say the Chairperson Anabel Mtalimanja may also leave, but nothing was said officially on Friday.

ny.title: Apolisi akufunsa mkulu wa bungwe la MEC za mavuto azachuma
ny.body: Apolisi anapita ku ofesi ya Malawi Electoral Commission ku Lilongwe Lachisanu. Apolisi pafupifupi 11 anabwera ku nyumbayo pamsonkhano. Anafunsa mafunso Yacinto Chikapa, Mtsogoleri wa Utsogoleri ndi Zachuma. Loya Wamkulu anati izi zinali mbali ya kafukufuku wokhudza kugwiritsa ntchito ndalama molakwika. Kafukufuku adapeza mavuto ndi momwe ndalama zimagwiritsidwira ntchito.
ny.body_more:
Apolisi anabwera Lachisanu nthawi ya 8:30am. Chikapa anafunsidwa mafunso kwa pafupifupi ola limodzi. Antchito ena anatuluka mnyumbamo chifukwa cha mantha. Sanadziwe chifukwa chake apolisi analipo. Msonkhanowo unapitirira pamene Chikapa anali kufunsidwa mafunso m'chipinda china.

Loya Wamkulu Frank Mbeta anati Apolisi a Zachuma akufufuza za kayendetsedwe ka ndalama molakwika. Kuyendetsa ndalama molakwika kumatanthauza kuti ndalama sizinagwiritsidwe ntchito moyenera. Mbeta anati: "Apolisi a Zachuma akuchita kafukufuku pa kayendetsedwe ka ndalama molakwika komanso nkhanza zomwe zawululidwa ndi lipoti la audit. Anali ku MEC ngati gawo la kafukufukuyo."

MEC ikukumananso ndi mavuto ena azachuma. Mwininyumba anatseka nyumba zosungiramo katundu chifukwa MEC sinalipire lendi kwa nthawi yayitali. Boma linapempha MEC kuti isamukire ku Blantyre, koma MEC inati ayi. MEC inati ndi yodziyimira payokha ndipo iyenera kukhala ku Lilongwe. MEC inapempha boma kuti lilipire lendi yomwe ikuyenera kubwerekedwa.

Pamsonkhanowo, a Commissioners adakambirana za zisankho ziwiri. Izi ndi zisankho za Nsanje South ndi Mangochi East. Zisankho zidzachitika pakati pa Julayi ndi Seputembala. Mkulu wa bungwe la MEC, Andrew Mpesi, wasiya ntchito yake. Anthu ena amati Wapampando, Anabel Mtalimanja, nayenso angasiye ntchito yake, koma palibe chomwe chinanenedwa mwalamulo Lachisanu.

en.title: Government Opens K6.8bn Market in Nkhata Bay
en.body: The government opened a new market in Nkhata Bay on Thursday. Minister Ben Phiri opened the Mkondezi Market. It will cost K6.8 billion. The market is in Senior Chief Mkumbira's area. The government says it will build what people ask for, not what it chooses.
en.body_more:
Phiri said the market shows a new way. The government will no longer force projects on communities. Instead, it will support what people themselves want. He said many people asked for this market. Because people wanted it, many traders will use it. The government will not have empty market stalls.

The market is part of the TRADE Programme. TRADE means Transforming Agriculture through Diversification and Entrepreneurship. The programme helps farmers and small business people. Barbara Ntapasa runs the TRADE Programme. She said the market will help farmers sell honey and other goods. Honey is important in Nkhata Bay. The market will give farmers a good place to sell their products.

The building company must finish the market in twelve months. Phiri told the company to do good work and finish on time. Communities need good markets to earn money. David Kayiwonanga Gondwe is the district commissioner. He said the market fits with Nkhata Bay's plans. The district wants to become a secondary city. Precious Mwandira leads the market committee. He said traders have waited a long time for a good market. Traders had bad places to sell before. Now they will have a modern market. The committee will help the builders do good work.

ny.title: Boma Latsegula Msika wa K6.8bn ku Nkhata Bay
ny.body: Boma latsegula msika watsopano ku Nkhata Bay Lachinayi. Nduna Ben Phiri yatsegula Msika wa Mkondezi. Udzawononga K6.8 biliyoni. Msikawu uli mdera la Senior Chief Mkumbira. Boma likunena kuti lidzamanga zomwe anthu amapempha, osati zomwe amasankha.
ny.body_more:
Phiri anati msika ukuwonetsa njira yatsopano. Boma silidzakakamizanso mapulojekiti m'madera. M'malo mwake, lidzathandizira zomwe anthu okha akufuna. Anati anthu ambiri adapempha msika uwu. Chifukwa anthu adaufuna, amalonda ambiri adzaugwiritsa ntchito. Boma silidzakhala ndi malo ogulitsira misika opanda kanthu.

Msikawu ndi gawo la Pulogalamu ya TRADE. TRADE imatanthauza Kusintha Ulimi Kudzera mu Kusiyanasiyana ndi Kupanga Mabizinesi. Pulogalamuyi imathandiza alimi ndi amalonda ang'onoang'ono. Barbara Ntapasa amayendetsa Pulogalamu ya TRADE. Anati msikawu uthandiza alimi kugulitsa uchi ndi zinthu zina. Uchi ndi wofunikira ku Nkhata Bay. Msikawu udzapatsa alimi malo abwino ogulitsira zinthu zawo.

Kampani yomanga iyenera kumaliza msika m'miyezi khumi ndi iwiri. Phiri adauza kampaniyo kuti ichite ntchito yabwino ndikumaliza pa nthawi yake. Madera amafunika misika yabwino kuti apeze ndalama. David Kayiwonanga Gondwe ndi komiti ya chigawo. Anati msikawu ukugwirizana ndi mapulani a Nkhata Bay. Chigawochi chikufuna kukhala mzinda wachiwiri. Precious Mwandira akutsogolera komiti yamsika. Anati amalonda akhala akuyembekezera nthawi yayitali msika wabwino. Amalonda anali ndi malo oipa oti agulitse kale. Tsopano adzakhala ndi msika wamakono. Komitiyi ithandiza omanga nyumba kuchita ntchito yabwino.

en.title: Police Minister Says Communities Must Build Police Stations
en.body: Malawi's Homeland Security Minister Peter Mukhito said on Friday that communities and their MPs must build police stations themselves. Government will only help once the buildings are finished. Mukhito also announced that 6,000 new police officers will be hired.
en.body_more:
Mukhito made the statement after answering questions in Parliament. He said communities and MPs have a duty to construct the police units. Once the buildings are complete, government will give architectural designs and send police officers to work there.

The minister said this arrangement shows government's commitment to work closely with communities and the Malawi Police Service. He wants every citizen to live in a safe place. Communities and police must work together to stop crime.

Mukhito pointed out that constituencies now receive K5 billion each through the Constituency Development Fund, also called CDF. CDF is money each constituency gets to spend on local projects. This amount was increased from K220 million. The minister said MPs and their constituents have enough money to build police units using this fund.

The announcement of 6,000 new police officers is welcome news for Malawians worried about crime. Mukhito said the new officers will help respond to crime faster and increase police presence across the country. The newly built police units will give these officers more bases to work from in communities. Mukhito said the partnership between government and local communities is key to helping more Malawians get police services. He urged communities to keep working with police to prevent crime and keep peace and security strong across Malawi.

ny.title: Nduna ya Apolisi Yati Anthu Ayenera Kumanga Malo Apolisi
ny.body: Nduna ya zachitetezo cha m'dziko la Malawi, Peter Mukhito, inanena Lachisanu kuti madera ndi aphungu awo ayenera kumanga malo apolisi okha. Boma lithandiza pokhapokha nyumbazo zikamalizidwa. Mukhito adalengezanso kuti apolisi atsopano 6,000 adzalembedwa ntchito.
ny.body_more:
Mukhito adalankhula izi atayankha mafunso ku Nyumba Yamalamulo. Iye adati madera ndi aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo ali ndi udindo womanga mayunitsi a apolisi. Nyumbazo zikamalizidwa, boma lipereka mapulani a zomangamanga ndikutumiza apolisi kukagwira ntchito kumeneko.

Ndunayo idati dongosololi likuwonetsa kudzipereka kwa boma kugwira ntchito limodzi ndi madera ndi Malawi Police Service. Akufuna kuti nzika iliyonse ikhale pamalo otetezeka. Madera ndi apolisi ayenera kugwirira ntchito limodzi kuti athetse umbanda.

Mukhito adati madera tsopano amalandira K5 biliyoni iliyonse kudzera mu Constituency Development Fund, yomwe imatchedwanso CDF. CDF ndi ndalama zomwe chigawo chilichonse chimapeza kuti chigwiritse ntchito pa ntchito zakomweko. Ndalamazi zidakwera kuchoka pa K220 miliyoni. Ndunayo idati aphungu ndi anthu awo ali ndi ndalama zokwanira zomangira mayunitsi a apolisi pogwiritsa ntchito ndalamazi.

Kulengezedwa kwa apolisi atsopano 6,000 ndi nkhani yabwino kwa anthu aku Malawi omwe akuda nkhawa ndi umbanda. Mukhito adati apolisi atsopanowa athandiza kuthana ndi umbanda mwachangu ndikuwonjezera kupezeka kwa apolisi mdziko lonselo. Magulu apolisi atsopanowa apatsa apolisiwa malo ambiri ogwirira ntchito m'madera. Mukhito adati mgwirizano pakati pa boma ndi madera am'deralo ndi wofunikira kwambiri pothandiza anthu ambiri aku Malawi kupeza ntchito za apolisi. Iye adalimbikitsa madera kuti apitirize kugwira ntchito ndi apolisi kuti apewe umbanda ndikulimbikitsa mtendere ndi chitetezo ku Malawi konse.

en.title: Parliament sitting extended to August 7, 2026
en.body: Parliament sitting has been extended by one week. The extension was approved by President Peter Mutharika. Speaker Sameer Suleman told MPs the new closing date is August 7, 2026. Parliament was going to close on July 31, 2026. The extra time gives MPs more days to finish their work.
en.body_more:
Parliament has much work to do. MPs need to debate bills that are on the Notice Paper. These are important government bills. Parliamentary committees are still giving their reports on these bills. The Speaker said committees must make high-quality reports. Good reports help MPs make sound decisions.

The Third Meeting of the 52nd Session of Parliament started on July 7, 2026. It was meant to end on July 31, 2026. But there was too much to do. MPs have spent weeks debating many issues. These include government borrowing, public finance, land, corruption cases, and constitutional reform. Long question-and-answer sessions between ministers and MPs have taken much time.

Under Malawi's constitution, the President has power to decide when Parliament begins and ends. Any extension must be approved by the President at State House. The Speaker said earlier this week that consultations were happening. He said lawmakers needed more time to look carefully at pending bills. The bills are already written and ready. Now they wait for committees to finish reports before MPs vote.

The extension is not new. But it shows government business is not finished. MPs will keep working until August 7, 2026. Select committees will also use this time to finish their reports. After August 7, Parliament will formally adjourn until the next sitting begins.

ny.title: Msonkhano wa Nyumba Yamalamulo wawonjezeredwa mpaka pa Ogasiti 7, 2026
ny.body: Msonkhano wa Nyumba Yamalamulo wawonjezeredwa ndi sabata imodzi. Kuwonjezeredwako kunavomerezedwa ndi Purezidenti Peter Mutharika. Wokamba nkhani Sameer Suleman adauza aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti tsiku latsopano lotseka ndi pa 7 Ogasiti, 2026. Nyumba Yamalamulo inali kutseka pa 31 Julayi, 2026. Nthawi yowonjezerayi imapatsa aphungu masiku ambiri kuti amalize ntchito yawo.
ny.body_more:
Nyumba Yamalamulo ili ndi ntchito yambiri yoti ichitike. Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo akuyenera kukambirana za malamulo omwe ali pa Notice Paper. Awa ndi malamulo ofunikira a boma. Makomiti a Nyumba Yamalamulo akuperekabe malipoti awo pa malamulo amenewa. Sipika adati makomiti ayenera kupanga malipoti abwino kwambiri. Malipoti abwino amathandiza aphungu kupanga zisankho zabwino.

Msonkhano Wachitatu wa Msonkhano wa 52 wa Nyumba Yamalamulo unayamba pa Julayi 7, 2026. Unali kutha pa Julayi 31, 2026. Koma panali zambiri zoti achite. Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo akhala akukambirana nkhani zambiri kwa milungu ingapo. Izi zikuphatikizapo kubwereka kwa boma, ndalama za boma, malo, milandu ya ziphuphu, ndi kusintha malamulo. Magawo a mafunso ndi mayankho aatali pakati pa nduna ndi aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo atenga nthawi yayitali.

Motsatira malamulo a dziko la Malawi, Purezidenti ali ndi mphamvu zosankha nthawi yomwe Nyumba Yamalamulo imayamba ndi kutha. Kuwonjezeka kulikonse kuyenera kuvomerezedwa ndi Purezidenti ku State House. Sipika adati koyambirira kwa sabata ino kuti zokambirana zikuchitika. Anati opanga malamulo amafunika nthawi yochulukirapo kuti ayang'ane mosamala malamulo omwe akuyembekezeka. Malamulowa alembedwa kale ndipo akonzeka. Tsopano akudikira kuti makomiti amalize malipoti a aphungu asanavote.

Kuwonjezekaku sikwatsopano. Koma zikusonyeza kuti ntchito za boma sizinathe. Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo apitiliza kugwira ntchito mpaka pa Ogasiti 7, 2026. Makomiti osankhidwa adzagwiritsanso ntchito nthawiyi kumaliza malipoti awo. Pambuyo pa Ogasiti 7, Nyumba Yamalamulo idzayimitsidwa mwalamulo mpaka msonkhano wotsatira uyambe.

en.title: Malawi loses 4-0 to Ghana before Africa Cup of Nations
en.body: Malawi's women's football team lost 4-0 to Ghana in a practice match before the CAF Women's Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco. Ghana's Doris Boaduwaa scored three goals. Sharon Sampson scored one. The match was at Municipal de Berrechid Stadium.
en.body_more:
This was Malawi's second loss in two practice matches. Last week, the team lost 2-1 to Morocco. The Scorchers play their first real match on Tuesday. They will face Nigeria, the defending champions, in Group C.

Head coach Lovemore Fazili used a different team than usual. He did not play Tabitha Chawinga, the captain who plays in France. Her sister Temwa Chawinga, who plays in the United States, came back and played in attack. Other players who started were Rose Kadzere, Madyina Ngulube, Bernadette Mkandawire, Rose Alufandika, Sabina Thom, Faith Chimzimu, Tendai Sani and Chimwemwe Madise.

Fazili also made a change in goal. He gave Yamikani Kaonga, who plays for MDF Lioness, her first start. The usual goalkeeper is Mercy Sikelo of Civil Service Women. During the second half, Fazili made many changes. Sikelo came in to replace Kaonga. Leticia Chinyamula, Vitumbiko Mkandawire and Maggie Chavula also came in. But the Scorchers could not score against Ghana.

Back home in Malawi, the National Bank of Malawi helped fans to watch the team. The bank gave free plane tickets to three people on Wednesday in Blantyre. They won tickets in a bank promotion called 'Wa ku Wafcon'. This means fans can travel to Morocco to cheer for the Scorchers.

ny.title: Malawi yagonja 4-0 ndi Ghana isanafike mpikisano wa Africa Cup of Nations.
ny.body: Timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi idagonjetsedwa ndi Ghana 4-0 pamasewera oyeserera asanafike mpikisano wa CAF Women's Africa Cup of Nations ku Morocco. Doris Boaduwaa wa ku Ghana adagoletsa zigoli zitatu. Sharon Sampson adagoletsa chimodzi. Masewerawa adachitikira ku Municipal de Berrechid Stadium.
ny.body_more:
Uku kunali kutayika kwachiwiri kwa Malawi pamasewera awiri oyeserera. Sabata yatha, timuyi idagonjetsedwa ndi Morocco 2-1. Scorchers imasewera masewera awo oyamba enieni Lachiwiri. Adzakumana ndi Nigeria, omwe ndi akatswiri oteteza, mu Gulu C.

Mphunzitsi wamkulu Lovemore Fazili adagwiritsa ntchito timu yosiyana ndi ya masiku onse. Sanasewere Tabitha Chawinga, kaputeni yemwe amasewera ku France. Mlongo wake Temwa Chawinga, yemwe amasewera ku United States, adabweranso ndikusewera powukira. Osewera ena omwe adayamba anali Rose Kadzere, Madyina Ngulube, Bernadette Mkandawire, Rose Alufandika, Sabina Thom, Faith Chimzimu, Tendai Sani ndi Chimwemwe Madise.

Fazili adasinthanso chigoli. Adapatsa Yamikani Kaonga, yemwe amasewera ku MDF Lioness, chigoli chake choyamba. Wosewera wanthawi zonse ndi Mercy Sikelo wa Civil Service Women. Mu theka lachiwiri, Fazili adasintha zambiri. Sikelo adalowa m'malo mwa Kaonga. Leticia Chinyamula, Vitumbiko Mkandawire ndi Maggie Chavula nawonso adalowa. Koma Scorchers sanathe kupeza chigoli motsutsana ndi Ghana.

Tili ku Malawi, National Bank of Malawi idathandiza mafani kuti aziwonera timuyi. Bankiyo idapereka matikiti aulere a ndege kwa anthu atatu Lachitatu ku Blantyre. Adapambana matikiti mu kampeni ya banki yotchedwa 'Wa ku Wafcon'. Izi zikutanthauza kuti mafani amatha kupita ku Morocco kukalimbikitsa Scorchers.

en.title: Vice-President Ansah escapes unhurt after tyre burst
en.body: First Vice-President Jane Ansah escaped unhurt on Wednesday after her official vehicle had a tyre burst. The car broke down while she travelled from Blantyre to Lilongwe, near Ntcheu. The Vice-President's office said she was safe. She was travelling in a Toyota Land Cruiser 300 VX.
en.body_more:
Richard Mveriwa, spokesman for the Office of the Vice-President, told the public about the incident. He asked for more time before giving further details. The government started an investigation to find out why the tyre burst.

Video on social media showed the Vice-President's motorcade stopped on the roadside. Security officers stood outside the vehicle. National Police deputy spokesperson Alfred Chimthere said the Office of the Vice-President was best placed to comment on what happened.

This incident comes three months after police arrested Esau Nalikole. Nalikole is 32 years old and works as a videographer. He was charged with criminal trespass and flying a drone over the Vice-President's home in Area 3, Lilongwe. The drone was flying live coverage when security officers saw it. Nalikole's case is still in court.

Malawi has seen other motorcade incidents before. In 2020, a vehicle in the late Vice-President Saulos Chilima's motorcade crashed near Phalula in Balaka. A Toyota Vitz hit another car in the convoy. Four people died in that crash. Chilima was not hurt. In 2010, a car on then Vice-President Joyce Banda's motorcade was hit by another vehicle at Kanengo in Lilongwe. Banda was travelling in a different car in the convoy at that time.

ny.title: Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Ansah wapulumuka osavulala tayala litaphulika
ny.body: Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah adapulumuka osavulala Lachitatu galimoto yake yovomerezeka itaphulika tayala. Galimotoyo idawonongeka pamene iye ankayenda kuchokera ku Blantyre kupita ku Lilongwe, pafupi ndi Ntcheu. Ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti idati ali bwino. Iye anali paulendo mu Toyota Land Cruiser 300 VX.
ny.body_more:
Richard Mveriwa, wolankhulira Ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti, adauza anthu za nkhaniyi. Adapempha nthawi yochulukirapo asanapereke zambiri. Boma linayamba kufufuza kuti lidziwe chifukwa chake tayala linaphulika.

Kanema pa malo ochezera a pa Intaneti adawonetsa kuti galimoto ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti inayima pamsewu. Apolisi anaima kunja kwa galimotoyo. Wachiwiri kwa wolankhulira apolisi a dziko lonse Alfred Chimthere adati Ofesi ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti ndiyo inali pamalo abwino oti afotokoze zomwe zinachitika.

Chochitikachi chikuchitika miyezi itatu apolisi atamanga Esau Nalikole. Nalikole ali ndi zaka 32 ndipo amagwira ntchito yojambula makanema. Anaimbidwa mlandu wolowa m'malo mwa apolisi ndikuyendetsa drone pamwamba pa nyumba ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti ku Area 3, Lilongwe. Droneyo inali kuuluka pompopompo pomwe apolisi adaiwona. Nkhani ya Nalikole ikadali kukhothi.

Malawi yawonapo zochitika zina za magalimoto kale. Mu 2020, galimoto yomwe inali m'galimoto ya Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Saulos Chilima inagwa pafupi ndi Phalula ku Balaka. Galimoto ya Toyota Vitz inagunda galimoto ina yomwe inali m'galimoto. Anthu anayi anamwalira pangoziyo. Chilima sanavulale. Mu 2010, galimoto yomwe inali pa msasa wa Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Joyce Banda inagundidwa ndi galimoto ina ku Kanengo ku Lilongwe. Banda anali kuyenda mgalimoto ina m'galimotoyo panthawiyo.

en.title: Government plans new homes for Kasasile families
en.body: Malawi's government says it will move families from Kasasile in Nkhata Bay District to one new home. Minister Chimwemwe Chipungu met Members of Parliament on Wednesday to talk about the plan. The families now live in a temporary shelter at Thungwe.
en.body_more:
The government will look for land in a neighbouring district. All the families will go to the same place. This is a new plan to help them. Amani Mussa is the Principal Secretary for Lands. He said the Ministry of Lands is looking for the land now.

About 367 families from Kasasile are marching to Lilongwe. They want to ask the government to help them. They say soldiers from the Malawi Defence Force told them to leave their homes many years ago. They have lived in temporary shelter for a long time. Now they want real homes and answers about when they can move.

The government is working with many groups to help. The Department of Disaster Management Affairs (DoDMA) will give food and help while the families wait. District councils will also help. A new committee has been made. It has Members of Parliament and workers from the Ministry of Lands, DoDMA and other government groups. This committee will find good land and help the families until they move to their new homes.

Amani Mussa said the government will do this in a fair and kind way. He said the government will keep the families safe and give them respect. But the families say old promises did not work. They want the government to act fast now. They say they cannot wait longer in the temporary shelter.

ny.title: Boma likukonzekera nyumba zatsopano za mabanja a ku Kasasile
ny.body: Boma la Malawi lati lisuntha mabanja kuchokera ku Kasasile ku Nkhata Bay District kupita ku nyumba yatsopano. Nduna Chimwemwe Chipungu adakumana ndi aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo Lachitatu kuti akambirane za dongosololi. Mabanjawa tsopano akukhala m'malo osungira anthu osakhalitsa ku Thungwe.
ny.body_more:
Boma lidzafunafuna malo m'chigawo chapafupi. Mabanja onse adzapita kumalo amodzi. Iyi ndi njira yatsopano yowathandiza. Amani Mussa ndiye Mlembi Wamkulu wa Malo. Anati Unduna wa Malo ukufuna malo tsopano.

Mabanja pafupifupi 367 ochokera ku Kasasile akupita ku Lilongwe. Akufuna kupempha boma kuti liwathandize. Akuti asilikali ochokera ku Malawi Defense Force adawauza kuti achoke m'nyumba zawo zaka zambiri zapitazo. Akhala m'malo osungira anthu kwakanthawi kwa nthawi yayitali. Tsopano akufuna nyumba zenizeni ndi mayankho okhudza nthawi yomwe angasamukire.

Boma likugwira ntchito ndi magulu ambiri kuti athandize. Dipatimenti Yoona za Masoka (DoDMA) ipereka chakudya ndi thandizo pamene mabanja akudikira. Mabungwe a madera nawonso athandiza. Komiti yatsopano yapangidwa. Ili ndi Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo ndi antchito ochokera ku Unduna wa Malo, DoDMA ndi magulu ena aboma. Komitiyi ipeza malo abwino ndikuthandizira mabanja mpaka atasamukira m'nyumba zawo zatsopano.

Amani Mussa adati boma lichita izi mwachilungamo komanso mokoma mtima. Iye anati boma lidzateteza mabanjawo ndi kuwalemekeza. Koma mabanjawo akuti malonjezo akale sanagwire ntchito. Akufuna kuti boma lichitepo kanthu mwachangu tsopano. Akuti sangadikire nthawi yayitali m'malo osungira anthu osakhalitsa.

en.title: Procurement must help drive business growth, says MIPS
en.body: The Malawi Institute of Procurement and Supply held a workshop in Salima on Thursday. Its leader, Amos Nyambo, told procurement workers they must help shape business plans. Procurement means buying goods and services. Mr Nyambo said it must do more than just buy things. It must help companies grow and do well.
en.body_more:
The workshop took place at Sunbird Livingstonia Beach Hotel. Its theme was "Aligning Procurement Operations with Business Strategy". Workers came from government, private companies and charities.

Mr Nyambo said the world has changed. Money problems, new technology, climate shocks, new laws and what customers want all make procurement harder. Companies like Coca-Cola, Toyota, Apple, Ford and Tesla now use procurement workers to help make big decisions. These workers help shape what products the companies make and which markets they enter.

When procurement aligns with company goals, it helps in many ways. It brings new ideas. It makes companies strong and able to handle problems. It helps companies compete better. It creates value that lasts long. Mr Nyambo said MIPS wants to train leaders in procurement. These leaders must work with honesty and new ideas. They must help Malawi's economy grow.

Business leaders can take steps now. They should know who their key suppliers are. They should link buying decisions to company goals like selling in new places or helping the environment. They should train workers in good buying practices. When companies use procurement this way, they save money and work better with other suppliers. The message is clear: procurement is not just a back office job. It is a partner that helps companies win and grow.

ny.title: MIPS yati kugula zinthu kuyenera kuthandiza kukula kwa bizinesi
ny.body: Bungwe la Malawi Institute of Procurement and Supply linachita msonkhano ku Salima Lachinayi. Mtsogoleri wake, Amos Nyambo, anauza ogwira ntchito yogula zinthu kuti ayenera kuthandiza kukonza mapulani a bizinesi. Kugula zinthu kumatanthauza kugula katundu ndi ntchito. Bambo Nyambo anati kuyenera kuchita zambiri osati kungogula zinthu zokha. Kuyenera kuthandiza makampani kukula ndikuchita bwino.
ny.body_more:
Msonkhanowu unachitikira ku Sunbird Livingstonia Beach Hotel. Mutu wake unali wakuti "Kugwirizanitsa Ntchito Zogula ndi Ndondomeko Yabizinesi". Ogwira ntchito anachokera ku boma, makampani achinsinsi ndi mabungwe othandiza anthu.

A Nyambo anati dziko lasintha. Mavuto azachuma, ukadaulo watsopano, kusintha kwa nyengo, malamulo atsopano ndi zomwe makasitomala amafuna zonse zimapangitsa kuti kugula kukhale kovuta. Makampani monga Coca-Cola, Toyota, Apple, Ford ndi Tesla tsopano akugwiritsa ntchito ogwira ntchito zogula kuti athandize kupanga zisankho zazikulu. Ogwira ntchito awa amathandiza kupanga zinthu zomwe makampani amapanga komanso misika yomwe amalowa.

Kugula kukagwirizana ndi zolinga za kampani, kumathandiza m'njira zambiri. Kumabweretsa malingaliro atsopano. Kumapangitsa makampani kukhala olimba komanso okhoza kuthana ndi mavuto. Kumathandiza makampani kupikisana bwino. Kumapanga phindu lomwe limakhala nthawi yayitali. A Nyambo anati MIPS ikufuna kuphunzitsa atsogoleri pankhani yogula. Atsogoleri awa ayenera kugwira ntchito moona mtima komanso ndi malingaliro atsopano. Ayenera kuthandiza chuma cha Malawi kukula.

Atsogoleri amalonda akhoza kuchitapo kanthu tsopano. Ayenera kudziwa omwe amawagulitsa ofunikira. Ayenera kulumikiza zisankho zogula ndi zolinga za kampani monga kugulitsa m'malo atsopano kapena kuthandiza chilengedwe. Ayenera kuphunzitsa antchito njira zabwino zogulira.
