Makampani akamagwiritsa ntchito kugula zinthu motere, amasunga ndalama ndipo amagwira ntchito bwino ndi ogulitsa ena. Uthenga wake ndi womveka bwino: kugula zinthu si ntchito yongochitika ku ofesi yokha. Ndi mgwirizano womwe umathandiza makampani kupambana ndikukula.

en.title: Five church leaders face charges in Ntcheu
en.body: Five leaders of a church in Ntcheu face charges about children's rights. Police say they stopped church members from going to hospital and sending children to school. They all come from Ndagoma Village. The church is called Tembenukani Mitima Kubwera kwa Ambuye Kwayandikira. A court in Ntcheu heard the case.
en.body_more:
The five accused are Stella Monta (40), Monta Monta (40), Havey Monta (21), Willy Monta (22), and Memory Mwale (35). When they first came to court, they did not answer questions. They said "God must answer everything." The magistrate told them a court is not a church. They must follow the law, not only religion.

The police first charged them under Section 242 of the Penal Code. This law says people cannot harm children's rights. The government then changed the charges to Sections 80 and 83. These laws are about child protection and justice. All five said they did not do these things. They said their faith guided their actions.

Four of the accused asked the court for bail. Bail means they can stay out of prison until the next court date. They said they live near the court and will not run away. One said he needs to work to feed his children. The magistrate, His Worship Chimdima Phiri, gave each person bail. Each must pay K50,000 and find one person to promise they will come back to court. They must report to police every third week. They cannot leave Ntcheu District without telling the police. The next court date is 4 August 2026.

ny.title: Atsogoleri asanu a tchalitchi akuimbidwa mlandu ku Ntcheu
ny.body: Atsogoleri asanu a tchalitchi ku Ntcheu akuimbidwa mlandu wokhudza ufulu wa ana. Apolisi ati adaletsa mamembala a tchalitchi kupita kuchipatala ndi kutumiza ana kusukulu. Onse amachokera ku Mudzi wa Ndagoma. Tchalitchichi chimatchedwa Tembenukani Mitima Kubwera kwa Mulungu Kwayandikira. Khothi ku Ntcheu linamva mlanduwu.
ny.body_more:
Oimbidwa mlandu asanu ndi Stella Monta (40), Monta Monta (40), Havey Monta (21), Willy Monta (22), ndi Memory Mwale (35). Atafika koyamba kukhothi, sanayankhe mafunso. Anati "Mulungu ayenera kuyankha chilichonse." Woweruza milandu anawauza kuti khothi si tchalitchi. Ayenera kutsatira lamulo, osati chipembedzo chokha.

Apolisi anayamba kuwaimba mlandu motsatira Gawo 242 la Malamulo Okhudza Milandu. Lamuloli limati anthu sangawononge ufulu wa ana. Kenako boma linasintha milanduyo kukhala Gawo 80 ndi 83. Malamulowa ndi okhudza kuteteza ana ndi chilungamo. Onse asanu anati sanachite izi. Anati chikhulupiriro chawo chimawatsogolera pa zochita zawo.

Anthu anayi mwa oimbidwa mlanduwo anapempha khothi kuti liwapatse belo. Belo limatanthauza kuti akhoza kukhala kunja kwa ndende mpaka tsiku lotsatira la khothi. Anati amakhala pafupi ndi khothi ndipo sadzathawa. Mmodzi anati ayenera kugwira ntchito kuti adyetse ana ake. Woweruza milandu, Wolambira Chimdima Phiri, anapereka belo kwa munthu aliyense. Aliyense ayenera kulipira K50,000 ndikupeza munthu m'modzi wolonjeza kuti adzabweranso kukhothi. Ayenera kukaonekera kupolisi sabata iliyonse yachitatu. Sangachoke m'boma la Ntcheu osauza apolisi. Tsiku lotsatira la khothi ndi pa 4 Ogasiti 2026.

en.title: Commonwealth Games in Glasgow Start Today
en.body: The Commonwealth Games start today in Glasgow, Scotland. Athletes from 56 nations will come to play sport for two weeks. Mwawi Kumwenda will play for Malawi. But the real prize for Commonwealth countries is trade and business, not just sport.
en.body_more:
The Commonwealth has 2.7 billion people in it. These people live on every continent. India is the biggest country. Some countries in the Commonwealth are very small. More than half of Commonwealth people are under 30 years old.

Trade between Commonwealth countries is cheaper than trade with other countries. History helps this happen. Commonwealth countries share the same language, the same laws, and the same ways of doing business. This makes buying and selling easier.

In November, Commonwealth leaders will meet in Antigua and Barbuda. This meeting is called the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM). The leaders will talk about trade and business. They will ask how to make trade stronger between Commonwealth countries. The world is changing fast. Countries are fighting over trade. International groups do not work well. So the Commonwealth must use its strength. Trust is important now. Commonwealth countries trust each other because they know each other well.

Countries should remove taxes on trade. They should make rules the same. They should make it easy for business people to move between countries. They should build supply chains together. They should use the same digital ways to trade. The Commonwealth already has some of these plans. But countries must do the work. CHOGM must push countries to act. The Commonwealth must help people get jobs and build businesses. This is the real power of the Commonwealth.

ny.title: Masewera a Commonwealth ku Glasgow Ayamba Lero
ny.body: Masewera a Commonwealth ayamba lero ku Glasgow, Scotland. Othamanga ochokera m'mayiko 56 abwera kudzasewera masewera kwa milungu iwiri. Mwawi Kumwenda adzasewera ku Malawi. Koma mphoto yeniyeni ya mayiko a Commonwealth ndi malonda ndi bizinesi, osati masewera okha.
ny.body_more:
Bungwe la Commonwealth lili ndi anthu 2.7 biliyoni. Anthuwa amakhala m'dziko lililonse. India ndi dziko lalikulu kwambiri. Mayiko ena m'bungwe la Commonwealth ndi ochepa kwambiri. Anthu opitilira theka la anthu a Commonwealth ali ndi zaka zosakwana 30.

Malonda pakati pa mayiko a Commonwealth ndi otsika mtengo kuposa malonda ndi mayiko ena. Mbiri imathandiza kuti izi zitheke. Mayiko a Commonwealth ali ndi chilankhulo chimodzi, malamulo omwewo, komanso njira zomwezo zochitira bizinesi. Izi zimapangitsa kugula ndi kugulitsa kukhala kosavuta.

Mu Novembala, atsogoleri a Commonwealth adzakumana ku Antigua ndi Barbuda. Msonkhanowu umatchedwa Msonkhano wa Atsogoleri a Boma la Commonwealth (CHOGM). Atsogoleriwo adzakambirana za malonda ndi bizinesi. Adzafunsa momwe angapangire malonda kukhala olimba pakati pa mayiko a Commonwealth. Dziko likusintha mwachangu. Mayiko akukangana chifukwa cha malonda. Magulu apadziko lonse lapansi sagwira ntchito bwino. Chifukwa chake Commonwealth iyenera kugwiritsa ntchito mphamvu zake. Kudalirana ndikofunikira tsopano. Mayiko a Commonwealth akukhulupirirana chifukwa amadziwana bwino.

Mayiko ayenera kuchotsa misonkho pamalonda. Ayenera kupanga malamulo ofanana. Ayenera kupangitsa kuti anthu amalonda azisuntha mosavuta pakati pa mayiko. Ayenera kumanga unyolo wogulira pamodzi. Ayenera kugwiritsa ntchito njira zomwezo za digito pogulitsa. Bungwe la Commonwealth lili kale ndi mapulani ena mwa awa. Koma mayiko ayenera kugwira ntchito. CHOGM iyenera kukakamiza mayiko kuti achitepo kanthu. Bungwe la Commonwealth liyenera kuthandiza anthu kupeza ntchito ndikumanga mabizinesi. Iyi ndiye mphamvu yeniyeni ya Commonwealth.

en.title: UK business leaders give K5m to Malawi Queens netball team
en.body: Four UK-based Malawian business leaders gave K5 million to the Malawi Queens netball team. The Queens prepare for the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. They play South Africa on 25 July. Head coach Debbie Fuller said thank you to the leaders.
en.body_more:
The four business leaders are Rhodrick Kalumpha, Abdul Chazolokera Chirwa, Sheriff Kaunde and Saidi Phiri. Sheriff Kaunde is Managing Partner at Liberty Immigration Services. Saidi Phiri is Managing Director of Dusk Commercials Limited. The donation shows their belief in Malawi's sports teams.

Liberty Immigration Services is a law firm based in Leicester. It helps UK and international clients with immigration law. Dusk Commercials is based in Manchester. It moves goods by ship and plane across the UK and Europe. It serves the SADC region and Malawi. This is the second year the four leaders gave money to the Queens. They also gave money when the team visited London last year.

Saidi Phiri said the donation shows respect for the players' hard work. He told the team to keep working hard and aim high. Malawi belonged among the world's best netball nations before, he said, and this team can bring that back. Debbie Fuller thanked the business leaders for their support and patriotism. She said it was good to see Malawian business people help their own country.

The Queens arrived in Glasgow on Tuesday after training in Manchester. They played New Zealand, England's men's team and England A. Fuller said the team has good strategies and speed. But she said they need to improve accuracy. The team plays Northern Ireland on 26 July, then England on 27 July. After that they play Australia and Tonga.

ny.title: Atsogoleri a mabizinesi ku UK apereka K5 miliyoni ku timu ya Malawi Queens ya netiboli
ny.body: Atsogoleri anayi amalonda aku Malawi ochokera ku UK apereka K5 miliyoni ku timu ya netiboli ya Malawi Queens. A Queens akukonzekera Masewera a Commonwealth ku Glasgow. Adzasewera ndi South Africa pa 25 Julayi. Mphunzitsi wamkulu Debbie Fuller wati zikomo kwa atsogoleri.
ny.body_more:
Atsogoleri anayi a mabizinesi ndi Rhodrick Kalumpha, Abdul Chazolokera Chirwa, Sheriff Kaunde ndi Saidi Phiri. Sheriff Kaunde ndi Managing Partner ku Liberty Immigration Services. Saidi Phiri ndi Managing Director wa Dusk Commercials Limited. Choperekachi chikusonyeza kuti amakhulupirira magulu amasewera aku Malawi.

Liberty Immigration Services ndi kampani ya zamalamulo yomwe ili ku Leicester. Imathandiza makasitomala aku UK ndi mayiko ena ndi malamulo okhudza anthu osamukira kumayiko ena. Dusk Commercials ili ku Manchester. Imasuntha katundu ndi sitima ndi ndege kudutsa UK ndi Europe. Imatumikira dera la SADC ndi Malawi. Ichi ndi chaka chachiwiri atsogoleri anayiwa apereka ndalama kwa a Queens. Anaperekanso ndalama pamene gululo linapita ku London chaka chatha.

Saidi Phiri adati choperekachi chikusonyeza kulemekeza ntchito yolimba ya osewera. Anauza gululo kuti lipitirize kugwira ntchito molimbika ndi cholinga chapamwamba. Malawi inali pakati pa mayiko abwino kwambiri padziko lonse lapansi, adatero, ndipo gululi likhoza kubweretsanso zimenezo. Debbie Fuller adathokoza atsogoleri a mabizinesi chifukwa chothandizira komanso kukonda dziko lawo. Anati zinali zabwino kuona amalonda aku Malawi akuthandiza dziko lawo.


A Queens adafika ku Glasgow Lachiwiri atamaliza maphunziro awo ku Manchester. Adasewera ndi New Zealand, timu ya amuna ya England ndipo England A. Fuller adati timuyi ili ndi njira zabwino komanso liwiro labwino. Koma iye adati akuyenera kukonza kulondola kwawo. Timuyi idzasewera ndi Northern Ireland pa 26 Julayi, kenako England pa 27 Julayi. Pambuyo pake adzasewera ndi Australia ndi Tonga.

en.title: Airtel Africa reports strong growth in first quarter
en.body: Airtel Africa says its revenue rose much higher in the first quarter of 2026. For the three months to 30 June 2026, the company made $1.853 billion. This is 31 percent more than the same time last year. The growth came from more people using data services and mobile money.
en.body_more:
The company now has 189 million customers. This is 11.6 percent more than before. More people are using smartphones and buying mobile data services. Data customers grew to 87.3 million. Each customer now uses 10.6 gigabytes of data per month. This is much more than 7.8 gigabytes one year ago.

Mobile money business also grew fast. The company's Airtel Money service now has 56.5 million customers. This is 23.3 percent more than the same quarter last year. The money moved through the service was $245 billion per year. This is 51.5 percent more than before.

Chief Executive Officer Sunil Taldar said the company is doing well. He said Airtel Africa is making it simpler for customers to use its services. The company is using data and artificial intelligence to help customers better. Profit after tax was $198 million, up from $156 million. The company spent $389 million on new network sites. It added more than 920 new sites during the quarter. The fibre network now reaches 82,100 kilometres.

Airtel Africa also said it wants to move its Airtel Money service to London. The company wants to list on the London stock market. This will help the company bring in money from other countries. The board agreed to buy back some of its own shares. It bought back 10.2 million shares for $46.6 million.

ny.title: Airtel Africa yalengeza kukula kwakukulu mu kotala loyamba la chaka chino
ny.body: Airtel Africa ikunena kuti ndalama zomwe inapeza zinakwera kwambiri mu kotala yoyamba ya 2026. Kwa miyezi itatu mpaka pa 30 Juni 2026, kampaniyo inapeza $1.853 biliyoni. Izi ndi 31 peresenti kuposa nthawi yomweyi chaka chatha. Kukula kumeneku kunabwera chifukwa cha anthu ambiri omwe amagwiritsa ntchito ntchito za data ndi ndalama zam'manja.
ny.body_more:
Kampaniyo tsopano ili ndi makasitomala 189 miliyoni. Izi ndi 11.6 peresenti kuposa kale. Anthu ambiri akugwiritsa ntchito mafoni a m'manja ndikugula ntchito za data pafoni. Makasitomala a data adakula kufika pa 87.3 miliyoni. Kasitomala aliyense tsopano akugwiritsa ntchito ma gigabytes 10.6 a data pamwezi. Izi ndi zoposa ma gigabytes 7.8 chaka chapitacho.

Bizinesi ya ndalama za m'manja idakulanso mwachangu. Utumiki wa Airtel Money wa kampaniyo tsopano uli ndi makasitomala 56.5 miliyoni. Izi ndi 23.3 peresenti kuposa kotala lomwelo chaka chatha. Ndalama zomwe zidatumizidwa kudzera muutumikiwu zinali $245 biliyoni pachaka. Izi ndi 51.5 peresenti kuposa kale.

Mkulu wa bungwe Sunil Taldar adati kampaniyo ikuyenda bwino. Anati Airtel Africa ikupangitsa kuti makasitomala azigwiritsa ntchito mosavuta ntchito zake. Kampaniyo ikugwiritsa ntchito deta ndi luntha lochita kupanga kuti athandize makasitomala bwino. Phindu pambuyo pa msonkho linali $198 miliyoni, kuchokera pa $156 miliyoni. Kampaniyo idagwiritsa ntchito $389 miliyoni pa mawebusayiti atsopano a netiweki. Yawonjezera mawebusayiti atsopano opitilira 920 mu kotala. Netiweki ya fiber tsopano yafika makilomita 82,100.

Airtel Africa yatinso ikufuna kusamutsa ntchito yake ya Airtel Money kupita ku London. Kampaniyo ikufuna kulembedwa pamsika wamasheya ku London. Izi zithandiza kampaniyo kubweretsa ndalama kuchokera kumayiko ena. Bungweli lavomereza kugulanso magawo ake ena. Linagulanso magawo 10.2 miliyoni pamtengo wa $46.6 miliyoni.

en.title: First runner-up to go to Miss World instead of reigning Miss Malawi
en.body: Malawi will send first runner-up Irene Navicha to Miss World 2026, not the reigning Miss Malawi Thandie Chisi. The Miss Malawi Organisation made this choice. Navicha will go to Vietnam in August for the 73rd Miss World pageant. The decision has caused much talk on social media.
en.body_more:
Many people have asked questions about why Chisi was not chosen. Chisi is still young enough for Miss World. She will be 27 years old when the pageant happens on 5 September 2026. Miss World allows women aged 17 to 27 to join. Other countries are sending women who are also 27 years old to Miss World 2026.

Irene Navicha is 20 years old. She is the daughter of Minister of Women and Gender Mary Navicha. Some people online have asked if her family helped her get chosen. The Miss Malawi Organisation has not said this is true. No proof of this has been found.

Stephen Mdala from the Miss Malawi Organisation said the choice looked at age rules and other things. He said how well a woman's work matched Miss World's ideas also mattered. Despite the talk online, Thandie Chisi said she will help Navicha. "We have not sent anyone to Miss World for a long time," Chisi said. "We should all be proud of this. We should all help Navicha, not argue." Chisi said Malawi's return to the world stage is more important than any one person.

The Miss Malawi Organisation hopes Navicha will show the world Malawi's beauty, culture and good work in her community.

ny.title: Wachiwiri pa nambala 2 kupita ku Miss World m'malo mwa Miss Malawi
ny.body: Malawi idzatumiza Irene Navicha yemwe wapambana paudindo wa Miss World 2026, osati Thandie Chisi yemwe wapambana paudindo wa Miss Malawi. Bungwe la Miss Malawi linasankha izi. Navicha adzapita ku Vietnam mu Ogasiti kukachita nawo mpikisano wa 73 wa Miss World. Chisankhochi chabweretsa nkhani zambiri pa malo ochezera a pa Intaneti.
ny.body_more:
Anthu ambiri afunsa mafunso okhudza chifukwa chake Chisi sanasankhidwe. Chisi akadali wamng'ono mokwanira kukhala Miss World. Adzakhala ndi zaka 27 pamene mpikisanowu udzachitika pa 5 Seputembala 2026. Miss World imalola akazi azaka zapakati pa 17 ndi 27 kuti alowe nawo. Mayiko ena akutumiza akazi omwe ali ndi zaka 27 ku Miss World 2026.

Irene Navicha ali ndi zaka 20. Ndi mwana wamkazi wa Nduna ya Akazi ndi Jenda Mary Navicha. Anthu ena pa intaneti afunsa ngati banja lake linamuthandiza kuti asankhidwe. Bungwe la Miss Malawi silinanene kuti izi ndi zoona. Palibe umboni wa izi womwe wapezeka.

Stephen Mdala wa bungwe la Miss Malawi anati chisankhocho chimayang'ana malamulo a zaka ndi zina. Anati momwe ntchito ya mkazi imagwirizanirana ndi malingaliro a Miss World inali yofunikanso. Ngakhale kuti nkhaniyo inali pa intaneti, Thandie Chisi anati athandiza Navicha. "Sitinatumize aliyense ku Miss World kwa nthawi yayitali," adatero Chisi. "Tonsefe tiyenera kunyadira izi. Tonsefe tiyenera kuthandiza Navicha, osati kukangana." Chisi anati kubwerera kwa Malawi padziko lonse lapansi n'kofunika kwambiri kuposa munthu aliyense.

Bungwe la Miss Malawi likuyembekeza kuti Navicha adzawonetsa dziko lonse kukongola, chikhalidwe ndi ntchito zabwino za Malawi m'dera lake.

en.title: Women MPs warn: gender violence cases stay very high
en.body: Women Members of Parliament say gender violence cases in Malawi are very high. They gave a report in Parliament in Lilongwe on Wednesday. The cases went up from 20,827 in 2022 to 24,900 in 2024. In 2025 there were 24,467 cases. The caucus leader is Mary Maulidi Khembo.
en.body_more:
Women are the main victims of gender violence. In 2025, 22,312 victims were women. Children make up about 13 out of every 100 victims. The most common type of violence is emotional abuse. This means using words or actions that hurt someone's feelings. But economic abuse and physical abuse are also growing fast. Economic abuse means stopping someone from having money or work.

The report says the Ministry of Gender, Children, Disability and Social Welfare does not have enough money. It also has not enough vehicles, staff, and computers. The police have units that help victims, but they need more cars and more trained workers. The report asks the government to give at least K500 million for this work. It also asks for new vehicles, computers to share information, and more police officers.

The Women's Caucus asked for the Gender Equality Act to be stronger. This law must have bigger punishments for those who break it. The law must also cover violence that happens on phones and computers. The report also asks for help from traditional leaders and religious leaders. These leaders can teach people that violence is wrong. The report says all groups — government, communities, churches, and civil society — must work together to stop gender violence.

The Caucus also said men must change their thinking. Programmes must teach men to respect women and girls. The government must work with traditional and religious leaders to teach communities that violence is not right.

ny.title: Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo Azimayi Achenjeza Kuti Milandu Yankhanza Yokhudza Kugonana Ikupitirirabe Kukwera
ny.body: Azimayi a Nyumba Yamalamulo akuti milandu ya nkhanza za amuna ndi akazi ku Malawi ndi yokwera kwambiri. Adapereka lipoti ku Nyumba Yamalamulo ku Lilongwe Lachitatu. Milanduyi idakwera kuchoka pa 20,827 mu 2022 kufika pa 24,900 mu 2024. Mu 2025 panali milandu 24,467. Mtsogoleri wa bungweli ndi Mary Maulidi Khembo.
ny.body_more:
Azimayi ndi omwe akuzunzidwa kwambiri ndi nkhanza za amuna kapena akazi. Mu 2025, anthu 22,312 omwe akuzunzidwa anali akazi. Ana amapanga pafupifupi 13 mwa anthu 100 aliwonse omwe akuzunzidwa. Mtundu wofala kwambiri wa nkhanza ndi nkhanza zamaganizo. Izi zikutanthauza kugwiritsa ntchito mawu kapena zochita zomwe zimapweteka malingaliro a wina. Koma nkhanza zachuma ndi nkhanza zakuthupi zikukulirakulira mofulumira. Nkhanza zachuma zikutanthauza kuletsa munthu kukhala ndi ndalama kapena ntchito.

Lipotilo likuti Unduna wa Jenda, Ana, Olumala ndi Ubwino wa Anthu ulibe ndalama zokwanira. Ulibenso magalimoto okwanira, antchito, ndi makompyuta. Apolisi ali ndi magulu othandiza ozunzidwa, koma amafunikira magalimoto ambiri ndi antchito ophunzitsidwa bwino. Lipotilo likupempha boma kuti lipereke ndalama zosachepera K500 miliyoni pa ntchitoyi. Likupemphanso magalimoto atsopano, makompyuta kuti agawane zambiri, ndi apolisi ambiri.

Gulu la Akazi lapempha kuti lamulo la Gender Equality Act likhale lolimba. Lamuloli liyenera kukhala ndi zilango zazikulu kwa iwo omwe akuliphwanya. Lamuloli liyeneranso kuphimba chiwawa chomwe chimachitika pafoni ndi makompyuta. Lipotilo likupemphanso thandizo kuchokera kwa atsogoleri achikhalidwe ndi atsogoleri achipembedzo. Atsogoleri awa akhoza kuphunzitsa anthu kuti chiwawa n'cholakwika. Lipotilo likuti magulu onse — boma, madera, matchalitchi, ndi mabungwe aboma — ayenera kugwira ntchito limodzi kuti athetse nkhanza za amuna ndi akazi.

A Caucus adatinso amuna ayenera kusintha maganizo awo. Mapulogalamu ayenera kuphunzitsa amuna kulemekeza akazi ndi atsikana. Boma liyenera kugwira ntchito ndi atsogoleri achikhalidwe ndi achipembedzo kuti aphunzitse madera kuti chiwawa sichoyenera.

en.title: Parliament needs K400 million for African conference
en.body: Parliament says it needs K400 million more to host a big African conference in August. Speaker Sameer Suleman said the total cost is K800 to K900 million. Over 300 people from Africa will come. The meeting is at the Bingu Convention Centre in Lilongwe from 9 to 16 August.
en.body_more:
Suleman is the Speaker of Parliament and leader of the Commonwealth Parliamentary Association (CPA) Africa Region. He told news people in Lilongwe that the CPA gave £25,000. China gave $20,000. But more money is still needed.

The conference will have many important people. Over 300 delegates will come from across Africa and beyond. This includes Speakers and Presiding Officers of Parliament from different countries. MPs, clerks and parliamentary staff will also attend. Development partners and observers will come too. The CPA chose Malawi to host because people trust Malawi's Parliament.

The meeting's theme is "Renewing the Social Contract: Parliaments as Catalysts for Inclusive Growth and Citizen Trust." The conference will talk about many things. These are: making democratic institutions strong, making parliamentary oversight better, promoting good governance, and making legislatures more effective. The talks will focus on sustainable development and regional cooperation. Suleman said this theme matches Malawi 2063. This is Malawi's long-term development plan. The conference will help Parliament's role in accountable leadership, effective institutions, inclusive governance and citizen participation.

Suleman said hosting this conference will help Malawi's economy. Tourism, hospitality and transport businesses will get more work. People will buy more local products. He said Parliament has made good progress with preparations. Accommodation and transport are ready. Conference systems for checking people in and registration are almost done. Security and medical services are arranged. Suleman asked the private sector and other helpers to keep supporting the event.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo ikufunika K400 miliyoni kuti igwiritse ntchito pamsonkhano wa ku Africa
ny.body: Nyumba Yamalamulo ikunena kuti ikufunika K400 miliyoni kuti ichitire msonkhano waukulu wa ku Africa mu Ogasiti. Sipikala Sameer Suleman adati ndalama zonse zomwe zingagwiritsidwe ntchito ndi K800 mpaka K900 miliyoni. Anthu opitilira 300 ochokera ku Africa adzabwera. Msonkhanowu udzachitikira ku Bingu Convention Centre ku Lilongwe kuyambira pa 9 mpaka 16 Ogasiti.
ny.body_more:
Suleman ndi Sipika wa Nyumba Yamalamulo komanso mtsogoleri wa Commonwealth Parliamentary Association (CPA) Africa Region. Iye anauza anthu atolankhani ku Lilongwe kuti CPA inapereka £25,000. China inapereka $20,000. Koma ndalama zambiri zikufunikabe.

Msonkhanowu udzakhala ndi anthu ambiri ofunikira. Anthu opitilira 300 adzachokera ku Africa konse ndi kwina. Izi zikuphatikizapo Oyankhula ndi Akuluakulu a Nyumba Yamalamulo ochokera kumayiko osiyanasiyana. Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo, alembi ndi ogwira ntchito ku Nyumba Yamalamulo nawonso adzapezekapo. Ogwirizana ndi chitukuko ndi owonera nawonso adzabwera. CPA idasankha Malawi kuti ichite nawo chifukwa anthu amadalira Nyumba Yamalamulo ya Malawi.

Mutu wa msonkhanowu ndi "Kukonzanso Pangano la Anthu: Nyumba Zamalamulo Monga Zothandizira Kukula Konse ndi Citizen Trust." Msonkhanowu udzakambirana zinthu zambiri. Izi ndi: kupanga mabungwe a demokalase kukhala olimba, kupanga kuyang'anira nyumba yamalamulo kukhala bwino, kulimbikitsa ulamuliro wabwino, komanso kupanga nyumba zamalamulo kukhala zogwira mtima kwambiri. Zokambiranazi zidzayang'ana kwambiri pa chitukuko chokhazikika komanso mgwirizano wa madera. Suleman adati mutuwu ukugwirizana ndi Malawi 2063. Iyi ndi ndondomeko ya chitukuko cha nthawi yayitali ya Malawi. Msonkhanowu uthandiza udindo wa Nyumba Yamalamulo pa utsogoleri wodalirika, mabungwe ogwira ntchito bwino, ulamuliro wophatikiza anthu onse komanso kutenga nawo mbali kwa nzika.

Suleman adati kuchititsa msonkhanowu kudzathandiza chuma cha Malawi. Mabizinesi oyendera alendo, alendo ndi mayendedwe adzapeza ntchito zambiri. Anthu adzagula zinthu zambiri zakomweko. Anati Nyumba Yamalamulo yapita patsogolo bwino ndi kukonzekera. Malo ogona ndi mayendedwe akonzeka. Machitidwe a misonkhano yowunikira anthu ndi kulembetsa atsala pang'ono kutha. Ntchito zachitetezo ndi zamankhwala zakonzedwa. Suleman adapempha mabungwe azinsinsi ndi othandizira ena kuti apitirize kuthandizira mwambowu.

en.title: Malawi's export plan will miss its goal this year
en.body: Malawi's second National Export Strategy ends this year. The plan wanted exports to reach 20 percent of GDP. GDP is the total value of all goods and services a country makes. But exports are only about 14.6 percent of GDP now. The strategy will not reach its target.
en.body_more:
The National Export Strategy started in 2021. It was made to help Malawi sell more goods to other countries. When the plan began, exports were 14.6 percent of GDP. The government wanted to grow this to 20 percent by the end of five years. Now that time is almost over, and the goal will not be reached.

Business owners say the plan had good ideas, but it was hard to use. Many problems stopped the plan from working well. The government wants to sell more goods and earn more money from other countries. But the actual work to do this has been very difficult. Roads are not good. It costs too much money to do business. Malawian goods are not cheap enough to sell well in other countries.

Now the government will make a new export plan. Business owners say the new plan should help fix these problems. The next plan should make it easier and cheaper to do business. It should help Malawian goods compete with goods from other countries. The plan should also help farmers and makers add more value to what they grow and make. This means taking raw things and turning them into finished goods that sell for more money.

Business owners must watch what the government does next. The new plan will decide how much money companies can borrow. It will also decide what help the government gives to sellers. These things are very important for any business that wants to grow and sell to other countries.

ny.title: Dongosolo la Malawi lotumiza katundu kunja silikwaniritsa cholinga chake chaka chino
ny.body: Ndondomeko yachiwiri ya dziko lonse yotumiza katundu kunja kwa dziko la Malawi ikutha chaka chino. Ndondomekoyi imafuna kuti katundu wotumizidwa kunja afike pa 20 peresenti ya GDP. GDP ndi mtengo wonse wa katundu ndi ntchito zonse zomwe dziko limapanga. Koma katundu wotumizidwa kunja ndi pafupifupi 14.6 peresenti yokha ya GDP tsopano. Ndondomekoyi sidzafika pa cholinga chake.
ny.body_more:
Ndondomeko Yadziko Lonse Yogulitsa Zinthu Kunja inayamba mu 2021. Inapangidwa kuti ithandize Malawi kugulitsa katundu wambiri kumayiko ena. Pamene dongosololi linayamba, kutumiza katundu kunja kunali 14.6 peresenti ya GDP. Boma linkafuna kukulitsa izi kufika pa 20 peresenti pofika kumapeto kwa zaka zisanu. Tsopano nthawiyo yatsala pang'ono kutha, ndipo cholinga chake sichidzakwaniritsidwa.

Eni mabizinesi akuti dongosololi linali ndi malingaliro abwino, koma linali lovuta kugwiritsa ntchito. Mavuto ambiri analetsa dongosololi kugwira ntchito bwino. Boma likufuna kugulitsa katundu wambiri ndikupeza ndalama zambiri kuchokera kumayiko ena. Koma ntchito yeniyeni yochitira izi yakhala yovuta kwambiri. Misewu si yabwino. Zimawononga ndalama zambiri kuti bizinesi ichitike. Katundu waku Malawi si wotsika mtengo mokwanira kuti agulitsidwe bwino m'maiko ena.

Tsopano boma lipanga dongosolo latsopano lotumiza katundu kunja. Eni mabizinesi akuti dongosolo latsopanoli liyenera kuthandiza kukonza mavutowa. Dongosolo lotsatira liyenera kupangitsa kuti bizinesi ikhale yosavuta komanso yotsika mtengo. Liyenera kuthandiza katundu waku Malawi kupikisana ndi katundu wochokera kumayiko ena. Dongosololi liyeneranso kuthandiza alimi ndi opanga kuwonjezera phindu pa zomwe amalima ndikupanga. Izi zikutanthauza kutenga zinthu zosaphika ndikuzisandutsa zinthu zomalizidwa zomwe zimagulitsidwa kuti apeze ndalama zambiri.

Eni mabizinesi ayenera kuyang'anira zomwe boma lichita kenako. Dongosolo latsopanoli lidzasankha kuchuluka kwa ndalama zomwe makampani angabwereke. Lidzasankhanso thandizo lomwe boma lingapereke kwa ogulitsa. Zinthu izi ndizofunikira kwambiri pa bizinesi iliyonse yomwe ikufuna kukula ndikugulitsa kumayiko ena.

en.title: Five witnesses testify in Agnes Katengeza murder trial
en.body: Five witnesses gave evidence in court in Lilongwe. They told the court about electronic items and phones. The State is prosecuting Amos Katengeza and Egnat Katengeza. They are accused of killing Agnes Katengeza. Agnes was a network administrator at the Reserve Bank of Malawi. The witnesses said Amos had items that belonged to Agnes.
en.body_more:
Francis Wilima told the court that Amos gave him a parcel. The parcel held a laptop, iPad, perfume and body lotion. Amos asked Wilima to send the parcel to a woman in Blantyre. Rosabel Mwakifwamba also testified. She said she kept the items for Amos for about one month. Then Amos came and took them back.

Joseph Saidi is a mobile phone and computer technician at Blantyre Flea Market. He gave evidence about electronic gadgets. Chifundo Kadepo is a businessman at Blantyre Market. He told the court he bought an iPhone 13 from Amos in 2023. Amos asked him many times to buy the phone. Kadepo paid K500,000 for it. He saw the same iPhone in court.

Frank Matchola is a network engineer at Airtel Malawi. He is 30 years old. He knew Amos since 2015. Amos asked to stay at his house in Blantyre. Matchola said yes. While Amos lived there, he bought and sold mobile phones. Matchola later received a call saying Amos had been arrested. Matchola identified an iPod and a laptop in court. He said these devices belonged to Amos.

The State lawyer said the case uses circumstantial evidence. This means small pieces of proof that together tell one story. The defence lawyer said the two accused men have been in prison for nearly three years. He asked the court to move faster. The prosecution will call 16 witnesses in total. The trial will continue for two more days.

ny.title: Mboni zisanu zapereka umboni pa mlandu wakupha Agnes Katengeza
ny.body: Mboni zisanu zinapereka umboni kukhothi ku Lilongwe. Zinauza khothi za zinthu zamagetsi ndi mafoni. Boma likuimba mlandu Amos Katengeza ndi Egnat Katengeza. Akuimbidwa mlandu wopha Agnes Katengeza. Agnes anali woyang'anira netiweki ku Reserve Bank of Malawi. Mbonizo zinati Amos anali ndi zinthu zomwe zinali za Agnes.
ny.body_more:
Francis Wilima anauza khoti kuti Amos adamupatsa phukusi. Phukusilo linali ndi laputopu, iPad, mafuta onunkhira ndi mafuta odzola thupi. Amos adapempha Wilima kuti atumize phukusilo kwa mayi wina ku Blantyre. Rosabel Mwakifwamba nayenso adapereka umboni. Iye adati adasunga zinthuzo kwa Amos kwa mwezi umodzi. Kenako Amos anabwera n’kuzitenga.

Joseph Saidi ndi katswiri wa mafoni ndi makompyuta ku Blantyre Flea Market. Adapereka umboni wokhudza zida zamagetsi. Chifundo Kadepo ndi wamalonda ku Blantyre Market. Adauza khoti kuti adagula iPhone 13 kwa Amos mu 2023. Amos adamupempha kangapo kuti agule foniyo. Kadepo adalipira K500,000. Adawona iPhone yomweyo kukhoti.

Frank Matchola ndi mainjiniya wa netiweki ku Airtel Malawi. Ali ndi zaka 30. Amadziwa Amos kuyambira 2015. Amos adapempha kuti akhale kunyumba kwake ku Blantyre. Matchola adati inde. Pamene Amos ankakhala kumeneko, adagula ndikugulitsa mafoni. Pambuyo pake Matchola analandira foni yomuuza kuti Amos wamangidwa. Matchola anapeza iPod ndi laputopu kukhothi. Anati zipangizozi ndi za Amos.

Loya wa boma anati mlanduwu umagwiritsa ntchito umboni wooneka ngati wofunikira. Izi zikutanthauza kuti umboni waung'ono womwe pamodzi umafotokoza nkhani imodzi. Loya woteteza anati amuna awiriwa akhala m'ndende kwa zaka pafupifupi zitatu. Anapempha khoti kuti lichitepo kanthu mwachangu. Otsutsa milandu aitana mboni 16 zonse. Mlanduwu upitirira kwa masiku ena awiri.

en.title: Mutharika meets Tony Blair to find investors
en.body: President Arthur Peter Mutharika met former UK Prime Minister Tony Blair on Tuesday, 21 July at Kamuzu Palace in Lilongwe. The two men talked about how to help Malawi's economy grow. Mutharika asked Blair to help bring money from big investors to Malawi.
en.body_more:
When Mutharika took office last year, Malawi faced big problems. He called them the Four Fs: Food, Forex, Fertiliser and Fuel. These were all in very bad condition. Forex is money from other countries. Mutharika told Blair that his team has now started to fix these problems. Food is more stable now. The government has brought in fertiliser again. The President said he wants to build a fertiliser factory by 2027. This will help Malawi buy less fertiliser from other countries.

Mutharika asked Blair to use his connections around the world. He wants Blair to find investors for mining and energy work. These two areas could help Malawi earn much more money. Mutharika also asked Blair to help Malawi with debt. Debt is money that a country must pay back to other countries. When debt is too high, it puts pressure on the government's money.

Blair said he was happy with Mutharika's work. He said Malawi has great possible for investment. He promised to use his Tony Blair Institute for Global Change to help. This institute works with governments around the world. Blair said Malawians voted Mutharika back into power because they trust him. They trust him to make the country's future better. Blair pledged to tap his global networks to bring serious, credible investors to Malawi.

ny.title: Mutharika akumana ndi Tony Blair kuti apeze osunga ndalama
ny.body: Purezidenti Arthur Peter Mutharika anakumana ndi Nduna yakale ya Britain Tony Blair Lachiwiri, pa 21 Julayi ku Kamuzu Palace ku Lilongwe. Amuna awiriwa adakambirana za momwe angathandizire kukula kwa chuma cha Malawi. Mutharika adapempha Blair kuti athandize kubweretsa ndalama kuchokera kwa osunga ndalama akuluakulu ku Malawi.
ny.body_more:
Pamene Mutharika adayamba kulamulira chaka chatha, Malawi idakumana ndi mavuto akuluakulu. Adawatcha kuti Four Fs: Chakudya, Forex, Feteleza ndi Mafuta. Zonsezi zinali mu mkhalidwe woipa kwambiri. Forex ndi ndalama zochokera kumayiko ena. Mutharika adauza Blair kuti gulu lake layamba kukonza mavutowa. Chakudya chili bwino tsopano. Boma labweretsanso feteleza. Purezidenti adati akufuna kumanga fakitale ya feteleza pofika chaka cha 2027. Izi zithandiza Malawi kugula feteleza wochepa kuchokera kumayiko ena.

Mutharika adapempha Blair kuti agwiritse ntchito maubwenzi ake padziko lonse lapansi. Akufuna kuti Blair apeze osunga ndalama pantchito zamigodi ndi zamagetsi. Madera awiriwa angathandize Malawi kupeza ndalama zambiri. Mutharika adapemphanso Blair kuti athandize Malawi ndi ngongole. Ngongole ndi ndalama zomwe dziko liyenera kubweza kumayiko ena. Ngongole ikakwera kwambiri, imaika ndalama za boma pamavuto.

Blair adati adakondwera ndi ntchito ya Mutharika. Adati Malawi ili ndi kuthekera kwakukulu koyika ndalama. Adalonjeza kugwiritsa ntchito Tony Blair Institute for Global Change kuti athandize. Bungweli limagwira ntchito ndi maboma padziko lonse lapansi. Blair anati anthu aku Malawi adasankha Mutharika kuti abwerere m'manja chifukwa amamukhulupirira. Amamukhulupirira kuti apangitsa tsogolo la dzikolo kukhala labwino. Blair adalonjeza kugwiritsa ntchito maukonde ake apadziko lonse lapansi kuti abweretse osunga ndalama odalirika komanso odalirika ku Malawi.

en.title: Airtel gives scholarships to 25 STEM students at MUST
en.body: Airtel Africa Foundation has given scholarships to 25 students at Malawi University of Science and Technology (MUST). The students come from poor families. They will study science, technology, engineering and maths. Airtel Malawi Managing Director Aashish Dutt said the money helps remove barriers to education. The students will start their courses on 31 August 2026.
en.body_more:
The Airtel Nzeru Tech Scholarship Programme started in January 2026. It is a partnership between Airtel Africa Foundation, Airtel Malawi plc and MUST. The first group has eight women and 17 men. They were chosen based on how well they studied in school.

The scholarships pay for tuition fees. They also give money for hostel accommodation. Each student gets a monthly stipend. The stipend is money to live on each month. Students also get data bundles for internet and a laptop computer. These things help students finish their studies.

The 25 students study many different STEM courses. Some study sustainable energy engineering. Others study business information technology, disaster risk management, mathematical sciences, geo-information and earth observation science, computer systems and security, manufacturing engineering, metallurgy and materials engineering, and science education. Aashish Dutt said these students are the future of Malawi's digital economy. He called them the next generation of problem-solvers and technology leaders.

MUST Vice Chancellor Professor Mauakowa Malata said this partnership is a big investment in Malawi's people. She said the students will become leaders in science, technology and innovation. Airtel and MUST chose the students fairly. They looked at how well the students did in school, their family money situation, and if they were in eligible STEM programmes. This scholarship programme is part of Airtel Africa Fellowship. That programme helps young Africans get higher education and work in STEM jobs.

ny.title: Airtel yapereka maphunziro aukadaulo kwa ophunzira 25 a STEM ku MUST
ny.body: Airtel Africa Foundation yapereka maphunziro aukadaulo kwa ophunzira 25 ku Malawi University of Science and Technology (MUST). Ophunzirawa akuchokera m'mabanja osauka. Adzaphunzira sayansi, ukadaulo, uinjiniya ndi masamu. Mtsogoleri wamkulu wa Airtel Malawi Aashish Dutt adati ndalamazo zimathandiza kuchotsa zopinga pamaphunziro. Ophunzirawa adzayamba maphunziro awo pa 31 Ogasiti 2026.
ny.body_more:
Pulogalamu ya Airtel Nzeru Tech Scholarship inayamba mu Januwale 2026. Ndi mgwirizano pakati pa Airtel Africa Foundation, Airtel Malawi plc ndi MUST. Gulu loyamba lili ndi akazi asanu ndi atatu ndi amuna 17. Anasankhidwa kutengera momwe amaphunzirira bwino kusukulu.

Ma scholarship amalipira ndalama zolipirira sukulu. Amaperekanso ndalama zogona ku hostel. Wophunzira aliyense amalandira ndalama zolipirira pamwezi. Ndalama zolipirira ndi ndalama zoti azipeza mwezi uliwonse. Ophunzira amalandiranso ma data bundles a intaneti ndi kompyuta ya laputopu. Zinthuzi zimathandiza ophunzira kumaliza maphunziro awo.

Ophunzira 25 amaphunzira maphunziro osiyanasiyana a STEM. Ena amaphunzira uinjiniya wamagetsi wokhazikika. Ena amaphunzira ukadaulo wazidziwitso zamabizinesi, kasamalidwe ka zoopsa, sayansi ya masamu, sayansi ya geo-information ndi earth observation, makina apakompyuta ndi chitetezo, uinjiniya wopanga zinthu, uinjiniya wa zitsulo ndi zida, ndi maphunziro asayansi. Aashish Dutt adati ophunzira awa ndi tsogolo la chuma cha digito ku Malawi. Adawatcha m'badwo wotsatira wa othetsa mavuto ndi atsogoleri aukadaulo.

Pulofesa Mauakowa Malata, wachiwiri kwa Chancellor wa MUST, adati mgwirizanowu ndi ndalama yayikulu kwa anthu aku Malawi. Iye anati ophunzirawo adzakhala atsogoleri mu sayansi, ukadaulo ndi zatsopano. Airtel ndi MUST adasankha ophunzirawo moyenera. Adayang'ana momwe ophunzirawo amachitira bwino kusukulu, momwe mabanja awo alili ndi ndalama, komanso ngati ali mu mapulogalamu oyenerera a STEM. Pulogalamu yophunzirira iyi ndi gawo la Airtel Africa Fellowship. Pulogalamu imeneyi imathandiza achinyamata aku Africa kupeza maphunziro apamwamba ndikugwira ntchito za STEM.

en.title: Tabitha and Temwa Chawinga named as players to watch at Wafcon
en.body: ESPN, a big sports news company, named Malawi sisters Tabitha and Temwa Chawinga as two of 11 players to watch at the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon) in Morocco. Tabitha plays for French club Olympique Lyonnesse. Temwa plays in the United States for Kansas City Current. Both play for Malawi's team, the Scorchers.
en.body_more:
Tabitha is the Scorchers captain. She plays for the French women's top league champions. In the 2025-26 season, she scored 13 goals and got 5 helps in 18 games. ESPN said she is a good playmaker, finisher and leader. Temwa plays as a striker and changed the game for African women players in the US league. This will be her first Wafcon.

Malawi qualified for Wafcon for the first time. Temwa arrived in Morocco on Sunday and joined the team on Tuesday. She has not played for Malawi for over one year because of injuries and other issues. The team's coach, Lovemore Fazili, said Temwa's arrival will help Malawi reach the last-eight stage. Temwa said she was ready to work hard and proud to play for her country again. She said Wafcon is a big chance for young Malawi players to get deals with foreign teams.

Tabitha said Nigeria's Super Falcons remain the strongest team. Malawi will play Nigeria on 28 July in their first game. They will also play Egypt on 1 August and Zambia on 5 August. All three games are in Group C. Tabitha said the Scorchers cannot expect to beat Nigeria but they are ready to play hard. She asked Oshoala, a top Nigerian player, to be kind in the score. Asisat Oshoala, a six-time Africa Footballer of the Year, joked back and told the Chawinga sisters to calm down.

ny.title: Tabitha ndi Temwa Chawinga omwe asankhidwa kuti awonere ku Wafcon
ny.body: Kampani yaikulu yofalitsa nkhani zamasewera ku ESPN, yasankha alongo aku Malawi, Tabitha ndi Temwa Chawinga, kukhala awiri mwa osewera 11 oti ayang'anire pa mpikisano wa Women's Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon) wa 2026 ku Morocco. Tabitha amasewera ku Olympique Lyonnesse, kilabu yaku France. Temwa amasewera ku United States ku Kansas City Current. Onse awiri amasewera ku timu ya Malawi, Scorchers.
ny.body_more:
Tabitha ndi kaputeni wa Scorchers. Amasewera m'gulu la akazi otchuka kwambiri ku France. Mu nyengo ya 2025-26, adagoletsa zigoli 13 ndipo adapeza ma help 5 m'masewera 18. ESPN idati ndi wosewera bwino, womaliza komanso mtsogoleri. Temwa amasewera ngati wosewera ndipo adasintha masewerawa kwa osewera achikazi aku Africa mu ligi ya US. Iyi idzakhala nthawi yake yoyamba ya Wafcon.

Malawi idayenerera Wafcon koyamba. Temwa adafika ku Morocco Lamlungu ndipo adalowa nawo timuyi Lachiwiri. Sanasewere Malawi kwa chaka chopitilira chimodzi chifukwa cha kuvulala ndi mavuto ena. Mphunzitsi wa timuyi, Lovemore Fazili, adati kufika kwa Temwa kudzathandiza Malawi kufika pagawo lachisanu ndi chitatu. Temwa adati anali wokonzeka kugwira ntchito molimbika komanso wonyada kuseweranso dziko lake. Adati Wafcon ndi mwayi waukulu kwa osewera achinyamata aku Malawi kuti apeze mapangano ndi magulu akunja.

Tabitha adati Super Falcons yaku Nigeria ikadali timu yamphamvu kwambiri. Malawi idzasewera ndi Nigeria pa 28 Julayi pamasewera awo oyamba. Adzaseweranso ndi Egypt pa 1 Ogasiti ndi Zambia pa 5 Ogasiti. Masewera onse atatu ali mu Gulu C. Tabitha adati Scorchers sangayembekezere kugonjetsa Nigeria koma ali okonzeka kusewera molimbika. Anapempha Oshoala, wosewera wabwino kwambiri wa ku Nigeria, kuti akhale wachifundo pa zigoli. Asisat Oshoala, yemwe wapambana mpikisano wa Africa Footballer of the Year kasanu ndi kamodzi, anaseka nauza alongo a Chawinga kuti akhale chete.

en.title: Malawi soccer team does well at big Sweden cup
en.body: Ascent Soccer Academy made history at the Gothia Cup in Sweden. This is the world's biggest youth football tournament. The Malawian team's Under-14 boys reached the Round of 16. The girls played there for the first time. Sponsor One Nico Group said the team did very well.
en.body_more:
The boys played in Group 10. They drew 0-0 with Iceland's FH 1 in their first game. Then they beat Sweden's Utbynäs SK 5-0. These wins helped them finish second in their group. The group also had Norway's HSV Fotball 2 and Sweden's Västerås SK Ungdom 2. The boys moved to the next round called the knockout stages.

The girls' team also played at the Gothia Cup for the first time ever. This was a big moment for Ascent Soccer Academy and for Malawi.

One Nico Group is proud to help the young players. Taweni Gondwe Xaba works for One Nico Group. She said the company believes young people are the future. She said: "We are very proud to help these young players. They show what Malawi can do. We believe that helping young people is helping our country." One Nico Group wants to help more young Malawians learn new skills. They want to give them chances to play on the world stage. The company says this helps young people find their dreams and do their best.

Experts say Ascent's games in Sweden show that Malawi has good young football players. The team's strong play proves that youth football in Malawi is growing better each year.

ny.title: Timu ya mpira wa ku Malawi yachita bwino kwambiri pa chikho chachikulu cha Sweden
ny.body: Ascent Soccer Academy yapanga mbiri pa Gothia Cup ku Sweden. Uwu ndi mpikisano waukulu kwambiri padziko lonse wa mpira wa achinyamata. Anyamata a timu ya Malawi omwe ali ndi zaka zosakwana 14 adafika mu Round of 16. Atsikana adasewera kumeneko koyamba. Wothandizira One Nico Group adati timuyi idachita bwino kwambiri.
ny.body_more:
Anyamatawo adasewera mu Gulu 10. Adagwirizana 0-0 ndi FH 1 ya ku Iceland pamasewera awo oyamba. Kenako adagonjetsa Utbynäs SK ya ku Sweden 5-0. Kupambana kumeneku kunawathandiza kumaliza pachiwiri mu gulu lawo. Gululi linalinso ndi HSV Fotball 2 ya ku Norway ndi Västerås SK Ungdom 2 ya ku Sweden. Anyamatawo adasamukira ku gawo lotsatira lotchedwa knockout stages.

Gulu la atsikana lidaseweranso pa Gothia Cup koyamba. Iyi inali nthawi yayikulu kwa Ascent Soccer Academy komanso kwa Malawi.

One Nico Group ikunyadira kuthandiza osewera achichepere. Taweni Gondwe Xaba amagwira ntchito ku One Nico Group. Anati kampaniyo ikukhulupirira kuti achinyamata ndi tsogolo. Iye anati: "Tikunyadira kwambiri kuthandiza osewera achichepere awa. Amasonyeza zomwe Malawi ingachite. Tikukhulupirira kuti kuthandiza achinyamata ndikuthandiza dziko lathu." One Nico Group ikufuna kuthandiza achinyamata ambiri aku Malawi kuphunzira maluso atsopano. Akufuna kuwapatsa mwayi wosewera padziko lonse lapansi. Kampaniyo ikunena kuti izi zimathandiza achinyamata kupeza maloto awo ndikuchita zonse zomwe angathe.

Akatswiri akuti masewera a Ascent ku Sweden akusonyeza kuti Malawi ili ndi osewera mpira achinyamata abwino. Kusewera bwino kwa timuyi kumatsimikizira kuti mpira wa achinyamata ku Malawi ukukula bwino chaka chilichonse.

en.title: Bioethanol cooking helps stop charcoal use in Malawi
en.body: Malawi's Minister of Natural Resources Patricia Wiskes visited a clean cooking project in Chikwawa on Tuesday. The project uses bioethanol fuel instead of charcoal for cooking. The minister said this helps save forests and improves health. The company PressCane Limited runs the project with help from the government and the United Nations.
en.body_more:
Bioethanol is fuel made from plants. It is cleaner than charcoal and better for indoor air. The project already helps many families. More than 566 households now use ethanol for cooking. The company has sold more than 12,000 litres of ethanol.

Chief Executive Officer Bryson Mkhomaanthu said the goal is to stop people using charcoal. He said charcoal harms forests and the environment. The project creates jobs for young people and graduates from Malawi University of Science and Technology. The company also exports ethanol to other countries to bring money into Malawi. The minister said this is good because it uses local products instead of foreign ones.

The project has help from the United Nations Development Programme and the Green Economic Transition Facility. These organisations paid half the project costs. PressCane works with an organisation called Youth Net and Counselling in Zomba. This helps young people and women sell ethanol and start their own small businesses. Fenella Frost from the United Nations said forests are very important to Malawi. She said losing forests is a serious problem that affects farming and people's lives. Ireland's ambassador Kate Brady also said her government supports clean cooking in Malawi.

ny.title: Kuphika bioethanol kwathandiza kuchepetsa kugwiritsa ntchito makala ku Malawi
ny.body: Nduna ya Zachilengedwe ku Malawi, Patricia Wiskes, adapita ku pulojekiti yophikira yoyera ku Chikwawa Lachiwiri. Pulojekitiyi imagwiritsa ntchito mafuta a bioethanol m'malo mwa makala pophikira. Ndunayi idati izi zimathandiza kupulumutsa nkhalango ndikukweza thanzi. Kampani ya PressCane Limited imayendetsa pulojekitiyi mothandizidwa ndi boma ndi United Nations.
ny.body_more:
Bioethanol ndi mafuta opangidwa kuchokera ku zomera. Ndi yoyera kuposa makala ndipo ndi yabwino kwambiri pa mpweya wamkati. Ntchitoyi yathandiza kale mabanja ambiri. Mabanja opitilira 566 tsopano akugwiritsa ntchito ethanol pophika. Kampaniyo yagulitsa malita opitilira 12,000 a ethanol.

Bryson Mkhomaanthu, mkulu wa bungwe la United Nations, anati cholinga chake ndikuletsa anthu kugwiritsa ntchito makala. Iye anati makala amawononga nkhalango ndi chilengedwe. Ntchitoyi imapanga ntchito kwa achinyamata ndi omaliza maphunziro ku Malawi University of Science and Technology. Kampaniyo imatumizanso ethanol kumayiko ena kuti ibweretse ndalama ku Malawi. Ndunayo inati izi ndi zabwino chifukwa imagwiritsa ntchito zinthu zakomweko m'malo mwa zakunja.

Ntchitoyi ili ndi thandizo kuchokera ku United Nations Development Programme ndi Green Economic Transition Facility. Mabungwewa adalipira theka la ndalama za ntchitoyi. PressCane imagwira ntchito ndi bungwe lotchedwa Youth Net and Counselling ku Zomba. Izi zimathandiza achinyamata ndi akazi kugulitsa ethanol ndikuyambitsa mabizinesi awo ang'onoang'ono. Fenella Frost wochokera ku United Nations adati nkhalango ndizofunikira kwambiri ku Malawi. Iye anati kutaya nkhalango ndi vuto lalikulu lomwe limakhudza ulimi ndi miyoyo ya anthu. Kazembe wa ku Ireland, Kate Brady, adatinso boma lake likuthandiza kuphika zakudya zoyera ku Malawi.

en.title: Mabedi and FAM appeal court money ruling
en.body: Coach Patrick Mabedi and the Football Association of Malawi (FAM) have both appealed a court ruling. The Industrial Relations Court gave Mabedi K53.69 million. This is money for unfair dismissal and unfair labour practices. Unfair dismissal means the employer fired him wrongly. Both sides now go to the High Court. The ruling came on May 26.
en.body_more:
Mabedi asked for K680.36 million in total. He said the court gave him too little money. His lawyers said the lower court made mistakes in law and in fact. Mabedi wants K319.56 million for unlawful dismissal. He wants K59.92 million for unfair labour practices. He also wants K59.92 million in place of notice pay. Notice pay means money a worker gets when the boss tells them to leave.

Mabedi's claim also asks for motor vehicle benefits, fuel, accrued leave, air tickets, annual bonus, gratuity, medical aid, travel allowances and severance pay. Severance pay is money a worker gets when they leave a job. His lawyer David Kanyenda said the court got it right to agree with the dismissal being unfair, but gave too little money.

FAM also filed an appeal. FAM said Mabedi's first claim of K917 million was too much. The association said Mabedi's claim was based on benefits that might never have come if he kept his job. The Industrial Relations Court gave Mabedi K32.21 million for unfair dismissal. The court gave K21.47 million for unfair labour practices. The court said no to claims for notice pay and severance allowance. The court said there was not enough proof for these claims.

Both appeals now go to the High Court of Malawi. Each side wants the court to change the earlier ruling. The case will now take more time to finish.

ny.title: Chigamulo cha ndalama cha Mabedi ndi FAM ku khoti la apilo
ny.body: Mphunzitsi Patrick Mabedi ndi bungwe la Football Association of Malawi (FAM) onse achita apilo chigamulo cha khoti. Khoti la Industrial Relations linapatsa Mabedi K53.69 miliyoni. Izi ndi ndalama zochotsera ntchito mopanda chilungamo komanso machitidwe osalungama a ntchito. Kuchotsa ntchito mopanda chilungamo kumatanthauza kuti bwanayo adamuchotsa ntchito molakwika. Magulu onse awiri tsopano apita ku Khoti Lalikulu. Chigamulocho chinaperekedwa pa Meyi 26.
ny.body_more:
Mabedi anapempha K680.36 miliyoni yonse. Anati khoti linamupatsa ndalama zochepa kwambiri. Maloya ake anati khoti laling'ono linalakwitsa m'malamulo ndipo kwenikweni. Mabedi akufuna K319.56 miliyoni chifukwa chochotsedwa ntchito mosaloledwa. Akufuna K59.92 miliyoni chifukwa cha ntchito zosalungama. Akufunanso K59.92 miliyoni m'malo mwa malipiro a chidziwitso. Malipiro a chidziwitso amatanthauza ndalama zomwe wantchito amapeza bwana akamuuza kuti achoke.

Chilango cha Mabedi chikupemphanso maubwino a galimoto, mafuta, tchuthi chowonjezeka, matikiti a ndege, bonasi ya pachaka, ndalama zothandizira, thandizo lachipatala, ndalama zoyendera ndi malipiro a kuchotsedwa ntchito. Malipiro a kuchotsedwa ntchito ndi ndalama zomwe wantchito amapeza akasiya ntchito. Loya wake David Kanyenda anati khotilo linavomereza bwino kuti kuchotsedwa ntchito kunali kosalungama, koma linapereka ndalama zochepa kwambiri.

FAM inaperekanso apilo. FAM inati pempho loyamba la Mabedi la K917 miliyoni linali lochuluka kwambiri. Bungweli linati pempho la Mabedi linali lochokera ku maubwino omwe sakanapezeka akanakhala kuti adapitiliza ntchito yake. Khoti la Industrial Relations linapatsa Mabedi K32.21 miliyoni chifukwa chochotsa ntchito mopanda chilungamo. Khotilo linapereka K21.47 miliyoni chifukwa cha ntchito zosalungama. Khotilo linati ayi pa zopempha za malipiro a chidziwitso ndi ndalama zothandizira kuchotsedwa ntchito. Khotilo linati palibe umboni wokwanira pa zopemphazi.

Zopempha zonse ziwiri tsopano zikupita ku Khoti Lalikulu la Malawi. Mbali iliyonse ikufuna kuti khotilo lisinthe chigamulo choyambirira. Mlanduwu tsopano utenga nthawi yochulukirapo kuti umalizidwe.

en.title: ACB boss faces fuel money claims
en.body: The Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) faces claims that leaders got extra fuel money. Acting Director General Gabriel Chembezi is named. Six ACB vehicles in Lilongwe cannot work. The Bureau says it has no money to fix them.
en.body_more:
Sources say senior managers at the ACB share fuel under the name "local running." This fuel is not in the Bureau's official fuel list for directors. The Director of Corruption Prevention is also named as getting fuel this way.

Six ACB vehicles are grounded in Lilongwe. Their registration numbers are MG 830, MG 331, MG 165, MG 940, MG 545, and MC 4757. The Bureau says it cannot pay to fix them. Other offices in Blantyre, Mzuzu, and Zomba also have broken vehicles. The Bureau says it has no money for maintenance.

When Chembezi travels to Blantyre for work, he rents a car when he arrives. At the same time, he tells government drivers to drive official ACB vehicles there by road. Sources say this costs the government extra money. The fuel the leaders get could pay for vehicle repairs, paper, and other things the Bureau needs.

The ACB said it did not respond to these claims. The Bureau has said before that it does not have enough money. Corruption is when leaders take money or things that are not theirs. The ACB is the government office that catches people who do this.

ny.title: Mtsogoleri wa ACB akuimbidwa mlandu wokhudza ndalama za mafuta
ny.body: Bungwe Lolimbana ndi Ziphuphu (ACB) likukumana ndi milandu yoti atsogoleri adalandira ndalama zowonjezera zamafuta. Mtsogoleri Wamkulu Wachiwiri Gabriel Chembezi watchulidwa. Magalimoto asanu ndi limodzi a ACB ku Lilongwe sangathe kugwira ntchito. Bungweli lati lilibe ndalama zowakonzera.
ny.body_more:
Magwero akuti oyang'anira akuluakulu ku ACB amagawana mafuta pansi pa dzina lakuti "local running." Mafuta awa sali pamndandanda wovomerezeka wa mafuta a Bureau kwa owongolera. Director of Corruption Prevention nayenso amatchulidwa kuti amalandira mafuta mwanjira imeneyi.

Magalimoto asanu ndi limodzi a ACB ali ku Lilongwe. Manambala awo olembetsa ndi MG 830, MG 331, MG 165, MG 940, MG 545, ndi MC 4757. Bureau ikunena kuti singathe kulipira kuti iwakonze. Maofesi ena ku Blantyre, Mzuzu, ndi Zomba nawonso ali ndi magalimoto osweka. Bureau ikunena kuti ilibe ndalama zokonzera.

Chembezi akapita ku Blantyre kukagwira ntchito, amabwereka galimoto akafika. Nthawi yomweyo, amauza oyendetsa boma kuti ayendetse magalimoto ovomerezeka a ACB kumeneko pamsewu. Magwero akuti izi zimawonongera boma ndalama zowonjezera. Mafuta omwe atsogoleri amapeza amatha kulipira kukonza magalimoto, mapepala, ndi zina zomwe Bureau ikufuna.

ACB idati sinayankhe izi. Bungweli lanena kale kuti lilibe ndalama zokwanira. Ziphuphu zimachitika pamene atsogoleri amatenga ndalama kapena zinthu zomwe si zawo. ACB ndi ofesi ya boma yomwe imagwirira anthu omwe amachita izi.

en.title: Four Rumphi MPs give K10.5m to fix broken mortuary
en.body: Four Members of Parliament from Rumphi District have raised K10.5 million to repair a broken mortuary at Rumphi District Hospital. Nine of the twelve cold room units stopped working nearly one year ago. The government did not fix them because it had no money. The MPs gave their own money to help.
en.body_more:
Rumphi Central MP Mathews Mtumbuka first spoke about the problem in Parliament. He told Health Minister Madalitso Baloyi that only three of the twelve units still work. The minister told him to use Constituency Development Fund money. This is money given to MPs to help their areas. Mtumbuka then asked other Rumphi MPs to help pay for the repairs.

Three other MPs joined him. Rumphi North MP Jappie Mhango gave K2 million. Rumphi East MP Florence Shapiro Khumbie gave K2 million. Rumphi West MP Yona Mkandawire gave K2 million. Mtumbuka himself gave K2 million. Justice Minister Charles Mhango also gave K2.5 million. This total of K10.5 million is much more than the K6.8 million needed to repair the nine broken units.

Mtumbuka said he was unhappy with the government. He said the government should fix hospital equipment like this. It should not depend on MPs giving their own money. First Deputy Speaker Victor Musowa said the four MPs came from different political parties but worked together. He asked other MPs in other parts of Malawi to do the same thing when their hospitals and schools need help.

ny.title: Nyumba yamalamulo inayi ya ku Rumphi yapereka K10.5 miliyoni kuti ikonze malo osungiramo mitembo omwe asweka
ny.body: Aphungu anayi a Nyumba Yamalamulo ochokera ku Rumphi District asonkhanitsa K10.5 miliyoni kuti akonze malo osungiramo zinyalala omwe anawonongeka ku Rumphi District Hospital. Zipinda zisanu ndi zinayi mwa zipinda khumi ndi ziwiri zozizira zinasiya kugwira ntchito pafupifupi chaka chimodzi chapitacho. Boma silinawakonze chifukwa linalibe ndalama. Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo adapereka ndalama zawo kuti athandize.
ny.body_more:
MP wa ku Rumphi Central, Mathews Mtumbuka, adalankhula koyamba za vutoli ku Nyumba Yamalamulo. Adauza Nduna ya Zaumoyo, Madalitso Baloyi, kuti magawo atatu okha mwa khumi ndi awiri omwe akugwirabe ntchito. Ndunayo idamuuza kuti agwiritse ntchito ndalama za Constituency Development Fund. Izi ndi ndalama zomwe zimaperekedwa kwa aphungu kuti zithandize madera awo. Mtumbuka kenako adapempha aphungu ena a ku Rumphi kuti athandize kulipira kukonza.

Aphungu ena atatu adagwirizana naye. MP wa ku Rumphi North, Jappie Mhango, adapereka K2 miliyoni. MP wa ku Rumphi East, Florence Shapiro Khumbie, adapereka K2 miliyoni. MP wa ku Rumphi West, Yona Mkandawire, adapereka K2 miliyoni. Mtumbuka mwiniwake adapereka K2 miliyoni. Nduna ya Zachilungamo, Charles Mhango, adaperekanso K2.5 miliyoni. Chiwerengero chonse cha K10.5 miliyoni ndi choposa K6.8 miliyoni yomwe ikufunika kuti ikonze magawo asanu ndi anayi osweka.

Mtumbuka adati sakusangalala ndi boma. Adati boma liyenera kukonza zida zachipatala ngati izi. Siziyenera kudalira aphungu kuti apereke ndalama zawo. Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Victor Musowa adati aphungu anayiwa akuchokera ku zipani zosiyanasiyana zandale koma amagwira ntchito limodzi. Iye anapempha aphungu ena a nyumba yamalamulo m'madera ena a Malawi kuti achite chimodzimodzi ngati zipatala ndi masukulu awo akufunika thandizo.

en.title: Two die, 21 hurt in head-on crash on Limbe-Zomba Road
en.body: Two people died and 21 others were hurt in a road crash this morning on the Limbe-Zomba Road near Sable Farming. A minibus and a saloon car crashed head-on. Police said the minibus driver tried to overtake another vehicle. The two dead people reached Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital but could not be saved.
en.body_more:
Limbe Police deputy spokesperson Demetria Banda said the minibus was a Mazda Bongo carrying 18 passengers. It was travelling from Njuli towards the Chiradzulu turn-off when the driver tried to overtake a lorry. This caused a head-on crash with a Mazda Demio saloon car that was carrying five passengers and travelling in the opposite direction, towards Njuli.

The driver of the Mazda Demio and one passenger were pronounced dead when they arrived at Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital. Both had sustained severe head injuries. Banda said these two people had injuries that were very serious.

The minibus driver and all other people in both vehicles were also injured. All 21 injured people are receiving treatment at Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital. Police said they do not know how many of these people will recover or when they will leave hospital.

Demetria Banda told police to remind all drivers about road safety. She said all road users must follow road rules at all times. Banda said this is the only way to stop accidents like this one from happening again. Road crashes are a big problem in Malawi.

ny.title: Anthu awiri afa ndipo 21 avulala pangozi ya galimoto yomwe inagwera pa msewu wa Limbe-Zomba.
ny.body: Anthu awiri afa ndipo ena 21 avulala pangozi ya pamsewu m'mawa uno pa msewu wa Limbe-Zomba pafupi ndi Sable Farming. Minibasi ndi galimoto ya saloon zinagundana maso ndi maso. Apolisi ati dalaivala wa minibasi anayesa kudutsa galimoto ina. Anthu awiri omwe anamwalirawo anafika ku chipatala cha Queen Elizabeth Central koma sanapulumuke.
ny.body_more:
Wachiwiri kwa wolankhulira apolisi a Limbe, Demetria Banda, anati minibus inali Mazda Bongo yomwe inali ndi anthu 18. Inali kuyenda kuchokera ku Njuli kupita ku Chiradzulu pomwe dalaivala anayesa kudutsa lorry. Izi zinapangitsa ngozi ya galimoto ya Mazda Demio yomwe inali ndi anthu asanu ndipo inali kupita mbali ina, ku Njuli.

Dalaivala wa Mazda Demio ndi munthu m'modzi adanenedwa kuti afa atafika ku Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital. Onse awiri adavulala kwambiri m'mutu. Banda adati anthu awiriwa adavulala kwambiri.

Dalaivala wa minibus ndi anthu ena onse m'magalimoto onse awiri nawonso adavulala. Anthu onse 21 ovulala akulandira chithandizo ku Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital. Apolisi adati sakudziwa kuti ndi angati mwa anthuwa omwe adzachira kapena nthawi yomwe adzatuluka kuchipatala.

Demetria Banda adauza apolisi kuti akumbutse madalaivala onse za chitetezo cha pamsewu. Iye adati ogwiritsa ntchito msewu onse ayenera kutsatira malamulo a pamsewu nthawi zonse. Banda adati iyi ndiyo njira yokhayo yoletsera ngozi ngati iyi kuti zisachitikenso. Ngozi za pamsewu ndi vuto lalikulu ku Malawi.

en.title: Malawi gives K100 billion for maize to fight El Niño hunger
en.body: The government has given K100 billion to the National Food Reserve Agency (NFRA) to buy more maize. Minister of Finance Joseph Mwanamvekha told Parliament on Monday that this money will help protect poor families from hunger. El Niño is a weather event that can reduce crops. The government wants to build up maize stores before the lean season comes.
en.body_more:
Mwanamvekha said the money is part of a plan to prepare for food shortages. He told MPs that NFRA already has maize in its grain stores and has found sellers who will provide more grain. The goal is to have enough food ready if communities run short during the lean season between October 2026 and January 2027. The minister explained that NFRA keeps grain stores for emergencies and gives maize free when there is hunger. ADMARC, another food body, sells maize to the public at market prices.

However, some groups say buying maize alone is not enough. The Civil Society Agriculture Network National Director Elizabeth Mnenula Namaona said the plan has problems. She said food security needs more than just maize. The country also needs irrigation and other kinds of food. Agriculture policy analyst Leonard Chimwaza agreed. He said buying maize is not a good strategy because the farming season has not even started yet. He told the government to use the money for irrigation instead.

Reports say between 1.5 million and 1.99 million Malawians will face hunger in the coming lean season. This is less than the 4 million people who needed food help last year. Charles Matabwa from the Department of Disaster Management Affairs said they are preparing but need more support. El Niño happened in 2015-16 and 2023-24, leaving millions of people without enough food both times.

ny.title: Malawi yapereka K100 biliyoni ya chimanga kuti ithandize kuthana ndi njala ya El Niño
ny.body: Boma lapereka K100 biliyoni ku National Food Reserve Agency (NFRA) kuti igule chimanga china. Nduna ya Zachuma Joseph Mwanamvekha adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo Lolemba kuti ndalamazi zithandiza kuteteza mabanja osauka ku njala. El Niño ndi nyengo yomwe ingachepetse mbewu. Boma likufuna kumanga malo osungira chimanga nyengo isanafike yokolola.
ny.body_more:
Mwanamvekha anati ndalamazi ndi gawo la dongosolo lokonzekera kusowa kwa chakudya. Iye anauza aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo kuti NFRA ili kale ndi chimanga m'masitolo ake a tirigu ndipo yapeza ogulitsa omwe angapereke tirigu wambiri. Cholinga chake ndikukhala ndi chakudya chokwanira ngati madera akusowa nthawi ya lean pakati pa Okutobala 2026 ndi Januwale 2027. Ndunayo inafotokoza kuti NFRA imasunga masitolo a tirigu nthawi zadzidzidzi ndipo imapereka chimanga kwaulere pakakhala njala. ADMARC, bungwe lina la chakudya, limagulitsa chimanga kwa anthu pamitengo yamsika.

Komabe, magulu ena amati kugula chimanga chokha sikokwanira. Mtsogoleri wa National Society Agriculture Network Elizabeth Mnenula Namaona anati dongosololi lili ndi mavuto. Iye anati chitetezo cha chakudya chimafunikira zambiri kuposa chimanga chokha. Dzikoli likusowanso kuthirira ndi mitundu ina ya chakudya. Katswiri wa zaulimi Leonard Chimwaza adavomereza. Iye anati kugula chimanga si njira yabwino chifukwa nyengo yaulimi sinayambe. Adauza boma kuti ligwiritse ntchito ndalamazo pothirira m'malo mwake.

Malipoti akuti pakati pa 1.5 miliyoni ndi 1.99 miliyoni aku Malawi adzakumana ndi njala mu nyengo ikubwerayi ya lean. Anthu okwana 4 miliyoni omwe amafunikira thandizo la chakudya chaka chatha ndi ochepa. Charles Matabwa wochokera ku Dipatimenti Yoona za Masoka anati akukonzekera koma akufunika thandizo lochulukirapo. El Niño inachitika mu 2015-16 ndi 2023-24, zomwe zinasiya anthu mamiliyoni ambiri opanda chakudya chokwanira nthawi zonse ziwiri.

en.title: NAP asks: Did Malawi honour July 20 martyrs?
en.body: Fifteen years after 20 people died in protests on 20 July 2011, the National Advocacy Platform (NAP) has asked the government for compensation for the families. On the anniversary, NAP Chairperson Benedicto Kondowe and National Coordinator Baxton Nkhoma released a statement saying justice delayed is justice denied.
en.body_more:
The 20 July demonstrations happened because people were angry about money troubles, bad government, and loss of freedom. Police opened fire on the protesters in several places. Many people were hurt, and 20 died. NAP says these people were martyrs. A martyr is a person who dies for what they believe in.

Fifteen years later, many families still have no money from the government. NAP says this is wrong. The government must pay the families soon. NAP said no money can bring back a dead child or parent. But the government has a duty to pay the families. This is written in the constitution. The constitution is the book of rules a country must follow.

NAP says the 20 martyrs died because they wanted justice, good government, and respect for people's rights. Malawi must not forget this. The country must build stronger government, where leaders tell the truth. The government must listen to people. Courts must be fair. When people disagree, they must talk, not fight.

NAP asked all Malawians: Have we truly honoured these 20 people? The answer is no, NAP said, until the families get help and the nation changes. Malawi must make sure no one ever dies again for asking for justice and freedom. The legacy of the 20 July martyrs must guide Malawi into the future.

ny.title: NAP ikufunsa kuti: Kodi Malawi yalemekeza anthu omwe anamwalira pa 20 Julayi?
ny.body: Patatha zaka 15 anthu 20 atamwalira pa ziwonetsero pa 20 Julayi 2011, National Advocacy Platform (NAP) yapempha boma kuti lipereke chipukuta misozi kwa mabanjawo. Pa chikondwererochi, Wapampando wa NAP Benedicto Kondowe ndi Wogwirizanitsa Dziko Baxton Nkhoma adatulutsa chikalata chonena kuti chilungamo chochedwa ndi kukanidwa.
ny.body_more:
Ziwonetsero za pa 20 Julayi zinachitika chifukwa anthu anali okwiya ndi mavuto azachuma, boma loipa, komanso kutayika kwa ufulu. Apolisi anawombera anthu otsutsa m'malo angapo. Anthu ambiri anavulala, ndipo 20 anamwalira. NAP ikunena kuti anthuwa anali ofera chikhulupiriro. Wofera chikhulupiriro ndi munthu amene amafa chifukwa cha zimene amakhulupirira.

Pambuyo pa zaka 15, mabanja ambiri alibe ndalama kuchokera ku boma. NAP ikunena kuti izi n'zolakwika. Boma liyenera kulipira mabanja posachedwa. NAP inati palibe ndalama zomwe zingabwezeretse mwana kapena kholo lakufa. Koma boma lili ndi udindo wolipira mabanja. Izi zalembedwa mu malamulo. Malamulo ndi buku la malamulo lomwe dziko liyenera kutsatira.

NAP ikunena kuti ofera chikhulupiriro 20 anafa chifukwa ankafuna chilungamo, boma labwino, komanso kulemekeza ufulu wa anthu. Malawi sayenera kuiwala izi. Dzikoli liyenera kumanga boma lolimba, komwe atsogoleri amanena zoona. Boma liyenera kumvera anthu. Makhothi ayenera kukhala achilungamo. Anthu akamatsutsana, ayenera kulankhula, osati kumenyana.

NAP inafunsa anthu onse aku Malawi kuti: Kodi tawalemekezadi anthu 20 awa? Yankho ndi ayi, NAP inatero, mpaka mabanja atalandira thandizo ndipo dziko lisinthe. Malawi iyenera kuonetsetsa kuti palibe amene adzamwalirenso chifukwa chopempha chilungamo ndi ufulu. Cholowa cha anthu omwe anamwalira pa 20 Julayi chiyenera kutsogolera Malawi mtsogolo.

en.title: Government gives K1.2 billion for youth and women loans
en.body: Malawi Enterprise Development Fund (Medf) has received K1.2 billion from the government. The money will help give loans to young people and women. Medf chief executive officer Kayisi Sadala said the funds started coming two weeks ago. The money comes from the Constituency Development Fund (CDF). This is money the government gives to help people in each area.
en.body_more:
Each area in Malawi gets K5 billion every year from the CDF. From this money, K100 million goes to youth loans and K100 million goes to women loans. Medf handles both types of loans.

The K1.2 billion released so far will help about 122,132 people. This includes 61,066 young people and 61,066 women across all areas. Groups of five to ten people can get between K2.5 million and K10 million. Single people can get between K250,000 and K500,000. The money helps people start or grow small businesses.

Sadala said the money is coming in phases. People who want a loan must fill out all forms correctly. Their applications must pass checks by Medf before they get the money. This process makes sure the loans go to people who really need them.

Medf now has a total loan portfolio of K240 billion. It has helped 377,460 Malawians so far. In 2025 alone, Medf gave out K116 billion. For this year, Medf wants to help 160,000 more people and give K100 billion through nine different loan types. These include loans for government workers, young people, women, farmers, traders and others. Medf started in 2005 as the Malawi Rural Development Fund. It became Medf in 2014, then changed to the National Economic Empowerment Fund in 2020. It became Medf again earlier this year.

ny.title: Boma lapereka K1.2 biliyoni kuti lipereke ngongole kwa achinyamata ndi akazi
ny.body: Ndalama za Malawi Enterprise Development Fund (Medf) zalandira K1.2 biliyoni kuchokera ku boma. Ndalamazi zithandiza kupereka ngongole kwa achinyamata ndi akazi. Mkulu wa bungwe la Medf, Kayisi Sadala, anati ndalamazi zinayamba kuperekedwa milungu iwiri yapitayo. Ndalamazi zimachokera ku Constituency Development Fund (CDF). Izi ndi ndalama zomwe boma limapereka kuti lithandize anthu m'dera lililonse.
ny.body_more:
Dera lililonse ku Malawi limalandira K5 biliyoni chaka chilichonse kuchokera ku CDF. Kuchokera mu ndalamazi, K100 miliyoni imapita ku ngongole za achinyamata ndipo K100 miliyoni imapita ku ngongole za akazi. Medf imayang'anira mitundu yonse iwiri ya ngongole.

K1.2 biliyoni yomwe yatulutsidwa mpaka pano ithandiza anthu pafupifupi 122,132. Izi zikuphatikizapo achinyamata 61,066 ndi akazi 61,066 m'madera onse. Magulu a anthu asanu mpaka khumi amatha kupeza pakati pa K2.5 miliyoni ndi K10 miliyoni. Anthu osakwatira amatha kupeza pakati pa K250,000 ndi K500,000. Ndalamazi zimathandiza anthu kuyambitsa kapena kukulitsa mabizinesi ang'onoang'ono.

Sadala adati ndalamazi zikubwera pang'onopang'ono. Anthu omwe akufuna ngongole ayenera kudzaza mafomu onse molondola. Mafomu awo ayenera kupitilira macheke a Medf asanalandire ndalamazo. Njirayi ikuwonetsetsa kuti ngongolezo zipita kwa anthu omwe amawafunadi.

Medf tsopano ili ndi ngongole yonse ya K240 biliyoni. Yathandiza anthu aku Malawi 377,460 mpaka pano. Mu 2025 yokha, Medf idapereka K116 biliyoni. Chaka chino, Medf ikufuna kuthandiza anthu ena 160,000 ndikupereka K100 biliyoni kudzera m'mitundu isanu ndi inayi ya ngongole. Izi zikuphatikizapo ngongole za ogwira ntchito m'boma, achinyamata, akazi, alimi, amalonda ndi ena. Medf idayamba mu 2005 ngati Malawi Rural Development Fund. Idadzakhala Medf mu 2014, kenako idasinthidwa kukhala National Economic Empowerment Fund mu 2020. Idadzakhalanso Medf koyambirira kwa chaka chino.

en.title: Government questions Finance Bank's K1 trillion claim
en.body: The Malawi government is fighting Finance Bank's K1 trillion compensation claim. In Blantyre, the State's lawyers questioned the bank's witnesses for five hours. The bank wants money because the government closed it in 2005. A court said the closure was wrong earlier this year.
en.body_more:
Finance Bank is asking for US$150 million for loss of rights and US$134 million for lost business. Attorney General Frank Mbeta and Reserve Bank lawyers Zumbe Kumwenda, James Masumbu, and Patrice Nkhono challenged the claim. They asked why the bank counted the money in US dollars when it took deposits and gave loans in Malawi kwacha. Mbeta said the figure was "huge" because the bank has been closed since 2006.

Finance Bank's lawyer called two witnesses: liquidator Sokwani Chilembo and adviser Nkhuzo Kuwani. Kuwani said the bank lost the chance to make more money. He told the court: "There was a loss of opportunity. We are pricing that opportunity." Chilembo said the claim was in US dollars because the owners were foreigners who gave money in dollars.

The Supreme Court ruled in February that the Reserve Bank wrongly closed Finance Bank. The closure started in May 2005. Before closing, the bank made K70 million profit in 2001 and K159 million in 2002. Between June and December 2005, deposits fell from K2.13 billion to K381 million. In 2014, the High Court gave Reserve Bank K13 million and rejected Finance Bank's first claim. Finance Bank opened in 1995 and closed fully in January 2006. In 2013, Reserve Bank gave a licence to New Finance Bank with the same owner, Rajan Mahtani, as a major shareholder.

ny.title: Boma likukayikira zomwe banki ya Finance Bank yapempha kuti ipereke K1 trillion
ny.body: Boma la Malawi likutsutsa pempho la Finance Bank la chipukuta misozi la K1 trillion. Ku Blantyre, maloya a boma adafunsa mboni za bankiyo kwa maola asanu. Bankiyo ikufuna ndalama chifukwa boma lidatseka nyumbayo mu 2005. Khothi linati kutseka nyumbayo kunali kolakwika koyambirira kwa chaka chino.
ny.body_more:
Banki ya Finance ikupempha US$150 miliyoni chifukwa cha kutayika kwa ufulu ndi US$134 miliyoni chifukwa cha kutayika kwa bizinesi. Loya Wamkulu Frank Mbeta ndi maloya a Reserve Bank Zumbe Kumwenda, James Masumbu, ndi Patrice Nkhono adatsutsa zomwe adanenazi. Adafunsa chifukwa chake bankiyo idawerengera ndalamazo mu madola aku US pomwe idatenga ndalama zosungiramo ndalama ndikulipira ngongole mu Malawi kwacha. Mbeta adati chiwerengerocho chinali "chachikulu" chifukwa bankiyo yatsekedwa kuyambira 2006.

Loya wa Banki ya Finance adayitana mboni ziwiri: woyang'anira ndalama Sokwani Chilembo ndi mlangizi Nkhuzo Kuwani. Kuwani adati bankiyo idataya mwayi wopeza ndalama zambiri. Adauza khothi kuti: "Panali kutayika kwa mwayi. Tikuyika mtengo wa mwayiwo." Chilembo adati zomwe adanenazi zinali mu madola aku US chifukwa eni ake anali akunja omwe adapereka ndalama mu madola.

Khothi Lalikulu lidagamula mu February kuti Banki ya Reserve idatseka Banki ya Finance molakwika. Kutseka kumeneku kunayamba mu Meyi 2005. Banki isanatseke, inapeza phindu la K70 miliyoni mu 2001 ndi K159 miliyoni mu 2002. Pakati pa Juni ndi Disembala 2005, ndalama zomwe zinasungidwa zinatsika kuchoka pa K2.13 biliyoni kufika pa K381 miliyoni.
