Mu 2014, Khothi Lalikulu linapatsa Reserve Bank K13 miliyoni ndipo linakana pempho loyamba la Finance Bank. Finance Bank inatsegulidwa mu 1995 ndipo inatsekedwa kwathunthu mu Januwale 2006. Mu 2013, Reserve Bank inapereka chilolezo ku New Finance Bank ndi mwiniwake yemweyo, Rajan Mahtani, ngati shareholder wamkulu.

en.title: FDH Bank gives K100 million to help MUST students
en.body: FDH Bank plc gave K100 million to Malawi University of Science and Technology (MUST) Endowment Fund. This helps poor students pay for school. The bank gave the money in Blantyre on Monday. This is the second gift from FDH Bank. The first gift was K106 million in 2023.
en.body_more:
FDH Financial Holdings Head of Marketing and Communication Ronald Chimchere spoke at the event. He said FDH Bank wants to help young Malawians through school. "We see this fund helps students," Chimchere said. "We believe school is needed for the country to grow. We want to help students finish their studies."

Chimchere said FDH Bank will keep giving money to MUST. They will help more students through the endowment fund. They will also start other new help plans.

MUST Vice-Chancellor Professor Address Malata thanked FDH Bank. She said the endowment fund stops many students from leaving school because of money problems. "FDH Bank help lets us help many poor students," Malata said. "Soon we will give school money (scholarships) to six students in November. We are proud and thank the bank very much."

The MUST Endowment Fund started in 2016. Endowment fund is money saved to help people over many years. Since then, the fund has collected almost K12 billion. This money helps students who do not have enough money for school costs. FDH Bank's two gifts now total K206 million.

ny.title: Banki ya FDH yapereka K100 miliyoni kuti ithandize ophunzira a MUST
ny.body: Banki ya FDH plc yapereka K100 miliyoni ku Malawi University of Science and Technology (MUST) Endowment Fund. Izi zimathandiza ophunzira osauka kulipira sukulu. Bankiyo idapereka ndalamazo ku Blantyre Lolemba. Iyi ndi mphatso yachiwiri yochokera ku Banki ya FDH. Mphatso yoyamba inali K106 miliyoni mu 2023.
ny.body_more:
Mtsogoleri wa Zamalonda ndi Kulankhulana wa FDH Financial Holdings, Ronald Chimchere, adalankhula pamwambowu. Iye adati FDH Bank ikufuna kuthandiza achinyamata aku Malawi kudzera m'masukulu. "Tikuwona kuti thumba ili likuthandiza ophunzira," adatero Chimchere. "Tikukhulupirira kuti sukulu ikufunika kuti dzikolo likule. Tikufuna kuthandiza ophunzira kumaliza maphunziro awo."

Chimchere adati FDH Bank ipitiliza kupereka ndalama ku MUST. Athandiza ophunzira ambiri kudzera mu thumba la ndalama zothandizira. Ayambitsanso mapulani ena atsopano othandizira.

Pulofesa Wachiwiri kwa Chancellor wa MUST, Address Malata, adathokoza FDH Bank. Iye adati thumba la ndalama zothandizira limaletsa ophunzira ambiri kusiya sukulu chifukwa cha mavuto azachuma. "Thandizo la FDH Bank limatithandiza kuthandiza ophunzira ambiri osauka," adatero Malata. "Posachedwapa tidzapereka ndalama za sukulu (maphunziro) kwa ophunzira asanu ndi mmodzi mu Novembala. Tikunyada ndipo tikuthokoza kwambiri bankiyo."

MUST Endowment Fund idayamba mu 2016. Endowment fund ndi ndalama zosungidwa kuti zithandize anthu kwa zaka zambiri. Kuyambira pamenepo, thumbali lasonkhanitsa pafupifupi K12 biliyoni. Ndalamazi zimathandiza ophunzira omwe alibe ndalama zokwanira zolipirira sukulu. Mphatso ziwiri za FDH Bank tsopano zikukwana K206 miliyoni.

en.title: MP asks for digital passport tracking system
en.body: A lawmaker has asked the government to digitise passports. Felix Njawala from Mwanza Central wants people to track applications online. Minister Peter Mukhito said government is already building this system. He also said passport printing has started again in Mangochi.
en.body_more:
Njawala proposed that people should be able to follow their passport applications through SMS, WhatsApp, a mobile app, or an online portal. He told Parliament that a digital system would cut direct contact between applicants and immigration staff. Less contact with staff means less corruption.

Njawala also suggested a queue system. Under this system, each applicant gets a number. The numbers show the order in which passports will be printed and given out. He said some people who applied later have received passports before people who waited almost a year.

Minister Mukhito agreed with Njawala. He called the queue idea "very, very good." Mukhito said government is already making the passport system better. The new system will have SMS messages, online portals, and WhatsApp so people can see what is happening with their applications. Mukhito said his ministry will work with the Ministry of Information to build the queue system. He said government understands that people are frustrated by long waits for passports. Mukhito said: "We feel the pain which most passport applicants are going through." He promised government will work hard to fix these problems.

Mukhito also told Parliament that passport printing has restarted in Mangochi. This means passports can now be printed there again. This restart will help speed up the work. Last year, the old minister said over 100,000 passports were waiting to be printed. The delay was because the government could not buy enough passport paper and supplies from other countries.

ny.title: MP apempha njira yotsatirira mapasipoti a digito
ny.body: Wopanga malamulo wapempha boma kuti lisinthe ma pasipoti kukhala a digito. Felix Njawala wochokera ku Mwanza Central akufuna kuti anthu azitsatira ma fomu ofunsira pa intaneti. Nduna Peter Mukhito adati boma likupanga kale njira imeneyi. Anatinso kusindikiza ma pasipoti kwayambanso ku Mangochi.
ny.body_more:
Njawala adapereka lingaliro lakuti anthu ayenera kutsatira ma pasipoti awo kudzera pa SMS, WhatsApp, pulogalamu yam'manja, kapena tsamba la pa intaneti. Adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti njira ya digito ingachepetse kulumikizana mwachindunji pakati pa ofunsira ndi ogwira ntchito zosamukira. Kusalumikizana kochepa ndi ogwira ntchito kumatanthauza kuti ziphuphu sizichepa.

Njawala adaperekanso lingaliro la njira yoyimilira. Pansi pa njira iyi, wofunsira aliyense amalandira nambala. Manambalawa akuwonetsa dongosolo lomwe ma pasipoti adzasindikizidwe ndikuperekedwa. Adati anthu ena omwe adalembetsa pambuyo pake adalandira ma pasipoti anthu asanadikire pafupifupi chaka.

Nduna Mukhito adagwirizana ndi Njawala. Adatcha lingaliro la mzere "labwino kwambiri." Mukhito adati boma likusintha kale njira ya pasipoti kukhala yabwino. Njira yatsopanoyi idzakhala ndi mauthenga a SMS, ma portal apaintaneti, ndi WhatsApp kuti anthu athe kuwona zomwe zikuchitika ndi ma mafomu awo. Mukhito adati unduna wake udzagwira ntchito ndi Unduna wa Zachidziwitso kuti apange njira yoyimilira. Adati boma likumvetsa kuti anthu akukhumudwa chifukwa cha kudikira kwa nthawi yayitali ma pasipoti. Mukhito adati: "Tikumva ululu womwe ambiri ofunsira ma pasipoti akukumana nawo." Adalonjeza kuti boma lidzagwira ntchito molimbika kuti likonze mavutowa.

Mukhito adauzanso Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti kusindikiza mapasipoti kwayambiranso ku Mangochi. Izi zikutanthauza kuti mapasipoti tsopano akhoza kusindikizidwanso kumeneko. Kuyambiranso kumeneku kudzathandiza kuti ntchito ifulumire. Chaka chatha, nduna yakale idati mapasipoti opitilira 100,000 anali kuyembekezera kusindikizidwa. Kuchedwa kumeneku kunali chifukwa boma silinathe kugula mapepala ndi zinthu zokwanira kuchokera kumayiko ena.

en.title: Four people die in motorcycle crash on Dedza road
en.body: Four people died in a road crash near Masasa on the Dedza-Ntcheu M1 road. A motorcycle crashed into a car that was coming the other way. The people were taken to Dedza District Hospital but doctors could not save them.
en.body_more:
The crash happened when a Lifan motorcycle tried to pass another vehicle. The motorcycle was coming from Lizulu direction. It moved into the other lane and hit a Toyota Prado car head-on. The car belonged to the Ministry of Energy and had registration number MG 381.

The car driver was Kasakula Namalika. He had one passenger with him. They were driving from Dedza to Lizulu. The motorcycle had no registration plate. It was carrying three passengers plus the rider. All four people on the motorcycle got very bad injuries.

Three of the dead were from Ntcheu. They were Timothy Gift, age 27, Western George, age 32, and Fara Chokapa, age 29. All three came from Traditional Authority Masasa in Ntcheu. The fourth person was Asiyatu Motasi, age 26, from Mozambique. She came from Zimenyana in T/A Majawa Angonia.

Ntcheu Police Station deputy spokesperson Beatrice Mlauzi told people about the crash. She said the four people died when they arrived at the hospital. Police asked motorcycle drivers to follow safety rules. Drivers must carry only the right number of passengers. This helps them control the motorcycle better. Last week, eight people died in another crash at Bembeke Trading Centre, about 25 kilometres away.

ny.title: Anthu anayi afa pangozi ya njinga yamoto pamsewu wa Dedza
ny.body: Anthu anayi afa pangozi ya pamsewu pafupi ndi Masasa pamsewu wa Dedza-Ntcheu M1. Njinga yamoto yagunda galimoto yomwe ikubwera mbali ina. Anthuwo adatengedwera ku chipatala cha Dedza District koma madokotala sanathe kuwapulumutsa.
ny.body_more:
Ngoziyi inachitika pamene njinga yamoto ya Lifan inkafuna kudutsa galimoto ina. Njinga yamotoyo inkachokera ku Lizulu. Inalowa mumsewu wina ndipo inagunda galimoto ya Toyota Prado. Galimotoyo inali ya Unduna wa Zamagetsi ndipo inali ndi nambala yolembetsera MG 381.

Woyendetsa galimotoyo anali Kasakula Namalika. Anali ndi wokwera m'modzi. Ankayendetsa galimoto kuchokera ku Dedza kupita ku Lizulu. Njinga yamotoyo inalibe chikwangwani cholembetsera. Inali ndi anthu atatu kuphatikiza wokwera. Anthu onse anayi omwe anali pa njinga yamotoyo anavulala kwambiri.

Atatu mwa omwe anamwalira anali ochokera ku Ntcheu. Anali Timothy Gift, wazaka 27, Western George, wazaka 32, ndi Fara Chokapa, wazaka 29. Onse atatu anachokera ku Traditional Authority Masasa ku Ntcheu. Munthu wachinayi anali Asiyatu Motasi, wazaka 26, wochokera ku Mozambique. Anachokera ku Zimenyana ku T/A Majawa Angonia.

Wachiwiri kwa wolankhulira wa Ntcheu Police Station Beatrice Mlauzi anauza anthu za ngoziyi. Iye anati anthu anayiwo anamwalira atafika kuchipatala. Apolisi apempha oyendetsa njinga zamoto kuti atsatire malamulo achitetezo. Oyendetsa njinga zamoto ayenera kunyamula anthu okwanira okha. Izi zimawathandiza kuyendetsa bwino njinga yamoto. Sabata yatha, anthu asanu ndi atatu anamwalira pangozi ina ku Bembeke Trading Centre, yomwe ili pamtunda wa makilomita 25 kuchokera kumeneko.

en.title: Mining Minister Visits Portland Cement's K200bn Plant
en.body: Malawi's Minister of Mining Thoko Tembo visited Portland Cement's plant in Balaka. He praised the company's K200 billion investment in manufacturing and mining. The investment creates jobs and helps Malawi make more cement at home. The company's chief executive Liu Jianguo said the firm follows all rules.
en.body_more:
Tembo toured the plant and mining operations with government officials from Balaka District Council. He said Portland Cement can help Malawi earn money from selling cement to other countries. The minister called the Balaka plant a big step for Malawi's industry. He said the plant helps local cement production grow and creates work for many people.

Liu told Tembo and his team that Portland Cement makes high-quality cement. He said the company follows all government rules and keeps workers safe. Liu also said the company cares for the environment and helps local people. He spoke about Corporate Social Responsibility. This means big companies help their communities grow stronger.

Balaka District Council Vice Chairperson Tiyanjane Chisowile said the investment helps the district. Chisowile said Portland Cement will build classroom blocks at Ngonga Primary School. This will help more children learn in better classrooms. Portland Cement was started in 1956. The company also runs plants in Makata and Lunzu in Blantyre.

ny.title: Nduna ya Zamigodi Yayendera Fakitale ya Simenti ya Portland Yogulitsa K200 Biliyoni
ny.body: Nduna ya Zamigodi ku Malawi, Thoko Tembo, adapita ku fakitale ya Portland Cement ku Balaka. Iye adayamikira ndalama zokwana K200 biliyoni zomwe kampaniyo yayika pakupanga ndi migodi. Ndalamazi zimapanga ntchito ndipo zimathandiza Malawi kupanga simenti yambiri kunyumba. Mkulu wa kampaniyo, Liu Jianguo, adati kampaniyo imatsatira malamulo onse.
ny.body_more:
Tembo adayendera fakitale ndi ntchito zamigodi ndi akuluakulu aboma ochokera ku Balaka District Council. Anati Portland Cement ingathandize Malawi kupeza ndalama pogulitsa simenti kumayiko ena. Ndunayo idati chomera cha Balaka ndi sitepe yayikulu kwa mafakitale aku Malawi. Anati chomerachi chimathandiza kupanga simenti yakomweko kukula ndikupangitsa anthu ambiri kugwira ntchito.

Liu adauza Tembo ndi gulu lake kuti Portland Cement imapanga simenti yapamwamba kwambiri. Anati kampaniyo imatsatira malamulo onse aboma ndipo imateteza antchito. Liu adatinso kampaniyo imasamalira chilengedwe ndipo imathandiza anthu amderalo. Adalankhula za Udindo wa Makampani Pagulu. Izi zikutanthauza kuti makampani akuluakulu amathandiza madera awo kukhala olimba.

Wachiwiri kwa Wapampando wa Balaka District Council, Tiyanjane Chisowile, adati ndalama zomwe zayikidwa zimathandiza chigawochi. Chisowile adati Portland Cement imanga matabwa a makalasi ku Ngonga Primary School. Izi zithandiza ana ambiri kuphunzira m'makalasi abwino. Portland Cement idakhazikitsidwa mu 1956. Kampaniyo imayendetsanso mafakitale ku Makata ndi Lunzu ku Blantyre.

en.title: Malawi artists get K1.8 billion in royalty payments
en.body: Malawian musicians, actors and writers shared K1.8 billion in royalty money on Monday in Lilongwe. The Copyright Society of Malawi (COSOMA) gave out the cash. This is much more than last year's K1 billion. The money covers creative works made between April 2025 and March 2026.
en.body_more:
COSOMA Executive Director Dora Makwinja said musicians got the most money — K1 billion went to 2,975 artists. Writers got K519 million. Film workers got K259 million. Makwinja told artists to keep making good work and to protect their ideas.

The royalty is a levy. A levy is a tax on something. The blank media levy is money collected on storage devices like memory cards, blank CDs and DVDs. This money goes to artists because people copy their work onto these devices. COSOMA works with the Malawi Revenue Authority to collect and share this money.

Actress Joyce Chavula was one person who got money. She said the payment shows her hard work is valued. Top music earners this year included Phyzix, Onesimus, Lucius Banda, Zeze Kingston, Driemo, Kelly Kay and Saint. But some gospel music artists said no gospel musician was on the top earners list. This made them unhappy. Musician Amos Mlolowa asked why gospel songs did not earn enough to be named among top earners.

Humphrey Mpondaminga works for the Ministry of Youth, Sports and Culture. He said the creative industry helps Malawi make money and grow. The government wants to help artists keep making more work, he said.

ny.title: Oimba aku Malawi alandira ndalama zokwana K1.8 biliyoni za royalty
ny.body: Oimba, ochita sewero ndi olemba aku Malawi adagawana ndalama zokwana K1.8 biliyoni zachifumu Lolemba ku Lilongwe. Bungwe la Copyright Society of Malawi (COSOMA) linapereka ndalamazo. Izi ndi zoposa K1 biliyoni ya chaka chatha. Ndalamazo zikuphatikiza ntchito zolenga zomwe zidapangidwa pakati pa Epulo 2025 ndi Marichi 2026.
ny.body_more:
Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa COSOMA, Dora Makwinja, anati oimba adapeza ndalama zambiri — K1 biliyoni idapita kwa ojambula 2,975. Olemba adapeza K519 miliyoni. Ogwira ntchito m'mafilimu adapeza K259 miliyoni. Makwinja adauza ojambula kuti apitirize kugwira ntchito yabwino ndikuteteza malingaliro awo.

Mtengo wachifumu ndi msonkho. Msonkho ndi msonkho pa chinthu china. Msonkho wa atolankhani wopanda kanthu ndi ndalama zomwe zimasonkhanitsidwa pazipangizo zosungiramo zinthu monga makadi okumbukira, ma CD opanda kanthu ndi ma DVD. Ndalamazi zimapita kwa ojambula chifukwa anthu amakopera ntchito zawo pazipangizozi. COSOMA imagwira ntchito ndi Malawi Revenue Authority kuti itole ndikugawana ndalamazi.

Wochita sewero Joyce Chavula anali munthu m'modzi amene adapeza ndalama. Anati malipirowo akuwonetsa kuti ntchito yake yolimba ndi yofunika. Omwe adapeza nyimbo zapamwamba chaka chino anali Phyzix, Onesimo, Lucius Banda, Zeze Kingston, Driemo, Kelly Kay ndi Saint. Koma ojambula ena a nyimbo za gospel adati palibe woimba nyimbo za gospel yemwe anali pamndandanda wa omwe amapeza ndalama zambiri. Izi zidawapangitsa kukhala osasangalala. Woimba Amos Mlolowa adafunsa chifukwa chake nyimbo za gospel sizinapeze ndalama zokwanira kuti zitchulidwe pakati pa omwe amapeza ndalama zambiri.

Humphrey Mpondaminga amagwira ntchito ku Unduna wa Achinyamata, Masewera ndi Chikhalidwe. Iye anati makampani opanga zinthu zatsopano amathandiza Malawi kupeza ndalama ndikukula. Boma likufuna kuthandiza ojambula kuti apitirize kupanga ntchito zambiri, iye anatero.

en.title: Bank Says Malawi Growth Will Be Slow This Year
en.body: The African Development Bank and local economists say Malawi's economy will grow slowly this year. They say the outlook is mixed and unclear. Inflation has come down, which is good. But growth will not be fast. The bank says the economy depends on keeping inflation low and avoiding shocks from world markets.
en.body_more:
Inflation is the rise in prices of things people buy. It has dropped from very high levels to a lower range. This is a sign things are getting better. However, growth is expected to be around 2 to 3 percent. This is slow growth. It means businesses must be careful when they spend money on new projects.

Business owners must plan well during this time. Lower inflation could help banks give loans at lower costs. This makes it cheaper for people to borrow money. But banks will still ask for proof that people can pay back the loans. Farmers and food businesses may do well because food is always needed in Malawi.

Other sectors face challenges. Tourism and making goods have mixed chances. Some businesses are using mobile money like M-Pesa to do their work. This helps them move faster. Yet many people do not know how to use digital tools, mainly in villages. Training can help fix this problem. Cooperatives where farmers and traders work together are growing. They share tools and sell their goods together to get better prices.

Road damage and power cuts hurt businesses. They add extra costs. Companies need to work with the government to fix roads and power supply. Some are buying solar power systems for their shops and factories. As more people get phones, buying and selling online is growing. But delivering goods to customers is still hard. Businesses that find good delivery partners will do better. The key message is: focus on what you can control, stay safe with money, and use new tools like phones and the internet.

ny.title: Banki Yati Kukula kwa Malawi Kudzachepa Chaka Chino
ny.body: Banki Yachitukuko ku Africa ndi akatswiri azachuma akumaloko akuti chuma cha Malawi chikukula pang'onopang'ono chaka chino. Akuti momwe zinthu zilili panopa n'zosiyana ndipo sizikudziwika bwino. Kukwera kwa mitengo kwatsika, zomwe ndi zabwino. Koma kukula sikudzakhala mwachangu. Bankiyo ikunena kuti chuma chimadalira kusunga kukwera kwa mitengo kukhala kotsika komanso kupewa kusokonezeka kwa misika yapadziko lonse.
ny.body_more:
Kukwera kwa mitengo ya zinthu zomwe anthu amagula ndi kukwera kwa mitengo ya zinthu zomwe anthu amagula. Kwatsika kuchoka pamlingo wapamwamba kwambiri kufika pamlingo wotsika. Ichi ndi chizindikiro chakuti zinthu zikuyenda bwino. Komabe, kukula kukuyembekezeka kukhala pafupifupi 2 mpaka 3 peresenti. Uku ndi kukula pang'onopang'ono. Izi zikutanthauza kuti mabizinesi ayenera kusamala akamagwiritsa ntchito ndalama pa mapulojekiti atsopano.

Eni mabizinesi ayenera kukonzekera bwino panthawiyi. Kutsika kwa mitengo ya zinthu kungathandize mabanki kupereka ngongole pamtengo wotsika. Izi zimapangitsa kuti anthu azibwereka ndalama mosavuta. Koma mabanki adzapemphabe umboni woti anthu akhoza kubweza ngongolezo. Alimi ndi mabizinesi azakudya angachite bwino chifukwa chakudya nthawi zonse chimafunika ku Malawi.

Magawo ena akukumana ndi mavuto. Zokopa alendo ndi kupanga zinthu zili ndi mwayi wosiyanasiyana. Mabizinesi ena akugwiritsa ntchito ndalama zam'manja monga M-Pesa kuti agwire ntchito yawo. Izi zimawathandiza kuyenda mwachangu. Komabe anthu ambiri sadziwa momwe angagwiritsire ntchito zida zama digito, makamaka m'midzi. Maphunziro angathandize kuthetsa vutoli. Mabungwe ogwirizana komwe alimi ndi amalonda amagwira ntchito limodzi akukulirakulira. Amagawana zida ndikugulitsa katundu wawo pamodzi kuti apeze mitengo yabwino.

Kuwonongeka kwa misewu ndi kuchepetsedwa kwa magetsi kumavulaza mabizinesi. Zimawonjezera ndalama zowonjezera. Makampani ayenera kugwira ntchito ndi boma kuti akonze misewu ndi magetsi. Ena akugula magetsi a dzuwa m'masitolo ndi m'mafakitale awo. Pamene anthu ambiri akupeza mafoni, kugula ndi kugulitsa pa intaneti kukukula. Koma kutumiza katundu kwa makasitomala kukuvutabe. Mabizinesi omwe amapeza ogwirizana nawo abwino otumizira katundu adzachita bwino. Uthenga waukulu ndi wakuti: yang'anani pa zomwe mungathe kuzilamulira, khalani otetezeka ndi ndalama, ndikugwiritsa ntchito zida zatsopano monga mafoni ndi intaneti.

en.title: Police investigate death of university lecturer in Zomba
en.body: Police in Zomba are looking into the death of Mary Hamba Nyirenda. She was an assistant lecturer at the University of Malawi. She was found dead at her home in Zakazaka on the evening of 19 July 2026. Her family raised an alarm when she did not answer their calls.
en.body_more:
Constable Andrew Mwale is the deputy public relations officer for Zomba police station. He said that early investigations show Nyirenda had surgery at Banja La Mtsogolo clinic on 30 June. On 18 July, she told her family that the surgical wound had opened again. The stitches had come loose, which caused her severe pain. She could not sleep because of the pain.

On the evening of 19 July, at around 8 p.m., Nyirenda locked herself in her bedroom. Her family tried many times to call her, but she did not answer. Her uncle became worried and forced the door open. He found her unresponsive inside the room. The family immediately told the police about what had happened.

Police officers went to the home and saw the body. Nyirenda's body was then taken to Zomba Central Hospital mortuary. Doctors will do a post-mortem examination to find out why she died. Nyirenda was 23 years old. She came from Chadza Village in Lilongwe District, under Traditional Authority Chadza. Police say they are still investigating what happened.

ny.title: Apolisi akufufuza za imfa ya mphunzitsi wa yunivesite ku Zomba
ny.body: Apolisi ku Zomba akufufuza za imfa ya Mary Hamba Nyirenda. Iye anali mphunzitsi wothandizira ku University of Malawi. Anapezeka atafa kunyumba kwake ku Zakazaka madzulo a pa 19 Julayi 2026. Banja lake linamuchenjeza pamene sanayankhe mafoni awo.
ny.body_more:
Constable Andrew Mwale ndi wachiwiri kwa mkulu wa ubale wa anthu ku siteshoni ya apolisi ku Zomba. Iye anati kafukufuku woyambirira akusonyeza kuti Nyirenda adachitidwa opaleshoni ku chipatala cha Banja La Mtsogolo pa 30 June. Pa 18 July, adauza banja lake kuti bala la opaleshoni lidatsegukanso. Masokisi adamasuka, zomwe zidamupangitsa kupweteka kwambiri. Sanathe kugona chifukwa cha ululu.

Madzulo a pa 19 July, pafupifupi 8 koloko madzulo, Nyirenda adadzitsekera m'chipinda chake chogona. Banja lake linayesa kangapo kumuyimbira foni, koma sanayankhe. Amalume ake adada nkhawa ndipo adakakamiza chitseko kutsegula. Anamupeza wosayankha mkati mwa chipindacho. Banja nthawi yomweyo linauza apolisi zomwe zidachitika.

Apolisi adapita kunyumbako ndikuwona thupilo. Kenako thupi la Nyirenda linatengedwa kupita ku mortuary ya Chipatala cha Zomba Central. Madokotala adzachita kafukufuku wa pambuyo pa imfa kuti adziwe chifukwa chake adamwalira. Nyirenda anali ndi zaka 23. Amachokera ku Mudzi wa Chadza ku Lilongwe District, pansi pa Traditional Authority Chadza. Apolisi akuti akadali kufufuza zomwe zidachitika.

en.title: Silver Strikers beat Karonga United 4-1 in league match
en.body: Silver Strikers won 4-1 against Karonga United yesterday. The match was in the FDH Bank Premiership at Silver Stadium in Lilongwe. Silver is now joint top of the table with Mighty Wanderers. Both teams have 21 points from 10 games each.
en.body_more:
Silver had lost 3-0 to Karonga United the week before in the Airtel Top 8 Tournament. This win was revenge for that loss. The first half had no goals. Karonga played well and was hard to beat. But Silver came back stronger in the second half.

Lassuli Jali scored first in the 51st minute. Two minutes later, Innocent Shema made it 2-0 with a header. Chinsisi Maonga scored the third goal in the 59th minute. Karonga got one goal back from a penalty kick. Lennox Kiwambe scored the penalty. But Charles Chipala scored Silver's fourth goal in the 86th minute from a cross by Charles Gototo.

Silver's assistant coach Mapopa Musukwa said the team played better in the second half. "We told the players to stay calm and follow our plan," he said. Karonga's coach Christopher Chinkwita said his team lost focus. "We started well but lost concentration. Silver scored three goals very fast," he said.

Other matches happened too. FCB Nyasa Bullets and Ekhaya FC drew 0-0 at Mpira Stadium in Blantyre. Bullets stay third with 20 points. At Civo Stadium in Lilongwe, Kamuzu Barracks beat Blue Eagles 2-1. Eagles are now fourth with 19 points. Only two points separate the top four teams now.

ny.title: Silver Strikers yagonjetsa Karonga United 4-1 mu ligi.
ny.body: Silver Strikers yapambana 4-1 motsutsana ndi Karonga United dzulo. Masewerawa anali mu FDH Bank Premiership ku Silver Stadium ku Lilongwe. Silver tsopano ili pamwamba pa tebulo limodzi ndi Mighty Wanderers. Magulu onse awiri ali ndi mapointi 21 kuchokera pamasewera 10 aliwonse.
ny.body_more:
Silver idataya 3-0 ndi Karonga United sabata yatha mu mpikisano wa Airtel Top 8. Kupambana kumeneku kunali kubwezera kutayika kumeneko. Gawo loyamba silinapeze zigoli. Karonga adasewera bwino ndipo zinali zovuta kugonjetsa. Koma Silver idabweranso mwamphamvu mu theka lachiwiri.

Lassuli Jali adagoletsa chigoli choyamba mu mphindi ya 51. Patatha mphindi ziwiri, Innocent Shema adapanga 2-0 ndi mutu. Chinsisi Maonga adagoletsa chigoli chachitatu mu mphindi ya 59. Karonga adapeza chigoli chimodzi kuchokera ku penalty kick. Lennox Kiwambe adagoletsa chigoli. Koma Charles Chipala adagoletsa chigoli chachinayi cha Silver mu mphindi ya 86 kuchokera ku cross ya Charles Gototo.

Wothandizira mphunzitsi wa Silver, Mapopa Musukwa, adati timuyi idasewera bwino mu theka lachiwiri. "Tidauza osewera kuti akhale chete ndikutsatira dongosolo lathu," adatero. Mphunzitsi wa Karonga, Christopher Chinkwita, adati timu yake idataya chidwi. "Tinayamba bwino koma tidataya chidwi. Silver idagoletsa zigoli zitatu mwachangu kwambiri," adatero.

Masewera ena adachitikanso. FCB Nyasa Bullets ndi Ekhaya FC adagwirizana 0-0 pa Mpira Stadium ku Blantyre. Bullets ili pa nambala 3 ndi mapointi 20. Pa Civo Stadium ku Lilongwe, Kamuzu Barracks idagonjetsa Blue Eagles 2-1. Eagles tsopano ili pa nambala 4 ndi mapointi 19. Mapointi awiri okha ndi omwe akusiyanitsa magulu anayi apamwamba tsopano.

en.title: Malawi plans to build fertiliser factory by 2028
en.body: The government of Malawi will build a fertiliser factory by the 2027/28 farming season. Minister of Agriculture Roza Mbilizi said this on Friday in Blantyre. Morocco sent experts to help plan the factory. Malawi got 500 metric tonnes of fertiliser from Morocco on Friday.
en.body_more:
Mbilizi said the plan started in March 2026 and must keep moving forward. Morocco sent a team of experts from OCP Africa, a fertiliser company. These experts held a workshop with Malawian experts to plan the new factory. The government wants local fertiliser production to reduce the need to buy fertiliser from other countries.

Malawi asked Morocco for help after many people went hungry last year. President Peter Mutharika asked for aid. Morocco said it would give 1,000 metric tonnes of fertiliser to Malawi. The first 500 tonnes came in February 2026. The final 500 tonnes arrived on Friday. Mbilizi said this fertiliser will help small farmers and people who do irrigation farming. Irrigation farming means using water to grow food in dry areas.

Morocco's ambassador to Malawi, Mohammed Oumiyer, said the gift shows the two countries work well together. He said King Mohammed VI wants to help other countries and grow partnerships. Mbilizi said Malawi and Morocco will work together on more things too. These include building irrigation systems, sharing farm knowledge, teaching new skills, and selling farm goods.

The new fertiliser factory will help Malawi grow more food. It will cut the cost of buying fertiliser from other places. Mbilizi said this is important because El Niño weather may come soon. El Niño is a weather pattern that can hurt crops.

ny.title: Malawi ikukonzekera kumanga fakitale ya feteleza pofika chaka cha 2028
ny.body: Boma la Malawi lidzamanga fakitale ya feteleza pofika nyengo ya ulimi ya 2027/28. Nduna ya zaulimi Roza Mbilizi adanena izi Lachisanu ku Blantyre. Morocco yatumiza akatswiri kuti athandize kukonza fakitaleyo. Malawi idalandira matani 500 a feteleza kuchokera ku Morocco Lachisanu.
ny.body_more:
Mbilizi anati dongosololi linayamba mu Marichi 2026 ndipo liyenera kupitilizabe. Morocco inatumiza gulu la akatswiri ochokera ku OCP Africa, kampani yopanga feteleza. Akatswiriwa adachita msonkhano ndi akatswiri aku Malawi kuti akonze fakitale yatsopanoyi. Boma likufuna kuti kupanga feteleza m'deralo kuchepetse kufunikira kogula feteleza kuchokera kumayiko ena.

Malawi inapempha thandizo ku Morocco anthu ambiri atavutika ndi njala chaka chatha. Purezidenti Peter Mutharika anapempha thandizo. Morocco inati ipereka matani 1,000 a feteleza ku Malawi. Matani 500 oyamba adabwera mu February 2026. Matani 500 omaliza adafika Lachisanu. Mbilizi anati feteleza uyu athandiza alimi ang'onoang'ono ndi anthu omwe amachita ulimi wothirira. Ulimi wothirira umatanthauza kugwiritsa ntchito madzi kulima chakudya m'malo ouma.

Kazembe wa Morocco ku Malawi, Mohammed Oumiyer, anati mphatsoyi ikuwonetsa kuti mayiko awiriwa amagwira ntchito limodzi bwino. Anati Mfumu Mohammed VI ikufuna kuthandiza mayiko ena ndikukulitsa mgwirizano. Mbilizi anati Malawi ndi Morocco zidzagwiranso ntchito limodzi pazinthu zina. Izi zikuphatikizapo kumanga njira zothirira, kugawana chidziwitso cha ulimi, kuphunzitsa maluso atsopano, ndikugulitsa zinthu zaulimi.

Fakitale yatsopano ya feteleza ithandiza Malawi kulima chakudya chochuluka. Idzachepetsa ndalama zogulira feteleza kuchokera kumadera ena. Mbilizi adati izi ndizofunikira chifukwa nyengo ya El Niño ingabwere posachedwa. El Niño ndi nyengo yomwe ingawononge mbewu.

en.title: Malawi hopes rare earth mine will bring money
en.body: Malawi's mining minister Thoko Tembo met with Mkango Resources. The company showed him plans for Songwe Hill rare earths mine. The project could bring $1.91 billion in total money. The government could get $1.23 billion through taxes and shares.
en.body_more:
The mine is in Phalombe district. Mkango Resources president Alexander Lemon led the briefing. He said the company's 10 per cent stake in the project means the government will earn money from taxes, royalties, and dividends. Royalties are payments made to the government when minerals are removed from the ground.

Minister Tembo visited the site on Saturday. He said Songwe Hill is one of Malawi's best mining projects. Tembo explained that a moratorium is now in place — this means new mining licences have stopped being given. Moratoriums are temporary stops on something. The Ministry is now finishing the legal rules needed before mining can start. He said the project will create jobs, add more value to the minerals, and help Malawi's economy grow.

Lemon told the minister that exploration work is finished. His team completed a new feasibility study report. Feasibility study means checking if the project can work. The company is now waiting for a mining licence. It will also do Front End Engineering Design work, or FEED, before construction begins. Lemon said the project is a game changer for Malawi. The company plans to process and add value to rare earths right here in Phalombe instead of selling them raw.

Traditional leader TA Mkhumba welcomed the news on behalf of Paramount Chief Kaduya. Community leaders said local people want construction to start soon. They expect the mine will bring new jobs and money to the area. The mine is expected to produce about 5,954 tonnes of rare earth oxides each year. It will operate for around 18 years.

ny.title: Malawi ikuyembekeza kuti migodi ya rare earth ibweretsa ndalama
ny.body: Nduna ya migodi ku Malawi, Thoko Tembo, anakumana ndi Mkango Resources. Kampaniyo inamuwonetsa mapulani a mgodi wa Songwe Hill rare earths. Ntchitoyi ikhoza kubweretsa ndalama zokwana $1.91 biliyoni. Boma likhoza kupeza $1.23 biliyoni kudzera mu misonkho ndi magawo.
ny.body_more:
Mgodi uli m'boma la Phalombe. Purezidenti wa Mkango Resources, Alexander Lemon, adatsogolera msonkhanowo. Anati gawo la 10 peresenti la kampaniyo mu ntchitoyi likutanthauza kuti boma lidzapeza ndalama kuchokera ku misonkho, ma royalties, ndi magawo. Ma royalties ndi malipiro omwe amaperekedwa ku boma pamene miyala yamtengo wapatali yachotsedwa pansi.

Nduna Tembo adapita kumalowa Loweruka. Anati Songwe Hill ndi imodzi mwa mapulojekiti abwino kwambiri a migodi ku Malawi. Tembo adafotokoza kuti kuyimitsa ntchito kwachitika tsopano - izi zikutanthauza kuti zilolezo zatsopano za migodi zasiya kuperekedwa. Kuyimitsa ntchito ndi kuyimitsa kwakanthawi pa chinthu china. Unduna tsopano ukumaliza malamulo ofunikira migodi isanayambe. Anati polojekitiyi ipanga ntchito, kuwonjezera phindu ku miyala yamtengo wapatali, ndikuthandiza chuma cha Malawi kukula.

Lemon adauza nduna kuti ntchito yofufuza yatha. Gulu lake lamaliza lipoti latsopano lofufuza momwe zinthu zikuyendera. Kafukufuku wotheka umatanthauza kuwona ngati polojekitiyi ingagwire ntchito. Kampaniyo tsopano ikuyembekezera chilolezo cha migodi. Idzachitanso ntchito ya Front End Engineering Design, kapena FEED, isanayambe kumanga. Lemon adati ntchitoyi ndi yosintha kwambiri dziko la Malawi. Kampaniyo ikukonzekera kukonza ndikuwonjezera phindu ku nthaka yosowa kuno ku Phalombe m'malo moigulitsa yopanda kanthu.

Mtsogoleri wachikhalidwe TA Mkhumba walandila nkhaniyi m'malo mwa Chief Kaduya. Atsogoleri ammudzi adati anthu am'deralo akufuna kuti ntchito yomanga iyambe posachedwa. Akuyembekeza kuti mgodiwu ubweretsa ntchito zatsopano ndi ndalama kuderali. Mgodiwu ukuyembekezeka kupanga matani pafupifupi 5,954 a ma oxides a nthaka yosowa chaka chilichonse. Udzagwira ntchito kwa zaka pafupifupi 18.

en.title: Admarc flour rots as families need food
en.body: Agricultural Development and Marketing Corporation (Admarc) let maize flour rot in storage while many Malawians could not find affordable flour to buy. The Parliamentary Committee on Agriculture and Irrigation found that Admarc made the flour called Thanzi but did not plan well. Poor storage and bad handling left flour worth K29.5 million unfit to eat.
en.body_more:
Admarc started the Thanzi Maize Flour Pilot Project to test if people wanted to buy the flour. The company took 473.642 metric tonnes of maize to Sungold Food Processors Limited. They made cream of maize, mgaiwa and maize bran under the Thanzi name. The plan was to see if the flour would sell before Admarc built its own mill.

But problems came quickly. Inspectors from Admarc found that 75.762 metric tonnes had weevils and larvae in it. The flour became lumpy and was not safe to eat. Another 48.812 metric tonnes was still being tested for aflatoxin, which is a poison that grows in grain. In the end, 15,129 kilogrammes of flour was confirmed unsafe. The contaminated flour came from Zomba, Ngabu and Chilambula.

The Parliamentary Committee said Admarc caused the losses. The company stored the flour too long after it stopped selling it. The storage rooms were poor. The flour was moved in bad ways that let water and dirt get into it. Admarc made too much flour that no one wanted to buy. The company also did no study before starting the project. No one checked the risks. No special team ran the project. The committee said people who ran this project should be investigated. They may have wasted money on purpose or been careless.

Willy Kambwandira works for the Centre for Social Accountability and Transparency. He said the findings are very bad. He asked for an independent check of what happened. He said the public money should be returned if people were careless. Anyone who broke the law should go to court. This is not the first time Admarc lost grain. In 2021, about 1,285 metric tonnes of maize rotted. In 2024, Admarc threw away 12,304 metric tonnes of maize because it was not safe.

ny.title: Ufa wa Admarc wavunda chifukwa mabanja akusowa chakudya
ny.body: Bungwe Loona za Chitukuko cha Zaulimi ndi Malonda (Admarc) linalola ufa wa chimanga kuwola pamene anthu ambiri aku Malawi sankatha kupeza ufa wotsika mtengo woti agule. Komiti Yanyumba Yamalamulo Yoona za Ulimi ndi Ulimi inapeza kuti Admarc inapanga ufa wotchedwa Thanzi koma sinakonzekere bwino. Kusasunga bwino komanso kusagwiritsa ntchito bwino ufa kunapangitsa kuti ufa wa K29.5 miliyoni ukhale wosafunika kudya.
ny.body_more:
Admarc inayambitsa Thanzi Maize Flour Pilot Project kuti iyese ngati anthu akufuna kugula ufawo. Kampaniyo inatenga matani 473.642 a chimanga ku Sungold Food Processors Limited. Anapanga kirimu wa chimanga, mgaiwa ndi chimanga pansi pa dzina la Thanzi. Dongosolo linali loti aone ngati ufawo ungagulitsidwe Admarc isanamange mphero yakeyake.

Koma mavuto anabwera mofulumira. Oyang'anira ochokera ku Admarc adapeza kuti matani 75.762 anali ndi tizilombo ndi mphutsi. Ufawo unakhala ndi ziphuphu ndipo sunali wotetezeka kudya. Matani ena 48.812 anali akuyesedwabe aflatoxin, yomwe ndi poizoni yomwe imamera mu tirigu. Pamapeto pake, makilogalamu 15,129 a ufa adatsimikizika kuti ndi osatetezeka. Ufa woipitsidwawo unachokera ku Zomba, Ngabu ndi Chilambula.

Komiti ya Nyumba Yamalamulo inati Admarc inayambitsa kutayika. Kampaniyo inasunga ufawo kwa nthawi yayitali itasiya kuugulitsa. Zipinda zosungiramo zinthu zinali zochepa. Ufawo unasunthidwa m'njira zoyipa zomwe zinalola madzi ndi dothi kulowa. Admarc idapanga ufa wochuluka kwambiri womwe palibe amene ankafuna kugula. Kampaniyo sinaphunzirepo kanthu isanayambe ntchitoyi. Palibe amene adayang'ana zoopsa zake. Palibe gulu lapadera lomwe lidayendetsa ntchitoyi. Komitiyo idati anthu omwe adayendetsa ntchitoyi ayenera kufufuzidwa. Mwina adawononga ndalama mwadala kapena anali osasamala.

Willy Kambwandira amagwira ntchito ku Centre for Social Accountability and Transparency. Iye adati zomwe zapezekazo ndi zoyipa kwambiri. Adapempha kuti afufuze payekha zomwe zidachitika. Adati ndalama za boma ziyenera kubwezedwa ngati anthu anali osasamala. Aliyense amene waswa lamulo ayenera kupita kukhothi. Iyi si nthawi yoyamba kuti Admarc itaye tirigu. Mu 2021, pafupifupi matani 1,285 a chimanga adawola. Mu 2024, Admarc idataya matani 12,304 a chimanga chifukwa sichinali chotetezeka.

en.title: Spain win World Cup for the second time
en.body: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the 2026 World Cup final. Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute at New Jersey Stadium in the United States on Sunday. This is Spain's second World Cup title. Argentina played the last part with only 10 men.
en.body_more:
Torres got the ball from Nico Williams and shot from close. The goal came just before one minute into extra time. Argentina's Enzo Fernandez got a red card in normal time for a second yellow card. This meant Argentina had to play with 10 men for all of extra time.

Spain had many chances in the first 90 minutes. They took 19 shots. Argentina took none. But Argentina's goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez made many good saves. He set a new record for the most saves in a World Cup final. The match was tense and tight. Neither team scored in normal time.

Spain's right back Pedro Porro won the award for best player of the match. He played well in defence and helped his team attack. The match was on Sunday night. In Malawi, it started at 9pm and went into Monday morning. Many Malawian football fans stayed up to watch.

This win ends a 16 year wait for Spain. They last won the World Cup in 2010 in South Africa when they beat the Netherlands. The victory also stopped Argentina from winning two World Cups in a row. Argentina won in 2022. For Lionel Messi, the match was likely his last World Cup. He is 39 years old. Lamine Yamal, who is 19, lifted the trophy for Spain. Messi and Yamal have a special story — in 2007, Messi bathed baby Yamal for a photo to help poor children. France's Kylian Mbappe won the Golden Boot award for scoring the most goals. He scored 10 goals. Messi and Torres each scored 8 goals.

ny.title: Spain yapambana World Cup kachiwiri
ny.body: Spain idagonjetsa Argentina 1-0 pambuyo pa nthawi yowonjezera mu fainali ya World Cup ya 2026. Ferran Torres adagoletsa chigoli mu mphindi ya 106 ku New Jersey Stadium ku United States Lamlungu. Uwu ndi mpikisano wachiwiri wa Spain wa World Cup. Argentina idasewera gawo lomaliza ndi osewera 10 okha.
ny.body_more:
Torres adalandira mpira kuchokera kwa Nico Williams ndipo anawombera kuchokera pafupi. Chigolicho chinafika mphindi imodzi isanakwane nthawi yowonjezera. Enzo Fernandez wa ku Argentina adalandira khadi lofiira munthawi yanthawi yokhazikika kuti alandire khadi lachiwiri lachikasu. Izi zikutanthauza kuti Argentina idayenera kusewera ndi amuna 10 munthawi yonse yowonjezera.

Spain idapeza mipata yambiri mu mphindi 90 zoyambirira. Adaponya zipolopolo 19. Argentina idaponya chilichonse. Koma mlonda wa Argentina Emiliano Martinez adapulumutsa bwino kwambiri. Adakhazikitsa mbiri yatsopano yopulumutsa kwambiri mu fainali ya World Cup. Masewerawa anali ovuta komanso olimba. Palibe gulu lomwe lidaponya zipolopolo munthawi yanthawi yokhazikika.

Pedro Porro, wosewera wakumanja waku Spain, adapambana mphoto ya wosewera wabwino kwambiri pamasewerawa. Adasewera bwino poteteza ndipo adathandiza gulu lake kuukira. Masewerawa anali Lamlungu usiku. Ku Malawi, adayamba 9pm ndipo adalowa Lolemba m'mawa. Okonda mpira ambiri aku Malawi adakhala maso kuti ayang'anire.

Kupambana kumeneku kumathetsa kudikira kwa Spain kwa zaka 16. Adapambana World Cup komaliza mu 2010 ku South Africa pomwe adagonjetsa Netherlands. Kupambanaku kunalepheretsanso Argentina kupambana World Cups ziwiri motsatizana. Argentina idapambana mu 2022. Kwa Lionel Messi, masewerawa mwina anali ake omaliza a World Cup. Ali ndi zaka 39. Lamine Yamal, yemwe ali ndi zaka 19, adapambana chikho cha Spain. Messi ndi Yamal ali ndi nkhani yapadera - mu 2007, Messi adasambitsa mwana Yamal kuti amujambule chithunzi kuti athandize ana osauka. Kylian Mbappe wa ku France adapambana mphoto ya Golden Boot chifukwa chogoletsa zigoli zambiri. Adagoletsa zigoli 10. Messi ndi Torres aliyense adagoletsa zigoli 8.

en.title: 44 Malawi firms go to Tanzania trade forum
en.body: More than 43 Malawian businesses will go to Tanzania next month. They will meet at the third Malawi–Tanzania Investment and Trade Forum. The forum is from July 29 to 31 in Dar es Salaam. Malawi hosted the last forum in 2023. The businesses want to find new trade and investment chances.
en.body_more:
The Malawi Investment and Trade Centre says the businesses include women in business groups, small and medium firms, cooperatives, agro-dealers, makers of goods, and tourism workers. William Mwale is the head of the National Association of Small and Medium Enterprises. He said his group wants to sign a deal with Tanzania. The deal will bring soap-making machines to Malawi. Small groups now make soap in small amounts. They need machines to make more soap and get more money.

Tanzania's Minister of Industry, Trade and Investment Hashil Abdallah said private businesses are key to making the economy grow. He said the government is cutting red tape so investors can get help more easily. The forum will talk about farming, food, power, mining, tourism, roads, and making goods. Both countries want to work together on these big ideas.

But there is a problem. Malawi's trade with Tanzania was good until 2022. In 2024, Malawi owed Tanzania K483.7 billion. This means Tanzania sent Malawi more goods than Malawi sent back. Most of what came in were finished goods ready to sell. Malawi needs to sell more of its own goods to fix this.

The forum gives Malawi's businesses a chance. They can find new markets, make deals with Tanzania, and get machines to make more goods. Women's groups and small makers of goods may gain the most. The forum shows that the two countries want to be close trading friends.

ny.title: Makampani 44 aku Malawi apita ku msonkhano wa zamalonda ku Tanzania
ny.body: Mabizinesi aku Malawi opitilira 43 apita ku Tanzania mwezi wamawa. Adzakumana pa msonkhano wachitatu wa Malawi-Tanzania Investment and Trade Forum. Msonkhanowu uyamba pa 29 mpaka 31 Julayi ku Dar es Salaam. Malawi idachititsa msonkhano womaliza mu 2023. Mabizinesiwa akufuna kupeza mwayi watsopano wamalonda ndi ndalama.
ny.body_more:
Malo Ogulitsira Ndalama ku Malawi akuti mabizinesiwa akuphatikizapo azimayi m'magulu amalonda, makampani ang'onoang'ono ndi apakatikati, mabungwe ogwirizana, ogulitsa alimi, opanga katundu, ndi ogwira ntchito zokopa alendo. William Mwale ndiye mtsogoleri wa National Association of Small and Medium Enterprises. Anati gulu lake likufuna kusaina mgwirizano ndi Tanzania. Mgwirizanowu udzabweretsa makina opangira sopo ku Malawi. Magulu ang'onoang'ono tsopano amapanga sopo pang'ono. Akufunika makina kuti apange sopo wambiri ndikupeza ndalama zambiri.

Nduna ya Zamalonda, Malonda ndi Ndalama ku Tanzania Hashil Abdallah adati mabizinesi achinsinsi ndi ofunikira kwambiri pakukweza chuma. Anati boma likuchepetsa malamulo oletsa kuti amalonda athe kupeza thandizo mosavuta. Msonkhanowu udzakambirana za ulimi, chakudya, magetsi, migodi, zokopa alendo, misewu, ndi kupanga katundu. Mayiko onsewa akufuna kugwira ntchito limodzi pamalingaliro akuluakulu awa.

Koma pali vuto. Malonda a Malawi ndi Tanzania anali abwino mpaka 2022. Mu 2024, Malawi inali ndi ngongole ya ku Tanzania ya K483.7 biliyoni. Izi zikutanthauza kuti Tanzania idatumiza Malawi katundu wambiri kuposa womwe Malawi idatumiza. Zambiri zomwe zidabwera zinali katundu womalizidwa wokonzeka kugulitsa. Malawi ikufunika kugulitsa katundu wake wambiri kuti ikonze vutoli.

Msonkhanowu umapatsa mabizinesi aku Malawi mwayi. Akhoza kupeza misika yatsopano, kupanga mapangano ndi Tanzania, ndikupeza makina opangira katundu wambiri. Magulu a akazi ndi opanga zinthu ang'onoang'ono angapindule kwambiri. Msonkhanowu ukuwonetsa kuti mayiko awiriwa akufuna kukhala mabwenzi apamtima ogulitsa.

en.title: Wanderers move to top with win over Civil Service
en.body: Mighty Wanderers moved to the top of the FDH Bank Premiership on Saturday. They beat Civil Service United 2-0 at Civo Stadium in Lilongwe. Wanderers now have 21 points from 10 games. Adam Wallace scored in the 50th minute. Gracious Kapachika scored an own goal in the 70th minute.
en.body_more:
The first half was close and even. Civil Service United played well and had control. Wanderers did not play their normal game. But Wanderers changed their plan at half-time. This worked. Wanderers played much better after the break and scored both goals.

Wanderers head coach Bob Mpinganjira said his team struggled in the first half. He said the players reacted well to his changes. He said they stayed focused and managed the game well. He also said they had been worried about letting in goals in similar moments before. But today they did not.

Civil Service United assistant coach Emmanuel Zoya said his team had chances to score in the first half. He said they created good chances but did not finish them. He said that against a strong team like Wanderers, if you miss chances, you lose. Civil Service United are now in 11th place with 11 points from 10 games. Gaddie Chirwa was voted Player of the Match for Wanderers. Blue Eagles are in second place, two points behind Wanderers. They will play Kamuzu Barracks on Sunday and can close the gap.

ny.title: Wanderers yakwera pamwamba ndi kupambana Civil Service
ny.body: Mighty Wanderers yafika pamwamba pa FDH Bank Premiership Loweruka. Yagonjetsa Civil Service United 2-0 pa Civo Stadium ku Lilongwe. Wanderers tsopano ili ndi mapointi 21 kuchokera pamasewera 10. Adam Wallace adagoletsa chigoli mu mphindi 50. Gracious Kapachika adagoletsa chigoli chake mu mphindi 70.
ny.body_more:
Gawo loyamba linali loyandikira komanso lofanana. Civil Service United idasewera bwino ndipo inali ndi ulamuliro. Wanderers sinasewere masewera awo achizolowezi. Koma Wanderers adasintha dongosolo lawo nthawi yopuma. Izi zidagwira ntchito. Wanderers idasewera bwino kwambiri pambuyo pa nthawi yopuma ndipo idapeza zigoli zonse ziwiri.

Mphunzitsi wamkulu wa Wanderers, Bob Mpinganjira, adati timu yake idavutika mu gawo loyamba. Anati osewerawo adachita bwino ndi kusintha kwake. Anati adakhalabe okhazikika ndipo adayendetsa bwino masewerawa. Anatinso adadandaula kuti alola zigoli munthawi zofanana kale. Koma lero sanachite.

Mphunzitsi wothandizira wa Civil Service United, Emmanuel Zoya, adati timu yake idapeza mwayi wopeza zigoli mu gawo loyamba. Anati adapanga mipata yabwino koma sanaimalize. Anati motsutsana ndi timu yolimba ngati Wanderers, ngati muphonya mipata, mumataya. Civil Service United tsopano ili pa nambala 11 ndi mapointi 11 kuchokera pamasewera 10. Gaddie Chirwa adasankhidwa kukhala Wosewera wa Masewera a Wanderers. Blue Eagles ili pa nambala yachiwiri, mapointi awiri kumbuyo kwa Wanderers. Adzasewera ndi Kamuzu Barracks Lamlungu ndipo akhoza kutseka kusiyana.

en.title: China's Xi Jinping sends birthday gift to Malawi President Mutharika
en.body: Malawi's President Arthur Peter Mutharika turned 86 today. He received a special birthday gift and letter from China's President Xi Jinping. China's Ambassador to Malawi, Lu Xu, gave the gift at Kamuzu Palace in Lilongwe. President Mutharika said the gift was an honour and shows friendship between the two countries.
en.body_more:
Mutharika said he was deeply honoured by the gift from Xi Jinping. He called Xi a colleague and a dear friend. The President asked Ambassador Lu Xu to tell Xi thank you. He said the gift was not just for him, but for all the people of Malawi.

The President praised China for helping Malawi in many ways. He said China has helped with schools, roads, and other parts of the economy. Mutharika said Malawi and China have a good relationship. He said this relationship will last forever and grow stronger.

Malawi and China are working together on many things. They work on building roads and other big projects. They also work on farming, health, and mining. The two countries want to help each other in these areas.

This gift comes at a time when things are changing for Malawi. The United Kingdom said it will give much less money to Malawi. The UK will keep only a small part of the help it gave before. This has made some people in Malawi ask the government to look at new friendships and business deals, especially with other countries.

ny.title: Xi Jinping wa ku China wapereka mphatso ya tsiku lobadwa kwa Purezidenti wa Malawi Mutharika
ny.body: Purezidenti wa Malawi Arthur Peter Mutharika wakwanitsa zaka 86 lero. Walandira mphatso yapadera ya tsiku lobadwa ndi kalata kuchokera kwa Purezidenti wa China Xi Jinping. Kazembe wa China ku Malawi, Lu Xu, ndiye wapereka mphatsoyi ku Kamuzu Palace ku Lilongwe. Purezidenti Mutharika adati mphatsoyi ndi ulemu ndipo ikuwonetsa ubwenzi pakati pa mayiko awiriwa.
ny.body_more:
Mutharika anati walemekezedwa kwambiri ndi mphatso yochokera kwa Xi Jinping. Anayimbira Xi mnzake komanso bwenzi lake lapamtima. Purezidenti anapempha Kazembe Lu Xu kuti anene kuti akuthokoza Xi. Anati mphatsoyi si ya iye yekha, komanso ya anthu onse aku Malawi.

Purezidenti anayamikira China chifukwa chothandiza Malawi m'njira zambiri. Anati China yathandiza masukulu, misewu, ndi madera ena azachuma. Mutharika anati Malawi ndi China zili ndi ubale wabwino. Anati ubalewu udzakhalapo kwamuyaya ndipo udzakhala wolimba.

Malawi ndi China akugwira ntchito limodzi pazinthu zambiri. Amagwira ntchito yomanga misewu ndi mapulojekiti ena akuluakulu. Amagwiranso ntchito pa ulimi, thanzi, ndi migodi. Mayiko awiriwa akufuna kuthandizana m'madera amenewa.

Mphatsoyi ikubwera panthawi yomwe zinthu zikusintha ku Malawi. United Kingdom inati ipereka ndalama zochepa ku Malawi. UK isunga gawo laling'ono chabe la thandizo lomwe idapereka kale. Izi zapangitsa anthu ena ku Malawi kupempha boma kuti liyang'ane ubwenzi watsopano ndi mapangano amalonda, makamaka ndi mayiko ena.

en.title: Vice President Ansah sends birthday message to President Mutharika
en.body: Vice President Jane Ansah sent a birthday message to President Arthur Peter Mutharika on Saturday. Mutharika turned 86 years old on 18 July. In a message on Facebook, Ansah wished him good health, wisdom, and many more years. She thanked God for his life and prayed for his strength and peace.
en.body_more:
Ansah wrote: "Happy Birthday, Your Excellency Professor Arthur Peter Mutharika. On this special day, I join your family, friends, and countless Malawians in thanking God for your life and wishing you abundant good health, wisdom, and many more blessed years. May the year ahead bring you continued strength, peace, and fulfillment as you remain committed to serving our beloved nation."

The birthday message is notable because reports say Ansah has been absent from many government events in recent months. Some observers say she has less power in the ruling Democratic Progressive Party now. There is talk of a new leader rising in the party, with the next election set for 2030. Despite this, Ansah chose to send a warm and public message to the president.

Mutharika is serving his second term as president. Many people from the DPP sent birthday messages on social media. The celebrations also drew attention from outside Malawi. Chinese President Xi Jinping sent Mutharika a personal letter and a gift. Xi said this shows the strong friendship between Malawi and China. Mutharika is the leader of the Democratic Progressive Party.

ny.title: Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Ansah atumiza uthenga wokhudza tsiku lobadwa kwa Purezidenti Mutharika
ny.body: Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Jane Ansah adatumiza uthenga wokumbukira tsiku lobadwa kwa Purezidenti Arthur Peter Mutharika Loweruka. Mutharika adakwanitsa zaka 86 pa 18 Julayi. Mu uthenga wake pa Facebook, Ansah adamufunira thanzi labwino, nzeru, ndi zaka zambiri. Anayamika Mulungu chifukwa cha moyo wake ndipo adamupempherera kuti amupatse mphamvu ndi mtendere.
ny.body_more:
Ansah analemba kuti: "Tsiku Lobadwa Labwino, Pulofesa Arthur Peter Mutharika. Pa tsiku lapaderali, ndikugwirizana ndi banja lanu, abwenzi anu, ndi anthu ambiri aku Malawi poyamika Mulungu chifukwa cha moyo wanu ndikukufunirani thanzi labwino, nzeru, ndi zaka zambiri zodalitsidwa. Chaka chomwe chikubwerachi chikubweretsereni mphamvu, mtendere, ndi chikhutiro chopitilira pamene mukupitirizabe kutumikira dziko lathu lokondedwa."

Uthenga wa tsiku lobadwa ndi wodziwika bwino chifukwa malipoti akuti Ansah wakhala akusowa pazochitika zambiri za boma m'miyezi yaposachedwa. Ena mwa owonera akuti ali ndi mphamvu zochepa mu chipani cholamula cha Democratic Progressive Party tsopano. Pali nkhani ya mtsogoleri watsopano amene akukwera m'chipanichi, ndipo chisankho chotsatira chikukonzekera 2030. Ngakhale izi zili choncho, Ansah anasankha kutumiza uthenga wachikondi komanso wapoyera kwa purezidenti.

Mutharika akutumikira nthawi yake yachiwiri monga purezidenti. Anthu ambiri ochokera ku DPP adatumiza mauthenga a tsiku lobadwa pa malo ochezera a pa Intaneti. Zikondwererozo zidakopanso chidwi kuchokera kunja kwa Malawi. Purezidenti wa China Xi Jinping adatumiza kalata yake ndi mphatso kwa Mutharika. Xi adati izi zikusonyeza ubwenzi wolimba pakati pa Malawi ndi China. Mutharika ndi mtsogoleri wa chipani cha Democratic Progressive Party.

en.title: Pesticides Board Trains Importers on New Rules
en.body: The Pesticides Control Board of Malawi held a training for Illovo Sugar Malawi on Friday at Nchalo Estate in Chikwawa. PCB Registrar James Kaphale said only registered pesticides can be imported. The board is training major pesticide importers to help them follow the law.
en.body_more:
Kaphale said pesticides are very important for farming, but they can also cause serious harm if brought into the country in the wrong way. Pesticides are chemicals used to kill crop pests. The board wants all importers to understand the legal rules before they bring pesticides into Malawi.

During the training, participants learned about the steps for pesticide registration. They learned what documents they need to get import permits. They learned what they must do after they register pesticides. Kaphale said the board's main goal is to check all pesticides carefully before they enter Malawi. Only pesticides that are registered can come into the country.

Illovo Sugar Malawi is one of the biggest pesticide importers in Malawi. Kaphale said the company showed good leadership by attending the training. He said the private sector now understands that following the rules is important. The board has a law called the Pesticides Act that controls how pesticides come in, are stored, are sold, and are thrown away.

Kaphale told the trainees to ask questions and share their ideas. He said the training will help them import pesticides in the correct and legal way. The board will continue to train more importers. The goal is to make sure pesticides are safe for workers, safe for the environment, and safe for people who eat the crops.

ny.title: Bungwe Loona za Mankhwala Ophera Tizilombo Laphunzitsa Ogulitsa Zinthu Zakunja Malamulo Atsopano
ny.body: Bungwe Loona za Mankhwala Ophera Tizilombo ku Malawi linachita maphunziro a Illovo Sugar Malawi Lachisanu ku Nchalo Estate ku Chikwawa. Wolemba wa PCB James Kaphale anati mankhwala ophera tizilombo olembetsedwa okha ndi omwe angalowe m'dzikolo. Bungweli likuphunzitsa ogulitsa mankhwala ophera tizilombo ochokera kunja kuti awathandize kutsatira malamulo.
ny.body_more:
Kaphale anati mankhwala ophera tizilombo ndi ofunika kwambiri pa ulimi, koma amathanso kuvulaza kwambiri ngati atabweretsedwa mdziko muno mwanjira yolakwika. Mankhwala ophera tizilombo ndi mankhwala omwe amagwiritsidwa ntchito kupha tizilombo toononga mbewu. Bungweli likufuna kuti onse oitanitsa mankhwala ophera tizilombo amvetse malamulo asanabweretse mankhwala ophera tizilombo ku Malawi.

Pa nthawi ya maphunzirowa, ophunzirawo adaphunzira za njira zolembetsera mankhwala ophera tizilombo. Adaphunzira zikalata zomwe amafunikira kuti apeze zilolezo zolowera kunja. Adaphunzira zomwe ayenera kuchita akalembetsa mankhwala ophera tizilombo. Kaphale adati cholinga chachikulu cha bungweli ndikuyang'ana mosamala mankhwala onse ophera tizilombo asanalowe m'Malawi. Mankhwala ophera tizilombo okha ndi omwe angalowe m'dzikolo.

Illovo Sugar Malawi ndi imodzi mwa makampani akuluakulu olowetsa mankhwala ophera tizilombo ku Malawi. Kaphale adati kampaniyo yawonetsa utsogoleri wabwino popita ku maphunzirowa. Anati makampani achinsinsi tsopano akumvetsa kuti kutsatira malamulo ndikofunikira. Bungweli lili ndi lamulo lotchedwa Pesticides Act lomwe limalamulira momwe mankhwala ophera tizilombo amalowera, amasungidwa, amagulitsidwa, komanso amatayidwa.

Kaphale adauza ophunzirawo kuti afunse mafunso ndikugawana malingaliro awo. Anati maphunzirowa adzawathandiza kuitanitsa mankhwala ophera tizilombo m'njira yoyenera komanso yovomerezeka. Bungweli lipitiliza kuphunzitsa ogulitsa ambiri oitanitsa. Cholinga chake ndikuwonetsetsa kuti mankhwala ophera tizilombo ndi otetezeka kwa ogwira ntchito, otetezeka ku chilengedwe, komanso otetezeka kwa anthu omwe amadya mbewuzo.

en.title: Government faces court case over unpaid MEC warehouse rent
en.body: The government must pay K885 million in rent arrears for a Malawi Electoral Commission warehouse in Njewa, Lilongwe within five days or lose the property. Lawyers say failure to pay breaks a High Court order. The dispute stems from President Peter Mutharika's plan to move MEC to Blantyre, which a court stopped.
en.body_more:
Justice Kenyatta Nyirenda's court order stopped the government from moving MEC and told the Ministry of Lands to keep paying rent for MEC's buildings. However, lawyers disagree on whether this order covers the Njewa warehouse at Plot Title No. 21/2/186. The government received a Notice of Distress from the Sheriff of Malawi giving five days to pay or have the property sold.

Lawyer George Kadzipatike represents the Malawi Congress Party and three Members of Parliament who won the court case blocking MEC's move to Blantyre. He said the government must obey the court order and keep paying all MEC rent. He warned that Chief Secretary Justin Saidi and the Minister of Lands risk contempt of court charges — a serious crime that happens when someone breaks a court order. Kadzipatike said court papers are ready to bring against these two officials if rent stays unpaid.

Attorney General Frank Mbeta disagreed. He said the warehouse problem is different from the court case about moving MEC. He said he does not see how contempt of court applies here. Lawyer Donvan Silungwe, who represents the warehouse owner Azmy Ali Jawad, said the government has done nothing to pay the money owed.

On Wednesday, MEC Director of Media and Public Relations Sangwani Mwafulirwa said MEC is talking with the government and the landlord to fix the problem and make the lease agreement correct. The government is also trying to overturn the court order that stopped MEC's move to Blantyre.

ny.title: Boma likuyang'anizana ndi mlandu kukhothi chifukwa cha lendi ya nyumba yosungiramo katundu ya MEC yosalipidwa
ny.body: Boma liyenera kulipira ngongole ya lendi ya K885 miliyoni ya nyumba yosungiramo zinthu ya Malawi Electoral Commission ku Njewa, Lilongwe mkati mwa masiku asanu kapena kutaya nyumbayo. Maloya akuti kulephera kulipira kuphwanya lamulo la Khothi Lalikulu. Mkanganowu umachokera ku dongosolo la Purezidenti Peter Mutharika losamutsa MEC kupita ku Blantyre, lomwe khoti linaletsa.
ny.body_more:
Lamulo la khothi la Justice Kenyatta Nyirenda linaletsa boma kusamutsa MEC ndipo linauza Unduna wa Zamalo kuti upitirize kulipira lendi ya nyumba za MEC. Komabe, maloya sagwirizana ngati lamuloli likukhudza nyumba yosungiramo katundu ya Njewa pa Plot Title No. 21/2/186. Boma linalandira Chidziwitso cha Mavuto kuchokera kwa Sheriff wa Malawi chomwe chinapereka masiku asanu kuti alipire kapena kuti katunduyo agulitsidwe.

Loya George Kadzipatike akuyimira chipani cha Malawi Congress ndi aphungu atatu a Nyumba Yamalamulo omwe adapambana mlandu wa khothi womwe unaletsa kusamuka kwa MEC kupita ku Blantyre. Anati boma liyenera kumvera lamulo la khothi ndikupitiliza kulipira lendi yonse ya MEC. Anachenjeza kuti Mlembi Wamkulu Justin Saidi ndi Nduna ya Zamalo akhoza kunyoza milandu ya khothi - mlandu waukulu womwe umachitika munthu akaswa lamulo la khothi. Kadzipatike anati mapepala a khothi ali okonzeka kubweretsa motsutsana ndi akuluakulu awiriwa ngati lendi ikhala yosalipidwa.

Loya Wamkulu Frank Mbeta sanagwirizane. Anati vuto la nyumba yosungiramo katundu ndi losiyana ndi mlandu wa khothi wokhudza kusamutsa MEC. Anati sakuona momwe kunyoza khothi kumagwirira ntchito pano. Loya Donvan Silungwe, yemwe akuyimira mwini nyumba yosungiramo katundu Azmy Ali Jawad, adati boma silinachitepo kanthu kuti lilipire ndalama zomwe likuyenera kulipira.

Lachitatu, Mtsogoleri wa Zankhani ndi Maubwenzi a Anthu ku MEC Sangwani Mwafulirwa adati MEC ikulankhula ndi boma ndi mwini nyumba kuti akonze vutoli ndikukonza pangano la lendi. Boma likuyesetsanso kusintha lamulo la khothi lomwe linaletsa kusamuka kwa MEC ku Blantyre.

en.title: Fake agents steal money from house hunters in Malawi
en.body: Bad property agents are stealing money from people who want to rent houses in Malawi. The government passed a law 18 months ago to stop this. But the law is not yet working. Fake agents, called dobadobas, now control the rental market. They charge people K20,000 to K25,000 just to view a house. Many people lose this money and never get a house.
en.body_more:
Sylvia Mbwana spent five months looking for a house in Lilongwe. She paid K50,000 in viewing fees to see bad houses. In the end, she gave up and moved with a friend. McPherson Banda came from Balaka to Lilongwe in April. He spent K120,000 on viewing fees. One agent took his K350,000 deposit for a house that was already full. He got the deposit back, but not the viewing fees. Nafy Chipala drives a minibus in Likuni. Every viewing fee costs him food and transport money for his family. He said many houses do not exist or look nothing like the pictures online.

The Real Estate Management Act became law on 13 January 2025. The government made a council called Remac to control the rental market. Remac should stop bad agents and make rules. But Remac has no office, no staff and no rules yet. Sarah Kauta Chauma leads Remac. She said the council started in May last year but cannot work. The Ministry of Lands must write the rules first. Desmond Namangale runs Knight Frank Malawi. He said bad agents copy real adverts and take money then run away. He said many people want the same house, so bad agents can fool people.

In Blantyre, Steven Nkhoma paid high fees for bad houses. In Mzuzu, Henry Malata paid up to 50 percent extra money and K20,000 to see houses. Prince Matchika is a real estate helper. He said the problem is that Malawi does not have enough houses. Many people move to cities but there are not enough homes to rent. This gives bad agents a chance to steal. Until Remac can work, people will keep losing money to fake agents.

ny.title: Antchito abodza akuba ndalama kuchokera kwa osaka nyumba ku Malawi
ny.body: Ogulitsa katundu oipa akuba ndalama kwa anthu omwe akufuna kubwereka nyumba ku Malawi. Boma linapereka lamulo miyezi 18 yapitayo loletsa izi. Koma lamuloli silikugwira ntchito. Ogulitsa zinthu zabodza, otchedwa dobadobas, tsopano akulamulira msika wobwereka. Amalipiritsa anthu K20,000 mpaka K25,000 kuti akangoona nyumba. Anthu ambiri amataya ndalamazi ndipo sapeza nyumba.
ny.body_more:
Sylvia Mbwana anakhala miyezi isanu akufunafuna nyumba ku Lilongwe. Analipira K50,000 ngati ndalama zowonera nyumba kuti akaone nyumba zoyipa. Pamapeto pake, anasiya ndipo anasamuka ndi mnzake. McPherson Banda anachokera ku Balaka kupita ku Lilongwe mu Epulo. Anagwiritsa ntchito K120,000 pa ndalama zowonera nyumba. Wothandizira wina anatenga ndalama zake zokwana K350,000 kuti apeze nyumba yomwe inali yodzaza kale. Anabwezeredwa ndalamazo, koma osati ndalama zowonera nyumba. Nafy Chipala amayendetsa minibus ku Likuni. Ndalama iliyonse yowonera nyumba imamuwonongera chakudya ndi ndalama zoyendera banja lake. Anati nyumba zambiri sizilipo kapena sizikuwoneka ngati zithunzi pa intaneti.

Real Estate Management Act inakhala lamulo pa 13 Januwale 2025. Boma linapanga bungwe lotchedwa Remac kuti lizilamulira msika wobwereka. Remac iyenera kuletsa oimira oipa ndikupanga malamulo. Koma Remac ilibe ofesi, ilibe antchito ndipo ilibe malamulo pakadali pano. Sarah Kauta Chauma akutsogolera Remac. Anati bungweli linayamba mu Meyi chaka chatha koma silingagwire ntchito. Unduna wa Zamalo uyenera kulemba malamulowo kaye. Desmond Namangale amatsogolera Knight Frank Malawi. Anati anthu ambiri amafuna nyumba yomweyo, kotero anthu ambiri amafuna nyumba yomweyo, kotero anthu ambiri amanyenga anthu.

Ku Blantyre, Steven Nkhoma amalipira ndalama zambiri pa nyumba zoyipa. Ku Mzuzu, Henry Malata amalipira ndalama zowonjezera mpaka 50 peresenti ndi K20,000 kuti akaone nyumba. Prince Matchika ndi wothandizira pa malo. Anati vuto ndilakuti Malawi ilibe nyumba zokwanira. Anthu ambiri amasamukira kumizinda koma palibe nyumba zokwanira zobwereka. Izi zimapatsa anthu ambiri mwayi woti aba. Mpaka Remac igwire ntchito, anthu azingotaya ndalama kwa anthu onyenga.

en.title: Malawi seeks new mobile operators to cut data costs
en.body: Malawi's government wants to bring more mobile network operators into the country. Minister of Information and Communications Technology Dr Shadric Namalomba told Parliament on Friday that more companies will increase competition and lower prices. He was responding to MP Francis Belekanyama's concerns about recent tariff increases by Airtel Malawi and TNM.
en.body_more:
Belekanyama warned that higher tariffs hurt households, students, small businesses, and job seekers. He said it risked cutting people off from the internet and reducing work output. Namalomba agreed that the country needs more operators. "We only have two operators now," he said. "With more competition, prices will come down."

Airtel Malawi and TNM had asked the Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority (MACRA) for a tariff increase of 55 percent. They said fuel prices had risen by 144 percent and electricity costs had gone up by 8 percent. MACRA approved a smaller increase instead. Airtel got 22.2 percent more, and TNM got 26 percent more. But both companies raised prices before telling customers seven days in advance, as the law requires. MACRA told both companies to give money back to customers who bought data between 26 June and 2 July 2026. The money must be paid back by 31 July.

Namalomba said the government is working to make digital services cheaper. The government cut spectrum licence fees by 50 percent. This money goes to help mobile companies pay less, so they can charge customers less. The government is also using US$150 million from the World Bank for the Digital Malawi Acceleration Project. This money pays for new mobile towers, especially in areas that do not have good internet now. "We are committed to giving all Malawians affordable internet," Namalomba said.

ny.title: Malawi ikufuna makampani atsopano a mafoni kuti achepetse ndalama zogulira deta
ny.body: Boma la Malawi likufuna kubweretsa anthu ambiri ogwira ntchito pa intaneti ya mafoni mdziko muno. Nduna ya Information and Communications Technology, Dr Shadric Namalomba, idauza Nyumba Yamalamulo Lachisanu kuti makampani ambiri adzakweza mpikisano ndi kutsika mitengo. Iye anali kuyankha nkhawa za MP Francis Belekanyama zokhudza kukwera kwa mitengo ya Airtel Malawi ndi TNM posachedwapa.
ny.body_more:
Belekanyama anachenjeza kuti mitengo yokwera imavulaza mabanja, ophunzira, mabizinesi ang'onoang'ono, ndi ofuna ntchito. Anati izi zitha kuwononga anthu pa intaneti ndikuchepetsa kuchuluka kwa ntchito. Namalomba adavomereza kuti dzikolo likufunika ogwiritsa ntchito ambiri. "Tili ndi ogwira ntchito awiri okha tsopano," adatero. "Pakakhala mpikisano wochulukirapo, mitengo idzatsika."

Airtel Malawi ndi TNM adapempha bungwe la Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority (MACRA) kuti mitengo yawo ikwere ndi 55 peresenti. Adati mitengo yamafuta yakwera ndi 144 peresenti ndipo mitengo yamagetsi yakwera ndi 8 peresenti. MACRA idavomereza kukwera pang'ono m'malo mwake. Airtel idakwera ndi 22.2 peresenti, ndipo TNM idakwera ndi 26 peresenti. Koma makampani onsewa adakweza mitengo asanauze makasitomala masiku asanu ndi awiri pasadakhale, monga momwe lamulo limafunira. MACRA idauza makampani onse awiri kuti abweze ndalama kwa makasitomala omwe adagula deta pakati pa 26 Juni ndi 2 Julayi 2026. Ndalamazo ziyenera kubwezedwa pofika pa 31 Julayi.

Namalomba adati boma likugwira ntchito kuti ntchito za digito zikhale zotsika mtengo. Boma lachepetsa ndalama zolipirira ma spectrum ndi 50 peresenti. Ndalama zimenezi zimathandiza makampani a mafoni kulipira ndalama zochepa, kuti athe kulipira makasitomala ndalama zochepa. Boma likugwiritsanso ntchito US$150 miliyoni kuchokera ku World Bank pa Digital Malawi Acceleration Project. Ndalama zimenezi zimalipira nsanja zatsopano za mafoni, makamaka m'madera omwe alibe intaneti yabwino tsopano. "Tadzipereka kupatsa anthu onse aku Malawi intaneti yotsika mtengo," adatero Namalomba.

en.title: Court says Pacific Limited has no land in Malawi
en.body: The High Court in Blantyre has dismissed a case by Pacific Limited. The company challenged Malawi's land laws as unfair. The court said Pacific Limited did not own any land in Malawi. Three judges ruled against the company.
en.body_more:
Pacific Limited wanted to challenge two laws. These are the Land Act and the Customary Land Act. The company said these laws were wrong and unfair. The laws restrict who can own land. Non-citizens cannot own much land. The law defines who is an indigenous Malawian. Indigenous means born in the country.

The Attorney General Frank Mbeta represented the government. Lawyers Neverson Chisiza and Francis MacJessie helped him. Pacific Limited was represented by Mordecai Msisha, who is a senior counsel, and Bright Theu. A senior counsel is a top lawyer.

Pacific Limited said the amended laws were not fair. The company said the laws wrongly stopped some people from owning property. Pacific Limited claimed to own 143 leasehold and freehold properties across Malawi. Leasehold means renting land for a long time. Freehold means owning land outright. However, the court found no evidence that Pacific Limited actually owned any of these properties.

Justices Jabbar Alide, Chimwemwe Kamowa and Dick Sankhulani made the decision. They said Pacific Limited did not prove it had a real interest in the case. The judges also agreed with the government. They said the land laws were properly made and are valid. This case was very important for Malawi. Many investors watched it closely. The case shows the balance between protecting customary land rights and welcoming investment into Malawi.

ny.title: Khoti Lati Pacific Limited Ilibe Malo ku Malawi
ny.body: Khoti Lalikulu ku Blantyre lachotsa mlandu wa Pacific Limited. Kampaniyo inatsutsa malamulo a malo aku Malawi kuti ndi osalungama. Khotilo linati Pacific Limited inalibe malo ku Malawi. Oweruza atatu adagamula motsutsana ndi kampaniyo.
ny.body_more:
Pacific Limited imafuna kutsutsa malamulo awiri. Awa ndi Land Act ndi Customary Land Act. Kampaniyo inati malamulo awa ndi olakwika komanso osalungama. Malamulowa amaletsa omwe angakhale ndi malo. Anthu osakhala nzika sangagule malo ambiri. Lamuloli limatanthauzira omwe ndi nzika ya ku Malawi. Anthu a ku Malawi amatanthauza obadwira mdzikolo.

Woyimira Milandu Frank Mbeta ndiye anayimira boma. Maloya Neverson Chisiza ndi Francis MacJessie anamuthandiza. Pacific Limited inaimiridwa ndi Mordecai Msisa, yemwe ndi loya wamkulu, ndi Bright Theu. Loya wamkulu ndi loya wapamwamba.

Pacific Limited inati malamulo osinthidwawo sanali olungama. Kampaniyo inati malamulowo molakwika analetsa anthu ena kukhala ndi malo. Pacific Limited inati ili ndi malo 143 obwereketsa ndi odziyimira pawokha ku Malawi konse. Kubwereka malo kumatanthauza kubwereka malo kwa nthawi yayitali. Kubwereka malo kumatanthauza kukhala ndi malo enieni. Komabe, khotilo silinapeze umboni wosonyeza kuti Pacific Limited inali ndi malo aliwonsewa.

Oweruza Jabbar Alide, Chimwemwe Kamowa ndi Dick Sankhulani adapanga chisankhocho. Anati Pacific Limited sinatsimikizire kuti inali ndi chidwi chenicheni pankhaniyi. Oweruza nawonso adagwirizana ndi boma. Anati malamulo okhudza malo adapangidwa moyenera ndipo ndi ovomerezeka. Mlanduwu unali wofunikira kwambiri ku Malawi. Amalonda ambiri adawuyang'anitsitsa. Mlanduwu ukuwonetsa kufanana pakati pa kuteteza ufulu wa malo ndi kulandira ndalama ku Malawi.

en.title: UK cuts aid to Malawi by 90 percent by 2029
en.body: The United Kingdom will cut its aid to Malawi by 90 percent by the year 2029. Malawi got £50.2 million in aid in 2025-26. The amount will drop to £20 million in 2026-27. Then it will fall to £10 million in 2027-28. Finally, it will reach just £5 million in 2028-29. The UK made this choice to pay for more defence spending.
en.body_more:
The cut to Malawi is much deeper than the cut across Africa. All of Africa will lose 52 percent of UK aid. Malawi will lose 90 percent. That is 38 percent more than the average cut in Africa. The UK government published this plan in the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office annual report for 2025-26. The report says the UK will reduce all aid money to 0.3 percent of the country's wealth by 2027.

Other countries in Africa will also see big cuts. Mozambique will lose 90 percent of its UK aid, like Malawi. Rwanda and Sierra Leone will each lose more than 80 percent. Stuart Brown is the chief of the Scotland Malawi Partnership. He said the cuts will hurt poor people. "Malawians already face many daily problems. The weather is bad and the money is hard. Poor women, children and families will suffer," he said. He said more people will go hungry. Hospitals will have less help. Schools will lose money. People will find fewer jobs.

General Lord Richard Dannatt was the old head of the British Army. He said cutting aid to pay for defence is a mistake. He said this will make Britain weaker, not stronger. Minister Joseph Mwanamvekha said Malawi needs more outside money for food, schools and health. This will help people as the cost of living goes up. The government has not yet changed its money plan to fit the new UK aid.

ny.title: UK yachepetsa thandizo ku Malawi ndi 90 peresenti pofika chaka cha 2029
ny.body: Dziko la United Kingdom lidzachepetsa thandizo lake ku Malawi ndi 90 peresenti pofika chaka cha 2029. Malawi idalandira thandizo la £50.2 miliyoni mu 2025-26. Ndalamazo zidzatsika kufika pa £20 miliyoni mu 2026-27. Kenako zidzatsika kufika pa £10 miliyoni mu 2027-28. Pomaliza pake, zidzafika pa £5 miliyoni mu 2028-29. UK idasankha izi kuti ipereke ndalama zambiri zodzitetezera.
ny.body_more:
Kuchepetsa kwa Malawi kuli kozama kwambiri kuposa kuchepetsa kwa Africa konse. Africa yonse idzataya 52 peresenti ya thandizo la UK. Malawi idzataya 90 peresenti. Izi ndi 38 peresenti kuposa kuchepetsa kwapakati pa Africa. Boma la UK linafalitsa dongosololi mu lipoti la pachaka la Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office la 2025-26. Lipotilo likuti UK idzachepetsa ndalama zonse zothandizira kufika pa 0.3 peresenti ya chuma cha dzikolo pofika chaka cha 2027.

Mayiko ena ku Africa nawonso adzaona kuchepetsa kwakukulu. Mozambique idzataya 90 peresenti ya thandizo lake la UK, monga Malawi. Rwanda ndi Sierra Leone aliyense adzataya oposa 80 peresenti. Stuart Brown ndiye mtsogoleri wa Scotland Malawi Partnership. Anati kuchepetsa kumeneku kudzavulaza anthu osauka. "Anthu aku Malawi akukumana kale ndi mavuto ambiri a tsiku ndi tsiku. Nyengo ndi yoipa ndipo ndalamazo ndi zovuta. Azimayi osauka, ana ndi mabanja adzavutika," adatero. Anati anthu ambiri adzakhala ndi njala. Zipatala zidzakhala ndi thandizo lochepa. Masukulu adzataya ndalama. Anthu adzapeza ntchito zochepa.
