General Lord Richard Dannatt anali mtsogoleri wakale wa gulu lankhondo la Britain. Iye anati kuchepetsa thandizo kuti mulipire chitetezo ndi cholakwika. Iye anati izi zipangitsa Britain kukhala yofooka, osati yolimba. Nduna Joseph Mwanamveka anati Malawi ikufunika ndalama zambiri zakunja zogulira chakudya, masukulu ndi zaumoyo. Izi zithandiza anthu pamene mitengo ya zinthu ikukwera. Boma silinasinthebe dongosolo lake la ndalama kuti ligwirizane ndi thandizo latsopano la UK.

en.title: CAMA asks Airtel and TNM to pay customers fast
en.body: The Consumers Association of Malawi (CAMA) has asked Airtel Malawi and Telekom Networks Malawi (TNM) to pay money back to customers quickly. The Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority (MACRA) told the two phone companies to give money to people who bought data bundles before a new price rule started. The companies did not tell people about the price change seven days before they made it happen.
en.body_more:
MACRA Director General Mayamiko Nkoloma said the phone companies broke the law. The Communications Act says phone companies must print the new prices in at least two newspapers seven days before they use them. Airtel and TNM did not do this. Customers who bought data bundles between 26 June and 2 July 2026 will get money back. They will get the difference in price for what they paid.

CAMA Executive Director John Kapito said CAMA asked MACRA to fix the problem. On 8 July 2026, CAMA and MACRA met and agreed the phone companies broke the law. Kapito asked the companies to pay back the money fast. He also asked customers to check their phone accounts to see if they got their money. Kapito said MACRA worked well and kept the law. He said MACRA helped protect people who buy phone services.

Kapito said "MACRA showed it can do its work well. We thank MACRA for helping consumers." Many people in Malawi worry about phone data prices. They say prices are too high. They want phone companies to tell the truth about prices. The companies must now give back the money they took from customers who bought the bundles at the wrong price.

ny.title: CAMA yapempha Airtel ndi TNM kuti azilipira makasitomala mwachangu
ny.body: Bungwe la Consumers Association of Malawi (CAMA) lapempha Airtel Malawi ndi Telekom Networks Malawi (TNM) kuti abweze ndalama mwachangu kwa makasitomala. Bungwe la Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority (MACRA) lauza makampani awiri a mafoni kuti apereke ndalama kwa anthu omwe adagula ma data bundles lamulo latsopano la mitengo lisanayambe. Makampaniwa sanauze anthu za kusintha kwa mitengo masiku asanu ndi awiri asanachite izi.
ny.body_more:
Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa MACRA, Mayamiko Nkoloma, anati makampani a mafoni anaswa lamulo. Lamulo la Communications Act limati makampani a mafoni ayenera kusindikiza mitengo yatsopanoyi m'manyuzipepala osachepera awiri masiku asanu ndi awiri asanagwiritse ntchito. Airtel ndi TNM sanachite izi. Makasitomala omwe adagula ma data bundles pakati pa 26 June ndi 2 July 2026 adzabwezedwa ndalama. Adzalandira kusiyana kwa mtengo wa zomwe adalipira.

Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa CAMA, John Kapito, adati CAMA idapempha MACRA kuti ikonze vutoli. Pa 8 July 2026, CAMA ndi MACRA adakumana ndipo adagwirizana kuti makampani a mafoni anaswa lamulo. Kapito adapempha makampaniwo kuti abweze ndalamazo mwachangu. Adapemphanso makasitomala kuti ayang'ane maakaunti awo a mafoni kuti awone ngati adapeza ndalama zawo. Kapito adati MACRA idagwira ntchito bwino ndipo idasunga lamulolo. Anati MACRA idathandiza kuteteza anthu omwe amagula ntchito zamafoni.

Kapito adati "MACRA yawonetsa kuti imatha kugwira ntchito yake bwino. Tikuthokoza MACRA pothandiza ogula." Anthu ambiri ku Malawi akuda nkhawa ndi mitengo ya data ya foni. Amati mitengo ndi yokwera kwambiri. Akufuna kuti makampani a mafoni azinena zoona za mitengo. Makampaniwa tsopano ayenera kubweza ndalama zomwe adatenga kwa makasitomala omwe adagula ma bundle pamtengo wolakwika.

en.title: MACRA tells Airtel and TNM to pay back customers
en.body: Airtel Malawi and TNM must pay back customers. The Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority (MACRA) made this order. The two phone companies raised their prices without following the law. MACRA Director General Mayamiko Nkoloma said both companies broke Section 76 of the Communications Act 2016. This law says new prices must appear in two newspapers seven days before they start.
en.body_more:
Customers affected between June 26 and July 2, 2026 will get money back. They will receive bundle credits equal to the price difference they paid. Bundle credits are extra phone services or data added to an account. MACRA says the compensation will fix the harm caused by the early price rises.

Both Airtel Malawi Plc and Telekom Networks Malawi Plc must finish paying customers by July 31, 2026. MACRA has also told the companies to make their systems better so they follow the law. The companies must show proof that they fixed their procedures. The two operators have not yet said if they will do this.

Many people in Malawi saw new phone prices appear suddenly weeks ago. Some people on social media said the two companies worked together to raise prices at the same time. MACRA says this breaks the law. Telecommunications operators must follow the rules before they change what customers pay. The law needs companies to give notice and publish new prices in newspapers so people know what is coming.

ny.title: MACRA yauza Airtel ndi TNM kuti azilipira makasitomala awo
ny.body: Airtel Malawi ndi TNM ayenera kubwezera makasitomala. Bungwe loona za kulankhulana la Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority (MACRA) linapereka lamuloli. Makampani awiriwa a mafoni adakweza mitengo yawo popanda kutsatira lamuloli. Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa MACRA, Mayamiko Nkoloma, adati makampani onsewa adaswa Gawo 76 la Lamulo la Kulankhulana la 2016. Lamuloli limati mitengo yatsopano iyenera kulembedwa m'manyuzipepala awiri masiku asanu ndi awiri isanayambe.
ny.body_more:
Makasitomala omwe akhudzidwa pakati pa June 26 ndi July 2, 2026 adzabwezedwa ndalama. Adzalandira ma bundle credits ofanana ndi kusiyana kwa mitengo yomwe adalipira. Ma bundle credits ndi mautumiki owonjezera a foni kapena deta yowonjezeredwa ku akaunti. MACRA ikunena kuti chipukuta misozi chidzakonza mavuto omwe abwera chifukwa cha kukwera kwa mitengo koyambirira.

Airtel Malawi Plc ndi Telekom Networks Malawi Plc onse ayenera kumaliza kulipira makasitomala pofika July 31, 2026. MACRA yauzanso makampaniwo kuti akonze machitidwe awo kuti atsatire lamulo. Makampaniwa ayenera kuwonetsa umboni woti adakonza njira zawo. Ogwira ntchito awiriwa sananenebe ngati achita izi.

Anthu ambiri ku Malawi adawona mitengo yatsopano ya mafoni ikubwera mwadzidzidzi milungu ingapo yapitayo. Anthu ena pa malo ochezera a pa Intaneti adati makampani awiriwa adagwira ntchito limodzi kuti akweze mitengo nthawi imodzi. MACRA ikunena kuti izi zikuswa lamulo. Ogwira ntchito zolumikizirana ayenera kutsatira malamulo asanasinthe zomwe makasitomala amalipira. Lamulo likufuna makampani kuti apereke chidziwitso ndikufalitsa mitengo yatsopano m'manyuzipepala kuti anthu adziwe zomwe zikubwera.

en.title: Parliament wants law to limit government borrowing
en.body: Malawi's Budget and Finance Committee wants a new law to stop the government borrowing too much money. The country now owes K23.9 trillion. This is almost all of what Malawi makes in one year. The committee said the country needs legal limits on borrowing, not just hope that leaders will be careful.
en.body_more:
On Thursday, Committee Chairperson Sosten Gwengwe said Malawi's debt has grown nearly six times in five years. He explained that a law called the Debt Management Act would set clear limits on how much money the government can borrow and how much it can spend more than it earns. Debt is money a country must pay back.

Of Malawi's total debt, about K16 trillion comes from borrowing inside the country and about $4.3 billion comes from other countries. The World Bank, IMF, and African Development Bank are the main lenders from outside. Gwengwe said external loans need Parliament to say yes through a special bill. But domestic borrowing is allowed automatically once lawmakers pass a budget that spends more than the country earns. A budget is a plan for money a government will spend.

The National Debt Coalition said domestic debt alone is K15.6 trillion, which is more than half of all debt. Dingaani Mithi, who works for the coalition, said this fast growth is bad for the country. It takes money away from building roads and hospitals. Mithi said Malawi needs stronger laws and stronger government bodies to watch over borrowing.

This year the government plans to borrow more than K2.8 trillion. Economist Velli Nyirongo said it will be very hard to borrow less while spending so much. He said the government must earn more money from taxes, spend less, handle money better, and make foreign lenders believe in Malawi again.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo ikufuna kuti lamulo lichepetse kubwereka kwa boma
ny.body: Komiti ya Bajeti ndi Zachuma ku Malawi ikufuna lamulo latsopano loletsa boma kubwereka ndalama zambiri. Dzikoli tsopano lili ndi ngongole ya K23.9 trilioni. Izi ndi pafupifupi zonse zomwe Malawi imapanga m'chaka chimodzi. Komitiyi inati dzikolo likufunika malire ovomerezeka pa ngongole, osati kungoyembekezera kuti atsogoleri azisamala.
ny.body_more:
Lachinayi, Wapampando wa Komiti Sosten Gwengwe adati ngongole ya Malawi yakula pafupifupi kasanu ndi kamodzi m'zaka zisanu. Anafotokoza kuti lamulo lotchedwa Debt Management Act lidzaika malire omveka bwino a ndalama zomwe boma lingabwereke komanso ndalama zomwe lingagwiritse ntchito kuposa zomwe limapeza. Ngongole ndi ndalama zomwe dziko liyenera kubweza.

Pa ngongole yonse ya Malawi, pafupifupi K16 trillion imachokera ku ngongole mkati mwa dzikolo ndipo pafupifupi $4.3 biliyoni imachokera kumayiko ena. Banki Yapadziko Lonse, IMF, ndi African Development Bank ndi omwe amapereka ngongole zazikulu kuchokera kunja. Gwengwe adati ngongole zakunja zimafuna kuti Nyumba Yamalamulo ivomereze kudzera mu lamulo lapadera. Koma kubwereka kwamkati kumaloledwa zokha akangopereka bajeti yomwe imagwiritsa ntchito ndalama zambiri kuposa zomwe dzikolo limapeza. Bajeti ndi dongosolo la ndalama zomwe boma lidzagwiritse ntchito.

National Debt Coalition idati ngongole zamkati zokha ndi K15.6 trillion, zomwe ndi zoposa theka la ngongole zonse. Dingaani Mithi, yemwe amagwira ntchito ku mgwirizanowu, adati kukula mwachangu kumeneku ndi koipa kwa dzikolo. Kumachotsa ndalama pomanga misewu ndi zipatala. Mithi anati dziko la Malawi likufunika malamulo olimba komanso mabungwe amphamvu aboma kuti ayang'anire kubwereka ndalama.

Chaka chino boma likukonzekera kubwereka ndalama zoposa K2.8 triliyoni. Katswiri wazachuma Velli Nyirongo anati zidzakhala zovuta kwambiri kubwereka ndalama zochepa pamene akugwiritsa ntchito ndalama zambiri. Anati boma liyenera kupeza ndalama zambiri kuchokera ku misonkho, kugwiritsa ntchito ndalama zochepa, kusamalira bwino ndalama, ndikupangitsa obwereketsa akunja kukhulupiriranso dziko la Malawi.

en.title: EU approves K283 billion aid package for Malawi
en.body: The European Union has approved €143 million (about K283 billion) in new money for Malawi. The funds will help agriculture, electricity, education and social protection. EU Ambassador Daniel Aristi-Gaztelumendi made the announcement in Lilongwe on July 17. A group of EU experts visited Malawi from July 13 to 16 to see how EU projects work.
en.body_more:
The €143 million package has three main parts. The first supports agricultural value chains. The second pays for electricity generation and transmission. The third funds secondary education, vocational training and social protection programmes.

Aristi-Gaztelumendi said the EU's total development cooperation with Malawi is €497 million. When the EU joins with its 27 member states and European investment banks, the total money reaches €1.5 billion. A special purpose vehicle called Mpatamanga Hydropower Limited is building a major hydropower project. This project costs between €500 million and €600 million and generates 350 megawatts of power. The project brings together money from the EU, member states, the European Investment Bank, Germany's KfW bank and private companies.

The recent visit by 30 EU experts lasted three and a half days. The experts met with government officials, non-governmental organisations and people who receive EU help. Irish Ambassador Kate Brady said the visit helps EU policymakers in Brussels understand how projects work on the ground. The visit shapes the EU's next long-term funding plan for 2028 to 2036. Malawi's development strategy, called Malawi 2063, guides this partnership. The EU focuses on economic change, human capital, climate resilience, good governance and social protection.

ny.title: EU yavomereza thandizo la K283 biliyoni ku Malawi
ny.body: Bungwe la European Union lavomereza ndalama zatsopano zokwana €143 miliyoni (pafupifupi K283 biliyoni) ku Malawi. Ndalamazi zithandiza ulimi, magetsi, maphunziro ndi chitetezo cha anthu. Kazembe wa EU Daniel Aristi-Gaztelumendi adalengeza izi ku Lilongwe pa Julayi 17. Gulu la akatswiri a EU linapita ku Malawi kuyambira pa Julayi 13 mpaka 16 kuti akaone momwe mapulojekiti a EU amagwirira ntchito.
ny.body_more:
Phukusi la €143 miliyoni lili ndi magawo atatu akuluakulu. Loyamba limathandizira maunyolo amtengo wapatali a ulimi. Lachiwiri limalipira kupanga magetsi ndi kutumiza magetsi. Lachitatu limathandizira maphunziro a sekondale, maphunziro aukadaulo ndi mapulogalamu oteteza anthu.

Aristi-Gaztelumendi adati mgwirizano wonse wa EU ndi Malawi ndi €497 miliyoni. EU ikalowa nawo mayiko 27 omwe ali mamembala ndi mabanki aku Europe, ndalama zonse zimafika €1.5 biliyoni. Galimoto yapadera yotchedwa Mpatamanga Hydropower Limited ikumanga pulojekiti yayikulu yamagetsi. Pulojekitiyi imawononga €500 miliyoni ndi €600 miliyoni ndipo imapanga ma megawatts 350 amagetsi. Pulojekitiyi imabweretsa ndalama kuchokera ku EU, mayiko omwe ali mamembala, European Investment Bank, banki ya KfW yaku Germany ndi makampani achinsinsi.

Ulendo waposachedwa wa akatswiri 30 a EU unatenga masiku atatu ndi theka. Akatswiriwa adakumana ndi akuluakulu aboma, mabungwe omwe si aboma komanso anthu omwe amalandira thandizo la EU. Kazembe wa ku Ireland Kate Brady adati ulendowu umathandiza opanga mfundo za EU ku Brussels kumvetsetsa momwe mapulojekiti amagwirira ntchito pansi. Ulendowu ukuwonetsa dongosolo lotsatira la ndalama la EU la nthawi yayitali kuyambira 2028 mpaka 2036. Njira ya chitukuko ya Malawi, yotchedwa Malawi 2063, ikutsogolera mgwirizanowu. EU ikuyang'ana kwambiri pa kusintha kwachuma, anthu ogwira ntchito, kupirira nyengo, ulamuliro wabwino komanso chitetezo cha anthu.

en.title: Malawi tells UN cities must grow better and faster
en.body: Malawi's Lands Minister Chimwemwe Chipungu spoke at the United Nations in New York on Wednesday. He said cities in Malawi are growing very fast. He called for better housing and services for all people.
en.body_more:
Chipungu gave a speech to the UN High-Level Meeting on the Midterm Review of the New Urban Agenda. He said the next ten years must have real action on cities. He told other countries that Malawi faces big challenges with urban growth.

Almost all of Malawi's city people live in informal settlements. These are areas without proper houses or services. The minister said towns and cities are growing at a very fast pace. This puts pressure on housing, roads, water and other basic services. Malawi wants to make cities a national priority under its Malawi 2063 Vision. The country plans to grow secondary cities. This means building new cities away from the biggest ones. The goal is to help rural areas benefit from city growth too.

Chipungu said the government is using decentralisation. This gives local leaders more power to manage city development. He called for more money for affordable housing and better infrastructure. He said partners must work together: government, local leaders, private business, communities and development helpers. Malawi gave an example of work done in Lilongwe. Habitat for Humanity Malawi and local government helped transform an informal settlement there. The minister also asked for more climate finance and technology for developing countries.

Malawi is co-chairing this UN process with Poland. The country is helping write a Political Declaration. This will push all countries to follow the New Urban Agenda until 2036. Chipungu ended by saying Malawi is committed to working with UN-Habitat and all partners. He said urbanisation must bring growth, strength and good life for all people, leaving no one behind.

ny.title: Malawi yauza mizinda ya UN kuti ikule bwino komanso mwachangu
ny.body: Nduna ya za malo ku Malawi Chimwemwe Chipungu adalankhula ku bungwe la United Nations ku New York Lachitatu. Iye adati mizinda ku Malawi ikukula mofulumira kwambiri. Adapempha kuti anthu onse azikhala ndi nyumba zabwino komanso ntchito zabwino.
ny.body_more:
Chipungu adalankhula pa Msonkhano Wapamwamba wa UN pa Kuwunikanso kwa Pakati pa Nthawi kwa Ndondomeko Yatsopano ya Mizinda. Anati zaka khumi zikubwerazi ziyenera kukhala ndi zochita zenizeni pa mizinda. Adauza mayiko ena kuti Malawi ikukumana ndi mavuto akuluakulu okhudzana ndi kukula kwa mizinda.

Pafupifupi anthu onse okhala mumzinda wa Malawi amakhala m'malo osakhazikika. Awa ndi madera opanda nyumba kapena ntchito zoyenera. Ndunayo idati matauni ndi mizinda ikukula mofulumira kwambiri. Izi zikuika mavuto pa nyumba, misewu, madzi ndi ntchito zina zofunika. Malawi ikufuna kupanga mizinda kukhala yofunika kwambiri padziko lonse lapansi pansi pa Masomphenya ake a Malawi 2063. Dzikoli likukonzekera kukulitsa mizinda yachiwiri. Izi zikutanthauza kumanga mizinda yatsopano kutali ndi mizinda yayikulu. Cholinga chake ndi kuthandiza madera akumidzi kupindulanso ndi kukula kwa mizinda.

Chipungu adati boma likugwiritsa ntchito njira zogawa mphamvu. Izi zimapatsa atsogoleri am'deralo mphamvu zambiri zoyendetsera chitukuko cha mizinda. Adapempha ndalama zambiri kuti pakhale nyumba zotsika mtengo komanso zomangamanga zabwino. Anati ogwirizana nawo ayenera kugwira ntchito limodzi: boma, atsogoleri am'deralo, mabizinesi achinsinsi, madera ndi othandizira chitukuko. Malawi idapereka chitsanzo cha ntchito yomwe yachitika ku Lilongwe. Habitat for Humanity Malawi ndi boma laderalo zathandiza kusintha malo osakhazikika kumeneko. Ndunayi idapemphanso kuti mayiko osauka alandire ndalama zambiri zokhudzana ndi nyengo komanso ukadaulo.

Malawi ikutsogolera ndondomeko ya UN iyi ndi Poland. Dzikoli likuthandiza kulemba Chikalata Chandale. Izi zikakamiza mayiko onse kuti atsatire Ndondomeko Yatsopano ya Mizinda mpaka 2036. Chipungu adamaliza ndi kunena kuti Malawi yadzipereka kugwira ntchito ndi UN-Habitat ndi mabungwe onse ogwirizana nawo. Anati kusamukira kumizinda kuyenera kubweretsa kukula, mphamvu ndi moyo wabwino kwa anthu onse, osasiya aliyense kumbuyo.

en.title: Icon Properties plans big new buildings in Malawi
en.body: Icon Properties plc said it will build new offices and shops. The company held a meeting on 15 July 2026 at Ryalls Hotel in Blantyre. Chief Executive Officer Washington Chimuzu said they will build a modern office building in Lilongwe. They will also make Chichiri Shopping Mall bigger in Blantyre.
en.body_more:
The company made a profit of K32.6 billion in the year 2025. This is more money than they made in 2024, when they had K24 billion. Icon Properties said it wants to grow more across Malawi. The company buys and sells buildings. They want more people to use their offices and shops.

The Mayor of Blantyre City Council said thank you to Icon Properties. The Mayor said the company helps the city grow. New buildings bring jobs and money to Blantyre. Ryalls Hotel was picked for the meeting. Ryalls Hotel is very old. It has been in Blantyre for more than 100 years. The hotel shows how good care of buildings keeps them strong and useful.

Icon Properties said it wants to keep making good buildings. The company works with many people. They have clients, partners and other people who work with them. All these people came to the meeting. Icon Properties said it will keep growing in a way that helps all of Malawi.

ny.title: Icon Properties ikukonzekera nyumba zatsopano zazikulu ku Malawi
ny.body: Icon Properties plc yati imanga maofesi ndi masitolo atsopano. Kampaniyo inachita msonkhano pa 15 Julayi 2026 ku Ryalls Hotel ku Blantyre. Mkulu wa bungweli Washington Chimuzu anati adzamanga nyumba yamakono ya maofesi ku Lilongwe. Adzapanganso Chichiri Shopping Mall yayikulu ku Blantyre.
ny.body_more:
Kampaniyo idapeza phindu la K32.6 biliyoni mu chaka cha 2025. Ndalama zimenezi ndi zambiri kuposa zomwe adapeza mu 2024, pomwe anali ndi K24 biliyoni. Icon Properties idati ikufuna kukula kwambiri ku Malawi konse. Kampaniyo imagula ndikugulitsa nyumba. Akufuna kuti anthu ambiri azigwiritsa ntchito maofesi ndi masitolo awo.

Meya wa Blantyre City Council adati zikomo kwa Icon Properties. Meya adati kampaniyo ikuthandiza mzinda kukula. Nyumba zatsopano zimabweretsa ntchito ndi ndalama ku Blantyre. Ryalls Hotel idasankhidwa pamsonkhanowu. Ryalls Hotel ndi yakale kwambiri. Yakhala ku Blantyre kwa zaka zoposa 100. Hoteloyi ikuwonetsa momwe kusamalira bwino nyumba kumazisungira zolimba komanso zothandiza.

Icon Properties idati ikufuna kupitiriza kupanga nyumba zabwino. Kampaniyo imagwira ntchito ndi anthu ambiri. Ali ndi makasitomala, ogwirizana nawo komanso anthu ena omwe amagwira nawo ntchito. Anthu onsewa adabwera pamsonkhanowu. Icon Properties idati ipitiliza kukula mwanjira yomwe ingathandize Malawi yonse.

en.title: Court stops High Court ruling on generals' move
en.body: The Supreme Court of Appeal has stopped a High Court ruling that cancelled the redeployment of five senior Malawi Defence Force generals to the civil service. Attorney General Frank Mbeta asked the court to pause the High Court decision while the government appeals. The Supreme Court agreed.
en.body_more:
Chief Justice Rizine Mzikamanda led the panel of judges that made the decision. The court said it would suspend the High Court ruling until the appeal is finished. This means the five generals will not go back to their old military jobs yet.

The redeployment was ordered by Justin Saidi, the Secretary to the President and Cabinet. The generals went to court to say the move was against the law. The High Court agreed with them and cancelled the redeployment order. But the government asked a judge to stop that ruling while it appealed. Judge Kenyatta Nyirenda said no. He said the government's case was weak.

Frank Mbeta then asked the Supreme Court of Appeal to pause the High Court ruling. He said the positions the generals held had already been filled by other people. The Supreme Court agreed with Mbeta. It said stopping the High Court ruling was the right thing to do until the appeal is decided. The court said it was not saying who was right or wrong yet. It only wanted to keep things as they were until the case is finished.

The five generals must wait for the Supreme Court to finish hearing the government's appeal. Until then, they cannot go back to their old jobs in the military.

ny.title: Khoti Laliletsa Chigamulo cha Khoti Lalikulu pa Chisankho cha Akulu Ankhondo
ny.body: Khoti Lalikulu la Apilo laletsa chigamulo cha Khoti Lalikulu chomwe chinaletsa kusinthidwa kwa akuluakulu asanu ankhondo a Malawi Defence Force kuti agwire ntchito m'boma. Loya Wamkulu Frank Mbeta adapempha khotilo kuti liyimitse chigamulo cha Khoti Lalikulu pamene boma likuchita apilo. Khoti Lalikulu linavomereza.
ny.body_more:
Woweruza Wamkulu Rizine Mzikamanda anatsogolera gulu la oweruza omwe adapanga chisankhocho. Khothi linati liyimitsa chigamulo cha Khothi Lalikulu mpaka apilo itatha. Izi zikutanthauza kuti majenerali asanuwa sadzabwerera kuntchito zawo zakale zankhondo.

Kusamutsa anthu m'malo mwa asilikali kunalamulidwa ndi Justin Saidi, Mlembi wa Purezidenti ndi Kabungwe. Majenerali anapita kukhothi kukanena kuti izi zinali zosemphana ndi lamulo. Khothi Lalikulu linagwirizana nawo ndipo linathetsa lamulo losamutsa anthu m'malo mwa asilikali. Koma boma linapempha woweruza kuti asiye chigamulocho pamene linkachita apilo. Woweruza Kenyatta Nyirenda anati ayi. Anati mlandu wa boma ndi wofooka.

Kenako Frank Mbeta anapempha Khothi Lalikulu la Apilo kuti liyimitse chigamulo cha Khothi Lalikulu. Anati maudindo omwe majenerali anali nawo anali atadzazidwa kale ndi anthu ena. Khothi Lalikulu linagwirizana ndi Mbeta. Linati kuletsa chigamulo cha Khothi Lalikulu chinali chinthu choyenera kuchita mpaka apilo itagamulidwa. Khothi linati silikunena kuti ndani anali wolondola kapena wolakwika. Limangofuna kusunga zinthu momwe zinalili mpaka mlanduwo utatha.

Asilikali asanu akuyenera kudikira kuti Khoti Lalikulu limalize kumva apilo ya boma. Mpaka nthawi imeneyo, sangabwerere kuntchito zawo zakale za usilikali.

en.title: Court stops case against Chinese wildlife smuggler Lin Yunhua
en.body: A High Court in Lilongwe stopped an order to drop a case against Chinese smuggler Lin Yunhua on Thursday. Environmental groups said this is good for wildlife protection in Malawi. The Anti-Corruption Bureau asked the court to stop the case, but the court said no.
en.body_more:
Lin Yunhua was convicted in 2020 of wildlife trafficking and money crimes. He was sentenced to 14 years in prison. He must be deported to China after he finishes his sentence.

Eleven environmental groups welcomed the court's decision. Zilanie Gondwe spoke for the groups at a news meeting in Lilongwe. She said the ruling protects the rule of law. Rule of law means everyone follows the same rules and no one is above the law. Gondwe said the case should continue because it is important to the public. She called for more honesty and openness in how the case is handled.

The groups said dropping the case would hurt trust in Malawi's courts. It would waste public money. It would also damage Malawi's image as a country that fights wildlife crime. Malawi has worked hard with international partners to stop illegal animal trade. Mathews Malata, another activist, said Yunhua broke the National Parks and Wildlife Act and the Financial Crimes Act. The court ruling shows that high-profile cases must finish fairly, the groups said.

The groups also said a concern remains. Director of Public Prosecutions Masauko Maele once represented Yunhua as a lawyer before taking his current job. This raises questions about fairness in the case. The groups have promised to watch the case closely. They will work with Parliament to ensure justice is done properly.

ny.title: Khoti laletsa mlandu wokhudza Lin Yunhua, wogulitsa nyama zakuthengo ku China
ny.body: Khoti Lalikulu ku Lilongwe laletsa lamulo loti mlandu wokhudza munthu wozembetsa zinthu ku China dzina lake Lin Yunhua uchotsedwe Lachinayi. Magulu oteteza zachilengedwe ati izi ndi zabwino poteteza nyama zakuthengo ku Malawi. Bungwe Lolimbana ndi Ziphuphu lapempha khoti kuti liletse mlanduwu, koma khotilo linati ayi.
ny.body_more:
Lin Yunhua adapezeka wolakwa mu 2020 chifukwa cha kugulitsa nyama zakuthengo ndi milandu ya ndalama. Adaweruzidwa kuti akhale m'ndende zaka 14. Ayenera kuthamangitsidwa ku China akamaliza chilango chake.

Magulu khumi ndi limodzi oteteza chilengedwe adalandira chigamulo cha khothi. Zilanie Gondwe adalankhula m'malo mwa maguluwo pamsonkhano wa atolankhani ku Lilongwe. Adati chigamulochi chimateteza ulamuliro wa malamulo. Ulamuliro wa malamulo umatanthauza kuti aliyense amatsatira malamulo omwewo ndipo palibe amene ali pamwamba pa lamulo. Gondwe adati mlanduwu uyenera kupitilira chifukwa ndi wofunika kwa anthu onse. Adapempha kuti pakhale chilungamo komanso kutseguka pa momwe mlanduwu udzachitidwire.

Maguluwa adati kusiya mlanduwu kungawononge chidaliro m'makhothi aku Malawi. Kungawononge ndalama za anthu. Kungawonongenso chithunzi cha Malawi ngati dziko lomwe limalimbana ndi umbanda wa nyama zakuthengo. Malawi yagwira ntchito molimbika ndi mabungwe apadziko lonse lapansi kuti aletse malonda osaloledwa a nyama zakuthengo. Mathews Malata, wolimbikitsa wina, adati Yunhua waswa lamulo la National Parks and Wildlife Act ndi Financial Crimes Act. Chigamulo cha khothi chikuwonetsa kuti milandu yotchuka iyenera kutha mwachilungamo, maguluwa adatero.

Maguluwa adatinso pali nkhawa yomwe ikadalipo. Mtsogoleri wa milandu ya anthu, Masauko Maele, nthawi ina ankayimira Yunhua ngati loya asanagwire ntchito yake yomwe ali nayo panopa. Izi zikubweretsa mafunso okhudza chilungamo pa mlanduwu. Maguluwa alonjeza kuti ayang'anira nkhaniyi mosamala. Agwira ntchito ndi Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti awonetsetse kuti chilungamo chachitika moyenera.

en.title: Water board chair faces abuse of office claims
en.body: Stanley Chirwa, the chairperson of Blantyre Water Board, is facing calls for an investigation. People say he is controlling the utility too much and making procurement decisions that he should not make. Five senior directors were put on leave on 9 February 2026. More than six months later, they are still on leave.
en.body_more:
The five directors lead Human Resources and Administration, Procurement and Disposal, Distribution and Commerce, and Finance and Technical Services. They were put on leave pending a forensic audit. A forensic audit is a detailed check of money and records. But the audit has not finished, and the leave has become indefinite. People question why the audit is taking so long.

Chirwa wanted to use a restricted tendering process to pick auditors for the forensic audit. Restricted tendering means only some companies are asked to bid. The Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets Authority (PPDA) said no. They said Chirwa did not give good reasons for using this method. In open tendering, all companies can bid.

Chirwa also cancelled several procurement processes that had already finished evaluation. The results of these tenders were published in The Nation newspaper on 24 March 2026. A second group of bidders say Chirwa stopped a tender opening on 2 July 2026. Bidders had submitted sealed bids by 9am on that day. But moments before the opening, they were told to take their bids back and leave. No formal explanation was given. By 7 July, no communication had been sent to the bidders. Several bidders have asked the Anti-Corruption Bureau and PPDA to help.

Further allegations say three firms bought bidding documents even though they did not attend a mandatory pre-bid meeting. These firms are PKG Associates, C-Success Consulting, and Baker Tilly. Only Yvespro Consult attended the required meeting. People alleged to help Chirwa include Mavuto Chimtengo, Oweni Maloni, Andrew Masiye, and Crissy Mwasowa. Employees say this is happening without the chief executive knowing. This shows poor governance at the water board.

ny.title: Wapampando wa bungwe la Water Board akukumana ndi vuto la kuphwanya malamulo a ofesi
ny.body: Stanley Chirwa, wapampando wa Blantyre Water Board, akukumana ndi zifuno zoti afufuze. Anthu akunena kuti akulamulira kwambiri makina opangira magetsi ndipo akupanga zisankho zogula zomwe sayenera kupanga. Akuluakulu asanu adapatsidwa tchuthi pa 9 February 2026. Patatha miyezi yoposa isanu ndi umodzi, akadali pa tchuthi.
ny.body_more:
Otsogolera asanuwa akutsogolera Human Resources and Administration, Procurement and Disposal, Distribution and Commerce, ndi Finance and Technical Services. Anapatsidwa tchuthi podikira kuti audit ya forensic ichitike. Ukawunilodi wa forensic ndi cheke chatsatanetsatane cha ndalama ndi zolemba. Koma audit sinathe, ndipo tchuthicho chakhala chosatha. Anthu amafunsa chifukwa chake audit ikuchedwa.

Chirwa ankafuna kugwiritsa ntchito njira yochepetsera kupereka ma tenda kuti asankhe owerengera ndalama kuti akawunilodi. Kuchepetsa kupereka ma tenda kumatanthauza kuti makampani ena okha ndi omwe amafunsidwa kuti apereke ma tenda. Bungwe la Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets Authority (PPDA) linati ayi. Anati Chirwa sanapereke zifukwa zomveka zogwiritsira ntchito njira imeneyi. Pakupereka ma tenda poyera, makampani onse amatha kupereka ma tenda.

Chirwa adaletsanso njira zingapo zogulira zomwe zidamaliza kale kuwunika. Zotsatira za ma tendawa zidasindikizidwa mu nyuzipepala ya The Nation pa 24 Marichi 2026. Gulu lachiwiri la opereka ma tenda limati Chirwa adayimitsa kutsegulidwa kwa ma tenda pa 2 Julayi 2026. Opereka ma tenda adapereka ma tenda otsekedwa pofika 9 koloko m'mawa tsiku lomwelo. Koma mphindi zochepa zisanatsegulidwe, adauzidwa kuti abwezere ma tenda awo ndikuchoka. Palibe kufotokozera kovomerezeka komwe kunaperekedwa. Pofika pa 7 Julayi, palibe uthenga womwe unatumizidwa kwa omwe akufuna kupereka mavoti. Opereka mavoti angapo apempha bungwe la Anti-Corruption Bureau ndi PPDA kuti athandize.

Zomwe zinanenedwa ndikuti makampani atatu adagula zikalata zopempha mavoti ngakhale kuti sanapite kumsonkhano wokakamiza wopereka mavoti. Makampaniwa ndi PKG Associates, C-Success Consulting, ndi Baker Tilly. Ndi Yvespro Consult yokha yomwe idapezeka pamsonkhano wofunikira. Anthu omwe akunenedwa kuti akuthandiza Chirwa ndi Mavuto Chintengo, Oweni Maloni, Andrew Masiye, ndi Crissy Mwasowa. Ogwira ntchito akuti izi zikuchitika popanda mkulu wa bungwe kudziwa. Izi zikusonyeza kuti kayendetsedwe ka boma ndi koipa pa bungwe la water board.

en.title: Court seals Mec warehouse over unpaid rent in Lilongwe
en.body: Sheriffs sealed a Malawi Electoral Commission (Mec) warehouse at Njewa in Lilongwe on Wednesday. The warehouse stores Mec equipment. The court ordered the sealing because rent was not paid. About K750 million is owed. Mec Director of Communications Sangwani Mwafulirwa confirmed what happened.
en.body_more:
The landlord is Azmy Ali Jawad. A court issued a warrant of distress. This is a court order to recover money owed. Sheriffs also seized motor vehicles to help recover the debt. Debt is money that must be paid back.

Mec said the warehouse lease ended on 31 March 2026. Before it ended, Mec started talks to renew the lease. Mec finished these talks in good time. But Mec needed government approval to sign the new lease. In February 2026, the government made new rules about spending money. Mec asked the government for permission to renew the lease. The government has not yet said yes. Mec is still waiting.

Mec said it is talking to the government and the landlord to fix this problem. Mec wants to make the lease proper again soon. Mec said it will keep its public assets safe and do its work for the country. The warehouse sealing comes while courts are hearing a case about moving Mec from Lilongwe to Blantyre. The High Court allowed this case to go to trial. The Malawi Congress Party and others asked the court to stop the move.

ny.title: Khoti latseka nyumba yosungiramo katundu ya Mec chifukwa chosalipira lendi ku Lilongwe
ny.body: Masherifu adatseka nyumba yosungiramo zinthu ya Malawi Electoral Commission (Mec) ku Njewa ku Lilongwe Lachitatu. Nyumba yosungiramo zinthu imasunga zipangizo za Mec. Khotilo linalamula kuti kutsekedwako kutsekedwe chifukwa lendi sinalipidwe. Pali ngongole ya pafupifupi K750 miliyoni. Mtsogoleri wa Kulumikizana kwa Mec Sangwani Mwafulirwa adatsimikiza zomwe zinachitika.
ny.body_more:
Mwininyumba ndi Azmy Ali Jawad. Khothi lapereka chikalata chokakamiza anthu kuti asamavutike. Ili ndi lamulo la khothi loti abweze ndalama zomwe adalipira. A Sheriff adalandanso magalimoto kuti athandize kubweza ngongoleyo. Ngongole ndi ndalama zomwe ziyenera kubwezedwa.

Mec adati lendi ya nyumba yosungiramo katundu inatha pa 31 Marichi 2026. Isanathe, Mec idayamba kukambirana kuti akonzenso lendi. Mec idamaliza zokambiranazi nthawi yake. Koma Mec idafunikira chilolezo cha boma kuti isaine lendi yatsopano. Mu February 2026, boma lidapanga malamulo atsopano okhudza kugwiritsa ntchito ndalama. Mec idapempha boma chilolezo kuti akonzenso lendi. Boma silinanenebe kuti inde. Mec ikudikirabe.

Mec idati ikulankhula ndi boma ndi mwininyumba kuti akonze vutoli. Mec ikufuna kukonzanso lendi posachedwa. Mec idati isunga katundu wake wa boma kukhala wotetezeka ndikugwira ntchito yake mdzikolo. Kutseka nyumba yosungiramo katundu kukuchitika pamene makhothi akumvetsera mlandu wokhudza kusamutsa Mec kuchokera ku Lilongwe kupita ku Blantyre. Khothi Lalikulu lalola kuti nkhaniyi iyambe kuzengedwa mlandu. Chipani cha Malawi Congress ndi ena adapempha khoti kuti liletse izi.

en.title: National Bank gives K100 billion for road repair
en.body: National Bank of Malawi (NBM) will pay K100 billion to fix the Golomoti-Monkey Bay Road. Transport Minister Jappie Mhango opened the work site yesterday in Dedza. The road section is 28.4 kilometres long. It runs from Golomoti Trading Centre in Dedza to Chantulo Trading Centre in Mangochi.
en.body_more:
The road is split into two parts. NBM pays for this section. FDH Bank pays for the other section, which is 30 kilometres long and goes from Chantulo to Monkey Bay T-junction. That section also costs K100 billion.

Minister Mhango said the bank's help is very good for the country. He said the old government did not fix roads. Now most roads are in bad shape. He wants the road network to be better in three years. NBM Board Chairperson Grant Kabango said the bank wants to help Malawi grow. The road goes to Mangochi, which brings many tourists. Good roads help farming, schools and hospitals too. Kabango said it is good to borrow money inside Malawi. This keeps the country safe from money problems with other countries. The loan can be paid back in the right way.

Roads Authority leader Engineer Newton Kambala said the road was built 20 years ago. It was very bad and had no big repair work since 2008. Now cars break down a lot. People take much longer to travel. Goods cost more to move. People cannot reach hospitals, markets and schools easily. This road helps people reach Mangochi and fishing areas.

The builder Mota-Engil has 24 months to finish the work. The government said there is no more money if work takes longer. People who took land from the road will not get money back.

ny.title: National Bank yapereka K100 biliyoni yokonzera misewu
ny.body: Banki Yadziko Lonse ya Malawi (NBM) ipereka K100 biliyoni kuti ikonze msewu wa Golomoti-Monkey Bay. Nduna Yoona za Mayendedwe Jappie Mhango adatsegula malo ogwirira ntchito dzulo ku Dedza. Gawo la msewuwu ndi lalitali makilomita 28.4. Limayambira ku Golomoti Trading Centre ku Dedza mpaka ku Chantulo Trading Centre ku Mangochi.
ny.body_more:
Msewuwu wagawidwa m'magawo awiri. NBM imalipira gawoli. FDH Bank imalipira gawo lina, lomwe ndi lalitali makilomita 30 ndipo limayenda kuchokera ku Chantulo kupita ku Monkey Bay T-junction. Gawoli limawononganso K100 biliyoni.

Nduna Mhango adati thandizo la banki ndi labwino kwambiri mdziko muno. Anati boma lakale silinakonze misewu. Tsopano misewu yambiri ili mumkhalidwe woipa. Akufuna kuti netiweki ya misewu ikhale yabwino m'zaka zitatu. Wapampando wa Bungwe la NBM Grant Kabango adati bankiyo ikufuna kuthandiza Malawi kukula. Msewuwu umapita ku Mangochi, komwe kumabweretsa alendo ambiri. Misewu yabwino imathandizanso ulimi, masukulu ndi zipatala. Kabango adati ndibwino kubwereka ndalama mkati mwa Malawi. Izi zimateteza dzikolo ku mavuto azachuma ndi mayiko ena. Ngongoleyi ikhoza kubwezedwa mwanjira yoyenera.

Mtsogoleri wa Roads Authority, Injiniya Newton Kambala, adati msewuwu unamangidwa zaka 20 zapitazo. Unali woipa kwambiri ndipo sunakonzedwe kwambiri kuyambira 2008. Tsopano magalimoto amawonongeka kwambiri. Anthu amatenga nthawi yayitali kuyenda. Katundu amawononga ndalama zambiri kuti asamuke. Anthu sangafike mosavuta m'zipatala, m'misika ndi m'masukulu. Msewu uwu umathandiza anthu kufika ku Mangochi ndi m'madera osodza.

Womanga nyumba Mota-Engil ali ndi miyezi 24 kuti amalize ntchitoyi. Boma lati palibe ndalama zina ngati ntchito itenga nthawi yayitali. Anthu omwe adatenga malo pamsewu sadzabwezedwa ndalama.

en.title: Maranatha Academy gives K12 billion for school help
en.body: Maranatha Academy will give K12 billion to help poor students go to secondary school. The school will give 500 scholarships for the next four years. Director Ernest Kaonga said many talented students cannot go to school because families have no money. The 2026 National Scholarship Programme started this week.
en.body_more:
The scholarships will pay all school fees for students who are chosen. Students from Forms One to Four can apply. They can come from public schools, private schools, grant-aided schools, and Maranatha Academy itself. Registration is open now in all parts of the country.

Ernest Kaonga, the Academy's director, said the school wants to help the government give good education to all students. He said many families need help to keep children in school. "These students will become doctors, engineers, teachers and leaders," Kaonga said. "They will help Malawi grow."

The Academy said many students have already applied from across the country. This shows how much families want this help. The school will interview students in different parts of Malawi before choosing who gets the money. The scholarships will help reduce the cost families must pay. They will also help more students stay in school and finish their studies.

Education experts say scholarship programmes like this are very important. They help poor students get good education. They also help Malawi train skilled workers for the future. This is the biggest scholarship programme Maranatha Academy has ever done.

ny.title: Maranatha Academy yapereka K12 biliyoni yothandizira masukulu
ny.body: Maranatha Academy ipereka K12 biliyoni kuti ithandize ophunzira osauka kupita kusukulu ya sekondale. Sukuluyi ipereka maphunziro 500 kwa zaka zinayi zikubwerazi. Mtsogoleri Ernest Kaonga adati ophunzira ambiri aluso sangathe kupita kusukulu chifukwa mabanja alibe ndalama. Pulogalamu ya National Scholarship ya 2026 yayamba sabata ino.
ny.body_more:
Ma scholarship awa adzalipira ndalama zonse za sukulu kwa ophunzira omwe asankhidwa. Ophunzira kuyambira Fomu Yoyamba mpaka Yachinayi akhoza kulembetsa. Akhoza kuchokera m'masukulu aboma, masukulu achinsinsi, masukulu othandizidwa ndi ndalama zothandizira, komanso Maranatha Academy yokha. Kulembetsa kwatsegulidwa tsopano m'madera onse a dzikolo.

Ernest Kaonga, mkulu wa Academy, adati sukuluyi ikufuna kuthandiza boma kupereka maphunziro abwino kwa ophunzira onse. Anati mabanja ambiri amafunikira thandizo kuti ana azikhala kusukulu. "Ophunzira awa adzakhala madokotala, mainjiniya, aphunzitsi ndi atsogoleri," adatero Kaonga. "Adzathandiza Malawi kukula."

Academy yati ophunzira ambiri alembetsa kale kuchokera kudziko lonselo. Izi zikusonyeza momwe mabanja akufunira thandizoli. Sukuluyi idzafunsa mafunso ophunzira m'madera osiyanasiyana a Malawi asanasankhe omwe adzalandire ndalamazo. Ma scholarship awa athandiza kuchepetsa ndalama zomwe mabanja ayenera kulipira. Athandizanso ophunzira ambiri kuti apitirize kusukulu ndikumaliza maphunziro awo.

Akatswiri a maphunziro amati mapulogalamu a scholarship ngati awa ndi ofunikira kwambiri. Amathandiza ophunzira osauka kupeza maphunziro abwino. Amathandizanso Malawi kuphunzitsa antchito aluso mtsogolo. Iyi ndi pulogalamu yayikulu kwambiri ya scholarship yomwe Maranatha Academy yachitapo.

en.title: Malawi Women Football Team Travels to Morocco Cup
en.body: The Malawi Women's National Football Team left for Morocco on Tuesday to play in the TotalEnergies Caf Women's Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon). The team, called the Scorchers, will first play a friendly match against Morocco's Atlas Lionesses. This is Malawi's first time at Wafcon. The tournament runs from July 25 to August 16 in Morocco.
en.body_more:
The Scorchers played Morocco before. Malawi lost 4-2 to Morocco at Kenitra Stadium last year. Coach Lovemore Fazili said this friendly match is a chance to try new ideas before Wafcon. "Morale is high," Fazili said. "Everybody is good and ready for the match."

Malawi has not won many games lately. The team beat Angola 1-0 at the Cosafa Women's Championship in South Africa in January. Since then, Malawi lost to Australia 5-0 and to India 3-2 in April. Malawi also lost to Tanzania 1-0. Fazili has 21 players in camp now. Star player Temwa Chawinga will arrive in Rabat on July 20. Three players—Chisomo Banda, Lyna James, and Tendai Sani—came back to the squad.

Malawi will play Nigeria on July 28 at Al Madina Stadium. Four days later, Malawi will play Egypt at Moulay Hassan Stadium in Rabat. The team will face Zambia on August 5 at Al Madina Stadium. National Bank of Malawi gave the team support at the airport. The bank said it is proud to help the Scorchers. Fazili told players to work hard and make Malawi proud in Morocco.

ny.title: Gulu la mpira wa azimayi la Malawi lapita ku Morocco Cup
ny.body: Timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi yapita ku Morocco Lachiwiri kukasewera mu mpikisano wa TotalEnergies Caf Women's Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon). Gululi, lotchedwa Scorchers, lidzayamba kusewera masewera a paubwenzi ndi timu ya Atlas Lionesses ya ku Morocco. Iyi ndi nthawi yoyamba ya Malawi ku Wafcon. Mpikisanowu uyamba pa Julayi 25 mpaka Ogasiti 16 ku Morocco.
ny.body_more:
A Scorchers adasewera kale ndi Morocco. Malawi idagonja 4-2 ndi Morocco ku Kenitra Stadium chaka chatha. Mphunzitsi Lovemore Fazili adati masewerawa ndi mwayi woyesa malingaliro atsopano asanafike Wafcon. "Moyo ndi wabwino," adatero Fazili. "Aliyense ali bwino ndipo ali okonzeka masewerawa."

Malawi sanapambane masewera ambiri posachedwapa. Gululi lidagonjetsa Angola 1-0 ku Cosafa Women's Championship ku South Africa mu Januwale. Kuyambira pamenepo, Malawi idagonja ndi Australia 5-0 ndi India 3-2 mu Epulo. Malawi idagonjanso ndi Tanzania 1-0. Fazili ali ndi osewera 21 mumsasa tsopano. Wosewera nyenyezi Temwa Chawinga adzafika ku Rabat pa Julayi 20. Osewera atatu—Chisomo Banda, Lyna James, ndi Tendai Sani—abwerera ku gululo.

Malawi idzasewera ndi Nigeria pa Julayi 28 ku Al Madina Stadium. Patatha masiku anayi, Malawi idzasewera ndi Egypt ku Moulay Hassan Stadium ku Rabat. Gululi lidzasewera ndi Zambia pa Ogasiti 5 ku Al Madina Stadium. Banki Yadziko Lonse ya Malawi yathandiza timuyi pa bwalo la ndege. Bankiyo yati ikunyadira kuthandiza a Scorchers. Fazili adauza osewera kuti agwire ntchito molimbika ndikupangitsa Malawi kunyadira ku Morocco.

en.title: FDH Bank and Ekhaya Group back Gwamba's big concert
en.body: Two big companies have given money to help musician Gwamba hold a large concert on August 1 in Lilongwe. FDH Bank Plc and Ekhaya Group are the sponsors. Nigerian artist Ruger will come and perform too. Gwamba, whose real name is Duncan Zgambo, said he is ready to go ahead.
en.body_more:
The concert is called 'Landlord Pakwao' and will happen at Bingu National Stadium in Lilongwe. FDH Bank will set up payment machines and mobile banking at the stadium so people can use the bank's services. Ekhaya Group will sell food and drinks at the event.

Sheila Kanjo is the Marketing Manager at FDH Financial Holdings Limited. She said on Tuesday that the bank wants to help the music business grow in Malawi. She said the bank will give people safe and easy ways to pay with machines and mobile phones.

Gwamba said the help from both companies is very good. He said music is a business that needs help from big companies to work well. He asked people to come to the stadium and fill it up to make history. Other local musicians will also perform. These are Zeze Kingston, Miracle Chinga, Saint Realest, Kell Kay, Eli Njuchi, Joe Ikon, Lady Aika and Teddy Makadi.

Ruger was born Michael Adebayo Olayinka. He is from Nigeria. He became famous when he made the song 'Bounce' and signed with a big music company called Jonzing World in 2021. He said in a video that this is his first time to come and perform live in Malawi on August 1, 2026.

ny.title: Banki ya FDH ndi Ekhaya Group athandizira konsati yayikulu ya Gwamba
ny.body: Makampani awiri akuluakulu apereka ndalama zothandizira woimba Gwamba kuchita konsati yayikulu pa Ogasiti 1 ku Lilongwe. FDH Bank Plc ndi Ekhaya Group ndi omwe akuthandizira. Wojambula waku Nigeria Ruger abweranso kudzaimba. Gwamba, yemwe dzina lake lenileni ndi Duncan Zgambo, adati ali wokonzeka kupitiriza.
ny.body_more:
Konsatiyi imatchedwa 'Landlord Pakwao' ndipo idzachitikira ku Bingu National Stadium ku Lilongwe. FDH Bank idzakhazikitsa makina olipira ndi mabanki am'manja pabwalo lamasewera kuti anthu athe kugwiritsa ntchito ntchito za bankiyi. Ekhaya Group idzagulitsa chakudya ndi zakumwa pamwambowu.

Sheila Kanjo ndi Woyang'anira Malonda ku FDH Financial Holdings Limited. Iye adati Lachiwiri kuti bankiyi ikufuna kuthandiza bizinesi ya nyimbo kukula ku Malawi. Iye anati bankiyi idzapatsa anthu njira zotetezeka komanso zosavuta zolipira ndi makina ndi mafoni am'manja.

Gwamba adati thandizo kuchokera kumakampani onse awiri ndi labwino kwambiri. Iye anati nyimbo ndi bizinesi yomwe ikufunika thandizo kuchokera kumakampani akuluakulu kuti igwire ntchito bwino. Iye adapempha anthu kuti abwere ku bwalo lamasewera ndikudzaza kuti alembe mbiri. Oimba ena am'deralo nawonso adzaimba. Awa ndi Zeze Kingston, Miracle Chinga, Saint Realest, Kell Kay, Eli Njuchi, Joe Ikon, Lady Aika ndi Teddy Makadi.

Ruger anabadwa Michael Adebayo Olayinka. Iye ndi wochokera ku Nigeria. Iye anatchuka kwambiri pamene anapanga nyimbo yakuti 'Bounce' ndipo anasaina mgwirizano ndi kampani yayikulu ya nyimbo yotchedwa Jonzing World mu 2021. Ananena mu kanema kuti iyi ndi nthawi yake yoyamba kubwera kudzaimba pompopompo ku Malawi pa Ogasiti 1, 2026.

en.title: Malawi Scorchers arrive in Morocco for first Wafcon
en.body: Malawi's women's football team, the Scorchers, has arrived in Morocco for their first Women's Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon). The tournament runs from 26 July to 16 August. The team will play friendly matches before the competition starts. Malawi plays Nigeria on 28 July in their first group match.
en.body_more:
The Scorchers travelled to Rabat, Morocco, two weeks before the tournament for training and friendlies. They will play host nation Morocco on Thursday, 16 July in Rabat. Then they face Ghana on 23 July in Mohammedia. Head coach Lovemore Fazili said the team is ready. "Being our first appearance, the target is to get out of the group and then take it step by step," Fazili said.

Malawi are in Group C with Nigeria, Egypt and Zambia. Only the top two teams from each group will move forward to the quarterfinals. Nigeria are the defending champions. Malawi play Egypt on 1 August and Zambia on 5 August. All Group C matches are in Rabat. The Scorchers will get help from three new players. Chisomo Banda, Lyna James and Tendai Sani will join the team on 17 July. Vice-captain Temwa Chawinga will arrive on 20 July. She has not played for Malawi since February last year. Her experience is expected to help the team.

Analyst Charles Nyirenda said Malawi should keep hopes realistic. "Being the first time for the team, we shouldn't set our expectations too high. At least reaching the knockout phase would be a huge bonus," Nyirenda said. Analyst Anointed Kamsampha said the team has good players. "Most of our players are recognised as best players internationally," he said. "It will depend on how prepared they are mentally to compete against strong teams like Nigeria." Two Malawians won an all-expenses-paid trip to Morocco through a National Bank of Malawi promotion. Charles Msatiyenda and Donard Nyirenda were the winners. They will travel to support the Scorchers at the tournament.

ny.title: Malawi Scorchers yafika ku Morocco pa mpikisano woyamba wa Wafcon
ny.body: Gulu la mpira wa azimayi la Malawi, Scorchers, lafika ku Morocco pa mpikisano wawo woyamba wa Women's Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon). Mpikisanowu uyamba pa 26 Julayi mpaka 16 Ogasiti. Gululi lidzasewera masewera ochezeka mpikisano usanayambe. Malawi idzasewera ndi Nigeria pa 28 Julayi pamasewera awo oyamba a gulu.
ny.body_more:
A Scorchers adapita ku Rabat, Morocco, milungu iwiri mpikisano usanachitike kuti akachite masewera olimbitsa thupi komanso ochezeka. Adzasewera ndi dziko lokhala ndi alendo la Morocco Lachinayi, 16 Julayi ku Rabat. Kenako adzakumana ndi Ghana pa 23 Julayi ku Mohammedia. Mphunzitsi wamkulu Lovemore Fazili adati timuyi yakonzeka. "Popeza ndi koyamba kuwonekera, cholinga chathu ndikutuluka mu gululo kenako ndikupita patsogolo pang'onopang'ono," adatero Fazili.

Malawi ali mu Gulu C ndi Nigeria, Egypt ndi Zambia. Magulu awiri apamwamba okha kuchokera mu gulu lililonse ndi omwe adzapite patsogolo ku quarterfinals. Nigeria ndiye ngwazi yoteteza. Malawi idzasewera ndi Egypt pa 1 Ogasiti ndi Zambia pa 5 Ogasiti. Masewera onse a Gulu C ali ku Rabat. A Scorchers adzalandira thandizo kuchokera kwa osewera atatu atsopano. Chisomo Banda, Lyna James ndi Tendai Sani adzalowa nawo timuyi pa 17 Julayi. Wachiwiri kwa kaputeni Temwa Chawinga adzafika pa 20 Julayi. Sanasewere Malawi kuyambira February chaka chatha. Chidziwitso chake chikuyembekezeka kuthandiza timuyi.


Katswiri Charles Nyirenda anati Malawi iyenera kusunga ziyembekezo zenizeni. "Popeza ndi nthawi yoyamba ku timuyi, sitiyenera kuika ziyembekezo zathu pamwamba kwambiri. Kufika pa gawo lomaliza kungakhale bonasi yayikulu," adatero Nyirenda. Katswiri Anneth Kamsampha anati timuyi ili ndi osewera abwino. "Osewera athu ambiri amadziwika kuti ndi osewera abwino kwambiri padziko lonse lapansi," adatero. "Zidzadalira momwe alili okonzeka m'maganizo kuti apikisane ndi magulu amphamvu ngati Nigeria." Awiri aku Malawi adapambana ulendo wopita ku Morocco wolipira ndalama zonse kudzera mu promotion ya National Bank of Malawi. Charles Msatiyenda ndi Donard Nyirenda ndi omwe adapambana. Adzapita kukathandiza Scorchers pa mpikisanowu.

en.title: Argentina beats England 2-1 in World Cup semi-final
en.body: Argentina won 2-1 against England in a World Cup semi-final match on Tuesday night. The game was played at Atlanta Stadium in the United States. England scored first through Anthony Gordon in the 55th minute. But Argentina scored twice in the final minutes to win. Enzo Fernández scored in the 85th minute. Lautaro Martínez scored again in the 91st minute.
en.body_more:
The match was very close and tense from the start. The first 45 minutes had no goals. Both teams played careful football and made many fouls. Argentina had more of the ball, but England stayed organized and strong. Lisandro Martínez got a yellow card for Argentina early on.

When Anthony Gordon scored for England in the 55th minute, England looked strong. They defended well and kept Argentina away from goal. But Argentina is a team that never gives up. In the last 15 minutes, Argentina played faster and pushed their fullbacks higher up the pitch. They found more space to attack. Enzo Fernández arrived late to score the equal goal in the 85th minute. This gave Argentina hope and made the stadium very loud with Argentine fans cheering.

England tried hard to stop Argentina in the last few minutes. But they were tired after defending all game. In stoppage time, Lautaro Martínez scored the winning goal in the 91st minute. This made it 2-1 to Argentina. More yellow cards went to Cristian Romero and Rodrigo De Paul for Argentina, and to Elliot Anderson for England.

Argentina will now play Spain in the World Cup final on Sunday, July 19, 2026 at MetLife Stadium. Spain is the European champion and beat France to reach the final. If Argentina wins again, they will be the first team since Brazil in 1962 to win the World Cup two times in a row. England goes home with pride but also sadness at coming so close to the final.

ny.title: Argentina yagonjetsa England 2-1 mu semifinal ya World Cup
ny.body: Argentina idapambana 2-1 motsutsana ndi England pamasewera a semifinal a World Cup Lachiwiri usiku. Masewerawa adachitikira ku Atlanta Stadium ku United States. England idagoletsa chigoli choyamba kudzera mwa Anthony Gordon mu mphindi ya 55. Koma Argentina idagoletsa zigoli ziwiri mu mphindi yomaliza kuti ipambane. Enzo Fernández adagoletsa chigoli mu mphindi ya 85. Lautaro Martínez adagoletsanso chigoli mu mphindi ya 91.
ny.body_more:
Masewerowa anali pafupi kwambiri komanso ovuta kuyambira pachiyambi. Mphindi 45 zoyambirira sizinali ndi zigoli. Magulu onse awiri adasewera mpira mosamala ndipo adachita zolakwa zambiri. Argentina inali ndi mpira wambiri, koma England idakhazikika komanso yolimba. Lisandro Martínez adalandira khadi yachikasu kwa Argentina koyambirira.

Anthony Gordon atagoletsa chigoli cha England mu mphindi 55, England inkaoneka yolimba. Adateteza bwino ndipo adaletsa Argentina kuti isalowe m'goli. Koma Argentina ndi gulu lomwe silimataya mtima. Mphindi 15 zapitazi, Argentina idasewera mwachangu ndikukankhira osewera awo kumbuyo mmwamba. Adapeza malo ambiri oti awukire. Enzo Fernández adafika mochedwa kuti apeze chigoli chofanana mu mphindi 85. Izi zidapatsa Argentina chiyembekezo ndipo zidapangitsa bwalo lamasewera kukhala lodzaza ndi mawu ndi mafani aku Argentina akusangalala.

England idayesetsa kwambiri kuletsa Argentina mu mphindi zochepa zapitazi. Koma idatopa atateteza masewera onse. Mu nthawi yotseka, Lautaro Martínez adagoletsa chigoli chopambana mu mphindi 91. Izi zidapangitsa kuti Argentina igole 2-1. Makhadi ena achikasu adapita kwa Cristian Romero ndi Rodrigo De Paul aku Argentina, komanso kwa Elliot Anderson aku England.

Argentina tsopano idzasewera ndi Spain mu fainali ya World Cup Lamlungu, pa Julayi 19, 2026 ku MetLife Stadium. Spain ndiye ngwazi ya ku Europe ndipo idagonjetsa France kuti ifike kumapeto. Ngati Argentina ipambananso, idzakhala timu yoyamba kuyambira Brazil mu 1962 kupambana World Cup kawiri motsatizana. England ikupita kunyumba ndi kunyada komanso chisoni chifukwa choyandikira kwambiri fainali.

en.title: Business groups ask bank to cut borrowing costs
en.body: Malawi's private sector wants the Reserve Bank to lower interest rates to help businesses grow. A business group says cheaper loans will help companies invest and create jobs. The central bank cut rates from 26 percent to 24 percent in the first quarter of 2026. But it raised other fees in April to control money in the banking system.
en.body_more:
The Malawi Confederation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry (MCCCI) made the call in a report on the economy. They said the Reserve Bank of Malawi (RBM) should slowly reduce the policy rate. Inflation is falling, so lower rates are possible. But the RBM must watch money supply growth and outside risks.

In March 2026, the RBM Monetary Policy Committee cut the policy rate from 26 percent to 24 percent. This aimed to help private sector investment. However, in April, the RBM held the rate at 24 percent. It raised the Liquidity Reserve Requirement from 10 percent to 12 percent. This absorbs extra money in banks to stop inflation from rising again. The RBM spokesperson Boston Maliketi Banda said the tight policy keeps inflation under control. Inflation is still above the RBM's target.

Private sector credit stayed strong in the first quarter. Credit grew to 37.2 percent in March. This was less than 38.8 percent in February. But it was much more than 17.8 percent in March 2025. Economist Velli Nyirongo said high borrowing costs hurt businesses. Companies cannot invest, expand, or hire workers. Lower interest rates would help private sector activity grow, he said. This growth is needed for the economy to recover.

MCCCI's report shows the RBM is trying to balance two things. It wants to help the economy recover. But it also wants to stop inflation from coming back. Business leaders say the current policy may slow growth too much. They will watch the RBM's next decisions closely.

ny.title: Magulu amalonda apempha mabanki kuti achepetse ndalama zobwereka
ny.body: Makampani achinsinsi ku Malawi akufuna kuti Reserve Bank ichepetse chiwongola dzanja kuti mabizinesi akule. Gulu la mabizinesi likuti ngongole zotsika mtengo zithandiza makampani kuyika ndalama ndikupanga ntchito. Banki yayikulu idachepetsa chiwongola dzanja kuchoka pa 26 peresenti kufika pa 24 peresenti mu kotala yoyamba ya 2026. Koma idakweza ndalama zina mu Epulo kuti ilamulire ndalama m'mabanki.
ny.body_more:
Bungwe la Malawi Confederation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry (MCCCI) linapereka pempholi mu lipoti lonena za chuma. Iwo anati Reserve Bank of Malawi (RBM) iyenera kuchepetsa pang'onopang'ono chiwongola dzanja cha ndondomekoyi. Kukwera kwa mitengo kukutsika, kotero mitengo yotsika ndi yotheka. Koma RBM iyenera kuyang'anira kukula kwa ndalama zomwe zilipo komanso zoopsa zakunja.

Mu Marichi 2026, Komiti Yoona za Ndalama ya RBM inachepetsa chiwongola dzanja cha ndondomekoyi kuchoka pa 26 peresenti kufika pa 24 peresenti. Izi cholinga chake chinali kuthandiza ndalama za makampani achinsinsi. Komabe, mu Epulo, RBM inasunga chiwongola dzanjacho pa 24 peresenti. Inakweza Chifuniro cha Liquidity Reserve kuchokera pa 10 peresenti kufika pa 12 peresenti. Izi zimatengera ndalama zowonjezera m'mabanki kuti kukwera kwa mitengo kusakwerenso. Mneneri wa RBM Boston Maliketi Banda adati mfundo yolimbayi imapangitsa kuti kukwera kwa mitengo kukhale koyenera. Kukwera kwa mitengo kukupitirira cholinga cha RBM.

Ngongole za makampani achinsinsi zinakhalabe zolimba mu kotala loyamba. Ngongole inakula kufika pa 37.2 peresenti mu Marichi. Izi zinali zosakwana 38.8 peresenti mu February. Koma zinali zoposa 17.8 peresenti mu Marichi 2025. Katswiri wazachuma Velli Nyirongo adati ndalama zambiri zobwereka zimavulaza mabizinesi. Makampani sangaike ndalama, kukulitsa, kapena kulemba antchito ntchito. Chiwongola dzanja chotsika chingathandize kuti ntchito zamakampani azikula, adatero. Kukula kumeneku ndikofunikira kuti chuma chibwererenso.

Lipoti la MCCCI likuwonetsa kuti RBM ikuyesera kulinganiza zinthu ziwiri. Ikufuna kuthandiza chuma kuti chibwererenso. Koma ikufunanso kuletsa kukwera kwa mitengo ya zinthu kuti kusabwererenso. Atsogoleri a mabizinesi akuti mfundo zomwe zilipo pano zitha kuchepetsa kukula kwambiri. Adzayang'anira zisankho zotsatira za RBM mosamala.

en.title: Businessman tells MPs of delays to fertiliser plant
en.body: A businessman named Napoleon Dzombe told MPs on Wednesday about long delays to his fertiliser factory in Dowa. The factory has not been built because of slow approval. Dzombe said the delays hurt him and scared away other investors.
en.body_more:
Dzombe came before a joint parliamentary committee that looks at why the project was slow. He said he wanted to build the Mulalo Granular Fertiliser Production Factory to help Malawi get more fertiliser. But the government took too long to give approval.

Dzombe said the delays made him feel unwelcome in his own country. Banks stopped believing in the project. He had to pay K10 million to the Malawi Environment Protection Authority for an environmental check. This is a test to see if a factory will harm nature and people. Dzombe said these high costs and long waits stop investors from coming to Malawi. He also said he lost K500 million when a bus terminal project failed before. The 26-hectare land for the factory is his, he said. A title deed was given in 1979, but the paper was lost.

The Malawi Environment Protection Authority said it finished checking the factory plan and approved it. The director, Dr Wilfred Kadewa, said delays came because Dzombe did not answer questions about waste, safety, water, and pollution. Once he fixed these things, the board said yes to the project. The factory will be built near Kang'oma River.

ny.title: Wabizinesi akuuza aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo za kuchedwa kwa fakitale ya feteleza
ny.body: Munthu wamalonda dzina lake Napoleon Dzombe anauza aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo Lachitatu za kuchedwa kwa nthawi yayitali ku fakitale yake ya feteleza ku Dowa. Fakitaleyo sinamangidwe chifukwa chovomerezedwa pang'onopang'ono. Dzombe adati kuchedwako kunamupweteka komanso kuopseza amalonda ena.
ny.body_more:
Dzombe adafika pamaso pa komiti yogwirizana ya nyumba yamalamulo yomwe imayang'ana chifukwa chake ntchitoyi inali yochedwa. Anati akufuna kumanga fakitale yopanga feteleza ya Mulalo Granular kuti athandize Malawi kupeza feteleza wochulukirapo. Koma boma linatenga nthawi yayitali kuti livomereze.

Dzombe adati kuchedwa kumeneku kunamupangitsa kumva kuti sakulandiridwa m'dziko lake. Mabanki adasiya kukhulupirira ntchitoyi. Anayenera kulipira K10 miliyoni ku Malawi Environment Protection Authority kuti akafufuze zachilengedwe. Iyi ndi mayeso oti awone ngati fakitale ingavulaze chilengedwe ndi anthu. Dzombe adati ndalama zambirizi komanso kudikira kwa nthawi yayitali kumaletsa amalonda kubwera ku Malawi. Anatinso adataya K500 miliyoni pomwe ntchito yomanga basi idalephera kale. Malo a mahekitala 26 a fakitale ndi ake, adatero. Chikalata chovomerezeka chinaperekedwa mu 1979, koma pepalalo linatayika.

Malawi Environment Protection Authority adati adamaliza kuyang'ana mapulani a fakitale ndikuvomereza. Mtsogoleri, Dr Wilfred Kadewa, adati kuchedwa kunabwera chifukwa Dzombe sanayankhe mafunso okhudza zinyalala, chitetezo, madzi, ndi kuipitsidwa. Atakonza zinthuzi, bungweli linavomereza ntchitoyi. Fakitaleyi idzamangidwa pafupi ndi mtsinje wa Kang'oma.

en.title: Malawi learns from India's education plans
en.body: Malawi is learning from India's education changes. Education Minister Bright Msaka said this in Lilongwe on Tuesday. A meeting called Pre-FLEX brought together education leaders from Africa and India. They want to help children learn to read and do maths from an early age.
en.body_more:
Minister Msaka said every child must stay in school. He said Malawi has a big problem. Many children leave school between Standard 1 and Standard 8. "Every child should acquire the foundational skills needed to succeed in school and in life," Msaka said. He added that Africa and India face the same problems. Both have different languages, limited money, and big differences between cities and villages.

Sanjay Kumar is a former leader of India's education system. He said India made big changes in 2020. These changes brought young children into schools. India then started the NIPUN Bharat Mission. This mission helps all children learn to read and do maths by the end of Standard 3. Kumar said that in some Indian states, government schools now do better than private schools. This shows the changes are working.

Penelope Campbell works for UNICEF in Malawi. She said over 80 children in Africa cannot read a simple sentence or do basic maths by age 10. She said every country needs to spend more money on schools. The government, private companies, aid groups, and teacher training schools must all work together. The main Foundational Learning Exchange conference will happen in Lilongwe from 15 to 17 July 2026. At that meeting, African leaders will share ideas about how to teach children better.

ny.title: Malawi yaphunzira kuchokera ku mapulani a maphunziro a ku India
ny.body: Malawi ikuphunzira kuchokera ku kusintha kwa maphunziro ku India. Nduna ya zamaphunziro Bright Msaka adanena izi ku Lilongwe Lachiwiri. Msonkhano wotchedwa Pre-FLEX unasonkhanitsa atsogoleri a zamaphunziro ochokera ku Africa ndi India. Akufuna kuthandiza ana kuphunzira kuwerenga ndi kuchita masamu kuyambira ali aang'ono.
ny.body_more:
Nduna Msaka anati mwana aliyense ayenera kukhala kusukulu. Anati dziko la Malawi lili ndi vuto lalikulu. Ana ambiri amasiya sukulu pakati pa Standard 1 ndi Standard 8. "Mwana aliyense ayenera kukhala ndi luso loyambira lofunikira kuti apambane kusukulu komanso m'moyo," anatero Msaka. Anawonjezera kuti Africa ndi India akukumana ndi mavuto omwewo. Onse ali ndi zilankhulo zosiyana, ndalama zochepa, komanso kusiyana kwakukulu pakati pa mizinda ndi midzi.

Sanjay Kumar ndi mtsogoleri wakale wa maphunziro a ku India. Anati India idasintha kwambiri mu 2020. Kusintha kumeneku kunabweretsa ana aang'ono m'masukulu. Kenako India idayambitsa NIPUN Bharat Mission. Ntchitoyi imathandiza ana onse kuphunzira kuwerenga ndi kuchita masamu pofika kumapeto kwa Standard 3. Kumar anati m'maiko ena aku India, masukulu aboma tsopano akuchita bwino kuposa masukulu achinsinsi. Izi zikusonyeza kuti kusinthaku kukugwira ntchito.

Penelope Campbell amagwira ntchito ku UNICEF ku Malawi. Anati ana opitilira 80 ku Africa sangathe kuwerenga chiganizo chosavuta kapena kuchita masamu oyambira akafika zaka 10. Anati dziko lililonse liyenera kugwiritsa ntchito ndalama zambiri pamasukulu. Boma, makampani achinsinsi, magulu othandizira, ndi masukulu ophunzitsa aphunzitsi onse ayenera kugwira ntchito limodzi. Msonkhano waukulu wa Foundational Learning Exchange udzachitikira ku Lilongwe kuyambira pa 15 mpaka 17 Julayi 2026. Pamsonkhanowo, atsogoleri aku Africa adzagawana malingaliro amomwe angaphunzitsire ana bwino.

en.title: Opposition calls for police to protect Malawi's doctors
en.body: The Leader of the Opposition, Simplex Chithyola Banda, asked the government to give police protection to doctors. He spoke in Parliament about attacks on doctors. Malawi has only 600 doctors. Two female doctors were killed in Blantyre recently.
en.body_more:
Chithyola Banda said doctors are now in danger. He told Parliament that Malawi has 600 doctors total. Of these, 459 are general practitioners and 177 are specialists. This means one doctor must care for about 33,000 people. That is very few doctors for so many people.

Chithyola Banda asked the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Homeland Security to work together. He wanted police to protect doctors, especially in Blantyre. He warned that doctors may leave Malawi to find work in other countries if attacks continue. This would make the shortage of doctors even worse.

The Minister of Health and Sanitation, Madalitso Baloyi, said the government was sad about the killings. She said the ministry was working with the Ministry of Homeland Security. She also said she did not know if the killings were by chance or if doctors were the targets. The minister praised the police for moving fast on their investigations. However, she said giving each doctor a bodyguard would be very hard. She said this plan had not been formally given to her ministry. She also said the police do not have enough people to do this work.

In November 2025, armed robbers killed Victoria Bobe at her home in Blantyre. Victoria Bobe was a teacher of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Kamuzu University of Health Sciences. Last week, another doctor, Atughanile Chomo, was killed at her home in Blantyre. Atughanile Chomo worked at Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital.

ny.title: Otsutsa apempha apolisi kuti ateteze madokotala aku Malawi
ny.body: Mtsogoleri wa chipani chotsutsa, Simplex Chithyola Banda, adapempha boma kuti lipatse apolisi chitetezo kwa madokotala. Iye adalankhula m'Nyumba ya Malamulo za kuukira madokotala. Malawi ili ndi madokotala 600 okha. Madokotala awiri achikazi adaphedwa ku Blantyre posachedwapa.
ny.body_more:
Chithyola Banda anati madokotala tsopano ali pachiwopsezo. Adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti Malawi ili ndi madokotala 600 onse. Mwa awa, 459 ndi akatswiri azachipatala ndipo 177 ndi akatswiri. Izi zikutanthauza kuti dokotala m'modzi ayenera kusamalira anthu pafupifupi 33,000. Izi ndi madokotala ochepa kwambiri kwa anthu ambiri.

Chithyola Banda adapempha Unduna wa Zaumoyo ndi Unduna wa Zachitetezo cha M'dziko kuti agwire ntchito limodzi. Ankafuna apolisi kuti ateteze madokotala, makamaka ku Blantyre. Adachenjeza kuti madokotala angachoke ku Malawi kukafunafuna ntchito m'maiko ena ngati ziwopsezo zipitirira. Izi zipangitsa kuti kusowa kwa madokotala kuipireipire.

Nduna ya Zaumoyo ndi Ukhondo, Madalitso Baloyi, adati boma ladandaula ndi kupha anthu. Adati unduna ukugwira ntchito ndi Unduna wa Zachitetezo cha M'dziko. Adanenanso kuti sakudziwa ngati kupha anthu kumeneku kunachitika mwangozi kapena ngati madokotala anali cholinga chawo. Ndunayo idayamika apolisi chifukwa chochita kafukufuku wawo mwachangu. Komabe, adati kupatsa dokotala aliyense mlonda kungakhale kovuta kwambiri. Adati dongosololi silinaperekedwe mwalamulo ku unduna wake. Ananenanso kuti apolisi alibe anthu okwanira oti agwire ntchitoyi.

Mu Novembala 2025, achifwamba okhala ndi zida adapha Victoria Bobe kunyumba kwake ku Blantyre. Victoria Bobe anali mphunzitsi wa Obstetrics and Gynaecology ku Kamuzu University of Health Sciences. Sabata yatha, dokotala wina, Atughanile Chomo, adaphedwa kunyumba kwake ku Blantyre. Atughanile Chomo ankagwira ntchito ku Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital.

en.title: Jamaican reggae singer Fantan Mojah dies at age 49
en.body: Fantan Mojah, a top Jamaican reggae singer, has died at age 49. He passed away on Tuesday evening at the University Hospital of the West Indies in Kingston. His heart was very sick. He was just three weeks away from his 50th birthday.
en.body_more:
Fantan Mojah's real name was Owen Lennox Moncrieffe. He was born on 5 August 1976 in St. Elizabeth, Jamaica. He became famous in the early 2000s as a reggae singer. He signed with Downsound Records and released big hit songs. His song "Hungry" went to number one on the Jamaican music charts and stayed there for eight weeks. He also sang "Rast Got Soul". Fantan Mojah was a member of the Bobo Ashanti faith. He sang songs about God, Africa, and what is right and wrong. His music spoke to many people about faith and being strong.

Fantan Mojah once came to Malawi and sang to people there. Reggae fans in Malawi loved his music and his message. Many people still remember his time here. He was the father of at least five children. In July 2024, he got very sick in Martinique. He had trouble breathing and his chest hurt. Doctors said his heart was working at a very low level. By early 2025, he got better and began to tour in Europe again.

But just before his death, he was too weak to work hard. He was staying with friends in Portmore. He had a plan to sing at the Reggae Jam Festival in Germany. His visa papers for the trip were ready. But he died before he could go. His health got very bad very fast in the last days. He died from his heart problems.

ny.title: Woyimba wa reggae waku Jamaica, Fantan Mojah, wamwalira ali ndi zaka 49
ny.body: Fantan Mojah, woyimba nyimbo za reggae wotchuka ku Jamaica, wamwalira ali ndi zaka 49. Iye anamwalira Lachiwiri madzulo ku University Hospital of the West Indies ku Kingston. Mtima wake unali wopweteka kwambiri. Anali atatsala milungu itatu kuti akwanitse zaka 50.
ny.body_more:
Dzina lenileni la Fantan Mojah linali Owen Lennox Moncrieffe. Anabadwa pa 5 Ogasiti 1976 ku St. Elizabeth, Jamaica. Anatchuka kumayambiriro kwa zaka za m'ma 2000 monga woyimba wa reggae. Anasaina mgwirizano ndi Downsound Records ndipo anatulutsa nyimbo zodziwika bwino. Nyimbo yake ya "Hungry" inafika pa nambala wani pa ma chart a nyimbo za ku Jamaica ndipo anakhala kumeneko kwa milungu isanu ndi itatu. Anayimbanso "Rast Got Soul". Fantan Mojah anali membala wa chikhulupiriro cha Bobo Ashanti. Anayimba nyimbo zokhudza Mulungu, Africa, ndi chabwino ndi choipa. Nyimbo zake zinalankhula kwa anthu ambiri za chikhulupiriro ndi kukhala wolimba mtima.

Fantan Mojah nthawi ina anabwera ku Malawi ndipo anaimbira anthu kumeneko. Okonda Reggae ku Malawi ankakonda nyimbo zake ndi uthenga wake. Anthu ambiri amakumbukirabe nthawi yake kuno. Anali bambo wa ana osachepera asanu. Mu Julayi 2024, anadwala kwambiri ku Martinique. Anali ndi vuto lopuma ndipo chifuwa chake chinamupweteka. Madokotala anati mtima wake unkagwira ntchito mochepa kwambiri. Pofika kumayambiriro kwa 2025, anachira ndipo anayambanso kuyendera ku Europe.

Koma asanamwalire, anali wofooka kwambiri moti sakanatha kugwira ntchito mwakhama. Ankakhala ndi anzake ku Portmore. Anali ndi dongosolo loimba pa Chikondwerero cha Reggae Jam ku Germany. Mapepala ake a visa paulendo anali okonzeka. Koma anamwalira asanapite. Thanzi lake linaipa kwambiri m'masiku otsiriza. Anamwalira chifukwa cha matenda a mtima.

en.title: President names first mining minister, warns smugglers
en.body: President Arthur Peter Mutharika swore in Thoko Tembo as Malawi's first dedicated Minister of Mining on Tuesday at Kamuzu Palace in Lilongwe. The new ministry was split from the old Energy and Mining portfolio. Mutharika called mineral smugglers "traitors" and said the country must benefit from its mining resources.
en.body_more:
Mutharika said Malawi has many high-value minerals. These include rare earth, niobium, uranium, rutile, gold and graphite. He said mining is important for jobs and growth. But the country has not used these minerals well.

The President explained that past agreements with mining companies were unfair to Malawi. "We did not have the capacity to negotiate favourable agreements," he said. "Many agreements were one-sided and brought little or no benefit to Malawi." Mutharika promised that experts will now help negotiate better deals. He said investors must make profit, but Malawi must also benefit.

Mutharika warned Malawians who help smuggle minerals out of the country. "I consider such individuals traitors," he said. "People who are willing to sell Malawi for a few pieces of silver." He said some mineral cartels come from outside Malawi but work with local people. He urged all involved to stop or face consequences.

Tembo, the new minister, said he is committed to serve the nation with humility and dedication. Before this appointment, he was Deputy Minister of Agriculture, Irrigation and Water Development. Splitting mining from energy shows the government believes the sector needs focused attention and dedicated oversight.

ny.title: Purezidenti wasankha nduna yoyamba ya migodi, wachenjeza anthu ozembetsa zinthu mozemba
ny.body: Purezidenti Arthur Peter Mutharika adalumbira Thoko Tembo kukhala Nduna yoyamba yodzipereka ya Migodi ku Malawi Lachiwiri ku Nyumba yachifumu ya Kamuzu ku Lilongwe. Unduna watsopanowu wagawanika ndi ntchito zakale za Energy and Migodi. Mutharika adatcha ogulitsa miyala yamtengo wapatali kuti ndi "achiwembu" ndipo adati dzikolo liyenera kupindula ndi migodi yake.
ny.body_more:
Mutharika anati Malawi ili ndi miyala yambiri yamtengo wapatali. Izi zikuphatikizapo nthaka yosowa, niobium, uranium, rutile, golide ndi graphite. Anati migodi ndi yofunika kwambiri pa ntchito ndi kukula. Koma dzikolo silinagwiritse ntchito bwino miyala iyi.

Purezidenti anafotokoza kuti mapangano akale ndi makampani opanga migodi anali osalungama ku Malawi. "Sitinathe kukambirana mapangano abwino," adatero. "Mapangano ambiri anali ambali imodzi ndipo sanabweretse phindu lililonse ku Malawi." Mutharika analonjeza kuti akatswiri tsopano athandiza kukambirana mapangano abwino. Anati osunga ndalama ayenera kupeza phindu, koma Malawi iyeneranso kupindula.

Mutharika anachenjeza anthu aku Malawi omwe amathandiza kuchotsa miyala m'dzikolo mozemba. "Ndimaona anthu oterewa ngati opandukira," adatero. "Anthu omwe akufuna kugulitsa Malawi ndi ndalama zochepa zasiliva." Anati magulu ena a migodi amachokera kunja kwa Malawi koma amagwira ntchito ndi anthu am'deralo. Analimbikitsa onse omwe akukhudzidwa kuti asiye kapena akumane ndi zotsatirapo.

Tembo, nduna yatsopano, anati akudzipereka kutumikira dzikolo modzichepetsa komanso modzipereka. Asanasankhidwe, anali Wachiwiri kwa Nduna ya Zaulimi, Ulimi Wothirira ndi Chitukuko cha Madzi. Kugawa migodi ndi mphamvu kukusonyeza kuti boma likukhulupirira kuti gawoli likufunika chisamaliro chapadera komanso kuyang'aniridwa kodzipereka.

en.title: Court stops Mangochi East election. New poll ordered.
