en.body: Malawi's Supreme Court of Appeal nullified the September 16 2025 parliamentary election in Mangochi East Constituency yesterday. The court found many problems in how the election was run. The Democratic Progressive Party candidate Francesca Theula Masamba had won. Nine judges agreed to order a fresh election.
en.body_more:
Chief Justice Rizine Mzikamanda led the panel of nine judges. Two men, Jackson Allie Daud Mataka and Abubakar M'baya, asked the court to stop the election. Their lawyers Patrick Mpaka and Cassius Chidothe said the vote had irregularities. Irregularities means things that went wrong and were not fair.

Mpaka said two polling stations were joined into one station. He said 1,835 votes were on unsigned tally sheets. Tally sheets are papers that write down how many votes each person got. He also said the Malawi Electoral Commission did not answer some complaints from voters. Chidothe added that results from the two joined stations could not be put into the computer system at the main counting place. The commission admitted this was true. The system could only take 600 votes at one time.

The other side said some small problems happened, but they did not change who won the election. Lawrence Kapinda was the lawyer for the election commission. He said the two stations were joined because one station's leader did not come to work. He said joining the stations did not take votes away from any candidate. But the court disagreed. Justice Dorothy NyaKaunda Kamanga said the problems made the election not fair. The court decided a new election must happen in Mangochi East.

This is the second election the Supreme Court stopped this year. On April 28, the court also nullified the Balaka Mulunguzi Constituency election. That election had been won by Ireen Mambala. After the September 16 election, the court received 83 complaints about elections across Malawi.

ny.title: Khoti laletsa chisankho cha Mangochi East. Kafukufuku watsopano walamulidwa.
ny.body: Khoti Lalikulu la Apilo ku Malawi laletsa chisankho cha aphungu cha pa September 16 2025 ku Mangochi East Constituency dzulo. Khotilo lapeza mavuto ambiri pa momwe chisankhocho chinachitikira. Francesca Theula Masamba, yemwe ndi woyimira chipani cha Democratic Progressive Party, ndiye wapambana. Oweruza asanu ndi anayi adagwirizana kuti alamule chisankho chatsopano.
ny.body_more:
Woweruza Wamkulu Rizine Mzikamanda anatsogolera gulu la oweruza asanu ndi anayi. Amuna awiri, Jackson Allie Daud Mataka ndi Abubakar M'baya, anapempha khoti kuti liimitse chisankhocho. Maloya awo Patrick Mpaka ndi Cassius Chidothe anati votiyo inali ndi zolakwika. Zosalongosoka zikutanthauza kuti zinthu sizinayende bwino.

Mpaka anati malo awiri ovotera analumikizidwa kukhala siteshoni imodzi. Iye anati mavoti 1,835 anali pa mapepala osasainidwa. Mapepala a Tally ndi mapepala omwe amalemba kuchuluka kwa mavoti omwe munthu aliyense adapeza. Anatinso Malawi Electoral Commission sinayankhe madandaulo ena ochokera kwa ovota. Chidothe anawonjezera kuti zotsatira za malo awiri ovotera sizinayikidwe mu kompyuta pamalo owerengera anthu ambiri. Komitiyo inavomereza kuti izi zinali zoona. Dongosololi likhoza kutenga mavoti 600 nthawi imodzi.

Mbali inayo inati mavuto ang'onoang'ono anachitika, koma sanasinthe amene anapambana chisankhocho. Lawrence Kapinda anali loya wa komishoni yovotera. Anati malo awiriwa analumikizidwa chifukwa mtsogoleri wa siteshoni imodzi sanabwere kuntchito. Iye anati kulowa m'malo oimikapo magalimoto sikunachotse mavoti kwa wopikisana naye aliyense. Koma khotilo silinagwirizane nazo. Woweruza milandu Dorothy NyaKaunda Kamanga anati mavutowa apangitsa kuti chisankhocho chisachitike mwachilungamo. Khotilo linaganiza kuti chisankho chatsopano chiyenera kuchitika ku Mangochi East.

Ichi ndi chisankho chachiwiri chomwe Khoti Lalikulu linaletsa chaka chino. Pa Epulo 28, khotilo linathetsanso chisankho cha Balaka Mulunguzi Constituency. Chisankho chimenecho chinapambana ndi Ireen Mambala. Pambuyo pa chisankho cha Seputembala 16, khotilo linalandira madandaulo 83 okhudza zisankho ku Malawi konse.

en.title: Malawi businesses struggle with foreign currency shortage
en.body: Malawi's private sector faced a very difficult time in the first half of 2026. The Malawi Confederation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry (MCCCI) said that 88 out of 100 businesses named foreign currency shortage as their biggest problem. This was much worse than the year before, when 74 out of 100 businesses said the same thing.
en.body_more:
The shortage of foreign currency is money that Malawi needs from other countries. It stops businesses from bringing in raw materials, machines and other things they need to make goods. Because of this, many companies have made their work smaller and their costs have gone up.

The MCCCI report shows how much businesses are suffering. Only 12 out of 100 firms are working at full power. More than half, or 53 out of 100 businesses, are working at between 50 and 75 percent of what they could do. The worst part is that 35 out of 100 companies are making goods at less than half of their full power. When businesses work so slowly, they spend more money to make each item. This makes them earn less profit and lose power to compete with other countries.

Other big problems also hurt businesses. Tax charges went up sharply. In 2025, only 15 out of 100 businesses said taxes were high. Now, 38 out of 100 say the same. Fuel shortage also grew worse. In 2025, 11 out of 100 businesses had fuel problems. Now it is 27 out of 100. The good news is that rising prices went down. But many business leaders say that foreign currency shortage is the root cause of all these troubles.

Minister Simon Itaye said the government wants to stop money leaving the country in wrong ways. The long-term plan is to make more goods at home instead of buying from other countries, and to sell more goods to other countries. The Reserve Bank of Malawi said in May that it does not have enough foreign money to give to all the sectors that need it, like health and fuel.

ny.title: Mabizinesi aku Malawi akukumana ndi vuto la kusowa kwa ndalama zakunja
ny.body: Mabungwe achinsinsi ku Malawi adakumana ndi nthawi yovuta kwambiri mu theka loyamba la chaka cha 2026. Bungwe la Malawi Confederation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry (MCCCI) linati mabizinesi 88 mwa 100 adatchula kusowa kwa ndalama zakunja ngati vuto lawo lalikulu. Izi zinali zoyipa kwambiri kuposa chaka chatha, pomwe mabizinesi 74 mwa 100 adanenanso zomwezo.
ny.body_more:
Kusowa kwa ndalama zakunja ndi ndalama zomwe Malawi ikufuna kuchokera kumayiko ena. Zimaletsa mabizinesi kubweretsa zipangizo zopangira, makina ndi zinthu zina zomwe amafunikira popanga katundu. Chifukwa cha izi, makampani ambiri achepetsa ntchito yawo ndipo ndalama zawo zakwera.

Lipoti la MCCCI likuwonetsa momwe mabizinesi akuvutikira. Makampani 12 okha mwa 100 akugwira ntchito mokwanira. Oposa theka, kapena mabizinesi 53 mwa 100, akugwira ntchito pakati pa 50 ndi 75 peresenti ya zomwe angathe kuchita. Choyipa kwambiri ndichakuti makampani 35 mwa 100 amapanga katundu ndi mphamvu zosakwana theka la mphamvu zawo zonse. Mabizinesi akamagwira ntchito pang'onopang'ono, amagwiritsa ntchito ndalama zambiri popanga chinthu chilichonse. Izi zimapangitsa kuti apeze phindu lochepa ndikutaya mphamvu kuti apikisane ndi mayiko ena.

Mavuto ena akuluakulu amavulazanso mabizinesi. Misonkho inakwera kwambiri. Mu 2025, mabizinesi 15 okha mwa 100 adati misonkho inali yokwera. Tsopano, 38 mwa 100 akunena chimodzimodzi. Kusowa kwa mafuta nako kunakulanso. Mu 2025, mabizinesi 11 mwa 100 anali ndi mavuto a mafuta. Tsopano ndi 27 mwa 100. Nkhani yabwino ndi yakuti kukwera kwa mitengo kunatsika. Koma atsogoleri ambiri amalonda amati kusowa kwa ndalama zakunja ndiko komwe kumayambitsa mavuto onsewa.

Nduna Simon Itaye adati boma likufuna kuletsa ndalama kuchoka mdziko muno m'njira zolakwika. Dongosolo la nthawi yayitali ndikupanga katundu wambiri kunyumba m'malo mogula kuchokera kumayiko ena, ndikugulitsa katundu wambiri kumayiko ena. Banki Yaikulu ya Malawi idati mu Meyi kuti ilibe ndalama zokwanira zakunja zoti ipereke kumadera onse omwe akufunikira mafuta, monga zaumoyo ndi mafuta.

en.title: Court cancels DPP MP's election win in Mangochi East
en.body: Malawi's Supreme Court of Appeal has cancelled the election victory of Democratic Progressive Party MP Francesca Theula Masamba in Mangochi East Constituency. Nine judges, led by Chief Justice Rizine Mzikamanda, ruled that the September 2025 election had serious problems. The court found that voting officials made big mistakes that changed the result.
en.body_more:
Two challengers, Jackson Allie Daud Mataka and Abubakar Mbaya, took the case to the top court after the High Court upheld Masamba's win in February 2026. Their lawyers, Patrick Mpaka and Cassius Chidothe, told the judges that election officials had made many errors during the vote.

The lawyers said officials wrongly combined two separate polling centres into one. They also said election officials did not fix problems that people raised on the day of voting. These failures were serious and changed how people could vote fairly.

The nine judges agreed that these mistakes were big enough to throw doubt on the whole election result. They decided to cancel the result completely. The court ruling means a fresh election will now be held for the Mangochi East seat. This is a big blow to the ruling Democratic Progressive Party, which loses the MP seat in parliament.

The case shows that even when a lower court says a win is correct, people can still challenge it in the highest court. The new election in Mangochi East will be watched closely by all parties.

ny.title: Khothi Laletsa Kupambana kwa MP wa DPP ku Mangochi East
ny.body: Khoti Lalikulu la Apilo ku Malawi laletsa kupambana kwa chipani cha Democratic Progressive Party, Francesca Theula Masamba, pa chisankho ku Mangochi East Constituency. Oweruza asanu ndi anayi, motsogozedwa ndi Chief Justice Rizine Mzikamanda, adagamula kuti chisankho cha Seputembala 2025 chinali ndi mavuto akulu. Khotilo linapeza kuti akuluakulu ovota adachita zolakwa zazikulu zomwe zinasintha zotsatira zake.
ny.body_more:
Otsutsa awiri, Jackson Allie Daud Mataka ndi Abubakar Mbaya, adatengera nkhaniyi kukhothi lalikulu pambuyo poti Khothi Lalikulu lavomereza kupambana kwa Masamba mu February 2026. Maloya awo, Patrick Mpaka ndi Cassius Chidothe, adauza oweruza kuti akuluakulu a zisankho adachita zolakwika zambiri panthawi ya voti.

Maloya adati akuluakulu adaphatikiza molakwika malo awiri osiyana ovotera kukhala malo amodzi. Adanenanso kuti akuluakulu a zisankho sanakonze mavuto omwe anthu adayambitsa patsiku lovota. Kulephera kumeneku kunali kwakukulu ndipo kunasintha momwe anthu angavotere mwachilungamo.

Oweruza asanu ndi anayi adagwirizana kuti zolakwika izi zinali zazikulu mokwanira kupangitsa kukayikira zotsatira zonse za chisankho. Adaganiza zochotsa zotsatira zonse. Chigamulo cha khothi chikutanthauza kuti chisankho chatsopano chidzachitika tsopano pampando wa Mangochi East. Ichi ndi chiwopsezo chachikulu kwa chipani cholamula cha Democratic Progressive Party, chomwe chimataya mpando wa MP mu nyumba yamalamulo.

Mlanduwu ukuwonetsa kuti ngakhale khothi laling'ono litanena kuti kupambana ndikolondola, anthu amathabe kutsutsa kukhothi lalikulu. Chisankho chatsopano ku Mangochi East chidzayang'aniridwa ndi magulu onse.

en.title: Malawi netball team leaves for Commonwealth Games
en.body: The Malawi National Netball Team left Blantyre on Tuesday for Manchester, England. From there, they will travel to Glasgow, Scotland for the Commonwealth Games. The team will play friendly matches against New Zealand, England, Northern Ireland and Wales before the main event.
en.body_more:
Head Coach Deborah Fuller said the team is ready to play well. "This is a good chance to test ourselves against the best teams. We want to win matches and make Malawi proud," she said. The coach also said the team is getting ready for the African Cup in September. That cup is a way to qualify for the Netball World Cup.

Netball Association of Malawi President Vitumbiko Gubuduza said the Commonwealth Games is part of a bigger plan. "We want to see how the young players handle the pressure of big matches," he said. "We have young players who are finding their place in the team already."

Goal Shooter Stella Matelezi told the press that the players are happy and ready to play well. Wing Attacker Mphatso Banda is playing at her first Commonwealth Games. "We are new to this, but we will fight hard and try to win," she said. The Commonwealth Games run from July 23 to August 2. Coach Fuller said she will be happy if the team can climb from its number nine place in the world rankings.

ny.title: Timu ya mpira wa netiboli ya ku Malawi yapita ku masewera a Commonwealth
ny.body: Timu ya Malawi National Netball idachoka ku Blantyre Lachiwiri kupita ku Manchester, England. Kuchokera kumeneko, idzapita ku Glasgow, Scotland kukachita masewera a Commonwealth. Timuyi idzasewera masewera ochezeka ndi New Zealand, England, Northern Ireland ndi Wales masewerawa asanachitike.
ny.body_more:
Mphunzitsi Wamkulu Deborah Fuller anati timuyi yakonzeka kusewera bwino. "Iyi ndi mwayi wabwino wodziyesa tokha motsutsana ndi magulu abwino kwambiri. Tikufuna kupambana masewera ndikupangitsa Malawi kunyada," adatero. Mphunzitsiyo adatinso timuyi ikukonzekera mpikisano wa African Cup mu Seputembala. Chikho chimenecho ndi njira yoti iyenerere mpikisano wa Netball World Cup.

Purezidenti wa Netball Association of Malawi Vitumbiko Gubuduza adati Masewera a Commonwealth ndi gawo la dongosolo lalikulu. "Tikufuna kuwona momwe osewera achichepere angathanirane ndi kupsinjika kwa masewera akuluakulu," adatero. "Tili ndi osewera achichepere omwe akupeza kale malo awo mu timuyi."

Woponya zigoli Stella Matelezi adauza atolankhani kuti osewerawo ali okondwa komanso okonzeka kusewera bwino. Wosewera wa Wing Attacker Mphatso Banda akusewera pa Masewera ake oyamba a Commonwealth. "Ndife atsopano pa izi, koma tidzamenya nkhondo mwamphamvu ndikuyesera kupambana," adatero. Masewera a Commonwealth ayamba pa Julayi 23 mpaka Ogasiti 2. Mphunzitsi Fuller adati adzakhala okondwa ngati timuyi itha kukwera kuchokera pamalo ake asanu ndi anayi pamndandanda wapadziko lonse lapansi.

en.title: Parliament to inquiry into Malawi's learning crisis
en.body: Parliament will start an inquiry into why children are not learning basic skills. The commitment was made on Monday in Lilongwe. A policy brief called Are Our Children Learning? was launched at Parliament Building. Mutani Tambala chairs the Parliamentary Committee on Education, Science and Technology. He said Parliament will investigate why children fail to read and count well, even though more children now go to school.
en.body_more:
The policy brief was made by civil society groups and education partners. It shows a serious problem in Malawi's primary schools. While more children now go to school, only some learn basic skills. The report says only one out of five children can read with understanding. Only one out of eight children have basic numeracy skills. Only one out of three children finish primary school. The report also shows many children repeat grades and are too old for their class. In Standard One, about four out of ten learners repeat the year.

Beth Gum is a Senior Policy and Advocacy Adviser at the International Parliamentary Network for Education. She said Malawi got many children into school but this did not help them learn. "We made progress getting children into classrooms, but children are not learning skills they need," she said. Benedicto Kondowe leads the Civil Society Education Coalition. He said being in a classroom is not enough. "Access improved, but learning is still a problem," he said. The inquiry will give Parliament facts to help hold government responsible.

The policy brief says children who learn to read, write and count well earn much more money as adults. Women and their children gain the most from this. The policy brief tells the government to help teachers teach reading better. It says schools need good books and workbooks. It asks for foundational learning programmes in all communities. Members of Parliament from education, budget and social welfare committees went to the launch. This shows they agree that fixing the learning crisis needs work across all parts of government. Many organisations helped with the launch, including ActionAid Malawi, UNICEF, and the Local Education Group.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo Ifufuza za Vuto la Kuphunzira ku Malawi
ny.body: Nyumba Yamalamulo iyamba kufufuza chifukwa chake ana sakuphunzira maluso oyambira. Kudzipereka kumeneku kunaperekedwa Lolemba ku Lilongwe. Ndondomeko yachidule yotchedwa Kodi Ana Athu Akuphunzira? idayambitsidwa ku Nyumba Yamalamulo. Mutani Tambala ndiye mtsogoleri wa Komiti Yamalamulo Yokhudza Maphunziro, Sayansi ndi Ukadaulo. Iye anati Nyumba Yamalamulo idzafufuza chifukwa chake ana amalephera kuwerenga ndi kuwerengera bwino, ngakhale kuti ana ambiri tsopano amapita kusukulu.
ny.body_more:
Chidule cha mfundochi chinapangidwa ndi magulu a anthu wamba komanso mabungwe othandiza pa maphunziro. Chikusonyeza vuto lalikulu m'masukulu a pulayimale ku Malawi. Ngakhale kuti ana ambiri tsopano amapita kusukulu, ena okha ndi omwe amaphunzira luso loyambira. Lipotilo limati mwana mmodzi yekha mwa asanu ndi mmodzi ndi amene amatha kuwerenga ndi kumvetsetsa. Mwana mmodzi yekha mwa asanu ndi atatu ndi amene ali ndi luso lowerengera. Mwana mmodzi yekha mwa atatu amamaliza sukulu ya pulayimale. Lipotilo likuwonetsanso kuti ana ambiri amabwereza magiredi ndipo ndi okalamba kwambiri kuposa kalasi yawo. Mu Standard One, ophunzira pafupifupi anayi mwa khumi amabwereza chaka.

Beth Gum ndi Mlangizi Wamkulu wa Ndondomeko ndi Uphungu ku International Parliamentary Network for Education. Iye anati Malawi inalowetsa ana ambiri kusukulu koma izi sizinawathandize kuphunzira. "Tapita patsogolo kulowetsa ana m'makalasi, koma ana sakuphunzira maluso omwe amafunikira," adatero. Benedicto Kondowe akutsogolera Civil Society Education Coalition. Iye anati kukhala m'kalasi sikokwanira. "Kulowa m'kalasi kwakula, koma kuphunzira kudakali vuto," adatero. Kafukufukuyu adzapatsa Nyumba ya Malamulo mfundo zothandiza boma kukhala ndi udindo.

Chidule cha mfundochi chikuti ana omwe amaphunzira kuwerenga, kulemba ndi kuwerengera bwino amapeza ndalama zambiri akakula. Azimayi ndi ana awo amapindula kwambiri ndi izi. Ndondomekoyi imauza boma kuti lithandize aphunzitsi kuphunzitsa kuwerenga bwino. Imati masukulu amafunika mabuku abwino ndi mabuku ogwirira ntchito. Ikupempha mapulogalamu oyambira kuphunzira m'madera onse. Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo ochokera m'makomiti a maphunziro, bajeti ndi zachitukuko adapita ku mwambowu. Izi zikusonyeza kuti akuvomereza kuti kuthetsa vuto la kuphunzira kumafunika kugwira ntchito m'maboma onse. Mabungwe ambiri adathandizira pa mwambowu, kuphatikizapo ActionAid Malawi, UNICEF, ndi Local Education Group.

en.title: Woman begs mercy for husband jailed for blinding her
en.body: A man has been jailed for five years for attacking his wife and blinding her in one eye. Blackson Godfrey, 27, a bicycle taxi rider, was convicted at Balaka Second Grade Magistrate's Court. His wife, Catherine George, lost her left eye in the assault. Right after the sentence, Catherine ran to the judge and begged him to free her husband. The court had already closed.
en.body_more:
The attack happened on 9 June at Makoloje Village in Balaka District. Catherine asked her husband where he had spent the night the day before. This question started a fight. The fight turned violent. Catherine was hurt so badly that doctors had to remove her damaged eye. She did not tell the police about the attack. An organisation called WORLEC, which helps women and girls, found out what happened. WORLEC told the police. Then the police caught Godfrey.

In court, Godfrey said sorry for what he did. He asked for a lighter sentence. He told the judge that Catherine was pregnant with his child and that he had family to feed. But the State Prosecutor, Inspector Rodrick Kamuona, said the court must give him a hard punishment. He said Catherine had lost her eye forever. The judge, Second Grade Magistrate Peter Nkuzi, agreed. He gave Godfrey five years in prison with hard work.

After the judge gave the sentence, Catherine cried. She walked from where she was sitting to the judge's bench. She asked the judge to have mercy on her husband and let him go free. But the court had already finished. The judge would not listen. Godfrey lives in Makoloje Village under Traditional Authority Nkaya.

ny.title: Mkazi apempha chifundo kwa mwamuna wake chifukwa chomugwira maso
ny.body: Mwamuna wina watsekeredwa m'ndende zaka zisanu chifukwa choukira mkazi wake ndikumuchititsa khungu diso limodzi. Blackson Godfrey, wazaka 27, wokwera njinga ya taxi, adapezeka wolakwa ku Khothi la Balaka Second Grade Magistrate. Mkazi wake, Catherine George, adataya diso lake lakumanzere pa chiwembucho. Catherine atangomaliza chigamulo, adathamangira kwa woweruza milandu ndikumupempha kuti amasule mwamuna wake. Khothi linali litatseka kale.
ny.body_more:
Kuukiraku kunachitika pa 9 June ku Makoloje Village ku Balaka District. Catherine anafunsa mwamuna wake komwe anagona usiku womwewo. Funsoli linayambitsa ndewu. Ndewuyo inakhala yachiwawa kwambiri. Catherine anavulala kwambiri moti madokotala anayenera kuchotsa diso lake lowonongeka. Sanauze apolisi za kuukiraku. Bungwe lotchedwa WORLEC, lomwe limathandiza akazi ndi atsikana, linapeza zomwe zinachitika. WORLEC inauza apolisi. Kenako apolisi anagwira Godfrey.

M'khothi, Godfrey anapepesa chifukwa cha zomwe anachita. Anapempha chilango chocheperako. Anauza woweruza kuti Catherine anali ndi pakati pa mwana wake ndipo anali ndi banja loti adyetse. Koma Woyimira milandu wa Boma, Inspector Rodrick Kamuona, anati khothi liyenera kumupatsa chilango chokhwima. Anati Catherine anataya diso lake kwamuyaya. Woweruza milandu, Peter Nkuzi, anavomereza. Anapatsa Godfrey zaka zisanu m'ndende ndi ntchito yovuta.

Woweruza atapereka chigamulocho, Catherine analira. Anachoka pomwe anali atakhala kupita ku benchi ya woweruza milandu. Anapempha woweruza milandu kuti achitire chifundo mwamuna wake ndikumumasula. Koma khoti linali litamaliza kale. Woweruza sanamvere. Godfrey amakhala ku Mudzi wa Makoloje pansi pa ulamuliro wa Traditional Authority Nkaya.

en.title: Beam Trust gives aid to South Africa returnees
en.body: First Lady Gertrude Mutharika's Beautify Malawi Trust (Beam) gave food and goods worth K100 million to 1,000 Malawians who came back from South Africa. The handover was at Joyce Chitsulo Stadium in Mwanza. Items given included duvets, sugar, soap, soya pieces, orange juice and flour.
en.body_more:
Beam Trust chairperson Dingiswayo Jere said the First Lady wanted to help the returnees. He called the gift a safety net for people starting life again at home. Many returnees left South Africa with no things and no money, Jere said.

Abdul Bright spoke for the returnees and thanked the First Lady. He said the items came at the right time. The returnees are now rebuilding their lives, he said.

Chief Secretary to the Government Justin Saidi was at the event. He asked the returnees to stay in Malawi and use their skills to help the country grow. The government is working to help the returnees fit back into their towns and villages, Saidi said.

The Department of Disaster Management Affairs said 41,976 Malawians have come home from South Africa so far. But more Malawians are still there, said Dodma Commissioner Wilson Moleni. In South Africa, over 53,000 people, mostly Malawians, have been sent back to their home countries, South African officials said. Malawians left South Africa because of anti-immigrant operations that got worse in recent weeks.

ny.title: Beam Trust yathandiza anthu obwerera ku South Africa
ny.body: Bungwe la Beautify Malawi Trust (Beam) la Mayi Woyamba Gertrude Mutharika linapereka chakudya ndi katundu wa K100 miliyoni kwa anthu 1,000 aku Malawi omwe anabwerera kuchokera ku South Africa. Kuperekako kunali ku Joyce Chitsulo Stadium ku Mwanza. Zinthu zomwe zinaperekedwa zinali ma duvet, shuga, sopo, zidutswa za soya, madzi a lalanje ndi ufa.
ny.body_more:
Wapampando wa Beam Trust, Dingiswayo Jere, anati Mkazi Woyamba akufuna kuthandiza obwerera. Iye anati mphatsoyi ndi njira yotetezera anthu omwe akuyambanso moyo wawo kunyumba. Anthu ambiri obwerera anachoka ku South Africa opanda zinthu kapena ndalama, Jere adatero.

Abdul Bright analankhula m'malo mwa obwerera ndipo anayamikira Mkazi Woyamba. Anati zinthuzo zinafika panthawi yoyenera. Obwerera tsopano akumanganso miyoyo yawo, anatero.

Mlembi Wamkulu wa Boma, Justin Saidi, analipo pa mwambowu. Anapempha obwerera kuti akhale ku Malawi ndikugwiritsa ntchito luso lawo kuthandiza dzikolo kukula. Boma likugwira ntchito yothandiza obwerera kuti abwerere m'matauni ndi m'midzi yawo, anatero Saidi.

Dipatimenti Yoona za Masoka inati anthu 41,976 aku Malawi abwerera kwawo kuchokera ku South Africa mpaka pano. Koma anthu ambiri aku Malawi akadali komweko, anatero Commissioner wa Dodma Wilson Moleni. Ku South Africa, anthu opitilira 53,000, makamaka aku Malawi, atumizidwa kumayiko awo, akuluakulu a boma la South Africa adatero. Anthu aku Malawi adachoka ku South Africa chifukwa cha ntchito zotsutsana ndi anthu othawa kwawo zomwe zidayipa kwambiri m'masabata apitawa.

en.title: Henry Mussa made head of tourism training school
en.body: The government has appointed Henry Mussa as Executive Director of the Malawi Institute of Tourism. MIT is the main school for tourism and hotel workers in Malawi. The appointment starts on 7 July 2026. Acting director Kamwana Karim told staff about the decision.
en.body_more:
The Malawi Institute of Tourism teaches people about hospitality, tourism and travel work. It is the country's main public training place for these jobs. The MIT Board of Trustees approved Mussa's appointment.

Mussa was once a senior member of the Democratic Progressive Party. He also worked as information minister. He was convicted of abuse of office, which means he used his power in a wrong way. He went to prison for this crime. Later, former leader Lazarus Chakwera pardoned him. A pardon is when a leader forgives a crime and lets a person go free.

Many people in Malawi know Mussa by his popular name, "Mtengowaminga." He has stayed known and liked by many people even after his time in top politics ended. His new job at MIT is respectable work and gives him a salary. But it is not as powerful as the government positions he held before.

The government is now trying to grow the tourism sector. Tourism means when people visit a country. Tourism can make money for a country and help workers get jobs. The government says Malawi's tourism is not as big as it could be. Mussa's appointment comes at this time when the government wants to make tourism stronger.

ny.title: Henry Mussa adasankhidwa kukhala mkulu wa sukulu yophunzitsa zokopa alendo
ny.body: Boma lasankha Henry Mussa kukhala Mtsogoleri Wamkulu wa Malawi Institute of Tourism. MIT ndi sukulu yayikulu ya ogwira ntchito zokopa alendo ndi mahotela ku Malawi. Kusankhidwa kumeneku kumayamba pa 7 Julayi 2026. Woyang'anira wogwirizira Kamwana Karim adauza ogwira ntchito za chisankhocho.
ny.body_more:
Bungwe la Malawi Institute of Tourism limaphunzitsa anthu za kuchereza alendo, zokopa alendo, ndi ntchito zoyendera. Ndi malo ophunzitsira anthu ambiri mdziko muno ntchito zimenezi. Bungwe la MIT Board of Trustees linavomereza kusankhidwa kwa Mussa.

Mussa kale anali membala wamkulu wa chipani cha Democratic Progressive Party. Anagwiranso ntchito ngati nduna yofalitsa nkhani. Anapezeka ndi mlandu wogwiritsa ntchito molakwika udindo wake, zomwe zikutanthauza kuti anagwiritsa ntchito mphamvu zake molakwika. Anapita kundende chifukwa cha mlanduwu. Pambuyo pake, mtsogoleri wakale Lazarus Chakwera anamukhululukira. Chikhululukiro ndi pamene mtsogoleri akhululukira mlandu ndikulola munthu kupita mfulu.

Anthu ambiri ku Malawi amadziwa Mussa ndi dzina lake lodziwika bwino, "Mtengowaminga." Wakhala akudziwika ndi kukondedwa ndi anthu ambiri ngakhale nthawi yake mu ndale zapamwamba itatha. Ntchito yake yatsopano ku MIT ndi ntchito yolemekezeka ndipo imamupatsa malipiro. Koma si yamphamvu ngati maudindo aboma omwe anali nawo kale.

Boma tsopano likuyesera kukulitsa gawo la zokopa alendo. Zokopa alendo zikutanthauza pamene anthu akuyendera dziko. Zokopa alendo zimatha kupanga ndalama kudziko ndikuthandizira ogwira ntchito kupeza ntchito. Boma limati zokopa alendo ku Malawi si zazikulu monga momwe zingakhalire. Kusankhidwa kwa Mussa kukubwera panthawiyi pamene boma likufuna kulimbikitsa zokopa alendo.

en.title: MP asks why DPP members moved from old seats
en.body: A Member of Parliament asked a funny question in the National Assembly on Monday. Steven Baba Malondera from Lilongwe Nyanja asked why senior members of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) had moved to different seats. The DPP is the party that governs Malawi. His question made many MPs laugh.
en.body_more:
Malondera rose on a point of order after the House had dealt with other business. He first asked about work on a committee that looks at rare earth mining. Then he turned to the seating changes. He said one senior MP who used to sit in position two had moved to position nine. Malondera named George Chaponda as the member who moved. He said Chaponda is one of the most senior MPs and holds an important government job.

The question sparked amusement in the chamber. Malondera's remarks also raised bigger questions about the DPP's internal power structure. Some lawmakers wondered if the seating change showed that power was shifting inside the party. These shifts could matter ahead of the 2030 Local Government, Parliamentary and Presidential Elections. Elections are when people vote to choose who leads them and makes laws.

Jappie Mhango, the Leader of the House, responded to Malondera. He told MPs to stop spending time on what he called petty issues. Mhango said Parliament should focus on government business instead. He also said MPs should not come to the House intoxicated, or drunk. Mhango did not say that Malondera was drunk. He used the remark to stress that Parliament has limited time and should not waste it on matters that do not help the public.

ny.title: MP wafunsa chifukwa chake mamembala a DPP adachoka pamipando yakale
ny.body: Phungu wa Nyumba Yamalamulo adafunsa funso loseketsa ku Nyumba Yamalamulo Lolemba. Steven Baba Malondera wochokera ku Lilongwe Nyanja adafunsa chifukwa chake mamembala akuluakulu a chipani cha Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) adasamuka kukhala ndi mipando yosiyanasiyana. DPP ndi chipani chomwe chimalamulira Malawi. Funso lake linaseketsa aphungu ambiri.
ny.body_more:
Malondera anadzuka pa mfundo ya dongosolo Nyumba ya Malamulo itatha kuchita zinthu zina. Choyamba anafunsa za ntchito mu komiti yomwe imayang'ana za migodi ya nthaka yosowa. Kenako anayang'ana kusintha mipando. Anati MP wina wamkulu yemwe anali pa udindo wachiwiri anasamukira ku udindo wachisanu ndi chinayi. Malondera adatchula George Chaponda ngati membala amene anasamukira. Anati Chaponda ndi m'modzi mwa aphungu akuluakulu a nyumba yamalamulo ndipo ali ndi ntchito yofunika kwambiri m'boma.

Funsoli linayambitsa chisangalalo m'chipindamo. Mawu a Malondera adabweretsanso mafunso akuluakulu okhudza kapangidwe ka mphamvu zamkati mwa DPP. Aphungu ena adadzifunsa ngati kusintha mipando kukuwonetsa kuti mphamvu zikusintha mkati mwa chipani. Kusintha kumeneku kungakhale kofunika zisanachitike zisankho za Boma la M'deralo, Nyumba Yamalamulo ndi Purezidenti za 2030. Zisankho ndi pamene anthu amasankha kuti asankhe amene amawatsogolera ndikupanga malamulo.

Jappie Mhango, Mtsogoleri wa Nyumba ya Malamulo, anayankha Malondera. Adauza aphungu kuti asiye kugwiritsa ntchito nthawi pa zomwe adazitcha nkhani zazing'ono. Mhango adati Nyumba ya Malamulo iyenera kuyang'ana kwambiri pa nkhani za boma. Anatinso aphungu sayenera kubwera ku Nyumba ya Malamulo ali oledzera, kapena oledzera. Mhango sananene kuti Malondera anali woledzera. Anagwiritsa ntchito mawuwo potsindika kuti Nyumba Yamalamulo ili ndi nthawi yochepa ndipo siyenera kuiwononga pazinthu zomwe sizithandiza anthu.

en.title: Court stops ACB from dropping wildlife trafficker case
en.body: A judge at the High Court stopped the Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) from dropping a corruption case against Lin Yun Hua. Lin is a man convicted of selling animals illegally. Judge Redson Kapindu said the ACB's move was wrong. He said it was a waste of time and broke court rules.
en.body_more:
Lin Yun Hua is in prison for wildlife trafficking. This means he sold protected animals illegally. While he was held at Maula Prison in 2019, he is accused of trying to bribe prison officers. He allegedly offered K30 million to Aaron Ganyavu Kaunda, who worked at the prison. Lin also promised to finish building Kaunda's house. In return, Lin wanted help to get a lighter sentence from the judge in his earlier case.

The ACB asked the court to stop the case on 9 June 2026. The Director of Public Prosecutions, Fostino Maele, told the ACB to ask for this. Judge Kapindu rejected the request. He said the State already has the power to stop cases without asking the court. The judge said asking the court to do this was wrong. It was an abuse of the court's process. He also said it wasted time and money.

Lin has pleaded not guilty to all the charges against him. The trial started in May this year. Two prison officers have already given evidence. The judge said that trying to bribe judges or court workers is very serious. It damages trust in the courts. But he said Lin is still innocent until proven guilty. The Malawi Law Society has also criticised Director Maele for a conflict of interest. Maele was Lin's lawyer before he became Director of Public Prosecutions early this year.

The court's ruling means the trial will go ahead. The case against Lin will continue unless Maele uses his power to stop it officially.

ny.title: Khoti laletsa ACB kuti isachotse mlandu wokhudza kugulitsa nyama zakuthengo
ny.body: Woweruza milandu ku Khoti Lalikulu adaletsa bungwe lolimbana ndi ziphuphu (ACB) kuti lisachotse mlandu wa ziphuphu motsutsana ndi Lin Yun Hua. Lin ndi munthu wopezeka ndi mlandu wogulitsa nyama mosaloledwa. Woweruza milandu Redson Kapindu adati zomwe bungwe la ACB lachita zinali zolakwika. Iye anati ndi kuwononga nthawi komanso kuswa malamulo a khoti.
ny.body_more:
Lin Yun Hua ali m'ndende chifukwa chogulitsa nyama zakuthengo. Izi zikutanthauza kuti adagulitsa nyama zotetezedwa mopanda chilolezo. Pamene anali kundende ya Maula mu 2019, akuimbidwa mlandu woyesa kupereka ziphuphu kwa akuluakulu a ndende. Akuti adapereka K30 miliyoni kwa Aaron Ganyavu Kaunda, yemwe ankagwira ntchito kundendeko. Lin adalonjezanso kuti amalize kumanga nyumba ya Kaunda. Pobwezera, Lin amafuna thandizo kuti alandire chilango chocheperako kuchokera kwa woweruza mlandu wake wakale.

ACB adapempha khothi kuti liyimitse mlanduwu pa 9 June 2026. Mtsogoleri wa milandu ya anthu, Fostino Maele, adauza ACB kuti ipemphe izi. Woweruza Kapindu adakana pempholi. Adati Boma lili kale ndi mphamvu zoletsa milandu popanda kupempha khothi. Woweruza adati kupempha khothi kuti lichite izi kunali kolakwika. Kunali kugwiritsa ntchito molakwika njira ya khothi. Adanenanso kuti kuwononga nthawi ndi ndalama.

Lin wakana milandu yonse yomwe adamuneneza. Mlanduwu unayamba mu Meyi chaka chino. Akuluakulu awiri a ndende apereka kale umboni. Woweruza adati kuyesa kupereka ziphuphu kwa oweruza kapena ogwira ntchito kukhothi ndi nkhani yaikulu kwambiri. Zikuwononga chidaliro m'makhothi. Koma adati Lin akadali wosalakwa mpaka atapezeka wolakwa. Bungwe la Malawi Law Society ladzudzulanso Director Maele chifukwa cha kusamvana kwa chidwi. Maele anali loya wa Lin asanakhale Director of Public Prosecutions koyambirira kwa chaka chino.

Chigamulo cha khothi chikutanthauza kuti mlanduwu upitirira. Mlandu wotsutsana ndi Lin upitirira pokhapokha Maele atagwiritsa ntchito mphamvu zake kuti awuletse mwalamulo.

en.title: Minister Gangata speaks in Parliament on Monday
en.body: Minister of Youth, Sports and Culture Alfred Gangata spoke in Parliament on Monday. MPs laughed and cheered when he stood up to speak. The Speaker asked if he wanted to say more about his papers. Gangata said no. He sent the matter to the Legal Affairs Committee instead.
en.body_more:
When it was time for ministers to answer questions, the Speaker called on Gangata again. Blantyre City Michiru-Chirimba MP Lasken Vinyo Vigaro had asked about building a sports place in his area. Gangata said the government has given some work to district councils. He told MPs to work with their councils to plan new sports places. His ministry would help them.

Other MPs also asked about sports. Mzimba South MP Emmanuel Chambulanyina Jere asked when Mbelwa Stadium would open. The stadium is almost done but still closed. Karonga Lufilya MP Abraham Mwakhwawa asked for Karonga Stadium to get proper stands. Lilongwe City Kamphuno MP Khadija Leah Chunga asked for help for young people in Chinsapo. Gangata said he would take note of all these things and talk to people about what to do next.

The Speaker said Gangata is "a man of few words but more action." This matches how many people see him. Outside Parliament, Gangata gets warm greetings from ordinary people at rallies and community meetings. He is known for connecting with people and bringing them together. His work in sports, especially football, helps him reach young people and communities. Football brings Malawians together from all backgrounds.

ny.title: Nduna Gangata akulankhula ku Nyumba Yamalamulo Lolemba
ny.body: Nduna ya Achinyamata, Masewera ndi Chikhalidwe Alfred Gangata adalankhula mu Nyumba Yamalamulo Lolemba. Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo adaseka ndikusangalala pamene adayimirira kuti alankhule. Sipika adamufunsa ngati akufuna kunena zambiri za mapepala ake. Gangata adati ayi. M'malo mwake adatumiza nkhaniyi ku Komiti Yoona za Zamalamulo.
ny.body_more:
Nthawi itakwana yoti nduna ziyankhe mafunso, Sipikala adayimbiranso Gangata. MP wa Blantyre City Michiru-Chirimba, Lasken Vinyo Vigaro, adafunsa za kumanga malo ochitira masewera m'dera lake. Gangata adati boma lapereka ntchito zina ku makhonsolo a zigawo. Adauza aphungu kuti agwire ntchito ndi makhonsolo awo kuti akonze malo atsopano amasewera. Unduna wake udzawathandiza.

Aphungu ena adafunsanso za masewera. MP wa ku Mzimba South, Emmanuel Chambulanyina Jere, adafunsa kuti bwalo la Mbelwa lidzatsegulidwa liti. Bwaloli latsala pang'ono kutha koma likadali lotsekedwa. MP wa ku Karonga Lufilya, Abraham Mwakhwawa, adapempha kuti bwalo la Karonga likhale ndi malo oyenera. MP wa ku Lilongwe City Kamphuno, Khadija Leah Chunga, adapempha thandizo kwa achinyamata ku Chinsapo. Gangata adati adzakumbukira zonsezi ndikukambirana ndi anthu za zomwe angachite.

Sipikala adati Gangata ndi "munthu wolankhula pang'ono koma wochitapo kanthu." Izi zikugwirizana ndi kuchuluka kwa anthu omwe amamuwona. Kunja kwa Nyumba Yamalamulo, Gangata amalandira moni wachikondi kuchokera kwa anthu wamba pamisonkhano ndi misonkhano ya anthu ammudzi. Amadziwika kuti amalumikizana ndi anthu komanso kuwagwirizanitsa. Ntchito yake pamasewera, makamaka mpira, imamuthandiza kufikira achinyamata ndi madera osiyanasiyana. Mpira umasonkhanitsa anthu ochokera m'mitundu yonse.

en.title: Malawi inflation much higher than other African countries
en.body: Malawi's inflation is much higher than other countries in Africa. In May, Malawi's inflation was 23.4 percent. Other countries have much lower inflation. Reserve Bank Deputy Governor Kisu Simwaka says Malawi needs help from the government to bring inflation down.
en.body_more:
Malawi's inflation came down a little bit in May. It was 24.3 percent in April, then it fell to 23.4 percent in May. Food prices went down from 19.1 percent to 17.6 percent. Non-food prices went down from 33.2 percent to 33.0 percent. But Malawi is still much worse than other countries.

Zambia has inflation of 6.6 percent. Tanzania has 4.2 percent. Rwanda has 12.9 percent. Angola has 10.9 percent. Mozambique has 7.2 percent. Botswana has 10.7 percent. South Africa has 4.5 percent. Malawi's 23.4 percent is much higher than all of them.

Simwaka says Malawi cannot fix inflation with interest rates alone. The country needs to fix deeper problems. Malawi does not have enough foreign money. When the kwacha loses value, prices go up fast. Malawi buys too many things from other countries — fuel, medicine, food, and fertiliser. The country also needs better farms. Rain makes Malawi's food prices go up and down. If there is no rain, food becomes very expensive. Zambia and Tanzania grow more food because they have better irrigation. Irrigation is when water is brought to farms by pipes and channels.

Simwaka also says the government borrows too much money. This makes it hard for the Reserve Bank to fight inflation. The government must collect more taxes and spend less money. People and businesses now expect prices to go up. So they ask for more money and charge more. This makes inflation worse. Simwaka says all government offices and the Reserve Bank must work together to bring inflation down.

ny.title: Kukwera kwa mitengo ya zinthu ku Malawi kwakwera kwambiri kuposa mayiko ena aku Africa.
ny.body: Kukwera kwa mitengo ku Malawi kuli kokwera kwambiri kuposa mayiko ena ku Africa. Mu Meyi, kukwera kwa mitengo ku Malawi kunali 23.4 peresenti. Mayiko ena ali ndi kukwera kwa mitengo kotsika kwambiri. Wachiwiri kwa Bwanamkubwa wa Reserve Bank Kisu Simwaka akuti Malawi ikufunika thandizo kuchokera ku boma kuti ichepetse kukwera kwa mitengo.
ny.body_more:
Kukwera kwa mitengo ku Malawi kunatsika pang'ono mu Meyi. Kunali 24.3 peresenti mu Epulo, kenako kunatsika kufika pa 23.4 peresenti mu Meyi. Mitengo ya chakudya inatsika kuchoka pa 19.1 peresenti kufika pa 17.6 peresenti. Mitengo yosakhala ya chakudya inatsika kuchoka pa 33.2 peresenti kufika pa 33.0 peresenti. Koma Malawi ikadali yoipa kwambiri kuposa mayiko ena.

Zambia ili ndi kukwera kwa mitengo kwa 6.6 peresenti. Tanzania ili ndi 4.2 peresenti. Rwanda ili ndi 12.9 peresenti. Angola ili ndi 10.9 peresenti. Mozambique ili ndi 7.2 peresenti. Botswana ili ndi 10.7 peresenti. South Africa ili ndi 4.5 peresenti. 23.4 peresenti ya Malawi ndi yokwera kwambiri kuposa onse.

Simwaka akunena kuti Malawi singathe kukonza kukwera kwa mitengo ndi chiwongola dzanja chokha. Dzikoli liyenera kukonza mavuto akuluakulu. Malawi ilibe ndalama zokwanira zakunja. Pamene kwacha itaya mtengo, mitengo imakwera mofulumira. Malawi imagula zinthu zambiri kuchokera kumayiko ena - mafuta, mankhwala, chakudya, ndi feteleza. Dzikoli likusowanso minda yabwino. Mvula imapangitsa kuti mitengo ya chakudya ku Malawi ikwere ndi kutsika. Ngati mvula siigwa, chakudya chimakhala chokwera mtengo kwambiri. Zambia ndi Tanzania zimalima chakudya chochuluka chifukwa zimakhala ndi ulimi wothirira wabwino. Kuthirira ndi pamene madzi amabweretsedwa m'minda ndi mapaipi ndi ngalande.

Simwaka akunenanso kuti boma limabwereka ndalama zambiri. Izi zimapangitsa kuti Reserve Bank ikhale yovuta kulimbana ndi kukwera kwa mitengo. Boma liyenera kusonkhanitsa misonkho yambiri ndikugwiritsa ntchito ndalama zochepa. Anthu ndi mabizinesi tsopano akuyembekeza kuti mitengo ikwere. Chifukwa chake amapempha ndalama zambiri ndikulipiritsa ndalama zambiri. Izi zimapangitsa kuti kukwera kwa mitengo kukwere. Simwaka akunena kuti maofesi onse aboma ndi Reserve Bank ayenera kugwira ntchito limodzi kuti achepetse kukwera kwa mitengo.

en.title: Mangochi checks CDF projects as delays worry MPs
en.body: The Malawi Economic Justice Network met with Mangochi District and town leaders to check projects planned under the new Constituency Development Fund. The fund gives K5 billion to each of Malawi's 225 constituencies. Parliament approved this in March 2024. The meeting checked health posts, roads, schools and markets that Mangochi plans to build.
en.body_more:
Mangochi District Council wants to upgrade Chapola Health Post to a health centre. The council also plans to build Nswanthaka Road, construct Chiunjiza Secondary School, build a fence at Jalasi Health Centre, construct Kanyenga Dispensary and upgrade Monkey Bay Market. Mangochi Municipal Council wants to renovate the town hall, upgrade the stadium, build a modern bus depot and improve the town's drainage system.

Mike Banda is the Malawi Economic Justice Network coordinator for the Southern Region. He said the meeting was good because it was the first time communities could check CDF projects under the new system. Banda said communities had different views on which projects were most important and how much they would cost. Banda worried that time was moving fast. More than four months had passed since Parliament approved the budget in March, he said.

Newton Munthali is the chief planning officer at Mangochi District Council. He said the council had started looking for building contractors to do the work. Fortune Msukwa is the director of planning at Mangochi Municipal Council. He said the municipality was ready to start its projects. However, one Member of Parliament, Sylvester Ayuba James, said the government does not have enough money to pay K5 billion per constituency. He asked the government to be honest about what it can afford. Ayuba James said the government should reduce the amount to K2 billion or K3 billion if that is what it can pay. The government has only released K7.5 billion nationwide so far, which is far less than the K1.125 trillion needed to fund all constituencies at K5 billion each.

ny.title: Mangochi akuyang'ana mapulojekiti a CDF chifukwa cha kuchedwa kwa nkhawa kwa aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo
ny.body: Bungwe la Malawi Economic Justice Network linakumana ndi atsogoleri a Chigawo cha Mangochi ndi mizinda kuti aone mapulojekiti omwe akukonzekera pansi pa Ndalama Zatsopano Zothandizira Kukula kwa Madera. Ndalamayi imapereka K5 biliyoni ku madera onse 225 aku Malawi. Nyumba Yamalamulo idavomereza izi mu Marichi 2024. Msonkhanowu udayang'ana malo azaumoyo, misewu, masukulu ndi misika yomwe Mangochi ikukonzekera kumanga.
ny.body_more:
Khonsolo ya Chigawo cha Mangochi ikufuna kukweza Chapola Health Post kukhala malo azaumoyo. Khonsolo ikukonzekeranso kumanga msewu wa Nswanthaka, kumanga sukulu ya sekondale ya Chiunjiza, kumanga mpanda ku Jalasi Health Centre, kumanga malo osungiramo zinthu zakale a Kanyenga ndikusintha msika wa Monkey Bay. Khonsolo ya Municipal ya Mangochi ikufuna kukonzanso holo ya tawuni, kukonza bwalo lamasewera, kumanga malo osungira mabasi amakono ndikukonza njira zotulutsira madzi mtawuniyi.

Mike Banda ndi wogwirizanitsa Malawi Economic Justice Network ku Southern Region. Anati msonkhanowu unali wabwino chifukwa unali nthawi yoyamba kuti madera azitha kuyang'ana mapulojekiti a CDF pansi pa dongosolo latsopanoli. Banda adati madera anali ndi malingaliro osiyanasiyana pa mapulojekiti omwe anali ofunikira kwambiri komanso ndalama zomwe angawononge. Banda akuda nkhawa kuti nthawi ikuyenda mwachangu. Miyezi yoposa inayi yapita kuyambira pomwe Nyumba Yamalamulo idavomereza bajeti mu Marichi, adatero.

Newton Munthali ndiye mkulu woyang'anira mapulani ku Khonsolo ya Chigawo cha Mangochi. Anati khonsolo yayamba kufunafuna makontrakitala omanga kuti agwire ntchitoyo. Fortune Msukwa ndiye director wa mapulani ku Khonsolo ya Municipal ya Mangochi. Anati boma linali lokonzeka kuyambitsa mapulojekiti ake. Komabe, m'modzi mwa aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo, Sylvester Ayuba James, anati boma lilibe ndalama zokwanira kulipira K5 biliyoni pa dera lililonse. Anapempha boma kuti likhale loona mtima pa zomwe lingakwanitse. Ayuba James anati boma liyenera kuchepetsa ndalamazo kufika pa K2 biliyoni kapena K3 biliyoni ngati ndi zomwe lingathe kulipira. Boma latulutsa K7.5 biliyoni yokha mdziko lonse mpaka pano, zomwe ndi zochepa kwambiri poyerekeza ndi K1.125 trillion yomwe ikufunika kuti ipereke ndalama kumadera onse pa K5 biliyoni iliyonse.

en.title: Wanderers and Karonga reach Airtel Top 8 semi-finals
en.body: Karonga United beat Silver Stadium 3-0 on Sunday to win their quarterfinal tie. Mighty Wanderers drew 1-1 with Creck Sporting Club. Both teams now go to the semi-finals. Karonga and Wanderers join Ekhaya FC and Blue Eagles FC in the last four.
en.body_more:
At Karonga Stadium, Silver came into the match with a 2-0 lead from the first game. But Karonga scored three times in the second half to win 3-2 on total goals. Lennox Kiwambe scored twice, in the 61st and 83rd minutes. Godfrey Sibale also scored in the 68th minute. Kiwambe was named Player of the Match.

Karonga United assistant coach Christopher Chinkwita said after the game: "This is a great win for us. The boys fought hard. We are happy to have a chance to win this cup again." But Silver coach Peter Mgangira said the referee made bad choices. "The referee helped Karonga win," he said. "Many of his choices were wrong."

At Aubrey Dimba Stadium in Mchinji, Mighty Wanderers had a 2-0 lead before the match began. Creck Sporting scored first through Ramadhan Mtafu in the 14th minute. Wanderers' striker Sama Thierry Tanjong scored with a bicycle kick in the 55th minute to make it 1-1. This gave Wanderers a 3-1 win on total goals. Coach Bob Mpinganjira said: "This was one of our hardest games. We are very happy to be in the semi-finals."

The four semi-final teams are Karonga United, Mighty Wanderers, Ekhaya FC, and Blue Eagles FC. Ekhaya and Blue Eagles beat FCB Nyasa Bullets and Civil Service United in earlier matches. This is Season 9 of the Airtel Top 8 cup. Silver Stadium won the cup in 2017.

ny.title: Wanderers ndi Karonga afika mu semi-finals ya Airtel Top 8
ny.body: Karonga United yagonjetsa Silver Stadium 3-0 Lamlungu kuti ipambane mpikisano wawo wa kotala fainali. Mighty Wanderers yagwirizana 1-1 ndi Creck Sporting Club. Magulu onse awiri tsopano akupita ku semi-finals. Karonga ndi Wanderers alowa nawo Ekhaya FC ndi Blue Eagles FC m'magawo anayi omaliza.
ny.body_more:
Pa Karonga Stadium, Silver idalowa mumasewerawa ndi chitsogozo cha 2-0 kuchokera pamasewera oyamba. Koma Karonga adagoletsa katatu mu theka lachiwiri kuti apambane 3-2 pa zigoli zonse. Lennox Kiwambe adagoletsa kawiri, mu mphindi ya 61 ndi 83. Godfrey Sibale adagoletsanso mu mphindi ya 68. Kiwambe adasankhidwa kukhala Wosewera wa Masewera.

Mphunzitsi wothandizira wa Karonga United, Christopher Chinkwita, adati masewerawa atatha: "Uku ndi kupambana kwakukulu kwa ife. Anyamata adalimbana mwamphamvu. Tikusangalala kukhala ndi mwayi wopambana chikhochi kachiwiri." Koma mphunzitsi wa Silver, Peter Mgangira, adati woweruza adasankha molakwika. "Woweruza adathandiza Karonga kupambana," adatero. "Zosankha zake zambiri zinali zolakwika."

Pa Aubrey Dimba Stadium ku Mchinji, Mighty Wanderers idatsogola 2-0 masewerawa asanayambe. Creck Sporting idagoletsa koyamba kudzera mwa Ramadhan Mtafu mu mphindi ya 14. Wosewera wa Wanderers, Sama Thierry Tanjong, adagoletsa chigoli ndi njinga mu mphindi ya 55 zomwe zidapangitsa kuti zigoli zonse zikhale 1-1. Izi zidapatsa Wanderers chigonjetso cha 3-1 pa zigoli zonse. Mphunzitsi Bob Mpinganjira adati: "Uwu unali umodzi mwa masewera athu ovuta kwambiri. Tikusangalala kwambiri kukhala mu semi-finals."

Magulu anayi a semi-finals ndi Karonga United, Mighty Wanderers, Ekhaya FC, ndi Blue Eagles FC. Ekhaya ndi Blue Eagles adagonjetsa FCB Nyasa Bullets ndi Civil Service United pamasewera oyambirira. Iyi ndi nyengo 9 ya Airtel Top 8 cup. Silver Stadium idapambana chikho mu 2017.

en.title: Aid groups say Malawi High Commission fails refugees in South Africa
en.body: Groups that help people say Malawi's High Commission in Pretoria is treating Malawians badly. These Malawians ran away from attacks on foreigners in South Africa. The groups say over 100 people sleep in a cold basement with no beds, blankets or food. They sent a letter on July 4, 2026 to the High Commissioner, Stella Ndau.
en.body_more:
The letter says many Malawians come to the High Commission every day seeking safety. Men, women, old people and babies have arrived. The High Commission lets them stay on the grounds but does not give them warm rooms or proper care. They sleep on hard, bare concrete. Over 100 people share one toilet. The air is not clean. Many people are getting upper respiratory infections — sickness that makes it hard to breathe.

The groups say these bad conditions are dangerous. Old people and babies can get pneumonia and hypothermia — sickness from the cold. The groups are asking the High Commission to give the Malawians warm rooms inside, more toilets that work, blankets, mattresses, blankets and heating. They also want a doctor to help the sick people.

After the letter was sent, aid workers met with High Commissioner Stella Ndau on Wednesday. Mariam Jooma Carikci, who was there, said the High Commissioner told them the High Commission does not have money to house people inside. She said the mission can only give buses to take people back to Malawi. Ndau did not answer questions from news reporters. Charles Nkhalamba, who speaks for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, also did not answer questions.

By Wednesday, 38,094 Malawians had been sent back home from South Africa. Five people died on the journey. One more person died at Mwanza District Hospital after coming home. The problems in South Africa began because of anti-immigrant marches. The March and March Movement says it will march every Thursday to tell foreigners to leave.

ny.title: Mabungwe othandiza ati bungwe la Malawi High Commission lalephera kupulumutsa anthu othawa kwawo ku South Africa
ny.body: Magulu omwe amathandiza anthu akuti Bungwe Lalikulu la Malawi ku Pretoria likuchitira nkhanza anthu aku Malawi. Anthu aku Malawi awa athawa kuukiridwa ndi alendo ku South Africa. Maguluwa akuti anthu opitilira 100 amagona m'chipinda chozizira chopanda mabedi, mabulangeti kapena chakudya. Anatumiza kalata pa Julayi 4, 2026 kwa Komiseri Wamkulu, Stella Ndau.
ny.body_more:
Kalatayo ikunena kuti anthu ambiri aku Malawi amabwera ku High Commission tsiku lililonse kufunafuna chitetezo. Amuna, akazi, okalamba ndi makanda afika. High Commission imawalola kukhala pabwalo koma siwapatsa zipinda zofunda kapena chisamaliro choyenera. Amagona pa konkire yolimba, yopanda kanthu. Anthu opitilira 100 amagawana chimbudzi chimodzi. Mpweya si woyera. Anthu ambiri akudwala matenda opatsirana m'mapapo apamwamba - matenda omwe amachititsa kuti zikhale zovuta kupuma.

Maguluwa akuti mavuto oipawa ndi oopsa. Okalamba ndi makanda amatha kutenga chibayo ndi hypothermia - matenda ochokera ku chimfine. Maguluwa akupempha High Commission kuti ipatse a Malawi zipinda zofunda mkati, zimbudzi zambiri zomwe zimagwira ntchito, mabulangete, matiresi, mabulangete ndi zotenthetsera. Akufunanso dokotala woti athandize odwala.

Kalatayo itatumizidwa, ogwira ntchito zothandizira anakumana ndi High Commissioner Stella Ndau Lachitatu. Mariam Jooma Carikci, yemwe analipo, adati High Commissioner adawauza kuti High Commission ilibe ndalama zosungira anthu mkati. Iye adati ntchitoyo imangopereka mabasi oti atenge anthu kubwerera ku Malawi. Ndau sanayankhe mafunso ochokera kwa atolankhani. Charles Nkhalamba, yemwe amalankhula mu Unduna wa Zachilendo, nayenso sanayankhe mafunso.

Pofika Lachitatu, anthu 38,094 aku Malawi anali atabwezedwa kwawo kuchokera ku South Africa. Anthu asanu anamwalira paulendowo. Munthu winanso mmodzi anamwalira ku Chipatala cha Mwanza District atabwerera kwawo. Mavuto ku South Africa anayamba chifukwa cha ziwonetsero zotsutsana ndi anthu othawa kwawo. Bungwe la March and March Movement likunena kuti liziwonetsa ziwonetsero Lachinayi lililonse kuti liuze alendo kuti achoke.

en.title: Ekhaya beats Big Bullets to reach cup semi-finals
en.body: Ekhaya FC knocked out FCB Nyasa Big Bullets on Saturday. The match was at Mpira Stadium in Blantyre. They drew 1-1 in normal time. Ekhaya won 7-6 on penalty kicks. This was a big shock. Big Bullets are one of Malawi's strongest teams. Ekhaya will now play in the semi-finals of the Airtel Top 8 Trophy.
en.body_more:
Allen Chihana scored for Ekhaya in the 44th minute. Big Bullets answered back in the 59th minute. Peter Banda scored to make it 1-1. No more goals came in normal time. The match went to penalties.

In the shootout, both teams scored many times. But some players missed. Yamikani Mologeni and Ephraim Kondowe hit the post for Big Bullets. Alfred Chizinga and Peter Banda also missed their shots. Chimwemwe Chunga then scored the last penalty for Ekhaya. This gave Ekhaya the win 7-6.

Ekhaya coach Enos Chatama said his team played well. He said they followed his orders. He said they were calm and strong. Big Bullets coach Wedson Nyirenda said his team made mistakes. He said they had many chances early on. He said poor shooting cost them the game. Big Bullets have won the Airtel Top 8 four times before. They won in 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2025. But this year they are out.

Blue Eagles also reached the semi-finals. They drew 1-1 with Civil Service United in Lilongwe. Blue Eagles won because of away goals. This means one team scores more goals in the other team's stadium. Civil Service coach Emmanuel Zoya said his team played hard. He said they did their best but lost anyway.

ny.title: Ekhaya yagonjetsa Big Bullets kuti ifike mu semi-finals ya chikho
ny.body: Ekhaya FC idagonjetsa FCB Nyasa Big Bullets Loweruka. Masewerawa adachitikira ku Mpira Stadium ku Blantyre. Adafanana 1-1 munthawi yanthawi zonse. Ekhaya idapambana 7-6 pa ma penalty kicks. Izi zidadabwitsa kwambiri. Big Bullets ndi imodzi mwa magulu amphamvu kwambiri ku Malawi. Ekhaya tsopano idzasewera mu semi-finals ya Airtel Top 8 Trophy.
ny.body_more:
Allen Chihana adagoletsa chigoli cha Ekhaya mu mphindi ya 44. Big Bullets adayankhanso mu mphindi ya 59. Peter Banda adagoletsa chigoli kuti zigoli zifike 1-1. Palibe zigoli zina zomwe zidabwera nthawi yanthawi zonse. Masewerawa adapita ku ma penalty.

Mu kuwomberana, magulu onse awiri adagoletsa kangapo. Koma osewera ena adaphonya. Yamikani Mologeni ndi Ephraim Kondowe adagunda positi ya Big Bullets. Alfred Chizinga ndi Peter Banda nawonso adaphonya zigoli zawo. Chimwemwe Chunga kenako adagoletsa chigoli chomaliza cha Ekhaya. Izi zidapatsa Ekhaya chigonjetso cha 7-6.

Mphunzitsi wa Ekhaya Enos Chatama adati timu yake idasewera bwino. Adati idatsatira malamulo ake. Adati anali bata komanso olimba. Mphunzitsi wa Big Bullets Wedson Nyirenda adati timu yake idalakwitsa. Adati adapeza mipata yambiri koyambirira. Adati kuwombera koyipa kudawawonongera masewerawa. Big Bullets yapambana Airtel Top 8 kanayi kale. Adapambana mu 2021, 2023, 2024 ndi 2025. Koma chaka chino atuluka.

Blue Eagles idafikanso mu semi-finals. Adasewera 1-1 ndi Civil Service United ku Lilongwe. Blue Eagles idapambana chifukwa cha zigoli zakunja. Izi zikutanthauza kuti timu imodzi yapeza zigoli zambiri mu bwalo lamasewera la timu ina. Mphunzitsi wa Civil Service Emmanuel Zoya adati timu yake idasewera molimbika. Anati adachita zonse zomwe angathe koma adatayabe.

en.title: Mpinganjira will not run for FAM president
en.body: William Mpinganjira, the president of Ekhaya FC, says he will not contest for the Football Association of Malawi (FAM) presidency. FAM is an organisation that runs football in Malawi. His name has been linked to the FAM top job ahead of next year's vote. Ekhaya FC made the statement on 20 June 2026.
en.body_more:
Mpinganjira's announcement comes after a Southern Region Football Association official told local news that FAM president Fleetwood Haiya had mentioned Mpinganjira as a possible candidate. Haiya said that although Mpinganjira has money, he does not have the same experience and is not firm on the ground. The FAM will hold its election meeting in December next year.

Ekhaya FC's chief executive officer Thando Mhango signed a statement saying the club's board and leaders want to assure all supporters, partners, and sponsors that Mpinganjira will not run for FAM president. The statement, dated 20 June 2026, says: "We wish to formally and unequivocally state that the club president will not be contesting for this position."

Mhango added that Mpinganjira's focus is to make Ekhaya FC strong and successful in continental football. "The club is at a pivotal stage that requires his full attention, energy and commitment," the statement said. This means Mpinganjira wants to lead his club to become a power in African football competitions instead of taking on the FAM role. The announcement clears up weeks of talk about whether Mpinganjira would run against Haiya in the December 2026 FAM elections.

ny.title: Mpinganjira sadzapikisana nawo pa chisankho cha pulezidenti wa FAM
ny.body: William Mpinganjira, purezidenti wa Ekhaya FC, akuti sadzapikisana nawo paudindo wa upulezidenti wa Football Association of Malawi (FAM). FAM ndi bungwe lomwe limayendetsa mpira ku Malawi. Dzina lake lakhala likugwirizanitsidwa ndi udindo wapamwamba wa FAM voti isanakwane chaka chamawa. Ekhaya FC idanena izi pa 20 June 2026.
ny.body_more:
Kulengeza kwa Mpinganjira kwabwera pambuyo poti mkulu wa bungwe la mpira wa ku Southern Region adauza atolankhani akumaloko kuti purezidenti wa FAM, Fleetwood Haiya, adatchula Mpinganjira ngati wopikisana naye. Haiya adati ngakhale Mpinganjira ali ndi ndalama, alibe chidziwitso chofanana ndipo sali wolimba mtima pagulu. FAM idzachita msonkhano wawo wosankha mu Disembala chaka chamawa.

Mkulu wa bungwe la Ekhaya FC, Thando Mhango, adasaina chikalata chonena kuti bungwe la oyang'anira ndi atsogoleri a kilabu akufuna kutsimikizira othandizira onse, ogwirizana nawo, ndi othandizira kuti Mpinganjira sadzapikisana paudindo wa purezidenti wa FAM. Chikalatacho, cha pa 20 June 2026, chimati: "Tikufuna kunena mwalamulo komanso mosapita m'mbali kuti purezidenti wa kilabu sadzapikisana paudindowu."

Mhango adawonjezera kuti cholinga cha Mpinganjira ndikupangitsa Ekhaya FC kukhala yolimba komanso yopambana mu mpira wa ku continental. "Kalabu ili pagawo lofunika kwambiri lomwe limafuna chidwi chake chonse, mphamvu zake, ndi kudzipereka kwake," chikalatacho chidatero. Izi zikutanthauza kuti Mpinganjira akufuna kutsogolera kilabu yake kuti ikhale yamphamvu m'mipikisano ya mpira wa ku Africa m'malo motenga udindo wa FAM. Kulengeza kumeneku kwathetsa nkhani ya milungu ingapo yokhudza ngati Mpinganjira angapikisane ndi Haiya pa chisankho cha FAM cha mu Disembala 2026.

en.title: Masters FC say no deal yet with striker Khuda Muyaba
en.body: Masters FC says it has not agreed a deal with striker Khuda Muyaba. On Thursday, Muyaba posted on Facebook that he was joining the Lilongwe team. But the club chief executive Kevin Moyo said on Friday: formalities are not done yet.
en.body_more:
Muyaba last played for Scotland FC, a team in Zimbabwe. He scored one goal before Scotland FC let him go at the end of last season. Two weeks ago, Muyaba posted a photo of Masters coach Peter Mponda on Facebook. He wrote: "See you boss, tigwire ntchito." This made people think he would join Masters.

Muyaba is 32 years old. In 2019, he won the best scorer award in Malawi's top league. He scored 21 goals that year. After that, he moved to Polokwane City, a team in South Africa's second league. He then joined Tishreen, a team in Syria, in 2023. Next, he played for Richards Bay in South Africa's top league for a short time.

In 2024, Muyaba played for a team called Malan in Jordan. Then he joined Venda FC in South Africa's second league. From there, he moved to Scotland FC in Zimbabwe. Now Masters FC says it is waiting. Kevin Moyo said: "He is in Lilongwe, but we are waiting for formalities. Until that is done, we cannot confirm the deal." The club has not yet said if the move will happen.

ny.title: Masters FC yati palibe mgwirizano ndi wosewera mpira Khuda Muyaba
ny.body: Masters FC yati sinagwirizane ndi wosewera mpira Khuda Muyaba. Lachinayi, Muyaba adalemba pa Facebook kuti akulowa nawo timu ya Lilongwe. Koma mkulu wa timuyi Kevin Moyo adati Lachisanu: malamulo sanakwaniritsidwebe.
ny.body_more:
Muyaba adasewera komaliza ku Scotland FC, timu ya ku Zimbabwe. Adagoletsa chigoli chimodzi Scotland FC isanamulole kupita kumapeto kwa nyengo yatha. Masabata awiri apitawo, Muyaba adayika chithunzi cha mphunzitsi wa Masters Peter Mponda pa Facebook. Adalemba kuti: "Tikuwonani bwana, tigwire ntchito." Izi zidapangitsa anthu kuganiza kuti adzalowa nawo Masters.

Muyaba ali ndi zaka 32. Mu 2019, adapambana mphoto ya wogoletsa zigoli wabwino kwambiri mu ligi yayikulu ya Malawi. Adagoletsa zigoli 21 chaka chimenecho. Pambuyo pake, adasamukira ku Polokwane City, timu yomwe ili mu ligi yachiwiri ya South Africa. Kenako adalowa nawo Tishreen, timu ya ku Syria, mu 2023. Kenako, adasewera ku Richards Bay mu ligi yayikulu ya South Africa kwa kanthawi kochepa.

Mu 2024, Muyaba adasewera timu yotchedwa Malan ku Jordan. Kenako adalowa nawo Venda FC mu ligi yachiwiri ya South Africa. Kuchokera pamenepo, adasamukira ku Scotland FC ku Zimbabwe. Tsopano Masters FC ikunena kuti ikudikira. Kevin Moyo anati: "Ali ku Lilongwe, koma tikudikira kuti zinthu zichitike. Mpaka zimenezi zitachitika, sitingatsimikizire mgwirizanowu." Kalabuyo sinanenebe ngati kusamukako kudzachitika.

en.title: Bank gives K20 million to teach clergy about investing
en.body: National Bank of Malawi (NBM) plc gave K20 million to help teach clergy members about stock market investing. The Minority Shareholders Association of Listed Companies (MISALICO) will run the programme in Mzuzu in August. The plan is to help clergy guide their communities on how to invest money and grow wealth.
en.body_more:
NBM plc Head of Legal and Company Secretary Zunzo Mitole gave the money during a ceremony in Blantyre on Friday. She said the bank believes investing in the stock market is a good way to save and grow money. "We want more people to understand that investing in shares is possible and that it can bring long-term financial benefits," Mitole said.

Frank Harawa, Secretary General of MISALICO, received the money on behalf of the group. He said many Malawians do not know how the stock market works, even though the Malawi Stock Exchange has been running for many years. "That is why we introduced these financial literacy programmes, to bridge this knowledge gap," Harawa said. The group chose clergy because they have strong influence in their communities and can teach many people about money and investing.

MISALICO has already run financial literacy programmes for young people and women in Zomba, Blantyre and Lilongwe. The Clergy Financial Literacy Programme will teach clergy about equity investments. Equity investments are shares in companies that people can buy to own a small part of the business. Once clergy learn about this, they can help their church members and communities make better choices with their money.

ny.title: Banki yapereka K20 miliyoni kuti iphunzitse atsogoleri achipembedzo za ndalama zomwe zayikidwa
ny.body: Banki ya National Bank of Malawi (NBM) plc yapereka K20 miliyoni kuti ithandize kuphunzitsa mamembala achipembedzo za kuyika ndalama pamsika wamasheya. Bungwe la Minority Shareholders Association of Listed Companies (MISALICO) lidzayendetsa pulogalamuyi ku Mzuzu mu Ogasiti. Dongosololi ndi lothandiza atsogoleri achipembedzo kutsogolera madera awo momwe angayikitsire ndalama ndikukulitsa chuma.
ny.body_more:
Mkulu wa Zamalamulo ndi Mlembi wa Kampani ya NBM plc, Zunzo Mitole, anapereka ndalamazo pa mwambo ku Blantyre Lachisanu. Iye anati bankiyo ikukhulupirira kuti kuyika ndalama pamsika wamasheya ndi njira yabwino yosungira ndikukulitsa ndalama. "Tikufuna kuti anthu ambiri amvetsetse kuti kuyika ndalama mu magawo n'kotheka ndipo kungabweretse phindu la ndalama kwa nthawi yayitali," adatero Mitole.

Frank Harawa, Mlembi Wamkulu wa MISALICO, adalandira ndalamazo m'malo mwa gululo. Iye anati anthu ambiri aku Malawi sakudziwa momwe msika wamasheya umagwirira ntchito, ngakhale kuti Malawi Stock Exchange yakhala ikugwira ntchito kwa zaka zambiri. "Ndicho chifukwa chake tidayambitsa mapulogalamu ophunzirira zachuma awa, kuti tithetse kusiyana kwa chidziwitso," adatero Harawa. Gululo linasankha atsogoleri achipembedzo chifukwa ali ndi mphamvu kwambiri m'madera awo ndipo amatha kuphunzitsa anthu ambiri za ndalama ndi ndalama.

MISALICO yayendetsa kale mapulogalamu ophunzirira zachuma kwa achinyamata ndi akazi ku Zomba, Blantyre ndi Lilongwe. Pulogalamu Yophunzitsa Zachuma ya Ansembe idzaphunzitsa atsogoleri achipembedzo za ndalama zogulitsa magawo. Kuyika ndalama mu magawo ndi magawo m'makampani omwe anthu angagule kuti akhale ndi gawo laling'ono la bizinesiyo. Abusa akadziwa izi, angathandize mamembala a tchalitchi chawo ndi madera awo kusankha bwino ndalama zawo.

en.title: Malawi Vice-President Jane Ansah joins global women leaders' council
en.body: Malawi's Vice-President Dr Jane Ansah has joined the Presidents Advisory Council of G100. G100 is a global network of women leaders from different sectors. It focuses on gender equality and women in leadership. Ansah is only the second woman to serve as Malawi's vice-president. She brings more than four decades of experience in law and public service.
en.body_more:
The council includes some of the world's most powerful women. Members are Judith Suminwa Tuluka, Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic of Congo. Rosalía Arteaga Serrano, a former president of Ecuador, is also on the council. Iveta Radičová, Slovakia's first female prime minister, serves alongside them. Oleksandra Matviichuk, a Ukrainian human rights lawyer, is another member. Her organisation won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2022. First ladies from Italy and Zimbabwe also sit on the council.

G100 is chaired by Dr Harbeen Arora Rai. The network brings together 100 women leaders from many sectors. It operates through chapters in different countries. Male supporters, called HeForShe champions, help the network's work. The Presidents Advisory Council guides G100's global plan and promotes women in government and business worldwide.

Ansah was born in Lilongwe in 1955. She studied law at Chancellor College, University of Malawi. She finished her studies in 1978. She later earned a master's degree in international human rights. In 2002, she earned a doctorate from the University of Nottingham. In 1997, she became a High Court judge. In 2006, she became Malawi's first female Attorney General. She held this post for seven years until 2013. She then returned to work as a Justice of Appeal at the Supreme Court of Appeal. She retired in 2020. Ansah also chaired the Malawi Electoral Commission. She led the Electoral Commissions Forum of the Southern African Development Community. She has written books about human rights and legal development. She serves as national overseer of Christ Citadel International Church.

Ansah became vice-president in October 2025. She ran as running mate to President Arthur Peter Mutharika of the Democratic Progressive Party. The general election was held on 16 September. This appointment to G100 shows growing recognition of African women in global leadership roles.

ny.title: Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti wa Malawi Jane Ansah walowa nawo m'bungwe la atsogoleri a akazi padziko lonse lapansi
ny.body: Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti wa Malawi, Dr. Jane Ansah, walowa nawo mu Bungwe Lolangiza la Apulezidenti la G100. G100 ndi gulu la akazi ochokera m'magawo osiyanasiyana padziko lonse lapansi. Limayang'ana kwambiri pa kufanana pakati pa amuna ndi akazi komanso utsogoleri wa akazi. Ansah ndi mkazi wachiwiri yekha kukhala wachiwiri kwa purezidenti wa Malawi. Ali ndi zaka zoposa makumi anayi akudziwa bwino za malamulo ndi ntchito za boma.
ny.body_more:
Bungweli lili ndi akazi ena amphamvu kwambiri padziko lonse lapansi. Mamembala ake ndi Judith Suminwa Tuluka, Nduna Yaikulu ya Democratic Republic of Congo. Rosalía Arteaga Serrano, yemwe kale anali purezidenti wa Ecuador, nayenso ali m'bungweli. Iveta Radičová, nduna yoyamba yachikazi ku Slovakia, amagwira nawo ntchito limodzi. Oleksandra Matviichuk, loya wa ufulu wachibadwidwe ku Ukraine, ndi membala wina. Bungwe lake linapambana Mphoto ya Mtendere ya Nobel mu 2022. Azimayi oyamba ochokera ku Italy ndi Zimbabwe nawonso ali m'bungweli.

G100 ikutsogozedwa ndi Dr Harbeen Arora Rai. Netiwekiyi imabweretsa pamodzi atsogoleri akazi 100 ochokera m'magawo osiyanasiyana. Imagwira ntchito m'magawo osiyanasiyana m'maiko osiyanasiyana. Othandizira amuna, otchedwa HeForShe champions, amathandiza ntchito ya netiwekiyi. Bungwe Lolangiza la Purezidenti limatsogolera dongosolo la G100 padziko lonse lapansi ndikulimbikitsa akazi m'boma ndi mabizinesi padziko lonse lapansi.

Ansah anabadwira ku Lilongwe mu 1955. Anaphunzira zamalamulo ku Chancellor College, University of Malawi. Anamaliza maphunziro ake mu 1978. Pambuyo pake adapeza digiri ya masters mu ufulu wachibadwidwe wapadziko lonse. Mu 2002, adapeza digiri ya udokotala kuchokera ku University of Nottingham. Mu 1997, adakhala woweruza wa Khothi Lalikulu. Mu 2006, adakhala Loya Wamkulu wachikazi woyamba ku Malawi. Anagwira ntchito imeneyi kwa zaka zisanu ndi ziwiri mpaka 2013. Kenako adabwerera kuntchito ngati Woweruza wa Apilo ku Khothi Lalikulu la Apilo. Anapuma pantchito mu 2020. Ansah adatsogoleranso Malawi Electoral Commission. Anatsogolera Electoral Commissions Forum of the Southern African Development Community. Walemba mabuku okhudza ufulu wachibadwidwe ndi chitukuko cha malamulo. Amatumikira monga woyang'anira dziko lonse wa Christ Citadel International Church.

Ansah adakhala wachiwiri kwa purezidenti mu Okutobala 2025. Anapikisana ngati woyimira mnzake wa Purezidenti Arthur Peter Mutharika wa Democratic Progressive Party. Chisankho chachikulu chinachitika pa 16 Seputembala. Kusankhidwa kumeneku ku G100 kukuwonetsa kudziwika kwakukulu kwa akazi aku Africa pantchito za utsogoleri padziko lonse lapansi.

en.title: Defence challenges video in Bobe murder trial
en.body: A defence lawyer questioned police video evidence in the murder trial of doctor Victoria Bobe. Assistant Superintendent Christopher Pangeti answered questions in High Court in Blantyre on Friday. The defence said the accused were threatened and not told they were being recorded.
en.body_more:
Defence lawyer Michael Goba Chipeta challenged the video that shows the seven accused reenacting the crime. He said the suspects were not given written permission to be recorded. Chipeta also said police took one accused, Charles Chikafa, to the crime scene before the video and told him what to say. He said Chikafa was told to blame another suspect, Rafic Abdul Hassan, for carrying a gun.

Pangeti denied these claims. He said the video showed two separate demonstrations on different days. The defence then showed other videos from a media outlet. These videos showed the same reenactment but with reporters and the public present. Pangeti said he did not know the media were there. Chipeta argued that both videos should have been shown together so the court could see the full truth.

Chipeta also claimed the suspects were beaten and hit with guns before and after the demonstrations. Pangeti said this was not true. The defence showed photographs to suggest some accused had injuries, but Pangeti said the photos were not clear enough to identify anyone. Pangeti also told the court that the murder weapon was never found. He said the police could not test the fence where the shooting happened because the crime scene was damaged.

Judge Ruth Chinangwa stopped the heated argument several times and asked all sides to stay calm. State prosecutor Abdul Limbe asked Chipeta to remember this was work, not personal. Doctor Victoria Bobe was killed during a robbery at her home in Blantyre on 17 November 2025. Seven people say they did not do this crime. The trial will start again on Monday.

ny.title: Oteteza akutsutsa kanema wokhudza mlandu wakupha Bobe
ny.body: Loya woteteza milandu adakayikira umboni wa kanema wa apolisi pa mlandu wakupha dokotala Victoria Bobe. Wothandizira Superintendent Christopher Pangeti adayankha mafunso ku Khoti Lalikulu ku Blantyre Lachisanu. Oteteza milandu adati otsutsawo adaopsezedwa ndipo sanauzidwe kuti akujambulidwa.
ny.body_more:
Loya wa oimira boma Michael Goba Chipeta adatsutsa kanemayo yemwe akuwonetsa oimbidwa mlandu asanu ndi awiri akuchitanso zaupanduwo. Iye adati oimbidwa mlanduwo sanapatsidwe chilolezo cholembedwa kuti ajambulidwe. Chipeta adatinso apolisi adatengera woimbidwa mlandu m'modzi, Charles Chikafa, kumalo ochitira upanduwo asanayambe kanemayo ndipo adamuuza zomwe anganene. Iye adati Chikafa adauzidwa kuti aimbe mlandu woimbidwa mlandu wina, Rafic Abdul Hassan, chifukwa chonyamula mfuti.

Pangeti adakana izi. Iye adati kanemayo adawonetsa ziwonetsero ziwiri zosiyana pamasiku osiyanasiyana. Kenako oimbidwa mlandu adawonetsa makanema ena ochokera ku media. Mavidiyo awa adawonetsanso zomwe zinachitika koma atolankhani ndi anthu onse analipo. Pangeti adati sakudziwa kuti atolankhani analipo. Chipeta adati makanema onse awiri ayenera kuti adawonetsedwa pamodzi kuti khothi liwone chowonadi chonse.

Chipeta adatinso oimbidwa mlanduwo adamenyedwa ndikumenyedwa ndi mfuti zisanachitike komanso zitatha ziwonetserozo. Pangeti adati izi sizowona. Oimbidwa mlandu adawonetsa zithunzi zosonyeza kuti oimbidwa mlandu ena adavulala, koma Pangeti adati zithunzizo sizinali zomveka bwino kuti zidziwike aliyense. Pangeti adauzanso khothi kuti chida chophera sichinapezeke. Iye anati apolisi sanathe kuyesa mpanda womwe unachitikira chifukwa malo ochitira upanduwo anawonongeka.

Woweruza Ruth Chinangwa analetsa mkangano woopsa kangapo ndipo anapempha mbali zonse kuti zikhale bata. Woimira boma Abdul Limbe anapempha Chipeta kuti akumbukire kuti izi zinali ntchito, osati zaumwini. Dokotala Victoria Bobe anaphedwa pa nthawi ya kuba kunyumba kwake ku Blantyre pa 17 Novembala 2025. Anthu asanu ndi awiri akuti sanachite upanduwu. Mlanduwu uyambanso Lolemba.

en.title: Minister tells Team Malawi: bring home medals from Glasgow
en.body: The Minister of Youth, Sports and Culture Alfred Gangata asked Team Malawi to win medals at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland. He spoke on Thursday at a send-off party at Sunbird Capital in Lilongwe. Gangata said Malawi has not won a medal for many years. He told the athletes it was time to make the country proud.
en.body_more:
Gangata asked the athletes to think about what Malawi has gained since 1970, when the country first joined the games. "It is high time we bring medals to Malawi," he said. "Malawians have hope in you. Your success will help young people want to do well too. Go and fight for your country."

Jappie Mhango is the president of the Malawi Olympic Committee. He also works as Minister of Transport and Public Works. Mhango said the same thing — he asked the team to do their best in Glasgow. "If you bring results we will give you rewards," he said. He told the athletes to remember they carry the Malawi flag. "We do not want bad behaviour," he added.

Mhango thanked the government, FDH Bank, Essential Tours, and the British High Commission for giving money to help the team. Ben Nicholson is the British Deputy High Commissioner. He told the team: "Go to Scotland and do your best. We hope you come home with medals." He said sport brings Malawi and the United Kingdom close together.
