Francis Kakhuta Banda is the chief of the team. He told the athletes: "You carry the hopes of 22 million Malawians." He said they must show courage and good character. The games will run from 23 July to 2 August. Team Malawi has 38 people — athletes and officials. Malawi last won a medal at these games in 1986.

ny.title: Nduna yauza Team Malawi kuti: Bweretsani mendulo kuchokera ku Glasgow
ny.body: Nduna ya Achinyamata, Masewera ndi Chikhalidwe Alfred Gangata adapempha Team Malawi kuti ipambane mendulo pa Masewera a Commonwealth ku Glasgow, Scotland. Adalankhula Lachinayi pa phwando lomaliza ku Sunbird Capital ku Lilongwe. Gangata adati Malawi sinapambane mendulo kwa zaka zambiri. Adauza othamanga kuti nthawi yakwana yoti dzikolo lidzitamandire.
ny.body_more:
Gangata adapempha othamanga kuti aganizire zomwe Malawi yapeza kuyambira mu 1970, pomwe dzikolo lidayamba kusewera nawo masewerawa. "Nthawi yakwana yoti tibweretse mendulo ku Malawi," adatero. "Anthu aku Malawi ali ndi chiyembekezo mwa inu. Kupambana kwanu kudzathandiza achinyamata omwe akufuna kuchita bwino. Pitani mukamenyere nkhondo dziko lanu."

Jappie Mhango ndi purezidenti wa Komiti ya Olimpiki ya Malawi. Amagwiranso ntchito ngati Nduna ya Zoyendera ndi Ntchito za Anthu. Mhango adanenanso zomwezo - adapempha gululo kuti lichite zonse zomwe lingathe ku Glasgow. "Ngati mubweretsa zotsatira tidzakupatsani mphotho," adatero. Adauza othamangawo kuti akumbukire kuti amanyamula mbendera ya Malawi. "Sitikufuna khalidwe loipa," adawonjezera.

Mhango adathokoza boma, FDH Bank, Essential Tours, ndi British High Commission chifukwa chopereka ndalama zothandizira gululo. Ben Nicholson ndi Wachiwiri kwa Commissioner Wamkulu wa Britain. Adauza gululo kuti: "Pitani ku Scotland mukachite zonse zomwe mungathe. Tikukhulupirira kuti mubwera kunyumba ndi mendulo." Adati masewerawa amabweretsa Malawi ndi United Kingdom pamodzi.

Francis Kakhuta Banda ndiye mtsogoleri wa gululo. Iye anauza othamanga kuti: "Muli ndi chiyembekezo cha anthu 22 miliyoni aku Malawi." Anati ayenera kusonyeza kulimba mtima ndi khalidwe labwino. Masewerawa adzayamba pa 23 Julayi mpaka 2 Ogasiti. Gulu la Malawi lili ndi anthu 38 — othamanga ndi akuluakulu. Malawi idapambana mendulo komaliza pamasewerawa mu 1986.

en.title: Malawi doubles university tuition fees from 2026
en.body: Malawi's public universities have doubled tuition fees starting in 2026. University of Malawi, Mzuzu University, Luanar, Must and Mubas have raised annual fees from K650,000 to K1,300,000. Kuhes has raised fees from K1,000,000 to K2,000,000. The universities say rising costs made this necessary. Minister of Education Bright Msaka told Parliament the decision is final.
en.body_more:
The universities explained the fee increase was needed because of rising costs to deliver education. The last fee change was in 2023. Minister Msaka said the government worked with the Ministry of Finance on this decision and held talks before the announcement. He said no student will drop out of university because of the higher fees.

Msaka told journalists that the government has given more money to the Higher Education Students' Loans and Grants Board. This board gives loans and grants to poor students. The minister said all students who qualify can now get loans to pay fees and living costs. He said the government spends about K8 million to teach one student at university. Students now pay only K1.3 million. This means families and the government together pay for education.

Many students and families are worried about the new fees. Some students have struggled to pay the old fee of K650,000. Thousands had to find money from social media and kind people to pay. Universities do not have enough space for students to live. Many students must rent rooms far from campus in private hostels that cost much money. Some Kuhes students now use space at Mubas because Kuhes does not have enough buildings. The minister said the government wants to give quality education and help students have access to it. He said strong universities will help Malawi reach its goals for 2063.

ny.title: Malawi yawonjezera kawiri ndalama zolipirira maphunziro a ku yunivesite kuyambira 2026
ny.body: Mayunivesite aboma ku Malawi achulukitsa kawiri ndalama zolipirira maphunziro kuyambira mu 2026. Mayunivesite a Malawi, Mzuzu University, Luanar, Must ndi Mubas akweza ndalama zolipirira pachaka kuyambira K650,000 mpaka K1,300,000. Kuhes akweza ndalama zolipirira kuyambira K1,000,000 mpaka K2,000,000. Mayunivesitewa akuti kukwera kwa ndalama zomwe zimawononga ndalama kwapangitsa kuti izi zikhale zofunikira. Nduna ya Maphunziro Bright Msaka adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti chisankhocho ndi chomaliza.
ny.body_more:
Mayunivesite adafotokoza kuti kukwera kwa ndalama zolipirira maphunziro kumafunika chifukwa cha kukwera kwa ndalama zolipirira maphunziro. Kusintha komaliza kwa ndalama zolipirira kunali mu 2023. Nduna Msaka adati boma lidagwira ntchito ndi Unduna wa Zachuma pa chisankhochi ndipo lidakambirana asanalengeze. Adati palibe wophunzira amene adzasiya yunivesite chifukwa cha kukwera kwa ndalama zolipirira.

Msaka adauza atolankhani kuti boma lapereka ndalama zambiri ku Bungwe la Ngongole ndi Ndalama Zolipirira Ophunzira a Maphunziro Apamwamba. Bungweli limapereka ngongole ndi ndalama zothandizira ophunzira osauka. Ndunayo idati ophunzira onse omwe ali oyenerera tsopano akhoza kupeza ngongole zolipirira ndalama zolipirira ndi ndalama zogulira zinthu. Adati boma limagwiritsa ntchito ndalama zokwana K8 miliyoni kuphunzitsa wophunzira m'modzi ku yunivesite. Ophunzira tsopano amalipira K1.3 miliyoni yokha. Izi zikutanthauza kuti mabanja ndi boma pamodzi amalipira maphunziro.

Ophunzira ambiri ndi mabanja akuda nkhawa ndi ndalama zatsopanozi. Ophunzira ena avutika kulipira ndalama zakale za K650,000. Anthu masauzande ambiri adayenera kupeza ndalama kuchokera kuma social media ndi anthu okoma mtima kuti alipire. Mayunivesite alibe malo okwanira oti ophunzira azikhala. Ophunzira ambiri ayenera kubwereka zipinda kutali ndi sukulu m'ma hostel achinsinsi omwe amawononga ndalama zambiri. Ophunzira ena aku Kuhes tsopano amagwiritsa ntchito malo ku Mubas chifukwa ku Kuhes kulibe nyumba zokwanira. Ndunayo inati boma likufuna kupereka maphunziro abwino ndikuthandiza ophunzira kuti apeze mwayi wolowamo. Iye anati mayunivesite olimba athandiza Malawi kukwaniritsa zolinga zake za 2063.

en.title: Coffee prices jump to K21,000 per kilogramme
en.body: Coffee prices in Malawi have risen sharply. The price of parchment coffee — coffee that has been cleaned and dried — went up from K7,000 per kilogramme in 2024 to K21,000 per kilogramme at the end of 2025. Camal, the Coffee Association of Malawi, said this helps farmers. But smuggling of coffee across the border is a big problem. Much coffee leaves Malawi without being tracked by the government.
en.body_more:
Kondwani Nanchukwa is the secretary general of Camal. He said on Wednesday that the price rise is good for farmers. But he said that smuggling stops the country from earning foreign exchange money. Foreign exchange is money that other countries give Malawi when Malawi sells things abroad.

Nanchukwa said that foreign traders buy coffee cheaply from farmers. These traders move the coffee across borders without telling the government. The parallel market — an illegal place where people trade money and goods — helps smugglers. The government cannot track money from these illegal sales.

Production of coffee in Malawi has fallen. In recent years, Malawi made 7,000 metric tonnes of coffee each year. Now it makes only 1,000 metric tonnes per year. One metric tonne is one thousand kilogrammes. In 2024, Malawi sold K6 billion worth of coffee abroad. But the Mzuzu Coffee Planters Cooperative Union said it shipped only 200 metric tonnes of coffee in 2024. The union wanted to ship 350 metric tonnes. Half of the coffee was lost to smuggling.

The government made a plan called the Malawi Coffee Strategy. The plan runs from 2025 to 2040. It will set up a Coffee Control Commission to stop smuggling and help farmers. The plan also wants to help farmers grow coffee better and fight climate change. Minister of Agriculture Roza Mbilizi said the plan could help Malawi sell K420 billion of coffee each year by 2040. Germany and other countries in Europe want to buy Malawi coffee. But smuggling stops Malawi from selling more.

ny.title: Mitengo ya khofi yakwera kufika pa K21,000 pa kilogalamu
ny.body: Mitengo ya khofi ku Malawi yakwera kwambiri. Mtengo wa khofi wopangidwa ndi parchment — khofi woyeretsedwa ndi kuuma — unakwera kuchoka pa K7,000 pa kilogalamu mu 2024 kufika pa K21,000 pa kilogalamu kumapeto kwa chaka cha 2025. Camal, bungwe la Coffee Association of Malawi, anati izi zimathandiza alimi. Koma kugulitsa khofi mozemba kudutsa malire ndi vuto lalikulu. Khofi wambiri amachoka ku Malawi osatsatiridwa ndi boma.
ny.body_more:
Kondwani Nanchukhwa ndi mlembi wamkulu wa Camal. Iye anati Lachitatu kuti kukwera kwa mitengo ndi kwabwino kwa alimi. Koma anati kugulitsa zinthu mozembetsa kumaletsa dzikolo kupeza ndalama zosinthira ndalama zakunja. Kusinthana kwa ndalama zakunja ndi ndalama zomwe mayiko ena amapereka ku Malawi pamene Malawi ikugulitsa zinthu kunja.

Nanchukkwa anati amalonda akunja amagula khofi motchipa kwa alimi. Amalondawa amasuntha khofi kudutsa malire popanda kuuza boma. Msika womwewo - malo osaloledwa kumene anthu amagulitsa ndalama ndi katundu - umathandiza ozembetsa. Boma silingathe kutsatira ndalama kuchokera ku malonda osaloledwa awa.

Kupanga khofi ku Malawi kwatsika. M'zaka zaposachedwa, Malawi imapanga matani 7,000 a khofi chaka chilichonse. Tsopano imapanga matani 1,000 okha pachaka. Toni imodzi ndi kilogalamu chikwi chimodzi. Mu 2024, Malawi idagulitsa khofi wa K6 biliyoni kunja. Koma Mzuzu Coffee Planters Cooperative Union idati idatumiza matani 200 okha a khofi mu 2024. Bungweli linkafuna kutumiza matani 350. Theka la khofi linatayika chifukwa cha kugulitsa zinthu mozembetsa.

Boma lapanga dongosolo lotchedwa Malawi Coffee Strategy. Dongosololi likuyamba mu 2025 mpaka 2040. Likhazikitsa Khothi Loyang'anira Khofi kuti liletse kuzembetsa ndi kuthandiza alimi. Dongosololi likufunanso kuthandiza alimi kulima khofi bwino komanso kulimbana ndi kusintha kwa nyengo. Nduna ya Zaulimi Roza Mbilizi adati dongosololi lingathandize Malawi kugulitsa khofi wa K420 biliyoni chaka chilichonse pofika mu 2040. Germany ndi mayiko ena ku Europe akufuna kugula khofi waku Malawi. Koma kuzembetsa kumaletsa Malawi kugulitsa khofi wochuluka.

en.title: Six Players and Coaches Named for May Awards
en.body: The Super League of Malawi (Sulom) has named six people for awards. Three coaches and three players are shortlisted for May honours. The awards are for the FDH Bank Premiership. The choices follow strong starts in the 2026/27 season.
en.body_more:
For Coach of the Month, Blue Eagles coach Declerk Msakakuona was nominated. He led Blue Eagles to four wins, one draw, and one loss. The team plays for the Malawi Police Service. Msakakuona's team is among the early title contenders.

Ekhaya caretaker coach Fundi Akidu also made the shortlist. Akidu took charge on an interim basis. He won three matches from four games. Two of his wins came back-to-back. He had just one defeat. Masters FC coach Peter Mponda completes the three nominees. Mponda guided Masters to four wins from six matches. He made history as the first coach this season to win three league matches in a row.

In the Player of the Month category, Mighty Wanderers forward Lameck Mithi earned nomination. He scored five goals in six matches. He was only the second player this season to score a hat-trick. Mithi also won one Man of the Match award. Silver Strikers midfielder Ernest Petro made the shortlist. Petro played in all six league matches for his team. He scored one goal and won two Man of the Match awards. Blue Eagles defender Webster Mzunda completes the player nominees. Mzunda played in all six opening matches. He was named Man of the Match twice.

Sulom General Secretary Williams Banda said the winners will be announced after an assessment process. Both coach and player awards are part of the FDH Bank Premiership monthly honours.

ny.title: Osewera ndi Aphunzitsi Asanu ndi M'modzi Asankhidwa Kuti Apikisane pa Mphoto za Meyi
ny.body: Super League of Malawi (Sulom) yasankha anthu asanu ndi mmodzi kuti adzalandire mphoto. Aphunzitsi atatu ndi osewera atatu asankhidwa kuti adzalandire mphoto za mwezi wa May. Mphotozo ndi za FDH Bank Premiership. Zosankhazi zikutsatira kuyamba bwino kwa nyengo ya 2026/27.
ny.body_more:
Mphunzitsi wa Blue Eagles, Declerk Msakakuona, adasankhidwa kukhala Mphunzitsi wa Mwezi. Iye adatsogolera Blue Eagles kupambana kanayi, kugoletsa kamodzi, ndi kutayika kamodzi. Gululi limasewera ku Malawi Police Service. Gulu la Msakakuona lili m'gulu la osewera oyamba omwe adapikisana nawo mpikisano.

Mphunzitsi wosamalira wa Ekhaya, Fundi Akidu, nayenso adasankhidwa kukhala m'gulu la osewera omwe adasankhidwa. Akidu adatenga udindowu kwakanthawi. Adapambana masewera atatu kuchokera pamasewera anayi. Ziwiri mwa zigonjetso zake zidachitika motsatizana. Adagonja kamodzi kokha. Mphunzitsi wa Masters FC, Peter Mponda, ndiye adamaliza omwe adasankhidwa kukhala atatu. Mponda adatsogolera Masters kupambana kanayi kuchokera pamasewera asanu ndi limodzi. Adalemba mbiri ngati mphunzitsi woyamba nyengo ino kupambana masewera atatu motsatizana a ligi.

Mu gulu la Player of the Month, wosewera wa Mighty Wanderers, Lameck Mithi, adasankhidwa kukhala m'gulu la osewera omwe ... Iye anagoletsa chigoli chimodzi ndipo anapambana mphoto ziwiri za Man of the Match. Woteteza wa Blue Eagles, Webster Mzunda, ndiye amene anamaliza kusankhidwa kwa osewera. Mzunda adasewera masewera onse asanu ndi limodzi oyambilira. Anasankhidwa kukhala Man of the Match kawiri.

Mlembi Wamkulu wa Sulom, Williams Banda, adati opambana adzalengezedwa pambuyo pa ndondomeko yowunikira. Mphoto zonse za mphunzitsi ndi osewera ndi gawo la mphoto za mwezi uliwonse za FDH Bank Premiership.

en.title: Parliament fights deadlock over Zamba hotel inquiry testimony
en.body: The Speaker of Parliament is trying to solve a disagreement about a big hotel deal. Colleen Zamba was a top government worker. She must tell Parliament what she knows about a hotel that cost K128 billion. A group called the Public Accounts Committee wants her to speak, but she is in South Africa.
en.body_more:
The Speaker, Sameer Suleman, said he will meet with the committee leader Steven Malondera to find a way for Zamba to testify. She may speak by video call from South Africa. The committee's report about the hotel deal was rejected because Zamba did not give her evidence. The hotel was bought by the Public Service Pension Trust Fund. Pension money is money that workers save for when they grow old.

But there is a big problem. The government has started a court case against Zamba. She is charged with abuse of office about the same hotel deal. Her lawyer George Kadzipatike said the law stops Parliament from talking about matters that are in court. This rule is called Standing Order 192. So Zamba cannot speak to the committee while the court case is happening. The government insists that Zamba must testify before the report can be shared with Parliament.

Malondera said the government is not being honest. He said: if the government truly wants Zamba to speak, it must stop the court case first. The Leader of the House, Jappie Mhango, disagrees. He said Zamba's testimony is very important and cannot wait. A group called the National Advocacy Platform said Parliament must finish the report before July 31. They said workers deserve answers about their money. The Reserve Bank of Malawi had told the government not to buy the hotel, but the deal went ahead.

ny.title: Nyumba Yamalamulo Yatsutsa Kusamvana Pankhani Yokhudza Umboni Wokhudza Kafukufuku wa Hotelo ya Zamba
ny.body: Sipikala wa Nyumba Yamalamulo akuyesera kuthetsa kusamvana pa nkhani ya mgwirizano waukulu wa hotelo. Colleen Zamba anali wantchito wapamwamba m'boma. Ayenera kuuza Nyumba Yamalamulo zomwe akudziwa za hotelo yomwe idawononga K128 biliyoni. Gulu lotchedwa Komiti Yoona za Maakaunti a Anthu likufuna kuti alankhule, koma ali ku South Africa.
ny.body_more:
Sipikala, Sameer Suleman, anati akumana ndi mtsogoleri wa komitiyi, Steven Malondera kuti apeze njira yoti Zamba achitire umboni. Akhoza kulankhula kudzera pa kanema kuchokera ku South Africa. Lipoti la komitiyi lokhudza mgwirizano wa hoteloyi linakanidwa chifukwa Zamba sanapereke umboni wake. Hoteloyi idagulidwa ndi Public Service Pension Trust Fund. Ndalama za penshoni ndi ndalama zomwe antchito amasunga akakalamba.

Koma pali vuto lalikulu. Boma layambitsa mlandu kukhothi motsutsana ndi Zamba. Akuimbidwa mlandu wogwiritsa ntchito molakwika udindo wake pa mgwirizano womwewo wa hoteloyi. Loya wake George Kadzipatike adati lamuloli limaletsa Nyumba Yamalamulo kulankhula za nkhani zomwe zili kukhothi. Lamuloli limatchedwa Standing Order 192. Chifukwa chake Zamba sangalankhule ndi komitiyi pamene mlanduwo ukupitirira. Boma likuumirira kuti Zamba ayenera kupereka umboni lipotilo lisanagawidwe ku Nyumba Yamalamulo.

Malonda adati boma silikunena zoona. Iye anati: ngati boma likufunadi kuti Zamba alankhule, liyenera kuyimitsa mlanduwo kukhothi kaye. Mtsogoleri wa Nyumba Yamalamulo, Jappie Mhango, sakugwirizana. Iye anati umboni wa Zamba ndi wofunika kwambiri ndipo sungachedwe. Gulu lotchedwa National Advocacy Platform linati Nyumba Yamalamulo iyenera kumaliza lipotilo isanafike pa Julayi 31. Iwo anati antchito ayenera mayankho okhudza ndalama zawo. Banki Yaikulu ya Malawi idauza boma kuti lisagule hoteloyo, koma mgwirizanowu unapitirira.

en.title: Man arrested after wife dies at refugee camp
en.body: Police in Dowa have arrested a 44-year-old Congolese man named Wilonje Ettando. He is suspected of killing his 22-year-old wife, Mapendo Assan, at Dzaleka Refugee Camp. The arrest follows a domestic dispute about a pregnancy.
en.body_more:
Ettando and his wife's relatives took Assan to Dzaleka Health Centre early on 9 July. They said she had suddenly become ill. When she arrived at the health centre, doctors found her already dead. Medical staff saw suspicious marks on her body.

Police were told right away. The body was moved to Dowa District Hospital for a postmortem examination. A postmortem is a medical check done on a dead person to find the cause of death. Doctors found that Assan died from suffocation caused by strangulation. They also saw marks on her neck and fingers. Medical tests showed that Assan was not pregnant. This was important because Ettando had disputed with his wife over pregnancy. He believed she was pregnant by another man.

Ettando had arrived at Dzaleka Refugee Camp from Mozambique just two days before Assan died. Dzaleka Refugee Camp is in Dowa district. Police say Ettando will go to court soon. He will be charged with murder. Murder is the unlawful killing of a person. Police spokesperson Sub Inspector Alice Sitima gave details of the case to the public. Investigations are still continuing as police work to gather more evidence.

ny.title: Mwamuna wamangidwa mkazi wake atamwalira pamsasa wa othawa kwawo
ny.body: Apolisi ku Dowa amanga mwamuna wazaka 44 wa ku Congo dzina lake Wilonje Ettando. Akukayikiridwa kuti wapha mkazi wake wazaka 22, Mapendo Assan, ku Dzaleka Refugee Camp. Kumangidwa kumeneku kukutsatira mkangano wapakhomo wokhudza mimba.
ny.body_more:
Ettando ndi achibale a mkazi wake adapita ndi Assan ku Dzaleka Health Centre koyambirira kwa pa 9 Julayi. Anati mwadzidzidzi adadwala. Atafika ku chipatala, madokotala adamupeza atamwalira kale. Ogwira ntchito zachipatala adawona zipsera zokayikitsa pathupi lake.

Apolisi adauzidwa nthawi yomweyo. Mtembowo udasamutsidwira ku Chipatala cha Dowa District kuti akawunikidwe pambuyo pa imfa. Kuwunika pambuyo pa imfa ndi kufufuza kwachipatala komwe kumachitika pa munthu wakufa kuti apeze chomwe chachititsa imfayo. Madokotala adapeza kuti Assan adamwalira chifukwa cha kupuma movutikira chifukwa cha kumenyedwa. Adawonanso zipsera pakhosi ndi zala zake. Mayeso azachipatala adawonetsa kuti Assan sanali ndi pakati. Izi zinali zofunika chifukwa Ettando adakangana ndi mkazi wake chifukwa cha mimba. Ankakhulupirira kuti anali ndi pakati ndi mwamuna wina.

Ettando adafika ku Dzaleka Refugee Camp kuchokera ku Mozambique masiku awiri okha Assan asanamwalire. Dzaleka Refugee Camp ili m'chigawo cha Dowa. Apolisi akuti Ettando apita kukhothi posachedwa. Adzaimbidwa mlandu wakupha. Kupha munthu ndi kupha munthu mosaloledwa. Wolankhulira apolisi, Sub Inspector Alice Sitima, adapereka tsatanetsatane wa nkhaniyi kwa anthu onse. Kafukufuku akupitirirabe pamene apolisi akugwira ntchito yosonkhanitsa umboni wina.

en.title: Malawi lacks strong systems to manage its growing debt
en.body: Malawi has a serious debt problem. A new survey says weak systems make it worse. Debt is money a country must pay back. The survey looked at how Malawi manages its debt. It found that Malawi does not have enough oversight. Oversight means checking what the government does.
en.body_more:
The Open Budget Survey 2025 Debt Accountability Module was done by the International Budget Partnership. This is a group of budget experts from around the world. The survey found that Malawi has laws for debt management. But the systems are too weak. Malawi has no independent fiscal institution. A fiscal institution checks if the government spends money well. The Parliamentary Budget Office exists but has no law backing it. It has no money of its own. This means it cannot check if the government's debt plans are good.

Parliament did not check the Medium-Term Debt Management Strategy last year. Parliament did not check the yearly borrowing plan either. The National Audit Office cannot check public debt. It has no legal right to do this. Dalitso Kubalasa is a public finance expert. He said Malawi must have firm rules to stop too much spending. He also said the country needs a better exchange rate framework. Exchange rates are how much money from one country is worth in another country. Kubalasa said the government must protect poor families during changes.

Finance Minister Joseph Mwanamvekha said the government knows about the debt problem. He said the National Economic Recovery Plan will help. This plan will run for five years. By December 2025, Malawi's public debt was K23.9 trillion. This is almost all of the country's yearly earnings. The government must pay K2.793 trillion in debt interest. This is about one quarter of all government spending in 2026/27. The government plans to borrow K2.852 trillion more to cover its budget shortfall. The International Budget Partnership warns this is dangerous. Money for schools, hospitals and help for poor people is now going to pay debt instead.

ny.title: Malawi ilibe njira zolimba zoyendetsera ngongole zake zomwe zikukulirakulira
ny.body: Malawi ili ndi vuto lalikulu la ngongole. Kafukufuku watsopano akuti machitidwe ofooka amawonjezera vutoli. Ngongole ndi ndalama zomwe dziko liyenera kubweza. Kafukufukuyu adayang'ana momwe Malawi imayendetsera ngongole zake. Adapeza kuti Malawi ilibe kuyang'anira kokwanira. Kuyang'anira kumatanthauza kuyang'anira zomwe boma likuchita.
ny.body_more:
Kafukufuku wa Open Budget Accountability Module wa 2025 unachitidwa ndi International Budget Partnership. Ili ndi gulu la akatswiri a bajeti ochokera padziko lonse lapansi. Kafukufukuyu adapeza kuti Malawi ili ndi malamulo oyendetsera ngongole. Koma machitidwe ake ndi ofooka kwambiri. Malawi ilibe bungwe lodziyimira pawokha la zachuma. Bungwe la zachuma limafufuza ngati boma limagwiritsa ntchito ndalama bwino. Ofesi ya Bajeti ya Nyumba Yamalamulo ilipo koma ilibe lamulo loichirikiza. Ilibe ndalama zakezake. Izi zikutanthauza kuti silingathe kuwona ngati mapulani a ngongole a boma ndi abwino.

Nyumba yamalamulo sinayang'ane Ndondomeko Yoyendetsera Ngongole Yapakatikati chaka chatha. Nyumba yamalamulo sinayang'anenso dongosolo lobwereka pachaka. Ofesi ya National Audit Office singayang'ane ngongole za anthu onse. Ilibe ufulu wovomerezeka wochita izi. Dalitso Kubalasa ndi katswiri wazachuma cha anthu onse. Anati Malawi iyenera kukhala ndi malamulo olimba kuti aletse kugwiritsa ntchito ndalama zambiri. Anatinso dzikolo likufunika njira yabwino yosinthira ndalama. Mitengo yosinthira ndalama ndi kuchuluka kwa ndalama kuchokera kudziko lina zomwe zili zofunika kudziko lina. Kubalasa adati boma liyenera kuteteza mabanja osauka panthawi yosintha.

Nduna ya Zachuma Joseph Mwanamvekha adati boma likudziwa za vuto la ngongole. Anati Ndondomeko Yobwezeretsa Chuma Chadziko Lonse ithandiza. Dongosololi lidzagwira ntchito kwa zaka zisanu. Pofika mu Disembala 2025, ngongole ya boma ya Malawi inali K23.9 trilioni. Izi ndi pafupifupi ndalama zonse zomwe dzikolo limapeza pachaka. Boma liyenera kulipira chiwongola dzanja cha ngongole ya K2.793 trilioni. Izi ndi pafupifupi gawo limodzi mwa magawo anayi a ndalama zonse zomwe boma limagwiritsa ntchito mu 2026/27. Boma likukonzekera kubwereka ndalama zina za K2.852 trilioni kuti lipereke ndalama zoperewera mu bajeti yake. Bungwe la International Budget Partnership likuchenjeza kuti izi ndi zoopsa. Ndalama za masukulu, zipatala ndi thandizo kwa anthu osauka tsopano zilipira ngongole m'malo mwake.

en.title: Minister promises: no student will lose place over new fees
en.body: Minister of Higher Education Bright Msaka told Parliament on Thursday that no student will be forced to leave university because of new tuition fees. The government raised fees at public universities. Msaka said the government will help poor students pay the new fees.
en.body_more:
Msaka spoke after several MPs asked him about the fee increases. Lilongwe Nyanja MP Steve Malondera asked why fees rose from K650,000 to K1.3 million. The minister explained that government still pays most of the cost. Government spends an average of K6.7 million on each student each year. Students now pay K1.3 million. The government pays the rest.

Msaka said universities need more money to work well and teach students good quality lessons. He said universities cannot close. The government met with the Ministry of Finance before raising the fees. The minister said the decision was hard but needed.

Malondera disagreed. He said the fee rise will hurt families, especially those in rural areas that farm. He said education helps the country grow. He asked the government to give more money to universities instead of asking students to pay more.

Msaka said the government has given more money to the Higher Education Students' Loans and Grants Board. This board gives loans to poor students. The loans will help pay the new fees. Msaka told Parliament that every good student will be able to go to university. The new plan from the Ministry of Higher Education will be shown to Parliament soon. Many groups have asked the government to stop the fee rises. Student groups, opposition parties and civil groups said the fees are too much. They said thousands of young Malawians will not go to university now.

ny.title: Nduna yalonjeza: palibe wophunzira amene adzataya malo ake chifukwa cha ndalama zatsopano zolipirira
ny.body: Nduna ya Maphunziro Apamwamba Bright Msaka adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo Lachinayi kuti palibe wophunzira amene adzakakamizidwe kusiya yunivesite chifukwa cha ndalama zatsopano zolipirira sukulu. Boma lakweza ndalama zolipirira ku mayunivesite aboma. Msaka adati boma lithandiza ophunzira osauka kulipira ndalama zatsopano.
ny.body_more:
Msaka adalankhula pambuyo poti aphungu angapo adamufunsa za kukwera kwa ndalama zolipirira. MP wa ku Lilongwe Nyanja, Steve Malondera, adafunsa chifukwa chake ndalama zolipirira zidakwera kuchoka pa K650,000 kufika pa K1.3 miliyoni. Ndunayo idafotokoza kuti boma limalipirabe ndalama zambiri. Boma limagwiritsa ntchito avareji ya K6.7 miliyoni pa wophunzira aliyense chaka chilichonse. Ophunzira tsopano amalipira K1.3 miliyoni. Boma limalipira zotsalazo.

Msaka adati mayunivesite amafunika ndalama zambiri kuti agwire ntchito bwino ndikuphunzitsa ophunzira maphunziro abwino. Adati mayunivesite sangatseke. Boma lidakumana ndi Unduna wa Zachuma lisanakweze ndalama zolipirira. Ndunayo idati chisankhocho chinali chovuta koma chofunikira.

Malonda sanagwirizane. Adati kukwera kwa ndalama zolipirira kudzavulaza mabanja, makamaka omwe ali m'madera akumidzi omwe amalima. Adati maphunziro amathandiza dzikolo kukula. Adapempha boma kuti lipereke ndalama zambiri ku mayunivesite m'malo mopempha ophunzira kuti alipire zambiri.

Msaka adati boma lapereka ndalama zambiri ku Bungwe la Ophunzira a Maphunziro Apamwamba ndi Ndalama Zothandizira. Bungweli limapereka ngongole kwa ophunzira osauka. Ngongolezi zithandiza kulipira ndalama zatsopano. Msaka adauza Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti wophunzira aliyense wabwino azitha kupita ku yunivesite. Ndondomeko yatsopano yochokera ku Unduna wa Maphunziro Apamwamba idzawonetsedwa ku Nyumba Yamalamulo posachedwa. Magulu ambiri apempha boma kuti liletse kukwera kwa ndalama zolipirira. Magulu a ophunzira, zipani zotsutsa ndi magulu aboma ati ndalama zolipirira ndi zochuluka kwambiri. Anati achinyamata ambiri aku Malawi sapita ku yunivesite tsopano.

en.title: Busy Signal comes to Malawi for charity work
en.body: Jamaican musician Busy Signal will visit Malawi from August 12 to 15. He will work on a charity mission with gospel singer Wendy Harawa. They will give school supplies to children and feed hungry families. This is his third trip to Malawi.
en.body_more:
Busy Signal first came to Malawi in 2016. He played at Sand Music Festival at Sunbird Livingstonia Beach in Salima. He came back in 2022 to play at Kambiri Lodge, also in Salima. This time he is not coming to play music. He is coming to help people.

Busy Signal works with his group called Busy Global Initiative. Wendy Harawa leads the Wendy Harawa Foundation. The two groups joined together for this charity work. Wendy Harawa also works with Busy Signal on his Africa team. She said she used this job to bring him to Malawi. Busy Signal will give school supplies, food, and time with young people. The organisers asked all Malawians to help. They said: "Join us as we welcome Busy Signal home. Help us have the best help we can give. Help us welcome him as he gives back to the Malawi people."

Wendy Harawa said this visit is very important. She said: "Busy Signal is not coming for a concert. He is coming for our people, our youth, our schools and for that needy child. This tells every Malawi child they are worth the time of big world names." She said the visit should give hope to families that want things to get better. "For Malawi, this is a moment of pride. It puts the Warm Heart of Africa on the world map," she said. She also said: "When we come together, not as big names, but as real people and walk into a school or meet a mother at a clinic and use what we know to help someone, that is when it really matters."

ny.title: Busy Signal wabwera ku Malawi kudzagwira ntchito zachifundo
ny.body: Woyimba waku Jamaica, Busy Signal, adzapita ku Malawi kuyambira pa 12 mpaka 15 Ogasiti. Adzagwira ntchito yothandiza anthu ndi woyimba nyimbo za gospel Wendy Harawa. Adzapereka zinthu za kusukulu kwa ana ndikudyetsa mabanja omwe ali ndi njala. Uwu ndi ulendo wake wachitatu ku Malawi.
ny.body_more:
Busy Signal adabwera ku Malawi koyamba mu 2016. Adasewera pa Sand Music Festival ku Sunbird Livingstonia Beach ku Salima. Adabweranso mu 2022 kudzasewera ku Kambiri Lodge, komwe kuli ku Salima. Nthawi ino sakubwera kudzasewera nyimbo. Akubwera kudzathandiza anthu.

Busy Signal amagwira ntchito ndi gulu lake lotchedwa Busy Global Initiative. Wendy Harawa akutsogolera Wendy Harawa Foundation. Magulu awiriwa adagwirizana pa ntchito yothandiza anthu. Wendy Harawa amagwiranso ntchito ndi Busy Signal mu timu yake yaku Africa. Anati adagwiritsa ntchito ntchitoyi kumubweretsa ku Malawi. Busy Signal adzapereka zinthu za kusukulu, chakudya, komanso nthawi ndi achinyamata. Okonza adapempha anthu onse aku Malawi kuti athandize. Iwo adati: "Tigwirizaneni pamene tikulandira Busy Signal kunyumba. Tithandizeni kukhala ndi thandizo labwino kwambiri lomwe tingapereke. Tithandizeni kumulandira pamene akubwezera anthu aku Malawi."

Wendy Harawa adati ulendowu ndi wofunika kwambiri. Iye anati: "Busy Signal sakubwera ku konsati. Akubwera chifukwa cha anthu athu, achinyamata athu, masukulu athu komanso mwana wosowa ameneyo. Izi zimauza mwana aliyense waku Malawi kuti ndi wofunika nthawi ya mayina akuluakulu padziko lonse lapansi." Iye anati ulendowu uyenera kupereka chiyembekezo kwa mabanja omwe akufuna kuti zinthu ziyende bwino. "Kwa Malawi, iyi ndi nthawi yonyada. Imaika Warm Heart of Africa pamapu a dziko lonse," adatero. Iye anatinso: "Tikasonkhana, osati ngati mayina akuluakulu, koma ngati anthu enieni ndi kulowa kusukulu kapena kukumana ndi mayi kuchipatala ndikugwiritsa ntchito zomwe tikudziwa kuthandiza wina, ndiye kuti ndizofunikira kwambiri."

en.title: Malawi Pension Fund Reaches K145 Billion But Many Do Not Claim Benefits
en.body: Malawi's Default Pension Fund now holds about K145 billion. The Reserve Bank of Malawi set up this fund in 2024. It keeps money for workers who left jobs but did not claim their pension. The fund grew because of investment returns. However, only K6 billion has been claimed so far.
en.body_more:
NBM Pension Administration Limited manages the Default Pension Fund. The fund first received K103 billion when dormant pension accounts were moved into it. James Ngalande is the Business Development Manager at NBM Pension Administration Limited. He said the fund grew from K103 billion to K145 billion because of investment income added to members' accounts. "The fund has really grown, especially because of the investment income that has been applied to the balances," Ngalande said.

The final transfer of money into the fund closed on January 1, 2026. Since then, only small new amounts have been added. These are newly dormant benefits from workers who left jobs after six months of waiting. Boston Maliketi Banda is the Reserve Bank spokesperson. He said access to pension benefits follows the law. Only workers who meet the legal conditions can get their money. Banda said the low number of claims does not mean people face problems getting their benefits. Instead, it shows that only workers who qualify under the law have claimed their funds.

Ngalande said many former workers do not know they have benefits waiting. He said awareness is low. The remaining K139 billion is kept safe and invested. It waits for members to become eligible to receive it. Banda said the money stays invested on behalf of members until they qualify. The Pension Act of 2024 created the Default Fund to hold benefits that remain unclaimed for six months after they become payable.

ny.title: Ndalama za Pensheni za Malawi Zafika K145 Biliyoni Koma Ambiri Sakufuna Mapindu
ny.body: Ndalama ya Default Pension Fund ya ku Malawi tsopano ili ndi ndalama zokwana K145 biliyoni. Banki Yaikulu ya Malawi idakhazikitsa thumba ili mu 2024. Imasunga ndalama za antchito omwe adasiya ntchito koma sanapemphe penshoni yawo. Ndalamayi idakula chifukwa cha phindu la ndalama zomwe adayika. Komabe, K6 biliyoni yokha ndi yomwe yapemphedwa mpaka pano.
ny.body_more:
NBM Pension Administration Limited imayang'anira Default Pension Fund. Ndalamayi idalandira K103 biliyoni koyamba pamene maakaunti a penshoni omwe anali osagwira ntchito adasamutsidwiramo. James Ngalande ndi Business Development Manager ku NBM Pension Administration Limited. Iye adati ndalamayi idakula kuchoka pa K103 biliyoni kufika pa K145 biliyoni chifukwa cha ndalama zomwe zayikidwa ku maakaunti a mamembala. "Ndondomekoyi yakula kwambiri, makamaka chifukwa cha ndalama zomwe zayikidwa ku ndalama zomwe zatsala," adatero Ngalande.

Kusamutsa komaliza ndalama mu thumbali kunatsekedwa pa Januware 1, 2026. Kuyambira pamenepo, ndalama zatsopano zochepa zokha ndizo zawonjezeredwa. Izi ndi ndalama zomwe zangoperekedwa kumene kuchokera kwa ogwira ntchito omwe adasiya ntchito atatha miyezi isanu ndi umodzi akudikira. Boston Maliketi Banda ndi wolankhulira Reserve Bank. Iye adati mwayi wopeza ndalama za penshoni umatsatira lamulo. Ogwira ntchito okhawo omwe amakwaniritsa zofunikira zalamulo ndi omwe angalandire ndalama zawo. Banda adati chiwerengero chochepa cha zopempha sizitanthauza kuti anthu akukumana ndi mavuto opeza ndalama zawo. M'malo mwake, zikusonyeza kuti ogwira ntchito omwe ali oyenerera motsatira lamulo ndi omwe adatenga ndalama zawo.

Ngalande adati antchito ambiri akale sakudziwa kuti ali ndi ndalama zomwe akuyembekezera. Iye adati chidziwitso chili chochepa. Ndalama zotsala za K139 biliyoni zimasungidwa bwino ndipo zimayikidwa. Zimadikira kuti mamembala akhale oyenerera kulandira. Banda adati ndalamazo zimakhalabe zomwe zimayikidwa m'malo mwa mamembala mpaka atayenerera. Pension Act ya 2024 idapanga Default Fund kuti ikhale ndi maubwino omwe sakhala olandidwa kwa miyezi isanu ndi umodzi atayamba kulipidwa.

en.title: Law Society questions top prosecutor over dropped cases
en.body: Malawi's Law Society says it is worried. The Director of Public Prosecutions, Fostino Maele, has stopped many cases. Many cases involve people who work with the government or were once Mr. Maele's clients. The Law Society made a statement on Thursday.
en.body_more:
The Law Society says one case is very worrying. The Anti-Corruption Bureau wants to stop the case against Lin Yunhua. Lin Yunhua is a Chinese businessman. He was charged with corruption. But the Law Society says the case should go to court first. The court must hear the evidence. The Law Society is concerned because Lin Yunhua was a client of Mr. Maele before Mr. Maele became Director of Public Prosecutions. This is a conflict of interest. A conflict of interest means a person may not be fair.

Davis Njobvu leads the Law Society. Francis M'mame is the secretary. They said in their statement that many stopped cases involve people aligned with the government. They also involve former clients of Mr. Maele. The Law Society says this makes people lose trust in the justice system. The Constitution gives the DPP power to stop cases. But this power must be used fairly. People must see that it is used fairly.

The Law Society wants changes to the Constitution. Parliament must have more power to check decisions by the DPP. Courts should also be able to review these decisions. The Law Society says Malawi has a poor score on corruption. The score is 34 out of 100. If cases keep being stopped, people will think the government protects powerful people. The Law Society says equality before the law must be for everyone. No person should get special treatment.

ny.title: Bungwe la Malamulo likufunsa woimira boma wamkulu za milandu yomwe yasiyidwa
ny.body: Bungwe la Malamulo ku Malawi lati likuda nkhawa. Mtsogoleri wa milandu ya anthu, Fostino Maele, waletsa milandu yambiri. Milandu yambiri imakhudza anthu omwe amagwira ntchito ndi boma kapena omwe kale anali makasitomala a Bambo Maele. Bungwe la Malamulo linapereka chiganizo Lachinayi.
ny.body_more:
Bungwe la Law Society likuti mlandu umodzi ndi wodetsa nkhawa kwambiri. Bungwe Lolimbana ndi Ziphuphu likufuna kuletsa mlandu wotsutsana ndi Lin Yunhua. Lin Yunhua ndi wamalonda waku China. Anaimbidwa mlandu wa ziphuphu. Koma bungwe la Law Society likuti mlanduwu uyenera kupita kukhothi kaye. Khothi liyenera kumva umboni. Bungwe la Law Society likuda nkhawa chifukwa Lin Yunhua anali kasitomala wa a Maele asanakhale Mtsogoleri wa Makhothi. Uku ndi kusagwirizana kwa zofuna. Kusagwirizana kwa zofuna kumatanthauza kuti munthu sangachite chilungamo.

Davis Njobvu akutsogolera bungwe la Law Society. Francis M'mame ndi mlembi. Iwo adati m'mawu awo kuti milandu yambiri yomwe yasiyidwa imakhudza anthu omwe amagwirizana ndi boma. Amakhudzanso makasitomala akale a a Maele. Bungwe la Law Society likuti izi zimapangitsa anthu kutaya chidaliro mu dongosolo la chilungamo. Malamulo amapatsa DPP mphamvu yoletsa milandu. Koma mphamvu imeneyi iyenera kugwiritsidwa ntchito mwachilungamo. Anthu ayenera kuwona kuti ikugwiritsidwa ntchito mwachilungamo.

Bungwe la Law Society likufuna kusintha kwa Malamulo. Nyumba Yamalamulo iyenera kukhala ndi mphamvu zambiri zowunikira zisankho za DPP. Makhothi ayeneranso kuwunikanso zisankhozi. Bungwe la Law Society likuti Malawi ili ndi zigoli zochepa pazachinyengo. Ziwerengero zake ndi 34 pa 100. Ngati milandu ikupitirira kuthetsedwa, anthu adzaganiza kuti boma limateteza anthu amphamvu. Bungwe la Malamulo limati kufanana pamaso pa lamulo kuyenera kukhala kwa aliyense. Palibe munthu amene ayenera kulandira chithandizo chapadera.

en.title: Police arrest man over doctor murder in Blantyre
en.body: Police have arrested a 25-year-old man named Macmillan Mvevula. He is accused of killing doctor Atughanile Chomo. She was found dead at her home in Blantyre on Tuesday. Police say they also found a mobile phone at the scene.
en.body_more:
The arrest came after detectives from the Blantyre Criminal Investigations Department did an intelligence-led operation. Police deputy spokesperson Alfred Chimthere said the arrest marks important progress. Mvevula is from Mtika Village in Thyolo District. Police recovered a Redmi mobile phone they believe belonged to Dr Chomo.

Dr Chomo was 28 years old. She was a new doctor at Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital. She came from Chitipa District. She was born on 26 June 1998. Police found her body at her home in Mount Pleasant, Blantyre. Mvevula remains in police custody. He will appear in court soon. Police say they have collected forensic evidence as they continue their work.

The death of Dr Chomo has shocked doctors across Malawi. Medical Doctors Union of Malawi said the killing raises concerns about safety. Doctor Steve Mlangiza said doctors fear for their lives. He said some doctors travel at night on public buses to and from work. Doctors earn low pay. This makes it hard for them to live in safe areas or hire security guards. Mlangiza asked the Ministry of Health to protect doctors better. Police say the investigation is still going on. They will share more details as work continues.

ny.title: Apolisi agwira munthu chifukwa cha kupha dokotala ku Blantyre
ny.body: Apolisi amanga mwamuna wazaka 25 dzina lake Macmillan Mvevula. Akuimbidwa mlandu wopha dokotala Atughanile Chomo. Anapezeka atafa kunyumba kwake ku Blantyre Lachiwiri. Apolisi ati adapezanso foni yam'manja pamalopo.
ny.body_more:
Kumangidwa kumeneku kunachitika pambuyo poti apolisi ochokera ku Blantyre Criminal Investigations Department adachita ntchito yotsogozedwa ndi ukazitape. Wachiwiri kwa wolankhulira apolisi Alfred Chimthere adati kumangidwaku ndi chizindikiro cha kupita patsogolo kwakukulu. Mvevula akuchokera ku Mtika Village ku Thyolo District. Apolisi adapeza foni yam'manja ya Redmi yomwe amakhulupirira kuti inali ya Dr Chomo.

Dr Chomo anali ndi zaka 28. Anali dokotala watsopano ku Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital. Anachokera ku Chitipa District. Anabadwa pa 26 June 1998. Apolisi adapeza mtembo wake kunyumba kwake ku Mount Pleasant, Blantyre. Mvevula akadali m'manja mwa apolisi. Adzawonekera kukhothi posachedwa. Apolisi ati asonkhanitsa umboni wa zamalamulo pamene akupitiliza ntchito yawo.

Imfa ya Dr Chomo yadabwitsa madokotala ku Malawi konse. Medical Doctors Union of Malawi yati kuphedwa kumeneku kukubweretsa nkhawa za chitetezo. Dokotala Steve Mlangiza adati madokotala akuopa miyoyo yawo. Iye anati madokotala ena amayenda usiku m'mabasi aboma kupita ndi kubwera kuntchito. Madokotala amalandira malipiro ochepa. Izi zimapangitsa kuti zikhale zovuta kuti azikhala m'malo otetezeka kapena kulemba alonda. Mlangiza adapempha Unduna wa Zaumoyo kuti uteteze bwino madokotala. Apolisi ati kafukufuku akupitirirabe. Adzafotokoza zambiri pamene ntchito ikupitirira.

en.title: Chief Whip's 'Black Box' remark causes chaos in Parliament
en.body: Parliament stopped work on Wednesday after a minister made a remark that made many MPs very angry. Chief Whip Patricia Wisikesi told opposition MP Moses Kunkuyu to keep quiet. She used words that upset people. Speaker Sameer Suleman closed parliament for the day.
en.body_more:
Wisikesi was talking about a plan to build a fertilizer factory in Malawi. Opposition MPs kept asking questions about the deal. Kunkuyu was one of them. Wisikesi told them "Black box, keep quiet." The words made MPs from the opposition party jump up and shout. They said the minister was trying to stop them from asking questions. Government MPs stood up too. The room became very loud and angry.

The words "black box" are painful to Kunkuyu. In June 2024, a plane crashed. Vice-President Saulos Chilima died. Eight other people also died. At that time, Kunkuyu was minister of information. He told journalists that a black box would help find out what happened. A black box is a machine on planes that records sounds and numbers from flying. But no black box was found. Investigators had no recordings to help them learn what caused the crash.

A team looked at the crash. They said bad weather and human error caused it. A German team also looked at it. They said the same thing. But the Justice Minister said there were problems with the first study. President Peter Mutharika asked for a new look at what happened. So the crash story is not finished. The old nickname now hurt Kunkuyu again in parliament.

After the chaos, Speaker Suleman said parliament would stop. The fertilizer factory plan was not finished. The government says the factory will help farmers get fertilizer. The opposition says the government must show the full deal first.

ny.title: Mawu a Chief Whip akuti 'Black Box' abweretsa chisokonezo ku Nyumba Yamalamulo
ny.body: Nyumba Yamalamulo inasiya kugwira ntchito Lachitatu nduna itanena mawu omwe anakwiyitsa kwambiri aphungu ambiri a nyumba yamalamulo. Chief Whip Patricia Wisikesi anauza MP wotsutsa Moses Kunkuyu kuti akhale chete. Iye anagwiritsa ntchito mawu omwe anakhumudwitsa anthu. Sipikala Sameer Suleman anatseka nyumba yamalamulo tsiku lomwelo.
ny.body_more:
Wisikesi anali kulankhula za dongosolo lomanga fakitale ya feteleza ku Malawi. Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo otsutsa anapitiriza kufunsa mafunso okhudza mgwirizanowu. Kunkuyu anali m'modzi mwa iwo. Wisikesi anawauza kuti "Black box, khalani chete." Mawuwa anapangitsa aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo ochokera ku chipani chotsutsa kulumpha mmwamba ndikufuula. Anati ndunayo ikuyesera kuwaletsa kufunsa mafunso. Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo a boma nawonso anaimirira. Chipindacho chinakhala chaphokoso kwambiri komanso chokwiya.

Mawu oti "black box" ndi opweteka kwa Kunkuyu. Mu June 2024, ndege inagwa. Wachiwiri kwa Purezidenti Saulos Chilima anamwalira. Anthu ena asanu ndi atatu anamwaliranso. Panthawiyo, Kunkuyu anali nduna yoona za chidziwitso. Anauza atolankhani kuti bokosi lakuda lingathandize kudziwa zomwe zinachitika. Bokosi lakuda ndi makina omwe amalemba mawu ndi manambala kuchokera kuuluka. Koma palibe bokosi lakuda lomwe linapezeka. Ofufuza analibe zolemba zowathandiza kudziwa chomwe chinayambitsa ngoziyi.

Gulu linayang'ana ngoziyi. Anati nyengo yoipa ndi zolakwika za anthu ndizo zinayambitsa ngoziyi. Gulu la Germany linayang'ananso. Ananenanso chimodzimodzi. Koma Nduna ya Zachilungamo inati panali mavuto ndi kafukufuku woyamba. Purezidenti Peter Mutharika adapempha kuti aonenso zomwe zachitika. Kotero nkhani ya ngoziyi sinathe. Dzina lakale la dzina lachibwana tsopano lapwetekanso Kunkuyu mu nyumba yamalamulo.

Pambuyo pa chisokonezo, Sipikala Suleman adati nyumba yamalamulo iyimitsa. Dongosolo la fakitale ya feteleza silinathe. Boma likuti fakitaleyo ithandiza alimi kupeza feteleza. Otsutsa akuti boma liyenera kuwonetsa mgwirizano wonse kaye.

en.title: Old Mutual gives K140 million to help bring Malawians home
en.body: Old Mutual (Blantyre) Foundation Trust gave K140 million to the government on Wednesday. The money will help bring Malawians home from South Africa. Xenophobic attacks in South Africa forced many Malawians to leave. The K140 million will pay for two buses to transport 140 people from Durban to Malawi.
en.body_more:
Trust Chairperson Tawonga Manda handed over the cheque in Lilongwe. He said the donation shows the nation stands together in hard times. "It is during moments like these that compassion, solidarity and humanity matter the most," Manda said. Pregnant women, mothers, young children and other weak people will get help first.

Chief Secretary Justin Saidi received the money on behalf of the government. He praised Old Mutual for fast help. "This financial support has gone directly to hire safe transport from South Africa to Malawi," Saidi said. He asked employers to give jobs to people returning home. These people learned new skills while working in South Africa.

Saidi said about 30,000 Malawians have already come home safely. More people want to return, but the government needs more money. He called on rich people, companies and other countries to help more. The government wants to bring all Malawians home who wish to return.

Old Mutual said this help shows the company cares about Malawi. The foundation helped during the COVID-19 illness outbreak and the cholera sickness. After Cyclone Freddy in 2023, Old Mutual gave K360 million to fix schools. The company said returnees are not alone and the money will help their journey home.

ny.title: Old Mutual yapereka K140 miliyoni kuti ithandize kubwezeretsa a Malawi kunyumba kwawo
ny.body: Bungwe la Old Mutual (Blantyre) Foundation Trust lapereka ndalama zokwana K140 miliyoni ku boma Lachitatu. Ndalamazi zithandiza kubwezeretsa anthu aku Malawi kuchokera ku South Africa. Ziwopsezo za maiko akunja ku South Africa zapangitsa kuti anthu ambiri aku Malawi achoke. Ndalama zokwana K140 miliyoni zidzalipira mabasi awiri onyamula anthu 140 kuchokera ku Durban kupita ku Malawi.
ny.body_more:
Wapampando wa Trust, Tawonga Manda, wapereka cheke ku Lilongwe. Iye anati choperekachi chikusonyeza kuti dziko lonse lili pamodzi m'nthawi zovuta. "Ndi nthawi ngati izi pomwe chifundo, mgwirizano ndi umunthu ndizofunikira kwambiri," adatero Manda. Azimayi oyembekezera, amayi, ana aang'ono ndi anthu ena ofooka adzalandira thandizo kaye.

Mlembi Wamkulu Justin Saidi adalandira ndalamazo m'malo mwa boma. Iye anayamikira Old Mutual chifukwa chothandiza mwachangu. "Thandizo la ndalamali lapita mwachindunji kuti libwereke mayendedwe otetezeka kuchokera ku South Africa kupita ku Malawi," adatero Saidi. Anapempha olemba ntchito kuti apereke ntchito kwa anthu obwerera kwawo. Anthuwa adaphunzira maluso atsopano akugwira ntchito ku South Africa.

Saidi anati anthu pafupifupi 30,000 aku Malawi abwerera kale kunyumba mosatekeseka. Anthu ambiri akufuna kubwerera, koma boma likufunika ndalama zambiri. Anapempha anthu olemera, makampani ndi mayiko ena kuti athandize kwambiri. Boma likufuna kubweretsa anthu onse aku Malawi omwe akufuna kubwerera kwawo.

Old Mutual inati thandizoli likusonyeza kuti kampaniyo imasamala za Malawi. Bungweli linathandiza panthawi ya mliri wa matenda a COVID-19 komanso matenda a kolera. Pambuyo pa mphepo yamkuntho ya Freddy mu 2023, Old Mutual inapereka K360 miliyoni kuti ikonze masukulu. Kampaniyo inati anthu obwerera kwawo sali okha ndipo ndalamazo ziwathandiza kubwerera kwawo.

en.title: MPs ask: where is CDF money for our areas?
en.body: Parliament heard angry questions on Tuesday about delayed money for local development. Minister Ben Phiri said the Constituency Development Fund (CDF is money for each area to build schools, health centres and roads) will start soon. But MPs said three months have passed with no work on the ground. The fund has K1.145 trillion to share.
en.body_more:
Lilongwe City Lumbadzi MP Denis Chalera said his constituents are tired of waiting. "The budget started on April 1, 2026. Today is July 7. Almost three months have passed with no money reaching the ground," he said. Chalera warned that people now think MPs are not doing anything.

Nkhata Bay Chintheche MP Noah Chimpeni told the minister about two stalled projects in his area. A health post stopped when America ended its funding. A theatre at Chintheche Rural Hospital is also not finished. He asked if these projects can get CDF money. Phiri said the Finance Ministry controls the money, not him. Mzimba West MP Aeckim Kumwenda also asked about stalled health centre work in his area.

Phiri said his ministry has done much work. New rules for CDF were made with the Finance Ministry and Justice Ministry. Local councils opened bank accounts for the money. The government hired 680 officers to help run CDF work and 36 internal auditors to check the money. Phiri said funds have started to go to councils. But he also said all stalled projects can get CDF money if they are done in the right way. District leaders must give details of each stalled project first.

Dedza Kasina MP Joshua Malango, from the ruling party, asked a hard question. He said the government has no money to pay builders now. "How will you pay for CDF projects if you cannot pay builders their money?" he asked. The reformed CDF gives each area K5 billion, much more than the old K200 million. It is meant to be a big new plan for giving money to areas for their own choices.

ny.title: Aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo akufunsa kuti: ndalama za CDF za madera athu zili kuti?
ny.body: Nyumba Yamalamulo idamva mafunso okwiya Lachiwiri okhudza ndalama zochedwetsa chitukuko cha m'deralo. Nduna Ben Phiri adati Ndalama Zothandizira Chitukuko cha Madera (CDF ndi ndalama za dera lililonse zomangira masukulu, zipatala ndi misewu) ziyamba posachedwa. Koma aphungu adati miyezi itatu yadutsa popanda ntchito. Ndalamayi ili ndi K1.145 trillion yoti igawane.
ny.body_more:
MP wa ku Lumbadzi ku Lilongwe City, Denis Chalera, adati anthu ake atopa ndi kudikira. "Bajeti idayamba pa Epulo 1, 2026. Lero ndi pa Julayi 7. Pafupifupi miyezi itatu yapita popanda ndalama," adatero. Chalera adachenjeza kuti anthu tsopano akuganiza kuti aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo sakuchita chilichonse.

MP wa ku Nkhata Bay Chintheche, Noah Chimpeni, adauza ndunayo za mapulojekiti awiri omwe adayima mdera lake. Malo azaumoyo adayima pomwe America idamaliza ndalama zake. Bwalo la zisudzo ku Chintheche Rural Hospital nalonso silinamalizidwe. Adafunsa ngati mapulojekitiwa angapeze ndalama za CDF. Phiri adati Unduna wa Zachuma ndiwo umayang'anira ndalamazo, osati iyeyo. MP wa ku Mzimba West, Aeckim Kumwenda, adafunsanso za ntchito yoyima ya malo azaumoyo mdera lake.

Phiri adati unduna wake wachita ntchito yambiri. Malamulo atsopano a CDF adapangidwa ndi Unduna wa Zachuma ndi Unduna wa Zachilungamo. Mabungwe am'deralo adatsegula maakaunti akubanki a ndalamazo. Boma lidalemba ntchito akuluakulu 680 kuti athandize kuyendetsa ntchito za CDF ndi owerengera ndalama 36 kuti ayang'ane ndalamazo. Phiri adati ndalama zayamba kupita kumabungwe. Koma adatinso mapulojekiti onse omwe atsekedwa akhoza kupeza ndalama za CDF ngati achitika moyenera. Atsogoleri a madera ayenera kupereka tsatanetsatane wa projekiti iliyonse yomwe yatsekedwa kaye.

Mphungu wa Dedza Kasina, Joshua Malango, wochokera ku chipani cholamulira, adafunsa funso lovuta. Iye adati boma lilibe ndalama zolipirira omanga tsopano. "Mudzalipira bwanji mapulojekiti a CDF ngati simungathe kulipira omanga ndalama zawo?" adafunsa. CDF yosinthidwayo imapatsa dera lililonse K5 biliyoni, yoposa K200 miliyoni yakale. Iyenera kukhala dongosolo latsopano lopereka ndalama kumadera omwe angasankhe okha.

en.title: UTM leader says university fees are too high
en.body: Dalitso Kabambe is the leader of UTM Party. He says public universities doubled their fees. Fees went from K650,000 to K1.3 million per year. Kabambe spoke in Lilongwe yesterday. He said this is wrong and must stop. He wants the government to change this decision.
en.body_more:
Kabambe said students now pay about K3.8 million each year for all costs. This includes tuition, food and a place to sleep. He asked how poor families can pay this much money. A farmer or shop worker cannot afford it, he said.

Kabambe told the government to use money from other areas instead. He said State residences get K85 billion each year. State residences are homes for leaders. Kabambe said the government can cut K60 billion from this budget. The Office of the President and Cabinet gets K52 billion per year. This money can also be cut, he said. Kabambe said President Peter Mutharika does not travel a lot. So the government does not need all this money for residences.

Naomie Mbeye is a student at Luanar. Luanar is Lilongwe University of Agriculture and Natural Resources. Mbeye said poor students cannot pay the new fees. She said many students cannot get loans from the Higher Education Students Loans and Grants Board. This board gives money to help students. But students in diploma and certificate programmes do not get help from this board. Mbeye said these students will suffer the most.

Five universities raised their fees last week. They are Luanar, Mzuzu University, University of Malawi, Malawi University of Business and Applied Sciences and Malawi University of Science and Technology. Kamuzu University of Health Sciences also raised fees. Fees went from K1 million to K2 million there. The Ministry of Education said the increase is needed. The government said it helps keep teaching good.

ny.title: Mtsogoleri wa UTM ati ndalama zolipirira mayunivesite ndi zokwera kwambiri
ny.body: Dalitso Kabambe ndi mtsogoleri wa chipani cha UTM. Iye akuti mayunivesite aboma adachulukitsa kawiri ndalama zomwe amalipiritsa. Ndalama zolipirira zidakwera kuchoka pa K650,000 kufika pa K1.3 miliyoni pachaka. Kabambe adalankhula ku Lilongwe dzulo. Iye adati izi ndi zolakwika ndipo ziyenera kutha. Akufuna kuti boma lisinthe chisankhochi.
ny.body_more:
Kabambe anati ophunzira tsopano amalipira pafupifupi K3.8 miliyoni pachaka pa ndalama zonse. Izi zikuphatikizapo ndalama za sukulu, chakudya ndi malo ogona. Anafunsa momwe mabanja osauka angalipire ndalama zambiri chonchi. Mlimi kapena wogwira ntchito m'sitolo sangakwanitse, anatero.

Kabambe anauza boma kuti ligwiritse ntchito ndalama zochokera m'madera ena m'malo mwake. Anati nyumba za boma zimalandira K85 biliyoni chaka chilichonse. Nyumba za boma ndi nyumba za atsogoleri. Kabambe anati boma likhoza kuchepetsa K60 biliyoni kuchokera mu bajetiyi. Ofesi ya Purezidenti ndi Kabinet imalandira K52 biliyoni pachaka. Ndalamazi zithanso kuchepetsedwa, anatero. Kabambe anati Purezidenti Peter Mutharika sayenda kwambiri. Chifukwa chake boma silikufuna ndalama zonsezi kuti likhale ndi nyumba.

Naomie Mbeye ndi wophunzira ku Luanar. Luanar ndi Lilongwe University of Agriculture and Natural Resources. Mbeye anati ophunzira osauka sangathe kulipira ndalama zatsopano. Anati ophunzira ambiri sangathe kupeza ngongole kuchokera ku Higher Education Students Loans and Grants Board. Bungweli limapereka ndalama zothandizira ophunzira. Koma ophunzira omwe ali mu mapulogalamu a diploma ndi satifiketi salandira thandizo kuchokera ku bungweli. Mbeye anati ophunzira awa adzavutika kwambiri.

Mayunivesite asanu adakweza ndalama zawo sabata yatha. Ndi Luanar, Mzuzu University, University of Malawi, Malawi University of Business and Applied Sciences ndi Malawi University of Science and Technology. Kamuzu University of Health Sciences idakwezanso ndalama. Ndalama zidachoka pa K1 miliyoni kufika pa K2 miliyoni kumeneko. Unduna wa Maphunziro unati kukwezako kukufunika. Boma linati zimathandiza kuti kuphunzitsa kukhale bwino.

en.title: DPP says no alliance with Solidarity Alliance Party
en.body: The Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) has rejected claims by the Solidarity Alliance Party (SAP) that the two parties made a secret alliance. DPP National Publicity Secretary Shadric Namalomba said on July 7 there is no agreement between them. He called SAP's claim a lie designed to fool Malawians.
en.body_more:
Namalomba said in a statement that there is no alliance, no agreement, no memorandum of understanding, and no talks happening between DPP and SAP. He described SAP's move as a calculated deception. The DPP said SAP was trying to use the DPP's name to gain credibility. SAP is a party that has never won a seat in parliament.

Namalomba said any real coalition would be announced properly through official party structures and told to the nation directly. He said it would not come from a press release from a party with no electoral history. The DPP said SAP was acting in desperation and using political opportunism. The party said it remains united and focused on serving Malawi. DPP said it will not be distracted by what it called baseless propaganda from SAP.

The DPP has called on the media and the public to ignore SAP's claim completely. The party has demanded that SAP withdraw its statement immediately and say sorry to both the DPP and the people of Malawi. The DPP said it is totally unshaken by the row and refuses to be used as a ladder to give credibility to SAP. The party emphasized that any such partnership would need to go through proper channels and be announced officially, not through dubious press releases from parties with no track record in elections.

ny.title: DPP yati palibe mgwirizano ndi Solidarity Alliance Party
ny.body: Chipani cha Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) chakana zomwe chipani cha Solidarity Alliance Party (SAP) chikunena kuti magulu awiriwa adapanga mgwirizano wachinsinsi. Mlembi wa DPP National Publicity, Shadric Namalomba, adati pa Julayi 7 palibe mgwirizano pakati pawo. Iye adati zomwe SAP ikunena ndi zabodza zomwe cholinga chake ndi kupusitsa anthu aku Malawi.
ny.body_more:
Namalomba adati m'mawu ake kuti palibe mgwirizano, palibe mgwirizano, palibe chiganizo chogwirizana, ndipo palibe zokambirana zomwe zikuchitika pakati pa DPP ndi SAP. Adafotokoza kuti zomwe SAP yachita ndi chinyengo. DPP idati SAP ikuyesera kugwiritsa ntchito dzina la DPP kuti ipeze kudalirika. SAP ndi chipani chomwe sichinapambanepo mpando mu nyumba yamalamulo.

Namalomba adati mgwirizano uliwonse weniweni udzalengezedwa bwino kudzera m'mabungwe ovomerezeka a chipani ndipo udzauzidwa kwa dziko lonse mwachindunji. Adati sizingachokere ku chikalata chofalitsa nkhani kuchokera ku chipani chomwe chilibe mbiri ya chisankho. DPP idati SAP ikuchita zinthu mopanda chiyembekezo komanso pogwiritsa ntchito mwayi wandale. Chipanichi chidati chikugwirizanabe ndipo chikuyang'ana kwambiri kutumikira Malawi. DPP idati sichidzasokonezedwa ndi zomwe idati propaganda zopanda maziko kuchokera ku SAP.

DPP yapempha atolankhani ndi anthu kuti anyalanyaze zomwe SAP yanena. Chipanichi chapempha kuti SAP ichotse mawu ake nthawi yomweyo ndikupepesa kwa DPP ndi anthu aku Malawi. DPP idati sidzagwedezeka konse ndi mkanganowu ndipo ikukana kugwiritsidwa ntchito ngati makwerero kuti ipereke kudalirika kwa SAP. Chipanichi chinagogomezera kuti mgwirizano uliwonse woterewu uyenera kuyendetsedwa bwino ndikulengezedwa mwalamulo, osati kudzera m'manyuzipepala okayikitsa ochokera ku zipani zomwe sizinachite bwino pa zisankho.

en.title: NAP tells MPs to help poor people with high prices
en.body: A group called the National Advocacy Platform (NAP) asked Parliament to help Malawians. The group said the cost of living is too high. Parliament is meeting from 7 to 30 July 2026. NAP wants MPs to fix the economy, help farmers get fertiliser, and help university students.
en.body_more:
NAP said life is hard for poor people in Malawi. Prices for food and goods are very high. People do not have enough money. The government takes too much tax. It is hard to buy things from other countries because there is not enough money.

Parliament must help, NAP said. The group asked MPs to talk about how to make life cheaper. They asked for plans to help farmers. The government must give farmers fertiliser for the next farm season. If there is no fertiliser, people will go hungry.

NAP also said universities need more money. Public universities want K536.7 billion but get only K133.6 billion from the government. This is not enough. Many poor students cannot go to university because fees are too high. The fees went up 100 percent. Parliament must give more money to universities and help students pay, NAP said.

NAP asked Parliament about other problems too. The group wants to know how many Malawians were hurt in South Africa. It wants the government to say how many people came home and how much money was spent. NAP also asked about money for towns and villages. This money is called Constituency Development Fund. It comes late and slows down building projects. NAP told MPs to work together and put Malawi first. Parliament must ask hard questions about money and power. It must make sure the government does the right thing.

ny.title: NAP yauza aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo kuti athandize anthu osauka ndi mitengo yokwera
ny.body: Gulu lotchedwa National Advocacy Platform (NAP) linapempha Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti ithandize anthu aku Malawi. Gululo linati mtengo wa moyo ndi wokwera kwambiri. Nyumba Yamalamulo ikukumana kuyambira pa 7 mpaka 30 Julayi 2026. NAP ikufuna kuti aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo akonze chuma, athandize alimi kupeza feteleza, komanso athandize ophunzira aku yunivesite.
ny.body_more:
NAP yati moyo ndi wovuta kwa anthu osauka ku Malawi. Mitengo ya chakudya ndi katundu ndi yokwera kwambiri. Anthu alibe ndalama zokwanira. Boma limatenga msonkho wochuluka. N'zovuta kugula zinthu kuchokera kumayiko ena chifukwa palibe ndalama zokwanira.

NAP yati Nyumba Yamalamulo iyenera kuthandiza. Gululo linapempha aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti akambirane za momwe angapangire moyo kukhala wotchipa. Anapempha mapulani othandizira alimi. Boma liyenera kupatsa alimi feteleza nyengo yotsatira yaulimi. Ngati palibe feteleza, anthu adzavutika ndi njala.

NAP yatinso mayunivesite amafunikira ndalama zambiri. Mayunivesite aboma akufuna K536.7 biliyoni koma amalandira K133.6 biliyoni yokha kuchokera ku boma. Izi sizokwanira. Ophunzira ambiri osauka sangapite ku yunivesite chifukwa ndalama zolipirira ndi zokwera kwambiri. Ndalama zolipirira zinakwera 100 peresenti. Nyumba Yamalamulo iyenera kupereka ndalama zambiri ku mayunivesite ndikuthandizira ophunzira kulipira, NAP yati.

NAP yafunsa Nyumba Yamalamulo za mavuto enanso. Gululi likufuna kudziwa kuti ndi anthu angati aku Malawi omwe avulala ku South Africa. Likufuna kuti boma linene kuti ndi anthu angati omwe abwerera kwawo komanso ndalama zomwe zagwiritsidwa ntchito. NAP yafunsanso za ndalama zamatauni ndi midzi. Ndalama zimenezi zimatchedwa Constituency Development Fund. Zimabwera mochedwa ndipo zimachedwetsa ntchito zomanga. NAP idauza aphungu a nyumba yamalamulo kuti agwire ntchito limodzi ndikuyika Malawi patsogolo. Nyumba yamalamulo iyenera kufunsa mafunso ovuta okhudza ndalama ndi mphamvu. Iyenera kuonetsetsa kuti boma likuchita zoyenera.

en.title: Young doctor found dead at home in Blantyre
en.body: Dr Favour Atughanile Chomo, age 28, was found dead at her home in Mount Pleasant, Blantyre on Wednesday. She was a medical doctor at Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital. Police say she died under unclear circumstances. Her body had a rope around the neck. Her hands and feet were tied. Police have started an investigation.
en.body_more:
Dr Chomo worked in the Emergency Centre at Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital. She joined the hospital in January this year. Before that, she finished her medical degree in March 2024 from Kamuzu University of Health Sciences. She was the top student at Maranatha Academy school. After she finished school, she went back to work there as a teacher.

Southern Region Police spokesperson Beatrice Mikuwa said investigators are working to find who did this. No suspects have been named yet. The hospital director, Professor Patrick Kamalo, said Dr Chomo was a good doctor. "She was reliable and committed. We are very sad," he said. Maranatha Academy said she was a brilliant and kind person. "She was our daughter, our colleague and a friend to many."

Steve Mlangiza, from the Medical Doctors Union of Malawi, said the country does not have enough doctors. "We already have very few medical doctors. Losing one leaves a huge gap in our work," he said. This death comes months after Dr Victoria Bobe, a gynaecologist, was killed at her home in Chigumula, Blantyre. Six people are in court for that killing.

ny.title: Dokotala wachinyamata wapezeka atafa kunyumba ku Blantyre
ny.body: Dokotala Favour Atughanile Chomo, wazaka 28, adapezeka atafa kunyumba kwake ku Mount Pleasant, Blantyre Lachitatu. Iye anali dokotala ku Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital. Apolisi akuti anamwalira pazifukwa zosadziwika bwino. Thupi lake linali ndi chingwe m'khosi. Manja ndi mapazi ake anali omangidwa. Apolisi ayamba kufufuza.
ny.body_more:
Dr Chomo ankagwira ntchito ku Emergency Centre ku Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital. Analowa mchipatalachi mu Januwale chaka chino. Asanamalize digiri yake ya udokotala mu Marichi 2024 kuchokera ku Kamuzu University of Health Sciences. Anali wophunzira wapamwamba kwambiri pasukulu ya Maranatha Academy. Atamaliza sukulu, anabwerera kuntchito kumeneko monga mphunzitsi.

Wolankhulira apolisi aku Southern Region Beatrice Mikuwa anati ofufuza akugwira ntchito kuti apeze amene anachita izi. Palibe amene watchulidwa mayina. Mtsogoleri wa chipatalachi, Pulofesa Patrick Kamalo, anati Dr Chomo anali dokotala wabwino. "Anali wodalirika komanso wodzipereka. Tili achisoni kwambiri," adatero. Maranatha Academy inati anali munthu wanzeru komanso wokoma mtima. "Anali mwana wathu wamkazi, mnzathu komanso bwenzi la ambiri."

Steve Mlangiza, wa Medical Doctors Union of Malawi, anati dzikolo lilibe madokotala okwanira. "Tili kale ndi madokotala ochepa kwambiri. Kutaya m'modzi kumasiya kusiyana kwakukulu pantchito yathu," adatero. Imfa iyi ikubwera miyezi ingapo Dr Victoria Bobe, katswiri wa matenda a akazi, ataphedwa kunyumba kwake ku Chigumula, Blantyre. Anthu asanu ndi mmodzi ali kukhoti chifukwa cha kupha munthuyo.

en.title: Doctor's husband tells court of home attack and wife's death
en.body: Yamikani Bobe told the High Court in Blantyre how armed men broke into his home on November 17, 2025. His wife, Victoria Bobe, a 33-year-old doctor, was shot and killed. Seven men are on trial for her murder. Yamikani said he watched the attack happen and tried to protect his wife.
en.body_more:
Victoria was a consultant obstetrician and gynaecologist. She worked at Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital and taught at Kamuzu University of Health Sciences. On the night of the attack, she woke Yamikani after hearing footsteps outside their home in Chigumula, Blantyre. When he checked the living room, he found some windows open.

Yamikani told the court that one of the suspects pointed a gun at him. He and Victoria ran to the bedroom and held the door shut. Victoria sent a message on WhatsApp to ask the neighbourhood watch for help. Then Yamikani heard a loud gunshot. The bullet came through the bedroom door and hit Victoria in the head. The attackers forced their way in. They had pangas and asked for money and dollars. Yamikani gave them his wife's handbag, a laptop bag with a MacBook, and a bank machine. He also offered to move money from a bank account, but the men left.

In court, Yamikani said he later pointed out two of the seven accused men. He knew them by marks on their faces and bodies. The men pleaded not guilty to murder, robbery and burglary. A retired police officer, Jimmy Kanyerere, also gave evidence. He was the neighbourhood watch leader. He said he saw Victoria's WhatsApp message at 11.34 pm. When he went outside, men told him in Chichewa to mind his business or he would die. He later saw stolen mobile phones near the Bobe home. The state says it will call nine witnesses in total.

ny.title: Mwamuna wa dokotala auza khoti za kuukiridwa kunyumba ndi imfa ya mkazi wake
ny.body: Yamikani Bobe adauza Khoti Lalikulu ku Blantyre momwe amuna okhala ndi zida adalowa mnyumba mwake pa Novembala 17, 2025. Mkazi wake, Victoria Bobe, dokotala wazaka 33, adawomberedwa ndi kuphedwa. Amuna asanu ndi awiri akuimbidwa mlandu wopha mkazi wake. Yamikani adati adawonera kuukiraku kukuchitika ndipo adayesetsa kuteteza mkazi wake.
ny.body_more:
Victoria anali katswiri wa za mimba komanso dokotala wa matenda a akazi. Ankagwira ntchito ku Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital ndipo ankaphunzitsa ku Kamuzu University of Health Sciences. Usiku wa kuukirako, anadzutsa Yamikani atamva mapazi kunja kwa nyumba yawo ku Chigumula, Blantyre. Atayang'ana chipinda chochezera, anapeza mawindo otseguka.

Yamikani anauza khoti kuti m'modzi mwa okayikiridwayo anamuloza mfuti. Iye ndi Victoria anathamangira kuchipinda chogona ndipo anatseka chitseko. Victoria anatumiza uthenga pa WhatsApp kuti akapemphe thandizo kwa oyang'anira m'deralo. Kenako Yamikani anamva kulira kwa mfuti kwakukulu. Chipolopolocho chinadutsa pakhomo la chipinda chogona ndipo chinagunda Victoria pamutu. Owukirawo analowa mwachangu. Anali ndi ma panga ndipo anapempha ndalama ndi ndalama. Yamikani anawapatsa chikwama cha mkazi wake, chikwama cha laputopu chokhala ndi MacBook, ndi makina a banki. Anaperekanso kuti achotse ndalama kuchokera ku akaunti ya banki, koma amunawo anachoka.

M'khoti, Yamikani anati pambuyo pake analoza amuna awiri mwa asanu ndi awiri omwe akuimbidwa mlandu. Anawadziwa ndi zizindikiro pankhope ndi matupi awo. Amunawo anakana mlandu wakupha, kuba ndi kuba. Wapolisi wopuma pantchito, Jimmy Kanyerere, nayenso anapereka umboni. Iye anali mtsogoleri wa gulu loyang'anira anthu ammudzi. Anati adawona uthenga wa pa WhatsApp wa Victoria nthawi ya 11:34 pm. Atatuluka panja, amuna adamuuza mu Chichewa kuti asamalire nkhani zake apo ayi angamwalire. Pambuyo pake adawona mafoni obedwa pafupi ndi nyumba ya Bobe. Boma likuti liitana mboni zisanu ndi zinayi zonse.

en.title: Malawi football sets K1 billion fundraising goal for women's team
en.body: The Football Association of Malawi wants to raise K1 billion. They will hold a dinner on Friday. The dinner is for the Malawi Scorchers women's football team. The team will play at the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations. The dinner will be at Bingu International Convention Centre in Lilongwe.
en.body_more:
The First Lady Gertrude Mutharika will attend the dinner as guest of honour. The Football Association has set aside 500 tables for companies and supporters to buy. Money from the dinner will help the team prepare for the tournament in Morocco.

Mayamiko Kafwamba works for the Football Association. He said the dinner will help raise money for the team. Blantyre City Mayor Isaac Jomo Osman will help sell tickets in the Southern Region. Ivy Chinangwa will help sell tickets in Lilongwe. Ivy Chinangwa works for Malawi National Council of Sports.

The dinner will also show the new Scorchers shirt. The team will wear this shirt at the tournament. Government leaders, companies and football fans will come to the dinner. They will say goodbye to the team before the tournament.

The Scorchers are in Group C at the tournament. They will play Nigeria, Zambia and Egypt. Nigeria won the last tournament. The Football Association asked companies and fans to buy tables and tickets. They said the money will help women's football grow in Malawi.

ny.title: Mpira wa ku Malawi wakhazikitsa cholinga chopezera ndalama zokwana K1 biliyoni ku timu ya azimayi
ny.body: Bungwe la Mpira wa Miguu la Malawi likufuna kusonkhanitsa K1 biliyoni. Adzachita chakudya chamadzulo Lachisanu. Chakudya chamadzulo ndi cha timu ya mpira wa azimayi ya Malawi Scorchers. Gululo lidzasewera pa mpikisano wa Women's Africa Cup of Nations wa 2026. Chakudya chamadzulo chidzachitikira ku Bingu International Convention Centre ku Lilongwe.
ny.body_more:
Mkazi Woyamba Gertrude Mutharika adzapezeka pa chakudya chamadzulo ngati mlendo wolemekezeka. Bungwe la Mpira laika pambali matebulo 500 kuti makampani ndi othandizira agule. Ndalama zochokera pa chakudya chamadzulo zithandiza gululo kukonzekera mpikisano ku Morocco.

Mayamiko Kafwamba amagwira ntchito ku Bungwe la Mpira. Iye anati chakudya chamadzulo chithandiza kupeza ndalama za gululo. Meya wa mzinda wa Blantyre Isaac Jomo Osman athandiza kugulitsa matikiti ku Southern Region. Ivy Chinangwa athandiza kugulitsa matikiti ku Lilongwe. Ivy Chinangwa amagwira ntchito ku Malawi National Council of Sports.

Chakudya chamadzulo chidzawonetsanso malaya atsopano a Scorchers. Gululo lidzavala malaya awa pa mpikisano. Atsogoleri aboma, makampani ndi okonda mpira adzabwera ku chakudya chamadzulo. Adzatsanzikana ndi gululo mpikisano usanayambe.

Scorchers ali mu Gulu C pa mpikisano. Adzasewera ndi Nigeria, Zambia ndi Egypt. Nigeria idapambana mpikisano womaliza. Bungwe la Mpira lapempha makampani ndi okonda kuti agule matebulo ndi matikiti. Anati ndalamazo zithandiza kukula kwa mpira wa azimayi ku Malawi.

en.title: Egypt loses to Argentina in World Cup match
en.body: Egypt lost 3-2 to Argentina in a World Cup game on Tuesday in Atlanta. Egypt led 2-0 until the 79th minute. Argentina then scored three goals to win. Coach Hossam Hassan said the referee made bad decisions.
en.body_more:
The match was played at Atlanta Stadium. Egypt took the lead in the 15th minute when Yasser Ibrahim scored with his head. Egypt made it 2-0 in the 67th minute when Mostafa Ziko scored. Argentina started their comeback in the 79th minute. Cristian Romero scored first. Lionel Messi then scored to make it 2-2. In the second minute of stoppage time, Enzo Fernandez scored the winning goal for Argentina. The final score was 3-2.

Coach Hossam Hassan was angry after the game. He said the referee made unfair decisions. Hassan said Egypt should have had a penalty. He also said a goal by Mostafa Ziko was wrongly taken away. "What happened to us was not fair," Hassan said. "Even if mistakes happened, the biggest mistake is not getting what you must get from the people who decide." Hassan said he would not watch more games in the tournament. He also praised his players. "With our home players, plus Mohamed Salah and Omar Marmoush, we could play with any team," he said.

Forward Mostafa Ziko also spoke against the referee. "The referee was bad and unfair," Ziko said. "He did not want us to win." Ziko ended with a joke: "Well done to Argentina on another World Cup win." Messi scored eight goals in the tournament. This was his best result so far. Argentina will now play the winner of the match between Switzerland and Colombia. Egypt leaves the tournament after reaching the knockout stage for the first time since 2014.

ny.title: Egypt yagonja ndi Argentina pamasewera a World Cup
ny.body: Egypt idagonjetsedwa ndi Argentina 3-2 pamasewera a World Cup Lachiwiri ku Atlanta. Egypt idatsogolera 2-0 mpaka mphindi 79. Kenako Argentina idapeza zigoli zitatu kuti ipambane. Mphunzitsi Hossam Hassan adati woweruzayo adapanga zisankho zoyipa.
ny.body_more:
Masewerowa adachitikira ku Atlanta Stadium. Egypt idatsogola mu mphindi ya 15 pomwe Yasser Ibrahim adagoletsa ndi mutu wake. Egypt idagoletsa 2-0 mu mphindi ya 67 pomwe Mostafa Ziko adagoletsa. Argentina idayamba kubwerera kwawo mu mphindi ya 79. Cristian Romero adagoletsa koyamba. Lionel Messi kenako adagoletsa kuti 2-2. Mu mphindi yachiwiri yopuma, Enzo Fernandez adagoletsa chigoli chopambana cha Argentina. Chigoli chomaliza chinali 3-2.

Mphunzitsi Hossam Hassan adakwiya pambuyo pa masewerawa. Adati woweruza adapanga zisankho zosalungama. Hassan adati Egypt iyenera kukhala ndi penalty.
